[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fs1qnYD.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work

​

Melee AFK Method (85 kph) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Overview

Useful Items and Unlocks
⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Equipment
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_2h_sword Masterwork 2H Sword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274330676061278334.png?v=1 masterwork2hsword]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 eruptive2] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Gloves_of_passage Gloves of Passage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1 glovesofpassage] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vestments_of_havoc_armour Vestments of havoc armour] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189297659940904.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavochood]     • Full Set [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1 ultimatums4] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Ket Igneous Kal-Ket] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Zuk Igneous Kal-Zuk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]     • Expect less kph if not using
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_Roar Chaos Roar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar]     • Expect less kph if not using ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Fury Greater Fury] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury]     • May replace with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879510372352.png?v=1 fury] if unowned
Other
⬥ 0 Mech (85 kph)     • Assumes [https://runescape.wiki/w/Arch-Glacor#Mechanics no mechanics are enabled]     • Allows for the highest kph     • No prayers required ⬥ 2 Mech (60 kph)     • Assumes [https://runescape.wiki/w/Arch-Glacor#Mechanics Flurry and Frost Cannon mechanics are enabled]     • Better for charms and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/884739993527013426.png?v=1 darknilas]     • Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=e54f8126-5a67-4af2-b282-a975cb12b9b5 Melee (0 Mech)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7a639b95-b6d7-4e7e-999c-0ed474704733 Melee (2 Mech)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fe54f8126-5a67-4af2-b282-a975cb12b9b5.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bars

⬥ 0 Mech

[https://img.pvme.io/images/0n5JNcBqXi.png Guide illustration] ⬥ 2 Mech

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X5CvvlTzW5.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-M1w2d2Xl_c Melee (0 Mech)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/a26Ztpkpa5w Melee (2 Mech)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Necromancy AFK Method (~80 kph) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

Useful Items and Unlocks
⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Equipment
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Occultist%27s_ring Occultist's ring] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1245442140318863490.png?v=1 occultistring]     • Passive effect will increase kph ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mor Igneous Kal-Mor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Zuk Igneous Kal-Zuk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]     • Expect less kph if not using
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army Conjure Undead Army] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]     • Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie] are selected     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109199069806604.png?v=1 conjurephantom] not required
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Equilibrium_aura Equilibrium] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Mahjarrat_aura Mahjarrat] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1 mahj]     • Not required but increase kph ⬥ This method does not require [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split Soul Split] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]     • You may opt to not use a damage prayer to increase AFK time     • Expect less kph if not using ⬥ This guide assumes [https://runescape.wiki/w/Arch-Glacor#Mechanics no mechanics are enabled]     • This allows for the highest kph

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=vLCQDFIDnEBmlFNaodoA Necromancy (T90)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=gwoolHpQwuAr9Qd0wgil Necromancy (T95-T100)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FgwoolHpQwuAr9Qd0wgil.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ddDtJrxvu9.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] is unowned, place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] in its slot

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/w8ak1nFvIpk Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026.

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work.

​

Introduction

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Binding_contract_(blood_reaver) Blood Reaver binding contracts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] are a good alternative to bossing for generating GP and a necessary evil for ironmen who wish to pursue many of the strategies outlined in PVME.

​

⬥ The below method assumes you have already prepared or collected your blank Binding Contracts from either:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Making them yourself after the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dagon_Bye Dragon Bye] quest

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Getting from [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_casket Ancient Caskets] (in stacks of 50)

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ZtFaoGl6zk.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Inside Nex's encampment, stand in the south-middle area

⬥ You will be dragged around as you are aggro'd

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Occasionally a Blood Reaver may walk away - you may wish to click them manually (or wait for it to wander back into range)

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

The majority of the below items and unlocks will increase your KPH, but are not mandatory:
Essential items:
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enchanted_notepaper Enchanted notepaper] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1 notepaper] for noting the contracts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch]
Non-essential items:
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) Demon Slayer (perk)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_slayer_equipment Demon slayer equipment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325697503907910.png?v=1 demonslayercirclet] ⬥ Damage-boosting auras like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1 mahj] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505652571963417.png?v=1 darkmagic] ⬥ Damage-boosting prayers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]     • Require extra prayer restoration from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1 penanceaura]
Poison-boosting:
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison%2B%2B%2B#(4) Weapon Poison+++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane_gloves Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_sticks Kwuarm sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Binding_contract_(blood_reaver) Blood reaver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vampyrism_aura Vampyrism aura] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1 vampaura]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] Ranged AFK Method (500+ kph)

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3m2Mi55EI1NlbyBzyNaC Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3m2Mi55EI1NlbyBzyNaC.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/I0jizlZPem.png Guide illustration] ​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] Necromancy AFK Method (500+ kph)

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ZcWKKyaPc7mDxPgU1aiD Necromancy preset (500+ pouches/hour)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FZcWKKyaPc7mDxPgU1aiD.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vMxsd6mIew.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://youtu.be/WbqFUolfT-Y Necromancy - 500 pouches/hour (no DPS prayer/familiar)]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://youtu.be/weoqmxvlpHw Ranged - 600 pouches/hour (with DPS prayer + familiar)]

​

AFK Method

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Useful Items and Unlocks
⬥ High tier (T85+) weapons: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809239255658587.png?v=1 skulllantern90] ⬥ 25+ Prayer bonus. Dragon Rider armour is an easy way to achieve this ⬥ Conservation of Energy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1 conservationofenergy] (only if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]) ⬥ Demon Horn Necklace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and Bonecrusher [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher] to upkeep prayer ⬥ Zuk cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk] (not needed for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]) ⬥ Any cannon variant [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] ⬥ Desolation / Anguish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] is active (only if Ranged) ⬥ Equilibrium aura [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] is a good choice due to its duration

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=5u3OF4Jb9zXCG92zF6tI Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=l5ctFI8ZkMyX3sxk8LiC Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fl5ctFI8ZkMyX3sxk8LiC.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Methods tested/updated: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HikgVgk3I1.png Guide illustration] ​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work.

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5MEmT1vJob.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] and stand on the tile marked above.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon entering the instance, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] once and stand on the tile south of the northernmost grave.

⬥ You may get moved due to the Corporeal Beast sometimes wandering around.

​

Melee AFK Method (80+ kph) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure.     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]].
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Essence_of_Finality_amulet EoF] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] may be substituted for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Am-hej Am-Hej Amulet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Wen Scripture of Wen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen] may be substituted for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Underworld_Grimoire_4 Underworld Grimoire 4][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1 underworldgrimoire4]
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kinetic_cyclone Upgraded Kinetic cyclone] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] ⬥ Multiple forms of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Poison poison damage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison+++#(4) Weapon poison+++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] for prayer restoration

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7399de7e-0dda-4b40-a177-389c1504f72f Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F7399de7e-0dda-4b40-a177-389c1504f72f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bars

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/CYoKQpzvXO.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8wyi_I85vc Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Necromancy AFK Method (Outdated) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure.     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]].
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Amulet_of_souls Amulet of souls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_elven_ritual_shard Ancient elven ritual shard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] causes issues with prayer sustain from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1 penanceaura] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mor Igneous Kal-Mor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Zuk Igneous Kal-Zuk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army Conjure Undead Army] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]     • Customised to conjure all spirits.
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness]     • Causes issues with prayer sustain from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1 penanceaura] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kinetic_cyclone Kinetic cyclone] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone]     • Ideally upgraded [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271733481493.png?v=1 kineticcycloneupgradekit] ⬥ Multiple forms of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Poison poison damage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane_gloves Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison+++#(4) Weapon poison+++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=xCFgfUoCqJC7AdulrFOR Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FxCFgfUoCqJC7AdulrFOR.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sxkxX7Hq1R.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/N91lzaNBLls?si=4GSEOEuWS9yoBbq6 Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Laniakea%27s_spear Laniakea's spear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Blood_amulet_of_fury Brawler's Blood Necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1534423392827080714.png?v=1 brawlersbloodnecklace] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes]     • Use weapon poison+++ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] / Kwuarm incense sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_retribution Ring of Retribution] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1511674831945334894.png?v=1 ringofretribution] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Strength_cape Strength skillcape] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] or its perk from Anachronia cape stand or max cape ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lesser_Bone_Shield Lesser bone shield] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1 lesserboneshield]

Items

[https://img.pvme.io/images/DJOEamAm4N.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work

​

Positioning

There are links below to each faction's arena map, showing the boss spawn location and your optimal AFK positioning:

⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/MPxyX1s1c6.png General Graardor]

⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/dLgTPaGWgY.png Kree'arra]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: due to Kree's special attack, the player will move frequently. As such, there is little benefit in a starting position.

⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/TBn9UjCOMu.png K'ril Tsutsaroth]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other player position is for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] specifically.

⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/4oIsmkO7SE.png Commander Zilyana]

​

Necromancy AFK Method [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783476169441401.png?v=1 dealertop80] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Deathdealer_robe_armour Deathdealer robes]     • Used for the passive ability to apply the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Mark Death Mark] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] debuff ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator Attuned Ectoplasmator] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon Horn Necklace]     • To further support prayer renewal at K'ril     • Can be substituted for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Essence_of_Finality_amulet Essence of Finality] for marginally faster kills
Talent Tree Unlocks
⬥ Tiers 1-2     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Skeleton_Warrior Conjure Skeleton Warrior] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Command_Skeleton_Warrior Command Skeleton Warrior] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] ⬥ Tiers 5-6     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness]
Prayers
⬥ Pray [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split Soul split] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sorrow Sorrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow]     • You will need to periodically use your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] to restore prayer     • You can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination] at the cost of renewing prayer points more frequently     • You may also have to take a few sips of a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Prayer#Prayer-restoring_potions prayer-restoring potion] throughout the hour depending on damage taken     • For K'ril: use your overload or prayer restoration after entering the instance as your prayer will be drained
Other
⬥ Your [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_(familiar) Ripper Demon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] does not require scrolls ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Corrupted_slayer_helmet Slayer Helmet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] (preferably on [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_helmet_stand Anachronia Stand])     • Provides bonuses against K'ril when on a Greater Demon task     • Provides bonuses against Kree when on an Aviansies task ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594794631198.png?v=1 intimidationtotem] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Totem_of_Intimidation Totem of Intimidation]     • To reduce the 40kc entry requirement

⬥ The method is very similar for all four GWD1 bosses, with slight exceptions as listed above for Kree'arra and K'ril Tsutsaroth.

⬥ Gear can be downgraded but you should expect more manual intervention and a lower KPH.

⬥ You may have to manually attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.

​

Preset and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1df551be-8d55-4fa1-87e3-2e801ab62d28 Necromancy AFK preset]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F1df551be-8d55-4fa1-87e3-2e801ab62d28.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bars [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VagVW62t1G.png Guide illustration] ​

KPH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ General Graardor - 90+

⬥ Kree'arra - 60+

⬥ K'ril Tsutsaroth - 80+

⬥ Commander Zilyana - 80+

​

Ranged AFK Method [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Comparison_of_high-level_ranged_weapons T87+ ranged weapons] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Xil Igneous Kal-Xil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Amascut Scripture of Amascut] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut]     • Other pocket slots can be used ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Amulet_of_souls Amulet of Souls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon Horn Necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator Attuned Ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator] should be used for prayer upkeep at K'ril
Other
⬥ Pray [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split Soul Split] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] + [https://runescape.wiki/w/Anguish Anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Desolation Desolation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation] requires additional prayer restoration ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594794631198.png?v=1 intimidationtotem] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Totem_of_Intimidation Totem of Intimidation]     • To reduce the 40kc entry requirement

⬥ The requirements for these encounters aren't high, however downgrading too much will negatively impact survivability and kph.

⬥ You may have to manually attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.

​

Preset and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2c73d446-37f3-420d-9b8d-db0f3a19c09f Ranged AFK preset] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F2c73d446-37f3-420d-9b8d-db0f3a19c09f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Note: Gear may be upgraded where available.

​

Action Bars [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/P6Bj48iSnn.png Guide illustration] ​

Magic AFK Method [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Comparison_of_high-level_magic_weapons T87+ magic weapons] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891361641365515.png?v=1 obliteration] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mej Igneous Kal-Mej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Amascut Scripture of Amascut] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut]     • Other pocket slots can be used ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Amulet_of_souls Amulet of Souls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon Horn Necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator Attuned Ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator] should be used for prayer upkeep at K'ril ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kerapac%27s_wrist_wraps Kerapac's wrist wraps] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869286640722513940.png?v=1 kerapacswristwraps]
Other
⬥ Pray [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split Soul Split] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] + [https://runescape.wiki/w/Torment Torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Affliction Affliction] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction] requires additional prayer restoration ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594794631198.png?v=1 intimidationtotem] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Totem_of_Intimidation Totem of Intimidation]     • To reduce the 40 kc entry requirement

⬥ The requirements for these encounters aren't high, however downgrading too much will negatively impact survivability and kph.

⬥ You may have to manually attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/j7RO67GrYD.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work.

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/SD1TVTad5N.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Enter instance, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and take 2 more steps forward.

​

Necromancy AFK Method (55+ kph) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure.     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]].
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet (e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane_gloves Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison+++#(4) Weapon poison+++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance Powder of Penance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mor Igneous Kal-Mor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Zuk Igneous Kal-Zuk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Command_Vengeful_Ghost Command Vengeful Ghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost]     • Only required for high-level setup with minion skips. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Spectral_Scythe#Cast_3 Spectral Scythe (Cast 3)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3]     • Only required for low-level setup without minion skips.
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness]     • Only required for low-level setup without minion skips. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_scarab Holy Scarab] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab]     • Doesn't require scrolls. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Undead_Slayer Undead Slayer perk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]     • Ideally paired with regular dps perks.

​

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=o1KmzTMjk0bFgBX4XkYu Necromancy - Low-level] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=qkkKruNMoSgfdr7aFWra Necromancy - High-level] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

⬥ A low-level preset (~47 KPH) is provided for when minions cannot (yet) be skipped:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] to help with survivability.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] is not required for survival you can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] instead.

⬥ The First Necromancer gear (+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ) can also be used for similar KPH.

⬥ Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination] over [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] is a small KPH increase.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FqkkKruNMoSgfdr7aFWra.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bars [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ High-level: minion skips

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ASHd9IMRen.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Low-level: without minion skips

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Fb65eOtSjY.png Guide illustration] ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If healing is an issue, put [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton]

​

KPH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ At Level 120 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] one can expect ~40s kill times and ~55 KPH with the high-level method.

⬥ The low-level method yields ~47 KPH with t90 weapons, t80 power armour and Level 90 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]; assuming the method requirements are met.

​

Example Kills [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LqJPeJ_zuMc High-level Hermod example]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

This guide is intended to be used in addition to the AFK and Low Effort guides. It will provide some assumed unlocks, and setup decisions that are omitted from specific guides to increase readability.

​

⬥ These guides can often be used for extended sessions if you bring more supplies which is useful for places where you can extend the instance such as GWD2

​

DISCLAIMER: IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)], and check this guide if you cannot get it to work

​

Definitions

Within these guides there are two levels of AFK you will see mentioned:

​

AFK

⬥ These do not usually require any attention to the game

⬥ You may still need to interact infrequently, for example: clicking to prevent lobbying, drinking potions, using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard], collecting loot, healing familiars with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alt1 can usually be used to notify you of these

​

Low Effort

⬥ These usually do require you to pay attention to the game, and are instead used to heavily reduce inputs required to kill a boss

⬥ In addition to those listed above under AFK, example interactions include: queuing an ability before the fight, repositioning every kill, banking between kills, moving out of the way of mechanics, eating food at low health

​

Assumed Setup

Several parts of AFK methods are assumed as mandatory (i.e., unless stated otherwise these should always be used for the method to work):

​

Prayers:

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split Soul Split] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/T95_prayers T95 prayers] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow]

​

Perks & Relics:

⬥ Basic perks on weapon and armour (see [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]])

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Persistent_Rage Persistent Rage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage]

​

Items:

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Elder_overload_salve#(6) Elder Overload Salve] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance Powder of penance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_luck_potion Enhanced luck potion] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717295935500.png?v=1 luckpotion]

​

Other:

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Auto-retaliate Auto Retaliate] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] active

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_vigour Ring of vigour] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] passive unlocked from the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction Extinction] quest

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] should not be active

​

Common Items

You may also see the below items commonly used across AFK methods - these are not assumed by default:

​

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Spring_cleaner Spring Cleaner] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170723130937427.png?v=1 springcleaner] to automatically alch / disassemble drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_wrench Holy Wrench] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588922417192.png?v=1 holywrench] to boost prayer restoration

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Potion_reservoir Potion Reservoir] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739200407654431.png?v=1 potionreservoir] to automatically drink potions

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Excalibur Enhanced Excalibur] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] to provide free healing every 5 minutes

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_elven_ritual_shard Ancient Elven Ritual Shard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] to provide free prayer points every 5 minutes

​

Top tips: Using Alt1's AFK Warden

To set up alt1 AFK Warden you can include several useful warnings.

⬥ HP Alert

⬥ Prayer Alert

⬥ Loot Beam

⬥ Inventory Full

⬥ Animate Dead

⬥ Overload

⬥ Weapon Poison

⬥ Summoning Familiar HP Alert

⬥ Kerapac Kill

⬥ Lobby timer

​

Depending on the boss you are doing, you can activate different ones of these, and set the HP threshold to a suitable level for the risk of your setup. Doing this will allow you to eat / excal to stop a death.

​

You can add all of these by clicking the save icon on alt1, and then importing the following text:

[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvme/pvme-guides/master/afk/PVME-Alt1-Setup.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvme/pvme-guides/master/afk/PVME-Alt1-Setup.txt]

​

Positioning

Positioning yourself in melee distance of where they spawn is not necessary, but is safer.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/F2iSmgl0OR.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work

​

Magic Low Effort Method (~35 kph)

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nQtbmH129c.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Always start on center Mushroom, use Bladed dive to one of the shown tiles (mushrooms directly North, East, South or West) if starting tile gets mushroom. Ensure you are stood directly on top of the mushroom caps of the BD tiles to avoid overlap in Mushroom Barrage.

​

Mandatory Requirements
⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mej Igneous Kal-Mej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Amascut Scripture of Amascut] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Excalibur Enhanced excalibur] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison%2B%2B%2B#(4) Weapon Poison +++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_death Ring of Death] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_Penance Powder of Penance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Animate_Dead Animate Dead] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Emerald_Aurora Emerald Aurora] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/914077639784935424.png?v=1 emeraldaurora]
Other
⬥ Thermal Bath and Bonfire HP boost     • Wearing HP boosting armour when you get your bonfire boost will increase the amount of bonus health received from the bonfire ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vampyrism Vampyrism] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1 vampaura] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Hellhound_(familiar) Hellhound familiar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=UCC8bbJXtWooe1Pdoydc Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FUCC8bbJXtWooe1Pdoydc.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mUj3Lg902a.png Guide illustration] ​

Necromancy Low Effort Methods (45-50 kph)

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wU3zbtwBmj.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Pink "Other" Tiles - Mushroom buds that you should only stand directly on top of are marked pink above. This is because some adjacent tiles have an increased chance of death due to the possibility of getting hit by multiple Mushroom Barrage attacks at once.

⬥ Position yourself on the tile shown above (the adjacent tile north of the mushroom bud) and avoid gas clouds when they spawn by moving to any safe tile if necessary. Once you are safe from the first set of gas clouds you do not need to move again for the rest of the fight.

⬥ A quick and easy way to remember which tile is safe is to never stand 2 tiles from mushroom buds, but on top of or directly adjacent to mushroom buds as they are normally safe.

​

Mandatory Requirements
⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Adrenaline_renewal_potion#(4) Adrenaline Renewal] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mor Igneous Kal-Mor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Jas Scripture of Jas] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1 scriptureofjas] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Excalibur Enhanced excalibur] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane_gloves Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison%2B%2B%2B#(4) Weapon Poison +++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_death Ring of Death] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod]
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invoke_Death Invoke Death] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army Conjure Undead Army] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]
Other
⬥ Thermal Bath and Bonfire HP boost     • Wearing HP boosting armour when you get your bonfire boost will increase the amount of bonus health received from the bonfire ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Mahjarrat_aura Mahjarrat aura] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1 mahj] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dark_magic_aura Dark Magic aura] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505652571963417.png?v=1 darkmagic] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Ward Death Ward Relic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1 deathward] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Hellhound_(familiar) Hellhound familiar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3PAH9i5rPpLCl6gBMoE8 Necromancy Deathwarden] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=cx1x3YPD4fAzMZy8qAHm Necromancy TFN] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fcx1x3YPD4fAzMZy8qAHm.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ You can save your preset with the excalibur [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] equipped to automatically dismiss your conjures when banking.

⬥ Using the deathwarden setup you are likely to encounter the Mushroom Barrage mechanic. Be aware that Mushroom Barrage explosions will still damage you after Helwyr has died if the spawn animation has begun.

⬥ Avoid going south of the starting tile with the deathwarden setup. This will allow you to automatically dodge one of the early mushroom barrage attacks and increase survivability.

​

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4zYgyH2bLd.png Guide illustration]

The fight

⬥ This method requires teleporting to War's Retreat after every kill to replenish prayer, adrenaline, familiar and player health, and reset cooldowns.

⬥ Cross the barrier to enter the boss room → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → (tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] + Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur]

⬥ Turning Auto-Retaliate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] on is recommended. If you have Auto-Retaliate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] off you will need to manually use soul sap at the beginning to start revolution.

⬥ It is not recommended to click on Helwyr to begin attacking due to the delay compared to target cycle. There is a small window to kill the boss before you are overwhelmed by the Mushroom Barrage.

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1enrEzEffvQ Magic Example] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/HvMh6PpLRvc Necromancy Example] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_(familiar) Ripper Demon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch], scrolls optional ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Nodon_dragonkin_(Slayer_assignment) Nodon dragonkin] task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107324853596251.png?v=1 nodondragonkin]     • Slayer helmet stand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Bonfire_Boost_Active Bonfire Boost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ogre_flask_(thermal) Ogre flask (thermal)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enriched_pontifex_shadow_ring Enriched pontifex shadow ring] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring] passive is unlocked. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance Penance powder] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Penance_aura Penance aura] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1 penanceaura]

⬥ If using Ek-ZekKil queue [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 zekkil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] ‎ ‎before respawn

⬥ Optionally at the start of the kill throw a Vulnerability Bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] if under 5k LP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively you may bank.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1be73c06-d0a8-49c2-a5de-a44b8b644bd2 Melee - Dual Wield] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] - Has been tested to work with Elder rune and Masterwork Top/Bottom/Boots instead of Vestments

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=32f0b99e-77c2-4b62-980e-1db898439b84 Melee - Ek-ZekKil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] - May replace Ek-ZekKil with [https://runescape.wiki/w/mwsoa Masterwork Spear of Annihilation][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F1be73c06-d0a8-49c2-a5de-a44b8b644bd2.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar (DW and 2H)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vuqPYuCF9c.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Necromancy Low Effort Method [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Eof Essence of Finality] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes]     • Use weapon poison+++ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] / Kwuarm incense sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_wen Scripture of Wen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Mor Igneous Kal-Mor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Igneous_Kal-Zuk Igneous Kal-Zuk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Grasp EoF Death Grasp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]     • Method may be less consistent without it.
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_(familiar) Ripper Demon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Nodon_dragonkin_(Slayer_assignment) Nodon dragonkin] task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107324853596251.png?v=1 nodondragonkin]     • Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Bonfire_Boost_Active Bonfire Boost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ogre_flask_(thermal) Ogre flask (thermal)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enriched_pontifex_shadow_ring Enriched pontifex shadow ring] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring] passive is unlocked. ⬥ Aura priority: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1 vampaura] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1 penanceaura]

⬥ Resummon conjures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] OR wait for boss to respawn and throw [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb]

⬥ Optionally queue [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] before respawn.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] if under 2.4k LP.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ee56929d-c410-4b31-a904-3366c4a60e66 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fee56929d-c410-4b31-a904-3366c4a60e66.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Hw8x0VfpkD.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJErWG9V-UA Necromancy Low Effort] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Alt1 Kerapac NM Helper

This tool reads your screen, and based on certain lines of dialogue in your chatbox, will trigger and play voice lines during the kill to let you know about upcoming mechanics and what to do for them.

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/GsMXUrqIm6.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/C2MBKJpjDW.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Enter instance and stand on the west tile against the Soul Obelisk.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1 keytothecrossing] to start the encounter.

Specifically for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]:

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1 keytothecrossing] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Magister spawns adjacent to you, take 1 step north.

⬥ After the kill use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] again. Repeat (See video for example).

​

Note: the 3x3 area on the map shows the possible spawn tiles for the Magister.

​

Magic Low Effort Method (75+ KPH) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Items
⬥ Powder of Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]     • Use before hour starts. ⬥ Kwuarm incense sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks]     • Use before hour starts. ⬥ Ripper demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] scrolls and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 spiritsticks], pre-summoned)   or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1 smokenihil] (if low accuracy) ⬥ Cinderbane gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ⬥ Weapon poison +++ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ Igneous Kal-Mej [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej]
Abilities
⬥ Exsanguinate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] unlocked ⬥ Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] unlocked

⬥ The following are highly recommended for increased profits:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 lotd] or another source of tier 4 luck increases [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643166362361004042.png?v=1 phylactery] drop rate from 1/18 to 1/17.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vital spark enhancers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1151164471813865623.png?v=1 sparkenhancer] double the drop.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] for higher max lifepoints. Stacks with bonfire boost.

⬥ pouches breakdown:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439136875253810.png?v=1 graspingpouchblack] Runes - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1 bloodrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658961481769.png?v=1 astralrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659301089280.png?v=1 bodyrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660333019136.png?v=1 soulrune]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439126519644271.png?v=1 graspingpouchpink] Runes - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659586433024.png?v=1 deathrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1 earthrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252661406760970.png?v=1 lawrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659615924258.png?v=1 cosmicrune]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439129275306164.png?v=1 graspingpouchblue] Runes - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659422855188.png?v=1 chaosrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 airrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1 waterrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1 firerune]

(Runes for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate])

​

Note: if you need to downgrade gear, using Animate Dead [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] with T70+ tank boots/helm is an option.

​

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c9baa602-65bc-46f4-bbf8-00c79ee86277 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fc9baa602-65bc-46f4-bbf8-00c79ee86277.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/uzB9J5bvAJ.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/r4lwBG_abU0 Low Effort Magister (magic)]

​

Necromancy Low Effort Method (88+ KPH) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Overview

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:     • Cutting corners will result in failure     • A more extensive list can be found in [[PvME/Lower-effort methods/AFK Overview|AFK Overview]]
Talent Tree Unlocks
⬥ Tiers 1-2     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Skeleton_Warrior Conjure] / [https://runescape.wiki/w/Command_Skeleton_Warrior Command Skeleton Warrior] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] ⬥ Tiers 3-4     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Putrid_Zombie Conjure Putrid Zombie] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Vengeful_Ghost Conjure] / [https://runescape.wiki/w/Command_Vengeful_Ghost Command Vengeful Ghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] ⬥ Tier 3-6     • All upgrades of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Spectral_Scythe Spectral Scythe] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] ⬥ Tier 7     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army Conjure Undead Army] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] Customised to conjure all spirits
Items
⬥ Powder of Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]     • Use before hour starts. ⬥ Kwuarm incense sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks]     • Use before hour starts. ⬥ Blood Reaver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] (no scrolls, pre-summoned) ⬥ Cinderbane gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ⬥ Weapon poison +++ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ Igneous Kal-Mor [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] for extra safety using the T90 preset. ⬥ Scripture of Ful [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] or Scripture of Wen [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen]
Abilities
⬥ Double Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894443778115.png?v=1 escapecodex] unlocked

⬥ The following are highly recommended for increased profits:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 lotd] Increases [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643166362361004042.png?v=1 phylactery] drop rate from 1/18 to 1/17.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vital spark enhancers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1151164471813865623.png?v=1 sparkenhancer] double the drop.

⬥ Boosting your maximum lifepoints (bonfire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] and thermal pool [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask]) is recommended.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem] is recommended over bonfire.

⬥ Double Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894443778115.png?v=1 escapecodex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] is used to prevent [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] bouncing to the obelisk as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to obelisk → Activate with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1 keytothecrossing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] back + throw [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb].

​

Note: the first few kills will be slower due to Corruption still stacking up.

​

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=RitWQU29gdVw9gjX3PhD Necromancy - T90 preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2fd8aac8-df98-4e1d-8e17-1adda5152ca3 Necromancy - T95 preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F2fd8aac8-df98-4e1d-8e17-1adda5152ca3.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/c1eQd61mCF.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dGMIoaSZS3I Necro Example]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gLIKF6eAHN.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/eeBgyzoRuL.png Guide illustration] ​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] South-East diagonally when entering the arena

​
