pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YrMqspEn6R.png Guide illustration] Beastmaster Durzag (BM) is the first of two raids bosses. Because of the straightforward nature of the fight, this is often the first group pvm experience for many players.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=wS6HzuD6XGWKxV7WepbL Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=EJIixTCYEnCWExL1Iuen Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=hibLsTuugMU261lTFUjH Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FhibLsTuugMU261lTFUjH.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Overview of the Fight

⬥ The fight begins by clearing airuts and chargers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Beware of Airuts' punishing melee attacks.

⬥ When the mob counter reaches 22 the first pet, Cormes, will spawn beside the western gong.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand slightly SE of this gong and attack the pet.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Protect melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] if attacked by melee airuts, or step away and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo].

⬥ Kill airuts and chargers until the countdown reaches 0.

⬥ At this point, team members should position themselves near the centre of the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base lures BM to the SE corner.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pet Tank 2 provokes the pet ensuring it faces away from the team.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• NC and BUSC clear chargers lining the arena perimeter.

⬥ The DPS attack Pet 2 until it reaches 100k health.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They should then switch to Pet 3, attacking until it reaches ~100k lifepoints.

⬥ Kill pets when BM is almost 750k LP. If BM still has high health (~900k), lower BM's lifepoints to 750k before finally killing the pets.

⬥ Once pets die, focus on BM.

​

Pet Tank

BM Pet Mechanics
Attack effects
⬥ Ranged attacks (Krar) drain run energy, stunning you if run energy reaches 0%. ⬥ Mage attacks (Tuz) apply a bleed. ⬥ Melee attacks (all pets if in melee distance) apply stacks which increase damage received.
General advice
⬥ Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] pets promptly and position to face away from the dps pile. ⬥ Ensure pets are not in the south-east quadrant with BM. ⬥ Pets can randomly 'jump', targeting other players.     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the pet back and lure it far from BM, keeping it facing away from the DPS pile. [https://img.pvme.io/images/SdALHPU.mp4 Example]. ⬥ Cycling defensives ([https://img.pvme.io/images/SdALHPU.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]) is advised to mitigate damage taken.

⬥ Pets are split between two players: Pet Tank 1/3 and Pet Tank 2

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The numbers refer to the respective order in which the pets spawn.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first pet is always Cormes, the second pet can be either Tuz or Krar.

⬥ For Cormes, stand north of the western gong and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] as soon as it spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Protect from Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] and DPS the pet until it dies.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nqu7oF0.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Pet 2 spawns with BM. Position yourself just east of the northern gong, drop your DPS ultimate and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the pet as soon as it spawns.

⬥ When Pet 2 reaches 500k LP, the third pet will spawn in a random corner.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pet Tank 1/3 should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] to draw the pet away from BM, keeping it facing away from the DPS pile.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/e4U8Wvb.png Guide illustration]

North Chargers (NC)

⬥ Draws aggression of the northern chargers and kills them.

⬥ Shortly before the mob counter reaches 0, make your way to the eastern gong.

⬥ The perimeter of the arena is lined with cages which fill with chargers once BM spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Start north of the eastern gong, move counter-clockwise.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click each cage to free the charger.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take a wide turn around the northern gong so chargers do not get trapped behind the pet. Example: [https://img.pvme.io/images/A1bDenb.mp4 https://img.pvme.io/images/A1bDenb.mp4][https://img.pvme.io/images/A1bDenb.mp4 Source video]

⬥ Once you collect all the northern chargers, move along the west wall to the SW corner.

⬥ Along with the BUSC, kill chargers with AOE abilities.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rangers should bring Mechanised Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magers should prioritise AOE abilities (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancers should utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike].

⬥ After clearing chargers, NC becomes a DPS for the rest of the fight.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KdwdbkC.png Guide illustration]

Backup / South Chargers (BUSC)

⬥ Clears southern chargers and helps the Base Tank with tanking BM.

⬥ To clear chargers, start south of the eastern gong and move clockwise to the SW corner, clicking cages. Example: [https://img.pvme.io/images/KE8qKSu.mp4 https://img.pvme.io/images/KE8qKSu.mp4][https://img.pvme.io/images/KE8qKSu.mp4 Source video]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AOE chargers down with the NC.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Rangers should bring Mechanised Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Magers should prioritise AOE abilities (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite]).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Necromancers should utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate].

⬥ After clearing chargers, go directly east of the southern gong.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drop your DPS ultimate and attack BM. It is safest to Protect Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] until the end of the fight.

⬥ When BM reaches 750k LP OR one of the pets dies (whichever happens first), [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] BM.

⬥ Aim to always have a defensive up as BM hits especially hard during this stage of the fight.

⬥ Eventually the base will provoke BM away from you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In longer kills, your stacks will clear. You should then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] back BM. Repeat this process with the base until the end of the kill.

​

Base Tank

BM Mechanics
⬥ BM attacks his main target with a 3x3 melee AOE attack.     • All players not directly behind him are hit with a ranged auto attack ⬥ Applies a stack to his primary target (up to a max of 15) per auto.     • This increases the damaged received by 6.6% per stack. ⬥ BM resets your defensives at 5, 10, and 15 stacks.     • Defensives are reset for 3 seconds, 6 seconds, and after every auto, respectively. ⬥ Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] is used to halve stacks.     • This halves stacks, rounded down (e.g. using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] at 9 stacks brings them down to 4). ⬥ BM throws out explosive magic bombs. [https://img.pvme.io/images/t0iiVH5.mp4 Example]     • Bombs put defensives on cooldown for 3 seconds.         ⬩ Click bombs to defuse them.         ⬩ Deflect Magic [https://img.pvme.io/images/t0iiVH5.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] halves damage from them. ⬥ BM can drag players into melee distance randomly. [https://img.pvme.io/images/9Ubda9SJwG.mp4 Example]     • Use [https://img.pvme.io/images/9Ubda9SJwG.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and run away quickly

⬥ When BM spawns, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] him and proceed to the SE corner. Example: [https://img.pvme.io/images/CCknDQP.mp4 https://img.pvme.io/images/CCknDQP.mp4][https://img.pvme.io/images/CCknDQP.mp4 Source video]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6zUuEsq.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Once in the corner, drop your DPS ultimate and attack BM.

⬥ After the BUSC provokes BM away from you, your stacks will eventually clear. When stacks clear, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] back and cycle through your defensive abilities.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KgFimmi.png Guide illustration]

⬥ After BM reaches 750k hp, DPS him down as fast as possible.

⬥ The Base and BUSC should 'juggle' BM to enable each other to clear stacks and maintain good HP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All other team members are now purely DPS until BM dies.

​

Learning Raids

Learning Raids
If you're interested in learning raids, join one of the teaching servers listed in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/944775418844688464 Affiliates (external Discord)]!
Discord Servers
⬥ [https://discord.gg/88ru2vd Boss School (external Discord)] ⬥ [https://discord.gg/egQBwuM Mazcab Academy (external Discord)] ⬥ [https://discord.gg/vfXXTBE Raids School (external Discord)]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wdEqnvjshG.png Guide illustration] Note: a Table of Contents is available in this page’s contents navigation.

​

Introduction

A being of pure chaos that resides to the west of the Rogues' Castle located in deep Wilderness. The Chaos Elemental is a beginner-friendly boss with simple mechanics meant to disorient the player more than harm them.

​

How to Get There

WARNING: THIS BOSS IS LOCATED IN THE WILDERNESS, BE SURE TO HAVE PVP TOGGLED OFF BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO FIGHT IT.

​

⬥ The level 50 Wilderness Obelisk is located east of the Chaos Elemental, easily accessed with the Portable Obelisk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1 portableobelisk], Obelisk Shards, or any of the other Wilderness Obelisks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These options will teleport the player to a random Wilderness Obelisk unless they have the hard Wilderness area tasks completed.

⬥ The teleport levers located in Edgeville [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552323903402024.png?v=1 edgevillelode] and Ardougne [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552315724517507.png?v=1 ardougnelode] teleport the player to the Deserted Keep, located west of the Chaos Elemental.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=aYihp5v5prjLizw4mZiC Basic Ranged Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=vg8oUa5bKInp1QL6BNuu Basic Necromancy Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fvg8oUa5bKInp1QL6BNuu.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ Summer Pies are used due to them leaving a Pie Dish in the player's inventory, keeping it full to avoid the Chaos Elemental's Madness attack.

​

Mechanics

Discord
The Chaos Elemental's basic attack, made up of green particles that deal either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage to the player. His other attacks are variations of this move with different effects.
Madness
⬥ The Chaos Elemental launches a multicoloured attack. Upon hit, the player's main hand weapon and up to 3 other pieces of equipped gear will be unequipped and placed in their inventory.     • If the player's inventory is full, the Chaos Elemental will not use this attack     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/gNKxb57aQz.mp4 Click to view an example of Madness]. [https://img.pvme.io/images/gNKxb57aQz.mp4 Source video]
Confusion
⬥ The Chaos Elemental launches an attack made of fire. Upon hit, the player will be teleported upwards of 20 tiles away from Chaos Elemental in a random direction.     • The player will stop attacking the boss after being teleported, be sure to click on the Chaos Elemental once this happens to resume attacking.     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/8OQ7OtVZhR.mp4 Click to view an example of Confusion] [https://img.pvme.io/images/8OQ7OtVZhR.mp4 Source video]

​

Tips and Tricks

⬥ The [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] hit of Discord is the most accurate, making it best to either Protect from Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1 protectfrommagic] or Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] throughout the fight.

⬥ Prioritize using powerful threshold abilities, only using basic abilities to build up to stronger ones, or when better options are on cooldown.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] examples of powerful abilities are Snap Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] and Rapid Fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid], with abilities like Dazing Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541307142307860.png?v=1 dazing] and Piercing Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] being your weaker basics. Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] is a very powerful ability, but should only be used near the start of the fight, if you find yourself with too much adrenaline.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] build up to abilities like Volley of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] and Finger of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] with your weaker abilities, Soul Sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] and Touch of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath], using your Basic Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] when all else is on cooldown.

⬥ If possible, keep your inventory full of items to avoid the Madness special attack, Chaos Elemental's drops can be used to fill any blank spaces.

⬥ An NPC named Edward, located outside the Dragonkin Laboratory, south-east of the level 50 Wilderness Obelisk, can be used as a bank to store any drops the player receives and resupply for longer trips.

⬥ Due to the Chaos Elemental being located in the Wilderness, all Wilderness based bonuses granted by the Infernal Puzzle Box [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] work against this boss.

​

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/GfiRAXoXNgU Simple Necromancy kills w/ banking at Edward]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/GfiRAXoXNgU Embedded guide video]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LdYq2RP.png Guide illustration]

ED1 is a very consistent money-maker and a good avenue for players to practice using AoE abilities, movement, avoiding damaging mechanics and DPS rotations. The requirements to feasibly solo it are moderate and many deaths should be expected when learning the dungeon due to the nature of the mechanics.

​

⬥ Use the zerker aura [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1 berserker] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1 reckless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1 mani] variants for the dungeon. Otherwise, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1 vamp] is fine for learning, but prioritise using defence reducing abilities for special attacks ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]) on Masuta and Seiryu's face. Also, expect to do additional cycles on Seiryu.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=GsbuR3CBDvwpdHQz6KPL Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=o9Fo2OzlWJKMHazAaOSS Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JYNxXhY5s0cZfQKbgUYb Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FJYNxXhY5s0cZfQKbgUYb.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Recommended Upgrades

Additional items to bring if possible, or acquire if you can afford to.
Magic
⬥ Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] w/ Caroming 4 switch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1 eofpurple] w/ Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff]
Melee
⬥ Greater Barge and Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry]
Ranged
⬥ Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] w/ Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] w/ Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow]

​

The Sanctum Guardian (Info)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KCgIv13UAG.png Guide illustration]

The first boss you encounter. Sanctum uses primarily slow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] auto attacks which hit moderately hard. However, they are aimed at the players' tile instead of character so you are able to dodge them by stepping away 3 or more tiles before they hit.

​

Mechanics
Attack Rotation
⬥ Sanctum's attack pattern is:     • Start of fight: 4x Ranged autoattack to start the fight.     • Rest of fight: Water Burst → Ranged auto → Water Jet → Ranged auto → Purple Smoke → Melee auto → repeat     • After the 4th water jet attack, 2 Crassian Reinforcements are summoned.     • The melee auto does nothing if you are out of melee range. ​
Ranged Autoattacks
⬥ A projectile that targets the spot the player is standing on and hits in a 3x3 area. [https://img.pvme.io/images/r63xxBI.mp4 Example]     • Targeted to a tile rather than the player and has travel time before it hits     • It is possible to dodge every Ranged autoattack simply by moving before the attack lands (not necessary). ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/r63xxBI.mp4 Source video]
Water Burst
⬥ Sanctum ducks down and rises back up quickly, splashing water and dealing heavy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/TJngvfo.mp4 Example] ⬥ Use [https://img.pvme.io/images/TJngvfo.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] as soon as you see this mechanic as it is very fast. You can also [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] this if needed.     • Staying or moving out of range in time will cause the attack to miss. Doing this is usually unnecessary. [https://youtu.be/3xDLQIAMeEc Example] ​
Water Jet
⬥ Sanctum spews water, rotating from North anti-clockwise, dealing ~6000 soft typeless damage if the player is caught in it. [https://img.pvme.io/images/xbJwXJj.mp4 Example]     • This mechanic can be avoided by moving to dodge it or via [https://img.pvme.io/images/xbJwXJj.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt].     • You can also [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] to reduce the damage if need be, although these are less efficient. ​
Purple Smoke
⬥ A blue bar appears above your character. When it drains, a cloud of smoke will cover a 5x5 area centred around your location. [https://img.pvme.io/images/CCIKuCR.mp4 Example]     • The smoke deals rapid typeless damage every tick which increases very fast, hitting ~4000 a tick eventually. Move out of it as soon as possible.     • Move to the place you want to drop it walk out after it drops. Don't panic and walk around unnecessarily, causing you to drop it in an undesirable position. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/CCIKuCR.mp4 Source video]

The Sanctum Guardian (Fight tips)

⬥ You may die a few times because the mechanics are quite fast and arguably hard to react to. This is perfectly normal.

​

⬥ Outline of rotations:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] (if owned) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → cycle thresholds again → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] again ASAP and finish off

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] → good thresholds → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] again ASAP → finish off with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] and good thresholds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → thresholds → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] again ASAP

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] again on the other side if boss has >100k HP left.

​

⬥ If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], you may find it useful to side step attacks from time to time as you have the most mobility while using abilities.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/j5yD1xR.mp4 Source media]

⬥ An easy way to dodge Water Jet if fighting Sanctum from the front is standing east then walking west as follows:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/OSdmLyz.mp4 Source media]

⬥ If you don't wish to teleport out to bank before Sanctum, go to the back and fight while standing along this thing so that Anagamis and Arhats following you get stuck as shown below and do not bother you during the fight.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/7qIjbzv.png Guide illustration] ​

Masuta, the Ascended (Info)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/l1tE0lAhOH.png Guide illustration]

Masuta is the second boss of ED1. Expect to eat a lot of food during this fight. Masuta is a fairly hard fight, dealing both high burst and sustained damage on the player. He is considered by some to be the hardest in the dungeon.

​

Mechanics
P1 Rotation
⬥ Masuta attacks at the fight using the following rotation:     • 2-4 autos → Hurricane → 3-5 autos → Tsunami → 3-5 autos → Repeats from Hurricane. ​
Autoattack information
⬥ Masuta mostly uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] during p1, occasionally using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://img.pvme.io/images/lQiGv8Y.mp4 Example]     • Occasionally, he summons a clone while using [https://img.pvme.io/images/lQiGv8Y.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] which deals an additional hit. Seiryu, the Azure Serpent (Info)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dksAPM9sP5.png Guide illustration]

Seiryu is the final boss of ED1 and attacks using primarily [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] auto attacks.

​

Mechanics
Face (7500k-7200k HP)
⬥ Seiryu first does 4 attacks then continues with the following attack rotation     • Huge Breath → 2 attacks → Shadow Energy → 2 attacks → repeat     • Seiryu's standard attack is either a slow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] attack (easy to flick) or a tail blackhole.     • The 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic will be replaced by the Black Hands mechanic. ​
Tail Blackhole
⬥ Seiryu dips his tail into the floor to summon a black hole under the player. [https://img.pvme.io/images/zwFuDq4.mp4 Example]     • Summoned blackholes will cover a 2x2 area, dealing rapid and increasing damage (~2000 per tick) to players standing on them, lasting for about 10 seconds before disappearing.     • Move out (1 tile north/east or 2 tiles south/west) of it to avoid damage. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/zwFuDq4.mp4 Source video]
Huge Breath
⬥ The message 'Seiryu takes a huge breath!' appears and Seiryu will swing his head from east to west while doing a breath attack. [https://img.pvme.io/images/fsznjRq.mp4 Example]     • This deals ~8000 [https://img.pvme.io/images/fsznjRq.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] attack unprotected.     • You can dodge this attack by standing along the 2 southern rows of the arena. Alternatively, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res].     • The hit lands when Seiryu's head reaches west making it easy to react to. ​
Shadow Energy
⬥ The game message 'Shadow energy bursts forth from Seiryu.' appears, and Seiryu launches a shadow projectile towards a tile marked by an arrow. Shortly after, highly damaging black hands will move from the marked tile towards your current location. [https://img.pvme.io/images/0NPw0Ot.mp4 Example]     • Move out of the way when the black hands spawn.     • The hands have moderate KO potential so be careful especially if the projectile lands near you. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/0NPw0Ot.mp4 Source video]
Black Hands
⬥ Replaces Seiryu's 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic. Black hands spawn from a random point along the south wall and move north, expanding out in V-shape pattern. [https://img.pvme.io/images/4YRp1Ra.mp4 Example]     • These hands are extremely damaging, avoiding them is vital.     • Take extremely caution especially if using [https://img.pvme.io/images/4YRp1Ra.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and don't stand directly at the south wall when this mechanic is imminent.     • Once this mechanic has been cast, a new set of black hands will spawn when the current formation is complete. ​
Shackle
⬥ At 7200k HP, Seiryu stops his attacks and lowers his head, all existing mechanics then disappear. [https://img.pvme.io/images/6UThIKD.mp4 Example]     • You will be able to climb the shackle at these two points and start damaging the Black Crystals on the shackle. [https://img.pvme.io/images/6UThIKD.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/ia7OVYS.png Example]     • The crystals have 150K HP and can be damaged using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine]. The fight ends once all of them are destroyed.     • After some time, 6 shadow enigmas will spawn and slowly move towards Seiryu. [https://img.pvme.io/images/NqEDUWE.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Upon reaching his face, enigmas will heal crystals by 50k HP each. [https://img.pvme.io/images/NqEDUWE.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/c7V97dw.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Ignore the first set of enigmas and DPS the crystals. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/c7V97dw.mp4 Source video]
Post-Shackle
⬥ After the 6th heal is finished, you have 13.2 seconds before you get stunned and teleported back down from the shackle.     • During this time, a second set of enigmas will have spawned.         ⬩ Tag and kill them before attacking Seiryu.     • Seiryu heals back to 7500k HP. Get him down to below 7200k again to continue killing the black crystals.     • After dragging you down, Seiryu will always start with a Huge Breath attack before continuing his attacking rotation from the previous phase.         ⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] before getting dragged down, and walk to the south wall while tagging and killing the enigmas to avoid the breath.         ⬩ Continue attacking Seiryu afterwards.     • If you kill all 3 crystals during the first shackle segment, the fight ends and this portion will not happen. ​

​

⬥ AoEs by style, generally from most to least viable

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1 flurry] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave] > targeted [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] is extremely good at places with lots of enemies.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] basic > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153635004447.png?v=1 ricocaroming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] is good way to clear hordes of enemies fast to avoid getting overwhelmed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153962684426.png?v=1 chaincaroming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 4TAA using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] is very helpful for clears.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] should be used whenever possible if owned for clears, especially with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous]

​

⬥ Some good places to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] are as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This helps you avoid taking unnecessary damage from mobs while clearing the dungeon.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/8htV7Pg.mp4 Source media] [https://img.pvme.io/images/6IQ9MAJ.mp4 Source media]

Example runs

All runs are done with close to BIS perks, expect slower times if using entry level perks. All Seiryus are 2 cycles.
Range
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fM9pFoNyIho 16:10]
Melee
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uaWAHAd8aDw 17:15]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] were both not used for this video.
Magic
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JIrwWHW9vgQ 16:03]     • 4TAA is not utilised in this example video.
Walkthroughs
⬥ Alternatively, check out these narrated video guides:     • [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qc0inKS8b7U Ranged]     • [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F59efgBX0Go Magic]     • [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4jIGoNwRm5E Melee]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EA7wP1w.png Guide illustration]

ED2 is considered the most beginner friendly Elite Dungeon. The requirements to feasibly solo it both in terms of gear and skill are generally considered low. However, it still has considerable amount of challenging components which can result in fast KOs if the player is not careful.

​

⬥ Mechanics with high KO potential include but are not limited to:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Astellarn's neutron star

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Astellarn's black hole combined with celestial rain

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Verak Lith's fire tornados

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Verak Lith's egg bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black Stone Dragon's purple smoke/fire

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black Stone Dragon's ability to attack semi-randomly using all 3 styles

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black hands' heavy magic autos and small shadow hands

​

⬥ Use zerker aura [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1 reckless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1 mani] variants for the dungeon. Otherwise, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1 vamp] is fine for learning.

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] are used for this guide as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] is by far the least beginner friendly style to use in ED2.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=xpnlmMZjX5UXZIbvLzzp Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=K8HHmIT1LBvEbQstfwF5 Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FK8HHmIT1LBvEbQstfwF5.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Recommended Upgrades

Additional items to bring if possible, or acquire if you can afford to.
Magic
⬥ Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] w/ Caroming 4 switch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1 eofpurple] w/ Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff]
Ranged
⬥ Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] w/ Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] w/ Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] ⬥ Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb]

​

Astellarn, the First Celestial (Info)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YzDTPVB5wy.png Guide illustration]

The first boss you encounter. The boss has many mechanics that deal typeless damage so be prepared to eat. It uses hard hitting but slow auto attacks in all 3 styles, but primarily uses a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] breath attack which is very easy to flick.

​

Mechanics
Attack Rotation
⬥ Astellarn's starting attack pattern is:     • 2-3 autos → Pulsar → ~2 autos → Black hole → 1-2 autos → Neutron Star → Repeat ​
Celestial rain
⬥ When Astellarn falls below 200k HP, she starts taking drastically decreased damage and spawns celestial rain which affects a quadrant of the arena at any point of time, dealing rapid typeless damage which ramps up. [https://img.pvme.io/images/M6UbQli.mp4 Example]     • Avoid standing in it always. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/M6UbQli.mp4 Source video]
Pulsar
⬥ Astellarn summons a pulsar with 20000 HP near you, dealing periodic typeless damage. Kill this as soon as possible once it spawns. [https://img.pvme.io/images/0UabHmn.mp4 Example]     • Using basics together with a powerful threshold such as [https://img.pvme.io/images/0UabHmn.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] to deal with it. ​
Wyrmhole
⬥ Astellarn places a blue bar above your head. When it expires a black wyrmhole is dropped at the player location which deals rapid typeless damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/ZVNJasC.mp4 Example]     • Focus on placing it along these lines to prevent it from being blocked out by the later rain mechanic. [https://img.pvme.io/images/ZVNJasC.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/wlaz77A.jpg Example] ​
Neutron Star
⬥ This will follow the player around and must be lured into the Wyrmhole, stabilizing it, turning white, and giving increased damage to Astellarn. [https://img.pvme.io/images/zHIuF3t.mp4 Example]     • Do not let it touch you to avoid taking 4000+ damage.         ⬩ Immediately teleport out and restart the fight if the star explodes like that.     • The timing of this mechanic is not fixed so be extra careful of it and react accordingly. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/zHIuF3t.mp4 Source video]

Astellarn, the First Celestial (Fight tips)

⬥ Do not use your damage boosting ultimates [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf], but instead igneous abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] and powerful thresholds for the first 50k HP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] after dropping the wyrmhole as you will deal most of your damage after luring the neutron star.

​

⬥ Stand out of her melee range so you only have to flick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] autos.

​

⬥ It is recommended to drop the wyrmhole between Astellarn and the west wall:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/t693lnb.png Guide illustration] ​

⬥ Keep hitting Astellarn before the Neutron Star spawns to build adren and as poison damage is unaffected by her damage reduction.

​

⬥ You can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] after using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] while waiting for the Neutron Star to spawn.

​

⬥ If you fail to lure the Neutron Star into the Wyrmhole, teleport out and restart the fight.

​

Verak Lith (Info)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/A2EOjdXdyH.png Guide illustration]

Verak Lith is the second boss of the dungeon, he has sizeable HP and mechanics that can shred your HP if handled improperly. He uses heavy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] autos.

​

Mechanics
Attack Rotation
⬥ Verak does the following attack rotation:     • 4 Auto attacks → Spire → 4 Auto attacks → Ricochet → 4 Auto attacks → Spire → 4 Auto Attacks → Nosedive/Hurricanes → Repeat ​
Spire
⬥ Verak Lith summons a spire with 15000 HP shortly after a warning message, dealing about 2000 melee damage to the player. [https://img.pvme.io/images/afn857t.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/afn857t.mp4 Source video]
Ricochet
⬥ Verak sends out a projectile that lands near the player after a few seconds. The element of this projectile can be poison, ice, or shock. [https://img.pvme.io/images/1c5I5Ar.mp4 Example]     • The correct way to deal with this mechanic is to pick up the projectile and interact with a different type of egg to disperse it before the bar fills up.     • Missing the projectile will deal 4000 damage and missing the dispersal can deal 9000+ damage.     • Players may want to miss the projectile and either [https://img.pvme.io/images/1c5I5Ar.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] it. ​
Nosedive
⬥ A message will appear on the screen mentioning that a dragon is nosediving. An arrow will show up near the player to indicate the direction of approach. Shortly after, a thin line of dragonbreath will be fired along the line. [https://img.pvme.io/images/66ACLwS.mp4 Example]     • This can deal over 8000 magic damage and can be avoided by simply moving out of the way. However, the arrow will adjust it's position based on the player's movement for a while so it is recommended to learn the timing on this mechanic and move as it goes off.     • This can also be dealt with by using [https://img.pvme.io/images/66ACLwS.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] and tanking it. ​
Hurricanes
⬥ Verak says 'Let the flames melt the flesh from your bones' and engulfs the area around the player in fire. This will deal no damage but after a short delay, hurricanes will spawn in the area that deal extremely high [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] damage, lasting for about 20 seconds. [https://img.pvme.io/images/uv37IW8.mp4 Example]     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/uv37IW8.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or run away from the area accordingly. ​

Verak Lith (Fight tips)

⬥ Soulsplit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] flicking is extremely recommended in this fight as it is quite long with Verak hitting you for moderately high damage consistently throughout.

​

⬥ It is recommended to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the hit from spires.

​

⬥ You may place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] throughout the fight as they might explode on spires for 3000 damage each, allowing you to clear them extremely fast.

​

⬥ Rotation outline:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] whenever possible.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A threshold should be used to deal with each spire.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf], follow ability progression [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf], follow ability progression [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous]

​

Black Stone Dragon (Info)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/K6oQJBiYGF.png Guide illustration]

Black Stone Dragon is the final boss of ED2 and attacks using primarily slow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] auto attacks, she can also use a fast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] bite or a spinning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] attack.

​

Mechanics
650k-520k
⬥ BSD does the following attack rotation:     • 3 Auto Attacks → Gemstone Spikes → 2 Auto Attacks → Dragonbreath → Repeat ​
Gemstone Spikes
⬥ BSD fires a line of spikes, causing the screen to shake. A 3x3 zone of spikes erupts around the player's initial position after a short delay, dealing 5000+ melee damage, draining all adrenaline and applying a debuff that reduces all adrenaline gain by 50% for a short duration if it hits. [https://img.pvme.io/images/4ppYV4M.mp4 Example]     • Move out of the way by at least 2 tiles. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/4ppYV4M.mp4 Source video]
Dragonbreath
⬥ The skybox will turn dark blue and BSD fires a breath attack that deals moderate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] damage.     • You can pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] to take less damage. ​
Black Hands
⬥ When BSD falls below 520k HP, the black hands phase begins as she becomes invulnerable and BSD moves to the center of the arena, spawning 4 black hands with 80,000 hp where the rocks are located. [https://img.pvme.io/images/jBFHmJu.mp4 Example]     • Clear them to continue the fight.         ⬩ [https://img.pvme.io/images/jBFHmJu.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] help greatly as they explode for 10,000 damage each.     • The hands attack by slamming down and sending out black smokes which hits for up to 4000+ magic damage upon impact. This is followed by a trail of small black hands which moves towards the player, dealing rapid 2000+ damage if stood on. [https://img.pvme.io/images/5MAYT2U.mp4 Example]         ⬩ The small hands will never reach the player if they on any of these 4 spots. [https://img.pvme.io/images/5MAYT2U.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/Oa1qT6q.png Example] ​
520k-260k
⬥ BSD does the following attack rotation:     • 1-5 Auto Attacks → Smoke Spiral → 3 Auto Attacks → Mage AoE → 2 Auto Attacks → Dragonbreath → Gemstone Spikes → 3 Auto Attacks → Mage AoE → Repeat ​
Smoke Spiral
⬥ BSD remains stationary, summoning a line of purple smoke spirals inwards towards BSD, dealing up to 4000+ damage per tick if stood on. [https://img.pvme.io/images/ak3Y05T.mp4 Example]     • Be aware when the smoke approaches your position and move out of the way if needed. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/ak3Y05T.mp4 Source video]
Mage AoE
⬥ Black Stone Dragon will call out 'GET. OUT. OF. ME.' or 'The shadow overwhelms!' and turn to fire a black projectile towards a random spot. [https://img.pvme.io/images/UIpNtaq.mp4 Example]     • The bomb explodes into black tendrils that deal heavy [https://img.pvme.io/images/UIpNtaq.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] damage in the area for a short period.     • Move away to avoid it if needed. ​
Fly
⬥ After BSD dips below 260k HP, she becomes invulnerable and starts jumping, landing randomly and spawning smoke lines towards the player every time she does, in addition to other zones of smoke.     • This occurs 7 times before BSD says 'Show me the light' and becomes vulnerable again.     • Move around as needed and use some abilities to build adrenaline on BSD and to avoid losing combat. ​
260k-0
⬥ BSD lands and immediately does a smoke spiral, following with the same post-smoke spiral attack rotation as 520k-260k. ​

Blackstone dragon (Fight tips)

⬥ Because her [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] autos are slow while her [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] autos are fast, sometimes the hits can land at the same time and stack you out, you may use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] if you see this coming.

​

⬥ Rotation Outline:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] at the start of the fight, and then whenever it comes back up until BSD flies.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] on BSD again after flight and finish her off with powerful thresholds and abilities.

​

⬥ Black hands

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] at the safespots during Black Hands to eliminate the need to move to avoid the small hands.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The default [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] option will help with applying [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] to Black Hands greatly.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clear 2 Black Hands and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to the safespot between the other pair. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] once it comes off cooldown and finish off the other pair of hands.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You may want to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] some hits from Black Hands.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] as often as you can on hands. Pay attention to when they come off cooldown.

​

⬥ Flight phase

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], be sure to build or sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear] or/and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] stacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Don't stay on low health during flight to avoid randomly dying to smoke.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Remember to refresh [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] after BSD completes her flight phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be ready to move from where you cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] to avoid smoke.

​

Mobs and movement

Mob clearing in ED2 is arguably the most tricky to do properly amongst the trilogy. There are various portions of the dungeon where you can be subjected to many sources of damage. Thus, using powerful abilities to clear and moving fast from place to place will benefit you greatly.

​

Monster mechanics
Laboratory Slimes
⬥ Laboratory Slimes hitting you will spawn clone slimes (signified by 'Bloop'). [https://img.pvme.io/images/8wtfLrx.mp4 Example]     • Pray [https://img.pvme.io/images/8wtfLrx.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] to avoid getting overwhelmed in the first room.     • Clear the light-coloured slimes to open barriers, the darker-coloured clones being killed will not progress the dungeon. [https://img.pvme.io/images/RUfcGvO.png Example] ​
Gemstone Dragons
⬥ All gemstone dragons standing not in melee distance can fire a gemstone spike special attack, dealing high magic damage and secondary effect depending on the type of dragon. [https://img.pvme.io/images/Rxkqxnf.mp4 Example]     • Dragonstone dragon - Halves your antifire/super antifire duration.     • Onyx dragon - Heals the dragon for 4000 HP.     • Hydrix dragon - Instantly drains all adrenaline and applies a debuff that halves adrenaline for about 15 seconds.     • Be careful of this especially when fighting multiple dragons.     • Avoid these specs by stepping 2 tiles away from your original location before the spikes land. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/Rxkqxnf.mp4 Source video]
Celestial Dragons
⬥ Sometime after hitting below 36,000 HP, Celestial Dragons will start healing rapidly for 2400 HP each tick following a message. It will then repeat this every 6 auto attacks. [https://img.pvme.io/images/tITMd30.mp4 Example]     • Stun or bind the dragon to stop the healing.         ⬩ An easy way to do this is to click a [https://img.pvme.io/images/tITMd30.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1 stickybomb] from your inventory when the dragon starts healing.         ⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] or 4T [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] are good methods to bind several dragons at once. ​

⬥ Beware of getting harassed by Lava Spiders from these areas:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] while taking the path furthest away from them to avoid gaining aggression.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/M5GzLDc.png Guide illustration]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ttzj2uX.png Guide illustration]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] usage for clears
Use them only in places with high concentrations of dragons
⬥ This includes but may not be limited to:     • 7 Red Dragons at dungeon start [https://img.pvme.io/images/akGjAOJ.png Example]     • 3 Celestial Dragons before Astellarn [https://img.pvme.io/images/wYkisYs.png Example]     • 6 Black Dragons before Verak Lith [https://img.pvme.io/images/PeWyyBX.png Example]     • 2 Lava Strykewyrms + 3 Black Dragons before Verak Lith [https://img.pvme.io/images/i4MpM6D.png Example]     • 1 Onyx Dragon and 3 Dragonstone Dragons before BSD [https://img.pvme.io/images/W8YBfnl.png Example] ​

⬥ You may find the dragons in ED2 tricky to hit with AoE abilities, the table below sheds some light on this. For more information, refer to [[PvME/Combat reference/Mechanics|Mechanics]] (NPC Center vs. Co-ordinate section) or use !chin ‎command in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)].

​

AoE abilities on dragons
[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] and anything affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]
⬥ If your main dragon target has another to their immediate south, west, or southwest, abilities will hit them. [https://img.pvme.io/images/M9XRIvs.png Example] ​
[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]
⬥ Target a dragon further away and anything between you and the target will also be hit by the ability. [https://img.pvme.io/images/nBhbkE6.png Example] ​

⬥ You may find yourself eating a lot of damage from Lava Spiders and Laboratory Slimes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clear any slimes that harass you or get them stuck behind this Celestial Dragon before Astellarn like so:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/w3PS4r4.mp4 Source media]

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lava Spiders after Astellarn will naturally get stuck behind Lava Strykes when you proceed to the Verak Lith boss fight:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/I7YK6hN.png Guide illustration] ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can also teleport out at any time and re-enter the dungeon to despawn any non-essential mobs that are following you around.

​

Example runs

Example runs
