pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/W5h47SR.png Guide illustration]

ED3 is generally considered the hardest Elite Dungeon in the trilogy, in most part due to its final boss: the Ambassador.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=KRtm6B0sipwNBi1vPqQv Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=03bAqOnWvTYSMEuZqC1M Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Ps87rZmMIyMRugzgJRRt Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FPs87rZmMIyMRugzgJRRt.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Recommended Upgrades

Additional items to bring if possible, or acquire if you can afford to.
Magic
⬥ Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] w/ Caroming 4 switch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1 eofpurple] w/ Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff]
Melee
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] w/ Dragon 2H [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword]
Ranged
⬥ Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] w/ Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] w/ Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow]

​

Dungeon Walkthrough (1/3)

This guide is organized according to the structure of the dungeon itself, and alternates between clearing mobs, and defeating the bosses.

​

The first few areas of the dungeon are relatively trivial. Generally, you can camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] - though, if struggling with some enemies you can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee]. Avoid the Sea Horrors.

​

Group mobs together and use your area of effect abilities:

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] + strong abilities

​

Crassian Leviathan

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hHWBVqywIK.png Guide illustration]

Overview

A video version of this basic strategy can be found here: [https://youtu.be/bpvq0Li-pTg https://youtu.be/bpvq0Li-pTg]

​

⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] if in melee distance, however it is recommended to simply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

⬥ Heals over time. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] to slow the healing.

⬥ The mechanic cycle is Poisonous Breath → Head Sweep → Head Sweep → Tactical Retreat → repeat.

​

Key Mechanics

⬥ Poisonous Breath: a green blast through the centre of the arena dealing high damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stay near the sides of the arena to avoid it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] - use a Halberd to more easily stay in the safe spots: [https://img.pvme.io/images/wKjEfc9.png https://img.pvme.io/images/wKjEfc9.png]

⬥ Head Sweep: Leviathan will slam its head side to side, twice, dealing high damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move quickly to the opposite side of each slam to avoid it.

⬥ Tactical Retreat: Leviathan will switch to the other end of the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is possible to be stunned while following it; [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to avoid this.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is also possible to be poisoned by the green gas; eat food if required.

​

Basic Approach

⬥ Camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment]

⬥ Execute a strong ultimate rotation at the start of the encounter, then maintain strong ability usage until Leviathan uses Tactical Retreat. Repeat until boss is defeated.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take care to avoid both the Poisonous Breath and the Head Sweep while inside of your ultimate.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → strong basics and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → strong basics and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → strong basics and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Dungeon Walkthrough (2/3)

The first few areas after the Crassian Leviathan are relatively trivial. Again, you can usually camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]. Try to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] a good amount so as to help you speed along. You can try to surge diagonally when possible to cut corners, and hug walls to avoid being attacked.

​

Movement Demo
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/mYnzcHG.mp4 Diagonal Surge] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/mYnzcHG.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/oFvx2jo.mp4 Hugging Walls] [https://img.pvme.io/images/oFvx2jo.mp4 Source video]

​

Notable Area: The Bridge

This is the most punishing area of the dungeon (aside from the bosses). After opening the gate to the bridge, you will be dealt rapid [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage. In addition, the Sea Horrors at the end of the bridge deal heavy typeless damage.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] while crossing the bridge. Clear the Horrors & Mage at the end of the bridge as fast as possible, making good use of your area-of-effect abilities. You can back yourself into the far corner to help keep them grouped.

​

Bridge Clearing Demo
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/YnkBiUx.mp4 Magic] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/YnkBiUx.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/jNUYyVz.mp4 Melee] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/jNUYyVz.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/Tp0aI9S.mp4 Ranged] [https://img.pvme.io/images/Tp0aI9S.mp4 Source video]

​

Taraket, the Necromancer

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1qztt5mzjF.png Guide illustration]

Overview

⬥ All enemies in the encounter are affected by Salve Amulet (e) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet], Undead Slayer perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] and the Undead Slayer ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer]

⬥ The overall structure of the fight is: (reach phase HP → deal with Corpse Carrier or Bloated Monstrosity) x2 → finish Taraket

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Throughout all stages, Taraket will occasionally use Death's Swiftness

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Throughout all stages, Rifts of Undeath will occasionally spawn.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the last stage, Spirit Walls will occasionally spawn.

​

Key Mechanics

⬥ Rift of Undeath: a portal that spawns Skeletons, and will eventually explode for high damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill the rifts immediately, before they explode.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using area of effect abilities can be helpful to kill Skeletons at the same time.

⬥ Absorb Undead: Taraket will occasionally absorb any Skeletons in the arena to heal himself.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dispatch skeletons as required.

⬥ Death's Swiftness: Taraket will apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and start dealing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Switch to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] as required; [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] flick if comfortable.

⬥ Corpse Carrier and Bloated Monstrosity: a large minion that will spawn Skeletons or increase damage dealt to the player, respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill them immediately.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using area of effect abilities can help dispatch skeletons at the same time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Luring them to Taraket will ensure he suffers from area of effect damage, too.

⬥ Spirit Wall: a blue line of ghost-like minions that rush towards the player, dealing extremely high damage if touched.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There will be two of these lines each time, in relatively quick succession.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move out of their way.

​

Basic Approach

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] by default; [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] flick (or camp) if comfortable.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Again, ensure to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] if Taraket uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]

⬥ Execute a strong ultimate rotation at the start of the encounter, then maintain strong ability usage until Taraket reaches phase HP (200,000).

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → strong basics and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → strong basics and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → strong basics and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

⬥ Prioritise strong abilities and area of effect abilities to kill the Corpse Carrier or Bloated Monstrosity quickly, along with Skeletons.

⬥ Phase once more, and repeat with the remaining Carrier/Monstrosity.

⬥ Execute another strong ultimate rotation once Taraket is in its final phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take care so as to avoid Spirit Walls while inside your ultimate.

​

Dungeon Walkthrough (3/3)

Most mobs past Taraket are relatively trivial. However, some hit very hard with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] - these include Warped Skeletons, and certain mages. If you start taking heavy magic damage, ensure to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage].

​

The Ambassador

[https://img.pvme.io/images/K27CYar5tn.png Guide illustration]

Overview

The Ambassador primarily attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and is the most complex boss of the dungeon, with an attack cycle that varies based on HP. Note that during all phases, Ambassador will use the Heavy Hit mechanic every 5 auto attacks.

​

⬥ 1,000,000 - 550,000

Black Stone Flames → Unstable Black Hole → Black Stone Flames → * Beams + Fragments → Pulse of Erebus → repeat.

​

Note: Beams + Fragments will be triggered after 1:00 of time has elapsed on each cycle. It can be triggered early during the first cycle if you reach 650,000 HP before 1:00 has elapsed.

​

⬥ 550,000 - 400,000

Black Stone Flames → Unstable Black Hole → Black Stone Flames until phased.

​

⬥ 400,000 - End

Black Hands (continuous) → Magic Onslaught (repeated).

​

Key Mechanics

⬥ Heavy Hit: a very strong [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] (blue orb) or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] (swipe animation) attack. The first will be used as soon as you enter the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It will be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] by default, unless you are standing within melee distance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These will occasionally happen throughout all phases of the encounter, except during Beams + Fragments.

​

Heavy Hit Demo
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/1oX424k.mp4 Magic] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/1oX424k.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/GGEN8a7.mp4 Melee] [https://img.pvme.io/images/GGEN8a7.mp4 Source video]

​

⬥ Black Stone Flames: a bar is placed above the player's head. Once it has emptied, the zone the player is standing on will be engulfed in flame, dealing rapid damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place the flames out of the way, moving to the edge of the arena if required.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ensure to wait at least one second after placing the flames, or else they will follow you.

​

Black Stone Flames Demo
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/1oX424k.mp4 Link] [https://img.pvme.io/images/1oX424k.mp4 Source video]

​

⬥ Unstable Black Hole: a black hole will spawn in the arena, and will eventually explode dealing high damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apply a stun to destroy it, before it explodes. Preferably, one of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541275957657600.png?v=1 tight] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand]

​

⬥ Beams: the Ambassador will become immune, and summon three spinning beams that will deal high damage on impact.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Never touch the beams. Move calmly, and kill the Fragments one by one.

​

⬥ Fragments: six Sinister Fragments will spawn across the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise strong abilities to try to kill all of them, or as many as possible.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] is reset on each kill to aid in mobility.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] can be applied on each fragment.

​

⬥ Erebus Pulse: for each spinner that was not killed, Ambassador will charge a highly-damaging attack, signified with a blue bar over his head.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] are first-choice options to survive the blow.

​

Erebus Pulse Demo
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/3U8LBRS.mp4 Link] [https://img.pvme.io/images/3U8LBRS.mp4 Source video]

​

⬥ Black Hands: during the final phase, several hands will circle the arena, and launch white smoke towards Ambassador, which heal him. After a few seconds, the hand will stop, and the next hand (clockwise) will take over.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand between the hand producing smoke, and the Ambassador. This will turn the smoke black and stop the healing.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move calmly in a clockwise manner around Ambassador so as to continuously block the smoke.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Staying in melee distance makes this much easier.

​

⬥ Magic Onslaught: Ambassador will say "Fall now, and be forgotten", before launching several highly-damaging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] attacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] and either Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo], or, Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + Vitality Powerburst [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality], or, Debilitate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] and eat.

​

Basic Approach

Phase One
⬥ Enter the fight with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] active to negate the first Heavy Hit.     • If no [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt], then pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] and tank the hit, or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]. ⬥ After negating the first Heavy Hit, use a strong ultimate ability rotation. ⬥ Negate Black Holes with a stun, and place Black Stone Flames as required. ⬥ Deal as much damage as possible to Ambassador before the first set of Beams + Fragments starts. Once it starts, move calmly and kill as many fragments as possible.     • Afterwards, negate Erebus Pulse according to how many were left alive. ⬥ Repeat the above, starting with another ultimate rotation, until Phase 2 commences at 550,000 HP.
Phase Two
⬥ Use a strong ultimate rotation(s), as cooldowns allow, to reach 400,000 HP. ⬥ Prayer flick to negate Heavy Hits, or, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to heal from them. ⬥ Continue to place each Black Stone Flame in a convenient location. ⬥ Watch for the unstable black hole, and close it quickly with a stun. ⬥ Ignore any minions that may spawn.
Phase Three
⬥ Seiryu will grant the player a full heal at this point. ⬥ Continue to negate Heavy Hits with either prayer flicking or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] ⬥ Execute a strong ultimate ability rotation     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], try to place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] underneath him. ⬥ Walk calmly in a clockwise circle, close to Ambassador, to block the lines of smoke from the Black Hands.     • Smoke will be black if correctly blocked. ⬥ When Ambassador calls your name and says "Fall now...", negate the magic onslaught as described above. ⬥ After the onslaught has concluded, repeat the above until dead.

​

Supplementary Videos
Example Runs
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zUx84iopkLg Magic] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/wTSNtEAAdJc Melee] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/qkqXEm4y0zg Ranged]
Boss Guides
⬥ [https://youtu.be/bpvq0Li-pTg Crassian Leviathan] ⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_LELEW40G_k Taraket] ⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VudEJXfZrNw The Ambassador]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/oggG9IjOw6.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

THIS IS A WORK IN PROGRESS, A FINISHED VERSION WILL BE POSTED SOON.

This guide, and its contents thereof, assume you are getting started with Ghrazi Blood Knights, and does not necessarily cover meta strategies. Due to the recency of the boss, this guide is considered Work in Progress and some mechanics may not be outlined.

​

Introduction

The aim of this guide is to provide a basic overview of how to get consistent kills at the Ghrazi Blood Knights. Due to demanding damage checks and mechanical complexity of this fight, contents of this guide assume you have at least made it to the end of Stage 1 of [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides] for your chosen style. As Ghrazi Blood Knights are enrage-based with fixed enrages of 100, 500, 750, 1000, 2000 and 4000%, mechanics and strategies may differ based on enrage. For the purposes of this guide, 100% enrage on duo mode will be utilized.

​

General Information

⬥ Ghrazi Blood Knights are located in Havenhythe. Fighting them requires the completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Heralds_of_Crimson Heralds of Crimson] quest.

⬥ Both bosses share a health bar, with health based on chosen mode and enrage:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Normal Mode: 1.5M + 300k

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 100%: 2M + 600k

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 500%: 3M + 900k

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 750%: 3.5M + 1.05M

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1000%: 4M + 1.2M

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2000%: 5M + 1.5M

⬥ As of October 12th, Ghrazi Blood Knights can only be fought in duo, with a solo mode added in November.

​

Gear, Relics, Familiars

The following presets are based on Stage 1 of [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides] for your chosen style. Antisanguine is strongly recommended, as it will apply a 40% damage reduction against all Sanguine damage dealt in this encounter, including Lord Vasily Ghrazi's mechanics.

​

Fight Mechanics (General)

As you are fighting two bosses at the same time, each player will have to handle the mechanics of their respective boss, barring shared mechanics.

​

Attack Rotation

⬥ Karmina attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], Vasily attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], with a mechanic every 4 auto-attacks for both

​

Close Formation

⬥ If Karmina and Vasily are standing next to each other, they gain a stacking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] buff that reduces hit chance

​

Crimson Lament (Vasily) / Blood Challenge (Karmina)

⬥ Both Karmina and Vasily gain a buff every time they hit their target, increasing all incoming damage from them by 4% per stack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Capped at 24 stacks, for a total of 96% increased damage

⬥ Stacks fall off after 30 seconds of not being attacked by the Blood Knight that inflicted the debuff (e.g. not being attacked by Vasily while having stacks of Crimson Lament)

​

Sanguine Influence

⬥ Persistent debuff that increases all incoming damage from both bosses

⬥ Stacks are gained at the start of Phase 2 and throughout Phase 3

​

Note: The current damage boost% per stack is unknown

​

Isolated

⬥ Persistent debuff that prevents players from directly benefitting from Heal Other, Heal Group, or Intercept

⬥ Only appears in 1000% Enrage or higher

​

Mechanics Rotation

⬥ Both Karmina and Vasily perform 4 auto attacks between each mechanic:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cross Cut -> Blood Waves & Sanguine Surge/Lunge -> Blood Bomb & Sanguine Strike/Blood Tribute -> repeat (Phase 1)

​

Cross Cut (a.k.a. Prayer Flurry)

⬥ Both Karmina and Vasily perform a flurry of attacks with all 3 styles, order of incoming attacks are random and the length is based on current phase

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Performs 3 attacks in Phases 1-3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is increased to 5 attacks in Phase 4 onwards

⬥ Each hit deals moderate to high damage if not prayed against, and only 1 damage if prayed against

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unprayed damage has defensive piercing(?)

⬥ All hits are within a tick of each other

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The flurry arrives sooner in 500% Enrage and above

​

Solution:

⬥ Pray against the attacks accordingly:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Red projectile: Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green projectile: Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blue projectile: Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Sanguine Surge (a.k.a. Lunge) (Karmina)

⬥ Karmina performs a hard hitting lunge that deals typeless damage and stuns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] the player

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The lunge has high defensive piercing

​

Solution:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] out of the way to fully negate the mechanic, timing is roughly 2-3 ticks after Karmina says Nowhere is beyond Our reach!​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] to prevent being stunned if caught off guard

​

Note: Sanguine Surge does NOT reset movement abilities on a successful dodge

​

Blood Waves (Vasily)

⬥ Vasily unleashes waves of blood that sweep parts of the arena, dealing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Number of blood waves depend on enrage, but all are 6 tiles wide and on Vasily's target

​

Solution:

⬥ Dodge the waves with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive], taking care not to accidentally hit the Karmina player

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage can be prayed against, and fully negated with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]

​

Sanguine Strike (a.k.a. Blood Tribute) (Karmina)

⬥ Karmina inflicts a hard hitting bleed that deals [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage for 10.2s

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] will not clear the bleed

​

Solution:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] Karmina or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] to mitigate incoming damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, both players switch targets and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] their respective new Blood Knights (e.g. Karmina player switches to Vasily, and vice versa)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] to fully negate the bleed as well as Vasily's attacks, removing KO potential from getting off-styled

​

Note: It's possible to fully pray against all of the Sanguine Strike hits, but it's usually safer to burn a threshold defensive than to flick prayers

​

Blood Bomb (a.k.a. Meatball) (Vasily)

⬥ Vasily unleashes a blob of Sanguine that deals typeless damage as it bounces six times between both players, starting with the player who has Vasily' aggression

⬥ Damage dealt by the blob has defensive piercing, and increases based on distance

​

Solution:

⬥ Stick together and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] to mitigate incoming damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In 750% Enrage or less, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] will drastically limit incoming damage

​

Fight Mechanics (Phase 2)

⬥ The Knights gain 200 Sanguine Influence stacks, increasing their damage dealt

⬥ Vasily gains a new mechanic exclusive to this phase, Tumour Summon

​

Mind Flail (a.k.a. Tumour Summon) (Vasily)

⬥ Vasily summons tumours visible only to the player who has his aggression

⬥ The tumours deal additional damage if allowed to fully channel(?)

​

Solution:

⬥ Clicking on a tumour will expunge it, negating the mechanic if all tumours are expunged

​

Fight Mechanics (Phase 3)

⬥ Both Karmina and Vasily go Immune, and a player is teleported up next to the Sanguine heart, while the arena is littered with Sanguine tumours

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player chosen is random(?)

⬥ One of the Blood Knights stop attacking and start channelling the Sanguine heart, increasing Sanguine Influence stacks

⬥ To progress to the next phase, players must take out the Sanguine heart

​

Sanguine Heart & Tumours

⬥ A player is transported to the top, where they have 18 seconds to deal as much damage as they can to the Sanguine heart

⬥ Six Sanguine Tumours also litter the arena, dealing typeless damage every 6s to the player who wasn't transported

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage dealt by the tumours are based on proximity; they deal less damage farther a player is from them

⬥ Sanguine Heart & Sanguine Tumours have health scaling with enrage:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Normal Mode: 300k LP (Heart), 5k LP (Tumours)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 100%: 400k LP (Heart), 15k LP (Tumours)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 500%: 900k LP (Heart), 27.5k LP (Tumours)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 750%: 1.05M LP (Heart), 33k LP (Tumours)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1000%: 1.2M LP (Heart), 40k LP (Tumours)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2000%: 1.5M LP (Heart), 50k LP (Tumours)

​

Solution:

⬥ Player at the bottom can reset the timer back to 18 seconds by killing Sanguine tumours, though this will also incur 25 stacks of Sanguine Influence and inflict a stack of Haemmorhage to the player attacking the Heart

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Haemmorhage deals [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage every 1.8s, increasing with every stack

​

Blood Diamond (Vasily)

⬥ Vasily summons 2 waves of hard hitting blasts that obliterate a large, diamond shaped area with typeless damage, first blast is smaller than the second

​

Solution:

⬥ The blasts are telegraphed, move out of the way, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] if necessary

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can run 2 tiles diagonally from starting position (and back) to avoid the blasts, preserving [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

Fight Mechanics (Phase 4)

⬥ After destroying the Sanguine Heart, players continue fighting the Blood Knights until their health fall to 0

⬥ Vasily gains a new mechanic during Phase 4

​

Sanguine Spores & Arena Destruction (Vasily)

⬥ Vasily starts charging and infests players with spores that, once on the ground, inflicts persistent [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage over time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A secondary bar will charge above the players' heads indicating when the spores will be placed down on the arena

⬥ Once Vasily finishes charging, some parts of the arena starts glowing red, indicating that they will be ripped away

​

Solution:

⬥ Stand on the glowing tiles that are about to be ripped out and drop the spores there, then move out of the way to avoid a hard instakill [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill]

​

Fight Mechanics (Phase 5)

⬥ Instead of dying, the Blood Knights become enraged, regaining some of their health and starting to inflict the Exsanguinated debuff on the players

⬥ They will also gain a persistent vampyric lifesteal effect during this phase

⬥ To win the fight, the players must lower the health of the Blood Knights to 0

​

Exsanguinated

⬥ Persistent, stacking debuff that builds over time by Karmina and Vasily's attacks and mechanics, increasing all incoming and outgoing damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More stacks are inflicted if a player mis-handles a mechanic(?)

⬥ At 100 stacks, the team WIPES [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill]

​

Solution:

⬥ Use Extra Action button to spawn a cleansing dome that removes Exsanguinated stacks

​

Troubleshooting

TBA

​

Example Kills

TBA

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vguguwzufC.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

A pest hiding under Falador Park. The Giant Mole is an introductory boss aimed at lower-levelled players. She will dig to a different part of the arena for every phase, indicated by a dirt arrow on the ground. This boss can be fought with tier 50-60 gear as well. The main difference between Normal Mode and Hard Mode is that the Giant Mole hits a bit harder and more quickly in Hard Mode.

​

Mechanics

Attack Rotation
Giant Mole uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] auto attacks between mechanics. Her mechanics are based on the chamber she is in. In the last phase she will move to the central chamber and use all four mechanics, starting with Mini-Moles
Burrow
Used after every phase. ⬥ The Giant Mole will burrow into the ground, going to another chamber in the arena. The player should: • Follow the dusty trail and go to the chamber in that direction to continue the fight     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/XRMV1fBCnz.mp4 Click to view an example of Burrow] [https://img.pvme.io/images/XRMV1fBCnz.mp4 Source video]
Mini-Moles
Used in the north-west chamber. ⬥ The Giant Mole will call in moles to fight against you. A message pop-up will say The Giant Mole calls for aid. ⬥ The moles are weak for their combat level, having only 100 lifepoints and hitting max 200. While they are alive the Giant Mole has increased Defence and damage reduction, so it is advised for lower level players to kill them as quickly as possible. The player should: • Use Area-of-Effect (AoE) abilities to kill the Mini Moles, such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1 chain] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/S2L7QwzZtP.mp4 Click to view an example of Mini-Moles] [https://img.pvme.io/images/S2L7QwzZtP.mp4 Source video]
Berserk
Used in the north-east chamber. ⬥ The giant mole will occasionally enter a berserk state where her attacks become stronger, more accurate and faster. This is indicated by her glowing red and green. She can be stunned as she enters this mode: a message pop-up will say The mole can now be stunned. The message The mole seems to regain her balance. will show as Berserk ends. The player could:     • Optionally use stunning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] to stop her attacks     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/EOqLJJ4yhs.mp4 Click to view an example of Berserk] [https://img.pvme.io/images/EOqLJJ4yhs.mp4 Source video]
Rockfall
Used in the south-east chamber. ⬥ The Giant Mole stomps the ground, loosening the ceiling, causing the player to be pinned and hit by falling rubble. This will be preceded by the message: You hear a crumbling noise above. ⬥ In Normal Mode, the main target becomes stunned and bound for 3.6 seconds. The player should:     • Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] or use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] beforehand to free yourself.     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/4VnevH9HQN.mp4 Click to view an example of NM rockfall] ⬥ In Hard Mode, the main target becomes trapped in mud. In this state, players may not move, attack, activate abilities or eat food but may still switch Prayers and drink potions.     • Freeing can be done by another player, or the giant mole will after dealing up to 3,000 damage to you, with the message [https://img.pvme.io/images/4VnevH9HQN.mp4 Source video]The Giant Mole strikes a mighty blow, shattering your muddy prison.     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/y39uBQHO8g.mp4 Click to view an example of HM rockfall] [https://img.pvme.io/images/y39uBQHO8g.mp4 Source video]
Upheaval and Rubble
Used in the south-west chamber. ⬥ The mole will use a rubble attack at the ground near the player's position. This has a 5x5 AoE centred on the player's position and deals 200 hard typeless damage every two ticks. During the attack she will also dive into the ground once, reappearing in another spot. In Hard Mode the damage is doubled from 200 to 400, and she dives twice instead of once. The player should:     • Move away from the area to avoid the attack. ⬥ This attack will also occur if you aren't in attack range of the Giant Mole at any point during the fight.     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/XdcYnY6ORi.mp4 Click to view an example of Upheaval] [https://img.pvme.io/images/XdcYnY6ORi.mp4 Source video]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dHS6UXGykg.png https://img.pvme.io/images/dHS6UXGykg.png] [https://img.pvme.io/images/dHS6UXGykg.png Guide illustration]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=aZpSCcQFoRf9I3PoO7JE Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ViQQNzWIjQiyLnjHu8kW Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FViQQNzWIjQiyLnjHu8kW.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Tips and Tricks

The Giant Mole can teach you to respond to game cues like message pop-ups and some movement, but is mostly an easy boss to get your first taste of bossing or boss kill count.

​

One hurdle for faster kills will be moving between the different chambers quickly, which is where mobility abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] can help a lot.

​

Your options for dealing damage will vary greatly depending on your gear and unlocked abilities.

⬥ When using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use strong threshold magic abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] when available.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can make Giant Mole walk while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb] is active for more damage too

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A god staff special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] is a hard-hitting attack if unlocked

⬥ When using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks, using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] to then use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks, then use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] (or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike])

​

Example Kill

⬥ [https://youtu.be/oU0KdlkKoEU Giant Mole NM magic]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/befXbfQX0n.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Gregorovic is located in the Heart of Gielinor.

⬥ Gregorovic has 200,000 LP in both Normal Mode and Hard Mode.

⬥ Level 80 Prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] and 40 Sliske kill count are required to enter.

⬥ Gregorovic can hit hard and accurately, making him one of the harder GWD2 bosses for learners.

⬥ In Hard Mode, Gregorovic is immune to poison and gains the Join Me Wight phase after reaching 0 LP.

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=gregorovic Gregorovic guides] [[PvME/Gregorovic/AFK Gregorovic|AFK Gregorovic]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

The following presets are based on Stage 1 [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides]:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=36ec3ebe-379d-4350-a3ff-ce7a88f7525a Magic]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=50e03e24-37ad-4be8-abf5-a4bb22c0aa09 Ranged]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=de7d0a00-3300-4607-ad6f-0c98f839c560 Melee]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918 Necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

⬥ Gregorovic deals both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] auto-attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Force Ranged hits by standing at 2+ squares away where possible

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using Melee, use halberd-range weapon e.g., Laniakea's Spear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear], Dragon Rider Lance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643161541931171872.png?v=1 dragonriderlance] or Noxious scythe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159341322240.png?v=1 noxscythe]

⬥ In Hard Mode, flick between Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] protection prayers

​

Attack Rotation

⬥ Normal Mode: 3 auto attacks → Trick Knife → 3 auto attacks → Summon Spirit → 3 auto attacks → Glaive Throw → Repeat

⬥ Hard Mode: 3 auto attacks → Trick Knife → 3 auto attacks → Summon Spirit → 3 auto attacks → Glaive Throw → Repeat

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 0 LP in Hard Mode, Gregorovic uses Join Me, then resumes his attack rotation after all Wight Hunters are killed

​

Trick Knife [https://img.pvme.io/images/aFZzLQF.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/aFZzLQF.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Gregorovic throws a blade after 3 auto attacks

⬥ The blade hits players 3 times total

⬥ In solo, all 3 hits will usually hit you

​

Solution:

⬥ Pray against Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551455078367313.png?v=1 protectfrommissiles]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] if you have low Defence

​

Summon Spirit [https://img.pvme.io/images/BVvu3F8.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/BVvu3F8.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Gregorovic summons a spirit that walks towards him, based on whichever mask you are nearest

⬥ If it reaches Gregorovic, he gains a buff

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spirit of Mania increases attack speed (south-west)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spirit of Rage increases damage (south-east)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spirit of Delirium increases poison damage (north)

⬥ In Hard Mode, 2 spirits spawn and move faster

​

Solutions:

⬥ Kill or ignore the spirit, or;

⬥ Force the Spirit of Delirium by standing in the north-west

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use either Irit Incense Sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265371144202.png?v=1 IritSticks] or Venomblood perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] and completely ignore the spirit

​

Glaive Throw [https://img.pvme.io/images/ZPw1hZR.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/ZPw1hZR.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Gregorovic marks shadow spots on the floor, including under you

⬥ Standing in shadows causes a large Magic hit

​

Solution:

⬥ Step onto a tile with no shadows

​

Shadows [https://img.pvme.io/images/4ce8fSc.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/4ce8fSc.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Gregorovic summons shadows at 140,000 LP and 60,000 LP and may teleport to them

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Normal Mode: 2 shadows, then 3 shadows

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hard Mode: 3 shadows, then 4 shadows

​

Solution:

⬥ Kill shadows with AoE abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] or simply ignore them

⬥ Note: you may need to ret-arget Gregorovic if he teleports

​

Join Me (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ At 0 LP, Gregorovic becomes invulnerable and turns you into a shadow clone

⬥ You will not be able to use damaging abilities

⬥ Gregorovic heals while 6 Wight Hunters spawn over time

⬥ Wight Hunters have 9,000 LP each

⬥ Your auto attacks deal high damage and can bounce to nearby wights

​

Solution:

⬥ Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to a corner to stack the Wight Hunters in a line

⬥ Click the closest Wight Hunter to deal damage

⬥ Avoid eating solid food, as it delays your auto attacks

⬥ Note: you can use defensive abilities to build adrenaline if low [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke]

​

Final Phase (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ After all 6 Wight Hunters die, Gregorovic becomes attackable again, returning with around 65,000-95,000 LP

⬥ Greg will return to his attack rotation

​

Solution:

⬥ Deal damage & handle mechanics normally again

​

Videos

⬥ Normal Mode examples: [https://youtu.be/5KfUDxPPyzM Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Hard Mode examples: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lAZVrjptcVo Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/F2iSmgl0OR.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Helwyr is a 1-phase fight in the Heart of Gielinor.

⬥ Helwyr has 200,000 LP in Normal Mode and 300,000 LP in Hard Mode.

⬥ Level 80 Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] is required to create an instance, which you can boost with any magic potion.

⬥ In Hard Mode, Helwyr gains stronger versions of his standard mechanics and an additional Mushroom Barrage mechanic.

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=helwyr Helwyr guides] [[PvME/Helwyr/AFK Helwyr|AFK Helwyr]] [[PvME/Helwyr/Low Effort Helwyr Hardmode|Low Effort Helwyr Hardmode]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

The following presets are based on Stage 1 [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides]:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=36ec3ebe-379d-4350-a3ff-ce7a88f7525a Magic]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=50e03e24-37ad-4be8-abf5-a4bb22c0aa09 Ranged]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=de7d0a00-3300-4607-ad6f-0c98f839c560 Melee]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918 Necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

​

Attack Rotation

⬥ Normal Mode: Mushroom Gas → 2 auto attacks → Cleave → 2 auto attacks → Frenzy → 2 auto attacks → Minions → 2 auto attacks → Repeat

⬥ Hard Mode: Mushroom Gas → 2 auto attacks → Cleave → 2 auto attacks → Frenzy → 2 auto attacks → Minions → 2 auto attacks → Mushroom Barrage → 2 auto attacks → Repeat

​

Mushroom Gas [https://img.pvme.io/images/KHMLekU.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/KHMLekU.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ A large gas cloud spawns, dealing rapid typeless damage and binding you if stood in for too long

⬥ In Hard Mode, 6 mushrooms release gas clouds at once, making the safe movement area smaller

​

Solution:

⬥ Move out of the gas

⬥ Stand near the edge of mushrooms to reduce the distance needed to move

⬥ If bound, do not use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom], as you want this saved for Frenzy

​

Cleave [https://img.pvme.io/images/OKDS0F5.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/OKDS0F5.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Helwyr stands up, dealing a large Melee attack in a frontal cone and applying a bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] on you

⬥ In Hard Mode, this can hit up to around 7,000 damage, disables protection prayers, and applies a typeless bleed

​

Solution:

⬥ Step out of the damage cone or

⬥ Use Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] to block the hit or

⬥ Use Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to heal from the hit

⬥ Vengeance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 Veng] can also be used

⬥ Do not use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the bleed, as you want this saved for Frenzy

​

Frenzy [https://img.pvme.io/images/G5CPPoC.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/G5CPPoC.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Helwyr spins and leaps around, dealing rapid Melee hits, with each hit reapplying a bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] on you

⬥ In Hard Mode, this damage is more punishing, especially if several bleed stacks are left active

​

Solution:

⬥ Use Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + pray against Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] to fully negate the damage

⬥ Debilitate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] can be used if Devotion is unavailable

⬥ With Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] or Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy], you can run away during the attack

⬥ With Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], it is usually better to stay in range and continue attacking

⬥ Use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] after Frenzy ends to clear the bleed

​

Minion Spawn [https://img.pvme.io/images/EB1ss4g.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/EB1ss4g.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Two Cywir Alphas are summoned to fight alongside Helwyr

⬥ In Normal Mode, they have around 3,000 LP each

⬥ In Hard Mode, they have around 5,000 LP each

​

Solution:

⬥ Kill them using AoE abilities or

⬥ Ignore them if you are comfortable with the extra damage

​

Mushroom Barrage (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ Helwyr blows up rows of mushrooms, dealing heavy typeless AoE damage per mushroom. One row is safe at a time, starting from the north and moving south after each explosion

⬥ This mechanic has no text or animation cue, but starts at around 00:50 kill time

​

Solution:

⬥ Move from north to south with the safe row

⬥ Avoid active mushroom gas clouds while moving

⬥ Use Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] and Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to reposition safely

⬥ Avoid standing near exploding mushrooms, as each explosion can deal around 5,500-6,000 typeless damage

​

Videos

⬥ [https://youtu.be/YXT-U2_XR-E Example kill]

​

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/YXT-U2_XR-E Embedded guide video] == Attribution and source history == Adapted from [https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/basic-guides/helwyr-basic/ Helwyr Basic] by PvME contributors. pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/RHEqJmlz7S.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

A powerful three-headed dragon residing north-west of the Edgeville lodestone. The King Black Dragon (KBD) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213018054852648.png?v=1 kbd] is an iconic lower-level boss suitable for players with tier 50-70 gear. His attacks involve dealing with high-damage Dragonfire and other elemental breath attacks.

​

Mechanics

Melee attacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]
⬥ The King Black Dragon can bite or swipe at the player, dealing up to 1,000 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage.     • The player can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1 protectfrommelee] to reduce this damage. ​
Fire Breath
⬥ The King Black Dragon can use regular dragonfire, hitting up 4,000 typeless damage     • The player should: use dragonfire protection, like super antifire potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1 superantifire] to strongly reduce this damage.         • If F2P: use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1 protectfrommagic] (recommended for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]) or anti-dragon shield. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/vE1ZG0djXT.png Click to view an example]
Frostfire Breath
⬥ A freezing type of dragonfire, which binds the player in place for a short duration.     • Note: This attack can hit up to 1,000 damage through [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1 superantifire] ​[https://img.pvme.io/images/pF0ng6BOhZ.webp Click to view an example]
Toxic Breath
⬥ A venomous type of dragonfire, which inflicts the player with poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] This can be mitigated by a variety of antipoison potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588884406272.png?v=1 superantipoison]     • Note: This attack can hit up to 1,000 damage through [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1 superantifire] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/7D8Ti9iVps.png Click to view an example]
Charged Breath
⬥ A shocking type of dragonfire that deals dragonfire damage, as well as slightly reducing your skill levels and prayer points.     • Note: This attack can hit up to 1,000 damage through [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1 superantifire] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/KlRFWMU11K.webp Click to view an example]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=huMj1Vo3XAJi6BhZkzgu Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=B0zo7I1FcF8bpWtHgBf6 Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=T1falNlWgx10W6x21LjH Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=zNOontl68LmQpELThf5v Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FzNOontl68LmQpELThf5v.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Tips and Tricks

The King Black Dragon's mechanics are mostly accounted for via good preparation such as bringing protection from dragonfire. During the fight you'll be largely focused on dealing good damage.

⬥ If you have access to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1 protectfrommelee], use it and stand in melee distance.

⬥ Don't forget to use any damage-boosting prayers you have available!

​

Your options for dealing damage will vary greatly depending on your gear and unlocked abilities. The below are guidelines, assuming no expensive unlocks.

​

Build adrenaline (and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]) and use strong threshold abilities when available:

​

⬥ Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]: wild magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] and asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try combust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb] and stepping under KBD!

⬥ Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]: assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] and destroy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] or hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try Slaughter [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1 slaughter] and stepping under KBD!

⬥ Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]: snapshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] and rapid fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try fragmentation shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541273755385885.png?v=1 frag] and stepping under KBD!

⬥ Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]: finger of death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] and volley of souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Having your skeleton [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] , ghost [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] , and bloat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] active is also a good idea.

​

Example Kill

We do not currently have a video for this guide. Interested in helping a fellow Scaper out? Post a videolink largely matching the guide in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)] in our Discord server!

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png Guide illustration]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=r3MoH4bAzq0LpS6ZfAro Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=zIW5ctjjvzeEjwkhdzGD Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FzIW5ctjjvzeEjwkhdzGD.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

General Knowledge

Phases

⬥ Kerapac has 4 phases, he transitions into next phase when brought down to 50k HP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac has 450k HP per phase (phase 4 excluded), making it so you need to deal 400k damage each phase.

​

Mechanics Summary

Auto Attacks

⬥ Kerapac uses magic attacks throughout the entirety of the fight.

​

Special Attacks

⬥ Shatter

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac raises his staff in the air before slamming it down, stunning the player and spawning a time rift.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move under Kerapac before he slams the ground to deny both the stun and the time rift.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Utilise channeled thresholds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] while under Kerapac.

​

⬥ Jumping Slam

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac flies into the air before diving on top of the player, stunning them and dealing constant melee damage, repeats 3 times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Kerapac lands on top the player, he receives decreased damage until the player moves out of range.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Overcharged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring] passive effect protects against the stun.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and move out of range after Kerapac lands to stop the melee hits.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Alternatively, use a mobility ability ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]) to dodge the slam. If dodged with perfect timing, the cooldowns of the these abilities will be reset.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Past slams will be present in the phases that follow, and are carried out by Kerapac echoes that only hit once when landing.

​

⬥ Lightning Strike

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac spawns a lightning wall that travels across the room in a random direction, dealing hard typeless damage upon contact.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to pass through the lightning walls.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Past lightning walls will be present in the phases that follow, meaning there is one lightning wall in phase 1, two walls on phase 2, and three walls on phase 3.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Lightning walls keep going even if a new phase starts.

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] Time Warp

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Accessible after phase 2 starts.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 10.2s after activation, your position, adrenaline, cooldowns and HP are all reverted back to the point before activation.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Special attack weapon cooldowns such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] are not affected.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Adrenaline potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] cooldowns are unaffected; however, Limitless [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] is.

​

⬥ Echoes & Clones

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On phase 4, Kerapac spawns 3 echoes of himself and 3 clones of the player in the North, West and South sections of the platform.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You will have to kill all 3 clones before you're able to deal damage to Kerapac.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Clicking a clone of yourself will teleport you to the clone's location as well as replacing your health with the clone's health.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Not clicking a clone in P4 will result in you dealing heavily reduced damage to the echoes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Clones' health are affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] potions.

​

⬥ Fury

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 4, the more stacks Kerapac and his echoes have, the stronger their damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac and his echoes start at 0 fury stacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 50 fury stacks are added upon each death of a Kerapac echo.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 25 upon each death of a player clone.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 25 upon the death of all Kerapac echoes.

​

Kerapac Attack Pattern

Phases 1-3

⬥ 3 Autos → Shatter → 3 Autos → Jumping Slam → 3 Autos → Lightning Strike → 7 Autos → Repeat from Shatter

​

Phase 4

⬥ Kerapac will only use auto-attacks.

⬥ Kerapac heals up to 200k HP and becomes untargetable.

⬥ Kerapac spawns 3 echoes of himself (100k HP each) and 3 clones of the player.

​

Basic Rotations

Note: resort to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/873142795706179651.png?v=1 zamorakstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] where possible.

​

Phase 1

⬥ Magic: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ Ranged: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid]

​

Phases 2 and 3

⬥ Magic: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ Ranged: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid]

​

Phase 4

Note: You will be under extremely heavy damage so spamming food is expected and required. Switch to your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] during this phase in case of death.

​

Magic

⬥ Enter a side clone and place yourself between two Kerapac echoes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] → hop to the farthest clone → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] → hop back to the original clone.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Echo 1: Basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] ends.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Echo 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/873142795706179651.png?v=1 zamorakstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

⬥ Go between Kerapac and the remaining echo, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] while eating close to full.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Echo 3: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] → basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + remaining thresholds + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/873142795706179651.png?v=1 zamorakstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] how you see fit.

​

Ranged

⬥ Enter a side clone and place yourself between two Kerapac echoes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] → hop to the farthest clone → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] → hop back to the original clone.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Echo 1: Basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] ends.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Echo 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] + basics.

⬥ Go between Kerapac and the remaining echo, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] while eating close to full.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Echo 3: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] → basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kerapac: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + remaining thresholds + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] how you see fit.

​

Example Kills

⬥ Magic: [https://youtu.be/RaVAlzwmKJY https://youtu.be/RaVAlzwmKJY]

⬥ Ranged: [https://youtu.be/JiHCvhgtYN8 https://youtu.be/JiHCvhgtYN8]
