[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EHBFVhLaE2.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

Nex is the Zarosian general found within the God Wars Dungeon. The [https://runescape.wiki/w/Frozen_key frozen key] is required in order to access the area of the dungeon where Nex is located.

​

⬥ 40 kill count is required in order access the encounter.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be bypassed by wearing a full set of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_ceremonial_robe_outfit ancient ceremonial robes] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522629804062.png?v=1 ceremonialmask]

⬥ The ability to access Nex without any of the usual requirements may be purchased for 10 million coins, a full set of ancient ceremonial robes, and the frozen key.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This may be purchased by speaking with the banker, [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ashuelot_Reis Ashuelot Reis].

​

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=IazpBk7RWF0MhY3Y5x0O Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FIazpBk7RWF0MhY3Y5x0O.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Mechanics

Nex Overview

⬥ Nex is a 1x1 NPC and has very strict softcaps, which means that any damage over a certain amount is reduced by X% depending on the phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During the first four phases, Nex has a soft cap that reduces excess damage above 5,000 by 50%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For example, a 6,000 damage hit would be reduced to 5,500 damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On the Zaros phase, the soft cap is changed to reduce excess damage above 2,000 by 75%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This means a 6,000-damage hit would be reduced to 3,000.

​

Mages Overview

⬥ Mages have a soft cap that reduces excess damage above 1,000 by a random amount between approximately 80% and 100%.

⬥ Each mage has 10,000 health and possesses a max hit of around 850. The mages are static and can only be attacked whenever Nex calls their name.

​

Note: Nex has 5 phases; Smoke, Shadow, Blood, Ice, and Zaros. Each phase has 2 special attacks, with the exception of Zaros.

​

Nex Attack Pattern

[https://img.pvme.io/images/uDTfJso.png Guide illustration] ​

Special Attacks

Smoke Phase
⬥ Virus → 5 auto-attacks → No escape → Five auto-attacks → Repeat.     • Don't stand in middle crossways. [https://img.pvme.io/images/BgsPoty.mp4 Example]     • Nex may drag you to MD of her at random times, nulling all damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/BgsPoty.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/0tauAFe.mp4 Example] [https://img.pvme.io/images/0tauAFe.mp4 Source video]
Shadow Phase
⬥ Shadow traps (if phased before virus) → Darkness → Shadow traps → 4 auto-attacks → Repeats from second shadow traps. ⬥ Move from Shadows and don’t stand MD.     • A shadow trap is avoided. [https://img.pvme.io/images/FZJq76Y.mp4 Example]     • A player escapes the shadows engulfing them. [https://img.pvme.io/images/FZJq76Y.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/4cZwRUJ.mp4 Example] [https://img.pvme.io/images/4cZwRUJ.mp4 Source video]
Blood Phase
⬥ Siphon summon → 3 auto-attacks → Blood sacrifice → 3 auto-attacks → Repeat. ⬥ Attacks during Siphon will heal Nex and sacrifice will heal Nex if not phased and in range.     • Nex summoning her Blood Reavers. [https://img.pvme.io/images/480GewR.mp4 Example]     • Nex sacrifices a player. [https://img.pvme.io/images/480GewR.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/qnjrQdC.mp4 Example] ⬥ Any bleeds used during this phase will heal Nex rather than damage her. [https://img.pvme.io/images/qnjrQdC.mp4 Source video]
Ice Phase
⬥ First special attack (based on phase start) → 3 auto-attacks → Second special attack (based on phase start) → 3 auto-attacks → Repeat. ⬥ If Blood phase ended with Sacrifice, Ice will start with Contain. [https://img.pvme.io/images/zFmdn67.mp4 Example] ⬥ If Blood phase ended with Siphon, Ice will start with Prison. [https://img.pvme.io/images/zFmdn67.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/YGkCP6F.mp4 Example]     • Run from Contain and Freedom [https://img.pvme.io/images/YGkCP6F.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] into eating up then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]     • Glacies' attacks can freeze players if they aren't using Protect/Deflect Magic; keeping the prayer active will result in all of her attacks missing regardless of the player's armour rating.
Zaros Phase
⬥ Upon the start of this phase, Nex activates Turmoil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] and heals herself for 33,333 (1/6) of her health to boost it up to 73,333. [https://img.pvme.io/images/lPTF0V0.mp4 Example] ⬥ Nex does not have any unique special attacks in this phase, she will instead [https://img.pvme.io/images/lPTF0V0.mp4 Source video]randomly cycle between her melee and magic autoattacks.     • If needed, you may run away from Nex whilst attacking her.

​

The Fight

Preventing Nex from Meleeing

Matching or having a higher Ranged defence compared to your Magic defence as shown below (found on the "Hero" tab in the subsection "loadout") will prevent Nex from attempting to melee you during the smoke and shadow phases.

While using Necromancy gear both these values will be the same by default.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/7yyiVRl.png Guide illustration] ​

Rotations

Notes Before The Fight

⬥ An Adrenaline Potion ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337470491033600.png?v=1 replenpot] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]) maybe be used if you're struggling with adrenaline.

⬥ In general, when running to minions you may use the time to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

⬥ As Nex spawns aim to use: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul]

⬥ The easiest way to kite Nex (only whilst she is attempting to melee you) is to move as a horse/knight does in chess (or in the shape of an L), then continuing. If you are having trouble with this, then another legitimate method is to flail your mouse and continuously click (this will be less effective but can stall her a good amount).

​

Smoke Phase

⬥ Vulnerability bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] Nex either just before she is attackable (12.0s on the boss kill timer) or during the early stages of the smoke phase.

⬥ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → build stacks and improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once she phases (160,000 HP) it's time for Fumus. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] will be nice here to disallow Nex to stun you whilst you're killing Fumus.

​

Shadow Phase

⬥ Be sure to switch to Protect from Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange].

⬥ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] and continue to build stacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] with 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] with 6+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] if needed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once she phases (120,000 HP), it's time for Umbra. Try to kill her in the exact same way as you killed Fumus.

​

Blood Phase

⬥ Be sure to switch back to protect magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage].

⬥ Throw another Vulnerability Bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb].

⬥ During her Blood Siphon, you may opt to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] as her wings reach their highest point or after. Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] with 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] OR [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] with 6+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once she phases (80,000 HP), your next target is Cruor. Try to kill him in the exact same way as you killed Fumus.

​

Ice Phase

⬥ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] as she is phasing → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

⬥ Alternatively: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] with 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] OR [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] with 6+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] (whichever you did not use last phase) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once she phases (40,000 HP), it's time for the final minion, Glacies. Try to kill her in the exact way as you killed Fumus.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Nex uses her Ice Prison special, use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] + Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

​

Zaros Phase

⬥ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] with 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] OR [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] with 6+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → Improvise

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/a6cpHA5pKSM Nex Basic]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/a6cpHA5pKSM Embedded guide video]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/84XEYnJq1T.png Guide illustration]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8tHDhZfEj1qjSLlYnxlU Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=nbcWVE1htdRe9esuOac6 Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FnbcWVE1htdRe9esuOac6.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

General Knowledge

⬥ Raksha fight consists of 4 phases, with 200k HP for each phase (400k if duo).

⬥ Prayer flicking is crucial and mandatory as Raksha is able to use all three combat styles.

⬥ Raksha uses a special attack after every 4 normal attacks during phases 1-3, and after every 2 normal attacks during phase 4.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1 er4] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] to ensure 1k minimum damage with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To see if you meet the minimum damage requirement, go to dummies at War's Retreat, set them to minimum hit mode, and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] with your Raksha gear.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you did not meet the requirement, use to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 Malevolence] while using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]

​

Unlocking Raksha

Raksha, the Shadow Colossus (Miniquest)

⬥ Slayer Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape] tele to Laniakea, speak to her about the door at the top of the ruins.

⬥ Go through all the dialogue, then head to the south west, siphon the purple stuff (Takes like 1 minute).

⬥ After siphoning the purple stuff, head in through the door and space bar through dialogue; miniquest complete.

​

Recommendation

Due to the nature of Raksha being very prayer-flick reliant, you may find it helpful to practice prayer flicking with nothing but a weapon until death, while doing damage and dealing with mechanics.

Repeat this until you get the hang of prayer flicking under pressure.

Note: if you are in melee distance, Raksha will not use the same style auto-attack back-to-back

​

Raksha Attack Pattern

[https://img.pvme.io/images/b37wb1r.png Guide illustration]

​

Mechanics Summary

Phases 1-3

⬥ Rockfall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Happens between phases 1-3 transitions.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5x5 rocks fall from the ceiling that deal heavy typeless damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Small rubbles indicate the spots rocks will fall on.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move out of the way before rocks hit the floor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

​

⬥ Tail Swipe and Charge

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tail Swipe → If the player is in melee distance → Raksha spins around in a 3x3 radius.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Charge → If the player is outside of melee distance → Raksha charges towards the player.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Getting hit by either of those attacks results in heavy typeless damage and a stun.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Remain in melee distance to avoid getting a Charge attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Run out of spin radius once Raksha starts the Tail Swipe animation.

​

⬥ Shadow Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha stuns the player before launching a shadow bomb that explodes and leaves a poison cloud in a 3x3 radius.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha launches 3 bombs in phase 3.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] beforehand to protect against the stun.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move out of the bomb's radius before it lands.

​

⬥ 5X Shockwave

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha walks to the middle of the room and unleashes 5 strong magic attacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Phase Raksha before he can reach this special attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Restart the fight if you receive said special attack.

​

⬥ Mind Poison

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha immobilizes the player and spawns 2-5 orbs that deal constant typeless damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Failure of expelling the orbs will result in heavy typeless damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Click the orbs to expel them.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Clicking the orbs does not interrupt combat or channeled abilities.

​

⬥ Shadow Anima Pools

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Harmless 1k HP pools that spawn in 4 different areas.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During phase 3, Raksha absorbs anima from said pools.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ At the start of phase 3, kill all pools with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1 Laceration] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] before Raksha can absorb any anima.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ DO NOT use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] during global cooldown as it will deal no damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] on the pool highlighted in green (using it on the pools in red will not guarantee all pools in the vicinity being cleared)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4hSPQGW.png Guide illustration] ​

⬥ Minion Spawn

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 3.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha spawns a 10k HP melee minion during Mind Poison.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] against minion when Raksha isn't attacking, and focus on phasing Raksha.

​

Phase 4

⬥ Raksha heals up to 400k HP.

​

⬥ Tail Swipe and Shadow Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tail Swipe → If the player is in melee distance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shadow Bomb → If the player is outside of melee distance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand anywhere on the red lines to force Tail Swipes.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Tw4qZsT.png Guide illustration]

​

⬥ Erebus Charge

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 4.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha stops attacking and covers himself in a blue dome.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deal enough damage to break the dome.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The dome's health scales with how much anima Raksha previously absorbed from phase 3.

​

⬥ Inner Power

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Extra action button, exclusive to phase 4.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Available after Erebus Charge special attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon activation, increase your damage by 10% for each shadow anima you collected.

​

⬥ Shadow Anima

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exclusive to phase 4.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After destroying the blue dome during Erebus Charge, collectable shadow anima drop on the ground.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Collect 6-12 anima before activating Inner Power.

​

Basic Rotations

Ranged

Note: If you do not own the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] cape, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] instead of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541307666595870.png?v=1 deadshot]

​

Phase 1:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Phase 2:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous]

​

Phase 3:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1 Laceration] → clear pools with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] after all rocks fall.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Phase 4:

⬥ Prioritise using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] in that order

⬥ Collect anima after dome breaks, utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

⬥ Inner Power → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Magic

In general, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] whenever you have excess adrenaline or if you need a little more damage to phase before a certain spec.

​

Phase 1:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

​

Phase 2:

⬥ Use powerful basics, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] as they come off cooldown.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] as soon as they come off cooldown.

​

Phase 3:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1 Laceration] → clear pools with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] after all rocks fall.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] → basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

​

Phase 4:

⬥ Refresh [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] upon entry, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] while waiting for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] cooldown, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] when it becomes available.

⬥ Quickly collect some anima after dome breaks, usually done by walking to a side of the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to the other side.

⬥ Inner Power and try to finish off Raksha while in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf].

​

Example Kills

[https://youtu.be/esnDkA33hig https://youtu.be/esnDkA33hig] - Ranged Example (Crossbows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468775936.png?v=1 ascmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159362031631.png?v=1 ascoh])

​

[https://youtu.be/iLVpl256hJo https://youtu.be/iLVpl256hJo] - Ranged Examples (Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation])

​

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v2NGGkN3YI0 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v2NGGkN3YI0] - Magic Example

​

Alt1 Raksha Helper

Voice guidance throughout the kill

This tool reads your screen, and based on certain lines of dialogue in your chatbox, will trigger and play voice lines during the kill to let you know about upcoming mechanics and what to do for them.

​

Disclaimer: Alt1 is a third party tool, and while generally safe to use, is still recommended to be installed and used at your own risk.

Alt1 Raksha Helper
Check out [https://linktr.ee/igorspresets Igor's Presets] and follow the download instructions there for Alt1 presets for this boss and more!

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/boe0MAWJIW.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

Rise of the Six (RotS) is a follow-up to the original Barrows Brothers encounter. Players, in groups of sizes 1 to 4, will take the six brothers in a cave-like arena. The brothers in RotS are significantly stronger than in the original encounter, and have deadly mechanics.

​

After successfully killing all brothers, the player is tasked with escaping from the cave through a randomly generated tunnel.

​

Please note that you can attune your Barrows portal in War's Retreat directly to the Rise of the Six well, as shown [https://img.pvme.io/images/NB0HcoM.png here].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pmFdFBCEsQgOGqBVVDBQ Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=KVD8GZMr7eb8REIakJdv Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FKVD8GZMr7eb8REIakJdv.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Arena Overview

The RotS arena is unique in that it is randomly generated for each and every kill. The path may twist and turn, and features a host of gaps, crossed by bridges. At the end of the tunnel there are four pads. In order to enter the final section of the arena, where the fight takes place, every player must stand on a pad.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JQrja8Q.png Guide illustration]

​

Mechanics

Brothers

The mechanics encountered are described on a brother-by-brother basis. As a general rule of thumb: if something looks bad in RotS, it probably is.

​

There are some mechanics that are shared across all brothers. Namely:

​

⬥ Shadow Realm

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A random brother will pull all players into the shadow realm.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The screen will turn a shade of grey, and all brothers will deal increased damage (including their special mechanics).

​

⬥ Healing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon killing a brother, a bar will be placed above their heads.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the bar is filled, all deceased brothers will return to life.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Killing another brother will reset all bars back to empty.

​

Some other mechanics are shared between just a few brothers:

​

⬥ Hurricane

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All melee brothers (Dharok, Guthan, Torag, Verac).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Brother will slow down and spin in a circle, dealing rapid damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stay away from them!

​

⬥ Wall Slam

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dharok, Torag, Verac.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Brother will jump off the wall, and deal damage in a 5x5 area on landing.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Run away before it lands!

​

⬥ Lightning Conductor / Turret of Fire

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil and Ahrim, respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spin around shooting energy out of their hands and become immune to damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stay away from them!

​

⬥ Teleport

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil or Ahrim will teleport up high in the centre of the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil will then unleash lightning across the other side of the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Surge through the lightning, or move sideways to dodge it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ahrim will then unleash purple and red gas pits that deal damage if stood upon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Do not step on the pits!

​

⬥ Throw

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Karil or Ahrim will be thrown across the room in a random direction, dealing damage if stuck under them.

​

Finally, each brother has its own unique mechanics, as described below:

​

Ahrim, the Blighted
⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] ⬥ Special: Flight     • Mechanic: levitates in the air, gaining full immunity against [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage, and 50% reduction in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] damage     • Strategy: continue to deal damage as normal, unless using magic or melee (switch to another target, if so)
[https://img.pvme.io/images/cd2jksl.png Guide illustration]

​

Dharok, the Wretched
⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ⬥ Special: Give Me Everything!     • Mechanic: becomes immune and absorbs all damage taken for 10 seconds, then hits the player with his axe, dealing the full value of absorbed damage     • Strategy: do not deal damage to Dharok until the animation is finished
[https://img.pvme.io/images/Hu9KXnp.png Guide illustration]

​

Guthan, the Infested
⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ⬥ Special: Impale     • Mechanic: throws his spear at a player. Player will be frozen briefly, and then start taking rapid damage     • Strategy: stand next to Guthan until he pulls his spear back out, dealing 1000 damage
[https://img.pvme.io/images/fDdXidh.png Guide illustration]

​

Karil, the Tainted
⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] ⬥ Special: Portal Dash     • Mechanic: Teleports to the other side of the chasm, leaving behind a bomb which deals very high damage in an 8x8 range. Repeats three times per side     • Strategy: Stay well clear of each bomb (it will spawn in the place Karil disappeared from)
[https://img.pvme.io/images/QUyvMQt.png Guide illustration]

​

Torag, the Corrupted
⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ⬥ Special: Whack     • Mechanic: slams the player into the ground and starts whacking them into the ground     • Strategy: the other player should deal damage to Torag until the player is freed
[https://img.pvme.io/images/BLRn2Cr.png Guide illustration]

​

Verac, the Defiled
⬥ Attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ⬥ Special: Soulspot     • Mechanic: Verac will mark a location on the map with green arrows, and rapidly drain prayer points     • Strategy: Proceed to the location marked by the four green arrows to stop the drain ⬥ Special: Deathcopter     • Mechanic: tracks a player with his flail, similar to the hurricane mechanic     • Strategy: stay at a safe distance
[https://img.pvme.io/images/rTZvYKT.png Guide illustration]

​

Tunnel Escape

In general, your goal is to reach the end of the tunnel and climb the rope, as fast as possible. In doing so, you will have to navigate around fallen obstacles, as well as cross gaps - these gaps were previously home to bridges; however, they are destroyed before the escape.

​

Make sure that all players have looted the chest and are ready to proceed before starting the escape. It only takes one person crossing the line to trigger the tunnel collapse.

​

Each previous bridge is replaced with two options: a ledge on the side of the gap, and a pedestal/vine in the middle of the gap. It is recommended to save the pedestal/vine for the last person crossing the gap. Players farther up should instead use the ledge.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5hxreuy.jpg Guide illustration]

​

While navigating the tunnel, it is recommended to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as much as possible, preferably with the Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] perk in effect. It is recommended to use a Powerburst of Acceleration [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] during the escape so that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] can be used repeatedly, for a short while.

​

As the countdown continues, you may notice your screen tilting and shaking more aggressively. If desired, it can be helpful to turn this off in settings: Gameplay > Camera > System > Camera Shake.

​

Basic Strategy

Keep in mind the golden rule of RotS: if it looks bad, it is.

​

Players in a group should split sides; for example, one experienced player soloing one side, and two less experienced players duoing the other side. Or, a solo/duo on either side.

​

Once everyone is inside the final arena, take position and prepare for the fight. If duoing a side, it is recommended to position as shown below, with one player holding aggro of the brothers (green diamond), and the other DPSing from a safe distance (blue square). The player holding aggro of the brothers can 'kite' as required in order to keep themselves safe. The player holding aggro should also use Incite [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1 Incite]. Once positioned, players can start the fight by right-clicking the shadow portal in the middle of the arena.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/FdM5SZz.jpg Guide illustration]

​

Prioritising Karil first is recommended, followed by Torag. Largely speaking, the other brothers can be killed with less urgency. Keep in mind the mechanics of each brother, and kite as necessary so as to delay or avoid their special attacks.

​

More Advanced Positioning

After gaining a bit of experience, it is possible to experiment with positioning. Both players can activate Soul Link [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989442220484616242.png?v=1 soullink] curse, stand on the same square, and don’t move unless necessary. The player using Incite [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1 Incite] will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and the DPSer can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989442220484616242.png?v=1 soullink] splits both the damage taken and health healed between the two players. This allows the incite to stay healthy while not moving, maintaining the stack of brothers and effectiveness of chins.

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gmrKIcfK2P.png Guide illustration]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d0Xvf3aqRMg3ot8FsO5S Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=CdctKobsOgdb24snUVkE Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=LHW4UPqeU5nGVxRNopLG Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JCCwlzEhxz4xTkI6lXx3 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FJCCwlzEhxz4xTkI6lXx3.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Phase One Mechanics

Pads

⬥ One green pad for each player in the battle will spawn at a random location

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to stand on a pad before the falling spore hits the ground

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players will be dealt 5-6k blight damage per pad missed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] can be used to survive missing (or skipping) pads

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] will also be required to survive skipping pads in groups of size 3 to 6

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] will not guarantee survival in a group of 7, at least one pad must be taken with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

Personal Blight Bomb

⬥ After pads, all players will have a bar above their head

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] as the bar fills entirely to negate the 9-10k damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ‎ ‎If you are not the base you can safely [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] after the first auto post the bar appearing above your head

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ‎ ‎If you are the base, the timing is a little tight. A melee smack will come out right before the bomb explodes. While learning use both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

​

Volatile Rootlings

⬥ At 0:21, 8 Volatile Rootlings [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/848803062684581929.png?v=1 roots] appear around the edges of the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended for each player to pre-place a set of two [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] underneath rootling spawn points before starting the fight

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] should be placed same-tick. If not, the second one will sometimes not explode

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A second set of two [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] can be placed while killing the remaining rootlings

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rootlings have 20,000 hp in a duo and gain 12,500 hp for every additional player in the fight

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not killed by around 1:30, they will become Blightbound Lashers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180203062001664.png?v=1 blightlasher]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Lashers will attack with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and can deal heavy damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If two consecutive rootlings turn into Lashers, the second will heal to full

​

Personal Roots

⬥ At 1:06, 2 random players will be given a text box informing that they have Blight Roots as well as a timer that counts down

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There will be yellow arrows at the players' feet, on the minimap, and on the arena itself indicating where the roots will be coming from

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When the timer hits 0, the roots will launch towards the players' location in a triangle shape

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player must move 1 or more tiles away from their pinpointed location and away from the roots to avoid damage and a stun

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] before the timer reaches 0 to ensure you won't be stunned

​

AoE Blight Bomb

⬥ At 1:32 and 1:49 (and throughout Phase 3, as well), up to 3 non-base roles will receive a bar above their head

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When filled entirely, an explosion will deal 3-4k damage (AoE)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] can be used for a heal

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Alternatively, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], or tank it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Solak's auto attacks will speed up after these bombs

​

Arms and Legs

⬥ At 1:55 (1:06 for rootskips, 1:32 and 1:49 respectively for bomb skips), Solak will root his arms to the center of the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms must be killed within 30 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After both arms die, Solak will stand up, exposing his legs. Legs must be killed within 20 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Being too slow on either arms or legs means that Solak will stand up and spawn Blightbound Lashers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180203062001664.png?v=1 blightlasher]

​

Core

⬥ After both the arms and legs have been killed, Solak will expose his core

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The core has 125,000 hp per person, and is exposed for 18 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the core is not finished within this time, P1 mechanics will repeat

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once the core is dead, Phase 1 ends and Phase 2 begins

​

Phase Two Mechanics

Eruptions

⬥ At the start of Phase 2, an eruption will spawn in each corner of the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When killed, these eruptions will spawn a blue circle that will teleport everyone within up to the Anima Storm 5 seconds after the eruption dies

​

Anima Storm

⬥ Persists from the beginning of Phase 2 until it is killed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every 10 seconds, it will drop blight rain onto the arena hitting all players for 2k damage and will add a Blight Stack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/851514430613487686.png?v=1 blight] to the player's debuffs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is destroyed by teleporting via the eruptions and spam clicking the storm in the sky

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As the storm "rains" down onto the arena, a puddle of blight rain will begin to form in the center

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stay away from the puddle as it hits for almost 2k damage per tick and will add a Blight Stack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/851514430613487686.png?v=1 blight] for each hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ While in the sky, players can position themselves away from the center to ensure they return to the ground outside of the puddle

​

Cleanse/Blight Stacks

⬥ In Phases 2 and 3, Merethiel can be clicked to activate a green circle on the ground at the south

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blight Stacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/851514430613487686.png?v=1 blight] appear on the players' debuff bars

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It will remove all blight stacks from players standing within it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Players will do 1000 less damage per click to the Anima Storm per stack, and receive 1% more damage

​

Blight Spores

⬥ 6 auto attacks after all eruptions die, Blight Spore bombs will spawn all around the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spores will rise into the air, fall back to the ground, and explode

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The longer the mechanic has progressed, the more damage they will deal

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Towards the end of the mechanic, they will hit up to 8k and should be avoided at all costs

​

Anima Rain

⬥ 12 auto attacks after spores, five hits of Anima Rain will fall from the sky

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players should click the golden sphere in the north to consume the Blessing of Nature

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Immediately before the first rain, players should press their extra action button to deploy the blessing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Blessing of Nature shield dome lowers the Anima Rain damage by 75%

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players can run outside of the shield and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] for a heal

​

Arm Climb

⬥ 2 auto attacks after the last Anima Rain, Solak will pull and root one player to the ground

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] from the roots and move away

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Failure to do so will result in being insta-killed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Solak slams his arm, a player should click the arm to climb up

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This will deal a deadly blow to Solak

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After the climb, Solak will hit the climber with a massive melee hit, up to 9k

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Climber should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] this hit

​

Phase Three Mechanics

Charge Pads

⬥ At the start of Phase 3, 8 pads will spawn around the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As Solak stands on this pad, it will charge up (indicated by a blue ring)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It takes 15 seconds for a pad to become fully charged

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When fully charged, Solak will stop attacking and begin to shake rapidly for 12 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This makes for a good time to heal with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Random bombs can fall onto pads throughout the phase, tank, move away, or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During this 12 second window, players may use their extra action button to access the Realm

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If all 8 pads are fully charged, P3 will end

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is not commonly done; instead, it is recommended to enter the realm and kill Erethdor

​

The Realm

⬥ Accessed on Phases 3 and 4 by using the extra action button

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If clicked during P3, the player will be in the Realm for 20 seconds before returning to the regular arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When in the Realm, food cannot heal you, but other sources of healing still work (e.g. excalibur)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In Phase 3, the Realm is used to kill Erethdor ("the Elf")

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The phase will end when Erethdor is killed

​

AoE Blight Bomb & Stun

⬥ AoE blight bombs also occur in Phase 3, and are dealt with the same as in Phase 1

⬥ Throughout the phase, Solak will stun all players in the regular arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If he is not stunned back, players will be hit with a bleed that escalates in damage over time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Weapons with Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] will still work for this mechanic

​

Phase Four Mechanics

Realm Manifestations

⬥ Entering the Realm on P4 should not be done under normal circumstances, instead, prefer to No-Realm

⬥ Manifestations will spawn inside of the Realm and attempt to consume Solak's mind

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the mind is consumed, all players will be insta-killed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The HP of Solak's mind is the bottom of the two displayed on-screen

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The rate at which manifestations consume the mind increases the longer they live

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More manifestations will spawn the faster Solak's HP bar is depleted

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This means delaying the use of some high damage abilities can be useful

⬥ Manifestations can be tanked by a player through entering the Realm

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Manifestations attack with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While in the Realm, players can sacrifice their own HP to heal Solak's mind

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This should be done by first using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and then clicking Solak

​

Burst of Nature

⬥ Appears as a purple tornado surrounding Solak

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals a large hit every ~28 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Damage can be lowered tremendously by using stunning abilities

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541275957657600.png?v=1 tight] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] will still reduce damage even with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4]

​

The No-Realm

⬥ The general approach to succeeding on P4 is to ignore the Realm, and instead finish Solak before his mind is consumed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enter the phase with a fairly high level of adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build up to 100%, and wait for Solak to rush forward, and then be pulled backwards

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can build on Solak before the pull-back, but he will be immune to damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Execute a strong ultimate ability rotation after Solak is pulled back

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stunning abilities should be used early to reduce Burst of Nature damage

​

Basic Strategy

Phase 1
Damage Solak down to his HP cap while handling mechanics that interrupt damage. Killing the Core will start Phase 2
Start & Pads
⬥ Pre-place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine], if available ⬥ Start fight, use damage-boosting ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath]     • Use a few strong abilities within your ultimate, and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to a pad         ⬩ Alternatively, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] (duo) or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] (3-6 people) ⬥ Return to Solak after pads, and continue doing damage until ~0:50
Rootlings, Roots & Bombs
⬥ The team should split up and kill volatile rootlings     • Place second set of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] if available ⬥ Handle personal roots at ~1:06     • Ensure you warn others if they need to move to safety ⬥ Continue doing damage until ~1:32 and ~1:49 Blight Bombs     • Negate as required with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]     • Keep doing damage between bombs
Arms, Legs, & Core
⬥ Kill arms, while keeping fairly high adrenaline     • If using necromancy, you should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] to kill arms     •Magers and rangers should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] at the end of arms ⬥ Kill the legs, while building adrenaline for core     • Meleers should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] just before core appears ⬥ Dump everything you have into the core     • Ensure somebody uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb]
Phase 2
Kill all 4 Eruptions and the Anima Storm. Then, damage Solak until his corruption bar has been drained completely. Once it is completely drained, Phase 3 will start
Eruptions, Cleanse & Storm
⬥ Kill a southern eruption and then cleanse ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] back to the destroyed eruption, go up and damage the Anima Storm ⬥ After returning to the ground, repeat with other Eruptions until the Storm is dead     • There is generally no need to cleanse a second time
Blight Spores, Anima Rain & Arm Climb
⬥ Meet at the very north of the arena between the torches     • Use damage-boosting ultimate immediately [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] ⬥ Damage Solak while avoiding Blight Spores ⬥ Use the blessing of nature when the Anima Rain comes     • Run outside of shield and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] one of the hits ⬥ Continue damaging until the Arm Climb     • If rooted, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]     • One player should climb, and mitigate large hit with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] ⬥ If not phased after climb, continue damage and potentially mitigate another Anima Rain     • Do not use a damage-boosting ultimate unless extremely low damage
Phase 3
Damage Solak down to his HP cap then kill Erethdor. When Erethdor dies, Phase 4 will start
Charge Pads & Erethdor
⬥ Use damage-boosting ultimate immediately [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] ⬥ Watch out for AoE Blight Bombs and stun when required throughout the phase ⬥ Charge first pad, and go up to the Realm     • Use strong abilities on Erethdor ⬥ Continue to damage Solak, use a second damage-boosting ultimate if Solak is high HP ⬥ When Solak is at HP cap, go up to the Realm once more     • This means charging pad when he is close to cap     • Finish off Erethdor, maintain relatively high adrenaline for P4 start
Phase 4
Damage Solak down to 0 hp before the manifestations kill him in the Realm
Kill, or Be Killed
⬥ Wait at Solak until he becomes targetable, then build adrenaline if needed     • If using magic, range, or necromancy you should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] immediately in order to build     • If using melee you should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] on the pull-back ⬥ After Solak is pulled back, start dumping good abilities into him     • Save hard-hitting abilities for later in your rotation ⬥ If Realming, a stun will be required when Solak says "THIS ENDS NOW" ⬥ Either wipe, or get the kill

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

​

Disclaimer

This guide is made with the idea of getting started at Telos, and does not cover meta strategies, for that refer to the guides found in [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=telos Telos guides].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=uCYUF3PdRTGiEaTRnXMF Magic - Statius's Warhammer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pi3Mt9McC4EVfYjOGCNZ Magic - No Statius's Warhammer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fpi3Mt9McC4EVfYjOGCNZ.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Enrage Mechanics

⬥ 50%: Virus is added on P2 and P3

⬥ 100%: Phase 5

⬥ 150%: Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 50 tick cooldown

⬥ 200%: Telos HP caps at 600,000 on P1-4

⬥ 250%: Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 31 tick cooldown, and P5 will be stun-immune after freedom for 10 ticks

⬥ 300%: Telos HP caps at 200,000 on P5

⬥ 500%: P4 font HP caps at 10,000

⬥ 1000%: P4 a rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, immortality no longer works P5, and Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown

⬥ The higher the enrage the stronger the damage Telos and golems deal.

​

Attack Pattern

This image shows the order of special attacks for each phase. The summary section below only explains newly-encountered ones.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/K44ZbrL43J.png Guide illustration]

​

Mechanics Summary

Phase 1
Auto-Attacks
Telos attacks with [https://img.pvme.io/images/e6LpKti.mp4 melee] when the player is in melee distance, otherwise [https://img.pvme.io/images/e6LpKti.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/wMhIhgf.mp4 magic]. If you leave MD, Telos will do one mage auto before walking up to you again. [https://img.pvme.io/images/wMhIhgf.mp4 Source video]
Tendrils
⬥ Telos binds you in place, drains both your health and adrenaline, and heals himself for every hit the player takes. [https://img.pvme.io/images/n92IQzM.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Deal (3,000 + 10 x Enrage) damage to free yourself. [https://img.pvme.io/images/n92IQzM.mp4 Source video]
Charge
⬥ Telos charges at the player after a short delay, dealing soft-typeless damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/iUIAuba.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Use [https://img.pvme.io/images/iUIAuba.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] 1 tick after the text above Telos disappears.         ⬩ Resort to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] if necessary.
Hold Still
⬥ Telos hits the player with a normal attack followed by a large melee hit that stuns, then jumps to the spot the player was standing on. [https://img.pvme.io/images/fKhoh6P.mp4 Example]     • The normal attack can be either a melee or a magic hit, depending on how far the player is.         ⬩ [https://img.pvme.io/images/fKhoh6P.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] beforehand to protect against the stun.         ⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the large melee hit.         ⬩ Move out of the jump radius.
Green Beam
⬥ Spawns at a random location.     • When the player is standing in the beam, they gain rapid adrenaline.     • When Telos is standing in the beam, he attacks 1 tick faster.         ⬩ Phase boss before beam comes out.
Phase 2
Auto-Attacks
Same as phase one: melee when in MD, otherwise mage. Again, if you move away, Telos will do one mage auto then walk back into MD.
Black Beam
⬥ Spawns on Telos.     • When the player is standing in the beam, they deal and take 30% less damage.     • When Telos is standing in the beam, the phase meter charges and he receives 20% less damage.         ⬩ Pull Telos out of the beam and avoid standing in it unless necessary.
Magic Onslaught
⬥ Telos stops moving and fires gradually stronger magic attacks until the phase meter is depleted.     • Move Telos out of the beam before this attack starts so the bar doesn't fill too much.     • If Telos starts this attack while in the beam, block it by standing in it.         ⬩ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage], resort to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] and/or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] if the meter was charged too much.
Virus
⬥ The player receives a coloured virus that deals constant damage.         ⬩ Stand in the beam to cleanse the virus.
Phase 3
Auto-Attacks
Telos only attacks with magic throughout this phase.
Red Beam
⬥ Spawns at a random location.     • When the player is standing in the beam, they deal and take 30% increased damage.     • When Telos is standing in the beam, the phase meter charges and he deals 30% increased damage.
Phase Meter and Golems
⬥ Meter naturally decreases. ⬥ Meter increases when Telos is standing in the beam. ⬥ With 1 golem alive, the meter slowly decreases. ⬥ With 2 golems alive, the meter remains stationary (increases and decreases back and fourth). ⬥ With 3 golems alive, the meter increases.
Shockwaves and Drain
⬥ If meter is on the left side → Drain: Telos drains the player's adrenaline and prayer points. [https://img.pvme.io/images/IrOrcBM.mp4 Example] ⬥ If meter is on the right side → [https://img.pvme.io/images/IrOrcBM.mp4 Source video]Shockwaves: Rapid, hard hitting soft-typeless attacks. [https://img.pvme.io/images/GNj9g8i.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Phase Telos before he could use Shockwaves, otherwise resort to [https://img.pvme.io/images/GNj9g8i.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]
Phase 4
Auto-Attacks
Telos attacks with melee when the player is in melee distance, otherwise magic. Telos will not re-enter MD if you move away from him on P4 after his first attack. ⬥ Phase 4 is split into 4 smaller sections, separated by 3 fonts.     • Deal a quarter of Telos's starting phase HP to phase him into a font.     • Once phased, you lose your target, Telos becomes untargetable, walks up to a font and spawns 3 different-coloured golems.
Golems
⬥ Three different-coloured melee golems spawn at each font. [https://img.pvme.io/images/Pqb71gY.mp4 Example]     • Red golems attacks are able to stun after their first 3 hits.         ⬩ Utilise [https://img.pvme.io/images/Pqb71gY.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti], resort to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] if you got stunned.     • Red golems have normal attack range.     • Green and black golems have halberd attack range.
Fonts
⬥ To block Telos's instakill, players must walk up to and charge the fonts with their HP, for a total of 5 hits while dealing with golems. [https://img.pvme.io/images/mBqSukd.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Utilise [https://img.pvme.io/images/mBqSukd.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] to reduce damage taken from fonts.         ⬩ Relevant defensives do NOT work on the last hit of fonts.         ⬩ Once the instakill is negated, all of your defensive abilities get placed on a 6s cooldown.
Font 3
⬥ Wrap around the center of the room and wait for the three golems to spawn.     • When the golems reach you, (tc) furthest golem → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]         ⬩ See example [https://img.pvme.io/images/dyeeCcK.mp4 here]     • Charge the font and phase Telos into P5. [https://img.pvme.io/images/dyeeCcK.mp4 Source video]
Weak Anima Bomb
⬥ Telos fires a slow moving orb that deals soft-typeless damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/rOCPDcD.mp4 Example]     • The player's overload timer is constantly drained after getting hit until cleansed.         ⬩ Ideally skip the mechanic, otherwise block using [https://img.pvme.io/images/rOCPDcD.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]         ⬩ Cleanse the overload debuff by stepping into one of the fonts.
So Much Power (SMP)
⬥ Once phase meter is filled, the next special attack is replaced by an SMP. [https://img.pvme.io/images/Ft9mmv4.mp4 Example] ⬥ Telos fires a deadly soft-typeless attack paired with a normal attack (much like Hold Still).         ⬩ Ideally skip the mechanic, otherwise block with [https://img.pvme.io/images/Ft9mmv4.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]
Phase 5
Auto-Attacks
Telos only attacks with magic throughout this phase. Note: Telos attacks 1 tick faster if green beam is not blocked by the player.
Strategy
⬥ Telos spawns 6 similar-coloured minions at the start of the phase. ⬥ Make your way to the green beam.     • Lure golems properly.         ⬩ To do this, always start by going to the left beam.         ⬩ If side beams → enter the 2nd tile in the green beam.         ⬩ If back beam → enter the 4th tile in the beam.
Rock
⬥ A single rock falls at certain times during the phase.         ⬩ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]
Virus
⬥ The player receives a random-coloured virus that deals constant damage.     • To cleanse the virus stand in the beam of the same colour.         ⬩ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]
Phase Meter
⬥ Gradually fills up     • Once filled, Telos begins charging an instakill attack and receives heavily reduced damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/7vfE0Da.mp4 Example]         ⬩ Ideally kill before he can use this mechanic, otherwise [https://img.pvme.io/images/7vfE0Da.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort]

​

Stunning Guide

Mage has access to 3 different stun abilities:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] Stuns for 1 GCD (3ticks/1.8s)

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] Stuns for 1 GCD + 2 ticks (5ticks/3s)

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] Stuns for the first 3 hits. (5ticks/3s)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chain these abilities however you see fit when stunning Telos.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not 4-ticking with mage, ideally leave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] for last.

​

Basic Rotations

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] Telos at the start of each phase.

Phase 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] towards Telos → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]

⬥ Aim to fit:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to break Tendrils.

​

Phase 2

⬥ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] + walked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb]

⬥ Utilise stuns; [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Phase 3

⬥ Aim to start with ~85%+ adrenaline.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta] → basics (utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Get in beam → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] before drain mechanic.

OR

⬥ Start with high adrenaline → build to 100% → enter beam → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159085207555.png?v=1 onsl]

​

Phase 4

To deal with Telos's SMP, ideally phase him into a font with 2 or 3 auto-attacks remaining before the next special.

​

⬥ Make use of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]

⬥ Make sure to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] before first font.

​

Font 1

⬥ Target and kill red golem while charging font.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

⬥ Finish killing golems while dealing with Telos's special attacks.

⬥ Phase Telos into next font, utilise stuns.

​

Font 2

⬥ Target and kill red golem while charging font.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

⬥ Finish killing golems while dealing with Telos's special attacks.

⬥ Phase Telos into next font, utilise stuns.

​

Font 3

⬥ Stick to the wall of the middle of the room and wait for the golems to reach you.

⬥ Target the farthest golem → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543875425055670275.png?v=1 SBS] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See example [https://img.pvme.io/images/dyeeCcK.mp4 here][https://img.pvme.io/images/dyeeCcK.mp4 Source video]

⬥ Charge font

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

⬥ Phase Telos into phase 5.

​

Phase 5

Note: for more information on timing & moving efficiently throughout P5, read: [[PvME/Telos/Telos — P5 Movement And Timing|P5 Movement And Timing]]

​

⬥ Always start by making your way to left beam.

⬥ You will be under heavy damage so spamming food after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] is expected.

⬥ Always start with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] as your first two abilities.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] while stunning Telos.

​

Side Beams

⬥ Enter second tile of the green beam.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] if red golems) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → (3hit) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] rock.

⬥ Walk melee distance to Telos → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] if red golems) → (tc) middle golems → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] and clear virus when it comes out.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

Back Beam

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] before reaching beam.

⬥ Enter fourth tile of the green beam.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] if red golems) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] → (2hit) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] rock

⬥ ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] if red golems) → (tc) middle golems → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] before virus.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] and clear virus when it comes out.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

Example Kills
