[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gaIHwzHbTa.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ The Twin Furies are located in the Heart of Gielinor.

⬥ The duo consists of Nymora in the East and Avaryss in the West.

⬥ Entering the encounter requires 40 kill count, or 20 kill count with enough reputation.

⬥ Level 80 Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] is required to create an instance, which you can boost with any ranged potion / overload [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1 overload]

⬥ The Twin Furies share one health pool of 200,000 LP.

⬥ In Hard Mode, the fight adds lava bombs alongside the standard mechanics.

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=twin%20furies Twin Furies guides] [[PvME/Twin Furies/AFK Twin Furies|AFK Twin Furies]] [[PvME/Twin Furies/Low Effort Twin Furies Hardmode|Low Effort Twin Furies Hardmode]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

The following presets are based on Stage 1 [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides]:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=36ec3ebe-379d-4350-a3ff-ce7a88f7525a Magic]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=50e03e24-37ad-4be8-abf5-a4bb22c0aa09 Ranged]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=de7d0a00-3300-4607-ad6f-0c98f839c560 Melee]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918 Necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

⬥ Poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] splats may appear, but they do not deal damage.

​

Attack Rotation

⬥ Normal Mode: Avaryss' Surge → auto attacks → Rain Death → auto attacks → Burn Phase → auto attacks → Repeat

⬥ Hard Mode: 2 auto attacks → Avaryss' Surge + Lava Bombs → auto attacks → Ceiling Collapse + Lava Bombs → auto attacks → Channeled Bomb + Lava Bombs → auto attacks → Blue Lava Bomb + Lava Bombs → auto attacks → Repeat

Shared Health Pool

Mechanic:

⬥ Avaryss and Nymora share one health pool

⬥ When they are close together, AoE abilities can hit both twins and effectively damage the shared health pool twice

⬥ Hit caps do not apply to the Twin Furies' health pool, so some high-damage hits may deal more damage than the visible hitsplats suggest

​

Solution:

⬥ Use AoE abilities when both twins are close together e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain]

⬥ High-damage combinations such as Chaos Roar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] → Overpower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] will also go through the hit cap

​

Avaryss' Surge [https://img.pvme.io/images/NWTHSDg.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/NWTHSDg.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Avaryss jumps to a wall, then charges across the arena

⬥ This repeats 4 times

⬥ Avaryss always travels in cardinal directions, such as north to south or west to east

⬥ In Hard Mode, the dive can hit up to around 4,000 Melee damage, stun for 3 seconds, and disable overhead prayers

⬥ In Hard Mode, attacking Avaryss mid-jump can reflect 90% of the damage taken

​

Solution:

⬥ Move out of Avaryss' path after she jumps to a new wall

⬥ In Hard Mode, continually move to avoid being pushed and stunned

⬥ Avoid attacking Avaryss mid-jump in Hard Mode

​

Ceiling Collapse [https://img.pvme.io/images/QIMa9WS.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/QIMa9WS.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Nymora jumps to a random square and causes a ceiling collapse

⬥ In Hard Mode, Nymora yells "we will purge them all!" before the collapse

⬥ In Hard Mode, this deals rapid Ranged damage up to around 1,000 damage every 1.8 seconds

​

Solution:

⬥ Stand in the 3x3 area around Nymora to negate the mechanic

⬥ Use defensive abilities if needed while moving into position

​

Channeled Bomb [https://img.pvme.io/images/N7ceSRh.mp4 (Examples)] [https://img.pvme.io/images/N7ceSRh.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/CJkO32O.mp4 (Explosion)][https://img.pvme.io/images/CJkO32O.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ The twins move to the centre of the arena and channel an attack

⬥ If the channel finishes, it deals 4,500 damage in Normal Mode

⬥ In Hard Mode, this can deal up to around 8,000 damage

⬥ During this mechanic, the twins take 2x damage

⬥ You take typeless damage during the channel, which can be offset by Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

​

Solution:

⬥ Use AoE abilities while the twins are close together

⬥ Melee can use Cleave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave], Hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] and Quake [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake]

⬥ Necromancy can use Spectral Scythe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe], Spectral Scythe II [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] and Spectral Scythe III [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3]

⬥ Move or Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to the edge of the arena before the explosion or

⬥ Block the explosion with defensive abilities

​

Lava Bombs (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ A lava bomb spawns alongside each main mechanic

⬥ Lava bombs bounce around the arena 5 times before disappearing

⬥ Green arrows show where the lava bomb will land

⬥ If you are within the 5x5 landing area, you take 3,000-4,000 hard typeless damage

⬥ After 2 bounces, a second lava bomb spawns

​

Solution:

⬥ Watch the green arrows and move away from the landing area

⬥ Keep moving while handling the main mechanic

⬥ Avoid pathing into Avaryss' jump path while dodging lava bombs

​

Blue Lava Bomb (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ A blue lava bomb bounces around the arena 3 times

⬥ Green arrows show where the blue lava bomb will land

⬥ If avoided, it homes in on the player and deals 6,000-7,000 hard typeless damage

⬥ If the player takes the bomb, it also hits both twins for the same damage

​

Solution:

⬥ Intentionally take the blue lava bomb to damage both twins

⬥ Prepare defensives or healing before taking the hit

⬥ Avoid overlapping the blue bomb with other dangerous mechanics where possible

Videos

⬥ Normal Mode examples: [https://youtu.be/9XD2MutZKFo Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] / [https://youtu.be/lag84Kr6CP8 Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Hard Mode examples: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6veyQTUV76A Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] / [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ri0umfL65Ms Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zURz0KcXrt.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

TzKal-Zuk is the general of the Ful Front of the Elder God Wars. This encounter is the third version of the Fight Caves/Fight Kiln, in that you fight waves of enemies before taking on the main boss.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ru5v5obHbrBemcQ6POw5 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pj8d55HpwtpAQB5ntbwJ Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=TWVxCyP8YycMd9j3Ssqg Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=siYYnSaV9o68CPmFsp21 Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FsiYYnSaV9o68CPmFsp21.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

The Fight

This encounter has 17 waves of enemies, and then the final boss, TzKal-Zuk. Normal mode has checkpoints after waves 5, 10, 15, and 17. Hard mode has one checkpoint after wave 17. The arena has some ledges in it that can be used to lure/safespot various mobs.

General Wave Safespot

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mHIVDj1.png Guide illustration] *1. Start at the southeast corner

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. There is a lava geyser here which can damage you, but isn’t much of a worry if you use animate dead

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. You can move as far south as you can to attack mobs over the ledge

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c. You can move to the east to dodge the wall of fire in hardmode

  1. There should only be 1-2 mobs that can attack you at a time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Kill them and move out to let some more mobs find you. Move back in once they are untrapped

  1. Repeat until the wave is cleared*

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WxvWBTS.png Guide illustration] ​

Normal Waves (1-3, 7-8, 12-13) and Igneous Waves (4, 9, 14)

NOTE: TzekHaar-Kih takes priority focus over everything.

Waves 1-3

⬥ Wave 1: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] at 10 seconds TzekHaar-Kih will spawn south and southeast, kill them immediately.

⬥ Wave 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] focus Xil x2, kill remaining.

⬥ Wave 3: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] Kih > Xil, kill remaining.

Waves 7-8

⬥ Wave 7: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] Kih > Tok-Xil x2, kill remaining.

⬥ Wave 8: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] Mej >Tok-Xil x6, kill remaining.

Waves 12-13

⬥ Wave 12: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] Kih > Tok-Xil x2, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] Ket-Zek takes priority after Tok-Xil are dead, kill remaining.

⬥ Wave 13: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] Tok-Xil x2 > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] Ket-Zek takes priority after Tok-Xil are dead, kill remaining.

​

​

Igneous Waves 4, 9, 14

⬥ 3 Large Igneous variants of mobs will spawn along with many normal versions of that mob

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Igneous TzekHaar-Hur

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Weaken by stunning, then kill normally.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Igneous TzekHaar-Xil

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Weaken by using a threshold or ultimate ability, then kill normally.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Igneous TzekHaar-Mej

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Weaken by standing in it's shield dome, then kill normally.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only the 3 Igneous variants need to be killed. The rest of the mobs can be ignored.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After killing the last Igneous mob of the wave, an extra action button will appear on your screen. Click that and attack TzKal-Zuk until you deal 50,000 damage to him.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎Note: If you fail to deal 50,000 damage to TzKal-Zuk, the phase repeats itself and you must do the remainder of the 50,000 damage to trigger the next phase

​

Challenge Waves (5, 10, 15)

These waves are challenges for the player. They must be completed successfully to achieve a flawless run which unlocks hardmode, or in hardmode it grants the ability to make the tribrid cape.

​

Wave 5

⬥ You must kill the 5 Volatile TzekHaar-Hur before the bar fills above their head.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Failure to do so will result in large typeless hits for each one left alive.

​

Wave 10

⬥ You must kill the Unbreakable TzekHaar-Ket before the bar fills above its head.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only hits that deal 3000+ damage will hurt this mob.

​

Wave 15

⬥ You must survive several attacks from three Fatal TzekHaar-Yt-Hurkots. Each one attacks with a different combat style, and for a flawless run you must not take damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] works for this.

​

Jad Waves (6, 11, 16)

Wave 6

⬥ This is the first wave with a Jad. Kill it as soon as possible then focus on the other mobs.

​

Waves 11 and 16

⬥ Wave 11 has 2 Jads and various mobs.

⬥ Wave 16 has 3 Jads but no other mobs.

Jad Wave Safespot

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5kOx3g4.png Guide illustration] 1. *Start at the northwest corner and kill Jad 1

  1. Clear out the extra mobs as needed (Wave 11)

  2. Move south to allow Jad 2 to attack you (yellow arrow)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Jad 3 should get stuck behind Jad 2 and be unable to attack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. For wave 11, Jad 2 doesn't exist so ignore this step

  1. Once Jad 2 is dead, move towards Jad 3 and kill it*

​

TzekHaar-Aken

[https://img.pvme.io/images/n4B2Z2KLAw.png Guide illustration]

Wave 17

⬥ This is the last enemy before fighting TzKal-Zuk. His head will appear for about 40 seconds when the wave starts. He has a lot of tentacles (Mage and Ranged) which will constantly attack dealing small damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After 40 seconds, his head will submerge for about 50 seconds, in which time you can kill some of the tentacles and use defensive abilities to mitigate some damage. You do not need to kill any tentacles finish the phase. Just the head needs to die.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• He has a mechanic that shoots a blob to your location that drains your adrenaline by 10% immediately and makes you gain 50% reduced adrenaline for a short time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ When his head is exposed, he only fires 1 blob at a time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ When he submerges, he fires blobs that expand into a 5x5 X ‎shape at your players location. These can be dodge by moving out of the way.

​

TzKal-Zuk

He primarily attacks with melee in melee distance, otherwise with magic.

Mechanics
Zuk performs a mechanic after every 3 auto attacks in normal mode. The mechanics appear in order as follows, and will repeat once all mechanics have happened. Note: Zuk will skip the first 3 auto attacks and go into the Geothermal Burn mechanic as soon as the encounter starts. In addition, when Zuk hits 100k lifepoints, he will restart his attack rotation, starting with the Geothermal Burn.
Geothermal Burn:
⬥ Zuk shouts You will break beneath me! and applies a magic bleed that lasts for 20 seconds.     • The bleed can be stopped by using Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom].
Sear
⬥ Zuk shouts Sear! or Suffer! and hits you with a melee hit and 2 magic hits, and lowers your constitution level.     • You need to travel 15 total tiles to stop the hp drain, and drink super restores to clear the debuff.     • This mechanic can be mostly negated instantly by using (Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as soon as Zuk does the spec, which will be his 4th attack after the last spec, and running back to where you started.
Quake
⬥ Zuk shouts Tremble before me! or Fall before my might! and causes the floor to crack in small areas around him that deal a lot of damage and apply an escalating magic bleed if stood in.     • This mechanic can be mostly negated instantly by using (Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as soon as Zuk does the spec, which will be his 4th attack after the last spec, and attacking from your new location.     • Getting hit by any of the eruptions from the ground fissures will apply the same magic bleed from Geothermal Burn. However, your Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] will still be on cooldown.
Empowered Magic
⬥ Zuk shouts Die! Begone! or Ful's power flows through me! and shoots a projectile at you that deals high soft-typeless damage.     • You can use Disruption shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] or Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to take 0 damage from this.
Igneous Rain
⬥ Zuk shouts Flames consume you! or Burn! and jump to the middle of the room, becoming immune to attacks, stunning and dragging you, and covering all but one section of the arena with fire that ramps up damage the longer you stand in it.     • You can use Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to get to the safe part of the arena, where an Igneous mob will be waiting for you to kill.     • Kill these the same way as in waves 4, 9, and 14. Use the extra action button to interrupt the mechanic. If you fail to interrupt it, it will instakill you.
Basic Igneous Rain (''Pizza Phase'')
Once Zuk is immune (1) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → (2) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] 120 degrees clockwise of current position → (3) defeat igneous mob → repeat steps 2/3 x2. Below is a general idea of what to use to defeat the igneous mobs.
Magic
⬥ Hur: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] → improvise with basics ⬥ Xil: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] → improvise with basics ⬥ Mej: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] + run melee distance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] → improvise with basics
Melee
⬥ Hur: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] → improvise ⬥ Xil: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → improvise ⬥ Mej: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] + run melee distance → improvise
Ranged
⬥ Hur: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → improvise ⬥ Xil: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → improvise ⬥ Mej: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] + run melee distance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → improvise
Note: Ensure you improvise with appropriate abilities so you can finish at 100% adrenaline in order to use ultimate as soon as possible.

Example Kills

Example Kills
Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]
⬥ [https://youtu.be/tmyXnVX6Sb8 Basic Magic Run].
Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]
⬥ [https://youtu.be/KEhh2yrybRo Basic Melee Run].
Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]
⬥ [https://youtu.be/TLWdsWmRTUM Basic Ranged Run].
Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]
⬥ TBD

Alt1 TzKal-Zuk Helper

Voice guidance throughout the kill

This tool reads your screen, and based on certain lines of dialogue in your chatbox, will trigger and play voice lines during the kill to let you know about upcoming mechanics and what to do for them.

​

Disclaimer: Alt1 is a third party tool, and while generally safe to use, is still recommended to be installed and used at your own risk.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sHIVTBZvZU.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Vindicta & Gorvek is a multi-phase fight in the Heart of Gielinor.

⬥ In Normal Mode, Vindicta starts at 200,000 LP and mounts Gorvek at 100,000 LP.

⬥ In Hard Mode, Vindicta starts at 300,000 LP and mounts Gorvek at 150,000 LP.

⬥ After Vindicta is defeated in Hard Mode, Gorvek continues the fight alone with 300,000 LP.

⬥ Level 80 Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] is required to create an instance, which you can boost with any attack potion.

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=vindicta Vindicta guides] [[PvME/Vindicta Gorvek/AFK Vindicta|AFK Vindicta]] [[PvME/Vindicta Gorvek/AFK Vindicta Hardmode|AFK Vindicta Hardmode]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

The following presets are based on Stage 1 [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides]:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=36ec3ebe-379d-4350-a3ff-ce7a88f7525a Magic]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=50e03e24-37ad-4be8-abf5-a4bb22c0aa09 Ranged]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=de7d0a00-3300-4607-ad6f-0c98f839c560 Melee]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918 Necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

​

Attack Rotation

Normal Mode:

⬥ P1: 2 auto attacks → Hurricane → 2 auto attacks / Ranged Attack → Dragonfire → 3 auto attacks → Hurricane → Repeat

⬥ P2: 1 auto attack → Ranged Attack → 1 auto attack → Dragonfire Wall → Repeat

​

Hard Mode:

⬥ P1: 2 auto attacks → Hurricane → 3 auto attacks → Dragonfire → 3 auto attacks → Hurricane → Repeat

⬥ P2: 1 Melee auto attack → Ranged Attack → 1 Melee auto attack → Fly + Dragonfire Wall → Repeat

⬥ P3: 10 rapid Melee auto attacks → Fly + Dragonfire Wall → Fly back to the middle → Repeat

​

Auto Attacks

Mechanic:

⬥ Vindicta's auto attacks deal Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage

⬥ In Hard Mode Phase 3, Gorvek attacks rapidly with Melee auto attacks, hitting up to around 4,500 damage per hit

​

Solution:

⬥ Pray against Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] or

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] once you are comfortable surviving mechanics

⬥ In Hard Mode Phase 3, use defensive abilities if you are taking too much damage from Gorvek's rapid attacks

​

Phase 1 - Hurricane [https://img.pvme.io/images/1tatA2X.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/1tatA2X.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Vindicta uses a 5x5 Melee AoE when you are within melee distance

⬥ If you are outside melee distance, Hurricane is replaced by a Ranged attack instead

​

Solution:

⬥ Use Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] to mitigate the damage or

⬥ Tank the attack

⬥ Stay outside melee distance if you want to force the Ranged attack instead

​

Phase 1 - Ranged Attack [https://img.pvme.io/images/Y43i9Dnwrr.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/Y43i9Dnwrr.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Vindicta fires a single Ranged hit if you are outside melee distance

⬥ In Hard Mode, this deals moderate Ranged damage to a random target

​

Solution:

⬥ Briefly switch to pray against Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange]

​

Phase 1 - Dragonfire [https://img.pvme.io/images/TG1pugT.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/TG1pugT.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Vindicta raises her arms to signal Gorvek

⬥ Gorvek fires a straight line of flames across the arena

⬥ This deals rapid Magic damage if stood in

​

Solution:

⬥ Move out of the fire

⬥ Avoid standing directly on the dragonfire line, as the damage hits rapidly

​

Phase 2 - Mounted Gorvek

Mechanic:

⬥ Vindicta mounts Gorvek once she reaches the phase transition threshold

⬥ In Normal Mode, this happens at 100,000 LP

⬥ In Hard Mode, this happens at 150,000 LP

⬥ Once mounted, Vindicta and Gorvek gain a new attack pattern

​

Solution:

⬥ Prepare for Ranged Attack and Dragonfire Wall

⬥ Keep moving out of dragonfire lines while continuing to damage the boss

​

Phase 2 - Dragonfire Wall [https://img.pvme.io/images/flnK9zh.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/flnK9zh.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Gorvek flies to a random corner and breathes a straight line of flames across the arena

⬥ This works the same as Phase 1 - Dragonfire

​

Solution:

⬥ Move out of the fire or

⬥ Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] towards Gorvek and past the fire

​

Phase 2 - Ranged Attack [https://img.pvme.io/images/h5uwYYH.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/h5uwYYH.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic:

⬥ Gorvek fires a high-damage Ranged hit

​

Solution:

⬥ Use Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to heal from the hit or

⬥ Pray against Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] and use Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]

​

Phase 3 - Gorvek (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ After Vindicta is defeated, Gorvek continues the fight alone with 300,000 LP

⬥ Gorvek uses rapid Melee auto attacks, then flies away to create a dragonfire wall before returning to the middle

​

Solution:

⬥ Pray against Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] during Gorvek's rapid auto attacks

⬥ Use defensive abilities if needed, as the Melee hits can deal heavy damage

⬥ Be ready to move when Gorvek flies away for Dragonfire Wall

​

Phase 3 - Dragonfire Wall (HM Only)

Mechanic:

⬥ Gorvek flies away and breathes a straight line of flames across the arena

⬥ This works the same as Phase 1 - Dragonfire

⬥ In Hard Mode Phase 3, dragonfire lines stay active until three are present

⬥ When the next dragonfire wall is used, the oldest line despawns

​

Solution:

⬥ Move out of the fire

⬥ Track active dragonfire lines and avoid boxing yourself in

⬥ Use Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to reposition safely

​

Videos

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Eo5sWwnuaPk Example kill]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

This basic guide is designed to streamline players who are starting Vorago duos, and contains some information for Trio, such as the TL5 responsibilities. The strategies in this guide are safe and easy relative to Vorago. Note though, that Vorago is not an easy boss in general, and will likely take multiple attempts before you get a kill.

​

Each weekly rotation has its own guide in the Vorago basic collection. This snapshot does not track the current weekly rotation.

​

Cheat Sheet

[https://img.pvme.io/images/NdvoAzn.png Guide illustration]

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2opcg6A6333zNZuab83G Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1NTfAoxaT6b57ltNVDNX Magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=oKY60D6b8jvdBHqseyHj Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FoKY60D6b8jvdBHqseyHj.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Additional Preset Information

⬥ With the use of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] the preset places [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] onto an armour piece.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: That is greater bone shield, and turtling 3, not their more common counterparts.

⬥ Melee is significantly more challenging than the other combat styles, and is thus omitted.

⬥ The last relic slot does not have a clear "best." Use what you find is most comfortable.

Misc Important Vorago Facts

⬥ BT refers to Bomb Tank, not Base Tank. Stands furthest away from Vorago to take bombs.

⬥ Base refers to Base tank, stands in melee distance of Vorago and holds aggression during most of the fight.

⬥ TL5 refers to the Top Lure 5.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a trio+ role.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They perform the climb in Phase 1, and take the 5th bleed when applicable during Phase 2 and Phase 4.

⬥ Commonly used abilities/spells unique to Vorago: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] equip the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] item in your inventory and then cade.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ As long as the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] isn't on a weapon/shield, you can switch back immediately.

Face/Phase 0

⬥ Vorago deals 70% of your maximum life points upon entry into Phase 1.

⬥ Challenge takes 12s. A bar charges above Vorago's head to indicate when the fight will start.

⬥ Optionally to save on hp, right before the bar fills up, click your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mqcrUBFaKz.mp4 Source media]

​

Phase 1

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EOpDHbN.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Three types of auto attack at random: Melee swipe, magic Blue Bomb, or both at the same time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto attack blue bombs home in on the furthest player from Vorago, deal AoE magic damage, and always hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes deal AoE melee damage around Vorago and around the Base Tank. They can splash.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not melee swipe if the player with aggro is not in melee distance.

⬥ Red Bomb deals 2000 damage, comes with a non-homing Blue Bomb, clears defensives and puts them on cooldown

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Thrown at the furthest player similar to Blue Bombs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For each player that is close to the bomb tank when the red bomb hits, an additional 1k damage occurs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move at least 4 tiles away from where you were stood to avoid the non-homing blue.

⬥ The phase can only end when someone has successfully jumped on Vorago to release the piece of the Maul of Omens.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago's hp goes under about 13k before this, his HP will "reset" somewhere between 80-100k

Base Tank

⬥ Prioritise tagging Vorago ASAP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Trio, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] as you tag.

⬥ Bring Vorago to the east of the red line in the image below. Once he is there use your main damaging abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/yhVlG5p6no.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Expect a few blue bombs. Prayer flick and use defensives as necessary. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] provides a big heal.

⬥ Once the BT has voked, stand directly south of the middle of Vorago and voke back at around 50k HP left.

Top Lure (The Bomb Tank in duo)

⬥ Climb speed is paramount to survival

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Less damage is taken by you and your base on faster climbs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use surge and dive as frequently as possible.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago from two north and two west of the jump spot and do not move until Vorago has finished moving.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is no leniency on what tile to stand on for this mechanic. If you mess up, the base must revoke vorago to the east and you must try again.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gXlab4c.png Guide illustration]

⬥ ‎ ‎Once Vorago stops moving, do a basic DPS rotation

⬥ ‎ ‎You must have at least one inventory space free for the Maul of Omens piece to be able to jump.

⬥ ‎ ‎Jump at <50k HP. Make sure to be high/full HP.

⬥ Food cannot be eaten during climb animations, but bombs can continue to land and stack damage upon animation finish. Make sure to maintain high HP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not risk death trying to save food. It is expected to use some this phase.

​

Phase 2

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pPNE2a2.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Phase 2 is largely time gated. Focus on mechanics.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One gravity orb spawns every reflect. Two are needed to progress. Missing orbs will result in additional cycles.

⬥ Use defensives to avoid food usage.

⬥ More advanced Vorago guides will minimise Vorago's movement on this phase, but while learning the focus should be on surviving and dealing with mechanics properly.

⬥ Vorago's Bleeds break defensives (i.e. take them off. So if you have resonance / cade up, it will remove them + you will receive damage.)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Appears as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] on debuff bar

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First bleed of the phase has no animation; it occurs during Vorago's spawning animation.

⬥ Reflect (Link)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DO NOT ATTACK ON REFLECT

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is immune to damage during this time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage dealt to Vorago instead goes to someone on the team

⬥ Spam click Vorago during Bring Him Down (BHD), then deal damage to free the maul piece.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BHD damage threshold is a collective 50k.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use high damaging thresholds, but refrain from using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] as you will want them for next phase.

Base Tank

⬥ Clear the first two bleeds with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] between the first and second bleeds to ensure aggro for the second bleed

[https://img.pvme.io/images/u56A12qwwv.mp4 Source media]

⬥ You will tank the blue bomb that comes with the third bleed. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] is recommended.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago after the fifth bleed.

⬥ It is recommended to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] the BT on red bomb release.

Bomb Tank

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the second bleed.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] the third, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the fourth, and stand still for the fifth. The Base Tank will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] and lure the boss away to clear the fifth bleed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will likely take at least one hit of bleed damage on the 5th bleed while learning.

⬥ Use any number of defensives against the Blue Bombs.

TL5 (if trio+)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the fourth bleed.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the 5th bleed when it is applied.

⬥ Step back out of melee distance after the Base vokes Vorago.

⬥ Tag red gravity orbs when they spawn.

​

Phase 3

Weekly Special - Ceiling Collapse
Mechanic
⬥ Vorago drops a rock randomly on 1/9th of the arena. ⬥ Deals 8k damage divided by the number of players hit by the rock (e.g. 2 players are hit for 4k each). ⬥ Vorago jumps randomly to a different 1/9th of the arena.     • Vorago cannot jump on existing rocks.
General Notes
⬥ Turn shadows and lighting detail up. Shadows should be at least MEDIUM. If you do not, you may not be able to see where the ceiling is falling. ⬥ Middle rocks can heavily hinder DPS in Phase 3. Clear middle rocks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality].

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YSSxmPI.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Often free-for-all BT. Distance from Vorago cannot be guaranteed due to Vorago's random jump positions. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] as needed.

⬥ Vorago can jump near the person with aggro. If this happens, he has a chance to melee swipe you. Aim to deflect melee

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Either player can volunteer to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] so that the other player doesn't have to deal with this. Otherwise free-for-all.

Suggested Rotations (Both Players)

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] after the reflect or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] after second jump.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This ensures players don't lose their ultimates due to a bad jump position

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] on top of each other, so that only one of you has to tank blue bombs.

⬥ If taking a lot of damage, consider using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

⬥ Rocks that remain at the end of Phase 3 carry over into Phase 4.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If high HP at the end of Phase 3, players should clear rocks to clear the arena for Phase 4

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: if the rock is in the centre of the arena, it will be auto-cleared by Vorago once he spawns into the next phase

​

Phase 4

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KklN0Ua.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Phase 4 is time gated. Focus on mechanics.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 Waterfalls are required to progress the phase. Lower Vorago's HP to under 30k before the last Waterfall.

⬥ Waterfall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spawns in one of the four corners. Run behind it quickly, or take up to 10k damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Some tiles look safe but are not. If unsure, run all the way into the corner.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clears active defensives and puts them on cooldown.

⬥ Leftover rocks from Phase 3 carry over into Phase 4, landing in the same positions

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deal 4k damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These rocks may block Waterfalls. Clear them ASAP.

⬥ Use defensives to avoid food usage.

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Massive time save if done both times

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See role sections below for each player's responsibilities

⬥ If clone skip is not done, a clone will appear on the player who does not have aggro of Vorago.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Several blue bombs follow before the weekly special occurs (skipping this is the main time save).

⬥ Ceilings Collapse mechanic is the same as Phase Three

Base Tank

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank walks Vorago to the wall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Turn run off, spam click Vorago + surge out of the Waterfall, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], walk under Vorago, click near the wall in the direction that Vorago walks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The BT may be out of bomb range, which means any potential bombs go to the Base Tank instead.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Eat to high HP in the Waterfall, prayer flick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] for Blue Bombs, and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] as needed.

⬥ After the skip, Vorago goes straight into the Ceiling Collapse special.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rocks can fall underneath Vorago, on top of the Base. Make sure to turn run on after the clone skip to be able to avoid the rock if this happens.

⬥ Clear bleeds as you would do in phase 2.

​

Bomb Tank

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge to the wall opposite of Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move in when Vorago does the clone animation (fake melee swipe)

⬥ If Clone Skip fails, BT should use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] against the Blue Bombs.

⬥ After the skip, Vorago goes straight into the Ceiling Collapse special.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] the Base when Vorago begins the CC animation.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both players should work to clear rocks.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] cooldown is relevant

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not use the turtling switch for cades this phase.

⬥ Clear bleeds as you would do in phase 2.

⬥ Pick up the third piece after the last Waterfall, and click on any piece to assemble the Maul of Omens.

TL5 (if trio+)

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge to the wall opposite of Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move in when Vorago does the clone animation (fake melee swipe)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the fourth bleed.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the 5th bleed when it is applied.

⬥ Step back out of melee distance after the Base vokes Vorago.

​

Phase 5

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Wm9e8eu.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Ceilings Collapse week shares the same Phase 5 as Teamsplit

⬥ Reverse tug-of-war mechanic

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 20k damage against Vorago pushes him east 1 square

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each tick of damage received from Vorago he pushes west 1 square

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any damage mitigated from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] negates any pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push Vorago all the way to the east, move melee distance, and click the Maul of Omens

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teamsplit damage does not cause him to push west at all.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teamsplit cancels all active defensives.

⬥ Base Tank hugs south wall, while BT hugs north wall. Players should only move away from their respective walls to clear Vorago's bleeds.

⬥ Bleeds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 bleeds with that are randomly assigned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not throw blue bombs during bleeds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Taking damage from bleeds results in Vorago pushing further west. Prioritise clearing them over DPS.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleeds are cleared by distance from the tile the bleed was received, not distance from Vorago in this phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move melee distance + go to the center of the arena. That way you can properly [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to remove bleeds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The safest way to clear bleeds in case you get all 3 is to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the first bleed and then run back melee distance, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] second bleed. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the third bleed.

⬥ If the phase lasts longer than one Teamsplit, the Base Tank and BT swap roles after every set of Vorago's Bleeds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player who is stood furthest out should build adrenaline to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] for the first Blue after the teamsplit explodes.

Suggested Rotations (Base Tank)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] in melee distance shortly after the Teamsplit spawns

⬥ After the 2nd/4th/6th/etc TeamSplit you switch to the BT role. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] to tank the blue bombs.

⬥ After [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling], build to 100% and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] during Reflect.

Suggested Rotations (Bomb Tank)

⬥ Use a threshold → basics to 100% → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] when the first Blue Bomb lands.

⬥ Build to 100% and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] in melee distance ASAP (and do damage after reflect ends/ bleeds begin).

⬥ You will be the BT role after the 1st/3rd/5th/etc TeamSplit

Phase End Notes

⬥ Lengthy phases can get hectic. Focus on proper [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] timings.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

This basic guide is designed to streamline players who are starting Vorago duos, and contains some information for Trio, such as the TL5 responsibilities. The strategies in this guide are safe and easy relative to Vorago. With good execution, players following this guide can reach up to 5 kills per hour.

​

Each weekly rotation has its own guide in the Vorago basic collection. This snapshot does not track the current weekly rotation.

​

Cheat Sheet

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gqLn3Ky.png Guide illustration]

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2opcg6A6333zNZuab83G Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1NTfAoxaT6b57ltNVDNX Magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=oKY60D6b8jvdBHqseyHj Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FoKY60D6b8jvdBHqseyHj.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Additional Preset Information

⬥ With the use of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] the preset places [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] onto an armour piece.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: That is greater bone shield, and turtling 3, not their more common counterparts.

⬥ Melee is significantly more challenging than the other combat styles, and is thus omitted.

⬥ The last relic slot does not have a clear "best." Use what you find is most comfortable.

Misc Important Vorago Facts

⬥ BT refers to Bomb Tank, not Base Tank. Stands furthest away from Vorago to take bombs.

⬥ Base refers to Base tank, stands in melee distance of Vorago and holds aggression during most of the fight.

⬥ TL5 refers to the Top Lure 5.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a trio+ role.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They perform the climb in Phase 1, and take the 5th bleed when applicable during Phase 2 and Phase 4.

⬥ Commonly used abilities/spells unique to Vorago: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] equip the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] item in your inventory and then cade.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ As long as the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] isn't on a weapon/shield, you can switch back immediately.

Face/Phase 0

⬥ Vorago deals 70% of your maximum life points upon entry into Phase 1.

⬥ Challenge takes 12s. A bar charges above Vorago's head to indicate when the fight will start.

⬥ Optionally to save on hp, right before the bar fills up, click your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mqcrUBFaKz.mp4 Source media]

​

Phase 1

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EOpDHbN.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Three types of auto attack at random: Melee swipe, magic Blue Bomb, or both at the same time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto attack blue bombs home in on the furthest player from Vorago, deal AoE magic damage, and always hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes deal AoE melee damage around Vorago and around the Base Tank. They can splash.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not melee swipe if the player with aggro is not in melee distance.

⬥ Red Bomb deals 2000 damage, comes with a non-homing Blue Bomb, clears defensives and puts them on cooldown

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Thrown at the furthest player similar to Blue Bombs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For each player that is close to the bomb tank when the red bomb hits, an additional 1k damage occurs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move at least 4 tiles away from where you were stood to avoid the non-homing blue.

⬥ The phase can only end when someone has successfully jumped on Vorago to release the piece of the Maul of Omens.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago's hp goes under about 13k before this, his HP will "reset" somewhere between 80-100k

Base Tank

⬥ Prioritise tagging Vorago ASAP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Trio, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] as you tag.

⬥ Bring Vorago to the east of the red line in the image below. Once he is there use your main damaging abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/yhVlG5p6no.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Expect a few blue bombs. Prayer flick and use defensives as necessary. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] provides a big heal.

⬥ Once the BT has voked, stand directly south of the middle of Vorago and voke back at around 50k HP left.

Top Lure (The Bomb Tank in duo)

⬥ Climb speed is paramount to survival

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Less damage is taken by you and your base on faster climbs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use surge and dive as frequently as possible.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago from two north and two west of the jump spot and do not move until Vorago has finished moving.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is no leniency on what tile to stand on for this mechanic. If you mess up, the base must revoke vorago to the east and you must try again.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gXlab4c.png Guide illustration]

⬥ ‎ ‎Once Vorago stops moving, do a basic DPS rotation

⬥ ‎ ‎You must have at least one inventory space free for the Maul of Omens piece to be able to jump.

⬥ ‎ ‎Jump at <50k HP. Make sure to be high/full HP.

⬥ Food cannot be eaten during climb animations, but bombs can continue to land and stack damage upon animation finish. Make sure to maintain high HP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not risk death trying to save food. It is expected to use some this phase.

​

Phase 2

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pPNE2a2.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Phase 2 is largely time gated. Focus on mechanics.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One gravity orb spawns every reflect. Two are needed to progress. Missing orbs will result in additional cycles.

⬥ Use defensives to avoid food usage.

⬥ More advanced Vorago guides will minimise Vorago's movement on this phase, but while learning the focus should be on surviving and dealing with mechanics properly.

⬥ Vorago's Bleeds break defensives (i.e. take them off. So if you have resonance / cade up, it will remove them + you will receive damage.)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Appears as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] on debuff bar

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First bleed of the phase has no animation; it occurs during Vorago's spawning animation.

⬥ Reflect (Link)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DO NOT ATTACK ON REFLECT

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is immune to damage during this time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage dealt to Vorago instead goes to someone on the team

⬥ Spam click Vorago during Bring Him Down (BHD), then deal damage to free the maul piece.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BHD damage threshold is a collective 50k.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use high damaging thresholds, but refrain from using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] as you will want them for next phase.

Base Tank

⬥ Clear the first two bleeds with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] between the first and second bleeds to ensure aggro for the second bleed

[https://img.pvme.io/images/u56A12qwwv.mp4 Source media]

⬥ You will tank the blue bomb that comes with the third bleed. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] is recommended.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago after the fifth bleed.

⬥ It is recommended to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] the BT on red bomb release.

Bomb Tank

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the second bleed.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] the third, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the fourth, and stand still for the fifth. The Base Tank will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] and lure the boss away to clear the fifth bleed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will likely take at least one hit of bleed damage on the 5th bleed while learning.

⬥ Use any number of defensives against the Blue Bombs.

TL5 (if trio+)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the fourth bleed.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the 5th bleed when it is applied.

⬥ Step back out of melee distance after the Base vokes Vorago.

⬥ Tag red gravity orbs when they spawn.

​

Phase 3

Weekly Special - Green Bomb
Mechanic
⬥ Vorago launches a green bomb that lands in a random 1/9th of the arena     • Covers this area in mist, then bounces and targets a player.     • Mist drains 10 adren for every time it deals damage, and run energy. Do not stand in the mist. ⬥ GB deals 10k damage to the targeted player if it is not passed. Do not pass the GB. Tank the damage.     • Passing occurs when the targeted player is within 2 tiles of another player. ⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] to mitigate some of the damage.
General Notes
⬥ In Phase 3 and 5, Vorago goes into reflect after either 5 auto attacks, or the Green Bomb is tanked (whichever comes first).     • This is usually when the Green Bomb is tanked.

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/2y7ZrgE.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Green Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If multiple Green Bombs target the same player, their partner can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] and ensure they have the hp to survive.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ e.g. If the Green Bomb targets the BT twice, BT should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] the first, and the Base may [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] for the second Green Bomb landing.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If more than 2 Green Bombs are tanked, there is a high chance of death.

​

Suggested Rotations (Both Players)

⬥ Drop [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] in one of the four corners melee distance, before Vorago spawns

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ensures one mist cannot cover the entire ultimate

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base and BT should ultimate on the same side of Vorago so they are within intercept range of each other.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ecnJwYw.png Guide illustration]

⬥ If necro, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] at start of the phase so it doesn't hit on reflect

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] during reflect

​

Base Tank

⬥ Voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] at the start of the phase and stand melee distance to reduce damage taken by the BT. Watch out for middle mist.

​

Bomb Tank

⬥ Avoid standing too close to Vorago. This is a common mistake from repositioning after the mist appears.

​

Phase 4

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nUiAFvU.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Phase 4 is time gated. Focus on mechanics.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 Waterfalls are required to progress the phase. Lower Vorago's HP to under 30k before the last Waterfall.

⬥ Waterfall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spawns in one of the four corners. Run behind it quickly, or take up to 10k damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Some tiles look safe but are not. If unsure, run all the way into the corner.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clears active defensives and puts them on cooldown.

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Massive time save if done both times

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See role sections below for each player's responsibilities

⬥ Green Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The person without the GB uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]. DO NOT PASS THE GB

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] cooldown is relevant so don't use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1 turtling4]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago goes into bleeds after the Green Bomb is tanked. Handle these appropriately.

Base Tank

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank walks Vorago to the wall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The BT may be out of bomb range, which means any potential bombs go to the Base Tank instead.

Bomb Tank

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge to the wall opposite of Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move in when Vorago does the clone animation (fake melee swipe)

⬥ If Clone Skip fails, BT should use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] against the Blue Bombs.

TL5 (if trio+)

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge to the wall opposite of Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move in when Vorago does the clone animation (fake melee swipe)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the fourth bleed.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the 5th bleed when it is applied.

⬥ Step back out of melee distance after the Base vokes Vorago.

Phase 5

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/GXSm3mQ.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Reverse tug-of-war mechanic

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 20k damage against Vorago pushes him east 1 square

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each tick of damage received from Vorago he pushes west 1 square

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any damage mitigated from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] negates any pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push Vorago all the way to the east, move melee distance, and click the Maul of Omens

​

⬥ Green Bomb:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On P5, reflect occurs after either 5 auto attacks or the Green Bomb is tanked. In reality, this means that reflect occurs when the Green Bomb is tanked.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Tanking the 10k hit from a Green Bomb causes 1 tile of pushback

​

⬥ Base Tank hugs the South wall, while Bomb Tank hugs the North wall. Players should only move away from their respective walls to clear Vorago's bleeds.

​

⬥ Bleeds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 bleeds with that are randomly assigned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not throw blue bombs during bleeds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Taking damage from bleeds results in Vorago pushing further west. Prioritise clearing them over DPS.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleeds are cleared by distance from the tile the bleed was received, not distance from Vorago in this phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move melee distance + go to the center of the arena. That way you can properly [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to remove bleeds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The safest way to clear bleeds in case you get all 3 is to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] ‎ ‎the first bleed and then run back melee distance, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] second bleed. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the third bleed.

​

Suggested Rotations (Both Players)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] at the start.

⬥ The person without the GB should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]

⬥ The person with the GB can keep using thresholds

⬥ Both players build to 100% adrenaline and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] during Reflect.

⬥ If the phase does not end before the second GB lands, there is a high chance of death. Avoid this at all costs.

​

Introduction

​

This basic guide is designed to streamline players who are starting Vorago duos, and contains some information for Trio, such as the TL5 responsibilities. The strategies in this guide are safe and easy relative to Vorago. With good execution, players following this guide can reach up to 5 kills per hour.

​

Each weekly rotation has its own guide in the Vorago basic collection. This snapshot does not track the current weekly rotation.

​

Cheat Sheet

[https://img.pvme.io/images/XEX4fur.png Guide illustration]

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2opcg6A6333zNZuab83G Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1NTfAoxaT6b57ltNVDNX Magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=oKY60D6b8jvdBHqseyHj Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FoKY60D6b8jvdBHqseyHj.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Additional Preset Information

⬥ With the use of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] the preset places [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] onto an armour piece.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: That is greater bone shield, and turtling 3, not their more common counterparts.

⬥ Melee is significantly more challenging than the other combat styles, and is thus omitted.

⬥ The last relic slot does not have a clear "best." Use what you find is most comfortable.

Misc Important Vorago Facts

⬥ BT refers to Bomb Tank, not Base Tank. Stands furthest away from Vorago to take bombs.

⬥ Base refers to Base tank, stands in melee distance of Vorago and holds aggression during most of the fight.

⬥ TL5 refers to the Top Lure 5.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a trio+ role.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They perform the climb in Phase 1, and take the 5th bleed when applicable during Phase 2 and Phase 4.

⬥ Commonly used abilities/spells unique to Vorago: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ As long as the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1 turtling3] isn't on a weapon/shield, you can switch back immediately.

Face/Phase 0

⬥ Vorago deals 70% of your maximum life points upon entry into Phase 1.

⬥ Challenge takes 12s. A bar charges above Vorago's head to indicate when the fight will start.

⬥ Optionally to save on hp, right before the bar fills up, click your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mqcrUBFaKz.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EOpDHbN.png Guide illustration]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto attack blue bombs home in on the furthest player from Vorago, deal AoE magic damage, and always hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes deal AoE melee damage around Vorago and around the Base Tank. They can splash.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not melee swipe if the player with aggro is not in melee distance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Thrown at the furthest player similar to Blue Bombs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For each player that is close to the bomb tank when the red bomb hits, an additional 1k damage occurs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move at least 4 tiles away from where you were stood to avoid the non-homing blue.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago's hp goes under about 13k before this, his HP will "reset" somewhere between 80-100k

⬥ It is recommended to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] the BT on red bomb release.

Bomb Tank

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the second bleed.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] the third, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the fourth, and stand still for the fifth. The Base Tank will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] and lure the boss away to clear the fifth bleed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will likely take at least one hit of bleed damage on the 5th bleed while learning.

⬥ Use any number of defensives against the Blue Bombs.

TL5 (if trio+)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the fourth bleed.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the 5th bleed when it is applied.

⬥ Step back out of melee distance after the Base vokes Vorago.

⬥ Tag red gravity orbs when they spawn.

​

Phase 3

Weekly Special - The End
Mechanic
⬥ Vorago sections off a quarter of the arena with his arms.     • Stand in the arms or take rapidly increasing typeless damage. ⬥ Vorago rotates his arms anticlockwise. Follow the arms or be smacked for 2.5k. ⬥ Quadrants 2-4 contain bombs, with heavy damage reduction depending on the bomb:     • In the Blue Bomb quadrant, Vorago takes 1/2 damage.     • In the Red Bomb Quadrant, Vorago takes 1/3 damage.     • In the Purple Bomb Quadrant, Vorago takes 1/4 damage. ⬥ After the last quadrant, Vorago stands up and releases all untagged bombs, in addition to Vorago's normal auto attacks.

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/thsFIBw.png Guide illustration] ⬥ The End

⬥ One person tags all Blue Bombs, while the other person uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tagging Blue Bombs resets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + puts it on cooldown. This is a two person job.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bomb tag and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] can be done by either player. Sort this out in advance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] slightly early is advised. Intercept will sometimes fail while your character is moving and can cause you to pk your partner.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] when bombs are released after Vorago stands up.

⬥ Stop attacking after the purple bomb explodes (for the reflect mechanic).

​

Base Tank

⬥ When Vorago stands up, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] + stand melee distance to reduce damage taken by the BT.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that this is done if you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] for the blue bombs during the mechanic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you do not, the Base will take blue bombs + melee swipes and it can be painful.

​

Bomb Tank

⬥ When Vorago stands up, make sure to be far away from Vorago.

​

Suggested Rotations (Both Players)

⬥ If using necro, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] while going to first quadrant and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] before he puts his arms down

⬥ Thresh and apply affinity debuffs in the first quadrant (no damage reduction)

⬥ Use basics to prepare for bomb tag during the second or third quadrant.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] at the end of the third quadrant

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move back into ultimate after the fourth quadrant and prepare to do damage when Vorago stands.

⬥ Ditch ultimates for second set of arms if necessary. Try to finish the phase with thresholds.

⬥ If a second stand is expected, players should switch roles for the tag + cepting of blue bombs if needed.

​

Phase 4

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/REPpAAF.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Phase 4 is time gated. Focus on mechanics.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 Waterfalls are required to progress the phase. Lower Vorago's HP to under 30k before the last Waterfall.

⬥ Waterfall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spawns in one of the four corners. Run behind it quickly, or take up to 10k damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Some tiles look safe but are not. If unsure, run all the way into the corner.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clears active defensives and puts them on cooldown.

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Massive time save if done both times

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See role sections below for each player's responsibilities

⬥ The End

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same mechanic as Phase 3, except:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After Vorago stands up, there are 3 auto attacks then his Red Bomb.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After the Red bomb, Vorago will use 4 auto attacks before reflect.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] strategies are used to handle the bombs instead of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] potion

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Do not use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] as it extends the cooldown for too long to be used twice on this phase

Base Tank

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank walks Vorago to the wall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Turn run off, spam click Vorago + surge out of the Waterfall, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], walk under Vorago, click near the wall in the direction that Vorago walks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The BT may be out of bomb range, which means any potential bombs go to the Base Tank instead.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Eat to high HP in the Waterfall, prayer flick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] for Blue Bombs, and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] as needed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ⬥ After the skip, Vorago goes straight into The End (Purple Bomb) special.

⬥ Build adrenaline throughout the arms animation

⬥ Tag red bombs in their quadrant. The Bomb Tank should use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] on you for this.

⬥ Red bombs drain adrenaline, ensure that you have 100% by Vorago's stand.

⬥ When Vorago stands up, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] on the Bomb Tank. Re-cept when cade timer has 10s left.

Bomb Tank

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge to the wall opposite of Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move in when Vorago does the clone animation (fake melee swipe)

⬥ If Clone Skip fails, BT should use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] against the Blue Bombs.

⬥ After the skip, Vorago goes straight into The End (Purple Bomb) special.

⬥ In the quadrant with Red Bombs, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] on the Base Tank while they tag Red Bombs.

TL5 (if trio+)

⬥ Clone skip

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge to the wall opposite of Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move in when Vorago does the clone animation (fake melee swipe)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after the fourth bleed.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to clear the 5th bleed when it is applied.

⬥ Step back out of melee distance after the Base vokes Vorago.

​

Phase 5

For Both Players

⬥ Vorago's attack rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gg1VugJ.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Reverse tug-of-war mechanic

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 20k damage against Vorago pushes him east 1 square

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each tick of damage received from Vorago he pushes west 1 square

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any damage mitigated from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] negates any pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push Vorago all the way to the east, move melee distance, and click the Maul of Omens

⬥ PB

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago turns all players into explosive Vitali, with a timer above their head.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When timer hits 0, a purple bomb explodes on the player. This is AoE, so avoid standing near your partner.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago will do 5 auto attacks before reflect.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Standing on opposite walls largely allows you to ignore this special.

⬥ Base Tank hugs the South wall, while Bomb Tank hugs the North wall. Players should only move away from their respective walls to clear Vorago's bleeds.

​

⬥ Bleeds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 bleeds with that are randomly assigned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not throw blue bombs during bleeds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Taking damage from bleeds results in Vorago pushing further west. Prioritise clearing them over DPS.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleeds are cleared by distance from the tile the bleed was received, not distance from Vorago in this phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move melee distance + go to the center of the arena. That way you can properly [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to remove bleeds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The safest way to clear bleeds in case you get all 3 is to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] ‎ ‎the first bleed and then run back melee distance, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] second bleed. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the third bleed.

Suggested Rotations (Base Tank)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] in melee distance

⬥ If you do not get the kill before the bleeds end, you will swap into the bomb tanking role

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] to tank the blue bombs during the purple bomb special.

Suggested Rotations (Bomb Tank)

⬥ Use a threshold → basics to 100% → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] when the first Blue Bomb lands.

⬥ If you do not get the kill before the bleeds end, you will swap into the base tanking role

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build to 100% and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] in melee distance ASAP

​
