​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3562f2bb-c205-4665-aee3-91c32e22328b.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Attack Rotation

Zamorak's damage and HP scales with enrage

⬥ Auto-attack cycle

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 Magic autos → 5 Ranged autos → Repeat (Special attacks get woven in)

⬥ Special attack cycle

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The following diagram outlines the pattern of special attacks used by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] and how they vary based on when you transition between phases:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/OWvsXcAQax.png Guide illustration]

​

Special Attacks
These are mechanics which will happen as you go around charging pads.
Channelers
⬥ The message Zamorak begins to draw power and energy from something within Infernus. appears and a witch spawns in infernus which you must kill to charge the next pad.     • Press extra ability button.     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] towards and kill witch.     • Press extra ability button to return to Zamorak. Then walk the next pad you want to charge. ​
Flames of Zamorak
⬥ Zamorak says The world will burn. and slams his wings into the ground, dealing 2 heavy melee hits.     • Step into melee distance of Zamorak, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] (use defensives if low hp)     • Generally, the smoke will go to the North Eastern most player.     • If any black smoke is absorbed, use defensives to mitigate damage. ​
Chaos Blast
⬥ Zamorak says I will tear you asunder! and wraps his wings around himself, with a blue bar appearing overhead.     • He sends a red smoke after you after you stun him and deal a specified amount of damage. The longer he charges the attack the more powerful the red smoke hits.     • Stun Zamorak to disrupt the blue bar. ⬥ He then says Feel the rage of a god.     • Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] before the red smoke hits you. ​ ⬥Fully channelled Chaos Blast releases with an auto that counts towards the 5 or 11 auto set. If a chaos blast is stunned and releases before the channel is finished, it will not release this auto and do the full set after the mechanic finishes.
Infernal Tomb
⬥ Zamorak says Step into the dark... meet your death., stunning you and sending to infernus while charging a blue bar.     • He sends a red smoke after you after you stun him. The longer he charges the attack the more powerful the red smoke hits.     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to avoid stun, and as screen turns black use a stun.         ⬩ You will only be hit with a weak attack shortly after entering infernus if done correctly.     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] towards and kill the demon by using a strong threshold and basic.     • Match overhead rune with one on top of a pad and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] onto it.         ⬩ Matching the wrong rune will make you take heavy damage.     • Note: If you didn't stun properly while entering, stun Zamorak ASAP after exiting infernus and stack defensives to mitigate a more powerful Chaos Blast. [https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 Example clip of proper stun timing here.][https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 Source video] ​
Adrenaline Cage
⬥ Zamorak says Chaos, unfettered!, dropping all overhead prayers and hits the base with a few [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] attacks soon after.     • Stand still. You will take additional damage when further away from the original tile where Zamorak cast the attack.     • Base [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] as soon as possible. ​
Rune of Destruction
⬥ Zamorak says You're already dead. and summons a ritual circle with an inner circle, an outer ring and a space in the middle.     • A black sludge will travel along the space stunning and dealing small typeless hits to players.     • Standing in the inner and outer rings will deal small typeless hits to the player.     • Stay off the red, avoid black sludge.     • Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] if you are in the black sludge to avoid getting stunned. ​

Mechanics

⬥ Charge Pads

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The arena has 6 pads that you can stand on to charge.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When it is full charged, Zamorak will stop attacking for a while and your adrenaline bar will be refilled. After this, you will gain an Edict while Zamorak gains a Hex depending on the pad charged.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will become unable to charge pads when Zamorak says HEED MY CALL. To continue charging the next pad, you must enter Infernus and kill the mage present.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This happens after charging every pad.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UOtlSkO.png Guide illustration]

Suggested Zamorak Edict Orders [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak]
⬥ There are a lot of viable Edict orders, adjust as you see fit ⬥ Use the [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Zamorakian_Undercity/Strategies#Pads RS Wiki] to see what each pad does
Speed
⬥ < 900%: 214653 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zTBR3x_ITLM demo] ⬥ > 900%: 241365 or 621345
Safety
⬥ < 900%: 241365 ⬥ > 900%: 243615 (1-2 cycle) or 235614 (0 cycle)     • [https://youtu.be/Bix_t8isO7A 0 cycle] uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] to tank the large bomb and kills Zamorak before small bombs

​

Notes: Once Chaos Traps have been activated, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] before stepping on other pads. Additionally, once the bar for charging a rune is full, move at least 3 squares away from the middle of the rune. If Coven is not your last rune, be prepared to kill a Healer and Protector.

​

Enrage-Based Mechanics

Zamorak's damage and HP scales with enrage, and additional mechanics are introduced at specific enrage thresholds:

​

⬥ 100% Phase 7 is introduced

⬥ 500% During Infernal Tomb, all players must be on their rune at the same time to exit Infernus

⬥ 500% During Channelers, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 50% adrenaline and the first ability is Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ 750% During Infernal Tomb, demons will move faster towards the portal

⬥ 900% During Channelers, grey HP healing ramp-up no longer resets between phases

⬥ 1000% During Channelers, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 100% adrenaline and their first ability is Omnipower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

⬥ 1000% On phase 7, red bar charge is no longer reset between cycle(s)

⬥ 1000% On phase 7, Zamorak's life points cap at 250,000 per player

⬥ 1470% The life points of chaos demons cap at 70,000 while on Infernus

⬥ 1500% During the Adrenaline Cage attack, the targeted player will have their Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] deactivated

⬥ 1600% Zamorak's stagger after killing a rune on Phase 7 reduced from 10 to 5 ticks

⬥ 1740% For phases 1-6, Zamorak's starting life points cap at 1,600,000 per player

⬥ 3500% On phase 7, the life points the runes revive with are capped at 60,000

Alt1 Zamorak Helper

Voice guidance throughout the kill

This tool reads your screen, and based on certain lines of dialogue in your chatbox, will trigger and play voice lines during the kill to let you know about upcoming mechanics and what to do for them.

​

Disclaimer: Alt1 is a third party tool, and while generally safe to use, is still recommended to be installed and used at your own risk.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Nex, Angel of Death, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here [[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Aod Overview|Aod Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8365aa1b-b4a7-4fe0-8b15-a12e7488dd8c Melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=73661080-7868-4dd4-babd-49c825092f05 Necromancy Base]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=11e64db3-5a8f-4c43-84f4-b3bf62ef6a19 Melee-Ranged]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=535b3b39-b0bf-4770-952c-703e57cef478 Melee-Magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8365aa1b-b4a7-4fe0-8b15-a12e7488dd8c.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Nex, Angel of Death (Perfect)

⬥ This achievement requires the player to defeat Nex, Angel of Death in a team of 5 or fewer without anyone dying while completing the following.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/Icy-them-coming Icy-them-coming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Freedom and don't run into anyone. Free teammates from ice ASAP. Also requires player to Freedom during Zaros Phase under effects of Glacies Pillar.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/Did_It_For_Them Did It For Them without]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/Poppin%27_pillars Poppin' pillars]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/You%27re_Not_Strong_Enough You're Not Strong Enough]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/One_for_All One for All]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/No_smoking No smoking]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Place smokes parallel to walls (East smoke south wall, north smoke west wall etc.) so the smoke doesn't spawn.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://runescape.wiki/w/Do_Not_Return_To_Sender Do Not Return To Sender]

​

Base Tank P4 Prebuild

Base runs AoD west at 600k, down to Fumus pillar. The team will lower Umbra pillar down to 30k health and run up to Glacies pillar. The base will pull AoD to Umbra and wait for the team to be ready. Third bomb is usually a good time as it will enable base to re-overload and prep 5 stack volley. The base will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] prematurely and on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] call. Base can then use any ability to kill the pillar once they have seen the bomb runner barge the dummy and in position under Glacies Pillar.

​

Team P4 Prebuild

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → build with basics → On Zerk Call → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] on dummy

​

Pillar 1: Base [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to Cruor → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

Pillar 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

Pillar 3: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

Pillar 4: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Notes:

⬥ Place one [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] down near Glacies pillar.

⬥ When it is the bomb that the team will go on, once bomb runner reaches centre, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] call will happen, non bomb carriers, should barge onto the dummy and stand under Glacies pillar, spam clicking until it is targetable. Once bomb carry barges onto the dummy, Base can kill Umbra and move to Cruor ready to meet team.

⬥ One last person will get marked at Cruor pillar. For safety you can equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] if slow to reach middle after killing Fumus pillar. Additionally, you can just [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005552211847295076.png?v=1 signoflife] if that is up.

⬥ With the addition of base going to Cruor, there is a safety net that only 2 meleers are needed for Cruor/Fumus pillar.

​

Example Kill with only 2 meleers on C/F pillar
[https://youtu.be/pZtNOAi0xeo Poppin' pillars]

​

Introduction

​

​

Phase 2

~59s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] if not dead

Phase 4

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879594258432.png?v=1 slice] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879577612298.png?v=1 sever] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879594258432.png?v=1 slice] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213019543699466.png?v=1 araxxi] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

⬥ Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can stall [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] to improve kill speed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using tc and not clicking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213019543699466.png?v=1 araxxi] 2t will need to be lost

Necromancy Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ As [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] Araxxor is desired for the Necromancy rotation, wearing a ranged weapon until Araxxor has spawned is required.

​

Phase 1

After Araxxor has spawned, equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern].

Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642262165790911.png?v=1 haunted] and build to 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks. Do not attack the boss other than to apply the debuffs and obtain stacks.

Phase 2

At 59 seconds use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

Phase 4

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → Target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213019543699466.png?v=1 araxxi] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YrMqspEn6R.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Grandmaster speed kill Combat achievement for Beastmaster Durzag.

​

General Information

⬥ The base must avoid being melee'd by Beastmaster Durzag so that he does not spawn the 3rd pet. They can do this by running between corners of the room and using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to avoid melee swipes.

⬥ The base should be the only person to pre-vuln Beastmaster Durzag to avoid other members getting aggro.

​

Positioning

⬥ Once the waves are about to end, everyone but base should stand on the tile below.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/TM7vrPMdLn.png Guide illustration] ​

Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness Darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army Conjure Undead Army] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]     • Have all 4 conjures selected
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Equilibrium_aura Equilibrium] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] ⬥ Ring of Vigour Passive Unlocked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] ⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_(familiar) Ripper Demon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] autofire set to 1

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=NIzAHOaz1Yhro3gfpmLc Grandmaster Speed Killer]

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1 mahj] can be used in place of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] but may be less consistent

⬥ Runes for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009570755836641331.png?v=1 venggroup] are not necessary but can be brought [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FNIzAHOaz1Yhro3gfpmLc.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Waves

Prebuild 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] + 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] (if available), have conjures summoned ready for Beastmaster Durzag's Spawn.

Rotation

0:01 on timer

One person [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

0:03 on timer

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → finish with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] if needed

​

Example Kill
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o0rEdszwEss Grandmaster Speed Killer Example Kill]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/K6oQJBiYGF.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Black Stone Dragon Grandmaster Speed Killer combat achievement, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found in [[PvME/Dragonkin Laboratory/ED2 Overview|ED2 Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=87efYB8PIuEQE29aDFt9 Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=YRTHHium4p1S5luvOYsb Range Melee Hybrid] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4f53138f-d23b-4683-ba5b-5748c1b1ae69 Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4f53138f-d23b-4683-ba5b-5748c1b1ae69.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Melee Grandmaster Speed Killer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Having a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] task is highly recommended, as well as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer]

​

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] (to stall)

​

Black Stone Dragon

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → (equip 2h) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep]

First Hand

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

Second Hand

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] (if not dead) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

Third Hand

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] (if not dead) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

Fourth Hand

(equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842595639306.png?v=1 jawsoftheabyss]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter] → (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189297659940904.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavochood]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

​

Note: try to kill the fourth hand with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

​

Black Stone Dragon

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for The Magister, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here [[PvME/The Magister/Magister|Magister]].

​

Presets and Relics

The Magister Master Speed Killer

⬥ Defeat the Magister in less than 0:12.0

​

Necromancy rotation

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/D6M7KtAfBS.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Rasial, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here [[PvME/Rasial/Rasial|Rasial]].

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/z4ifLrUqck.png Guide illustration] ⬥ The tile shown above serves as a safespot for the ghost wall mechanic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This tile is ideal as it keeps you 5 tiles away for quicker [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For the soul obelisks, you may run 4 tiles west (toward obelisk), and 2-4 east.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Doing this allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] to kill one of the soul obelisks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is only recommended if you have the ruthless perk.

⬥ For an in-game example of the correct tile being used, [https://img.pvme.io/images/N8u6ViKvDL.mp4 click here].[https://img.pvme.io/images/N8u6ViKvDL.mp4 Source video]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=IdcNE9rzLNb07bjRkls5 Connection Lost]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4d75453c-1edf-42dc-86c5-28f678633704 Master Speed Killer] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4d75453c-1edf-42dc-86c5-28f678633704.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rasial Master Speed Killer

⬥ This rotation is NOT recommended for standard kills, only for the achievement.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The setup takes extra time, thus lowering average kills per hour.

​

⬥ This rotation seeks to consistently hit under 1 minute kill times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Will be slower without Innate Mastery enhancement [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1 shardofgenesisessence]

⬥ Requires [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] on one gear piece.

​

Pre-build

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to adren crystal

​

With War's Blessing 4: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] + Adren crystal to 100% → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to portal → enter instance

Without War's Blessing 4: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] + Adren crystal → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to portal → enter instance

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] is used purely to time target cycle, can be substituted for other abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones]

Phase 1-3

​

(tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + 2t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → improv with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap], build to 70%-80%

​

Phase 4

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → improv

​

Note: Phase 4 is very lenient and your rotation depends on when you phase into it. The rotation above is just an example.

Focus on using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] ASAP, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], finish with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Connection Lost. Please Wait - Attempting to Reestablish

⬥ This requires you to survive 45 seconds after Rasial casts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] on phase 4.

​

Phase 4

⬥ Starts on "Ha! No more games!"

⬥ All basic abilities can be any basics, only used to build adrenaline and get Rasial low to kill.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be careful to not accidentally kill Rasial before completing the achievement.

⬥ Keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] alive to heal you.

⬥ Move and kill Rasial as soon as you get the achievement.

​

basic + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1 deflectnecromancy] → 4 basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] → 6 basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] → 7 basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

​

Example Kills
⬥ [https://youtu.be/qlxfxfm_XRo Example Master Speed Kills] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/YjfM8ER6i9o Connection Lost]

​

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Seiryu, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found in [[PvME/Temple of Aminishi/ED1 Overview|ED1 Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=81d8bf4c-143d-4bc2-9f06-fdce73980e89 Range Melee Hybrid]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=14a0bfba-1426-4a00-bd7b-56eda223a13a Melee Camp]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F14a0bfba-1426-4a00-bd7b-56eda223a13a.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ranged-Melee Hybrid Seiryu Grandmaster Speed Killer

⬥ This rotation is NOT recommended for standard kills, only for the achievement

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The setup takes extra time, thus lowering average kills per hour

⬥ With this rotation it is possible to hit ~0:39.0 kill times

​

Wars

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

Prebuild

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] + 2t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes a very strong understanding of everything found in [[PvME/Telos/Overview|Telos Basic]], [[PvME/Telos/Telos — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]] and [[PvME/Telos/Telos — P5 Movement And Timing|P5 Movement And Timing]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=73aa05b7-d87f-4079-b8a5-07ee0275b522 Melee Grandmaster Speed Killer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=5f7097ba-a6cf-49de-97f8-ffa70a6573ee Ranged Grandmaster Speed Killer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F5f7097ba-a6cf-49de-97f8-ffa70a6573ee.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Melee Grandmaster Speed Killer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Dragon scimitar and Zaros Godsword EoF's can be swapped out for their physical variants.

Wars

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Prebuild

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → 1t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to Telos → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Phase 1

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to jump spot

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to jump spot

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to jump spot

​

Phase 4

Rotations here are left in simplified form, with a strong understanding of P4 timing and movement being assumed.

Font 1

Font 2

Font 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154071998464.png?v=1 anticlearheaded] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos] s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

Phase 5

Utilise prayer flicking and wearing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] to get through the phase.

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006129858889404467.png?v=1 greenbeam] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Ranged Grandmaster Speed Killer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

Prebuild

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to Telos

​

​

Phase 2

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Grandmaster Speed Killer Combat Achievement for Normal Mode Vorago.

​

Vorago-Specific Tricks/Skips

This section will cover the different tricks and skips specific to the Vorago fight that are necessary in order to achieve the GM timer.

​

TC Timing:

⬥ Every single phase Vorago can be targeted with Target Cycle earlier than he visibly shows up in the arena. Learning this timing is integral to speedkills so you do not lose ticks. This is especially important on P5, as if you do not attack and push Vorago on-tick, TeamSplit will immediately spawn which is too much time-loss for the GM timer. ⬥ The easiest way to learn this timing is by using the Alt1 Plug-In called 'Vorago Timer' found in [[PvME/Combat reference/Alt1|Alt1]]. ⬥ Another common way to time it is to use an ability with a 10-second cooldown on the tick that you would normally crack-heal. The ability will come off cooldown on the exact tick you want to TC. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153769877514.png?v=1 escapemobile] are the best options as they can be used off GCD, so they won't interrupt prebuilds. ⬥ One more way you can align your TC timing is using Vorago's jumping animations. If you use an ability right as you see Vorago land, and continuously use GCDs from that point on without losing ticks, you will be lined up perfectly going into P3 or P5 so that your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] will be on the correct tick. ⬥ Note that, if you follow the rotations below, you will not need to do anything special for P3 TC timing. Phasing Vorago on P2 with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and then immediately targeting the dummy and using continuous GCDs without losing ticks will align you properly to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] on the correct tick.

​

Solo Lure:

⬥ Solo Lure refers to the Base Tank luring Vorago to the exact correct spot for the jump, so that the Bomb Tank can instantly jump. ⬥ See [https://img.pvme.io/images/6t22pJob20.png here] for a detailed map showing how to Solo Lure. ⬥ See [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1mgdsTZGMuY here] for a detailed video guide on how to Solo Lure.

​

Accel-Pot Climb:

⬥ Accel-Pot Climb refers to using an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] in order to do the Top Lure climb in the most optimal way possible. For the purpose of GM, you want to be consistently clicking to jump on Vorago's back no later than the first tick of 0:30 seconds. ⬥ If you are struggling with losing ticks elsewhere, it may be worth it to learn how to get 0:28 climbs, as this is something you can practice very easily solo. ⬥ See [https://www.youtube.com/clip/UgkxLgppa2wy2GLzuC8JtLBHmzhOqKqvJrnX here] for an example of what a 0:28 climb looks like.

​

Clone Skip:

⬥ Clone Skip refers to skipping the Phase 4 clones. This is done by having the Base Tank walk Vorago all the way to the side of an arena, while the Bomb Tank stays all the way on on the opposite wall, outside of Vorago's attack range. Since Vorago can only give clones to the Bomb Tank, but the Bomb Tank is out of range of Vorago's attacks, the special is skipped entirely. ⬥ There are several ways for the Base Tank to walk Vorago, but the easiest method is to turn your Run off and spam click the opposite side of Vorago in order to walk underneath him. You may have to adjust where you click depending on what direction Vorago starts walking. ⬥Ceiling Collapse rocks can block Vorago from walking to a particular side of the Arena, so make sure to remove all non-corner rocks prior to Clone Skip. ⬥ One thing to note is that Vorago will never walk north. This can be helpful to know as it means north ceiling rocks do not need to be destroyed, and can be useful to save to give the Base Tank more options later for Bleeds Skip.

​

Bleeds Skip:

⬥ Bleeds Skip refers to skipping the Phase 4 bleeds. This is done by luring Vorago around a Ceiling Collapse rock in such a way that he gets stuck on the rock and cannot get within melee distance of you to apply bleeds. ⬥ Vorago will jump and drop a Ceiling Collapse, throw two auto attacks, then begin bleeds. As soon as he applies the first bleed is when you want to trap him on the rock so he cannot apply any subsequent bleeds. ⬥ Once Vorago is stuck, make sure nobody attacks him as it will break the skip. This includes familiars, so familiar attack mode should be set to 'Passive'. ⬥ For a better understanding of how the movement looks, check out the example videos below to see the skips in action.

​

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] to tank the 3rd Waterfall

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/FysXlFOwOW.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

This guide will go over how to complete the Zemouregal & Vorkath (HM) Grandmaster Speed Killer achievement, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter.

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c2520edc-fbc9-41e2-92f9-947cd6c1a851 Magic/Melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=n3P9OYgySOM5k05NTVCi Melee/Ranged]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fn3P9OYgySOM5k05NTVCi.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Checklist and Unlocks
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] Overload at bank ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] Quivers with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] Physical spec SGB to keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] boost ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] Slayer perks with task active • These can be combo'd onto the same gizmo ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] Slayer helm in tier 3 slayer lodge

​

Melee/Ranged Grandmaster Speed Killer

⬥ With this rotation it is possible to hit ~1:14.4 - 1:18.0 kill times

⬥ You may need to finish Zemouregal with multiple [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

​

Wars

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/jivq2mpX3i.png Guide illustration]

Note: This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Zuk, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here [[PvME/TzKal-Zuk/Tzkal Zuk Overview|Tzkal Zuk Basic]]

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=snnRqsGBVSDGGqtq90o9 Necromancy | Ful of Energy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FsnnRqsGBVSDGGqtq90o9.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ful of Energy But Nowhere To Go

⬥ Defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run without moving after attacking the 'Conduit of Ful' in wave 18.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You are allowed to move after the conduit has spawned, just not after you have started attacking it

​
