[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

​

In RuneScape PvM, the meta at the time of writing is about pushing out as much damage in as little time as possible. It is important to understand that good and efficient PvM, especially at the higher tiers, is about squeezing out as much damage as possible in between mechanics.

​

This guide will cover fundamental terminology, discuss full manual vs. revolution, how to put together a rotation, and common hiccups that players run into while getting into PvM.

​

Related guides

For further information and reading, you can refer to the following resources.

Quick Navigation Links
Links to related guides and resources for more information about PvM and DPS.
Damage guides
⬥ [[PvME/Damage rotations/Magic damage guide|DPM Advice Mage]] ⬥ [[PvME/Damage rotations/Melee damage guide|DPM Advice Melee]] ⬥ [[PvME/Damage rotations/Ranged damage guide|DPM Advice Range]] ⬥ [[PvME/Damage rotations/Necromancy damage guide|DPM Advice Necro]]
Misc. Info
⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Revolution Bars|Revolution Bars]] ⬥ [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=abilities Ability information] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Mechanics|Mechanics]]
Invention
⬥ [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] ⬥ [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]]

Note: If you have any difficulties in using the tools or understanding what the information means, you can always ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)].

​

Terminology

Common Abbreviations in PvM

⬥ Ability - the combat actions you can perform for each style, unique to EoC.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic ability - abilities that require no adrenaline to use, such as Sonic Wave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063115709972651.png?v=1 sonic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Threshold - abilities that require 50% adren to use, and cost 15% adren, e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enhanced - abilities that typically cost adrenaline to use, e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ultimate - powerful abilities that cost 60-100% adrenaline to use, such as Tsunami [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Special attack - some weapons have in-built special attacks, e.g. the Dragon Battleaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 DBA]

⬥ Auto – the Basic Attack

⬥ DPS – damage per second, or referring to damage in general

⬥ DW – dual-wield weapons

⬥ 2H – two-handed weapons

⬥ Juggling/Swapping – generally referring to switching between DW and 2H weapons to gain access to more damaging abilities

⬥ Camping – refers to using only one type of weapon - e.g. 2H camping or DW camping

⬥ Rotation – refers to the usage of abilities in sequence, and managing ability cooldowns

⬥ Switch – refers to a piece of gear worn and used only temporarily for some effect

⬥ Tick – a unit of time in which a game action can occur - Runescape runs on 0.6 second ticks

⬥ Lossless - meaning no ticks are lost in performing an action

⬥ GCD - global cooldown - an innate cooldown built into every ability that lasts for 3 ticks (1.8 seconds)

​

A full list of abbreviations can be found [https://runescape.wiki/w/Glossary here].

​

Combat Modes

Runescape combat can vary in how much user input is required during the encounter depending on what ability categories you allow Revolution to use, the categories are:

⬥ Basic - also known as "basic" Revolution

⬥ Threshold - only affects certain Constitution and Defence abilities like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

⬥ Enhanced - also known as Revolution+

⬥ Ultimate - also known as Revolution++

You can change combat modes by right-clicking the yellow cog icon on the action bar.

⬥ The settings can also be found at: (Press Esc) > Settings > Gameplay > Combat & Action Bar > Combat Mode

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mcaPwrZJOu.png Guide illustration] When Revolution is enabled, a yellow bar will appear around your abilities. This indicates which abilities the system has access to.

⬥ Abilities outside this box will not be used automatically

⬥ The bar can be made bigger or smaller by adjusting Revolution Size in the settings menu

​

Basic Revolution

What is Revo

With Basic Revolution (often just called Revo), basic abilities are used automatically, but everything else must be used by the player.

⬥ You can still override this with manual inputs

Newer players may find this combat mode helpful, as it gives some control over your ability rotation but takes away the burden of managing your basic abilities. To enable Revolution, only allow basic abilities to be used by the game automatically:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/D5ILK2gQ2Z.png Guide illustration] ​

Combat Strategy with Revo

Set up your ability bar properly, can see example bars below. When you reach 100% adrenaline, activate your damage-boosting Ultimate abilites.

⬥ These are Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] , Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift], Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk], or Living Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] depending on your combat style

From there, use your enhanced abilities, modified ultimate abilities and special attacks as adrenaline and ability cooldowns permit.

⬥ Examples include Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] , Snapshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] , Assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] , etc

This simple pattern can be used to achieve a moderate level of DPS with low-medium player input:

⬥ Build to 100% → damage-boosting ultimate → enhanced/modified ultimates/special attacks → Repeat

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you have full adrenaline, but cannot use a damage-boosting ultimate, you can use a couple enhanced abilities while waiting for the cooldown

Setting Up A Revolution Bar

⬥ Strong basics are prioritised over weaker basics

⬥ At least one short cooldown ability is placed at the front to help with ability cooldowns

⬥ Enhanced and ultimate abilities can be placed anywhere on the bar − you will be manually activating them, so the order does not matter

⬥ Look at [[PvME/Combat reference/Revolution Bars|Revolution Bars]] for style-specific revolution bars

​

How to Approach Using Full Manual

Note: For a more in-depth guide, you can look at [[PvME/Learning to boss/Revo To Full Manual|Revo To Full Manual]].

⬥ It does not matter where you place abilities on your bar with Full Manual, but you may still find it helpful to organize how you set it up

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. first basic, then enhanced, then ultimate abilities

⬥ Going from Revo to Full Manual can seem intimidating, but the key to success is practice, practice, practice

⬥ You can begin with Revo to use your basics, and manually using enhanced and ultimate abilities

⬥ Once comfortable, you can also press your basic abilities, but leave Revo on as a backup (to avoid losing ticks doing nothing)

⬥ Once you feel confident with your keybinds, try turning off Revolution entirely

Practicing Full Manual

One way to practice is to try attacking a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] for a full minute, using only basics. Your goal is to not lose any ticks between basic abilities, while still using as many high damaging basics as you can.

⬥ This helps you learn about ability cooldowns and get used to pressing inputs

⬥ After this, you can practice a more realistic rotation including enhanced and ultimate abilities

Once you get comfortable at a combat dummy, try it out on a real boss at GWD1 (e.g. K'ril Tustsaroth) or GWD2 (e.g. Vindicta). There is no easy "trick" to skip past the practice. It takes time to learn full manual, so don't give up! Do not worry if your damage lessens during this process - it is normal have worse DPS while learning full manual.

How to Build a Rotation

Note: This is just one example for one style. More detailed and style-specific information can be found in their respective guides: [[PvME/Damage rotations/Magic damage guide|DPM Advice Mage]] / [[PvME/Damage rotations/Melee damage guide|DPM Advice Melee]] / [[PvME/Damage rotations/Necromancy damage guide|DPM Advice Necro]] / [[PvME/Damage rotations/Ranged damage guide|DPM Advice Range]].

Factors to Consider

A rotation is a general order of abilities we try to follow to maximize our DPS. This is achieved taking into account a number of factors, such as:

⬥ Ability Damage - we want to use strong abilities

⬥ Ability Cooldowns - we can only use each ability every so often

⬥ 2H/DW reqs - some abilities can only be used with two-handed or dual-wield weapons specifically

This is a lot to take in, so consider the following example. We randomly use some of the strong melee basics and see what happens:

⬥ Dismember [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] → Greater Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → Rend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → Chaos Roar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → Punish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → Adaptive Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → ?

All the strong basics are now on cooldown and we have to use the Basic Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] , how can this be fixed?

​

Rotating Your Basic Abilities

To avoid running into situations where there are no good abilities to use, we pick a strong basic that has a relatively short cooldown to build around. One ability that immediately comes to mind is [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] , because:

⬥ It is not too weak - 140% maximum ability damage

⬥ It has a short cooldown - 5.4 seconds / 9 ticks, or 3 global cooldowns (GCDs)

⬥ In other words, we can use Adaptive Strike as every 3rd ability

We also notice Rend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] :

⬥ It is one of our strongest basics (165% maximum damage)

⬥ It has a relatively short cooldown - we can use Rend every 6th ability

Putting it together, we get a rotation:

⬥ [ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] ] → [ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] ] → Repeat

This rotation, using groups of 3 abilities around Adaptive Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] , can be indefinitely repeated. This gives us a strong foundation to build adrenaline that we can then consume to use enhanced and ultimate abilities.

⬥ This is just a basic example to show how cooldown management works, the rotation is still very bare bones and not optimised

⬥ In a final rotation, abilities like Greater Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] can replace the Basic Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] before strong abilities like Punish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

When To Use Thresholds / Ultimates

We want to use our damage-boosting ultimates ( [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] ) as often as we can, if the fight will last longer than the duration of the ultimate. Inside the ultimate, the goal is to use as many good enhanced abilities, modified ultimates (like Overpower with an Igneous Kal-Ket [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] ) and special attacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] as possible, and minimize the use of the Basic Ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic].

⬥ During cooldowns, we will continue to use strong basics

⬥ After the ultimate ability ends, while waiting for it to come back off cooldown, we can use a few enhanced abilities

What to Use Inside Ultimates

Players have worked out some of the best ways to use abilities inside ultimates. There are rotations available depending on your gear and what abilities you have unlocked. Knowing such information helps plan out ability rotations, and commit them to muscle memory over time with practice.

For example, using a BiS setup with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189295592161291.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavoctop] we can fit the following abilities within a single Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] :

⬥ 2x Greater Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry]

⬥ 4x Overpower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

Note: Many different ultimate rotations for different scenarios can be found in the style-specific [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Damage%20%26%20rotations Damage and rotation guides] channels.

​

Common Mistakes and How to Fix Them

The following sections cover some common mistakes made by players in PvM. It is likely that as you work towards improving your PvM ability, you will need to improve in one or many of these areas. The first step is recognizing what mistakes you're making, then working on the solution. Don't be discouraged if you don't get it right away, some of these issues can be harder to fix than others. Remember, everything just takes practice.

​

PvM Checklist

It may seem obvious, but ensuring that you are not missing anything in terms of gear loadout and character buffs can help with avoiding frustration during PvM. Here are some things that you may want to check if you run into difficulties, or to avoid them.

Checklist

⬥ Gear/equipment

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enough divine charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipment is repaired [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1388314911742099576.png?v=1 mwmhat] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556582803014418432.png?v=1 elitetectmask]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jewellery is charged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 RoD] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485544188391424.png?v=1 onyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485545480228895.png?v=1 alchemicalhydrixdust]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rune pouches are filled [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439126519644271.png?v=1 graspingpouchpink] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 Airrune]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quivers are filled [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Nexus is filled [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1 zemouregalsnexus] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138808701029982319.png?v=1 bonerune]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pocket slots are charged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1 scriptureofjas] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiar + scrolls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll]

⬥ Character Buffs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP boosts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overloads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Correct spellbook [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543875425055670275.png?v=1 SBS] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1 SBSLunars]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Incense sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 LantaSticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 SpiritSticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks]

⬥ Other

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Action bar switches set up correctly

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keybinds set up correctly

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quick prayers set up [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010486261682810891.png?v=1 protectitem] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 Malevolence]

Quick Banking Preset

It can be helpful to have a preset dedicated to general PvM setup, for quickly preparing for a bossing hour and to ensure that you don't miss the items on the checklist.

⬥ Use the !banking ‎command to learn more

​

Cancelling Channelled Abilities Late/Early

Why Channeled Abilities Are Important

Most abilities in the game take 1.8 seconds / 3 ticks, or 1 GCD, to cast. Channeled abilities take longer than this duration to cast fully. These abilities can be cancelled, by activating the next ability early. It is important to properly cancel abilities in order to not lose any ticks, or damage potential. The channel bar gives a good indication of how far into a channel you are.

⬥ Animations can be unreliable, and longer than the actual hit duration of the ability

⬥ It can be higher damage-per-tick, or net you more adrenaline, to cancel long channels early

⬥ Some interactions actively discourage cancelling channels, like the Tumeken resplendence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1 tumekenrobetop] armour set effect

​

Channeled Abilities

Note: 2-hit implies that you channel the ability for 2 hits, and so on. How long you channel will depend on your rotations. 3 ticks = 1.8 seconds = 1 GCD.

⬥ Magic Abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373968731811880.png?v=1 conc] - 3-hit (3t/1.8s)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] - 3-hit (3t/1.8s)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] - 2-hit (3t/1.8s), or 4-hit (7t/4.2s)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Smoke Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] - 4-hit (7t/4.2s)

⬥ Ranged Abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] - 1-hit (3t/1.8s)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rapid fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] - 8-hit (8t/4.8s)

⬥ Melee Abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] - 2-hit (3t/1.8s), or 4-hit (7t/4.2s)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Greater Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] - 8-hit (8t/4.8s)

⬥ Necromancy Abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood Siphon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon] - 5-hit (9t/5.4s)

Ability Prioritisation

Why It's Important

As obvious as it may sound, using stronger abilities increase your DPS, more so than any other gear upgrade. Abilities can be prioritised differently based on the scenario. For example, DoTs, or damage-over-time abilities (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1 corruptionblast] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] ) have lower priority while under damage-boosting ultimates ( [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] ) since their damage doesn't get boosted.

⬥ In other words, you should know which abilities are strong in which scenarios, and use that to your advantage.

​

How to Fix

Read the Ability Prioritisation sections in the style-specific guides to get an idea of how to prioritise abilities for each style ([[PvME/Damage rotations/Magic damage guide|DPM Advice Mage]], [[PvME/Damage rotations/Melee damage guide|DPM Advice Melee]], [[PvME/Damage rotations/Ranged damage guide|DPM Advice Range]], [[PvME/Damage rotations/Necromancy damage guide|DPM Advice Necro]]).

⬥ For more information, check out the Ability Damage Maths spreadsheet in [[PvME/Combat reference/PvM Spreadsheets|PvM Spreadsheets]]

⬥ Also, an explanation of how most abilities work can be found in [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=abilities Ability information]

​

Managing Cooldowns

Why It's Important

Strong abilities often come with long cooldowns. If you use all your strong abilities at once, you will be forced to use many weak abilities during the cooldown. By contrast, managing the cooldowns lets you use a balance of very strong and moderately strong abilities, and for the most part, avoid weak abilities altogether.

​

How to Fix

Your goal should be to make use of "filler" abilities, ones with decent damage and short cooldowns, in-between your strong abilities in order to "manage" their cooldowns. Managing your cooldowns effectively will translate to a direct DPM increase, as you will be using fewer weak abilities overall. Example filler abilities by style:

⬥ Magic: (Greater) Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373968731811880.png?v=1 conc]

⬥ Ranged: Piercing Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot]

⬥ Melee: Adaptive Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike], Rend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend]

⬥ Necromancy: Soul Sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap], Touch of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Losing Ticks

Why It's Important To Be Aware of Losing Ticks

Not using the next ability in the sequence fast enough causes lost ticks, where your character stands still doing nothing. This may be due to slow ability input, or being slow with weapon switches, or forgetting to click a target again while using revo if you stop attacking for any reason. This is similar to not cancelling channeled abilities properly - it can add up to a large amount of wasted DPS potential over time.

How to Fix

Practice more! Try to anticipate what abilities you will need to use in advance, so that you are prepared to input them as required.

⬥ The setting to automatically trigger the Basic Ability is not advised as it gets in the way more often than not

​

Not Using Invention Perks

Why It's Important To Use Perks

Invention perks offer large increases to both your damage and survivability, and are absolutely recommended to be used. The benefits of perks far outweigh the costs of using augmented gear. There are two kinds of perks - the perks that you camp, or base perks, and the perks that go on switches, that we'll call switch perks. It is strongly recommended to unlock Ancient Invention, requiring 85 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] Invention (boostable with an extreme invention potion from level 67 and blueprints for gizmos can be bought on the Grand Exchange).

⬥ Ancient invention perks are stronger, and in many cases far easier to get, than their normal counterparts

Note: You can get starter perks going as low as level 68 Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] + an Extreme Invention potion. For a detailed list of perks and why they're used, check out [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] and [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]].

​

Base Perks

These are the perks you would camp on your weapons and armour. For players beginning their PvM journey, the following starter perks are recommended:

⬥ Weapons: Precise 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] + Eruptive 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1 er4]

⬥ Body: Biting 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502516874051590.png?v=1 b3] + Crackling 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4]

⬥ Legs: Impatient 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] + Enhanced Devoted 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4]

These perks offer substantial DPS increases over no perks at all, boost your adrenaline gains with Impatient [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] and offer large defensive damage mitigation with Enhanced Devoted 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4].

⬥ Not using at least some level of starter invention perks is a large damage and defence loss

​

Switch Perks

Some invention perks like Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] , Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] and Lunging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736522494315593759.png?v=1 lunge4] can drastically change how good certain abilities are to use. However, depending on the situation, these perks may not be good to permanently put on your items - in which case, they may end up as switches.

⬥ Not using these perks under the right circumstances can be significant lost DPS potential

​

How to Fix

⬥ Always use augmented, properly perked gear! Even the 'starter' invention perks are miles better than no perks at all

⬥ Practice adding in the switches slowly, and it will become muscle memory with time

⬥ With Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] your basic stun abilities like Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1 impactflank] / Binding Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153400647701.png?v=1 bindingshotflank] / Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1 backhandflank] / Soul Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] become some of your strongest basics, and add more options to your rotations. It also buffs the corresponding enhanced stun abilities

⬥ Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] combined with Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478668630265958471.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] can become an exceptionally good way to clear large groups of monsters

⬥ Lunging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736522494315593759.png?v=1 lunge4] combined with a Masterwork Spear of Annihilation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] makes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] your strongest melee basic ability

​

Incorrect Weapon Switching

Why It’s Important

⬥ Changing your weapon during a channeled ability such as during Rapid Fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] will cancel the ability abruptly

⬥ Some abilities and special attacks are tied to your main hand weapon. Changing weapons loses the buff.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After using Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] your next ability must be with the same weapon as well, to use the crit chance buff

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Some special attacks like ECB spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] are tied to your main hand weapon as well, and changing weapons loses the buff

⬥ Mistakes like these, and more, can cost significant lost damage potential, and are essential to avoid

​

How to Fix

Learn when you can and cannot switch weapons, and deliberately practice proper juggling rotations to ensure that you commit the correct actions to muscle memory. In the long term, it is easier to learn good habits than to unlearn bad ones.

​

Cheaping Out On Supplies

Why It’s Important

It may seem convenient and cost-effective to save on supplies, doing things such as:

⬥ Using normal spells [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543465115870035999.png?v=1 AirSurge] over ancient spells [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]

⬥ Using cheap ammo like Araxyte arrows instead of Elder God arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows]

⬥ Using low tier food instead of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489363087360.png?v=1 Sailfish] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336701933060106.png?v=1 sailfishsoup]

⬥ Wearing cheaper alternatives [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846959454617610.png?v=1 sirenicmask] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1 sirenicbody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846938537623564.png?v=1 sireniclegs] instead of better equipment [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717359934640168.png?v=1 edracocoif] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717430436704306.png?v=1 edracolichhauberk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717529015427146.png?v=1 edracochaps]

⬥ Not using perked gear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

⬥ and the list goes on...

It may seem appealing to save money in these little ways, but it is not worth it. The loss of any one of these upgrades may look small, but together they can add up to a large impact on your PvM ability. Being able to have more utility spells at hand, to not waste time casting vuln, to do more damage with better ammo/spells, to heal more health quickly, to take less damage with better armour and perks, and so on can make PvM far less tedious and more enjoyable.

Note: in some extreme scenarios, it is worth considering cheaper alternatives.

​

How to Fix

Supply costs are the price to pay for the chance to do exciting PvM encounters, and fight fun bosses. Just accept them as a part of PvM. Treat it as an incentive to get better at PvM - the faster you kill things, the fewer supplies you use and the more money you make.

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

This guide will go over general damage output lessons, ability prioritisation, a learning path, and style-specific solutions for common PvM concerns

⬥ Knowledge of in-game ability/item descriptions is assumed, this guide aims to tie the tools together rather than list what they do

⬥ For general PvM terminology, damage tips, and revolution bars, check out their respective sections in [[PvME/Damage rotations/Damage rotations FAQ|DPM Advice Faq]]

⬥ To compare abilities, use [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/magic RS Analysis' Magic Page], and add your gear

​

> Core Magic Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

This section covers rotations using core style abilities before later unlocks are obtained

See Advanced Magic Rotations section further down for info on magic rotations using best-in-slot gear

​

⬥ A typical Magic rotation uses the strongest Basic Abilities available to build adrenaline, and spends it on the strongest available Enhanced Abilities, Ultimate Abilities, or Special Attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While doing this, we must think about the following key considerations:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Basic ability patterns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Buff usage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spell effects [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]

​

Basic Pattern

If Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] is not unlocked, use the regular version [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373968731811880.png?v=1 conc] instead

​

⬥ Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] should form the foundation of your rotation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to follow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] with strong abilities that can critically strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

⬥ The basic pattern uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] often in blocks of 3 abilities:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → Ability → Ability ] → Repeat

​

⬥ When building adrenaline, fill the empty slots with strong Basic Abilities:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon Breath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sonic Wave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063115709972651.png?v=1 sonic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Combust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust]

⬥ Then spend adrenaline on Enhanced Abilites, Ultimate Abilities, and Special Attacks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Such abilities are often categorically referred to as spenders

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Omnipower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Lasts long enough to fill both empty slots between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] uses

⬥ This pattern helps ensure that your cooldowns are always cycling to allow for a consistent flow of strong abilities

​

Sunshine

It is assumed that either the Planted Feet perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] or Greater Sunshine unlock has been obtained [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] for the purposes of this guide

​

⬥ Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] is the main buff to prioritise whenever there is an opportunity to deal damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The exception to this is when the fight would end too quickly, or mechanics occur, and you can't benefit from the full duration

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, enter boss fights and important phases with 100% adrenaline so you can activate it immediately

⬥ In Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine], continue following the basic pattern while fitting in your most powerful spenders:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Omnipower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ Keep in mind that Damage-over-Time (DoT) abilities such as Combust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] are not affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] and most other damage buffs

⬥ While waiting for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] cooldown, you do not want to needlessly camp 100% adrenaline, and can start building when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] is nearly ready to use again

​

Other Buffs

Besides Sunshine, Magic has multiple buffing abilities that are meant to supplement and enhance its core rotation

​

⬥ Tsunami [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] grants adrenaline per critical strike and is most often used alongside [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Synergises with abilities that have built-in critical strike chance boosts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils]

​

⬥ Sonic Wave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] is typically used to save adrenaline while setting up [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can also be used on spenders [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] to help maintain high adrenaline while waiting on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] cooldown

​

⬥ Runic Charge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] can flexibly enhance different basic abilities but is most commonly used for:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (1) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] on either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] to allow for more immediate adrenaline during the buff window

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (2) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] on either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] for consistent critical strikes on your highest damaging abilities

​

⬥ Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] provides a critical strike damage boost after its full channel, often stacked with other buffs to maximise burst damage

​

Spell Effects

Magic spells can be clicked in the spellbook or right-clicked on an ability bar to be set to autocast, which 'selects' them to use with your abilities, like picking your ammo for a ranged weapon

​

⬥ When using abilities, stronger autocast spells can increase your ability damage and provide additional effects

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Autocast either Exsanguinate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] or alternatively Incite Fear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear] if you plan to use Tsunami [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Otherwise, use the highest rank of blood [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] / air [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543465115870035999.png?v=1 airsurge] spell available or Crumble Undead [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead] if applicable

⬥ Any damaging spell can be dragged onto a hotbar slot to act as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1 magicbasic] although you will gain the secondary effect of that spell when used rather than the secondary effect of your autocast

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended to do so to maintain a consistent hit timing for your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1 magicbasic], as certain spells such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear] hit slower than others

> PvM Decision Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

Next, we explore how magic solves common PvM scenarios and other style-specific decisions it has to make

​

Area-of-Effect (AoE)

⬥ Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063105182269460.png?v=1 chain] / Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] is the default option for dealing with AoE scenarios as magic

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Longer range AoE targeting than other options while being flexible in terms of adrenaline management

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use a powerful ability on the main target like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] or high hitting special attacks such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If the main target dies before the followup ability is cast, the effect will be lost

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be used to briefly stun multiple targets with stun abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

​

⬥ Magma Tempest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] deals high damage when targets are expected to survive for a longer period of time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Targeted variant [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] is good for setting up damage before enemies have spawned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Is not classified as DoT damage, allowing it to benefit from Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] and other damage buffs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can mostly finish ticking if used between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] cooldown

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] can also help with tagging and luring enemies into [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1 magmatemptest] 5x5 area

​

⬥ Low Priority or Highly Situational

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Barrage Spells [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] provide a spammable AoE option but have restrictive 3x3 area and low damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Can be used for AoE healing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] or freeze [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tsunami [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] is usually only used for AoE when the timing lines up with when you would normally use it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon Breath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] may be used for lower target counts (<= 4) and can be boosted further with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1 corruptionblast] has higher multipliers than [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] but is restrictive due to being classified as DoT and costing adrenaline

​

Spending Excess Adrenaline

⬥ Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] is your go-to spender and deals more damage than other options under most circumstances

⬥ Essence of Finality Special Attacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] are rarely needed for magic rotations due to the extremely low cooldown on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] can automatically fill up to 2/3 of your rotation on their own

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Iban's Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929543068618752.png?v=1 ibansstaff] and Legatus's Emberstaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1 legatusemberstaff] can be used as the main [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] options

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For situations where you have adrenaline but no strong cooldowns available, or when fishing for high immediate burst damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] is used only when a hit chance boost is needed

​

Dealing with Movement

⬥ Bosses may require you to move for mechanics during Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] and/or mid-channel [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] occupies a 7x7 area, it is often possible to pre-position it to fit into any movement requirements a boss has

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] (loops)

​

Notes:

⬥ We can now fit more abilities into each [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] buff, allowing us to aim for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] under the buff

⬥ We actively utilise 5-tick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] to line up the second [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] as early as possible

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Applicability of this can change from boss to boss

⬥ We still have a slot to fill in with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], but can be replaced with any other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if doing group bosses

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] itself becomes a solid damage ability while waiting for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] cooldown

​

Runic Charge and Adrenaline Renewal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]

⬥ In previous example rotations we have been using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] to guarantee more adrenaline after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This sacrifices a use on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] that we're unable to use on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] during the first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] buff

⬥ In reality, there are multiple considerations that allow us to optimise our [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] uses

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] can be consistently skipped in the opener when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] is available

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Preparing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] ~10s before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] allows it to be used on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] as usual while having it come up back up soon after the first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ In general, plan to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] as early as possible as long as it won't be consumed on the wrong ability

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This allows you to potentially find spots to squeeze in additional uses

​

Example (1 minute+):

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] (as early as possible) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] (5-tick) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] ends) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

​

Notes:

⬥ Uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] to get 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] uses during first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

⬥ Goes back to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] for second sun since [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] is now on cooldown

​

Temporal Anomaly [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1 temporalanomaly]

⬥ Due to its random nature, Temporal Anomaly (TA) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1 temporalanomaly] is typically not written into rotations. However, using TA resets correctly can still result in improved kill times on average, even if the base rotation you work with is relatively static.

⬥ The value of most resets primarily comes down to the cooldown of the ability were you to use it again

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example, a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] reset is not particularly useful because it needs to be back up by the next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] (which cannot reset off TA), and casting it again runs the risk of de-syncing your major cooldowns

​

⬥ TA reset considerations

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] Best reset, allows additional casts during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] that isn't otherwise possible

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] With 4-piece [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1 tumekenrobetop], can do the second cast earlier to get extra abilities under the buff near the end of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] Deals good damage, can replace the next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] or filler ability if a reset occurs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] Also allows additional casts under [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] that isn't otherwise possible, though generally un-needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] in AoE-heavy scenarios

⬥ It's important to recognize that many TA resets will not be particularly useful in the context that they occur, don't feel obligated to use every one immediately. Often times, just prioritizing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] leads to the most consistent gains from TA, though fishing for more resets from abilities like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] can lead to higher peaks.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

This guide will go over general damage output lessons, ability prioritisation, a learning path, and style-specific solutions for common PvM concerns.

​

⬥ Knowledge of in-game ability/item descriptions is assumed, this guide aims to tie the tools together rather than list what they do.

⬥ Melee rotations are highly situational and often change based on boss timings, phase length, weapon setup, and how much switching is practical.

⬥ For general PvM terminology, damage tips, and revolution bars, check out their respective sections in [[PvME/Damage rotations/Damage rotations FAQ|DPM Advice Faq]]

⬥ For recommended upgrade order, see [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Melee upgrade order|Melee]]

⬥ For invention perks, see [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]]

⬥ If you need tailored advice for a specific boss or gear setup, ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)]

⬥ To compare abilities, use [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/melee RS Analysis' Melee Page], and add your gear

​

Abilities, Attacks and Weapons

​

Prioritising Basic Abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic]

You should prioritise the following Basic abilities:

⬥ Punish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] if the target is <50% life points

⬥ Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1 backhandflank] with Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] if the boss is not facing you

⬥ Greater Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury]

⬥ Rend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1488133579614588948.png?v=1 rendgop] with Gloves of Passage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1 glovesofpassage]

⬥ Adaptive Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]

⬥ Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879510372352.png?v=1 fury] (if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] is not yet unlocked)

​

Do not use these Basic abilities to build:

⬥ Chaos Roar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] should be used before a heavy-hitting attack and its cooldown is too long

⬥ Greater Barge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] should be used before a strong channelled ability

​

Prioritising Stronger Abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

When spending adrenaline, there are two primary considerations:

⬥ total damage over time (e.g., the start of a phase) vs. instant damage (burst damage, e.g., boss damage check window)

⬥ adren cost vs. total damage

​

In general, prioritise the following abilities and special attacks:

⬥ Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] whenever possible

⬥ Ek-ZekKil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] for fights lasting over 1 minute

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First cast 280 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Further casts (Flamebound Rival [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404885709034229922.png?v=1 flameboundrival]) 1045 AD​

⬥ Greater Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] 520 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For its Berserk extension

⬥ Assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] when 4+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] 720 AD​

⬥ Greater Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] with 4+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] and target below ~71% life points

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• <71% LP 671 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• <50% LP 780 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• <35% LP 858 AD​

⬥ Overpower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] with Igneous cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] 620 AD​

⬥ Assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] with <4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] 560 AD​

⬥ Massacre [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1 massacre] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] + not inside [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + your target can take damage for another 24s 1120 AD​

⬥ Slaughter [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] + not inside [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + your target can take damage for another 18s 810 AD​

⬥ Dismember [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] + Strength cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] + Lunging perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736522494315593759.png?v=1 lunge4] + not inside [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + your target can take damage for another 18s 549 AD​

⬥ Overpower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] without cape 545 AD​

⬥ Varanus's Mercy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] 491.25 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unless perked with Equilibrium [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1 equilibrium]

⬥ Leng Set special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] with 2+ Primordial Ice [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 stacks 475 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 stacks 435 AD​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 stacks 395 AD​

⬥ Greater Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] when <4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] or the target is >71% LP 520 AD​

⬥ Hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] 320 AD​

​

Situational special attacks:

⬥ Granite Maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] ignores cooldowns and can be spammed during a single GCD 125 AD​

⬥ Dragon Claws [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] are seen as a direct downgrade from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] 400 AD​

​

Camping & Switching Weapons

Melee has multiple strong weapons, and the best option depends heavily on the situation:

⬥ Some rotations camp one weapon setup for simplicity

⬥ Some rotations switch between weapons to use specific abilities for extra damage

⬥ Some fights are too short or too awkward to make switches worthwhile

​

The most common "default" or "camped" weapons include:

⬥ Ek-ZekKil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Camp Ek-ZekKil when the fight lasts over 1 minute

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Its value comes from Flamebound Rival [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404885709034229922.png?v=1 flameboundrival] while equipped (+12% damage and damage reduction)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not reliant on RNG stacks, with higher single-GCD burst and stronger damage from the second minute onwards

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More expensive, weaker in the first minute, and needs a dual-wield switch to stall / cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry]

⬥ Leng swords [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Camp Lengs for fights sub-1 minute, especially for higher first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They are cheaper, do not need an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof], and passively build Primordial Ice [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] stacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Icy Tempest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] costs 0 adrenaline at 3+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] (still requires +30% to use)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Needs a 2h switch to stall / cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

Step 5: Putting it all together

This is it, the moment you've been waiting for, the BiS rotation...

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

This guide will go over general damage output lessons, ability prioritisation, a learning path, and style-specific solutions for common PvM concerns

⬥ Knowledge of in-game ability/item descriptions is assumed, this guide aims to tie the tools together rather than list what they do

⬥ For general PvM terminology, damage tips, and revolution bars, check out their respective sections in [[PvME/Damage rotations/Damage rotations FAQ|DPM Advice Faq]]

⬥ To compare abilities, use [https://rs-analysis.xyz/necromancy.html RS Analysis' Necromancy Page], and add your gear

​

> Core Necromancy Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

This section covers rotations using core style abilities before later unlocks are obtained

See Advanced Necromancy Rotations section further down for info on necromancy rotations using best-in-slot gear

​

⬥ A typical Necromancy rotation uses the strongest Basic Abilities available to build adrenaline, and spends it on the strongest available Enhanced Abilities, Ultimate Abilities, or Special Attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While doing this, we must think about the following key considerations:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Basic ability patterns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Buff usage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stack management [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul]

​

Basic Pattern

⬥ The basic pattern uses Touch of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] and Soul Sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] to build stacks, then spends them later

⬥ Touch of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath], Has high priority when cooldown is available

⬥ Soul Sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap], Often used in blocks of 3 abilities:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → Ability → Ability ] → Repeat

​

⬥ Stack spenders, Use these to spend your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Finger of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Prioritised inside of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Often shouldn't be used when under 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks due to adrenaline cost

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Volley of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Often shouldn't be used when under 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Death Guard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] Special Attack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spends all [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks, Often shouldn't be used when over 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks

​

⬥ Other strong abilities, These should be woven into rotations effectively:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Death Skulls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Split Soul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bloat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Command Skeleton Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Living Death

⬥ Living Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] is the main buff to prioritise whenever there is an opportunity to deal damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The exception to this is when the fight would end too quickly, or mechanics occur, and you can't benefit from the full duration

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, enter boss fights and important phases with 100% adrenaline so you can activate it immediately

⬥ In Living Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath], continue following the basic pattern of building and spending stacks, while maximizing Death Skulls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] usage:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Death Skulls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Finger of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Volley of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ Keep in mind you want to be using your other strong abilities in-between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] and your stack spenders

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Split Soul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bloat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat], only approximately every 20 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Command Skeleton Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

⬥ While waiting for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] cooldown, you do not want to needlessly camp 100% adrenaline, and can start building when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] is nearly ready to use again

​

Conjures

Conjures are summoned allies that help you in combat and should be used everywhere, unless a good reason is stated

⬥ Vengeful Ghost [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] should be kept active and commanded with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] before damage rotations, as this provides both passive damage and sustain throughout the fight

⬥ Skeleton Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] should be kept active, with Command Skeleton Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] woven into rotations when available for effective damage

⬥ Putrid Zombie [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie] is mainly kept active for passive damage, but Command Putrid Zombie [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] can be used situationally for burst AoE

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This kills the Zombie, so only use it when the burst damage is worth needing to refresh [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] or wait for the original conjure cooldown

⬥ Phantom Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109199069806604.png?v=1 conjurephantom] is primarily defensive, reducing incoming damage while active

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It builds Valour stacks over time when getting hit, which can be spent by Command Phantom Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109200432959528.png?v=1 commandphantom] for situational AoE damage

⬥ Conjure Undead Army [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] is the standard way to summon or refresh conjures before key damage windows

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be configured by right-clicking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] and choosing the customise option

Stack Management

Necromancy rotations are heavily shaped by managing Necrosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] and Residual Soul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks effectively

⬥ Necromancy uses stack stack building basic abilities to unlock stronger spenders later in the rotation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Touch of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] grants 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soul Sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] grants 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These stacks should generally be built naturally while cycling your strongest available abilities

​

⬥ Necrosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks are primarily spent on Finger of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to avoid using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] below 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] for effective use

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During Living Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] prioritise Finger of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] and Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] higher than other weaker options

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Death Guard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] Special Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] consumes all [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] to deal good damage and stun the target, can be used when at or less than 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]

⬥ Residual Soul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks are primarily spent on Volley of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Volley of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] should be used with 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] for maximum value

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soul Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] can be used with Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] to deal good damage per soul, outside of your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] rotation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] can be comboed alongside Threads of Fate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] to generate more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] in AoE scenarios

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Devourer's Guard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511720455143539.png?v=1 devourersguard] Special Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] consumes all [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] souls to deal good damage and stun the target, can be used outside of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] rotation as its own seperate rotation

​

⬥ Good stack management means avoiding both early spending and overcapping

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spending too early lowers the value of the stacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overcapping wastes potential value the stacks

​

> Rotation Examples [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath]

These are only suggestions to work from, and will not necessarily be applicable at all bosses or situations. For boss-specific rotations, see their respective guides.

​

Starting Unlocks

⬥ Ring of Vigour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] or its passive effect after [https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction Extinction quest]

⬥ Super Adrenaline or Enhanced Replenishment Potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Adrenaline potion rotations can be looped with the corresponding non-adrenaline potion rotation

⬥ Necromancy Talent Tree fully unlocked

⬥ Because Necromancy relies on multiple [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] every [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath], Try to obtain Igneous Kal-Mor [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] as soon as possible

⬥ Conservation of Energy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1 conservationofenergy] is highly recommended

​

Living Death Rotation Examples

Rotations assume a regular prebuild of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] is done beforehand

Example
