> PvM Decision Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

Next, we explore how necromancy solves common PvM scenarios using its versatile tools

​

Area-of-Effect (AoE)

⬥ Threads of Fate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] is the default option for dealing with AoE scenarios as necromancy

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Longer range AoE targeting than other options while being very flexible in ability usage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use powerful abilities like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] or use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] to build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Can continue to be used even if target dies, this helps with killing multiple sets of enemies with one cast

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be used to briefly stun multiple targets with stun abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike]

​

⬥ Spectral Scythe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] can be used for close range AoE multiple times

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First activation is only an arc in front of the player, subsequent casts will hit all around the player

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costly to use multiple times, but effective for smaller groups of close enemies

​

⬥ Low Priority or Highly Situational

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soul Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] provides a cheap spammable AoE option, but is often too weak or costs too many [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Command Putrid Zombie [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] deals good damage, but can often be unreliable and causes your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie] to die, forcing you to refresh [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bloat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] is best used when you kill the main target, causing it to spread to nearby enemies, good but low range and costs adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood Siphon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon] can be useful for large healing, but has very low AoE damage

​

Short Damage Checks

⬥ Some PvM scenarios emphasise short phases and quick damage checks rather than keeping up a consistent flow of damage

⬥ In such cases, we have some of the following options:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] ahead of time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilising abilities with late hit timings [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] to clip into the start of the next phase

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spend all stacks quickly by using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilising stalling with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

This guide will go over general damage output lessons, ability prioritisation, a learning path, and style-specific solutions for common PvM concerns

⬥ Knowledge of in-game ability/item descriptions is assumed, this guide aims to tie the tools together rather than list what they do

⬥ For general PvM terminology, damage tips, and revolution bars, check out their respective sections in [[PvME/Damage rotations/Damage rotations FAQ|DPM Advice Faq]]

⬥ To compare abilities, use [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/ranged RS Analysis' Ranged Page], and add your gear

​

> Core Ranged Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

This section covers rotations using core style abilities before later unlocks are obtained

See Advanced Ranged Rotations section further down for info on ranged rotations using best-in-slot gear

​

⬥ A typical Ranged rotation uses the strongest Basic Abilities available to build adrenaline, and spends it on the strongest available Enhanced Abilities, Ultimate Abilities, or Special Attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To achieve this, we must think about the following key considerations:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Basic ability patterns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Buff usage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Ammo effects [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows]

​

Basic Pattern

⬥ The basic pattern comboes Galeshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] into Rapid Fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] when both cooldowns are available

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] can be thought of as buffing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] + 3 abilities of your choice, adding additional damage onto each hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Therefore, try to follow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] with strong multi-hit abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → 3 Abilities] → [Filler] → [[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → 3 Abilities] → repeat

⬥ Ranged has other rotational synergies that help to fill empty ability slots

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] + Piercing Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Imbue: Shadows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] + Shadow Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]

​

⬥ When building adrenaline, fill with available Basic Abilities:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Piercing Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic]

⬥ Then spend adrenaline on Enhanced Abilites, Ultimate Abilities, and Special Attacks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Such abilities are often categorically referred to as spenders

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snap Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deadshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] + Shadow Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] don't spend adrenaline but are still considered Enhanced Abilities

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If adrenaline is limited, prioritise having enough adrenaline for your next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] combo

⬥ With these considerations, we can ensure that cooldowns are always cycling to allow for a consistent flow of strong abilities

​

Death's Swiftness

It is assumed that either the Planted Feet perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] or Greater Death's Swiftness unlock has been obtained [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] for the purposes of this guide.

​

⬥ Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] is the main buff to prioritise whenever there is an opportunity to deal damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The exception to this is when the fight would end too quickly, or mechanics occur, and you can't benefit from the full duration

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, enter boss fights and important phases with 100% adrenaline so you can activate it immediately

⬥ In Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift], continue following the basic pattern while fitting in your most powerful abilities:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]] → [Fill w/ Basics and Spenders] → [[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → ...]

⬥ While waiting for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] cooldown, you do not want to needlessly camp 100% adrenaline, and can start building when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] is nearly ready to use again

​

Other Buffs

Besides Death's Swiftness, Ranged has multiple supportive buffs that are meant to supplement and enhance its core rotation

​

⬥ Imbue Shadows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] grants adrenaline per hit and is extremely important to pair with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Synergises with multi-hit abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] and is vital to maintain a consistent flow of adrenaline during your damage buffs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep in mind that Damage-over-Time (DoT) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] does not count as a hit for the purposes of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows]

​

⬥ Shadow Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] extends [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] duration and should always be used once during a full [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]

​

⬥ Deathspore Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] should be used to get a free [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift], allowing for tremendously accelerated rotational setup

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 12 stacks can be obtained through a combination of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] or with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] if necessary

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Start building [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] in advance of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] cooldown so as to not waste time once it's available

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rare situations may not allow enough time to stack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows], in which case a form of adrenaline potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] can help with buff setup

​

⬥ Because of ranged's reliance on multi-hit abilities for both damage and adrenaline, it is highly recommended to prioritise obtaining Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] and Igneous Kal-Xil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] upgrades as early as possible in the style's progression

​

Ammo Effects

Due to having considerably stronger and more consistent effects, it is recommended to use bows + arrows over crossbows + bolts in the current state of the game. The information in this guide will assume that the highest available tier of bow + arrows are being used.

​

⬥ When using abilities, stronger ammunition can increase your ability damage and provide additional effects

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Ful Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] and Deathspore Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] together for general use

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Black Stone Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] or Wen Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] when hit chance is needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] are otherwise equal to or worse than [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] unless boss mechanics provide downtime to build stacks for free

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Otherwise, use the highest tier of generic ammunition available or Jas Bane arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow] if applicable

​

⬥ When using Pernix's Quiver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver], multiple keybind options are available that make ammo cycling easier

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (1) Quiver Slot: Drag the empty quiver slot from your gear interface onto an action bar to cycle ammo in any currently equipped quiver

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (2) Specific Quiver: Drag a specific quiver onto an action bar to either equip the quiver or, if already equipped, cycles its ammo

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (3) Quiver ammo slot 1 + Quiver ammo slot 2: Utility Abilities in the ranged ability book which cycles ammo to the selected slot

[https://img.pvme.io/images/DKjsxOkobI.png Guide illustration] ​

> Rotation Examples [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]

These are only suggestions to work from, and will not necessarily be applicable at all bosses or situations. For boss-specific rotations, see their respective guides.

​

Starting Unlocks:

⬥ Ring of Vigour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] or its passive effect after [https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction Extinction quest]

⬥ Greater Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409580420374568.png?v=1 gdeathsswiftcodex] or Planted Feet perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf]

⬥ Shadow Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]

⬥ Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409587110293665.png?v=1 gricocodex] in later examples

Area-of-Effect (AoE)

⬥ Decimation Special Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] is ranged's most powerful and versatile AoE tool

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moderate 3-tile AoE search range with no cooldown, a minor adrenaline cost, and can be set up before enemies spawn

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Combo with powerful abilities like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to quickly deal with AoE scenarios

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every additional hit counts for the purposes of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] adrenaline gain, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] stack generation, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] reduction on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] cooldown

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] is not active, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] can be an adrenaline-efficient way to make use of the effect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Most often used from an Essence of Finality amulet (EoF) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] to allow use with higher tier weapons

​

⬥ Bombardment [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] can be used to quickly deal with low life point targets

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upfront damage that doesn't require a prior ability cast to set up, but has more restrictive 2-tile AoE search range

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Outclassed by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if enemies would live for 3 or more abilities, or are spread further apart from each other

Sustaining with Ranged

⬥ Ranged has to frequently lock itself out of healing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] or inflict self-damage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] in order to maximise damage output

⬥ To plan around a lack of sustain, consider the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise lossless defensive and healing tools [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] as your first resort

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiarise yourself with boss mechanics to anticipate periods of heavy or little incoming damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Optionally introduce [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] into rotations after becoming comfortable at a boss

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Leave a few abilities of downtime in between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to give yourself a chance to heal up

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It is mainly important that it overlaps with your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] pattern

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drop [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if unable to maintain sufficient [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] uptime for it to be worthwhile i.e. during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] twinshot

Utilising Stalls in Combat

Multiple ranged abilities provide a duration-based buff that starts counting down when they are cast/released. Therefore, we can stall these abilities and release with the next ability to "extend" their buffs and gain other benefits.

​

⬥ Ranged usually has to exit its attack range in order to stall, which can be challenging depending on the situation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Therefore, it will typically only be recommended to use these tricks if the boss allows you to

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

⬥ Some guides require sharing an action bar to go alongside them, but it can be difficult to make in-game if you don't have spare action bars, or if you don't have the required abilities to do so unlocked.

⬥ A couple of tools have been developed that make this process easier.

​

Ability Bar Builder

⬥ Try it here: [https://pvme.github.io/ability-bar-builder/ https://pvme.github.io/ability-bar-builder/]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/H3MDTbTKzK.png Guide illustration] ⬥ This tool (created by Contributor name unavailable) allows you to quickly create custom revolution bars that you can then take screenshots of, or directly export as .png.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can then send it to [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)] to get a image link to use in guides generated.

⬥ To use it, simply click on an ability bar slot and choose an ability to go there.

⬥ You can use the toggles above to change the bar length, toggle the yellow outline on/off, and remove the white number icons.

​

Revo Bar Tool

Note: This tool may sometimes be down (towards the end of a month), due to excessive traffic.

​

⬥ Try it here: [https://revocalc.fly.dev/ https://revocalc.fly.dev/]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/50aZhme.png Guide illustration] ⬥ This tool was created by Contributor name unavailable and allows you to create custom revolution bars, similar to the Ability Bar Builder.

⬥ To use it, drag and drop abilities from the menus above into the bar. To clear a slot on the bar, simply drag out the ability from it.

⬥ You can also simulate using the revolution bar in combat, to compare its long-term sustained DPS with other bars.

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⬥ A banner summarising key information about a monster should be used atop every guide (or section, if there are multiple like an elite dungeon).

​

⬥ Please note, all banners are stored in the [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OGM9MBUG2bQVbHxlm86Xfs60soFcjINSOrPv1WL3Vgw/edit#gid=1657882095 PvME Spreadsheet]. Check here before creating one, and if you create one let us know in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)] so it can be added to the sheet.

​

⬥ Head to [https://pvme.io/banner-builder/ https://pvme.io/banner-builder/] to start creating your first banner, in your browser, with no design knowledge required!

​

⬥ If you need help, however big or small please ask for help in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)].

​

⬥ Key information about banners:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They are sized with the ratio 12w x 5h and a minimum of 300px in height

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They have the following components:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A blurry background representing the arena/area the monster lives in

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The name picture of the monster

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The monster's size (2x2, 5x5 etc)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Whether poison can be used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Which weapon the monster is vulnerable to

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Whether familiar damage can be used

​

Instructions for manual banner creation

⬥ In some situations (for example, the entire the entire internet falls to robots) you may need to create banners manually

​

⬥ Manual creation will work in any app that supports transparency, for example:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Photoshop

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gravit.io

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• PowerPoint

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Paint.net

Step 1: Create a blurry background and add the boxes

  1. Save [https://img.pvme.io/images/x5oFrjy7Kx.png this template file] to your machine and open it in your chosen editor

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Note: If using PowerPoint, unlock aspect ratio to fix pixel dimensions, then type the pixel value into the boxes that say "cm/inch" (e.g. "1440px")

  1. In-game, visit the monster's area and use the Freecam or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Orb_of_oculus Orb of oculus] to find a nice backdrop for your banner

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Note: A darker environment [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skyboxes_and_filters skybox] will usually make the banner look cleaner - experiment!

  1. Screenshot the chosen area, and copy the image into your editor

  2. Re-order your objects so the background is behind/under the template you started with

  3. Crop the background image to the same size as the template

  4. Add a strong blur effect to the background image so you can still see the general vibe of the area but not the details

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Note: If using PowerPoint, right-click image → Picture corrections → Sharpness (-70 to -90%)

​

Good job! You should now have a banner that looks something like below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wMPYOsxghY.png Guide illustration] ​

Step 2: Add the monster's name and image

  1. [https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Russo+One Download the Russo One font] and install it to your machine

  2. Open and copy [https://img.pvme.io/images/av8OFsrGoq.png this guide layer] into your editor

  3. Staying within the red lines, add a text box (start with font size 102px) and enter the boss' name

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Note: If the monster has a long name, reducing the font-size is okay as long as it stays within the red lines

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Note: If using PowerPoint, you will need to eyeball the font-size rather than use pixel font-sizes

  1. Centre the boss' name horizontally in the middle of the white boxes (it should be off-centre to the left)

  2. Get the image of the monster from the Runescape Wiki:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Open the Runescape Wiki, navigate to the monster's page

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Click on the main image - it should maximise the image file

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c. Right-click download this image

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎d. Import it into your editor (note: this is an important step in some editors, as copying sometimes loses the transparent background)

  1. Move the monster's image to the empty space on the right, and resize as appropriate

  2. You can now safely hide or delete the red guide layer

​

Good job! You should now have a banner that looks something like below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4DdX0AEOHn.png Guide illustration] ​

Step 3: Add the summary boxes

  1. Now comes the fiddly part! Copy in the relevant icons from the below list to the remaining white boxes, ensuring they are centred within their box.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎a. Note: The only non-icon box is the bottom-left, where you will need to use the same font as before to type in the boss' size (start with font size 53px)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎b. Note: You should be able find the boss' size in a table on the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Seren_godbow#Recommended_bosses Seren godbow Wiki page]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎c. Note: If using PowerPoint, the align tools are under "Arrange"

​

⬥ Icons (download or copy these into the editor as required):

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/XWT3opBawS.png Box 3 - Inquisitor Staff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/AgiCM4irg5.png Box 3 - Hexhunter Bow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/9p8Vgvlnr6.png Box 3 - Terrasaur Maul]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/aaZzcDbzQ1.png Box 3 - Omni guard]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/mBlPRJIESa.png Box 4 - Familiar]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/3e7tQSVVvV.png Tick]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://img.pvme.io/images/1i1nfMnNwt.png Cross]

​

Good job! You should now have a finished banner that looks something like below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ln64exSIhj.png Guide illustration] ​

Manual creation video tutorial

For a video tutorial, see [https://youtu.be/2pYVji_k0DY here]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/2pYVji_k0DY Embedded guide video]

​

pages.comment: Attributed pinned PvME snapshot 074a9438f79d10fba75735791be0030734db8b5e; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Note: This editor guide applies to AFK bossing, not slayer or low-effort methods.

​

Get your priorities straight

AFK methods must:

  1. Be safe (rare chance of death)

  2. Be consistent (every hour is similar)

  3. Be easy to follow (no questions needed in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)])

​

AFK methods may:

  1. Encourage maximum KPH

  2. Require minimum gear

  3. Have low upkeep costs

​

Building an AFK setup

Note: This section only applies to AFK bossing - not AFK slayer.

​

There are a couple of things to note:

⬥ Abilities should ideally be fired in the exact same order every kill

⬥ Some bosses take longer than others to start a fight

​

You can improve consistency by reducing RNG:

⬥ Removing critical strike boosters, e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring]

⬥ Disable pocket slot books [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut]

​

You can make kill times slower by:

⬥ downgrading prayers, e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] → nothing

⬥ removing extra-DPS gear/items, e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1449363594495135776.png?v=1 nodonspikeharness] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1276946271424479234.png?v=1 primalabyssalarmourspikes]

⬥ downgrading gear, e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189297659940904.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavochood] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643847068103737354.png?v=1 masterworkhelm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073883114797010974.png?v=1 bandoshelm]

⬥ downgrading spells / ammo

​

You can make kill times faster by doing the opposite, plus:

⬥ adding poison, e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]

⬥ adding a DPS familiar, e.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch]

​

Sometimes during testing, two people have different results. Try this first to identify the differences (tag @Editing Staff if you can't figure it out or get into a disagreement and need support):

⬥ Share screenshots of your buff bar, worn equipment, perks and familiar window

​

Breaking the bar: an example of AFK method writing

Sometimes, our bar "breaks" during testing and we need to adjust - let's walk through an example together and how we might solve it:

⬥ The first ability is [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] (which has a 1-minute cooldown)

⬥ You kill the boss at 28s, then wait another 27s for the next boss to respawn ("fastest" instance)

⬥ The arena spawns the 2nd boss at 55s... and your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] is still on cooldown... oops!

​

At this point we should note - some bosses take longer than others to start the fight, so this might not be an issue. But let's assume for this example that the boss would have started attacking you immediately at the start of the fight.

​

You have two options: remove [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] or try to slow down the kill by a few seconds. Let's do the latter!

​

There are several ways to slow down a fight, and you can try any combination of these to find the sweet spot:

⬥ If you are far off the mark, adjust the ability bar

​

In our above [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] example:

⬥ We're pretty close, so won't update the ability bar yet

⬥ We will downgrade prayer from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil]

⬥ We will remove the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1449363594495135776.png?v=1 nodonspikeharness]

⬥ We will switch from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943630520350.png?v=1 championring] to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod]

​

Et voila! We are now up to consistent 30s kill times.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide will cover creating icons for our Discord forums, such as the below examples:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/v6TiG5kkgZ.png Guide illustration] ​

Creating using web app

Link to the tool
⬥ [https://pvme.io/forum-icon-builder https://pvme.io/forum-icon-builder]
Finding problems?
⬥ If you have any issues, contact Nick (@neonx222) ⬥ Do not sit struggling alone!

​

Steps

  1. Grab the background image of the boss you're looking for

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. If using [https://runescape.wiki/ https://runescape.wiki] then:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Do not right-click the image on the NPC's main page (it is low quality/size)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Instead, click on the image and download the full-size version

​

  1. Once added into the web app, you can move (by dragging) and zoom (by scrolling) the background image

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Try to make the background image in the bottom-right

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Scroll through forum images to get an idea of the style

​

  1. Download your file by clicking the create icon ‎button

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Your icon should be a .png ‎file - if not, use a converter tool online first such as [https://cloudconvert.com/webp-to-png https://cloudconvert.com/webp-to-png]

​

  1. Edit the relevant forum inside [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/689575078698287152 Bot test (external Discord)] by typing /forum edit ‎and following the instructions

​

  1. Et voila! It's that simple.

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

⬥ Try it for yourself: [https://pvme.github.io/guide-editor/ https://pvme.github.io/guide-editor/]

⬥ The PvME Guide Editor, developed by @pleb0025, is a comprehensive editor tool to accelerate guide making for PvME.

⬥ It is the recommended way to write guides, as it makes it easier to check them with the live preview, and prevent issues from occurring with the help of the integrated error checker.

⬥ Additionally, the /files ‎bot command offers the ability to open any current guide directly in the guide editor.

​

Editor Layout

⬥ When you open the website you'll see the a layout similar to the following.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zr62id2.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Input Text is where your input text goes.

⬥ Discord Preview is a live preview of what it will look like in discord.

⬥ Error Checker displays any formatting and syntax errors in your text that need to be corrected.

⬥ The Formatting Bar contains tools to help you format your input text.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Covered in detail below.

​

Formatting Bar

⬥ The formatting bar at the top contains tools to help format your input text.

Text Formatting

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WcekSyf.png Guide illustration] ⬥ B I U S - Bold, italicize, underline, and strike through.

⬥ H1 - Indents, bolds and underlines paragraph.

⬥ H2 - Bolds and underlines paragraph.

​

Lists and Code

[https://img.pvme.io/images/H8jz5KQ.png Guide illustration] ⬥ 2 buttons on the left - Reformats selected text as bulleted and numbered lists, respectively.

⬥ 2 buttons on the right - Reformat selected text as inline code and as a code block respectively.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HUYXf3K.png Guide illustration] ​

Commands and Templates

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YpdbuKa.png Guide illustration]

Misc. Buttons

[https://img.pvme.io/images/rYEb2gj.png Guide illustration]

⬥ <|> - Toggles automatically scrolling of the live preview to the bottom of the preview (mimics guide channels in the discord).

⬥ 👁 - Toggles the live preview on/off, useful for reducing lag when writing very long guides.

⬥ ? - Shows formatting shortcuts and features, and instructions for the editor.

⬥ ⓘ - Some quick links for editors may use, as well as the GitHub issues tab for this website editor for any updates that are in the works.

​

Input Text

⬥ Use the left box for input text to write the raw content for your guides.

⬥ There is a live preview on the right, as shown in the layout image above.

⬥ See the question mark ? button on the top right of the web editor for tips to make editing a little quicker.

​

Error Checker

⬥ If any style or formatting errors are present in your guide, then they will be listed here.

⬥ The checker is the same as the one used during pull requests on GitHub, so if you see any errors here, fix them before submitting it!

​

Video Tutorial

If you prefer to watch a video guide, then see the following tutorial by @trackandxc: [https://youtu.be/LQWuufctPLA https://youtu.be/LQWuufctPLA]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide will cover creating and editing:

  1. Emojis used in PvME's guides - [https://pvme.io/pvme-settings/#emojis https://pvme.io/pvme-settings/#emojis]

  2. Icons used in the Preset Maker - [https://pvme.github.io/preset-maker/ https://pvme.github.io/preset-maker/]

​

Requirements
Take note of these before you start.
Interface scaling
⬥ Ensure both system and RuneScape interface scaling are set to 100%.     • System display scaling can be found under [https://img.pvme.io/images/XspEfnR9K5.png System > Display > Scale] for Windows users.     • RuneScape interface scaling can be found under [https://img.pvme.io/images/4wusRQznyv.png Settings > Graphics > Interface Scaling]. ​
Manual emoji creation/Image editing
⬥ [https://www.getpaint.net/download.html#download Paint.net] or better image editing software downloaded. ​
Emoji/icon creation by script
⬥ [https://www.python.org/downloads/ Python] installed. ⬥ Internet connection. ⬥ [https://www.getpaint.net/download.html#download Paint.net] is still highly recommended to manually edit or make icons where the script fails. ​
Raw input picture requirements
⬥ In game interfaces MUST have 0% transparency. ⬥ Must [https://img.pvme.io/images/DneowCezKn.png look clear when zoomed in] (affected by interface scaling)​

Icon formatting

Every icon consists of 4 parts:

  1. The main item - Colour varies, never contains the same shade as the outline and shadow.

  2. The outline - A black border that immediately surrounds the main item (RGB value 0,0,2).

  3. The shadow - A black border that appears bottom-right of the outline where applicable (RGB value 0,0,1).

  4. (Only for stackable items) The number (RGB value 255,255,0).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Numbers have their own shadows.

​

Image showing different regions selected:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/tHGKxIrkby.png Guide illustration]

Preset icons are extracted from inventory slots pictures (38x34) and contains all icon parts.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Yv2AN2KqdH.png Guide illustration]

Emojis are extracted from bank pictures and have shadows and numbers removed. They are also cropped to size.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ZlC9E1hWBh.png Guide illustration]

RSWiki icons

⬥ All preset icons should be made via the script or manually, and not based on RSWiki icons.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Emojis can be made from RSWiki icons based on conditions below.

​

⬥ The source of the icon determines whether you can use the RSWiki icon as an emoji.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Icons which are prepared by users and accurately reflects how they appear in the game can be used.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the icon is prepared by a bot. It is most likely a Java icon which do not reflect how the icon looks like in the live game.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/TgSLjZRTq9.png Guide illustration]

Icon creation (script)

Currently, the script only works for screen grabs of the inventory section when banking or of the GE buy interface.

​

Setting up

⬥ Download the script here: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lLI6X3hAx-IebShGFe1jxbCZgGOzJ60-/view?usp=sharing https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lLI6X3hAx-IebShGFe1jxbCZgGOzJ60-/view?usp=sharing]

⬥ Move the script to a desired directory.

⬥ Run the script to set up the folders required.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Let the script to install the Pillow Python package if not installed (required for Python to manipulate images).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DO NOT RENAME THE CREATED FOLDERS.

[https://youtu.be/PG19o3AzfCc https://youtu.be/PG19o3AzfCc]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/PG19o3AzfCc Embedded guide video]

Making icons/emojis

⬥ Take screen grabs of items from the inventory section of the banking interface (example below) and save it in "Inventory screengrabs" as a .png file.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To make emojis instead of preset icons: add a "_emoji" suffix to the name of the screengrab.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/0nBdPW5cuc.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Navigate back and run "Make icon.py"

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Check that the quantities printed in the terminal are correct.

⬥ Check "Generated emojis" for emojis and "Generated preset icons" for preset icons.

⬥ Use "Archive images.py" to archive all images after they have been added.

⬥ Example video of basic/icon creation:

[https://youtu.be/81FjnkxgNoQ https://youtu.be/81FjnkxgNoQ]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/81FjnkxgNoQ Embedded guide video]

Icon creation (manual)

⬥ Take a screen grab of an item from an opaque bank interface (for emojis) or opaque inventory slot (for preset icons)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Your bank background should be uniformly coloured to facilitate background removal.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Items on the Grand Exchange and preset interface have their outlines removed and cannot be used as a source for emojis.

​

Manual icon creation

  1. Open the item you want to make an icon of in Paint.net, crop it as nicely as possible.

  2. Zoom in and crop the inventory slot exactly using rectangle select (this should give you a 38x34 area).

  3. Use the crop to selection option under Image.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + X.

  1. Select the Magic Wand and Rectangle select/Lasso select tools to select and delete regions until the background is completely removed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Use Shift + Click with the Magic Wand on 0% tolerance on the background to quickly select chunks of regions.

[https://youtu.be/ZjdWPbp4YUo https://youtu.be/ZjdWPbp4YUo]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZjdWPbp4YUo Embedded guide video]

Manual emoji creation

  1. Open the item you want to make an icon of in Paint.net, crop it as nicely as possible.

  2. Select the Magic Wand tool on 0% tolerance and use Shift + Click followed by Delete on the background.

  3. Repeat the previous step for shadow and number pixels.

  4. If removing number pixels, ensure that the number or its shadow do not cover the icon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Post in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)] if there is no way to get the complete unnumbered icon or visit the Image stacking section below.

  1. Use the Magic Wand again to select the transparent background, press Ctrl + I followed by Ctrl + Shift + X to crop the image to size

[https://youtu.be/9oiHOuCO89U https://youtu.be/9oiHOuCO89U]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/9oiHOuCO89U Embedded guide video]

Image stacking

If you're trying to emoji-fy a stackable item (check if icon is available on wiki first) and cannot get a whole icon due to the number partially covering it, you can stack multiple incomplete images (made by removing different numbers) to form a complete image.

​

⬥ The most efficient quantities you can use for stacking are not yet known, but generally:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Items without varying icons based on quantity (e.g. teleport tabs), use quantities 1, 7 and 9.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Items with varying icons throughout numbers 1-5 (e.g. Bakriminel bolts), use quantities 11, 44, 77 and 99.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Items with varying icons throughout 1-1000 (e.g. congealed blood), use numbers 1111, 2222, 7777 and 9999.

​

Stacking with the script

  1. Save an image consisting multiple inventories with different quantities of the same item(s) you want stacked.

  2. Run "Make icon.py" to generate the incomplete emojis.

  3. Create respective folders starting with "stack" followed by the item name and sort the incomplete emojis into their respective folders.

  4. Run "Stack.py" to create the stacked icons.

[https://youtu.be/MCmgf2WiOeY https://youtu.be/MCmgf2WiOeY]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MCmgf2WiOeY Embedded guide video]

Manual stacking

  1. Have images consisting different quantities of the item(s) you want stacked open in different windows.

  2. Carry out removal of background, shadows, and quantities.

  3. Paste the incomplete emojis onto different layers and merge them to get the complete emoji(s).

[https://youtu.be/yM61GooZZco https://youtu.be/yM61GooZZco]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/yM61GooZZco Embedded guide video]

Known issues

⬥ Currently, there is not a standardised method for auras and other icons (e.g. buffs, debuffs).

⬥ If your inventory slots (from the banking interface) are not completely uniform, the script will not be able to recognise them as inventory slots.

⬥ The script uses the complete frames of the inventory slot to identify them: [https://imgur.com/CCfr7dG https://imgur.com/CCfr7dG], [https://imgur.com/ypnZCL3 https://imgur.com/ypnZCL3].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If an item has its shadow and/or outline invading the inventory slot, the frame will not be recognised and the item will not be extracted.

Examples:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/MmKQxc25gA.png Guide illustration]

Submitting completed icons

Preset icons - Upload the icon to https://img.pvme.io/ ‎(via [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)]), copy the item link, and fill in this template for each item to submit via pasting it to Referenced guide unavailable in this snapshot:

name:
image:
slot:
label:
breakdownNotes:
wikiLink:

Fields explanations:

⬥ name: ‎The item name as displayed on the RSWiki.

⬥ image: ‎The raw https://img.pvme.io/ ‎link.

⬥ slot: ‎Numbers 0 to 13 which decides where the item can be equipped.

INVENTORY = 0

HELM = 1

BODY = 2

LEGS = 3

MH_WEAPON = 4

OH_WEAPON = 5

GLOVES = 6

BOOTS = 7

AURA = 8

AMMO = 9

NECKLACE = 10

RING = 11

CAPE = 12

POCKET = 13

⬥ label: ‎The name: ‎of the item with all lower-case and no spacing OR an acceptable abbreviation.

⬥ breakdownNotes: ‎Default text that appears in item breakdown when an item is picked. This is usually left blank.

⬥ wikiLink: ‎Link to the item on RSWiki.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure the link is valid.

​

Examples:

name: Abyssal scourge
image: https://img.pvme.io/images/Moh9yya.png
slot: 4
label: abyssalscourge
breakdownNotes:
wikiLink: https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_scourge

​

name: Black stone arrows
image: https://img.pvme.io/images/uBbMQoy.png
slot: 9
label: bsa100
breakdownNotes:
wikiLink: https://runescape.wiki/w/Black_stone_arrows

Emojis - Once done creating the emoji(s), use Ctrl + A + Ctrl + C to copy the cropped image (if made manually) or drag and drop saved emojis into Referenced guide unavailable in this snapshot along with the item names.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide will cover creating tile-based maps for our guides, such as the below examples:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/8tY6vB0VH7.png Guide illustration] ​

Method 1: Creating using web app

Link to the tool
⬥ [https://pvme.io/tilemap-maker https://pvme.io/tilemap-maker]
Finding problems?
⬥ If you have any issues, contact Nick (@neonx222) ⬥ Do not sit struggling alone!

​

Method 2: Creating via coding

Link to the tool
⬥ [https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1OfiHQwIhKCfCJxgHCjXNiteoMJqVX6Yr?usp=sharing Map Generator on Google Colab]
Finding problems?
⬥ If you have any issues, contact Chrash (@chrash.) ⬥ Do not sit struggling alone!

​

Step 1

1.1 Run the first code section by clicking the first play button

[https://img.pvme.io/images/iSHbmxoSrX.png Guide illustration] ​

Step 2

2.1. Scroll down to the second code section and edit the variables between the two lines of #########​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fCvNMZwNGs.png Guide illustration]

Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Check Referenced guide unavailable in this snapshot first for already created maps and variables sets to save you time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. You can find map chunks by visiting [https://mejrs.github.io/ https://mejrs.github.io/]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Turn on the grid layer by hovering over the icon in the bottom-right

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you struggle to find a specific area the RS Wiki has a [https://runescape.wiki/w/RuneScape:Map/mapIDs page listing common locations] - simply replace the -1 ‎in the mej URL to the corresponding map ID

​

2.2. If unsure about the coloured tile markings, enter a number around where you think for player/cannon etc, then tweak and re-run the code

​

2.3. Choose how many tiles to trim off each side of the image (left,upper,right,bottom)

​

2.4. Select which legend to use from the listed options

​

2.5. Remove the # ‎from any lines you have set (any lines with a # ‎will not be executed)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/88RSQ8Bnvb.png Guide illustration] ​

Step 3

3.1. Run the main code

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hN8YQKzJWk.png Guide illustration] 3.2. Wait for the code to execute - you can track its progress at the bottom of your browser

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JOBeROCphO.png Guide illustration] ​

Step 4

4.1. Scroll to the very bottom of the page to view your created map and right click > save ‎when happy, or scroll back up and tweak the variables if it's not right

​

Real example

The objective: make a player position map for the new Osseous AFK guide.

​

First we find the Rex Matriarch arena (we've had to scroll across Mej's map to find it):

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4bOVcYUEIk.png Guide illustration] ​

Next, we add map gridlines on so we know which map chunks to reference:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/XwdQIAu7uv.png Guide illustration] ​

Now we want to reduce the map to just the Osseous arena (highlighted by the yellow box), which crosses multiple map chunks.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EJXkK2pB4r.png Guide illustration] ​

First we set the x and y values to be of the top tile (63,153)

mej_x = 63
mej_y = 153

​

Next let's make it so 2 tiles are shown vertically

mej_height = 2
mej_width = 1

​

If we ran the code now, it would give us this:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UDpjeF4nPZ.png Guide illustration] ​

Let's trim off the sides and press the run button to check our map:

left = 1
upper = 43
right = 21
lower = 43

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xb7wjGpZut.png Guide illustration] ​

It's almost there! Let's cut off some of that excess map, put a coloured tile for the player position, and set the legend to show just 'player position':

[https://img.pvme.io/images/A76Rk7HV0P.png Guide illustration] ​

Now let's hit the run button again... we did it!

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Dys4yLDFqW.png Guide illustration] ​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

The PvME Preset Maker is a website used for creating presets in the standard PVME format. It is the preferred way to display presets in guides.

​

This guide only covers how to use the tool. For full preset formatting, please see [[PvME/Contributing/Style Guide|Style Guide]] or reference any of the other guides in PvME where presets are used.

​

The Preset Maker can be found here: [https://pvme.github.io/preset-maker/ https://pvme.github.io/preset-maker/]

​

If a desired item is not available, request for it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)]

​

Preset Maker Layout

⬥ When you open the Preset Maker, you'll see the following layout.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to create a New Preset by clicking the New Preset button if making a new preset.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/kWUpaX5GjO.png Guide illustration] ⬥ There are 2 buttons shown at the top right.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• IMPORT JSON - Allows you to import preset items and notes via an uploaded JSON file.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• EXPORT JSON - Allows you to export preset items and notes as a downloaded JSON file.

⬥ The GENERATE SHAREABLE LINK button produces a link to use in guides which saves all items and notes.

⬥ The SAVE NEW PRESET buttons saves the displayed preset and breakdown which can be loaded when the website is opened again on the same browser.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Tih0Kzi13s.mp4 Source media]

⬥ The RESET button erases all data in the displayed preset.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JyXbC3krgg.mp4 Source media]

⬥ The COPY IMAGE TO CLIPBOARD and COPY BREAKDOWN TO CLIPBOARD buttons copies the preset and breakdown as images respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This facilitates fast uploading of images to [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)], or [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/689575078698287152 Bot test (external Discord)].

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nQO9WEgEZZ.mp4 Source media]

​

Creating a Preset

⬥ Click on an slot in the preset interface. Use the search bar to find the desired item to assign it with.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/a1xc1Ca.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Your last 5 unique entries will be displayed in the Recent Items: section.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This speeds up filling multiple inventory slots with the same item e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593742291033.png?v=1 blueblubber] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1 spiritualprayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974503666352525312.png?v=1 portentofrestorationx]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/8GQfprD.png Guide illustration]

⬥ You can also use the multi-select feature by holding [SHIFT] when selecting the slots, as shown in the video below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dYhrbS86tW.mp4 Source media]

​

Adding Preset to Guide

⬥ After you are finished with the preset and breakdown, upload to cloud by the Menu dropdown (wait for the green confirmation message), then generate the shareable link (wait for the green confirmation message) and paste the result in the link section of the preset embed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click on the link in the guide editor to check that it is working. It may take a bit to load.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/c9abKcCH9l.mp4 Source media] == Attribution and source history == Adapted from [https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/editor-resources/editor-references/preset-maker/ Preset Maker] by PvME contributors. pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

The PVMe Spreadsheet is a Google Sheet document that is used to store dynamic information for use in guides. This includes things like prices of items, values of invention components, calculating boss revenue, etc. which can change over time. This guide is a brief overview of the sheet, and how you can use data from it in your guides.

​

The spreadsheet can be found at the following link.

PvME Spreadsheet
Check out the PvME Spreadsheet [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OGM9MBUG2bQVbHxlm86Xfs60soFcjINSOrPv1WL3Vgw/ here]. You can make a copy for own use, but it will not affect any PvME guides.

Note: Data in guides is only pulled from the master copy of the sheet. To modify existing data, or add new data, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)].

​

PvME Spreadsheet Layout

⬥ When you open the spreadsheet, you will see the following sheets at the bottom:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/u0WjDXv.png Guide illustration] ⬥ These tabs correspond to different categories of items/etc. within the game for data is present/calculated for use in the guides:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prices: sheet that contains and periodically fetches/updates GE prices of items.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bosses: used to calculate earnings for [[PvME/Combat reference/Boss Revenue|Boss Revenue]].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Slayer: used to calculate earnings for [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Slayer Slayer guides].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Perks: used to calculate cost of Invention components and perks for [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocks: prices of unlockable items found in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Permanent Unlocks|Permanent Unlocks]].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Miscellaneous: some misc. prices and calculations.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Consumables: prices of consumable items found in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Consumables|Consumables]].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mastery: outdated sheet, kept for historic/reference purposes.

⬥ To access a specific piece of information, only two things are required: the sheet name and named range.

​

Using Spreadsheet Data In Guides

⬥ Using data from the spreadsheet in a guide is very straightforward.

⬥ Values from the sheet can be accessed using the following command: data_pvme:<sheet>_<namedrange>, replacing the contents of <sheet> ‎and <namedrange> ‎with the sheet name and named range respectively.

⬥ When posted (by the PvME Bot), the command text will get replaced by the value present in that cell.

​

⬥ For example, the following sentence might be in a guide:

Greater Chain <:gchain:1257440278512537740> is a very powerful ability, but is also quite expensive, costing <:coins:698816156961603654> $data_pvmе:unlock_gchain$.

⬥ When posted by the bot, it will look like the following:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KQeL5Dq.png Guide illustration] Note: The command syntax can also be found in the Commands dropdown menu in the web guide editor tool.

​

Requesting Changes/Additions

⬥ Anyone can make a copy of the sheet for personal use, but only data from the master sheet will be referenced by the bot.

⬥ To request any changes or additions to the sheet, use the [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)] channel.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

⬥ The Rotation Builder is a tool that was developed by @pleb0025 to make writing rotations for guides easier.

⬥ Try it for yourself here: [https://pvme.github.io/rotation-builder/ https://pvme.github.io/rotation-builder/]

​

Rotation Builder Layout

⬥ When you open the website you'll see the a layout similar to the following.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/bigtPP9.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Input Text is where your input text goes.

⬥ Output is a live output of the emojis from your input text.

⬥ Copy Options allow you to copy the text in a couple different output options.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Copy Discord copies the text as it would be input for a guide in PvME.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Copy Draw.io copies the raw HTML for import into draw.io (a free online tool that helps make flowcharts, diagrams, etc.)

​

Input Text

⬥ When typing the name or alias of an emoji from [https://pvme.io/pvme-settings/#emojis https://pvme.io/pvme-settings/#emojis], the website will automatically display it as an emoji instead of text.

⬥ For example, typing the raw input text gbarge → assault → deci → destroy ‎will yield the following output:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/7x5KPtM.png Guide illustration] ⬥ More examples of how to format input are given on the website.

​

Saving Output

⬥ To save it as an image: please screenshot only the output section.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A picture of the rotation looks cleaner and is more easily shared with people than a ton of emoji text IDs.

⬥ To use emojis directly in a guide: use the Copy Discord button and paste the copied text into your guide.

⬥ Copying the data for draw.io: follow the tutorial given at the bottom of the website.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WlrWVGRvQC.png Guide illustration] ​

Contributing in its Simplest Form

Making a post in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]. Someone else can see that post and turn it into the edit you want to see added to PvME. For example:

⬥ Pointing out typos/rotation changes in guides

⬥ Writing down strategies for a guide that doesn't exist yet

​

The First Steps of Using PvME's Editor Tools

These are the most commonly used tools that are used by editors who want to be a bit more involved in making their edits happen:

⬥ [https://pvme.io/guide-editor/ https://pvme.io/guide-editor/]:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is the most important tool editors use. It lets them visualise what the text would look like in discord.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Check out [[PvME/Contributing/Guide Editor|Guide Editor]] for a tutorial on how to use it, or [https://youtu.be/cPWgpRLsqGU a youtube video showing off how easy it is to use]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can load the guide's text content into the guide editor by using the /files ‎command in discord and searching for the guide you want to edit, and clicking on the guide editor link the bot responds with.

⬥ [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/771436827214086154 Guide media upload and request (external Discord)]:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A simple command /upload ‎is all it takes to turn your picture into a usable link.

​

What to Edit

Unsure of how you can contribute? Here's some ideas:

⬥ Check out [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1152990486714388622 Editing jobs (external Discord)] and click the Easy ‎tag at the top of the page as shown here: [https://img.pvme.io/images/Fyfjxwn5W3.png https://img.pvme.io/images/Fyfjxwn5W3.png] [https://img.pvme.io/images/Fyfjxwn5W3.png Guide illustration]

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• That should filter the channel to only show jobs that are deemed as easy and open to everyone who wants to help out.

⬥ Finding mistakes in guides as you are reading them to learn a new pvm information for yourself

​

Asking for Help

Asking your editing questions in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)] is never a bad idea, but if you find yourself not getting answered, these are the people to ping:

⬥ Lead Editor

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @chrash.

​

⬥ Editing Staff

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @ferroric

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @rcm37

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @mionee.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @tinky1

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @.ndy

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Linie

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @neonx222

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cris

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @porfy

​

Next Steps

Once you feel comfortable with this calibre of editing, feel free to dive into [[PvME/Contributing/Intro To Editing Continued|Intro To Editing Continued]] to see some more advanced editing methods and tools.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Now that you are more familiar with the most basic and essential tools used for editing, this guide will outline the other tools commonly used in creating new guides from start to finish.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WlrWVGRvQC.png Guide illustration] ​

Essential Tools

These are tools that are used in almost every guide:

Note: Tutorials for all tools can be found in their respective forums in [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Contributing Contributor guides]

⬥ [https://pvme.io/guide-editor/ Guide Editor] - Has all text formatting tools built in, as well as the style guide rule set integrated.

⬥ [[PvME/Contributing/Style Guide|Style Guide]] - Has all of our formatting rules explained in great detail. This is built into the Guide Editor and will display any broken styling rules in the bottom-left window of the Guide Editor website.

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example: [https://img.pvme.io/images/hKXqQoi3fs.png https://img.pvme.io/images/hKXqQoi3fs.png] [https://img.pvme.io/images/hKXqQoi3fs.png Guide illustration]

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ There was an empty space after the last word on line 12, so the Guide Editor informed me to delete it.

⬥ [[PvME/Contributing/Templates|Templates]] - Has the skeleton structure for various guides/embeds pre-made so you can just copy paste and fill in blanks as needed to give you a head start on guide creation. This guide also has information on how to format text within embeds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: There are tools built into the Guide Editor that offer the same functionality

⬥ [https://pvme.io/preset-maker/ Preset Maker] - Used to provide a standardized UI so the layout looks the same across all guides.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click an inventory slot and type the name of an item to see it populate the slot.

⬥ [https://pvme.io/ability-bar-builder/ Ability Bar Builder] - Used for creating Revolution bars for AFK and Slayer guides.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click a slot on the bar and select an ability from the popup.

⬥ [https://pvme.io/rotation-builder/ Rotation Builder] - Has built-in autoformatting tools to turn common ability names into emoji code output which you can copy/paste into the guide editor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example: gbarge automatically becomes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] when typed into the rotation builder.

​

Niche Tools

These are the extra tools that editors can use to make their guides more pretty and refined:

Note: Tutorials for all tools can be found in their respective forums in [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Contributing Contributor guides]. If you are not comfortable using these tools, do your best to explain what is needed in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)] and ask someone else to make them for you to add to the guide later.

⬥ [[PvME/Contributing/Map Generation|Map Generation]] - Used for making map pictures with gridlines on them to mark exact tiles to place cannons/player standing spots/boss spawn locations.

⬥ [https://pvme.io/banner-builder/ Banner Builder] - Used for creating banners for every boss guide that describes their size and susceptibilities to things like poison or familiar damage.

⬥ [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pvme/pvme-guides/master/editor-resources/editor-references/hyperlinked-emojis.txt Hyperlinked Emojis] - A raw document of emoji codes that link the emoji item to the appropriate wiki page for the item.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example: Opening the website and using ctrl + F ‎to search for Ascension Crossbow ‎will show you a line that has this text: [Ascension crossbow](<https://runescape.wiki/w/Ascension_crossbow>) <:ascmh:513190158468775936>. If you copy paste that whole line and post it into the Guide Editor, it will display as [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ascension_crossbow Ascension crossbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468775936.png?v=1 ascmh].

⬥ [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1250465610903585000 Emoji Combinations (external Discord)] - A channel with content similar to Hyperlinked Emojis. It has quick access copy paste text for common combinations of emojis such as <:graspingpouchblack:1390439136875253810> <:bloodrune:536252658970001409> <:astralrune:536252658961481769> <:bodyrune:536252659301089280> <:soulrune:536252660333019136>, which will display in the Guide Editor as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439136875253810.png?v=1 graspingpouchblack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1 bloodrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658961481769.png?v=1 astralrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659301089280.png?v=1 bodyrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660333019136.png?v=1 soulrune].

⬥ [https://pvme.io/forum-icon-builder/ Forum Icon Builder] - Used for creating icons for our Discord forums.

​

Making a Guide From Start to Finish

Here's a quick overview of the steps taken to make guides from scratch:

  1. Open the Guide Editor.

  2. Click Templates.

  3. Select the guide you want to make. For this, I'll choose a standard guide.

  4. Create a banner for the boss using the [https://pvme.io/banner-builder/ Banner Builder], or ask someone in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)] to create one for you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. These are archived in the [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OGM9MBUG2bQVbHxlm86Xfs60soFcjINSOrPv1WL3Vgw/edit?gid=1657882095#gid=1657882095 PvME Spreadsheet] in the Art Resources ‎tab.

  1. Intro: Describe the boss where the template requests the info.

  2. Presets and Relics: Use the [https://pvme.io/preset-maker/ Preset Maker], or post your preset from in-game, describe the relics/niche items used, and ask someone in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)] to create the preset for you.

  3. Mechanics: Describe the mechanics where the template requests the info.

  4. The Fight: Describe an overview of the fight where the template requests the info.

  5. Rotations: Utilise the [https://pvme.io/rotation-builder/ Rotation Builder] to get your rotations written down quickly, then hit the copy discord ‎button. Then paste that copied output into this section of the guide editor.

  6. Example Kills: Put a couple youtube video links showcasing quality kills here

  7. Table of Contents: Click the Table of Contents ‎dropdown button and select Categorized. Click Copy, then paste that copied output at the bottom of the guide.

  8. Click Export to .txt file ‎and paste the copied output into [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)] which will upload as a file. Describe your guide in the suggestion and ask that someone uploads it to GitHub for you.

​

GitHub

If you want to learn about github to edit or upload guides directly on the source code, check out [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=github GitHub tutorials]

​

Asking for Help

Asking your editing questions in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/724129126314803230 Editors chat (external Discord)] is never a bad idea, but if you find yourself not getting answered, these are the people to ping:

⬥ Lead Editor

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @chrash.

​

⬥ Editing Staff

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @ferroric

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @rcm37

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @mionee.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @tinky1

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @.ndy

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Linie

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @neonx222

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cris

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• @porfy

​
