Settings Menu

The Settings menu is accessed through the Options menu in-game, reachable at any time by pressing Escape, and contains in-game settings that can be modified. Here, we cover several useful/important options that can be customised.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/iWprrL4oGa.png Guide illustration] ​

Gameplay Settings > Interfaces

These settings affect your screen area, visible interfaces and information, and general QoL.

⬥ Game Interaction > Mouseover tooltips

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep this on to make it easier to ensure your clicks land on their intended target

⬥ Game Interaction > Mouseover tooltip options

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shows the amount of extra options on hover, disable for less screen clutter

⬥ Game Interaction > Walk markers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Makes it easier to see where the character is moving when ground tiles are not visually clear, or when animation stalls occur (stalling abilities, delayed animations)

⬥ Game Interaction > Disable shortcuts to close windows

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prevent UI windows from being accidentally closed if keybound

⬥ Game Interaction > Slim headers / Hide title bars when locked

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reduces the space taken up by bulky title bars

⬥ Game Interaction > Extra potion info

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Show all effects of any potion being consumed

⬥ Information Windows > Slayer counter

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep open to see slayer task counts without needing a slayer helm or slayer gem. Can click the icon to toggle and show reaper tasks

⬥ Information Windows > Highlight boosted skills

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Show when skills are boosted above or drained below their usual values, useful to know when to re-apply boosts like overloads or notice stat drains from mechanics or items like saradomin brews

⬥ Information Windows > Boss kill/instance timers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shows the time since the start of the fight/instance, which can be used to keep track of mechanics

⬥ Warning Screens

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can disable warnings to enter certain areas quicker, such as the Wilderness. Can also add security features like item value warnings and requiring bank PINs on every login

⬥ Inventory > Drag-to-drop

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Disable this to prevent accidentally dropping valuable items

⬥ Inventory > Auto-teleport/destroy empty containers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• QoL for skilling

⬥ Buff Bar

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turn on everything to ensure you have all necessary buffs, and know if you are ever debuffed

​

Gameplay Settings > Combat & Action Bar

These settings affect your combat and gameplay experience concerning PvM.

⬥ Combat Mode > Familiar combat mode

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Set to attack same target to maximize the damage done by the familiar

⬥ Action Bar > Ability cooldown timer

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Choose between having the cooldown timer centered, or top right

⬥ Combat Mode > Ability queueing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ability queueing lets abilities be queued in advance, to activate once ready. This has both benefits and downsides

⬥ Action Bar > Additional action bars

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Have up to 4 extra on-screen action bars for more keybinds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More details in Keybinds and Action Bars section

⬥ Action Bar Binding

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bind action bars to weapon categories to automatically switch bars when swapping weapons

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More details in Keybinds and Action Bars section

⬥ Choose Option Menu > Player/NPC attack options

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Choose what click options are available for players and NPCs to avoid misclicks

⬥ Choose Option Menu > Hide familiar options

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prevent accidentally misclicking familiars during combat with things like bladed dive or intercept

⬥ Targeting > Target reticules

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Indicate what targets are selected (yellow circle) or aggroed to the player (red circle)

⬥ Targeting > Target scenery with targeted movement abilities

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Toggles the ability to Bladed Dive/Dive directly onto scenery. Turning this off will prevent you from diving onto scenery accidentally

⬥ Targeting > Target cycle settings

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Set up Target Cycle to target monsters with keybinds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target cycling can target monsters at precise times, switch between multiple targets rapidly in multi-target scenarios, and in some cases target monsters earlier than they normally would be attackable (e.g. any of the GWD2 bosses like Vindicta or Helwyr)

⬥ Hitsplats

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Customise hitsplat colours to distinguish between different hits in combat more effectively

​

Gameplay Settings > Camera

Settings to do with camera and camera movement.

⬥ System > Camera mode

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Different camera modes offer different levels of maximum zoom and rotation speed, it is recommended to use freedom mode for better visibility

⬥ System > Camera shake

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Toggle whether the camera shakes during cutscenes and certain PvM encounters

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Situationally useful - e.g. enable for ED2 (to see dragon special attacks easier), but disable for RotS (easier to escape tunnels without the shaking effect)

⬥ Loot System > Use area loot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Area loot opens up a menu to loot items, both opening the interface and looting items can be keybound

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be customised based on item quantities, types and values to determine what gets looted

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Useful to avoid accidentally missing loot on the floor

⬥ Loot Beams > Show loot beams

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Highlights items above a player-defined threshold with a customisable beam to avoid accidentally not picking them up

Controls

These settings are used to set all keybinds used within the game, affecting everything from action bar bindings to UI elements to hidden hotkeys. It is recommended to go through the controls set to ensure they are to your preference, but some of the less well-known keybinds that can be set are mentioned for convenience.

⬥ Quick prayer - this keybind toggles on/off all prayers set to quick prayer simultaneously

⬥ Target cycle - keybinds for target cycling

⬥ Special attack - can keybind weapon special attacks without having to sacrifice an ability bar slot*

⬥ Familiar action - can keybind familiar actions without having to sacrifice an ability bar slot*

⬥ Extra action button - can trigger extra action button effects (in fights like Solak or Zamorak) without clicking it

⬥ Area loot - open the area loot menu without moving

Note: Special attack and familiar action keybinds cannot be queued with ability queueing if set through the Controls tab. Use the action bar if queueing is required.

These settings affect the visual appearance of the game. Depending on your computer's specs, you can adjust these to improve the game's performance or increase the graphical fidelity of the game. Some useful ones are covered here, but more detailed explanations of all the options can be found on the RuneScape Wiki page about Graphics Settings.

⬥ Draw distance - the higher this setting, the more of the world is visible, but it can impact FPS on slower machines

Action Bars

Action bars are part of every player's interface containing slots that you can drag different actions to keybind. This section covers basic information about action bars, extra action bars, and action bar binding.

​

Action Bar Basics

Action bars have 14 slots that can be filled with a variety of actions, including but not limited to abilities, prayers, spells, and gear switches. To populate the bar, simply drag an action onto a slot on the bar.

Note: If this does not work, then your bar is locked. To unlock your action bar, click the golden lock icon on the primary bar (shown in the following picture).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/2AATN75VNi.png Guide illustration]

In addition to the ability slots, the primary action bar also displays:

⬥ Health - the red meter

⬥ Adrenaline - the yellow meter

⬥ Prayer points - the purple meter

⬥ Summoning points OR special move points - the green meter, click this to toggle it

Additionally, the four icons on the bar can be interacted with to enable some settings:

⬥ Clicking the heart icon will turn on regenerate which will enable once outside combat

⬥ Clicking the sword icon will toggle auto-retaliate mode on and off - when this is on, the icon will be replaced with a pair of cross swords

⬥ Right-clicking the prayer and summoning icons will let you set up quick prayers and configure a familiar action respectively

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These can then be activated by clicking on their respective icons, or keybinding them

⬥ The golden lock icon can be toggled to lock the action bars, this prevents changes being made to abilities on any bar

⬥ Right-clicking the cog will bring up access to combat settings and quickly change combat mode

​

Action Bar Presets

The number on any action bar indicates what preset for that bar is currently loaded. There are a total of 18 presets (10 in free-to-play). Adding an action to the action bar is sufficient to update the preset. The preset can then be loaded to any action bar by changing the number on that bar.

Note: clicking the number icon of the action bar will bring up a list of presets that can be loaded.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/prulhUMfss.png Guide illustration]

Action bar presets can be named in the settings found at Settings > Gameplay > Action Bar > Change Action Bar Preset Names.

​

Additional Action Bars

Additional action bars can be displayed by enabling them through Settings > Gameplay > Action Bar > Display Additional Action Bars. You can have up to four additional bars for a total of five on-screen at any given time.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/DEayN1PfPr.png Guide illustration]

Additional bars provide more slots to place actions for keybinding, reducing the number of things you need to manually click. They also facilitate easier switching of gear during combat and can overall improve your gameplay experience as you take time and familiarize yourself with your keybinds while playing.

​

Action Bar Binding

Action bars can be configured to switch automatically depending on the weapons equipped by the player, this settings can be found in Settings > Gameplay > Action Bar Binding. Both the primary and additional action bars can be bound, independent of one another if needed. Bindings can be made for when the following types of weapons are equipped:

⬥ only 2h weapons

⬥ only dual wield weapons

⬥ either 2h or dual wield weapons

​

Consider the following example:

⬥ Action bar preset number 1 → ability bar for 2h magic

⬥ Action bar preset number 2 → ability bar for dual wield magic

⬥ Action bar preset number 13 → additional ability bar for magic-related abilities and switches

We want our primary action bar to change based on our equipped weapons, and our secondary bar to change based on our equipped style.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/7Nrz4BVCCq.png Guide illustration]

In the above example, the first two binding setups change the primary action bar.

⬥ When equipping dual-wield magic weapons, it switches to preset number 1 (named Magic - Dual Wield)

⬥ When equipping two-handed magic weapons, it switches to preset number 2 (named Magic - Two-handed)

The third binding setup changes the additional action bar.

⬥ When equipping any magic weapons, it switches to preset number 13 (named Magic - Switches)

When set up correctly for multiple styles, it will look something like this:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/CAcj8vQaZO.mp4 Source media]

Keybinds

When it comes to setting up keybinds, some important points can help structure your keybinds and make them easier to incorporate into PvM. The goal is to make learning your keybinds less frustrating, and feel more natural to use. This is done by making a few decisions.

​

Keybind Tips

⬥ Keybinds should be easy to reach - moving your hands too far can make it difficult to find and press keys

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Consider placing your more frequently used binds closer at hand, and rarely-used ones further away

⬥ Bind similar items near each other

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overhead prayers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Food and brews

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon switches

⬥ Modifier keys can increase the number of binds available, at a cost - it is easier to press one key than two

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This affects things such as prayer switches which occur very often. For more information, look at Modifier Keys

Certain common rapid input sequences that are often used as your PvM progresses are worth considering when choosing binds. It is helpful to have easy-to-press keybinds sequences for such scenarios. An input such as q → w → r ‎is easier to press than something like q → ctrl+w → alt+r.

⬥ Examples of such input sequences:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spellbook swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1 sbslunars] + Disruption shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mainhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] + Offhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Solid food [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489363087360.png?v=1 sailfish] + Blubber [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593742291033.png?v=1 blueblubber] + Saradomin brew [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1 brew]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Roar switch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] + Ingen [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] + Soulfire spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + Omniguard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard]

⬥ Using an MMO mouse gives many easily accessible buttons to bind actions to

⬥ Using the middle mouse button for camera instead of keys frees up 4 keybinds

​

Modifier Keys.

Note: If you release the modifier before the key first, it will trigger the underlying key press. Keep this in mind when setting up modifier keys.

⬥ The Shift, Alt, and Ctrl keys can be used to modify keybinds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A, Shift+A, Ctrl+A ‎and Alt+A ‎would be four separate keybinds

⬥ This increases the range of available keybinds

⬥ If using a mouse, you can bind Modifier+Key ‎to a single mouse button, making it easier to press

​

⬥ Some gaming mice software may not work on all operating systems, especially Linux

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Logitech mouse users have an open-source option for Linux called logiops. Find it in your favourite distro's repository (e.g. Chaotic-Aur for Arch Linux users) or look at their repository at [https://github.com/PixlOne/logiops https://github.com/PixlOne/logiops]. Lastly, there are also other alternatives such as Piper for consideration

⬥ 4th bar: prayers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1 deflectnecromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] / constitution abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / aspects [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/q0H8z0u6gw.png Guide illustration] ​

Keybinds Guide

As a reference, check out this very well-thought-out guide to setting up the keybinds that can help you plan your keybinds.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zn_y-_2giZg https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zn_y-_2giZg]

​

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/zn_y-_2giZg Embedded guide video]

Banking & Presets

Bank organization is very much a subjective choice, and entirely up to your preference. There are some items that you may want to consider when sorting and placing in your tabs.

Bank Tabs

Having well-sorted bank tabs can make it easier to keep track of gear upgrades, and ensure you have enough supplies to last your bossing trips, which is especially relevant for group PvM, so you do not have to interrupt gameplay and slow your teammates by having to buy supplies during an hour.

⬥ PvM gear - armour, weapons, switches, jewellery, pouches, quivers, and other related items

⬥ Supplies for PvM - all kinds of food, potions, runes, ammunition, summoning pouches + scrolls, and more

⬥ Herblore tab - optional but might make it easier to keep track of your supplies to make potions with (more relevant for ironmen)

Sample Bank Tabs
Here are some examples of sorted bank tabs. The width refers to the amount of items per row.
Bank Tabs
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/ZOY0yf077m.png Rcm37] (18 wide) ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/NWc14PQIxU.png P U P] (14 wide) ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/IyzWjKvkRa.png Mionee] (12 wide) ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/2zinXDLziN.png Dyanne] (10 wide)

​

Bank Presets

Bank presets make it easy to equip entire loadouts with a single click. There are 18 presets available, accessible by clicking the cog icon at the bottom right of your bank interface. We can cover a few important points about presets here.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4WLm6Y71Up.png Guide illustration]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WvBCI8Rzrf.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Every preset can be configured to load any combination of the inventory, worn items and beast of burden storage (if summoned)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done by clicking the yellow icons next to the preset (or the tick boxes below the preset list)

⬥ To save a preset with the currently equipped items, select a preset slot and click the Overwrite button at the bottom left

⬥ To save the beast of burden storage, use the dedicated Beast of Burden located below preset number 18

⬥ The middle section of the interface shows the inventory/worn items that will be equipped when that preset is loaded

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can quickly drag and drop items into this section to instantly update the preset

⬥ The Exact Matching option will check for perks when equipment is withdrawn if there is an augmented item in the preset

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After enabling this option, you must re-save the preset with the correct augmented items for it to apply

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is useful when you have multiple of the same item but with different perks

⬥ Presets can be dragged and dropped to re-order them

⬥ Saved presets can be loaded within the bank interface by clicking the numbered icons at the bottom right corresponding to each preset

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They can also be loaded using the number keys 1 ‎and 2 ‎for the first two presets, and Alt+(number) ‎for higher presets

⬥ Here is an example demonstrating setting up and loading a preset:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pDdD6tAO9B.mp4 Source media]

​

Quick Banking Preset

It is generally a useful idea to dedicate one of your preset slots to a 'quick banking' preset that you can use to apply buffs before a bossing trip or between kills, such as aspect timers, incense sticks, potion effects, familiar timers, etc.

⬥ Some items that people may have in their banking preset include:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiars/scrolls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1 mammothpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540070332346388.png?v=1 mammothscroll]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-fight potions - Overloads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] /Weapon Poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] / Summoning renewal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475161809190913.png?v=1 summoningrenewal] /Thermal flask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pouches (to cast aspects [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1 temporalanomaly]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439126519644271.png?v=1 graspingpouchpink] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439129275306164.png?v=1 graspingpouchblue] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439136875253810.png?v=1 graspingpouchblack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716442816532540.png?v=1 deathwardennexus]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Incense sticks - Spirit Weed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 SpiritSticks] / Lantadyme [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 LantaSticks] / Kwuarm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Divine charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Powders - Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / Item Protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953716908269598.png?v=1 powderofitemprotection] / Protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pocketslot items + recharges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643168594493964298.png?v=1 grimpage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284373898334238.png?v=1 manuscriptofful]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953726341267606.png?v=1 magiccape]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Archaeology cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953724441231431.png?v=1 archcape]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Slayer cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayermastercape]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Grim gem [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953720628621352.png?v=1 grimgem]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wicked hood

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blessed flask + extreme prayer potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/659122178704408598.png?v=1 blessedflask] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897785881235606.png?v=1 extremeprayer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Luck of the Dwarves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 LotD]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Grace of the elves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900765150678749204.png?v=1 gote]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vestments of havoc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189295592161291.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavoctop]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon battleaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba]

⬥ If you do not have the Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem] unlocked, you have to consider worn equipment to reach the maximum bonfire boost:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP boosting armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142784247543894056.png?v=1 wardentop80] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336168363561041.png?v=1 cryptbloomtop] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583428622094958612.png?v=1 achtotempestbody]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP boosting shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553021457645579.png?v=1 merciless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553026415313006.png?v=1 vengeful] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553024536252466.png?v=1 malevkite]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP boosting cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839906296290476033.png?v=1 reefcape]

⬥ Typically, ancient ceremonial armour is not included as the Nex bank door can be permanently unlocked using a full set [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522629804062.png?v=1 CeremonialMask] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522441060363.png?v=1 CeremonialTop] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522533335051.png?v=1 CeremonialLegs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522633736214.png?v=1 CeremonialGloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522575147018.png?v=1 CeremonialBoots] + 10M GP [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] at Ashuelot Reis

⬥ To reach the maximum possible bonfire boost of 750 HP, you need at least 13400 HP while using the bonfire

Banking Presets
Some players' banking presets for reference. [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7a3eaf08-a1ce-4a89-b3ec-ee94efcffa29 Dyanne], [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2a258b96-3929-47f3-adc6-92a8d6f8a95a hikaru nara], [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ad56e52f-0cd0-4173-9caf-a4cf1e04170e basic preset]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Some skills are a vital part of your character's PvM strength. Here we go over some of the ways to train the skills and what they unlock. Full skilling guides for every skill can be found on the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skill_training_guides Wiki].

​

Prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer]

⬥ 46 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] for protection prayers that halve that type of damage received.

⬥ 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] - best DPS prayers on the normal prayer book [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215399597581533264.png?v=1 Piety] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215399596239618118.png?v=1 Rigour] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799720926478437.png?v=1 augury] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941000636092467.png?v=1 sanctity]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocked after completing [https://runescape.wiki/w/King%27s_Ransom/Quick_guide King's Ransom] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Knight_Waves_training_ground knight training], for when you start PvMing or bossing.

⬥ 92-95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] Curses

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Temple_at_Senntisten/Quick_guide The Temple at Senntisten] quest

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] which heals you based on damage dealt.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gives access to strong DPS curses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow], which should be your primary long-term goal.

⬥ Primarily train [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] by burying bones with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_burials powder of burials] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989191014738698340.png?v=1 powderofburials].

⬥ Suggested [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] quests & training:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-43: Do: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Restless_ghost_quick_guide Restless Ghost], [https://runescape.wiki/w/Priest_in_Peril/Quick_guide Priest in Peril], and [https://runescape.wiki/w/One_Piercing_Note/Quick_guide One Piercing Note] → [https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_Cithara#Obtaining_the_Holy_Cithara Holy Cithara] (if Desert Treasure completed) quests and then [https://runescape.wiki/w/God_Statues God Statues] monthly D&D. Then:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-95 Cheap: Offer Infernal ashes at [https://runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_altar_(Wilderness) Chaos Altar].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-70: Bury dragon bones with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989191014738698340.png?v=1 powderofburials] active

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-95: Bury dinosaur bones with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989191014738698340.png?v=1 powderofburials] active

​

Summoning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning]

Summoning allows you to summon helpful familiars for to aid you in combat via extra inventory, healing, or dealing damage.

Note: This assumes you already have the charms needed from other PvM content. The list of familiars suggested below is only a recommendation.

⬥ Check [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 summoning] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Summoning Wiki calculators] for up-to-date pricing.

⬥ The weekly Familiarisation minigame can be beneficial when farming charms (triple charms for up to 40 minutes).

⬥ Charming potions add +1 charms dropped when killing things, and are tradeable on the GE - use them when gathering charms for training summoning!

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Arch-Glacor#Normal_mode Arch glacor 0-1 mechanics] is a low-level boss that drops a lot of blue charms.

⬥ Suggested pouches to craft:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-4 : Do the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Wolf_Whistle/Quick_guide Wolf Whistle] quest

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4-16: Dreadfowls

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 16-32: Granite Crabs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 32-46: Honeybadgers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 46-49: Pyrelords

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 49-61: Bloated Leeches

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 61-64: Smoke Devils or Bloated Leeches

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 64-74: Stranger Plants or Smoke Devils

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 74-79: Granite Lobsters

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 79-89: Moss Titans

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 89-99: Geyser titans

​

Herblore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore]

Herblore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 herblore] grants you access to untradeable potions such as [https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload Overloads] (96+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 herblore] for combat skill boosting, and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Adrenaline_potion#(4) adrenaline potions] (84+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 herblore]) for more adrenaline on-demand.

Note: prices of supplies and potions fluctuate. Making certain potions may even be profitable. Do some research before training.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 herblore] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Herblore Wiki calculators] for research.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Warbands Warbands] are one option for relatively fast and free Herblore XP, but may require some time investment to learn, and are located in the Wilderness.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• unavailable for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1 iron].

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Herby_Werby Herby Werby] has no requirements and can be done after visiting [https://runescape.wiki/w/Anachronia/Quick_guide Anachronia] once. Buy [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_seed ancient seeds] to return weekly.

⬥ You can choose to wait for a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Double_XP_Live DXP (Double XP) weekend] to train.

⬥ Always make use of portable wells when making potions for the +10% experience boost.

​

⬥ Suggested training methods:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-38: Do Warbands daily, Herby-Werby weekly or the highest level potion available

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 38-52: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Prayer_potion Prayer potions]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 52-66: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Super_Energy_potion Super Energy potions]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 66-84: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Super_Defence_potion Super Defence potions]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 84-88: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Adrenaline_potion Adrenaline potions]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 88-96: Make ~3000 of each [https://runescape.wiki/w/Extreme_potion extreme potion]. Should that not be enough, just make some more adrenaline potions OR more extremes of equal amounts until you hit 96.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 96-99: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload Overloads]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 98-99: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Supreme_overload Supreme overloads]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can boost to 107 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 herblore] via pulse core once you get to 99 in order to make [https://runescape.wiki/w/Elder_overload_potion Elder overload potions]. These are the best-in-slot potions, and very worth the cost.

​

Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] may be less [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] xp/hr than other methods; but comes with other benefits like making some [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins], unlocking new monsters to kill, collecting charms for Summoning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning] while training your combat stats all at the same time.

​

⬥ If you choose to do Slayer, prioritise completing the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Smoking_Kills/Quick_guide Smoking Kills] quest. This doubles your point rewards from tasks. Then remember to quickly get a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet Full Slayer Helmet] for the big accuracy and damage boost it provides for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee].

⬥ Make sure to use the highest available [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Masters#Overview Slayer Master] to get the best tasks.

⬥ Early on, you can quickly train slayer by squishing Corrupted Scarabs at Menaphos.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See the soulobby ‎FC for calls on when scarabs spawn.

⬥ Fast/expensive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] training method:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_demon_berserker greater demon berserkers] with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Wildcard Slayer wildcards] to 115 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]. Safespottable and even at lower levels this is very high xp/h.

​

Crafting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1 crafting]

80 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1 crafting] is required for Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] and also up to 85 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1 crafting] to craft [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] armour.

Note: gp/xp calculations can be found on the Wiki page for training Crafting.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1 crafting] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Crafting Wiki calculators] for research.

⬥ Free/slow/cheap training methods:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+: dungeoneering crafting (craft magic/ranged armour in Daemonheim, sell them to the smuggler and buy more supplies, repeat).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+: crafting urns

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+ weekly clan citadel contribution at loom plot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 75+: Prifddinas harps

⬥ Fast/pricey training methods:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20+: Cutting gems (sapphire/ruby/emerald/diamond)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 54+: Crafting battlestaves

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 63+: Crafting dragonhide armour

​

Divination [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1 divination]

⬥ 80 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1 divination] is required for Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention].

⬥ The best way to train Divination early on is through daily activities:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-80: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Guthixian_Cache Guthixian Caches] (start doing Caches ASAP - at low level, do them on legacy worlds, as there will be fewer people so you can Cres more often).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-80: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Hall_of_Memories Hall of Memories] (use corehunting ‎FC for the most efficient method of training here - they also have a Discord server if you are interested).

​

Smithing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1 smithing]

80 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1 smithing] is required for Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] and also up to 85 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1 smithing] to craft [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] weapons.

Note: gp/xp calculations and more details can be found on the Wiki page for training Smithing.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1 smithing] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Smithing Wiki calculators]

⬥ 80 Smithing is required for Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1 iron] may benefit from saving armour for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] disassembling, or smithing full sets for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Smithing_training#Forging_burial_armour burial armour] on w70.

⬥ Suggested training methods:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-30: Do [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword/Quick_guide The Knight's Sword] quest, then make steel platebodies +1

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 30-40: Make mithril platebodies +2

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 40-50: Make adamant platebodies +2

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 50-60: Make rune platebodies +3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 60-70: Make orikalkum platebodies +3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-80: Make necrite platebodies +4

​

Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

Invention unlocks the ability to use perks on gear, which adds a huge amount of DPS, skilling utility and survivability.

​

Note: see [[PvME/Invention perks/Invention Basics|Invention Basics]] for more information.

⬥ Suggested training methods:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-4: Complete the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_tutorial Invention tutorial].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4-27: Research max item level 5, and disassemble two items at level 5 (cheap options like crystal halberd, black salamander, etc.)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 27-60: Research max item level 10, then disassemble items once they hit level 10.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 60-99/120: Disassemble (at level 10) or siphon (at level 12) weapons and armour while doing PvM/bossing and the skill will passively level up over time.

⬥ Shattered Worlds can be used to powerlevel invention, at the cost of combat experience.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See !shatteredworlds ‎command for more information.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Item experience will be higher than AFK alternatives, but the combat experience will be significantly reduced.

​

Archaeology [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology]

Archaeology relics boost skilling and PvM in many ways, and is required for many important quests.

⬥ Do archaeology tutorial for + 500 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698225967679930408.png?v=1 fontoflife] relic.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] quest requirements:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ‎ ‎40 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Daughter_of_Chaos/Quick_guide Daughter of Chaos] quest.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ part of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Succession/Quick_guide Succession] questline for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1 iron]: 68(b) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dagon_Bye Dagon Bye] mystery for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Summoning ancient summoning].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 74 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] for [https://runescape.wiki/w/City_of_Senntisten/Quick_guide City of Senntisten] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear] spells.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ part of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction/Quick_guide Extinction] questline for passive ring of vigour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 86 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tomes_of_the_Warlock/Quick_guide Tomes of the Warlock] quest. Necromancy questline for talent tree incantations [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield]

⬥ 56-112 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] important for high-lvl pvm relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1 berserkersfury] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1 furyofthesmall] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1 deathward] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1 conservationofenergy]

​

Dungeoneering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering]

Note: As tokens are the limiting factor for most upgrades, the farming of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] is the focus of this subsection.

Dungeoneering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering] is a support skill that gives a plethora of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Daemonheim_Rewards rewards] to enhance your skilling and pvm (e.g. [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_vigour ring of vigour] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Charming_imp Charming imp]) that can be bought with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken].

⬥ ‎ ‎[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dungeoneering#Preparing_for_a_dungeon Dungeoneering] can be trained by completing Daemonheim floors or by doing [https://runescape.wiki/w/Elite_Dungeons Elite Dungeons].

​

Token [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] farming

An efficient token [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] farming method is killing minibosses in elite dungeons, which yields 5,000 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] per kill.

Level 70+ stats and weapons are recommended.

​

⬥ Temple of Aminishi

⬥ Tokens [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] can be farmed in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Temple_of_Aminishi Temple of Aminishi] (ed1) on the first level solo up to trio (trio recommended). Click [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dungeoneering_token/Strategies here] for strategies.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Miniboss spawns here are random. You can stretch your minimap to check for the miniboss icons.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When all have been killed, restart the dungeon.

⬥ Cerberus Juvenile

⬥ Alternatively, one can kill the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cerberus_Juvenile Cerberus Juvenile] miniboss in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Zamorakian_Undercity Zamorakian Undercity] (ed4) at the beginning, solo up to 5-man. You can safespot him by standing just outside the room.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• He always spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• By using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] you can prevent luring the mages after the Mender passes, as shown [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=500nAj3PcDw here]. Kill the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_witch_mender Chaos witch mender] after.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Cerberus has been killed, restart the dungeon.

Note: If the Mender aggros on you as you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive], the mages will be alerted!

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

This guide is intended as a guide for newer and returning players looking to jumpstart their way into RS3 PvM and Bossing. This page links to a host of pages, each dedicated to cover important subjects that help you on your PvM journey.

⬥ General tips like setting up your game interface and basic money making to get started.

⬥ New to PvM to get you to level 70 in every combat style! There are:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example upgrade orders and ability bars

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guides on the important non-combat skills for PvM and some training methods

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Important quests to work towards

⬥ New to Bossing assumes you already have most of the PvM knowledge and skill from New to PvM, and helps you set progression goals for bossing. This includes prayer flicking, good bosses for learning, how to learn PvM, and how to transition to full manual combat.

⬥ Note that the discord links in here will refer to either of two Runescape Discord servers. If you have not joined these, the links won't work.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The official Runescape Discord [https://discord.com/invite/rs invite link (external Discord)]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The PvM Encyclopedia [https://discord.gg/invite/pvme invite link (external Discord)]

General Tips

Before you begin, it can be helpful to get a few things out of the way:

⬥ Setting up a good interface - see [[PvME/Getting started/Interface Guide|Interface Guide]].

​

Help and Guidance

If you ever feel stuck, confused, in need of teamforming, or wanting personal input on your PvM situation; there are several resources you can jump to.

⬥ Joining a Clan (RS discord recruitment page: [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1197226494523621376 RuneScape > looking for group (external Discord)]) or dedicated discord servers (PvMe Discord affiliates: [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/944775418844688464 Affiliates (external Discord)]) can be great for getting (PvM) help or finding people to PvM with.

⬥ You can ask Mentors in the RS Discord server for help [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/723915055976153138 Affiliates (external Discord)] or look for groups in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/992535252276887602 RuneScape > recruitment all (external Discord)]

⬥ You can ask for advice in the pvm-help channel of the PvMe Discord server for all your PvM inquiries! [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)]

​

Skilling Goals

⬥ There are many Skills in Runescape that are not direct combat skills, but that greatly impact your combat prowess through prayers, potions, perks, familiars, and relics. We covered these in [[PvME/Getting started/Noncombat Skilling Guides|Noncombat Skilling Guides]]. This page is relevant for New to PvM as well as New to Bossing readers.

​

Early Money making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins]

Training buyable skills and upgrading your gear can be expensive, but there are money making methods that are effective even as a lower-level player. These are just a few methods you can try out - there are a lot more methods in the game for you to explore.

[[PvME/Getting started/Early Moneymaking Ideas|Early Moneymaking Ideas]]

​

New to PvM

This covers helpful beginner PvM goals, quests, but also combat upgrade suggestions and ability bars to get you from level 1 to level 70.

⬥ The go-to page that outlines early-game quests, good monsters for training, handy items and more: [[PvME/Combat foundations/Early Game Combat|Early Game Combat]]

⬥ Early [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] upgrade order & ability bar:[[PvME/Combat foundations/Early Magic Upgrades|Early Magic Upgrades]]

⬥ Early [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] upgrade order & ability bar: [[PvME/Combat foundations/Early Melee Upgrades|Early Melee Upgrades]]

⬥ Early [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] upgrade order & ability bar: [[PvME/Combat foundations/Early Ranged Upgrades|Early Ranged Upgrades]]

⬥ Early [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] upgrade order & ability bar:[[PvME/Combat foundations/Early Necromancy Upgrades|Early Necromancy Upgrades]]

​

New to Bossing

This covers important level 70+ combat-related goals and upgrading information. You don't have to read all of this right away, there is a lot, just know it exists for when you feel you need a hand.

⬥ The go-to page that outlines mid to end-game quests, suggested monsters for training, handy items and more: [[PvME/Learning to boss/Mid Game Combat|Mid Game Combat]]

⬥ The PvMe upgrade order for every style level 70-99: [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides]

⬥ High level ability bars for Revo, Revo++ and Revo++ (AoE): [[PvME/Combat reference/Revolution Bars|Revolution Bars]]

⬥ A recommended order of bosses that teach you valuable PvM lessons: [[PvME/Learning to boss/Bossing Path|Bossing Path]]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One such PvM lesson is prayer flicking: [[PvME/Learning to boss/Prayer Flicking|Prayer Flicking]]

⬥ Consumable items relevant to PvM and bossing: [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Consumables|Consumables]]

⬥ Permanent unlocks (abilities, spells, quest rewards): [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Permanent Unlocks|Permanent Unlocks]]

⬥ Armour, weapons and their uses: [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]]

⬥ Damage per minute (DPM) basics: how to think about your ability rotation to deal more damage: [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Damage%20%26%20rotations Damage and rotation guides]

​

Basic boss guides

The PvMe Discord has basic guides for almost every boss in Runescape.

⬥ These guides have beginner preset recommendations (think level 70+ / stage 1 upgrade order), an overview of how the boss's mechanics work, and suggestions for how to deal with them: [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Boss%20fundamentals Boss fundamentals]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Note: a Table of Contents can be found in the pinned messages.

​

Introduction

Invention, the only elite skill in the game, is one of the best ways to easily increase your DPS and defences, as well as provide a ton of utility. As such, it is very important to unlock and train it as soon as possible.

​

This guide will cover the following:

⬥ Unlocking Invention

⬥ Materials (parts and components)

⬥ Gizmos & Perks

⬥ Adding gizmos to items

⬥ Augmentation & item levels

⬥ Invention machines

⬥ Tech trees - Dwarven/Goblin

⬥ Ancient Invention

⬥ Training methods

⬥ Tips & tricks

​

If you are just looking for information on what perks you should use, check out [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] and [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]].

​

Unlocking Invention

Requirements

⬥ Unlocking Invention has the following requirements:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 80 Smithing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1 smithing]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 80 Crafting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1 crafting]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 80 Divination [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1 divination]

​

Unlocking Invention

⬥ First head to the Invention guild located just north of Falador (around the Dwarven mines area).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Bq1tAou.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Next go to talk to the dwarf inside called Doc.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1u8quO8.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Doc will walk you through a basic Invention tutorial that shows you how to augment items.

​

The Inventor's Workbench

Using the Workbench

⬥ This is where you'll manufacture most of the items Invention gives you access to.

⬥ Each bench has two click options: discover and manufacture

⬥ You must first discover an item before you can manufacture it.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VcjjxMr.png Guide illustration] ​

Discovery Tab

⬥ This is the screen you'll see when you open the Discover tab.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/L1xzFwg.png Guide illustration]

⬥ On the left, there are blueprints, corresponding to Invention items.

⬥ A blueprint must be successfully 'completed' before the corresponding item is accessible to you.

⬥ Selecting a blueprint brings up a small minigame:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You first select 5 modules (through trial and error) from 10 options to find the ones that work.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then you arrange them into order to successfully unlock items, which gives some [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] experience.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/R5unsHe.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Note:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The modules can be placed in any order (but correct orders give up to 5x more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] experience).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The different levels of success are: Poor < Satisfactory < Good < Excellent < Perfect

[https://img.pvme.io/images/7q46xXN.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Once you have discovered items, you can manufacture them using the other side of the workbench.

​

Manufacturing Tab

⬥ The right side of the bench allows you to manufacture invention items.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/PCvnhmH9DF.png Guide illustration] ⬥ This includes things like divine charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge], gizmos [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1 ancientweapongizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041619653152858.png?v=1 ancienttoolgizmo], invention items [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1 augmentor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869649975787580.png?v=1 gizmodissolver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869647677313144.png?v=1 augmentationdissolver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869642455404594.png?v=1 equipmentseperator], certain augmented items [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1 sirenicbody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846938537623564.png?v=1 sireniclegs], and much more.

​

Materials

What Are Materials

⬥ Materials are parts and components used in the creation of all Invention items and perks.

⬥ You get them primarily from disassembling things.

⬥ There are 4 types of materials: common, uncommon, rare and ancient.

⬥ You can check what materials you have by clicking on the aforementioned icon. Items can also be disassembled by dragging them to this icon.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/96igPYd.png Guide illustration] ⬥ As you start collecting materials, they will be filled into your invention pouch, looking something like this.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/M0Oc0Ey.png Guide illustration] ​

Obtaining from the Grand Exchange

Click on any material name to be linked to the calculator for best items to disassemble.

⬥ Set your Junk Reduction chance according to your level

⬥ Use the sort buttons under "Cost per mat" to sort from lowest to highest

⬥ Ignore any items that have a low value for the "Trade vol." column

⬥ Pay attention to the "Mats per hour" column as you go down the list and consider the time/money tradeoff

​

For convenience, the following lists are compiled by balancing the above factors at zero junk chance reduction. Higher level players are encouraged to use the calculators themselves as the increased junk chance reduction may make other items better for disassembly.

​

Common Components

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183448330270.png?v=1 baseparts] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Base Base] - Medium/large bladed adamant salvage, Royal/broad-tipped bolts, Dragonhide shields

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183465238536.png?v=1 bladeparts] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Blade Blade] - Steel+ darts, Adamant javelins, Guthix mjolnirs, Medium/large bladed adamant salvage

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183674953728.png?v=1 clearparts] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Clear Clear] - Air/water/earth/fire/unpowered orbs, Rubies

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183200866321.png?v=1 connectorparts] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Connector Connector] - Black/green salamanders, Magic stocks

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434318848720906.png?v=1 coverparts] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Cover Cover] - Huge plated steel salvage, Small plated mithril salvage

Gizmos and Perks

Gizmos are the main focus of invention. They allow you to put perks on your weapons, armour and tools which allow for some very useful effects during skilling or PvM.

​

Making Gizmos

⬥ There are separate gizmos for tools [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041619653152858.png?v=1 ancienttoolgizmo], weapons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1 ancientweapongizmo] and armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo] each needing to be discovered at the workbench.

⬥ Unlock gizmos by discovering their blueprints at the following levels:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon gizmos - level 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Armour gizmos - level 16 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tool gizmos - level 22 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

⬥ You can then create at the workbench if you have sufficient resources.

​

Adding Perks to Gizmos

⬥ Click a gizmo to bring up the following menu:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/lpZ1nXp.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Click or drag materials to fill the slots on the top right. This will fill them with the selected material.

⬥ Depending on the materials used and their layout, the possible perk results are shown on the bottom right.

⬥ Click Create to create the gizmo.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/H3qQ2F9.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Each gizmo can hold up to 2 perks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is why most endgame PvM perks are a combo of two perks - this maximises the number of perks you can have

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. a single gizmo containing Biting 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] and Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] perks

​

⬥ Keep in mind:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not all perks are guaranteed outcomes. Be prepared to try multiple times in some cases.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Perks with multiple ranks will be more effective at higher ranks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ e.g. Biting 1 gives 2% crit chance, Biting 4 gives +8% crit chance

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You should wait to get expensive endgame perks at level 120 Invention.

​

Adding Gizmos to Items

⬥ Gizmos can only be added to augmented items, as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tools: 2 tool gizmos each

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• MH and OH weapons: 1 weapon gizmo each

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2H weapons (excluding shieldbows): 2 weapon gizmos

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defenders: 1 weapon OR armour gizmo

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shieldbows (e.g. strykebow, darkbow): 1 weapon AND 1 armour gizmo

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Body/leg armours: 2 armour gizmos each

​

Note: weapon and armour gizmos can be either normal or ancient. You should use ancient as soon as they're available as they offer better perks. For more detailed info, see [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Invention Ancient Invention].

​

⬥ To remove a gizmo from an item, there are a few options:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gizmo dissolvers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869649975787580.png?v=1 gizmodissolver] will remove a single gizmo, destroying the perks in that gizmo.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Augmentation dissolvers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869647677313144.png?v=1 augmentationdissolver] will de-augment the item, destroying all gizmos/perks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipment separators [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869642455404594.png?v=1 equipmentseperator] will remove and return the gizmos to you, but require items to be level 15 or higher.

​

⬥ Augmented items (and the perks in them) will not work unless you have divine charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge] stored. You can either create them at the workbench or buy them at the GE.

​

Augmentation

How to Augment Items

⬥ Items can be augmented in two ways:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For most items: click Augmentor [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1 augmentor] → use on Item

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Degrade-to-dust items: take fully-repaired Item + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1 augmentor] → create augmented item at Workbench

​

Item Levels

⬥ Augmented items gain experience as you use them, increasing their item level.

⬥ Maximum item levels can be increased by discovering blueprints:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 5 - at 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 10 - at 27 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 15 - at 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20 - at 99 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

⬥ As items increase in level, they get some benefits, notably:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 3 - disassembles for 2x materials

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 6 - disassembles for 3x materials

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 8 - gizmos are returned when disassembling

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 9 - disassembles for 4x materials

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 10 - disassembles for maximum experience

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 12 - siphons for maximum experience

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 15 - equipment separators can be used on this item

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20 - perks are 10% more effective on this item

​

⬥ Note that items use less charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge] as they level up, making them more efficient.

​

Machines

⬥ Towards the back of the Invention guild, you'll be able to create machines (starting at level 60).

⬥ These machines can do some very handy stuff such as High Alching [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290631786496.png?v=1 highalch] and disassembling items, and even partially processing items (e.g. logs → planks, herbs → unf potions, etc.)

⬥ Up to 5 spots for machines (pink), and one spot for a power generator (red) are available:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/An6ZlWP.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Clicking on an empty machine hotspot you'll see a list of the machines you can make and the materials/items needed to make them.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zufYzSW.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Machines are powered by divine charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Charges are added to the power generator to supply power to the rest of the machines.

⬥ Machines each consume a certain level of 'power' - i.e. a way to limit how many machines you have at once.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This limit increases as you build better generators.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Having a tier 3 Workshop at Fort Forinthry increases the power capacity of machines by 25%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Jumbo generator provides 160 power.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Jumbo generator with a tier 3 Workshop provides 200 power.

⬥ Machines cannot be turned on/off - to change your power allocation, you must destroy/rebuild them.

​

Tech Trees

What Are Tech Trees

⬥ Tech trees are found on the small noticeboard next to the bank in the Invention guild.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VLXAeM6.png Guide illustration] ⬥ They're used to unlock additional blueprints to discover create items.

⬥ Currency for unlocking blueprints can be gained by completing tasks for each tree.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tasks usually require handing in materials or finished items.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One task is added every 12h, stacking up to 5.

​

Dwarven Tech Tree

The following blueprints are part of the Dwarven tree:

⬥ Corporeal components

⬥ Sprinkler MK1

⬥ Mining Accumulator

⬥ Book switcher

⬥ Calorie bomb

⬥ Auto-sanctifier

⬥ Kinetic Cyclone

⬥ Dungeoneering lock melter

​

Goblin Tech Tree

The following blueprints are part of the Goblin tree:

⬥ Pestiferous components

⬥ Mechanised chinchompas

⬥ Woodcutting accumulator

⬥ B.A.N.K Stander

⬥ Monkey mind-control helmet

⬥ Dungeoneering party simulator

⬥ Electrified box trap

⬥ Oldak coil

​

Ancient Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention]

What Is It

⬥ With the release of Archaeology [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology], Ancient Invention was introduced to the game.

⬥ This includes new tools (higher tier t70→t80), new gizmos [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1 ancientweapongizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041619653152858.png?v=1 ancienttoolgizmo], new materials & perks.

⬥ 85 Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] (boostable from 68 with an extreme potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1 extremeinventionpotion]) is required to discover, create and use ancient gizmos.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ancient blueprints technically require 95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] but blueprints and ancient materials are both tradeable on the GE.

​

Note: Ironmen [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1 iron] cannot boost for this, and will have to get the blueprints themselves at level 95.

​

Ancient Gizmos

⬥ Ancient gizmos have 9 slots (vs. the regular 5 slots of normal gizmos), allowing for more perk choices and combinations.

⬥ This makes getting a starter set of perks for PvM very easy - see [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]].

⬥ Keep in mind though that as with regular gizmos, it's not worth going for high-end perks till 120 Invention.

⬥ Discovering 'perfect' rated blueprints is also a good source of XP early on.

​

How to Train Invention

Training Methods

⬥ Invention is primarily trained by disassembling or siphoning augmented equipment once it reaches an appropriate level.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Items disassemble for full XP from level 10 or higher.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They siphon for full XP from level 12 or higher.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can siphon/disassemble at lower levels, but this gives less XP.

​

⬥ Items gain XP and level up as you use them appropriately (combat items when fighting, skilling tools when skilling).

⬥ In general: faster XP gain → faster item levelling → faster Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] XP

⬥ XP Capacitors [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869645768884256.png?v=1 xpcapacitor] (tradeable on the GE) should be used to double the rate of item XP gain, effectively doubling your Invention XP/hr.

​

Level 1-4

⬥ Tutorial puts you at level 4.

​

Level 4-27

⬥ Discover item maximum level 5 blueprint.

⬥ Buy any cheap augmentable weapon (crystal halberd or black salamanders for example) and level it up to level 5.

⬥ At level 16, research augmented body armour and buy some cheap augmentable armour and level up to level 5.

⬥ When your weapons / armour reach level 5, disassemble them for xp. Do this until you hit level 27.

​

Level 27-60

⬥ Discover item maximum level 10 blueprint.

⬥ Continue as before but disassemble your weapons/armour at level 10 instead.

⬥ At level 45, research augmented leg armour. Buy some cheap augmentable leg armour and level it up along with your torso and weapon.

​

Level 60

⬥ Discover item maximum level 15 blueprint.

⬥ Stop using your cheap gear - augment your main gear and level it up.

⬥ At level 12, siphon the items for XP. Repeat till you reach level 120.

Invention Training Methods
See !shatteredworlds command for how to get item XP quickly. For more detailed info, see the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_training Wiki guide].

​

Tips and Tricks

Blueprints

⬥ Extreme invention pots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1 extremeinventionpotion] (requiring 85 Herblore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore]) let you research blueprints up to 17 levels earlier.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you can't make them, use super Invention potions instead.

⬥ Blueprints will give double XP on DXP weekends.

​

Perks & Materials

⬥ Augmentable items will disassemble for more materials at level 3 (2x), 6 (3x) and 9 (4x).

⬥ Level items up for disassembly when possible, especially for expensive materials.

⬥ Scavenging 3/4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1 scavenging4] perk can add up to a lot of uncommon/rare materials over time as you PvM.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is especially noticeable when AFK farming, or doing high KPH activities like Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

⬥ When going for a specific perk, always calculate the optimal way to get it in advance.

Useful Links
⬥ To calculate perk chances, and what materials you should use to get them, you can use this helpful [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks Wiki Perk Calculator]. ⬥ See [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] for info on what perks you should use. ⬥ See [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]] for why those perks are chosen.

​
