[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide explains in detail perk choices and placements.

For a full list of perk combos and their positions on gear, check out [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]].

​

Entry Level Weapon Perks

Precise 6 + Eruptive 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1 er4]
⬥ ~7.1% damage increase over no weapon perks at all.     • Refer to this [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Biting_Precise_and_Equilibrium calculator] to see effects of individual ranks. ⬥ Very cheap to obtain once [https://runescape.wiki/w/'Ancient_gizmos'_blueprint Ancient Gizmos] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1 ancientweapongizmo] are unlocked. ⬥ Don't have to worry about [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] stacks when using switches. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] on main hand to maximise damage while using     • Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] / Defender [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846849362657280.png?v=1 kalphiterepriser] / Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553026415313006.png?v=1 vengeful] switch.
Flanking 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4]
⬥ When a target is not facing you, this perk multiplies the damage of:     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Impact Impact] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] , [https://runescape.wiki/w/Backhand Backhand] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] , [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Strike Soul Strike] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] , and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Binding_Shot Binding Shot] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] by 2.6x.     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Deep_Impact Deep Impact] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] , [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forceful_Backhand Forceful Backhand] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand] , and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tight_Bindings Tight Bindings] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541275957657600.png?v=1 tight] by 1.6x. ⬥ Removes the stun effect from the above mentioned abilities. ⬥ Relatively inexpensive perk with strong benefits, but requires a switch. ⬥ For more information on the angles from which Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] works, see [[PvME/Combat reference/Mechanics|Mechanics]].
Planted Feet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf]
⬥ Increases the duration of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunshine Sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Death's_Swiftness Death's Swiftness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]     • From 30s (50 ticks) to 37.8s (63 ticks). ⬥ Usually used as one of the following:     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] on a main hand weapon to preserve [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] stacks.     • On a defender, optionally as a combo with a perk like [https://runescape.wiki/w/Caroming Caroming] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4].     • See !pf and !defender ⬥ Becomes obsolete once you unlock [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sunshine Greater Sunshine] / [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Death's_Swiftness Death's Swiftness]

​

Advanced Weapon Perks

Precise 6 Aftershock 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] on main hand to maximise damage while using     • Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] / Defender [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846849362657280.png?v=1 kalphiterepriser] / Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553026415313006.png?v=1 vengeful] switch. ⬥ Aftershock 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1] on main hand to prevent losing stacks when using a switch. ⬥ On 2H Weapons, different combos can be used instead such as:     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800924942396.png?v=1 ruthless1] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953962207957162.png?v=1 caroming1] , or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 er2] if using another [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] combo (expensive).
Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 er2]
⬥ Along with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1], is a:     • ~9.6% DPM boost over no weapon perks. ⬥ This is effectively the same as having:     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] , [https://runescape.wiki/w/Eruptive Eruptive] 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 er2] , and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] simultaneously. ⬥ Cheaper to get than [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 + [https://runescape.wiki/w/Eruptive Eruptive] 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 er2] in one gizmo.
Caroming 4 Eruptive 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 er2]
⬥ Hits 1 additional monster per rank of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Caroming Caroming] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]     • Synergistic with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Ricochet Greater Ricochet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Chain Greater Chain] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain]. ⬥ For Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] setups with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]     • Can be camped alongside [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1]. ⬥ For Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] setups with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain]     • Can be combo-ed as a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Planted_Feet Planted Feet] + [https://runescape.wiki/w/Caroming Caroming] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] switch.     • Or just used on its own as a switch.
Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1 er4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3]
⬥ Along with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise Precise] 6 [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aftershock Aftershock] 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1], is a:     • ~8.3% DPM boost over no wep perks before accounting for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ruthless Ruthless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3]. ⬥ Can be good at places where [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ruthless Ruthless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3] is effective, such as slayer. ⬥ Relatively cheap to obtain.
Lunging 4 X [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736522494315593759.png?v=1 lunge4]
⬥ Increases max hit of the following abilities by +80% on stationary targets:     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dismember Dismember] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] , [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fragmentation_Shot Fragmentation Shot] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541273755385885.png?v=1 frag] , and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Combust Combust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb] ⬥ Reduces the damage multiplier of walking these abilities from 2x to 1.5x. ⬥ Generally only used with melee as you cannot walk [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dismember Dismember] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember].     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541273755385885.png?v=1 frag] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb] are better if walked without lunging.

​

Entry Level Armour Perks

Biting 3 + Impatient 4 (body armour) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502516874051590.png?v=1 b3] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Biting Biting] 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502516874051590.png?v=1 b3] gives a 6% chance of forcing a crit each hit.     • ~3.8% damage increase on average (varies with other boosts).     • Refer to this [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Biting_Precise_and_Equilibrium calculator] to see effects of individual ranks. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Impatient Impatient] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] has a 36% chance to grant 3% more adren per basic ability.     • On average this results in an increase of ~1% adrenaline per basic ability.     • Stacks with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fury_of_the_Small Fury of the Small] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1 furyofthesmall] relic. ⬥ Very cheap to obtain once [https://runescape.wiki/w/'Ancient_gizmos'_blueprint Ancient Gizmos] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1 ancientweapongizmo] are unlocked.
These perks are on separate gizmos.
Crackling 4 (leg armour) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crackling Crackling] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] deals 200% ability damage every 60 seconds. ⬥ Can easily be combo-ed with an auxiliary perk     • Cheaper than some other combos involving perks like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4]. ⬥ Pairing with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Devoted Enhanced Devoted] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] on legs can make armour switches cheaper, as legs tend to cost less than bodies.
Enhanced Devoted 4 (leg armour) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Devoted Enhanced Devoted] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] has a 18% chance per hit on you of activating a 3 second version of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Devotion Devotion] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] ability. ⬥ The effectiveness of this depends on the attack speed of a boss. ⬥ Assuming the correct overhead prayers, this works out to approximately:     • 18% damage reduction against targets that attack less than once every 2.4s (4t).     • 30.5% against targets that attack once every 2.4s (4t). ⬥ Takes priority over the normal [https://runescape.wiki/w/Devoted Devoted] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] perk.     • However the normal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] perk can activate during the time [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] is active.     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Combined_Enhanced_Devoted_and_Devoted#Calculator This calculator] can be used to see exact differences in perk ranks.
Turtling 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1 turt4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Turtling Turtling] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1 turt4] increases the duration and cooldown of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Barricade Barricade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] by 40%. ⬥ This allows for Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] to last for 13.8s (23 ticks)     • 17.4s (29 ticks) with the T2 [https://runescape.wiki/w/Farm_totem#Anachronia_Dinosaur_Farm_perks Malletops perk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1 malletops].

​

Advanced Armour Perks

Biting 4 X [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Biting Biting] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] gives a 8% chance of forcing a crit each hit.     • ~5% damage increase on average (varies with other boosts).     • Refer to this [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Biting_Precise_and_Equilibrium calculator] to see effects of individual ranks. ⬥ Can be combo-ed with an auxiliary perk but is generally expensive:     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal], etc
Relentless 5 Crackling 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Relentless Relentless] 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] gives a 5% chance to not consume adrenaline when using an ability that requires adrenaline. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crackling Crackling] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] deals 200% ability damage every 60 seconds. ⬥ As [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] is expensive, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] is a perk useful in all situations putting both on your body armour allows you to use different augmented legs with different perk setups.
Impatient 4 Devoted 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4]
⬥ When not using Enhanced Devoted [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] , it is preferred to combo Impatient with Devoted.     • However it can be comboed with many auxiliary perks situationally. ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] has a 12% chance per hit on you of activating a 3 second version of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Devotion Devotion] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] ability. ⬥ Damage reduction if praying correctly:     • 12% against targets that attack less than once every 2.4s (4t).     • 21.4% against targets that attack once every 2.4s (4t).
Invigorating 4 X [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invigorating Invigorating] 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4] gives 20% increased adrenaline from auto attacks. ⬥ Can easily be combo-ed with an auxiliary perk. ⬥ Most impactful for Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] and Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] setups.
Lucky 6 X [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/890542428287795221.png?v=1 lucky6]
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lucky Lucky] 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/890542428287795221.png?v=1 lucky6] gives a 3% chance of reducing a hit to 1 damage.     • Works on all damage except hard typeless, such as Araxxor's cleave. ⬥ This can be good for some end-game ranged setups utilising the ECB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] since Lucky [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/890542428287795221.png?v=1 lucky6] will work even when Soulsplit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] is active, unlike Devoted [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] / Enhanced Devoted [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4]. ⬥ Can be paired with an auxiliary perk like [https://runescape.wiki/w/Absorbative Absorbative] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/890542428556230666.png?v=1 absorbative4] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Hoarding Hoarding], etc.

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Due to the removal of negative perks some of our old component combinations are no longer accurate so the perk index has been temporarily removed and will be readded once we've updated it!

The Perks/Search calculator [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks/Search https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks/Search] has been updated so you can use that to find any component combinations you need.

​

Note: a Table of Contents can be found in the pinned messages.

​

Introduction

This guide covers the perks we suggest for your gear and how to obtain them.

​

When you see symbols in a listed perk (+ and X):

​

⬥ + represents an item with multiple gizmos slots:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g., [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 eruptive2]

​

⬥ X - represents where you have a choice of perks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g., 'Biting 4 X' you could choose between 9 different perks to go with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] depending on your preference

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These combinations are listed in the later sections of this guide

​

Related Guides & Links
⬥ [[PvME/Invention perks/Invention Basics|Invention Basics]] is a must-read if you're new to Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] ⬥ [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]] describes every perk we recommend. ⬥[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks/Search RuneScape Wiki's Perk Search] lets you search a perk combination to find which component setup is best. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks RuneScape Wiki's Perk Calculator] lets you test out component combinations and see your chance of different perks. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Shattered_Worlds Shattered Worlds] is the fastest way to level up your augmented gear.     • Video guides: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oy0IZCZWTn0 Base Tank] / [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bOeknuojYtI Evil Lucario]     • Alternatively, level up your gear using a slayer mob in [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Slayer Slayer guides].

​

Recommended Perks

Starter Perks

Many starter perks are decent & inexpensive and may well last your entire PvM career.
Requirements

Armour / Shields
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643847056527458324.png?v=1 masterworkbody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1 sirenicbody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783476169441401.png?v=1 dealertop80] Body - Equilibrium 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504357414207490.png?v=1 eq1] + Impatient 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556586037216804864.png?v=1 SuperiorZurielstop] Body (Magic) - Biting 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502516874051590.png?v=1 b3] + Impatient 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556591275604836395.png?v=1 SuperiorZurielsrobebottom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556592058794770432.png?v=1 masterworklegs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846938537623564.png?v=1 sireniclegs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783488257429504.png?v=1 dealerlegs80] Legs - Crackling 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] + Enhanced Devoted 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553021457645579.png?v=1 Merciless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553024536252466.png?v=1 malevkite] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553026415313006.png?v=1 vengeful] Shield - Turtling 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1 turtling4]     • For Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] just use Bone Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1 lesserboneshield] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield]

​

Advanced Weapon Perks

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]
Use 2H perks for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] if using them as primary weapons ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa] 2-handed - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 + Precise 6 Ultimatums 4 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] Main-hand - Caroming 4 Aftershock 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] Off-hand - Lunging 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159261630467.png?v=1 sing] Flanking switch - Flanking 4 Eruptive 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522503712781.png?v=1 ancientlantern] Planted Feet switch - Planted Feet, or Caroming 4 Planted Feet ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891495041073152.png?v=1 abyssalorb] Caroming switch - Caroming 4 Eruptive 2
Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842469834832.png?v=1 abyssalscourge] Main-hand - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh] Off-hand - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513206794752098327.png?v=1 khopeshoh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656785061072338954.png?v=1 rapieroh] Flanking switch - Flanking 4 Eruptive 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274330676061278334.png?v=1 masterwork2hsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] 2-handed - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 + Precise 6 Ruthless 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] Halberd (AoE) - Aftershock 4 Precise 2 + Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 masterworkspearofannihilation] MW Spear of Annihilation - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 + Lunging 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] Statius' Warhammer - Aftershock 1
Necromancy
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511720455143539.png?v=1 devourersguard] Main-hand - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern] Off-hand - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1365390498369372230.png?v=1 barrowssoulbound] Switch - Flanking 4 Eruptive 1
See !necroperks for an explanation of why reversed perks are no longer recommended.
Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow] 2-handed - Precise 6 Caroming 1 + Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1560137984848691200.png?v=1 malachistooth] Main-hand - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1560139473314906151.png?v=1 malachisclaw] Off-hand - Caroming 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] Hydrix Grico switch - Caroming 4 + Aftershock 1 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879230738434.png?v=1 bbcoh] Off-hand (for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]) - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] (Off-style) SGB - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 + Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891494977765446.png?v=1 sunspear] Planted Feet switch - Aftershock 1 + Planted Feet

Advanced Armour/Shield Perks

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1 tumekenrobetop] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/552955120707698699.png?v=1 elitetectbody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336168363561041.png?v=1 cryptbloomtop] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1388314908638183514.png?v=1 mwmrobetop] Body - Biting 4 X + Relentless 5 Crackling 4 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500691772112956.png?v=1 tumekenrobebottom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177869272121344.png?v=1 elitetectlegs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336167432159283.png?v=1 cryptbloombottoms] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1388314906671059015.png?v=1 mwmrobebottom] Legs - Impatient 4 X + Energizing 4 Invigorating 3 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553021457645579.png?v=1 Merciless] Merciless Kiteshield - Turtling 4 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976219612708954.png?v=1 arcanespiritshield] Arcane Spirit Shield - Lucky 4 Absorbative 2
Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189295592161291.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavoctop] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536966366272552960.png?v=1 tmwbody] Body - Biting 4 X + Relentless 5 Crackling 4 ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189293515980902.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavocbottom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643847107186524200.png?v=1 tmwlegs] Legs - Impatient 4 X + Ultimatums 4 X ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553024536252466.png?v=1 malevkite] Malevolent Kiteshield - Turtling 4
Necromancy

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Note: a Table of Contents is available in this page’s contents navigation.

​

Introduction

Scavenging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] is an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] perk which provides players a chance to get uncommon or rare components as a drop, whenever they kill an NPC.

​

⬥ Each rank provides a 1% chance per rank for uncommon components to drop from a kill, with a 1% chance that they will be rare components instead.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scavenging 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1 scavenging4] on level 20 equipment provides a 4.4% chance per kill, of activation, with a 1% chance that the components will be rare instead of uncommon.

⬥ Check the wiki for more information about [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenging Scavenging] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging]

⬥ Killing monsters en masse for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] procs is called scav farming, a low effort/AFK way to obtain a variety of components.

​

Acquiring Scavenging 4

⬥ With Ancient Invention unlocked, scavenging 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1 scavenging4] should be obtained by placing 9 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604724224008.png?v=1 preciouscomp] into an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prepare a few gizmos as the chance for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1 scavenging4] is 1/15.4 at 137 Invention.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Visit the wiki's [https://tinyurl.com/bdfskkd9 perk calculator] to calculate your chances at lower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] levels.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure you use an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1 extremeinventionpotion]

​

Components

Components obtained from scav farming are not only useful for making perks, but also crafting items which are profitable, including but not limited to:

​

Uncommon components

  1. Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Obtainable from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434584679776256.png?v=1 livingcomp]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Also requires - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434336737427475.png?v=1 platedparts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183200866321.png?v=1 connectorparts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109432592945659904.png?v=1 redchin]

  1. Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1 augmentor]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Obtainable from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434584113283072.png?v=1 enhancingcomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604644663299.png?v=1 powerfulcomp]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Also requires - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507182880686125.png?v=1 incand] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183448330270.png?v=1 baseparts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317699743754.png?v=1 flexibleparts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317720584224.png?v=1 tensileparts]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Other energies can also be used.

  1. Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869644175069204.png?v=1 equipmentsiphon]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Obtainable from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026263191563.png?v=1 dextrouscomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604724224008.png?v=1 preciouscomp]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Also requires - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434336741621761.png?v=1 simpleparts]

​

Rare components

  1. Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409577014599701.png?v=1 gsunshinecodex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409580420374568.png?v=1 gdeathsswiftcodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Obtainable from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430147538026496.png?v=1 cywircomp]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Also requires - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189285102202890.png?v=1 lostknowledgecodex]

  1. Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109427809140609054.png?v=1 alchonyx]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Obtainable from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435543845797891.png?v=1 fortunatecomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604724224008.png?v=1 preciouscomp]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Also requires - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604501794883.png?v=1 refinedcomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485544188391424.png?v=1 onyx]

  1. Making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004453774494015519.png?v=1 undeadslayercodex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004453772233293916.png?v=1 dragonslayercodex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004453770924658828.png?v=1 demonslayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Obtainable from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026229506058.png?v=1 oceaniccomp] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004453774494015519.png?v=1 undeadslayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435452556640259.png?v=1 resilientcomp] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004453772233293916.png?v=1 dragonslayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429563465730.png?v=1 silentcomp] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004453770924658828.png?v=1 demonslayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Also requires - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643162243571122196.png?v=1 blackstoneheart] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485544188391424.png?v=1 onyx]

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

⬥ Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Ful Scripture of Ful] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful]     • Activate to increase your kph, with no extra inputs required ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Bik Scripture of Bik] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109791735848.png?v=1 scriptureofbik]     • Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher] is toggled off for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109791735848.png?v=1 scriptureofbik] to trigger during combat. Can still have bone collector toggled on ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Spirit_weed_incense_sticks Spirit weed incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 spiritsticks] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lantadyme_incense_sticks Lantadyme incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 lantasticks]     • Passively increase your kph, and the duration of your potions ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_aggroverload#(6) Holy aggroverload] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1 holyaggroverload]     • Upkeep, or place in a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739200407654431.png?v=1 potionreservoir] ⬥ Weapon with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Caroming Caroming 4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Magma_Tempest Magma Tempest] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Chain Greater Chain] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sunshine Greater Sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Totem_of_Summoning Totem of Summoning] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811539499.png?v=1 summtotem] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Luck_of_the_Dwarves_(relic_power) Luck of the Dwarves (relic power)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/987267727980912701.png?v=1 lotdrelic]     • Allows you to increase your kph by wearing a better ring ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Note Death Note (relic power)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150755093426216.png?v=1 deathnote]     • Allows for automatic looting of noted bones in conjunction with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Smoke_devil Smoke devil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109432590865281126.png?v=1 smokedevil] with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Smoke_Devil_scroll_(Dust_Cloud) Dust Cloud scrolls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109432587086200953.png?v=1 dustcloud]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405301623619624.png?v=1 spiritcape] allows your familiar to use its special move more often     • Ensure familiar combat mode is default, and the autofire rate is set to 1

​

Where to use Scavenging

Besides dedicated farming via [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging] (method below), it's a convenient perk to have for passive profit when engaging in any activity which requires killing large amounts of enemies. Consider bringing an armour piece with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1 scavenging4] if doing:

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] Slayer creatures - Check out [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Slayer Slayer guides] for details on methods. Examples include:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Nightmares - Popular AFK moneymaker, doable on and off-task.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Vyres - Popular combat method for training [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213693790519307.png?v=1 farming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Abyssal beast - Popular combat method for AFK gp and clues.

⬥ Champion scroll farming.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430543321071626.png?v=1 seiryu] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542326759435.png?v=1 bsd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542809235458.png?v=1 ambassador] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] Elite Dungeons - More effective for trash runs.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1037463867716018206.png?v=1 cluescroll] Gathering clues via combat.

​

Lumbridge Catacombs

After completing [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact The Blood Pact] quest, the Lumbridge Catacombs are unlocked.

​

⬥ This is the most effective location to farm for scavenging procs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There aren't any noteworthy drops besides the occasional [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skeleton_Champion's_scroll Skeleton Champion's scroll].

⬥ The catacombs are southeast of the Lumbridge lodestone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552337035767839.png?v=1 lumbridgelode]

​

Method: Skeletons ~4300 kph [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~5150-5400 kph [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/kuoEe5c2YL.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Go to the bottom floor and walk south-east then south, to where you find the Topaz statuette.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand on the tile shown above, 2 north and 1 west of the pillar in the center of the room.

​

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=341f5dbf-3053-4ef8-b105-fa569b5c3dae Magic (Seasingers)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=fcd0d19b-462e-426f-bc31-52750efd33a1 Magic (Power Armour)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c1bd0b1a-2882-4890-a531-addca9a7e0eb Melee (Tetsu)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d5bea91c-d176-4252-af29-62c1e824f64c Melee (Power Armour)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd5bea91c-d176-4252-af29-62c1e824f64c.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ With Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] a minimum hit of 2100 with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Purifying_Light Purifying Light] is necessary to obtain optimal kph.     • This can be achieved with the following: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Reaper_Crew Reaper Crew], salve amulet (e) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet], Equilibrium 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504357414207490.png?v=1 eq1] Undead Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk], and Ruthless 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3]     • It is still possible to achieve optimal kph if using ports armour (offstyle works), this allows for [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ports_resource_crate ports resource crates] via the set effect.
Setup with Equilibrium 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504357414207490.png?v=1 eq1] Undead Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]
⬥ If using t95 (t100) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799750416637993.png?v=1 p2], an additional damage bonus of 133 (86) is necessary.     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6], you only need an additional damage bonus of 53 (7).     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689551388576972805.png?v=1 aggroverload] you only need an additional damage bonus of 91 (43).     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1 holyaggroverload] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313898068738151.png?v=1 ultimatestrength] you only need an additional damage bonus of 11 (0).
Alternative with Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] Undead Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]
⬥ If using t95 (t100) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799750416637993.png?v=1 p2], an additional damage bonus of 61 (15) is necessary.     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6], additional damage bonus is not necessary.     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689551388576972805.png?v=1 aggroverload], you only need an additional damage bonus of 18 (0).     • If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1 holyaggroverload] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313898068738151.png?v=1 ultimatestrength], additional damage bonus is not necessary.

​

Ability Bar

⬥ Magic

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nQO1MICmJ0.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/M7gZPhllSa.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YuR7gDGkfWg Skeleton Magic]

​

Chaos Dwarf Battlefield

After completing the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forgiveness_of_a_Chaos_Dwarf Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf] quest, the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield is unlocked.

​

⬥ This location hosts an abundance of mobs which are profitable to kill.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chaos dwogres, chaos dwarves and hand cannoneers can all drop the dragon pickaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1145061199118086215.png?v=1 dragonpick]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Chaos dwarf hand cannoneers can drop the hand cannon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891495037272094.png?v=1 handcannon]

⬥ The Chaos Dwarf Battlefield can be easily accessed by using a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 lotd] to teleport to Keldagrim, and running south past the Giant Dwarf statue, then following the southwestern path to the cave entrance.

​

Method: Dwogres ~2400 kph

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Q02oPqHM9s.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Stand on the left tile, and place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] on the right tile.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] yields a higher kph but is more expensive.

​

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c7w8rckczkiN1xj48NSH Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fc7w8rckczkiN1xj48NSH.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mtd2ahThEN.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/OUB0btsLK1I Dwogre Magic ~2400 kph]

​

Waterbirth Island Dungeon

The Waterbirth Island Dungeon doesn't require any quests to be unlocked, and hosts an abundance of mobs which can be killed to farm for scavenging procs.

​

⬥ This location is notable because at ~3950 kph, you can expect ~2000 crimson charms per hour.

⬥ The Waterbirth Island Dungeon can be easily accessed via the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enchanted_lyre enchanted lyre].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Hard_Fremennik_achievements hard Fremennik achievements] to be completed.

​

Method: Dagannoths ~3950 kph

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fUStAfQVRD.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Stand and place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] on the tile shown above.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Line yourself up with the rock in the water, then walk 6 east and 1 north from the edge of the water.

​

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8zGAnOvcVP0qygB8mdHG Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8zGAnOvcVP0qygB8mdHG.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ovqBfuu1bU.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/ZJsZImHxjhA Dagannoth Magic ~3950 kph]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

​

Unlike OSRS which has the RuneLite client, RS3 only has its NXT client. In order to add some extra QoL/features, the Alt1 Toolkit was developed by @skillbert. This guide serves as a brief overview about Alt1 and what it's used for, as well as some extra helpful add-ons/plugins developed for it.

Alt1 Download
You can download Alt1 from the official [https://runeapps.org/alt1 RuneApps website]. For Alt1 support/queries, please visit the [https://discord.gg/G3SbcS8 RuneApps discord (external Discord)]. You can also check out the [https://runeapps.org/forums/ RuneApps forums].

​

If you have any issues with regard to Alt1, please use the dedicated RuneApps discord server that has a section for player support.

​

Alt1 Overview

What Is Alt1

Alt1 is a 3rd-party program that consists of several application overlays on your screen. They get information by reading your screen, and provide a bunch of QoL/useful features.

​

A detailed explanation of Alt1's features can be found on the Alt1 website, but amongst its default features it includes:

⬥ AFK Warden - the most common use for Alt1, its in-game activity detection overlays

⬥ Clue Solver - solves all clue puzzles and displays output as an overlay to speed up clue solving

⬥ DgKey - an overlay of your Dungeoneering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering] map to keep track of gatestones, teammates, etc.

⬥ Stats Lookup - look up a player's stats ;stats;, quest points, etc.

⬥ Item Lookup - quickly find any item's page on the Runescape Wiki

⬥ D&D Notifications - opt-in for D&D notification alerts

⬥ XpMeter - track XP/hr rates in real time

⬥ Droplogger - an alternative to using the endgame RuneMetrics drop log

​

How It Works

⬥ Alt1 is designed to capture images of the NXT Client and parse them with an OCR (Optical Character Recognition) Library.

⬥ The captured data is then transformed into pixel data that can be used in Alt1 apps.

⬥ More information can be found on the forums and in the Alt1 Toolkit discord.

​

Is It Safe?

⬥ Alt1 is essentially a glorified Chromium browser that creates overlays over your game. Every Alt1 app is essentially a webpage.

⬥ Alt1 does not send any inputs or otherwise directly interact with your client beyond reading the pixels on the screen.

⬥ It is not a client, therefore you won't get banned for using it.

​

AFK Warden

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UG5psi4.png Guide illustration]

What Is AFK Warden

⬥ This is one of the most commonly used Alt1 apps, so will be covered in some detail here.

⬥ This reads the pixels on your screen to recognize your character, buff bars, chatbox and more in order to provide AFK alert notifications.

⬥ It tracks a number of things, including:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 Constitution] and Prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] alerts

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Buff timers like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 LantaSticks]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiar duration [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Loot beams [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AFK lobby timers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Seren Spirits and Blessings of the Gods

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Character stance (for AFK skilling alerts)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• XP drops, and more.

​

Clue Solver

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EhTPOsI.png Guide illustration]

What Is Clue Solver

⬥ This is a very useful app that looks at your currently open clue on screen, and tells you how to solve it.

⬥ It handles all clue steps, including puzzle boxes, scans, compass clues, etc. With the exception of scan clues.

⬥ Have your clue visible on-screen clearly and click the 'Unlock Any' button to find a solution to your clue that will be displayed on the overlay.

​

Useful 3rd-Party Alt1 Apps

In addition to the default apps that come with Alt1, there are a number of other useful third-party apps that can be installed, which will briefly be covered here.

​

How to Install Alt1 Apps

⬥ Alt1 Addons can be installed by going to the correct URL in either your normal browser or the Alt1 in-built browser.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will bring up a prompt to add the application to Alt1.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The list of apps below have the full URL following each one.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that none of these links will work on mobile, as they require Alt1 to be installed.

​

Combat Apps

⬥ Barrows Helper - track killed brothers, solve doors and displays droprates

alt1://addapp/https://markvsrs.github.io/BarrowsHelperSrc/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Better AoD - improved minion order tracker over the default Alt1 tracker

alt1://addapp/https://cgyi4.csb.app/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Better Buffs Bar - displays buffs in the order you decide on

alt1://addapp/https://nadyanayme.github.io/better-better-buffs-bars/appconfig.json

​

⬥ BoLG Tracker - shows BoLG [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] stacks more clearly

alt1://addapp/https://holycoil.nl/alt1/bolg/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Dharok Relic - shows the %DPS boost from Berserker's Fury

alt1://addapp/https://holycoil.nl/alt1/DharokRelic/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Igor's Presets - Boss Presets Hub for Multiple bosses

https://github.com/IgorsCC/afkwarden-presets/blob/master/readme.md

​

⬥ Job Gauges - FFXIV-inspired job gauges for Runescape combat styles. Currently only Necro, Mage, and Range (WIP) is supported.

alt1://addapp/https://nadyanayme.github.io/job-gauges/dist/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Rotation Master - Input an ability rotation to be able to display an overlay on your screen for rotational help.

alt1://addapp/https://ellamental2.github.io/RotationMaster/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Slayer Tasks - helps decide what [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] task to pick when using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344597934120.png?v=1 slayervip] tickets

alt1://addapp/https://unlishema.github.io/slayerassistant/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Vorago Timer - shows Target Cycle (TC) timings for Vorago phases

alt1://addapp/https://holycoil.nl/alt1/VoragoTag/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Zamorak Specs - shows the next special attack at Zamorak

alt1://addapp/https://zerogwafa.github.io/Zamorak-Attack-Tracker/appconfig.json

​

Skilling Apps

⬥ Archaeology Mats - tracks excavated Archaeology [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] mats and calculate artefact restore costs

alt1://addapp/https://zerogwafa.github.io/ArchMatCounter/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Components Counter - tracks Invention [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 Invention] components from disassembly / scavenging

alt1://addapp/https://zerogwafa.github.io/ComponentCounter/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Croesus Alerts - displays upcoming attacks and other fight information at Croesus

alt1://addapp/https://raphire.github.io/SusAlert/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Penguins - shows weekly Penguin locations (pulled from www.w60pengs.com)

alt1://addapp/https://shaun.us.to/alt1/penguins/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Seren Spirit Tracker - alerts when a Seren Spirit appears

alt1://addapp/https://zerogwafa.github.io/SerenTracker/appconfig.json

​

Clue Apps

⬥ Clue Trainer - An alternative, fully featured clue solver featuring improved puzzle solvers and recommendations for efficient movement [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1037463867716018206.png?v=1 cluescroll]

alt1://addapp/https://cluetrainer.app/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Bik Book Timer - alerts when to disassemble with Bik book [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109791735848.png?v=1 scriptureofbik]

alt1://addapp/https://amerryma.github.io/alt1-bik-proc-timer/appconfig.json

​

⬥ OpenLogger - an open source clue logger that will help keep track of your clues as you open them

alt1://addapp/https://redx1000.github.io/OpenLogger/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Catalyst Tracker - tracks clues from Catalyst of alterations displayed in the chat window

alt1://addapp/https://ibbykay.github.io/CatalystClueTracker/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Clue Splits - automatically tracks your clue times while doing a clue run, with no input required [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

alt1://addapp/https://yongyi781.github.io/clue-split/appconfig.json

​

Misc. Apps

Note: Price Check & Trade Alt1 App currently not working; in the process of being updated.

⬥ Screen Markers - customisable on-screen markers to make clicking easier

alt1://addapp/https://kosblue.com/nekoapps/apps/ScreenMarkers/appconfig.json

​

⬥ Quest Helper - shows steps for quests that you pick

alt1://addapp/https://techpure.dev/RS3QuestBuddy/appconfig.prod.json

​

⬥ Dungeoneering Helper - Logs your Dungeoneering floor times automatically

alt1://addapp/https://dghelper.pages.dev/appconfig.json

​

Troubleshooting

For any issues it is preferred to search if someone else has had the same issue or see the FAQ section on the forums, or use the official discord for support.

​

Use the RuneApps website, forum and external Discord links provided in this guide.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

This guide displays calculated GP/kill and related values for many commonly farmed bosses. The source calculations use GE list prices. Prices in this captured edition do not update automatically. Drop rates are sourced from the Runescape Wiki.

​

How To Use This Guide

To calculate your expected hourly profits [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] for a given boss, take the listed GP/kill total and multiply it by your kills per hour (KPH). Any listed KPH rates below are based on the current meta farming methods, to allow for comparison between bosses.

​

To use your own KPH values, visit the PvME spreadsheet [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OGM9MBUG2bQVbHxlm86Xfs60soFcjINSOrPv1WL3Vgw/ here], make a copy, and edit KPH values in the "Boss Revenue" sheet.

​

Note: The numbers provided do not take into account supply costs, with the exception of Magister and Legiones where key costs have been accounted for.

​

Amascut

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Amascut,_the_Devourer#Drops Wiki]
GP/Kill

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

Note: Use the Table of Contents in this page’s contents navigation to find the information you are looking for.

​

Some general notes:

⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: 1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds).

⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: 1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s.

⬥ Auto attacks will only give adrenaline if they hit (splash = no adrenaline gain).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Debuff spells like Vuln [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] or Enfeeble [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 Enfeeble] or Smoke Cloud [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] do not give adrenaline.

⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.

​

Ability Damage Maths
To calculate your ability hit damage in detail, [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/ click here]. This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
Ability Hit Timings
To see detailed breakdowns on ability hit timings, [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rK7u17JN6I-vf3dKBKg6tm9IPWje9EWSe_r8KPdsxoc/edit?usp=sharing click here]. This refers to when hitsplats appear on your target.
Auto-attack Adren Gain
To see adrenaline gained with different auto attacks, [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invigorating click here].

Note: If you have any difficulties in using the tools or understanding what the information means, you can always ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)].

​

Constitution [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

This section covers auto attacks, basics, thresholds, ultimate abilities and special attacks for Defence.

​

Autos

Default Auto [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]
⬥ Cooldown: Based on Weapon Speed     • Fastest: 4t (2.4s)     • Fast: 5t (3.0s)     • Average: 6t (3.6s) ⬥ Takes on style of main hand weapon

​

Basics

Siphon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050198012854275.png?v=1 siphon]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Only works on targets with more adrenaline than you

​

Sacrifice [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065907322880.png?v=1 sacrifice]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Heal for 25% of your damage dealt     • Increased to 100% if killing hit

​

Storm Shards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Stacks delayed ability damage on target     • Up to 10 stacks     • Damage is triggered by using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter] ⬥ Damage when triggered is dependant on weapon which applied the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards]

​

Regenerate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770309315997836.png?v=1 regenerate]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Must be out of combat to use ⬥ Trades 10% adrenaline for 2% of max health per tick until either     • Health is full; or     • Adrenaline is empty; or     • Combat is initiated

​

Eat Food [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073883122069934182.png?v=1 eatfood]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Eats food

​

Tuska's Wrath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas]
⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s)     • 25t (15s) if used on non slayer target ⬥ If enemy is your active slayer target, it will do 100*(Slayer level damage)     • All bosses except The Magister are immune to this effect

​

Thresholds

Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 reprisal]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Duration: 10t (6s), or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 reprisal] is cast again ⬥ Stores incoming damage while active (up to 30,000) ⬥ Stored damage dealt to target at end of duration

​

Shatter [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter]
⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s) ⬥ Unleashes all Storm Shards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] on target ⬥ Maximum hit of 30,000 ⬥ Damage is based on weapon which applied [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] , but effected by damage boosts when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter] is used

​

Special Attacks

Essence of Finality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Adrenaline cost: dependant on weapon stored in Essence of Finality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] ⬥ main hand weapon must be of the same style as weapon stored
This ability requires an Essence of Finality with a stored weapon

​

Weapon Special Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s)     • Some weapons have their own weapon specific cooldown ⬥ Duration: dependant on weapon

​

Ultimates

Guthix's Blessing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196767145995.png?v=1 guthixsblessing]
⬥ Cooldown: 500t (300s) ⬥ Duration: 16t (9.6s) ⬥ Every 4t (1.6s) heal for 8% of your max HP     • Enemies may target the butterfly and end effects early ⬥ Shares cooldown with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal]

​

Ice Asylum [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196817215491.png?v=1 iceasylum]
⬥ Cooldown: 500t (300s) ⬥ Duration: 34t (22.2s) ⬥ Heals players nearby for 1 - 7% of their max HP (based on proximity) every 6t (3.6s) ⬥ Healing capacity of 300% of your max HP ⬥ Shares cooldown with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal]

​

Onslaught [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159085207555.png?v=1 onsl]
⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s) ⬥ Channeled ability ⬥ Up to 26 hits     • Drain adrenaline 25 at per hit to 0     • Subsequent hits damage you for 25% of the outgoing hit

​

Transfigure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196523876354.png?v=1 transfigure]
⬥ Cooldown: 300t (180s) ⬥ Duration: 10t (6s) of incapacitation, then 25t (15s) of stun and bind immunity ⬥ Heal for 250% of damage taken during incapacitation, when it ends, up to a maximum 75% of max HP

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] Constitution Ability Index [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]
⬥ Click the links to quickly navigate to that ability's information. ⬥ General notes can be found in the introduction [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#introduction|here]].
Auto and Basics (1/2)
⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-defaultauto|Default Auto]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-eatfood|Eat Food]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-regenerate|Regenerate]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-sacrifice|Sacrifice]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-siphon|Siphon]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-stormshards|Storm Shards]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-tuskaswrath|Tuska's Wrath]]
Thresholds
⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-reprisal|Reprisal]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-shatter|Shatter]]
Special Attacks
⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-essenceoffinality|Essence of Finality]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-weaponspecialattack|Special Attack]]
Ultimates
⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-guthixsblessing|Guthix's Blessing]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-iceasylum|Ice Asylum]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-onslaught|Onslaught]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Constitution Abilities#block-transfigure|Transfigure]]

​

Defence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence]

This section covers auto attacks, basics, thresholds, ultimate abilities and special attacks for Defence.

​

Autos

Default Defence Auto [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence]
⬥ Cooldown: Based on Weapon Speed     • Fastest: 4t (2.4s)     • Fast: 5t (3.0s)     • Average: 6t (3.6s) ⬥ Takes on style of main hand weapon

​

Basics

Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Duration: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ Reduces all incoming damage by 10% ⬥ Provides stun immunity

​

Bash [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306546716692.png?v=1 bash]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Basic offensive ability
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Cease [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864235458464186418.png?v=1 cease]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Stops the following:     • Channelled abilities     • Familiar attacks for 10t (6s)     • Auto-retaliate for 10t (6s)     • Queued abilities ⬥ Cancelled by attacking target ⬥ Generates no adrenaline

​

Divert [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Duration: 10t (6s) ⬥ Shares cooldown with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] ⬥ Generates 0.8 to 50 adrenaline (1.6 to 100 under the effects of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat])     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Divert Divert calculator]
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Duration: 10t (6s) ⬥ Removes and grants immunity to stuns and binds ⬥ Clears any existing damage over time effects

​

Preparation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Duration: 16t (9.6s) ⬥ Reduces any remaining cooldown of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] by 5t (3s) per attack received
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke]
⬥ Cooldown: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ Forces enemy to target you     • Some enemies have other methods of aggression rendering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] useless ⬥ Castable off gcd     • Will trigger gcd if used on gcd

​

Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Duration: 10t (6s) ⬥ Shares cooldown with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] ⬥ Heal for (50 + 0.5 x shield tier)% of incoming hit
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Thresholds

Debilitate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Duration: 13t (7.8s) to 23t (13.8s)     • Extended if cast with a shield/defender     • If shield/defender removed the effects are removed     • A full table is available on the wiki [https://runescape.wiki/w/Debilitate#Duration here] ⬥ Reduces damage from the effected target

​

Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Duration: 15t (9.6s) to 30t (19.2s)     • Killing an enemy adds 8t (4.8s) to base duration ⬥ While active protection prayers are 100% effective

​

Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Duration: 316t (9.6s) ⬥ Incoming damage reduced by 50% ⬥ Reduced damage returned to sender
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Revenge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259645878302.png?v=1 revenge]
⬥ Cooldown: 75t (45s) ⬥ Duration: 32t (19.2s) ⬥ Increases outgoing damage done while wielding shield/defender     • Up to 10 stacks can be built     • Each stack adds 10% (5% with defender) damage to your attacks
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Ultimates

Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) to 140t (84s)     • Effected by turtling perk ⬥ Duration: 8t (4.8s) to 29t (17.4s)     • Effected by shield tier, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1 malletops], and turtling perk ⬥ Full table of duration and cooldowns can be found [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Barricade here] ⬥ Blocks all incoming damage except hard typeless
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Immortality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort]
⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s) ⬥ Duration: 50t (30s)     • Or until returned to life ⬥ Reduces taken damage by 25% ⬥ Be revived to 40% HP if dead while active     • 3t (1.8s) immunity to all damage while being revived     • Instakills avoid this effect
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat]
⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s) ⬥ Duration: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Doubles ability adrenaline gain

​

Rejuvenate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258873995284.png?v=1 rejuvenate]
⬥ Cooldown: 500t (300s) ⬥ Duration: 16t (9.6s) ⬥ Gain 2.5% of hp per tick while active (40% total) ⬥ Shares cooldown with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal]
This ability requires a shield or defender - the effects will be lost if removed.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Defence Ability Index [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence]
⬥ Click the links to quickly navigate to that ability's information. ⬥ General notes can be found in the introduction [[PvME/Combat reference/Defence Abilities#introduction|here]].
Auto and Basics (1/2)
⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Defence Abilities#block-defaultdefenceauto|Default Auto]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Defence Abilities#block-anticipate|Anticipate]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Defence Abilities#block-bash|Bash]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Defence Abilities#block-cease|Cease]] ⬥ [[PvME/Combat reference/Defence Abilities#block-divert|Divert]]
