Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

This section covers auto attacks and spells, basic abilities, enhanced abilities, ultimate abilities, utility abilities and special attacks for Magic.

​

Autos and Spells

Barrages [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage]
⬥ It is an AoE:     • 3x3 AoE     • Secondary targets take reduced damage (0.7x) ⬥ Each element has different effects when cast:     • Smoke: Enemy hit chance reduced by 5% for 16t (9.6s)     • Shadow: Enemy damage reduced by 5% for 16t (9.6s)     • Blood: Heals you for 5% of damage dealt     • Ice: Enemy is bound for 16t (9.6s)

​

Blitzes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535616247807868938.png?v=1 bloodblitz]
⬥ Single target version of Barrages ⬥ Effects last for 12t (7.2s)

​

Vulnerability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln]
⬥ Increases damage dealt by 10% ⬥ Lasts 60s

​

Incite Fear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]
⬥ Every ability cast applies a stack:     • Caps at 5 stacks, and at max stacks uses no runes on ability casts     • Stacks are lost after 20s, refreshed upon applying another stack     • Each stack reduces Tsunami's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] cast cost by -12% adrenaline ⬥ Frost Surge:     • At 5 stacks, ability casts trigger Frost Surge; deals 10-50% ability damage     • Triggering it costs runes even at max stacks     • Frost Surge is a 5x5 AoE around your primary target which hits up to 8 extra targets in range for 10-50% ability damage each     • Frost Surge has a 12s cooldown, after an ability cast can trigger it again

​

Exsanguinate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate]
⬥ Every ability cast applies a stack:     • Caps at 12 stacks, and at max stacks uses no runes on ability casts     • Stacks are lost after 20s, refreshed upon applying another stack     • Each stack increases basic ability damage by +1%

​

Smoke Cloud [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud]
⬥ Increases damage dealt with critical hits by 15% for Magic, 6% otherwise ⬥ Lasts 120s

​

Animate Dead [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead]
⬥ Applies a flat damage reduction:     • Reduction based on 10% of equipped magic tank gear's armour + 25% of your current Defence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] level after any buffs or debuffs     • Damage reduced cannot exceed 60% of the damage taken     • 60% cap is based off the damage after all other damage reductions such as deflect prayers ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage]) on the hit ⬥ Lasts 12 minutes ⬥ Does not reduce [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] HP / adrenaline gain ⬥ A calculator can be found [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Animate_Dead here]

​

Basic Abilities

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1 magic_basic]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Applies auto-cast spell effect ⬥ Auto triggered during combat

​

Sonic Wave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063115709972651.png?v=1 sonic]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Applies Flow to self for 15t (9s) ⬥ Next Magic ability uses 10% less adrenaline

​

Greater Sonic Wave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Applies Greater Flow to self for 15t (9s) ⬥ Next Magic ability uses 20% less adrenaline

​

Dragon Breath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]
⬥ Cooldown: 12t (7.2s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • AoE is straight line to target + 3x3 around it     • Hits 5 targets, inclusive of main ⬥ It is affected by Kerapac's wrist wraps [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869286640722513940.png?v=1 kerapacswristwraps]:     • Next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] to hit within 10t of the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] cast will have remaining hits instantly hit at 25% more damage     • Within 10t means: if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] is cast t0, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] has to hit within t0-9         ⬩ Latest you can cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] is t7 ⬥ It is affected by the Dragonrider Amulet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656785090994503700.png?v=1 drider]     • Boosts damage by 10%     • Has a 10% chance of applying a 3-hit DoT, each for 10% of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] max hit, rounded down (excludes boosts that do not normally boost bleeds)

​

Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s)     • Charges: 2 ⬥ Stuns and binds for 3t (1.8s) ⬥ It is affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon]:     • Increases Max by 40% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] rank     • Increases Minimum by 8% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] Rank     • No longer stuns or binds

​

Combust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust]
⬥ Cooldown: 30t (18s) ⬥ It is a Burn:     • Not affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005204971886743572.png?v=1 precise]     • Hits every 3t (1.8s), for a total of 10 times ⬥ Affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009423860875153559.png?v=1 lunging]:     • Increases damage by 10% + 3% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009423860875153559.png?v=1 lunging] rank ⬥ Affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] modified by Kerapac's wrist wraps [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869286640722513940.png?v=1 kerapacswristwraps]     • Next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] to hit within 10t of the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] cast will have remaining hits instantly hit at 25% more damage     • Within 10t means: if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] is cast t0, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] has to hit within t0-9         ⬩ Latest you can cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] is t7 ⬥ Deals 40% increased damage if used within 15 seconds of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063105182269460.png?v=1 chain]
⬥ Cooldown: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Hits within a 5 square radius from SW tile of initial target     • Hits 3 targets, inclusive of main     • Does not hit things on initial target's SW tile ⬥ Secondary targets hit by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063105182269460.png?v=1 chain] take the next ability cast on your main target within 6s at 30% ⬥ Affected by Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063105182269460.png?v=1 chain] secondary target damage increased by 5% + 5% per Caroming rank

​

Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain]
⬥ Cooldown: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Hits within a 5 square radius from SW tile of initial target     • Hits 7 targets, inclusive of main     • Does not hit things on initial target's SW tile ⬥ Secondary targets hit by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] take the next ability cast on your main target within 6s at 50% ⬥ Affected by Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] secondary target damage increased by 5% + 5% per Caroming rank

​

Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063109712121856.png?v=1 conc]
⬥ Cooldown: 9t (5.4s) ⬥ Provides a passive critical hit buff     • 5% increased crit chance for each hit ⬥ Channelled ability     • Hits a maximum of 3 times over 5t (3s)

​

Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc]
⬥ Cooldown: 9t (5.4s) ⬥ Provides a passive critical hit buff     • 7% increased crit chance for each hit ⬥ Channelled ability     • Hits a maximum of 3 times over 5t (3s)

​

Enhanced Abilities

Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]
⬥ Cooldown: 9t (5.4s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ Two separate, strong hits

​

Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ Stuns for 6t (3.6s) ⬥ Channelled ability, 4 hits at full channel duration (7t, 4.2s)

​

Smoke Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 Smoke_Tendrils]
⬥ Cooldown: 75t (45s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 0% ⬥ Channelled ability, 4 hits at full channel duration (7t, 4.2s) ⬥ Inflicts self-damage each hit ⬥ Each hit is a guaranteed critical hit

​

Magma Tempest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 35t (21s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 20% ⬥ Is a 5x5 area-of-effect ⬥ Hits every 1.2s (2t) over 9.6s for a total of 8 hits ⬥ Cannot critical hit ⬥ Has two variants, see differences using !magma

​

Corruption Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1 corruption_blast]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 20% ⬥ It is a DoT:     • Not affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005204971886743572.png?v=1 precise]     • Hits every 2t (1.2s), for a total of 5 times ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Spreads to targets within 2 tiles each hit

​

Special Attacks

Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% (22.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Applies an affinity and defence reduction:     • +2 affinity     • Reduces [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] level by 5% of base

​

Armadyl Battlestaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1 armadylbattlestaff]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Channelled ability, 5 hits at full channel duration (5t, 3s) ⬥ Subsequent hits deal increasing damage

​

Iban's Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929543068618752.png?v=1 ibansstaff]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])
Legatus's Emberstaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1 legatusemberstaff]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 35% (31.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Deals 1% increased damage for each 1% life points the target is missing     • Up to a maximum of 75%
Roar of Awakening [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening]
⬥ Special Attack: Soulfire ⬥ Cooldown: 75t (45s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 35% (31.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Hits every 1.8s (3t) over 12.6s for a total of 7 hits. ⬥ Gain Conflagrate buff for 15s (25t).     • Next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] deals 40% increased damage. ⬥ Can get reset while having at least 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1 essencecorruption]     • For more information on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1 essencecorruption], use !essencecorruption in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)]

​

Fractured Staff of Armadyl [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa]
⬥ Special Attack: Instability ⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Lasts 50t (30s) ⬥ Whenever a magic critical hit is inflicted on primary target, an additional Time Strike will be fired     • Time Strike deals 90%-110% damage to your current target ⬥ For more information on how to use the special attack, use !fsoa in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)]

​

Ultimate Abilities

Omnipower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 60% ⬥ Affected by the Igneous Kal-Mej [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] and Igneous Kal-Zuk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]     • Fires 4 hits     • Increases average ability damage from 460% to 540%

​

Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 100% ⬥ It is an on cast buff ⬥ Increases damage by 50% from t0→t51 (52t/31.2s duration); buff starts t1 ⬥ 7x7 buff radius ⬥ Does not incur the auto cooldown ⬥ Planted Feet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] increases duration to t0→t64 (65t/39s)); buff starts t1

​

Greater Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 100% ⬥ Duration becomes t0→t64 (65t/39s duration); buff starts t1     • Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] does not extend this further ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] retains the DoT effect of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine]     • Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] will cancel this

​

Tsunami [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 100% ⬥ It is an AoE ⬥ Provides a Critical Adrenaline buff:     • For the next 30s, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] critical hits give 8% adrenaline     • This buff is applied on release of the ability ⬥ Adrenaline cost can be reduced through auto-casting Incite Fear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]     • Each stack reduces [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] adrenaline cost by 12, down to 40% at 5 stacks

​

Utility Abilities

Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ It is a Mobility ability:     • Moves you forward 10 tiles ⬥ Affected by Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob]     • Reduces cooldown to 17t (10.2s) ⬥ Can be upgraded with a Double Surge codex: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894414417944.png?v=1 surgecodex]     • Gives you a second [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] on its own 34t (17t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob]) internal cooldown that is used after the first

​

Runic Charge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Applies Anima Charged to self for 25t (15s), consumed once used ⬥ Anima Charged     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063115709972651.png?v=1 sonic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] Next Magic Ability costs 35%/45% less adrenaline     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] Increased damaged     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063109712121856.png?v=1 conc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] Each channel grants an additional 10% crit chance

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] Magic Ability Index [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

Note: Use the Table of Contents in this page’s contents navigation to find the information you are looking for.

​

Some general notes:

⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: 1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds).

⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: 1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s.

⬥ Auto attacks will only give adrenaline if they hit (splash = no adrenaline gain).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Debuff spells like Vuln [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] or Enfeeble [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 Enfeeble] or Smoke Cloud [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] do not give adrenaline.

⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.

​

Ability Damage Maths
To calculate your ability hit damage in detail, [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/melee click here]. This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
Ability Hit Timings
To see detailed breakdowns on ability hit timings, [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rK7u17JN6I-vf3dKBKg6tm9IPWje9EWSe_r8KPdsxoc/edit?usp=sharing click here]. This refers to when hitsplats appear on your target.
Auto-attack Adren Gain
To see adrenaline gained with different auto attacks, [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invigorating click here].

Note: If you have any difficulties in using the tools or understanding what the information means, you can always ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)].

​

Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

This section covers basic abilities, enhanced abilities, ultimate abilities, utility abilities and special attacks for Melee.

​

Basic Abilities

Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack

​

Adaptive Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]
⬥ Cooldown: 9t (5.4s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ Generates 12 Adrenaline ⬥ Depends on weapon used: • 2H: AoE in a cone of attack direction, hitting up to 9 targets, inclusive of main • DW: 2 hits on target

​

Rend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend]
⬥ Cooldown: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ Generates 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stacks ⬥ Affected by Gloves of Passage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1 Glovesofpassage], details in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]]

​

Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879510372352.png?v=1 fury]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ Next melee attack has +25% increased crit chance

​

Greater Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ Next non-bleed melee hit within 15s is guaranteed to crit     • Only affects first hit of a combo ability     • Is applied only to 1 target in AoE     • Bleeds do not consume buff

​

Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) • Charges: 2 ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ Stuns for 3t (1.8s) ⬥ It is affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon]     • Increases Max by 40% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] rank     • Increases Minimum by 8% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] rank     • No longer stuns or binds

​

Punish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]
⬥ Cooldown: 40t (24s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ Damage boosted by 2.5x when target is <50% health

​

Barge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ It is a Mobility ability:     • Will move you to Melee Distance ⬥ It is affected by Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob]     • Reduces cooldown to 17t (10.2s) ⬥ Binds for 11t (6.6s) ⬥ Clears Bound debuff

​

Greater Barge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust stack ⬥ All normal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] things apply ⬥ It has additional effects:     • Every tick (0.6s) since the player stopped attacking their target, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] gains +7% to its max range and +5% to its min, capping at 10t (6s) for a total of 100% and 20%. Damage range go from 75%-95% to 125%-165%     • After 8t (4.8s) pass since you stopped attacking, when you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge], if you cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1 flurry] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] within 10t (6s), it will convert the first one done into a damage over time ⬥ For details on how to use it, use !gbarge

​

Chaos Roar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Unlocked using a Chaos Roar ability codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189286960287764.png?v=1 chaosroarcodex] ⬥ Next Melee ability within 7.2s does 1.75x damage     • So, it doubles all hits of bleeds (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember]) and multi-hit attacks (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane])     • Channels have multiple casts, so only doubles the first cast (e.g [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] hit 1)

​

Enhanced Abilities

Assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault]
⬥ Cooldown: 10t (6s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ Channelled ability, can move while channelling ⬥ Bloodlust Assault (consumes 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust) • Increases damage from 140% AVG/hit to 180% AVG/hit

​

Hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ It is an AoE hitting up to 10 targets, inclusive of main:     • 3x3 with player as centre     • 5x5 with player as centre with Halberd-type weapon ⬥ Reduces the cooldown of Hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] by 3s for each enemy hit ⬥ Bloodlust Hurricane (consumes 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust) • Third AoE hitting up to 10 targets, inclusive of main

​

Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1 flurry]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ Channelled Ability, can move while channelling ⬥ Stuns and Binds the target for 6t (3.6s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • 3x3 with player as centre ⬥ Bloodlust Flurry (consumes 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] Bloodlust) • Deals 1% increased damage per % hp target is missing up to 65%

​

Greater Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ All normal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1 flurry] things apply ⬥ Each hit extends [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] by 1t/hit (0.6s/hit) for up to 8t (4.8s)

​

Dismember [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember]
⬥ Cooldown: 40t (24s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 0% ⬥ It is a damage over time:     • Not affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005204971886743572.png?v=1 precise] ⬥ Can be extended:     • Strength skillcape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] passive adds 3 hits     • Masterwork Spear of Annihilation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] adds 50% more hits ⬥ It is affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009423860875153559.png?v=1 lunging]     • Max hit increases by 10% + 3% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009423860875153559.png?v=1 lunging] rank ⬥ Can be recast 2 additional times within 24s of previous cast: • 1st cast: Hits every 2t (1.2s) for 8 (11 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] , 15 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] ) times, heals for 4% of damage • 2nd cast: Hits every 3t (1.8s) for 6 (9 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] , 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] ) times, heals for 6% of damage • 3rd cast: Hits every 3t (1.8s) for 7 (10 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] , 13 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1172654837616353320.png?v=1 strcape] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] ) times, heals for 12% of damage

​

Special Attacks

Ek-Zekkil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Marks target as Flamebound Rival, then deals damage     • Only applicable to one target at a time         ⬩ Effects only apply to Flamebound Rival ⬥ If wielding the Ek-Zekkil, fighting your Flamebound Rival will grant:     • 12% increased damage dealt on attacks (except bleeds)     • 12% reduced damage taken (from Flamebound Rival)     • Igneous Showdown an additional 3 (simultaneous) hits         ⬩ Refunds 15% adrenaline ⬥ Switching to Ek-ZekKil will reapply Flamebound Rival to initial target

​

Zaros Godsword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ On cast buff ⬥ 7x7 area (enemy you cast spec on takes damage every 3t (1.8s) while in it) ⬥ Increases damage by 25% from t0→34t (35t/21s duration)     • Buff starts t1 for autos, t2 for everything ⬥ Does not incur the auto cooldown, but will still attempt to force an auto ⬥ Can take weapon off and retain spec effect

​

Dragon Battleaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 DBA]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 100% (90% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Drains 10% (rounded down) of your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] levels and gain a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 Strength] level boost of 10 + 1 level for every 4 drained from your other stats ⬥ Boosts damage by 1.2 (stacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] for a 1.25 * 1.2 = 1.5 boost), or 1.1 when using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk], making it a 2 * 1.1 = 2.2 boost ⬥ Multiplicative 10% reduction to hitchance debuff ⬥ These effects lasts 1 minute ⬥ Can take weapon off and retain spec effect

​

Varanus's Mercy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])

​

Dragon Claws [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])

​

Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 35% (31.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Applies an affinity and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] reduction:     • +5 affinity     • Reduces [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] level by 30% of base

​

Dragon Scimitar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% (22.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Increases accuracy with slash weapons by 25% for 100t (60s)

​

Granite Maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 50% (45% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ Can be used during the GCD

​

Dark Shard of Leng [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 30% (27% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ It is an AoE ⬥ Consumes all [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] stacks ⬥ For every stack consumed     • Adrenaline Cost is reduced by 12%     • Each hit increased by 18-22%

​

Ultimate Abilities

Overpower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 60% ⬥ Affected by the Igneous Kal-Ket [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] and the Igneous Kal-Zuk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]:     • The ability has two hits.

​

Pulverise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 60% ⬥ Applies Pulverised debuff to target • Reduces damage dealt by target by 25% • If target dies with debuff, you gain 50% adrenaline

​

Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 100% ⬥ It is an on cast buff ⬥ It increases damage by 75% from t0→t33 (34t/20.4s duration) ⬥ Wearing 3+ pieces of Vestments [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189295592161291.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavoctop] extends the duration from t0→t33 (34t/20.4s) to t0→t43 (44t/26.6s) ⬥ It increases damage taken by 25% ⬥ Maximum Bloodlust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] increased by 4 ⬥ Basic attacks and basic abilities generate 2x Bloodlust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] ⬥ Overpower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] cooldown reduced to 15t (9s)

​

Meteor Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 60% ⬥ It is an AoE hitting up to 9 targets, inclusive of main:     • 3x3 with player as centre     • 5x5 with player as centre with Halberd-type weapon ⬥ Provides an Adrenaline buff for the next 30s:     • Melee basic abilities generate 1.5x Adrenaline • Generate 4.5% every 1t you have a Melee weapon equipped     • This buff is applied on release of the ability

​

Utility Abilities

Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ It is a Mobility ability:     • If you use it on a tile, it will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] you to that tile     • If you use it on a target it will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] you some point at Melee Distance of the target (the movement is accounted 1t later than had you clicked a tile) ⬥ It is affected by Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob]     • Reduces cooldown to 17t (10.2s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Hits 3x3 around where you land if used on a target     • This becomes 5x5 with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581988599398400.png?v=1 Laceration] Halberd [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] ⬥ If you use it on a target and it dies within 10t (6s), the cooldown ends

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

Note: Use the Table of Contents in this page’s contents navigation to find the information you are looking for.

​

Some general notes:

⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: 1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds).

⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: 1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s.

⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.

​

Ability Damage Maths
To calculate your ability hit damage in detail, [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/necromancy click here]. This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
Ability Hit Timings
To see detailed breakdowns on ability hit timings, [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rK7u17JN6I-vf3dKBKg6tm9IPWje9EWSe_r8KPdsxoc/edit?usp=sharing click here]. This refers to when hitsplats appear on your target.
Auto-attack Adren Gain
To see adrenaline gained with different auto attacks, [https://img.pvme.io/images/7EINzgc.png click here].

Note: If you have any difficulties in using the tools or understanding what the information means, you can always ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)].

​

Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

This section covers the basic abilities, enhanced abilities, ultimate abilities, conjures and commands, special attacks, and incantations for Necromancy.

​

Basic Abilities

Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 3t (1.8s) ⬥ Affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009422698633502881.png?v=1 invigorating]:     • Gain ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009422698633502881.png?v=1 invigorating] Rank * 0.05) more adrenaline ⬥ Automatically activated when in combat (toggleable) ⬥ Generates 1 Death Spark stack if Omni Guard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] is equipped     • At 6 Death Spark stacks the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] will deal double damage
Touch of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 24t (14.4s) ⬥ Generates 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks
Soul Sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 9t (5.4s) ⬥ Generates 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stack

Enhanced Abilities

Soul Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770972703883354.png?v=1 areatarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ Requires minimum 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stack. One stack is consumed on use. ⬥ Stuns and Binds for 5t (3s) ⬥ Deals a reduced amount of damage to enemies within 1 tile of target
Volley of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ Requires minimum 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks. All stacks consumed on use.
Finger of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ Base adrenaline cost of 60% ⬥ Adrenaline cost reduced by 10% for each [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stack ⬥ Consumes up to 6 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks
Bloat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ Base adrenaline cost of 20% ⬥ Applies Bloated debuff to target for 10 hits ⬥ Bloated:     • 25% of initial damage per hit every 3t (1.8s)     • On Death: Applies Bloated to up to 9 enemies within 1 tile for 4 hits
Spectral Scythe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770972703883354.png?v=1 areatarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Base adrenaline cost of 10% ⬥ AoE damage in a cone (max 9 targets) ⬥ On-hit: 25% chance to generate 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stack per target hit ⬥ Able to be re-cast upon unlock from the Necromancy skill tree:     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] 2nd cast costs 20% and does AoE within 2 tiles of you (25 max targets, in addition to your primary target)         ⬩ Also has a 25% chance to generate a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stack per target hit     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] 3rd cast costs 30% and does AoE within 2 tiles of you (25 max targets, in addition to your primary target)         ⬩ Damage is increased by 1% per 1% missing life points on target
Blood Siphon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770972703883354.png?v=1 areatarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 75t (45s) ⬥ No adrenaline cost ⬥ AoE to enemies within 2 tiles of player ⬥ Channeled attack: 4 hits over 8t (4.8s)     • Completing the full channel deals 100% of the total heal plus extra damage to the target ⬥ Heal for 70% of the damage dealt

Ultimate Abilities

Death Skulls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770974431944835.png?v=1 multitarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Launches a Death Skull that bounces up to 4 times after hitting the target ⬥ Prioritises enemies by maximum life points, but can also bounce off of you ⬥ The Necromancy Zuk Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] reduces the adrenaline cost of this ability to 60% and also adds two additional bounces
Living Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 150t (90s) ⬥ Change forms into Death form, empowering Necromancy abilities for 30s ⬥ On-cast: the cooldowns of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] are reset ⬥ While active:     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] generates 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] generates an addition 6% adrenaline     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] deals 1.5x damage     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] cooldown reduced to 10.2s

Conjures and Commands

Listed conjure durations do not account for the Spirit Pact unlocks in the Necromancy talent tree nor the set effect of the First Necromancer armour

Conjure Skeleton Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ 70t (42s) duration ⬥ Conjure a Skeleton warrior:     • Skeleton attacks every 5t (3s)     • Generates 1 Rage stack with each attack     • Deals an additional 3% ability damage per Rage stack
Command Skeleton Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandwarrior] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Commands a conjured skeleton to rapidly perform additional attacks (every 2t (1.2s)) for 10t (6s)
Conjure Vengeful Ghost [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ 70t (42s) duration ⬥ Conjure a Vengeful Ghost:     • Ghost attacks every 7t (4.2s)     • Heal for 140% of the damage dealt by the ghost
Command Vengeful Ghost [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ Applies Haunted to the target     • Haunted: Takes up to 10% bonus damage from all attacks, capped at 20% ability damage
Conjure Putrid Zombie [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ 70t (42s) duration ⬥ Conjure a Putrid Zombie:     • Zombie attacks every 6t (3.6s)     • Zombie inflicts poison damage every 3t (1.8s) to enemies within 1 tile
Command Putrid Zombie [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770972703883354.png?v=1 areatarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ Command the Zombie to explode, dealing large damage to enemies within 2 tiles
Conjure Phantom Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109199069806604.png?v=1 conjurephantom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]
⬥ No Cooldown ⬥ 70t (42s) duration ⬥ Conjure a Phantom Guardian:     • Does not auto attack     • Reduces core damage taken by 5%, up to 10% of your ability damage         ⬩ Core damage refers to the 4 combat styles     • Generates 1 stack of Valour per incoming hit, up to 25
Command Phantom Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109200432959528.png?v=1 commandphantom] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]
⬥ Cooldown: 15t (9s) ⬥ Deals 45%-55% Necromancy Spirit damage to the target and up to 4 additional enemies within 1 tile of the target ⬥ Consumes all Valour and increases damage dealt by 20% for each stack     • Caps at 270%-330% damage at 25 stacks
Conjure Undead Army [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770968736079957.png?v=1 selftarget]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

Note: Use the Table of Contents in this page’s contents navigation to find the information you are looking for.

​

Some general notes:

⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: 1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds).

⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: 1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s.

⬥ Debuff spells like Vuln [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] or Enfeeble [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 Enfeeble] or Smoke Cloud [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] do not give adrenaline.

⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.

​

Ability Damage Maths
To calculate your ability hit damage in detail, [https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/ranged click here]. This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
Ability Hit Timings
To see detailed breakdowns on ability hit timings, [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rK7u17JN6I-vf3dKBKg6tm9IPWje9EWSe_r8KPdsxoc/edit?usp=sharing click here]. This refers to when hitsplats appear on your target.
Auto-attack Adren Gain
To see adrenaline gained with different auto attacks, [https://runescape.wiki/w/Invigorating click here].

Note: If you have any difficulties in using the tools or understanding what the information means, you can always ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)].

​

Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

This section covers basic abilities, enhanced abilities, ultimate abilities, utility abilities and special attacks for Ranged.

​

Basic Abilities

Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 ranged_basic]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Affected by Fleeting Boots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813993480388640.png?v=1 fleetingboots]     • Applies the cooldown reduction effect of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercing_shot]

​

Piercing Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercing_shot]
⬥ Cooldown: 5t (3s) ⬥ Fires 2 hits ⬥ Reduces cooldown of Snipe by 4t (2.4s) per hit, 8t total (4.8s) ⬥ Affected by Fleeting Boots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813993480388640.png?v=1 fleetingboots]     • Reduces cooldown of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] by additional 2t (1.2s) per hit, 4t (2.4s) extra, 12t (7.2s) total

​

Binding Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s)     • Charges: 2 ⬥ Stuns for 2t (1.2s) and binds for 16t (9.6s) ⬥ It is affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon]:     • Increases Max by 40% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] rank     • Increases Minimum by 8% per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] Rank     • No longer stuns or binds

​

Galeshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 imbue_gales]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Applies Searing Winds to self for 10t (6s) ⬥ Searing Winds:     • Ranged attacks deal 20% damage with each hit

​

Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1 ricochet]
⬥ Cooldown: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Hits within a 5 square radius from SW tile of initial target     • Hits 3 targets, inclusive of main     • Main target hit an additional 15-20% for each enemy that cannot be found     • Does not hit things on initial target's SW tile ⬥ It is affected by Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]     • Ricochet hits 4% bonus damage per Caroming rank ⬥ Not affected by Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]

​

Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]
⬥ Cooldown: 17t (10.2s) ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Hits within a 5 square radius from SW tile of initial target     • Hits 7 targets, inclusive of main     • Main target hit an additional 15-20% (4-6% after 2 hits) for each enemy that cannot be found     • Does not hit things on initial target's SW tile ⬥ It is affected by Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]     • Ricochet hits 4% bonus damage per Caroming rank ⬥ Not affected by Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]

​

Enhanced Abilities

Snap Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]
⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ Two separate, strong hits

​

Snipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 0% ⬥ It is a channeled ability ⬥ It is affected by Nightmare Gauntlets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 NMG], details in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]]

​

Bombardment [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard]
⬥ Cooldown: 9t (5.4ss) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ It is an AoE:     • 5x5 with target's true centre (SW tile) as centre     • Up to 9 targets ⬥ Not affected by Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]

​

Rapid Fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% ⬥ 8 hits ⬥ Binds for 10t (6s) ⬥ Channelled ability ⬥ Each attack extends the duration of Searing Winds by 1t (0.6s)

​

Shadow Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]
⬥ Cooldown: 75t (45s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 0% ⬥ Calculates damage on activation ⬥ Deals self-damage to the player ⬥ Extends the duration of Shadow Imbue by 3.6s ⬥ Guaranteed to crit

​

Corruption Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot]
⬥ Cooldown: 25t (15s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 20% ⬥ It is a DoT:     • Not affected by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005204971886743572.png?v=1 precise] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214364892895907941.png?v=1 eruptive]     • Hits every 2t (1.2s), for a total of 5 times ⬥ It is an AoE:     • Spreads to targets within 2 tiles each hit, up to 5 additional targets

​

Imbue: Shadows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbue_shadows]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 40% ⬥ Applies Shadow Imbued to self for 50t (30s) ⬥ Shadow Imbued:     • Ranged attacks against your target generate 5% adrenaline for each hit

​

Special Attacks

Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 65% (58.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])

​

Zamorak Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 40% (36% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])

​

Gloomfire Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow]
⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 65% (58.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])

​

Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 30% (27% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov]) ⬥ To see how use the special attack, use !sgb in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)]

​

Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb]
⬥ Special Attack: Split Soul ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 25% (22.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])     • Lasts 25t (t0-t24)     • Anything [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] would have healed whilst spec is active instead deals Blight damage equal to 4 * [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] heal amount     • To get the Split Soul damage both the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] heal and the hit of the ability must occur within the duration of the special     • Special attack is lost if main hand weapon is switched while active     • Blight damage is affected a second time by Vulnerability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln], X Slayer sigils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer], the NopeNopeNope PoF perk, and X Slayer perks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk]

​

Bow of the Last Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg]
⬥ Special Attack: Balance by Force ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 30% (27% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov])     • Lasts 50t (t0-t49)     • While active, the number of stacks needed to trigger the passive effect is lowered to 4     • If 3 or more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stacks when used the passive effect will trigger     • For more info on how to use the special attack, use !bolg in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)]

​

Ultimate Abilities

​

Deadshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]
⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s) ⬥ Adrenaline Cost: 60% ⬥ Fires 4 hits ⬥ Affected by the Igneous Kal-Xil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] and Igneous Kal-Zuk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]     • Adrenaline cost becomes 60%     • Fires 8 hits

​

Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ It is an on cast buff ⬥ Increases damage by 50% from t0→t51 (52t/31.2s duration); buff starts t1 ⬥ It has a 7x7 buff radius ⬥ It does not incur the auto cooldown ⬥ Planted Feet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] increases duration to t0→t64 (65t/39s)

​

Greater Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]
⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s) ⬥ Duration becomes t0→t64 (65t/39s duration); buff starts t1     • Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] does not extend this further ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] retains the DoT effect of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]     • Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] will cancel this

​

Utility Abilities

Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]
⬥ Cooldown: 34t (20.4s) ⬥ It is a Mobility ability:     • For [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]: moves you back (weapon attack range - 1) tiles     • For non-[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]: moves you back 7 tiles ⬥ It is affected by Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob]     • Reduces cooldown to 17t (10.2s) ⬥ Can be upgraded with a Double Escape codex: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894443778115.png?v=1 escapecodex]     • Gives you a second [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] on its own 34t (17t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob]) internal cooldown that is used after the first

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] Ranged Ability Index [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]
