pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

The Essence of Finality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eofor] is an amulet which combines the Amulet of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos] and Reaper Necklace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159412494367.png?v=1 Reaper] passives, as well as lets you store a special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]. This special attack can then be used through the Essence of Finality ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] in the Constitution [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 Constitution] ability book. These specs can be broken down into the following categories:

​

Direct Upgrades

⬥ Gloomfire Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] / Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] / Zamorak Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow]

⬥ Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] (Ranged camp)

⬥ Legatus's Emberstaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1 legatusemberstaff] / Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] / Zamorak Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/873142795706179651.png?v=1 zamorakstaff]

⬥ Varanus's Mercy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] / Dragon Claws [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048040865726485.png?v=1 dragonclawoh]

​

Expensive/Niche Specs

⬥ Statius Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh]

⬥ Annihilation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation]

⬥ Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb]

⬥ Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] (Offstyle)

⬥ Decimation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation]

⬥ Armadyl Battlestaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1 armadylbattlestaff]

⬥ Staff of Light [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289319964763.png?v=1 staffoflight]

​

Cheap Versatile Specs

⬥ Dragon Longsword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword]

⬥ Dragon 2H Sword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword]

⬥ Dragon Dagger [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048040644083733.png?v=1 dragondagger]

⬥ Dragon Halberd [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd]

⬥ Granite Maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul]

⬥ Iban's Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929543068618752.png?v=1 ibansstaff]

​

More In-depth Breakdown of Each Special Attack

⬥ Any niche uses for EoF spec weapons will have their uses in the boss guides, along with how worthwhile it is in that encounter. It is up to you to determine if that niche is something you would like to invest in.

⬥ Ring of Vigour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] works the same as it would on the respective special attacks.

​

Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu]

⬥ Special Attack: Descent of Darkness

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 65% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 hits that deal 190-230% ability damage each (regardless of ammo, despite the ingame description)

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Big burst damage

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] - Nex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213159071547395.png?v=1 Nex], Vorago [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/572867742613635082.png?v=1 vorago], Nex, Angel of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod], Barrows: Rise of the Six [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513222840162582541.png?v=1 Dharokhead]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Gloomfire Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow]

⬥ Special Attack: Shadowfall

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 65% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 hits that deal 85-105% ability damage each, third hit that deals 255-295%

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally can not

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Big burst damage, with a larger 3rd hit which can be lined up with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium]

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] but do NOT have other damage buffs

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Zamorak Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412727242773.png?v=1 eofgreen]

⬥ Special Attack: Destructive Shot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 40% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 hits that deal 160-180% ability damage each

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Efficient adrenaline dump between Snap Shot and Dark Bow, can be more versatile for rotations

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Note: Obtaining one of either Dark Bow EoF or Zamorak Bow EoF is high priority. The other becomes low priority and should be put off until other EoF special attacks are obtained.

​

Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412865523722.png?v=1 eofpink]

⬥ Special Attack: Split Soul

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For 15 seconds (25 ticks), Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] no longer heals you, but deals 4x the amount of healing you would have gotten as damage against your target

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Switching main hand weapons will end the effect, but switching off-hand weapons or amulets will not.

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ECB spec with bows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] that can use arrows

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ECB spec with 1h/DW/Chins

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Allows Needle Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259108876293.png?v=1 needle], the use of Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4], and the ability to use Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] as a switch

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Ranged Camp SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412906680330.png?v=1 eofblue]

⬥ Special Attack: Crystal Rain

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 30% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 arrows are launched, dealing 125-155% ability damage each. The first will always hit, the rest depend if they land on tiles occupied by a potential target.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 30 second cooldown

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The damage range of the spec is based off of a couple factors, refer to the wiki for specifics: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Seren_godbow#Special_attack https://runescape.wiki/w/Seren_godbow#Special_attack]

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows usage of SGB spec under the effect of Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] spec

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you would SGB spec while Ranging (generally 3x3 boss size or larger)

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High if you can SGB spec, medium otherwise​

​

Decimation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022282076553268.png?v=1 eofpurpleu]

⬥ Special Attack: Locate

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 35% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turns all single-target Ranged attacks into AoE attacks that hit up to 9 targets within a 3x3 area of the primary target for 10.8 seconds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The 3x3 area is centred around the target's SW tile for larger NPCs

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows usage of Decimation spec with higher tiered weapons and other special attacks, allowing for incredible AoE damage with SGB spec, Dark Bow spec, etc.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows usage of Decimation spec under the effect of Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] spec

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Nex, Angel of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod], Arch-Glacor [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/891948878583189514.png?v=1 archglacor]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Medium, mechanised chinchompas can act as a mediocre substitute​

​

Offstyle SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412906680330.png?v=1 eofblue]

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows usage with Bow of the Last Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] for higher base damage and a potential Perfect Equilibrium proc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium]

Note: Keep in mind that using EoF SGB offstyle requires at least an extra inventory space to use, when compared to using a normal SGB.

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you would off-style SGB spec (generally 5x5 boss size or larger)

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Low​

​

Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack]

Annihilation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation]

⬥ Special Attack: Gravitate

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 60% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When used, for 30 seconds all successful attacks on your opponent(s) adds a stack, which increases your damage by 1% per stack, capping at 20%

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The special attack will clear itself prematurely if: you switch weapons, you splash on any target, or if the special attack is used again within 30 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Functionally useless, as you can just use DBA [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 DBA] spec and get a similar buff for a minute

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A lasting damage amplifier that allows you to be mobile

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be used with a Noxious Scythe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159341322240.png?v=1 noxscythe]

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Possible uses for melee Elite Dungeon mobs and Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Very low​

​

Dragon Claws [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048040865726485.png?v=1 dragonclawoh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412839833601.png?v=1 eofred]

⬥ Special Attack: Slice & Dice

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 50% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first hit deals between 160-200% damage, the second hit deals between 80-100% damage, and the final two hits deals 40-50% each. It totals to 320-400% ability damage.

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump large amounts of adrenaline to deal burst damage (relentless proc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] on Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] or at the end of a kill)

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Dragon Dagger [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048040644083733.png?v=1 dragondagger]

⬥ Special Attack: Draconic Puncture

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 quick strikes that deal 110-140% ability damage each

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can make use of excess adrenaline without being too much of a commitment.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals very consistent damage

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spinners at Ambassador [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542809235458.png?v=1 Ambassador], rootlings [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/848803062684581929.png?v=1 roots] at [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371310891029.png?v=1 solak]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Low​

​

Dragon Longsword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword]

⬥ Special Attack: Draconic Cleave

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 250-290% damage

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can make use of excess adrenaline without being too much of a commitment.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quickly deals a high damaging attack at the end of a kill or phase.

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pool skips at [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813907706478603.png?v=1 raksha].

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Low​

​

Dragon 2H Sword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword]

⬥ Special Attack: Power Stab

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 50% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 260-320% ability damage in a 5x5 zone to any enemies adjacent to the target

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Casting this special with Halberd weapons increase this range to 7x7.

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• High, low variance area damage

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At Shattered Worlds for a low effort method to level up melee gear and Elite Dungeons for fast mob clearing.

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High for SW / Medium EDs, very low otherwise​

​

Dragon Halberd [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd]

⬥ Special Attack: Sweep

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 30% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Does 2 AoE hits of 105-135% damage each

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More damage

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/572867742613635082.png?v=1 vorago], Elite Dungeons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430543321071626.png?v=1 Seiryu] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542326759435.png?v=1 BSD] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542809235458.png?v=1 Ambassador], Twin Furies [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212995892019211.png?v=1 TwinFury], glacytes at [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/891948878583189514.png?v=1 archglacor]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Low​

​

Granite Maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul]

⬥ Special Attack: Quick Smash

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 50% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 100-120% ability damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ignores all cooldowns, including the global cooldown

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Large amount of burst damage in a single tick

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Usually used in short speedkills

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High if speedkilling, very low otherwise​

​

Statius Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku]

⬥ Special Attack: Obliterate

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 35% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 140-160% ability damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drains 30% of the target's defence level and increases affinity by 5 for 1 minute

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hammer → auto, cheap hammer specs

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Nex, Angel of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod], Telos [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 Telos], Vorago [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/572867742613635082.png?v=1 vorago], Raids [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212996948983809.png?v=1 BeastmasterDurzag] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/725230791260504144.png?v=1 yakahelm2]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High because of cost reduction​

​

Varanus's Mercy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy]

⬥ Special Attack: The Final Flurry

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 50% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 hits that deal 65-85% ability damage each, third hit that deals 135-165%

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• +25% critical strike chance and critical strike damage on the first two, and +50% on the third

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally can not

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Big burst damage, with a fairly low adrenaline cost

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally a straight update to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw]

⬥ It is not ideal to end a kill with this spec as the third hit lands quite late

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use melee

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1 eofpurple]

⬥ Special Attack: Claws of Guthix

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 200-240% ability damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drains target's defence level by 5% of the base level and increases affinity by 2 for 1 minute

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1h/DW Guthix Staff, Magic adrenaline sink

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use Magic, and the affinity debuff is needed

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

Zamorak Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/873142795706179651.png?v=1 zamorakstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1 eofpurple]

⬥ Special Attack: Flames of Zamorak

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 200-240% ability damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drains target's magic level by 5% of the previous level and decreases target's accuracy by 5% in all combat styles for 1 minute

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1h/DW Zamorak Staff, Magic adrenaline sink

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use Magic, and the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] affinity debuff is not needed

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Medium​

​

Legatus's Emberstaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1 legatusemberstaff]

⬥ Special Attack: The Last Command

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 35% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 240-280% ability damage, increasing by 1% (multiplicative) per 1% maximum life points the target is missing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Caps at 420-490% ability damage with 75% missing life points

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More damage than [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929543068618752.png?v=1 ibansstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] for lower adrenaline cost if the target is below 60% hp

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More damage than [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] always

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mage camping when excess adrenaline can be an issue

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Medium​

​

Iban's Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929543068618752.png?v=1 ibansstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412902223892.png?v=1 eofyellow]

⬥ Special Attack: Iban Blast

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 50% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 340%-390% ability damage

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Large adrenaline sink for more damage than Gstaff/Zstaff, combos well after Greater Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc]

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mage camping when excess adrenaline can be an issue, Zamorak [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Medium​

​

Armadyl Battlestaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1 armadylbattlestaff]

⬥ Special Attack: Tempest of Armadyl

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 50% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A channelled ability that lasts 5 ticks, dealing one hit of 45-55% ability damage per tick, increasing by 5% per additional hit, for a total of 275-325% ability damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This special attack benefits from the increased critical hit chance provided by the Channeller's Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1 channellerring].

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More damage and frequent Time Strike procs when used with the Fractured Staff of Armadyl [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa]

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used exclusively with the Fractured Staff of Armadyl [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa] special attack, as an adrenaline dump to fish for crits once other good thresholds have been exhausted.

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Very low​

​

Staff of Light [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289319964763.png?v=1 staffoflight]

⬥ Special Attack: Power of Light

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 100% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All melee attack damage is reduced by 50% for 1 minute

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows you to change main hand and EoFs after casting the special attack, allowing you to use it while building before going into an encounter

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pushing High Enrage Telos [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 Telos], Solo Beastmaster Durzag [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212996948983809.png?v=1 BeastmasterDurzag]

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​Low​

​

Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Death Guard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 eofblack]

⬥ Special Attack: Death Grasp

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 405-495% ability damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It also deals an additional 40% necromancy damage per Necrosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stack, consuming all of them.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 12 Necrosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks, the special attack deals up to 885%–975% necromancy damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Has a cooldown of 30 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stuns and binds the target for 4.8 seconds

⬥ What [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] lets you do that you normally cannot

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Easy use of the T90 special attack without carrying a switch

⬥ Scenarios it is used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use Necromancy

⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):

​High​

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

​

This guide will cover a number of game mechanics, uncommon ability interactions, and more nuanced game information that can be used for reference.

​

Ability Queueing

How It Works

⬥ Ability queueing ('queueing') is a toggleable setting that allows you to 'queue' abilities to trigger them when possible.

⬥ The setting can be found by pressing Esc > Settings > Gameplay > Combat & Action Bar > Action Bar.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/jrJ2XoSlss.png Guide illustration]

⬥ When you enable ability queueing, pressing an ability that cannot immediately be activated queues it, with the following icon appearing on top of it [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/898660152025161778.png?v=1 queueing].

⬥ The ability will then get used as soon as it becomes possible to do so (after constraints like adrenaline, 2H/DW weapon requirements, global/ability cooldowns, etc.)

⬥ There are a number of interactions with ability queueing that are worth mentioning.

​

Movement Stalling

⬥ Queued abilities will interrupt movement when they are activated by the game.

⬥ This may cause issues if you are trying to 'kite' monsters (like at Nex or Barrows: Rise of the Six) while also trying to use ability queueing.

⬥ The solution is to disable queueing, or simply press the ability slightly later so that it triggers normally (without queueing).

​

On-tick Defensives

⬥ Some abilities will have their effects affected depending on whether or not they're queued.

⬥ Defensive abilities that are queued will have different 'on-tick' behaviour under different scenarios.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 'On-tick' refers to a defensive ability that is cast on the same tick as getting hit by an attack.

⬥ They can be queued on 3 different ticks (since each global cooldown is 3t long), and they work as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 ticks before cast: works with on-tick damage if player is between 1 to 5 tiles from the enemy.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 ticks before cast: works with on-tick damage if player is 1 or 2 tiles from the enemy.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1 tick before cast: does not work with on-tick damage.

​

Last-Tick Interactions

⬥ Certain 'last tick' interactions (with ultimates and other timed abilities) are affected by queueing.

⬥ Greater Barge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The buff from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] lasts 10t/6s, but trying to convert a channel into a DoT barge bleed on the last tick, will not work if the ability is queued.

⬥ Limitless / Ingenuity of the Humans [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] lasts 10t/6s, but trying to use a queued threshold with <50% adrenaline on the last tick will not work.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] lasts 10t/6s, but trying to use an ability on the last tick will not give it the guaranteed 100% hitchance.

​

Note: For more information on damage boosts from the last ticks of damage-boosting buffs, see the section on Berserker Auras (linked in the pinned message).

​

Ability Queueing and Last-Tick
To see how ability queueing prevents the last tick of Berserk from boosting an ability, [https://img.pvme.io/images/JlBezRH.mp4 click here] [https://img.pvme.io/images/JlBezRH.mp4 Source video]

Losing Target

⬥ When ability queueing is enabled, you can lose a target with the following options:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right-click a shield and use the 'Provoke' option - requires a T80 or higher shield (from Dungeoneering or Barrows: Rise of the Six).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use a special attack without having a target selected. This does not work with special attacks of the following weapons, as they do not require any target to activate.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Dragon Battleaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 DBA]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zaros Godsword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Staff of Light/Darkness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289319964763.png?v=1 staffoflight] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592387907634.png?v=1 staffofdarkness]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Decimation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb]

​

Ability Stalling

Note: See !stalling ‎for a summary instead on how to stall and release abilities.

Ability Stalling Video Guide
If you prefer a video guide, [https://youtu.be/kd9QpM12ckg click here.]

How It Works

⬥ It is possible to 'stall' an ability by activating it but not actually using it, instead holding it 'in reserve' to release it at a later time.

⬥ This is primarily used to delay the activation of an ability to stack it together with another ability, to deal extra damage without losing any ticks.

​

How to Stall Abilities

⬥ Casting a non-channeled ability outside your maximum attack range will normally try to run your character back into range to use it on a target.

⬥ If you interrupt this action by clicking away (e.g. on the floor), it will 'hold' the ability in reserve to be released (this is the stalled ability).

⬥ The ability can then be 'released' later to use the ability without consuming a global cooldown.

​

How to Release Stalled Abilities

⬥ Method 1: Run-in Release

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Casting an ability outside your attack range and not interrupting the action, your character will run in and release it automatically.

⬥ Method 2: Click Release

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After stalling an ability, click your target to release the stalled ability.

⬥ Method 3: Target Cycle Release

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After stalling an ability, target cycle to an enemy within attack range to release the stalled ability.

​

Adrenaline Management

Adrenaline is generated when players use basic abilities, and by default, naturally drains after the player falls out of combat (10 seconds of no combat). Your adrenaline determines what abilities you can and cannot use at any given point.

​

There are a couple different mechanics to note with regard to adrenaline.

⬥ Stalling adrenaline to not lose it out of combat.

⬥ Gaining adrenaline even without a target under some circumstances.

⬥ Deliberately losing your target to use some abilities (like Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] ) without costing adrenaline.

⬥ Adrenaline gained from certain actions may feel 'delayed' (covered below).

​

Stalling Adrenaline

⬥ There are multiple ways to stall adrenaline.

⬥ Method 1: Simply remain in combat.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is done by using abilities that do not require a target within every 10 seconds to make the game think the player is still 'in combat'.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Non-defensive abilities that do not require a target - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal] / etc.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Defensive abilities - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / etc.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Other abilities like Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal]

⬥ Method 2: Use something that grants permanent adrenaline stalling.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Adrenaline Urn [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717413507074.png?v=1 adrenurn] (holds up to 1000% adrenaline).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Persistent Rage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage] relic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Infernal Puzzle Box [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] (unlocked up to the 3rd tier).

​

Gaining Adrenaline Without Target

⬥ For 10 seconds after your last damaging ability on a target, you can use any abilities to gain adrenaline.

⬥ After 10 seconds, you can continue to gain adrenaline using defensive basics, at most once per 10 seconds.

⬥ The following abilities do not affect or reset this 'cooldown':

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Non-defensive abilities that do not require a target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensive thresholds (these will consume 15 adren if you have a target, but their use does not affect the cooldown).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ultimates that do not require a target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] / etc.

Adrenaline Without Target
For a demonstration of gaining adrenaline after losing target, [https://img.pvme.io/images/kq3890N.mp4 click here]. [https://img.pvme.io/images/kq3890N.mp4 Source video]

​

Late Adrenaline

⬥ Adrenaline Renewals [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When used, gives 4% adrenaline per tick for 10 ticks (40% total).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Except the first tick, when drinking a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] the adrenaline gained cannot be used until the next game tick.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is because the input action (drinking) is registered on the same tick as other input actions, but for all other ticks, player input registers before the adren gain.

⬥ Barrages [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Barrage crits check for crit buffs that give adrenaline later in the tick than normal.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Essentially, this means that if you crit a barrage auto attack and in the same tick gain a buff that generates adrenaline from crits, the barrage will give adrenaline.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → will give adrenaline if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] crits.

​

How To Lose Target

⬥ It is possible to lose your target to enable the using threshold abilities like Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] to be used without consuming adrenaline, in a couple ways.

⬥ Method 1: Simply drop out of combat.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is accomplished by not attacking/being attacked for 10 seconds.

⬥ Method 2: Have your target no longer be present.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill your current target, or switch to a target that then dies (e.g. Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] that gets dismissed), then use an ability.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If queueing is on: try to use a special attack or press 'Provoke' on a shield.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If queueing is off: try to use a damaging ability.

​

Note: For more information, see the section on Ability Queueing (linked in the pinned message).

​

Camera Shaking

How It Works

⬥ During some mechanics and cutscenes, the game has the ability to 'shake' the camera view.

⬥ The setting can be found by pressing Esc > Settings > Gameplay > Camera > System.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/omeOGKRqgJ.png Guide illustration]

⬥ This is sometimes used as an indicator for certain boss mechanics, but you can disable this if you suffer from motion sickness.

⬥ Some examples of places this is found:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Barrows: Rise of the Six (during the tunnels - recommended to have camera shaking turned off).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Solak (during the roots phase in P1).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Raksha (during the rockfall attack).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ED2 (during the 'spikes' special attack of Black Stone Dragon and any other Gemstone Dragon).

​

Critical Strike

Note: For a summary, see the !crit ‎and !critbuff ‎commands.

How It Works

⬥ Players have a base 10% chance to critical strike. They are indicated by larger, stylized damage numbers.

⬥ A critical strike deals a fixed percentage of bonus damage based on combat stats (up to 50% at 90)

⬥ Your total critical hit chance is your base 10% plus any added effect you may be using as seen below.

⬥ (see Items That Affect Critical Hits below).

​

Ability Interactions

⬥ Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879510372352.png?v=1 fury]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Increases the next melee attack critical strike chance by +25%.

⬥ Greater Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Makes the next non-bleed melee attack within 15s have a 100% critical strike chance.

⬥ (Greater) Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373968731811880.png?v=1 conc]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each hit increases the next magic abilities critical strike chance by 5%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This caps at 15% after the 3rd hit.

⬥ Smoke Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All hits of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] will always crit.

⬥ The following abilities cannot do critical hits, regardless of what they actually hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dismember [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Slaughter [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Massacre [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1 massacre]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Combust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1 corruptionblast]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magma Tempest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot]

Items That Affect Critical Hits

Note: These methods can stack together.

⬥ Biting Perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• +2% critical hit chance per rank, up to 8% at Biting 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] (up to 8.8% with level 20 equipment)

⬥ Elite tectonic armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556582803014418432.png?v=1 elitetectmask]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• +2% critical hit chance per equipped piece.

⬥ Kal'gerion Demon familiar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Its special move, Crit-i-kal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] gives +5% critical hitchance for 60 seconds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This applies to everyone near the familiar when it is cast, and you can move away from the familiar without losing the effect after it is cast.

⬥ Erethdor's Grimoire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• +12% critical hit chance while active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Outside of Solak, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] is expensive to use.

⬥ Reaver's Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• +5% critical hit chance at the expense of -5% accuracy.

⬥ Champion's Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943630520350.png?v=1 championring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• +3% critical hit chance if the target has any active bleed on it.

⬥ Channeller's Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1 channellerring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Channelled magic abilities gain +4% critical hit chance per channeled hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. Asphyx would gain +4%/+8%/+12%/+16% critical hit chance on each of its 4 hits respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This affects (Greater) Concentrated Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373968731811880.png?v=1 conc] , Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] , and Onslaught [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159085207555.png?v=1 onsl]

⬥ Smoke Cloud [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Increase damage dealt by crits by 15% for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], and by 6% for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

​

Grimoire/Scrimshaw Switching ('Grimshaw')

Note: This is very rarely done due to the extreme intensity of inputs required, and due to how some weapons like the FSOA [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] can actually be hindered by doing it..

How It Works

⬥ It is possible to obtain the boosts of Erethdor's Grimoire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] and a Scrimshaw [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588959510539.png?v=1 elementsscrim] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159546712074.png?v=1 Cruelty] at the same time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can result in ~6% damage increase across the course of an entire rotation, but will drastically increase the amount of inputs.

⬥ This is due to how critical hits work:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Critical hits are rolled on cast.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Modifiers like scrimshaws are calculated on hit.

Sample Rotation

⬥ The grimoire must be on when the ability is cast, and the scrimshaw must be on when it hits.

⬥ A single input sequence using Dragon Breath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] might look like:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588959510539.png?v=1 elementsscrim] → repeat

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588959510539.png?v=1 elementsscrim] take 2 inputs to use → one input to equip, second input to activate, both in the same tick as all other actions.

Hex Weapons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894829522954.png?v=1 terramaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff]

How It Works

⬥ This refers to the following three weapons:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hexhunter bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Terrasaur maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894829522954.png?v=1 terramaul]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Inquisitor's staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff].

⬥ They are referred to as 'Hex' weapons because the Hexhunter bow was the first weapon with its passive effect, and all of them have very similar passive effects.

⬥ The passive effect provides +12.5% damage and +10% hitchance against susceptible targets.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a passive +10% hitchance compared to a standard T80 weapon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Effect works on targets whose main attack style is weak to the weapon's style (based on the combat triangle).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the passive works, a debuff icon will appear underneath the target's health bar.

⬥ The damage increase works on the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abilities

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto-attacks

⬥ The damage increase does not work on the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Aftershock [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crackling [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4]

⬥ The damage can be further boosted by an additional +5% if the relevant style-specific enchantment is consumed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enchantment of Affliction [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481321087991819.png?v=1 enchantmentofaffliction] boosts damage of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff] by +5%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enchantment of Dispelling [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481317266993193.png?v=1 enchantmentofdispelling] boosts damage of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow] by +5%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enchantment of Savagery [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481307443937310.png?v=1 enchantmentofsavagery] boosts damage of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894829522954.png?v=1 terramaul] by +5%.

​

Notes

⬥ It is common to see people refer to them as 'T97' or 'T105' weapons, etc. - this is a common misconception, and is only a theoretical effective tier possible with sufficient level boosts and equipment bonuses.

Hex Weapons

​

Instance Hopping

How It Works

⬥ This is a minor mechanic, but can be used to get more kills per hour at some places (most notably, at GWD2 bosses).

⬥ To do it: kill boss → pick up loot → quickly exit instance → quickly re-enter instance → repeat.

⬥ This works because it is faster to spawn a boss for the first time in an instance, compared to the duration between subsequent spawns.

⬥ At the expense of higher effort, this can potentially save time even compared to the 'Fastest' instance spawn speed, if you instance-hop sufficiently quickly.

NPC Centre vs. Coordinate

This section covers the difference between an NPC's centre and coordinate and how it impacts certain abilities when it comes to targeting and hitboxes.

NPC Centre vs. Coordinate

⬥ An NPC's centre and coordinate are both attributes of its position. They are not the same, and are both used in different scenarios to decide where exactly the 'centre' of an NPC is.

⬥ The NPC centre depends on the size of the NPC:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For odd-sized NPCs (1x1, 3x3, 5x5, etc.): it is always the centre tile.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For even-size NPCs (2x2, 4x4, 6x6, etc.): it is always the south-west tile in middle 2x2 tile region.

NPC Facing and Flanking

Note: For more information on boss sizes and how to calculate their NPC centre and coordinate tiles, see NPC Centre vs. Coordinate.

This section covers how NPCs face, how it affects their movement and targeting, and its impact on Flanking Angles.

Facing Direction: Movement

⬥ NPC's in RuneScape can only face in one of 8 directions: the four cardinal directions N/W/S/E and the four diagonal directions in-between, NW/SW/SE/NE.

⬥ NPCs can also only move in one of these 8 directions.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The same behaviour applies to players as well.

⬥ Each direction therefore corresponds to a 45° angle.

​

Facing Direction: Targeting

⬥ Bosses in Runescape will always face the direction their target is in. Again, this can only be one of the 8 directions mentioned earlier.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When without a target, NPCs will face in the direction they are moving.

⬥ Players can face any direction, but they will be re-oriented to face their target when:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They get a new target (by clicking or using target cycle).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They attack a target (using any spell/ability/special attack/etc.)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They try to cast a channel while in attack range of a target.

⬥ The following image attempts to show how bosses will face based on their target's location.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/BJtN9We.png Guide illustration]

⬥ In the above image:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The centre 2x2 region represents the monster's hitbox.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The monster's centre tile is marked by C (in this case, the SW tile of the middle 2x2 region since the monster is even-sized).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The dark-coloured tiles represent cardinal directions, and the lighter tiles are diagonal directions.

⬥ Here is a small table of player positions vs. where the monster would face:

Player at F6 → Monster faces NORTH-WEST
Player at R10 → Monster faces EAST
Player at K14 → Monster faces SOUTH
Player at L14 → Monster faces SOUTH-EAST
etc.

⬥ This is important as it can affect flanking angles.

NPC Directions and Flanking

⬥ Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] requires the following conditions to be met:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target is facing a particular direction.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Your distance past the target's centre tile in that direction is zero - i.e. relative to the centre tile you are not further ahead than the target in that direction.

⬥ If both the above conditions are met, then you can Flank [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] the target.

⬥ See the following image for 2 examples of angles that you can Flank from on larger targets.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fgggN05.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Case 1: Target Facing South (Cardinal Direction)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Player can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] anywhere in the green region because:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The target is facing south.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The player is not further south than the target's centre.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• i.e. Flanking angle is the 180° region behind the target's centre.

⬥ Case 2: Target Facing North-West (Diagonal Direction)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Player can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] anywhere in the green region because:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The target is facing both north and west.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Player is only further north, not also further west, than the target's centre.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• i.e. Flanking angle is the 270° region not including the quadrant the boss is facing.

⬥ See the following image for an example of this behaviour with a 2x2 monster:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/G3bGkKk.png Guide illustration] ​

Solo Flanking

⬥ It is possible to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] on some bosses even in a solo scenario.

⬥ Method 1: Move Behind Target

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• By moving behind the target, you can use cast an ability and get the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] effect.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Some bosses like Black Stone Dragon (during the spiral flames) or Kerapac (when he spawns the Time Thread Tears) will avoid moving, and this gives time for the player to move behind them.

⬥ Method 2: Move Under Target

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can move under a target when casting an ability and be able to benefit from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] effect.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can happen when the target is immobile (like Ambassador), or temporarily immobile (like the examples before).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mobile but stunnable/bindable targets (like Telos) can be stunned/bound then walked under.

Seren Godbow (SGB) Mechanics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb]

Note: For a summary of where/when/how to use SGB, and a list of boss sizes use the !sgb ‎command.

How It Works

⬥ The Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] is a T92 chargebow that has a strong special attack, Crystal Rain.

⬥ The special attack fires 5 arrows that land in a certain area around the target. There are two aspects to this:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Where Arrow 1 hits, and if it misses.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• How the game decides where Arrows 2-5 hit, and which enemy is damaged by them.

​

Arrow 1

⬥ Arrow 1 will be aimed at the center of the target, and will only hit the target.

⬥ If Arrow 1 hits: The special attack succeeds, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] goes on cooldown for 30s.

⬥ If Arrow 1 misses (only possible if damage potential is <1%): all other arrows miss, the arrow landing animation does not appear, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] can be re-used immediately (no cooldown).

​

Arrows 2-5+

⬥ To decide where and what Arrows 2-5 hit, the game does the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step 1: Find NPC centre

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is the actual NPC centre (middle tile).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For even-sized NPCs (2x2, 4x4, etc.) this is the SW tile of their middle 2x2 region.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is also the location of Arrow 1.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step 2: Choose 4 tiles in a 5x5 square centred at the chosen tile

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Arrows 2-5 will land on these tiles.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If a tile is already used by a previous arrow (including Arrow 1), reroll the choice up to 10 times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step 3: Each of arrows 2-5 will damage one enemy with a hitbox that overlaps the tile it lands on.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If there are multiple enemies that overlap the arrow's tile, one will be selected.

​

⬥ This means that the chances that Arrows 2-5 hit the target increase with the size of the target.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• i.e. on bigger targets, the minimum expected damage of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] increases.

​

The following diagram visualizes this process for two example targets, 3x3 and 4x4 in size.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/2VsDDTr00Q.png Guide illustration] Note: The image is just an example, actual results may vary due to randomness.

Target Cycling (TC)

How It Works

⬥ Target cycling is the ability to select a new combat target using a keybind, instead of clicking it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is similar to 'tab-targeting', found in other MOBAs and MMOs.

⬥ Target cycle settings can be found by pressing Esc > Settings > Gameplay > Combat > Targeting.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ixoeAlQiHl.png Guide illustration]

⬥ These settings determine how a target is found when the corresponding keybind (forward or backward) is pressed.

⬥ Radial targeting:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cycles from the nearest to the farthest target from the player when pressed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the case of multiple equidistant targets, it will cycle clockwise starting from the north.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is useful for simply snapping to the closest target available.

⬥ Conal Targeting:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cycles from the closest to the farthest target in the direction the camera is facing.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The angle for an NPC to be considered eligible for selection is around 75-90°.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is most useful for more precise targeting in scenarios with multiple NPCs around.

⬥ The maximum target distance limits the range of available targets to the set value.

​

Why it is Useful

⬥ Allows for easy target selection with just the press of a keybind.

⬥ Can target some encounters earlier than normal by using target cycling instead of clicking.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This happens at places like Helwyr or Vindicta, where the boss has spawned but cannot be clicked for a few ticks. Target cycling bypasses this delay.

⬥ It is useful for improving consistency and speed in nearly all boss encounters.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Being able to target them on the same tick every encounter makes opening rotations at first easier.

⬥ A notable advantage is that you can target cycle to a new target while still charging Detonate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] without cancelling it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is not possible without target cycle (you would have to release Detonate then select a new target).

​

Tick System

⬥ RuneScape runs on an internal clock, otherwise known as the 'tick system'.

⬥ This is how often the game updates information. All actions and updates are registered on a tick.

⬥ Each game tick (often just written as 't') is 0.6 seconds long - i.e. 1t = 0.6s.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For reference, the global cooldown (the time between pressing abilities one after another) is 3t/1.8s long.

⬥ This has enormous impact on virtually all aspects of the game, from movement to abilities used in combat to skilling and everything in between.

⬥ One big advantage of the tick system is that even if you have relatively high latency, its impact on the gameplay is not as noticeable as in other games like FPS shooters, due to the lengthy in-built tick duration.

​

Typeless Damage

How It Works

⬥ Typeless damage is a generic damage that appears as a red hitsplat with no symbol next to it. There are two kinds of typeless damage: hard typeless and soft typeless.

⬥ Hard Typeless

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This damage is immune to being affected by almost all damage modifiers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Common exceptions include Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Examples include Araxxor's Egg Bomb special attack, Vorago's damage on drop-down or his Red Bomb attacks.

⬥ Soft Typeless

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This damage is affected by most damage modifiers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is also increased by effects like Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] .

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Examples include Telos' rockfall damage, and Nex, AoD's 'Elements' special attack.

How It Works

⬥ Vengeance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 Veng] is a Lunar Spell that gives a player the 'Vengeance' buff - the next incoming hit will be rebounded for 75% of its damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can be cast every 30 seconds.

⬥ Group Vengeance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009570755836641331.png?v=1 venggroup] is a variant that applies the effect to the caster and up to 50 players in a 7x7 region centred on the caster.

Vengeance Interactions

⬥ It cannot damage reflect-immune targets.

⬥ It does not get consumed by typeless damage.

⬥ The following spells/abilities will take priority - Vengeance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 Veng] will not be consumed if they are active:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vulnerability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] and other damage-increasing curses on the target will increase rebounded damage.

Walking Monsters

Note: Not all targets can be walked (e.g. Ambassador) - this section specifically refers to targets that can be walked.

How It Works

⬥ 'Walking' refers to moving a target from its original position.

⬥ There are two ways to walk targets:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move outside its attack range, and it will move to try and attack you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move underneath it, and it will move aside to try and attack you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For targets not in MD, movement abilities like Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] can be used to get under them losslessly during GCD.

⬥ NPCs can only move in 3 directions when walked under: east, west and south. Never north.

⬥ Bosses will move at 2 squares per tick, just like players running.

Determining Walk Direction

⬥ When walking a target by moving under them, they will first move in a random direction.

⬥ After hitting a wall, monsters will walk in the next cardinal direction counter-clockwise to the direction they are current walking, skipping north. For example:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Targets moving east will move west after hitting a wall.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Targets moving west will move south after hitting a wall.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Targets moving south will move east after hitting a wall.

⬥ If a monster is unable to move in the new direction, it will move in the next counter-clockwise cardinal direction.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A target walked into the south wall will move west if unable to move east, skipping north.

Walking Bosses
⬥ To see an how walking a boss like Araxxor works, [https://youtu.be/A_6ah7GF_1k click here]

​

Weapon Poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]

How It Works

⬥ Weapon Poison provides a buff that allows players to have a 12.5% chance of poisoning a non-immune target every attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Duration of this buff depends on the grade of poison (normal, +, ++, +++) being used.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After being poisoned [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] targets will take damage every 16t/9.6s, for 3 minutes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Poison damage hits 2t after the damage that applied it.

​

Calculating Poison Damage

⬥ Base poison damage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] is 20% of ability damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each tier of weapon poison (+, ++, +++) increases this value by 25% of its base value. Cinderbane gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] also give an additional 25%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The final damage is 65-130% of the total value.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unless refreshed, the damage range is reduced by 3% every poison hit.

⬥ Final poison damage averages in terms of ability damage:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon Poison: 19.5% (1)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon Poison+: 16.25-32.50% (average 24.36%)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon Poison++: 19.50-39.00% (average 29.25%)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon Poison+++: 22.75-45.50% (average 34.13%)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cinderbanes+++ 26.00-52.00% (average 39.00%)

⬥ Poison damage is affected by a number of items, covered in the following section.

​

Poison Interactions

⬥ Cinderbane gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ignores the 16t poison damage cooldown.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gives 1/8 (12.5%) chance per hit to apply poison, doing an extra hit of damage and resetting the 16t damage timer.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Also gives 1/8 (12.5%) chance for a poison hit to re-apply poison, also resetting the 16t timer.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Works out to an effective 1/7 (~14.3%) chance of apply poison on any given hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If no poison variant is used, the gloves act as if Weapon Poison+ is used.

⬥ Kwuarm Incense Sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Per level of potency, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks] will add a multiplicative +2% increase to the final poison damage (up to 10% at potency level 4).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This therefore stacks with other buffs.

⬥ Bik Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697235689513.png?v=1 bikarrow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Per stack, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697235689513.png?v=1 bikarrow] will add a multiplicative +3% increase to the final poison damage (up to +450% at 150 stacks).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One arrow is consumed per hit (except bleed hits).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stacks last 30 seconds, and vanish entirely if not refreshed within the duration.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They are recommended to be used at fights that take 3-4 minutes or longer where poison-stacking methods can be utilised.

⬥ Laniakea's Spear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Increases the rate of application of poison is by an additive 5%, increasing it from 12.5% → 17.5%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After accounting for poison re-applying itself, this gives an effective application rate per hitsplat of ~21.2% (up from ~14.3% with Cinderbanes).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Also increases poison damage by a multiplicative 5%, similar to Kwuarm Incense Sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks].

⬥ Upgraded Bone Blowpipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010563018772.png?v=1 boneblowpipe]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Halves poison damage but doubles the number of procs from every 16 ticks → every 8 ticks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This effect does halve the damage of poison procs caused by Cinderbane gloves, but does not double its proc chance

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This effectively halves your poison damage if used in combination with Cinderbane gloves.

⬥ Wyvern Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522587729940.png?v=1 wyverncrossbow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Applies its own "poison" damage separate from normal weapon poison.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 50% chance per hit to apply a DoT that can stack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ DoT deals damage 5 times, every 2 ticks, unless refreshed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Damage range increases with stacks, from 10-24 per hit → 125-249 per hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The extra hitsplats from the DoT on the target increase the chances for normal poison damage to apply.

⬥ Poison can be applied/refreshed by any player-sourced damage, including:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All auto-attacks and abilities - including bleeds and DoTs from abilities like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / etc.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal Parasites [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1276946271424479234.png?v=1 primalabyssalarmourspikes]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bakriminel Bolts (extra hits from Emerald [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/866551637714665484.png?v=1 emeraldbakri] and Dragonstone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489144852511.png?v=1 DragonstoneBakri] bolts)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood Necklaces [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1015698981118038117.png?v=1 bloodfury]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dwarf Multicannon (+upgrades) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dominion Mines [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• God books and Scriptures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159051915264.png?v=1 armabook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1 scriptureofjas] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Poison Damage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] (can re-apply itself)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Puncture bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1025020525770178661.png?v=1 punctureddebuff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reflect damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wyvern Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522587729940.png?v=1 wyverncrossbow] (passive effect)

⬥ Self-Healing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 VampScrim]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Poison damage dealt by the player will not heal them through any means.

​

Poison in Group Encounters

⬥ Global modifiers like Bik arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697235689513.png?v=1 bikarrow] or Vuln [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] that are target-based will affect all poison damage (i.e. sourced from any player).

⬥ Local modifiers (that are player-specific) like Cinderbanes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] / Wyvern Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522587729940.png?v=1 wyverncrossbow] / etc. will only affect the hitsplats as a result of that player.

⬥ The single recurring poison hit that occurs on a poisoned target every 9.6s will take its damage based on the last player who applied poison on the target.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/BzE7Gzo.jpg Guide illustration]

Introduction

This guide is oriented towards first time mobile users and those looking to set up themselves better to succeed. Once you are set up properly and used to using the mobile interface, all other guides can be roughly followed.

​

Getting Started

To enter combat mode you simply press the shield and sword icon in the bottom left corner.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YFWAfYH.png Guide illustration]

Main Action Bar

⬥ This should contain any switches, defensives, food, potions and prayers you will be needing during the fight.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Omit anything from the bar that is not time sensitive that may be used within a large window.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Overload, excalibur, elven ritual shard, prayer potions, etc.

⬥ To change your main action bar, press the number on the far left to open a menu to change the Main Action Bar.

⬥ More advanced bosses and rotations may involve using additional bars, this will be covered later.

⬥ Try to keep switches, prayers and food on the left side of this bar so you may open ability books to manually use abilities.

⬥ These are set up in this way so you can open your ability books and manually cast abilities while having access to your prayers, weapons and food.

​

Revolution Action Bar

⬥ This is a normal revolution bar, you may change the number of slots it uses in combat settings.

⬥ For help making optimal revolution bars:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Source channel no longer available

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Contains a variety of information on ability damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Revolution Damage Calculator - [http://rs-revolution.herokuapp.com/bar/ http://rs-revolution.herokuapp.com/bar/]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Helps compare damage on different ability bars

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• RuneScape Wiki - [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revolution/Bars https://runescape.wiki/w/Revolution/Bars]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ In depth sample revolution bars

Note: You may also choose to use !revo ‎or !revo++ ‎in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)] for more examples.

​

Target Information

⬥ Shows you the information on your current target.

⬥ You may tap this button to Target Cycle to a new target as well.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For more information on Target Cycle see [[PvME/Combat reference/Mechanics|Mechanics]].

​

Player Status

⬥ Displays your current buffs, debuffs, HP, adrenaline, prayer points and summoning points.

​

Combat Settings

⬥ Used to enable and disable combat mode.

⬥ Opens menu to select your Main Action Bar.

⬥ This is primarily used to change the contents of your ability bars.

⬥ Long tapping this will lock and unlock your ability bars.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows you to drag and drop items from your inventory and worn equipment onto your ability bar.

​

Example Ability Bars

Normal Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LQ6nALa.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Revolution Action Bar and Main Action Bar appropriately set up

​

Specialised Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xht0xKH.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Revolution Action Bar remains the same and Main action bar has been swapped

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This action bar may be for a specialised dps rotation, to deal with mechanics, etc.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This normally will include abilities which you would otherwise be unable to cast back to back from ability books.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ An example of this would be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] + ability

​

Content Based Information

Afk Content

Plenty of content is able to be done completely afk, below is a list of some examples of guides of afk content. The mobile client has a slightly larger area loot range and is preferred for afking spread out targets, this may be further extended with the Lorehound pet.

​

AFK Guides

⬥ [[PvME/Arch-Glacor/AFK Arch Glacor|AFK Arch Glacor]]

⬥ Referenced guide unavailable in this snapshot

⬥ [[PvME/Corporeal Beast/AFK Corporeal Beast|AFK Corporeal Beast]]

⬥ Referenced guide unavailable in this snapshot

⬥ [[PvME/Kalphite Queen/AFK Kalphite Queen|AFK Kalphite Queen]]

⬥ [[PvME/Gregorovic/AFK Gregorovic|AFK Gregorovic]]

⬥ [[PvME/Kree’arra/AFK Kree Arra|AFK Kree Arra]] (HM)

⬥ [[PvME/Helwyr/AFK Helwyr|AFK Helwyr]]

⬥ Source channel no longer available

⬥ [[PvME/Kerapac/Low Effort Kerapac|Low Effort Kerapac]]

⬥ [[PvME/The Magister/Low Effort Magister|Low Effort Magister]]

⬥ [[PvME/Twin Furies/AFK Twin Furies|AFK Twin Furies]]

⬥ [[PvME/Vindicta Gorvek/AFK Vindicta|AFK Vindicta]]

Note: This may be outdated. For a full list feel free to use !afkguides ‎in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)].

​

Non-Afk Content

⬥ Require manually inputting defensives, prayer flicking, and weapon switches.

⬥ These bosses may require periods of high damage, lots of prayer flicking and different abilities required on an additional main action bar.

​

Examples

⬥ Testing and review of a variety of bosses: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W8Mq-I3ag68 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W8Mq-I3ag68]

⬥ 4000% Telos: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h2KiASH2wYU https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h2KiASH2wYU]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

PvME is open-source! If you have a suggested improvement, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]

​

This guide lists the recommended Action Bars to use in Revolution combat mode (see section Configuring Revolution+ later in this guide for more info).

​

The different combinations of bars are:

⬥ Single-target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget] (e.g., most bosses)

⬥ Multi-target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770974431944835.png?v=1 multitarget] (e.g., slayer mobs)

⬥ 2-handed (only one weapon can be equipped)

⬥ Dual-wield (where two weapons can be equipped, one in each hand)

​

If a combination is not displayed, it means the bar scored poorly in tests and is not worth using.

​

Disclaimer

No revolution bar is perfect for every situation - unless you have accessibility needs, we strongly recommend learning full manual to gain total control over which abilities are fired when. You can find more information in [[PvME/Learning to boss/Revo To Full Manual|Revo To Full Manual]]

​

Variances may include:

⬥ Single-target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1 singletarget] bars performing differently based on duration of the fight

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Testing was conducted at both War's Retreat dummies and Vindicta

⬥ Multi-target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770974431944835.png?v=1 multitarget] bars performing differently based on the number of enemies surrounding you, and their life points
