[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide lists the general natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. From levels 1 - 50, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.

Last Revised: 13 April 2024

Levels 1 - 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Gear:

⬥ 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Caitlin%27s_staff Caitlin's staff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Free from the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact] and provides unlimited [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 airrune]

⬥ 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Mindspike Mindspike]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Free and can be obtained from [https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik Gudrik] in Port Sarim

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlimited supply of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 airrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1 waterrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1 earthrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1 firerune] in the element the player chooses

⬥ 10 ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] Imp horn wand, Imphide book

⬥ 20 ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] Spider wand, Spider orb

​

Armour

⬥ 1 ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Pathfinder armour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This armour is free and can be obtained from [https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik Gudrik] in Port Sarim.

⬥ 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Spider silk robes

⬥ Amulet of Magic

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Spellstorm_drape Spellstorm drape] - Best in Slot cape for F2P

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Silverhawk_boots Silverhawk boots] (non-ironman & P2P) can be freely claimed from the Marketplace and give a small damage boost.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] respectively.

​

Ability bars levels 1 - 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Use the lesser abilities as placeholders. These will update automatically as you unlock the full ability.

​

Bar at 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5JhxQueXvB.png Guide illustration]

⬥ At level 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] add [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] to Spot 1 on your bar

⬥ At level 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] add [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] to Spot 3 on your bar

​

At level 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] your bar will look like the bar below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/AK8b1bEJyh.png Guide illustration]

Monsters to kill 1 - 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghostly_troll_thrower Ghostly Troll Thrower] in City of Um cave.

⬥ Monsters in [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lumbridge_Catacombs#Monsters Lumbridge Catacombs]. Requires [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact quest].

Levels 20 - 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Gear:

⬥ 30 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] Air/Water/Earth/Fire battlestaff (P2P only) or Batwing wand & Batwing book

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Former provides unlimited supply of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 airrune] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1 waterrune] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1 earthrune] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1 firerune]

⬥ 40 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] Mystic Air/Water/Earth/Fire staff (P2P only) or Splitbark wand & Splitbark orb

⬥ 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_staff Ancient staff] (P2P only) or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Iban%27s_staff Iban's staff] (P2P only) or Mystic wand & Mystic orb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ancient Staff requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/Desert_Treasure/Quick_guide Desert Treasure]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Iban's Staff requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/Underground_Pass/Quick_guide Underground Pass]

​

Armour

⬥ 30 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Batwing robes

⬥ 40 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lunar_equipment Lunar equipment] > Splitbark armour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lunar equipment requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lunar_Diplomacy/Quick_guide Lunar Diplomacy]

⬥ 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skeletal_armour Skeletal armour] (P2P) > Mystic equipment (F2P)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skeletal armour requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Fremennik_Trials/Quick_guide The Fremennik Trials] to be worn.

⬥ Obsidian cape (P2P) or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cape_of_legends Cape of legends] (P2P)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Latter requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/Legends%27_Quest/Quick_guide Legends Quest]

⬥ Amulet of glory (P2P)

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Explorer%27s_ring_3 Explorer's ring 3] (F2P) or Ring of Wealth (P2P)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Former requires completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Medium_Lumbridge_achievements medium Lumbridge achievements]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Silverhawk_boots Silverhawk boots] (non-ironman & P2P)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50, and 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] respectively.

Ability bars levels 20 - 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Bar at 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/AK8b1bEJyh.png Guide illustration]

⬥ At level 37 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] you will unlock [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto]

⬥ At level 45 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] add [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1 chain] to Spot 9 on your bar

​

At level 45 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] your bar will look like the bar below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/s4fWdNNQ0C.png Guide illustration]

Monsters to kill 20 - 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghostly_troll_thrower Ghostly Troll Thrower] in City of Um cave.

⬥ 30+: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragith_Nurn#Monster Dragith Nurn]. Requires [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact quest] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] works!).

Levels 50 - 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Gear:

⬥ 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Guthix_staff Guthix staff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] or Grifolic wand & Grifolic orb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] bought from the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Arena Mage Arena] - whilst there, unlock the special attack

⬥ 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_staff Crystal staff] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_wand Crystal wand] & [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_orb Crystal orb]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both require 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864819760758844.png?v=1 agility] and completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/roving_elves/Quick_guide Roving Elves]

​

Armour

⬥ 65 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Superior_skeletal_armour Superior Skeletal armour] - made using Skeletal armour and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fremennik_equipment_patch Fremennik equipment patches]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Whilst Superior Skeletal armour degrades, degradation takes a very long time - don't let this put you off!

⬥ 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Subjugation robe armour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This an expensive but worthwhile upgrade - it is okay to use Superior Skeletal armour until this becomes affordable

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet(e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] if fighting undead.

⬥ Ring of Fortune

⬥ One of the God books [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439461404682.png?v=1 zarosbook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439356809216.png?v=1 guthixbook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439461404672.png?v=1 zambook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159051915264.png?v=1 armabook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439473987628.png?v=1 bandosbook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439482638346.png?v=1 sarabook]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/Horror_from_the_Deep/Quick_guide Horror from the Deep]

Ability bars levels 50 - 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Bar at 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/s4fWdNNQ0C.png Guide illustration] ⬥ At level 55 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] add [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] to Spot 2 on your bar and remove [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]

​

At level 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] your bar will look like the bar below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JAH1UXIfr4.png Guide illustration]

Monsters to kill 50 - 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragith_Nurn#Monster Dragith Nurn]. Requires [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact quest] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] works!).

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyss/Combat_training The Abyss Monsters] (req. [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss_(miniquest)/Quick_guide Enter the Abyss miniquest]).

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoured_zombie Armoured Zombies] (req. [https://runescape.wiki/w/Defender_of_Varrock/Quick_guide Defender of Varrock quest], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] works!).

​

Frequently asked questions

⬥ At level 37 I unlock Detonate but it's not used on the bars. Why?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Detonate is an Area-of-effect ability that doesn't work well with revolution - you will have to activate this manually as it requires charging. Revolution will override the charge and "waste" the ability.

⬥ What are Special Attacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and how do I use them?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Certain weapons e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] have special attacks - these are powerful abilities that you have to activate manually. Therefore, place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] outside your revolution bar (the abilities with gold trim around them) if your weapon has one. You can find the ability in your Constitution [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] abilities.

⬥ How do I select a spell?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To select a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] combat spell:

Spellbook → right click chosen spell → select auto cast → select option 3 (main hand & off-hand).

⬥ When should I change spells?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You should regularly upgrade your auto-cast to the highest available spell tier. You can find out a spell's damage level cap by checking its tooltip.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example: Air strike's damage cap is at level 16 - you can upgrade to Air bolt at level 17.

⬥ Can I just train slayer?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.

⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide lists the general natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. ‎ ‎From levels 1 - 50, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.

Last Revised: 13 April 2024

​

Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] and Strength [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength] are the two combat skills that define melee combat in Runescape.

⬥ General notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] affects accuracy and its level is what determines what melee weapons you can equip.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Strength [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength] determines your damage dealt with melee weapons.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The best defence is a good offence: weapon upgrades take precedence over armour upgrades!

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As you get stronger, dual wield becomes better for single target combat and Two-handed (2H) for multi-way combat

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To switch xp gain between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]: Settings → Gameplay → Combat & Action bar → Combat XP. Tick the skills to enable how you want the XP focused.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All bars assume "Revolution++" is being used: Settings → Gameplay → Combat & Action bar. Activate revolution, make the revo outline cover 10 slots, and tick the boxes for thresholds and ultimate abilities.

Levels 1 - 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]

Gear:

⬥ 1 ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] Bronze 2h sword or Bronze halberd; or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Reese%27s_sword Reese's sword] & [https://runescape.wiki/w/Reese%27s_off-hand_sword Reese's off-hand sword]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Latter are free from the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact]

⬥ 5 ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Keenblade Keenblade]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Free from [https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik Gudrik] in Port Sarim

⬥ 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] Steel 2h sword or Steel halberd; or Steel dagger, mace, or warhammer + off-hand.

Armour

⬥ 1 ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Pathfinder armour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This armour is free and can be obtained from [https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik Gudrik] in Port Sarim.

⬥ 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Steel armour

⬥ Amulet of strength

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Bladestorm_drape Bladestorm drape] - Best in Slot cape for F2P

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Silverhawk_boots Silverhawk boots] (non-ironman & P2P) can be freely claimed from the Marketplace and give a small damage boost.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] respectively.

Ability bars levels 1 - 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]

These bars assume you are training Attack and Strength at the same time.

⬥ Use the lesser abilities as placeholders. These will update automatically as you unlock the full ability.

​

Bar at 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]: For Dual-Wield swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1217207451536068628.png?v=1 lessersmash] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1217207450273448137.png?v=1 lesserhavoc]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/yrnmiJkWcN.png Guide illustration]

​

At level 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength], your bar will look like the bar below:

​

Armour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence]

Ability bars levels 20 - 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]

⬥ 30+: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragith_Nurn#Monster Dragith Nurn]. Requires [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact quest] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] works!).

Gear:

⬥ 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] Dragon 2h sword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword], Dragon spear or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_halberd Dragon halberd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864819760758844.png?v=1 agility] and completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Roving_Elves/Quick_guide Roving Elves] quest

Armour

⬥ 65 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Superior_rock-shell_armour Superior Rockshell armour] - made using Rockshell armour and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fremennik_equipment_patch Fremennik equipment patches]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Whilst Superior Rockshell armour degrades, degradation takes a very long time - don't let this put you off!

⬥ 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] Bandos armour > Necronium armour

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet(e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] if fighting undead.

⬥ Ring of Fortune

⬥ One of the God books [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439461404682.png?v=1 zarosbook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439356809216.png?v=1 guthixbook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439461404672.png?v=1 zambook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159051915264.png?v=1 armabook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439473987628.png?v=1 bandosbook] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439482638346.png?v=1 sarabook]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of the quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/Horror_from_the_Deep/Quick_guide Horror from the Deep]

Ability bars levels 50 - 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]

Bars at 50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]

⬥ If DW:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At level 67 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength] add Decimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879325822986.png?v=1 deci] to Spot 4 on your bar

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Put [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1 slaughter] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] on Spots 5 and 6.

​

At level 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength], your bar will look like the bar below:

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] Two-Handed (multi-target focused)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/3iR7hF8HrU.png Guide illustration]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] Dual-Wield

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Hw1JjTSnch.png Guide illustration]

Monsters to kill 50 - 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragith_Nurn#Monster Dragith Nurn]. Requires [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide Blood Pact quest] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] works!).

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyss/Combat_training The Abyss Monsters] (req. [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss_(miniquest)/Quick_guide Enter the Abyss miniquest]).

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoured_zombie Armoured Zombies] (req. [https://runescape.wiki/w/Defender_of_Varrock/Quick_guide Defender of Varrock quest], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] works!).

Frequently asked questions

⬥ Some dual wield weapons have more damage bonus than others. Are they better?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• No. When using abilities, weapons of the same tier deal the same amount of damage. Weapon speed and damage bonus together make it deal identical ability damage in the end.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can safely mix different types of main hand and off-hand weapons.

⬥ Why is two-handed recommended over dual wield?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2H melee is better in multi-target situations than Dual-Wield, and therefore often lead to faster levelling.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ‎ ‎Flurry [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1 flurry] (37 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack]), Quake [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] (36 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]), Cleave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave] (48 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 strength]), and hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] (55 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 attack]) are multi-target attacks, often called Area-of-Effect (AoE) abilities, that hit multiple nearby monsters.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These are 2H abilities (except for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1 flurry]) and benefit greatly from halberd's larger attack range.

⬥ Can I just train slayer?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.

⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.

​

Introduction

This guide lists the general natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. From levels 1 - 20, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.

Last Revised: 11 June 2024

​

All bars assume Revo++ is being used. The bars below are taken from the Youtube video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rLEbibxK6OI Necromancy revolution bars]. Below we use the AoE Healing bars as our main AoE bar whilst you learn combat in RuneScape. It is worth noting that Necromancy ability bars can change upon every new ability unlock. Therefore, for more granular information on how to set up your ability bars at each ability unlock, check out the linked video above.

Talent Tree Unlocks

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xoUfjyZr9M.png Guide illustration] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Talents Talents] allow the player to unlock and upgrade Necromancy abilities, incantations, and passive effects. Talents can be unlocked with talent points, which can be acquired by gaining experience in combat using necromancy as a combat style. Unlocking higher tiers requires a combination of Necromancy levels, an amount of souls contributed to the Well of Souls through rituals, at least one talent from the previous tier, as well as the completion of quests and are managed at the Well of Souls at the ritual site in the City of Um.

​

Frequently asked questions

⬥ Why are there only Dual Wield weapons listed here?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] currently only has Dual Wield weapons. This guide will be updated should this change in the future.

⬥ What are Special Attacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and how do I use them?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Certain weapons e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] have special attacks - these are powerful abilities that you have to activate manually. Therefore, place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] outside your revolution bar (the abilities with gold trim around them) if your weapon has one. You can find the ability in your Constitution [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] abilities.

⬥ Can I just train slayer?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.

⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.

Introduction

This guide lists the general natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. From levels 1 - 50, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.

Levels 1 - 20 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/C2VhF0emPG.png Guide illustration] From levels 50 to 70 Ranged, there are no recommended abilities to add for Revolution. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard] is not recommended due to being low damage output.

​

Monsters to kill 50 - 70 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyss/Combat_training The Abyss Monsters] (req. [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss_(miniquest)/Quick_guide Enter the Abyss miniquest]).

​

Frequently asked questions

⬥ Some Dual-Wield weapons have more damage bonus than others. Are they better?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• No. When using abilities, weapons of the same tier deal the same amount of damage. Weapon speed and damage bonus together make it deal identical ability damage in the end.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can safely mix different types of main hand and off-hand weapons.

⬥ Why do I prefer crossbows to bows?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At this stage in the game, crossbows are stronger than bows because of the enchanted effects on bolts.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This reverses when arrows have better effects in the later game.

⬥ When should I change ammo?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage is capped at the tier of the bow or the tier of the arrow - whichever is lowest. As you upgrade your bow/crossbow, you should also upgrade your ammo.

⬥ Can I just train slayer?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.

⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

K'ril Tsutsaroth, General Graardor, Commander Zilyana and King Black Dragon

This guide will cover the basic strategy to get your first 1 tick boss kills. These 1 tick kills are fairly consistent, and are a good entry point to make progress towards minimum tick feats roles.

​

⬥ These Bosses have been grouped together due to them using the same setup and rotation. This works as they are in a similar HP range (40-60k), K'ril and Zilyana will need better luck or more granite mauls due to having slightly more hp.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You may have to incorporate a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] end with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen]

⬥ For general 1 tick kill information, and some useful tips and tricks make sure to read [[PvME/One-tick guides/General Tips|General Tips]].

​

Positioning

In the below images the boss spawns covering the Blue square, and you can stand on any tile in the Red square INCLUDING under the boss.

Positioning
⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/aTlpHKSowP.png General Graardor] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/zCpr0i7R9m.png Commander Zilyana] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/IpZwHBN7RQ.png King Black Dragon] ⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/bW5Q7S4REJ.png K'ril Tsutsaroth]

​

Melee

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=cc5793e3-afa6-449d-bd36-b31b535f7c49 Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

⬥ Many items can be downgraded and still get fairly consistent 1t kills, however the more downgrades that are made the more attempts will be needed on average.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fcc5793e3-afa6-449d-bd36-b31b535f7c49.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

This is the basic rotation for these speed kills, many other rotations can be done instead.

​

War's Retreat Build

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk]

​

In Instance

⬥ At any point after entering the instance switch to Grim [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] and activate.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] + place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → (4t) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → (tc) r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OKq3XmFZ4zs Melee examples]

​

Necromancy

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FuOclPKFh7UzUHRlLnT6S.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

This is the basic rotation for these speed kills, many other rotations can be done instead.

​

War's Retreat Build

Build 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks with the following rotation:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

Off and wait 10 seconds to drop combat:

​

In Instance

⬥ At any point after entering the portal switch to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] and activate.

⬥ You only need the second rotation including [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] for Commander Zilyana.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer] can be used for extra damage on KBD / K'ril after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90]

​

Wait until [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] has 10 seconds or less on its cooldown then enter the instance:

Go through door + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → wait until [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] has 11 seconds on its cooldown remaining (1s if mobile is on your gear) →

⬥ ( tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] )

⬥ ( tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec])

​

Note: Inputs within ( ) should be done in the right order, in the same tick.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide will cover general tips, tricks and mechanics that are used throughout the 1 tick boss kill guides. It is recommended you read over this before attempting advanced 1t boss kills, however you will still be fine to attempt more basic 1t kills with very little info from this guide.

​

1 tick boss kills are defined and graded [https://www.pvm-records.com/onetickinfo here], and you can submit your 1t kills to PvM Records to fill in your profile!

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While we will often refer to these as 1t kills, they are actually tick perfect. Due to phase transition and spawning animations these can often be more than 1 tick long.

​

⬥ A lot of these 1t boss kills can be very RNG reliant, or difficult to execute. Try not to get disheartened if a certain kill is taking a long time, but do submit attempts to [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1019648841965916220 VOD reviews (external Discord)] if you are not sure if you are doing the kill correctly. This will allow more experienced 1t killers to help you find your mistakes.

​

General Recommendations

⬥ Always use a Kal'gerion Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll], you want as much crit chance as possible.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using Dragon Battleaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] you can use your Kalg spec at any point after this, and it will last long enough

⬥ If meleeing try to input an extra Gmaul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] or two if you are comfortable to take advantage of relentless procs.

⬥ Using the Berserker's Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1 berserkersfury] and lowering your HP using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159085207555.png?v=1 onsl] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] initially, and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588632092694.png?v=1 zamorakbrew] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132202052567715890.png?v=1 dwarvenrockcake] to get it lower. Sitting at the lowest HP you are comfortable at provides a noticeable damage increase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To increase safety ensure to always have disruption shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] up.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Maintaining low health is easier while NOT having the constitution skillcape perk active.

⬥ For more complex builds avoid clicking items out of your inventory as this will cancel charging adrenaline from the crystals

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The items can either be keybound or clicked off a bar

Keybinds

To effectively go for 1 tick kills you will most likely have to mess up some of your bars and ability bindings. It is highly recommended to take a screenshot of your bars and binds before and after doing this for reference.

⬥ Changing binds allows you to set inputs that need to be done rapidly close together (e.g. qwert or asdfghj) so that you can click them easier or run your finger across the keyboard to click them.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can make the inputs required for a kill significantly easier.

​

Berserker Blood Essence

Berserker blood essence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132205017546358794.png?v=1 berserkerbloodess] is very good for short speed kills as it allows for higher strength level boosts than an overload

⬥ +36 strength level bonus for 20s compared to +31 from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1 berserker]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As you are not overloaded, you will want to use the berserker prayer to extend these stat boost.

​

Melee

To get the largest boosts from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132205017546358794.png?v=1 berserkerbloodess] for melee, you will need to pair it with Super Warmaster Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132202567875702864.png?v=1 supremewarmasters], an Extreme Attack Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1133056073339785349.png?v=1 extremeattack], Extreme Necromancy Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1246044583453003786.png?v=1 extremenecro] and DBA [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

The order of actions to get these boosts is as follows

⬥ Drink the Super Warmaster Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132202567875702864.png?v=1 supremewarmasters] and Extreme Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1246044583453003786.png?v=1 extremenecro] just before you DBA [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

⬥ DBA spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This drains your non strength combat stats

⬥ Drink Extreme Attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1133056073339785349.png?v=1 extremeattack] to boost your hitchance (This is not always needed depending on the boss)

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132205017546358794.png?v=1 berserkerbloodess] just before your kill, then equip and activate Grimoire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim]

Note: if on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1 berserker] drink [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132202567875702864.png?v=1 supremewarmasters]

​

Ranged

To get the largest boosts from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132205017546358794.png?v=1 berserkerbloodess] for ranged, you will need to pair it with a Supreme Ranging Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1133050157294956714.png?v=1 supremeranging]

​

The order of actions to get these boosts is as follows

⬥ Drink the Supreme Ranging Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1133050157294956714.png?v=1 supremeranging]

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132205017546358794.png?v=1 berserkerbloodess] just before your kill, then equip and activate Grimoire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim]

​

If you need to go through an area where you may get attacked, it is beneficial to equip a different pocket slot to stop the passive effect of the Blood essence activating as this stops you using the active. When needing to use the essence you should equip and use it in 1 tick to ensure it activates.

Examples of this include

⬥ GWD1

⬥ GWD2

⬥ ED2

Note: Berserker blood essence is not needed for lower end 1t kills (such as NM Graardor, NM K'ril, NM Zilyana and KBD) however it will still help

​

General GWD1 Tips

⬥ Ensure you have the Stone of Jas buff active if you have it unlocked

⬥ Equip shard of zaros to stop the portal warning screen and stop yourself getting attacked

⬥ When doing K'ril your prayer will be drained upon portal entry. Drink some form of prayer potion and reactivate your prayers

⬥ Minions spawn 1 tick after the bosses. If you end up targeting a minion you will have target cycled at least 1 tick late

⬥ If doing the no prep Kree 1 tick method you will need to use backwards tc to avoid going onto your dummy

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

This guide will cover the basic strategy to get a tick perfect kill at legios (3.6s). This 1 tick kill is fairly consistent, and a fairly easy 1t to make progress towards minimum tick feats roles.

​

⬥ For general 1t kill information, and some useful tips and tricks make sure to read [[PvME/One-tick guides/General Tips|General Tips]]

​

⬥ This kill requires being on a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer#Social_Slayer Co-op slayer assignment]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To do this it is recommended to both get the task individually and then join a social slayer group by using an enchanted gem on the other person.

⬥ After getting the task, both go to the legio you wish to kill, and have one person enter. The other will get a popup asking if they want to join.

⬥ Quickly kill the spawned legio, and then you can setup for the 1t kill, bring multiple keys and dummies to do multiple attempts in the instance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done at any legio.

⬥ For this 1t, one person will be the damage dealer and one person will start the fight.

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=HK6RglCdwLR1tbLtBZ2w Ranged - Basic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Many items can be downgraded and still get 1t kills, however the more downgrades that are made the more attempts will be needed on average.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For info on how to use Berserker blood essence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1132205017546358794.png?v=1 berserkerbloodess] see [[PvME/One-tick guides/General Tips|General Tips]]

⬥ The person starting the fight will need keys, food, and some prayer restoration to protect from magic if the 1t is not done successfully.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FHK6RglCdwLR1tbLtBZ2w.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

This is the basic rotation for this speed kills, while many other rotations can be done instead.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] → build to 100% adren → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to legio spawn tile → ( tc → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] + r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] )

​

Inputs within ( ) should be done in the right order, in the same tick

Within a short time of tc, use your blood essence as described in [[PvME/One-tick guides/General Tips|General Tips]]

​

The person starting the fight should do so by pre clicking the door, and then pressing start 3 ticks after the damage dealer uses dive.

​

Positioning

Make sure to be stood under thee legio spawn when target cycling and releasing your abilities, as legiones have damage reduction based on distance from them, and you deal 110% damage while stood under. It is useful to check the spawn position when you first enter the instance.

​

Example Kill

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bAOggYK8ZjY Example kill]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/bAOggYK8ZjY Embedded guide video]

Note: The positioning will vary depending on the Legio being killed but the rotation is the same.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WtQpNoN.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide will cover the basic strategy to get a tick perfect kill at Rise of the Six in a 4 man team.

​

⬥ For general 1 tick kill information, and some useful tips and tricks make sure to read [[PvME/One-tick guides/General Tips|General Tips]]

​

⬥ This method requires everyone to use Necromancy, everyone on the team should be at least level 110 or higher, the higher the easier the 1 tick will be.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=SX3hOCa4jOiUwcxYoe7T Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FSX3hOCa4jOiUwcxYoe7T.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

⬥ Do the entire rotation on the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]

⬥ Turning off revolution [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] will help.

​

Build 12 Necrosis Stacks with the following rotation:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

​

The person starting the fight should signal they are ready with an ability such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom], the starter will also have to do it slightly differently. They also must have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] bound somewhere on their actionbar.

​

Starter Rotation is as follows:

Note: make sure you press 1 + click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] 4 ticks after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate]

⬥ Signal with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → click Disrupt Shadow portal → space → 1 + click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] in the same tick.

​

Once the person who is starting has signalled they are about to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] do the following rotation 3 ticks after their signal:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → wait 4 ticks → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Positioning

⬥ Place the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] 1 West / East of the middle brother (blue squares in image below).

⬥ On each side, a player will stand 1 North and 1 South of the middle brother. This helps distinguish between players (green squares in image below).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gGu7jsdNVk.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kill

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uzAo0HabV7I Starter POV]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/uzAo0HabV7I Embedded guide video]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zxLswr2B8q.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

The Barrows Brothers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513222840162582541.png?v=1 dharokhead] are mainly camped by high-level players in an effort to obtain the Graverobber title. The brothers are relatively weak, with the exception of Linza.

​

Useful Unlocks

⬥ Completing all [https://runescape.wiki/w/Morytania_Set_Tasks_-_Hard Hard Morytania achievements]:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Doubles rune drops

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows you to bank loot directly from the chest

⬥ Completing all [https://runescape.wiki/w/War%27s_Blessing_1 Easy Combat Mastery Achievements]:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Portals will permanently appear in corner & central rooms of the underground crypt

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Teleporting via these portals circumvents the need to to solve puzzles or open doors

⬥ Bringing a Dragon/Barrows defender allows for additional defender components. Corrupted sigils can be dissasembled for undead components

​

The Fight

Suggested order for killing the brothers:

Linza → Ahrim → Verac → Akrisae → Torag → Karil → Guthan → Dharok

​

General Strategy

⬥ It is recommended to be on an Undead slayer task to benefit from the slayer helmet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and Guardhouse boosts

⬥ You can pre-vuln by using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] on the ground after clicking the sarcophagus

⬥ Bringing a spade and using it to dig in order to enter the mounds is quicker

⬥ Good movement can improve the efficiency of your runs, below are some examples starting at Dharok's crypt:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://youtu.be/f4UiE6w-0zs Guthan last]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LnnjpAuaeLE Akrisae last]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vUq-P5gYWgk Karil last]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=igtJtWTDS90 Torag last]

​

Necromancy

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ca2b614a-96ff-4c1f-a697-a2c32e5a09d0 Necromancy Preset] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fca2b614a-96ff-4c1f-a697-a2c32e5a09d0.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

Renew conjures as needed

​

Default to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] for all regular brothers. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517253056024647.png?v=1 barrowsamulet] to skip Akrisae

​

Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] when moving between brothers

​

Linza and Ahrim

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to Linza → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec])

​

Notes:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] as you click on Ahrim's tomb

⬥ Run over to Ahrim whilst doing the rotation, be sure to not run out of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] range

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1uFaRsE6ol8 Example Necromancy run]

​

Magic

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=975a86d0-7991-44e1-b727-39b55ddd5184 Magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F975a86d0-7991-44e1-b727-39b55ddd5184.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ Augmented gear piece has Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] Undead Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]

​

Rotations

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lunging is recomended on the orb but not necessary, Linza might take an additional ability without it

⬥ Can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517253056024647.png?v=1 barrowsamulet] to skip any brother other than Linza

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This guide assumes you don't use them

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This guide assumes you reset at War's Retreat after every run

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] while running to Ahrim, you still want enough time on runic to use the second Linza rotation if Ahrim is in the tunnel

​

Ahrim

Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] while running to Ahrim (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1 corruptionblast] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic]

Note: move towards Linza while using the abilities.

​

Linza

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] reset [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] again otherwise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc]

​

Ahrim Tunnel

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HikgVgk3I1.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

The Corporeal Beast is a boss unlocked from completing the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Summer's_End Summer's End] quest. Summoning familiars cannot be used at this boss, however a legendary pet can be used here.

​

Mechanics

Mechanics
Auto Attacks
⬥ Only uses magic attacks if you are outside of melee distance. ⬥ Uses magic and melee attacks if you are in melee distance.     • Protection prayers only partially reduce damage rather than halve it     • Magic attacks will do an AOE splash on their target in a 3x3 square. ​
Core
⬥ Occasionally, a dark core will spawn and jump towards its target. ⬥ The core will do constant typeless damage while nearby.     • Damage will stop when you step more than 1 square away.     • Will heal the boss unless it is killed or you step away from it. ​

​

General

Any weapon that isn't a Spear will deal half damage, so Melee is the recommended style that should be used at this boss.

​

⬥ It Is recommended to teleport out [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] after every kill to reset Abilities, Health and Prayer.

​

⬥ AFK methods can be found in [[PvME/Corporeal Beast/AFK Corporeal Beast|AFK Corporeal Beast]]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xHpS3qu3aW.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

The Dagannoth Kings are located at the bottom of the cave in Waterbirth Island, and are generally only camped by high level players in an effort to get the pets or the collection log.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=WVderdEaRP6HcbMphACG Low-level]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=BaFDdRaZawclqmjb8h6c High-level]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FBaFDdRaZawclqmjb8h6c.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Active Strategy

The Fight

Camp Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and switch to the respective T95/T99 Curses ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 Affliction] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 Desolation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 Malevolence]) as you kill the Kings. Cancel the channelled threshold abilities with basic abilities to gain additional adren if the King is about to die.

​

Rotations

⬥ Dagannoth Supreme

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] → walked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1 slaughter] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854327640064.png?v=1 bloodtendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] (cancel with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879577612298.png?v=1 sever])

​

⬥ Dagannoth Prime

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541273755385885.png?v=1 frag] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] (cancel with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds])

​

⬥ Dagannoth Rex

walked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373972443775056.png?v=1 sonicwave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (cancel with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439366708592651.png?v=1 wrack])

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/SdFGL1LHkjk Active]

​

Revolution++ Strategy

It’s possible to “semi-AFK” the Dagannoth Kings by switching weapons and using revolution, even without any hybrid armour. Normally, using armour that’s off-style has an accuracy penalty i.e. if using a Melee weapon, then magic/ranged armour will lower accuracy. For DKs, a combination of T90 weapons + overloads + T80 power armour of different styles will ensure 100% accuracy on all three kings. Higher armour or lower tier weapons will affect accuracy, but adding prayers/curses will get accuracy back up to 100%.

​

The strategy here is to wear power armour of different types i.e. (melee helm, ranged body, magic legs), and swap weapons/prayer for each king. This requires two clicks/key binds every kill, but is otherwise auto-pilot.

​

⬥ Camp Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

⬥ Switch to the respective T95/T99 Curses ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 Affliction] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 Desolation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 Malevolence]) as you kill the Kings

⬥ ~160kph with T85-87 weapons in a standard instance

⬥ ~200kph with T90 weapons + a custom instance for fast re-spawns

​

Revolution++ Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/8HWujgR4Bw.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Generic 2H Melee:

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/n4B2Z2KLAw.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

The [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fight_Kiln Fight Kiln] is a wave-based encounter which requires completion of [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Elder_Kiln The Elder Kiln] quest and a one-time sacrifice of a fire cape. There are 37 waves which become increasingly difficult as the fight progresses.

​

⬥ Completing the fight rewards you with a cape for your most used style [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153768065427853354.png?v=1 kilnmage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602582045553590274.png?v=1 KilnMelee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772314215858247.png?v=1 kilnnecro] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602582045541269567.png?v=1 KilnRanged]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each cape can be used to craft its respective igneous variant [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These are combined into the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk]

​

General Wave Breakdown

⬥ 1-9 are mostly weak to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack]

⬥ 11-19 are mostly weak to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ 21-29 are mostly weak to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

⬥ 31 is weak to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack]

⬥ 32 is weak to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

⬥ 33 is weak to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=AToCog7o6tN7tyjnbfpN All styles] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FAToCog7o6tN7tyjnbfpN.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ Gear and inventory can get switched around based on what you have and how experienced you are

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As long as you have a pickaxe in your toolbelt, you will be able to kill Dills using your Melee weapon

⬥ Obsidian armour reduces damage taken in the Fight Kiln and saves inventory space if not bringing switches

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tri-bridding is the best way to deal with the Fight Kiln. At the minimum, you want a 2H weapon of every style

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160759550042.png?v=1 tokkulzo] provides a 10% damage boost against the mobs but requires tokkul to upkeep

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] if the passive version is not unlocked

​

The Fight

Waves 1-9

There will be mostly rangers with an increasing number of magers and meleers so use Melee and switch to kill the others

⬥ Wave 2: Invulnerability crystal spawn

⬥ Wave 4: Restoration crystal spawn

⬥ Wave 5: Dill spawn

⬥ Wave 9: All rangers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] on the last ranger to have it for Jad

​

Wave 10

[https://img.pvme.io/images/cibB2kx.jpg Guide illustration] ⬥ Jad spawns southwest

⬥ 1 ranger also spawns southeast

​

Wave 11-19

There will mostly be magers with an increasing number of meleers and rangers so use Ranged and switch to kill the others

⬥ Wave 14: Invulnerability crystal spawn

⬥ Wave 16: Restoration crystal spawn

⬥ Wave 19: Dill spawn (switch to Melee for Dill)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go northeast, kill the Dill then go southwest and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] killing all the magers, use remainder on Jad

​

Wave 20

⬥ Jad spawns southwest

⬥ 1 mager also spawns southeast

​

Waves 21-29

There will mostly be meleers with an increasing number of magers and rangers so use Magic and switch to kill the others

⬥ Wave 26: Invulnerability crystal spawn

⬥ Wave 28: Restoration crystal spawn

⬥ Wave 28: 6 Dills spawn with a mager (kill mager then swap to Melee)

⬥ Wave 29: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] and kill meleers, use remainder on Jad

​

Wave 30

⬥ Jad spawns southwest

⬥ 3 meleers spawn in other corners

​

Waves 31-33

⬥ Wave 31: Use Melee

⬥ Wave 32: Use Magic

⬥ Wave 33: Use Ranged

​

Wave 34

⬥ Jad spawns southeast

⬥ 1 meleer spawns northwest, and one ranger southwest

​

Wave 35

⬥ Jad spawns northeast

⬥ 1 meleer spawns northwest, 1 ranger southwest, and 1 mager southeast

​

Wave 36

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hLsQnEw.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Double Jads spawn in both southern corners

⬥ Use invulnerability crystals here

​

Wave 37 (Har-Aken)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/n4B2Z2KLAw.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Spawns tentacles that deal Magic or Ranged hits. Build/heal on these when he is not on the surface

⬥ He never spawns on northern side of the platform

⬥ Spawns after ~72 seconds and is up for ~30 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1 sunshinepf] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1 deathsswiftpf] as he surfaces

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spam [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1 spiritualprayer] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll]

​

Tips and Tricks

General

⬥ You can use restoration crystals in emergencies and to extend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159085207555.png?v=1 onsl] on Har-Aken if needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure you have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005552211847295076.png?v=1 signoflife] up just in case because the hits start to add up very quickly

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] for the majority of the fight and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] as needed, don't forget [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On wave 19 there are a lot of magers so using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] can help

⬥ Always use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] when fighting Jads

⬥ Invulnerability crystals do not protect you from Dill special attacks, instead use restoration crystals

​

Speed

⬥ Make sure to take advantage of the combat triangle whenever possible

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160759550042.png?v=1 tokkulzo] if you have excess tokkul as that will be your best in slot ring if you are able to sustain it

⬥ It is helpful to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 LantaSticks], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 SpiritSticks] for increased potion duration, weapon poison damage, and scrolls used per hour

​

How to get a specific cape

Use the indicated style for the entire listed wave, except when Melee is required to break Dill armour.
Hybrid (37% of total LP dealt with style 1)
⬥ Style 1: 1-9, 11-15, 22-24, 31-32 ⬥ Style 2: 10, 16-21, 25-30, 33-37
Tribrid (23% of total LP dealt with style 1)
⬥ Style 1: 1-5, 8, 11-13, 22-23, 31-32 ⬥ Style 2: 6-7, 9-10, 14-21 ⬥ Style 3: 24-30, 33-37
Quadbrid (17% of total LP dealt with style 1)
⬥ Style 1: 1-3, 8, 11-13, 22-23, 31 ⬥ Style 2: 28-30, 32-37 ⬥ Style 3: 17-21, 24-27 ⬥ Style 4: 4-7, 9-10, 14-16

​

Example Kill

⬥ [https://youtu.be/P3SvPeq2rik 34:46 Revo+ kill with basic gear]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/P3SvPeq2rik Embedded guide video]

​
