pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Nj7IVJsNgU.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz is a stalker boss located in the Wilderness and requires 40 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering] to fight. Unlike other [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stalker_creatures_(Slayer_assignment) stalker creatures], 71 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is not required. This encounter is aimed at lower levels and introduces movement as a mechanic which players must react to and avoid.

​

Attack Rotation

3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto → 3x3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] square → 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto → 3x waves → 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto

​

3x3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] square → 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto → 3x waves → 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto → minions → repeat

​

Notes:

⬥ Bar fills up per each auto, Mhekarnahz does a mechanic when bar is full

⬥ After minions it will be 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos

​

Mechanics

Auto-attack
⬥ Does 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto-attacks between mechanics     • The start of the encounter only has 3     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/gptIeL96KN.mp4 Click to view an example of the auto-attack] [https://img.pvme.io/images/gptIeL96KN.mp4 Source video]
Targeted 3x3 Square
⬥ Shoots a 3x3 attack towards the player that inflicts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage     • Getting hit will cause a short [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon]     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/7AkOQn7ylg.mp4 Click to view an example of the targeted 3x3 square] [https://img.pvme.io/images/7AkOQn7ylg.mp4 Source video]
Waves
⬥ Unleashes 3 consecutive waves which cover specific parts of the arena     • They occur back-to-back in a random order and deal typeless damage     • They cover the outer, middle, and inner sections of the arena respectively     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/CHLqUALsSc.mp4 Click to view an example of the 3 waves] [https://img.pvme.io/images/CHLqUALsSc.mp4 Source video]
Minions
⬥ Spawns 3 warped flesh sacs with bars above their heads     • If a bar fills, spawns a warped seeker     • Boss is immune while minions are alive     • [https://img.pvme.io/images/EkfOuHcVyS.mp4 Click to view an example of the minions] [https://img.pvme.io/images/EkfOuHcVyS.mp4 Source video]

Presets

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=f4ac2925-6760-42e7-850f-dd93326142ce Melee - Resetting] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2ef43c03-f77f-4f85-a540-35c645e1a28d Ranged - Instance Camp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=b75930d4-76fd-4282-aae4-6ac34dbe162f Magic - Instance Camp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=84b49ef8-1cdd-42f1-ba72-eec54ff0f8c1 Melee - Instance Camp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F84b49ef8-1cdd-42f1-ba72-eec54ff0f8c1.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

All listed strategies use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1285372688457797672.png?v=1 eclipsedsoul] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1285372247665803264.png?v=1 divinerage] + the style's respective stat-boosting prayer. May replace with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] curses but could result in slightly less consistent kills per hour.

​

Rotations

Melee Wars Reset (120 KPH) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

This rotation aims for sub-10s kill times, resetting at [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] every kill

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879300526080.png?v=1 havoc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879820619786.png?v=1 smash] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane])

​

Notes:

⬥ If you have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless], you can replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1 underworldgrimoire4] and skip using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1 berserker] by adding [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] to the end of the rotation for consistent sub 11.4 sec kills with far less cost of supplies, however [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] is required for consistency.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] is currently not working as intended on Mhekarnahz

​

Melee Instance Camp (140 KPH) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Alternates rotations and aims for 10s-18s kill times, camping inside the instance

​

⬥ Rotation 1: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] if up → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879300526080.png?v=1 havoc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] → filler until dead

⬥ Rotation 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → filler until dead, aim to end with 80%+ adrenaline

​

Notes:

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1 conservationofenergy] for easier adrenaline management

⬥ End kills with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] for adrenaline if needed

​

Ranged Instance Camp (120 KPH) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

Start hour with 7x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1240756221024403526.png?v=1 icychill] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow]

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → filler until dead

Notes:

⬥ Click to jump over the ledge when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] cooldown hits 17s

​

Magic Instance Camp (120 KPH) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate]

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439387474722836.png?v=1 wrackandruin] → filler until dead

​

Example Kills

pages.title: PvME/Gate of Elidinis/Gate Of Elidinis
pages.comment: Attributed pinned PvME snapshot 074a9438f79d10fba75735791be0030734db8b5e; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/oYHCcxJkXV.png Guide illustration] ​

Intro

The Gate of Elidinis is RuneScape's second skilling boss. It can be soloed or done in a group of up to 10 players. Skills used in the encounter are Mining, Divination, Crafting, Construction, and Agility. Mining and Divination make up the majority of the encounter's mechanics. Mining boosts are most important for speeding up the kill times.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=HBljJAqqGZ7w4Vd0MQjy Basic Preset] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1 iron] Friendly) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4luWv5kmbbkNzzqsoKEl Advanced Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]

​

Note: None of the worn equipment shown is necessary but will help speed up kills.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1 lesserboneshield] is used alongside [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716442816532540.png?v=1 deathwardennexus] to ignore a hit via [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, can use Icthlarin's shield at the cost of ~10s to heal up.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If no Tagga's corehammer, just use a shield for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

⬥ Tier 2 Asciatops passive from RooT works.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341748180025365.png?v=1 fortitude] prayer can be used losslessly to speed up passive healing.

⬥ Can also use obsidian golem (+8 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]) or lava titan (+10 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]) familiar for more consistency.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4luWv5kmbbkNzzqsoKEl.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Mechanics

Corruption Stacks

⬥ This mechanic will exist passively throughout the encounter. You will take constant damage during the fight that scaled based on how many stacks of corruption are held.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This damage is doubled beyond the barrier.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will gain 1 corruption stack per transmutation action on a shard.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption stacks are also gained if hit by avoidable attacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption stacks will be reduced by 2 for each Cleansed statue shard used on the Gate during an activation of Icthlarin's Aid.

​

Moonlight Barrier

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Moonlight Barrier reduces damage taken from the Gate while standing behind it. The gate must be repaired using Moonstone Shards gathered from the mining nodes at the entrance to the encounter. Each moonstone shard will repair 10% of the barrier.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The barrier will be damaged by 30% per Channeled Blast attack from the Gate, but only if stood behind the barrier.

​

Channeled Blast

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Gate will say Begone! ‎and siphon energy from the nodes around the arena. Shortly after, the Gate will fire a large attack at the players. This damage can be partially mitigated by standing behind the Moonlight Barrier if repaired, also dealing 30% damage to the barrier.

​

Shard Explosion

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Gate will say Rot and suffer... ‎and then fire attacks at some of the Shards of Elidinis in the arena. The damage is telegraphed by expanding squares from each Shard affected. The attack will then jump to another Shard and repeat the expanding squares.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Damage is avoided by leaving the radius of the expanding square.

​

Aid of the Akhs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Gate will say Children, to me! ‎and summon a feline akh. The akh will add to the Gate's corruption until dismissed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Clicking on the akh will deal damage to it, requiring two clicks to dismiss fully, using two moonstone fragments.

​

Icthlarin's Aid

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clicking the Extra Action Button will create four pillars of increasing height near to the Gate. Clicking these pillars in-order in quick succession will give the player a 5-25% boost to cleansing the Gate, and also consume all Shards in the player's inventory and Beast of Burden inventory. The level of boost received depends on how quickly the player ascends the pillars.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Immediately following the cleanse, the Gate will prepare for a very large attack. This attack fully breaks the Moonlight Barrier regardless of repair percentage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Entering the shielded area next to Icthlarin will nullify the damage from the attack, and also heal the player to max lifepoints continuously until it disappears.

​

The Fight

This guide will focus on completing a 2-cycle kill, which can easily ignore any interactions with the Moonstone Barrier. Players can optionally repair the barrier to help mitigate the Channeled Blast attack damage at the cost of kill speed.

​

Some tips to keep in mind:

⬥ Keybinding actions allows you to do most of them without interrupting skilling actions.

⬥ Try to move out of mechanics directly after an "xp drop" to save time.

⬥ There is a large delay between activating Icthlarin's Aid and the pillars actually appearing. This can be used to your advantage as activating Icthlarin's Aid will pause any auto attacks or special attacks. Players frequently activate it before fully depleting the second rock on each side, using that delay to finish gathering shards before climbing pillars.

⬥ Since the rocks are 3x3 and the Gate's auto-attacks are also 3x3 (centred on player), it is wise to move between the "corners" while gathering as shown in this graphic:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/u3FtwUybpZ.png Guide illustration] ​

Starting the fight

The Shard of Elidinis nodes do not appear for roughly 20 seconds after starting the encounter. This is a perfect time to gather enough Moonstone Shards to last for the entirety of the encounter.

⬥ Gather 30-40 Moonstone Shards.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] north, repairing the barrier only if you plan on using it for reducing Channeled Blast specials.

​

Gathering Shards

⬥ Transmute the nearest Shard of Elidinis and begin mining. The shards that are north of the moonlight barrier give shards twice as fast as those south of the barrier.

⬥ Using the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] healing effect shortly before the Channeled Blast mechanic hits is recommended.

⬥ When the Channeled Blast mechanic occurs, step or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] behind the Moonlight Barrier if needed.

⬥ Avoid damage from regular and Shard Explosion mechanics. Getting hit by any tile-based mechanic will also add 2500 corruption to the Gate.

⬥ Dismiss the feline akhs as quickly as possible to prevent additional corruption to cleanse.

​

Jumping

⬥ After gathering all shards from the two northeastern rocks, activate Icthlarin's Aid by clicking the Extra Action Button.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a good time to eat as it will not interrupt any skilling actions.

⬥ After climbing the pillars and cleansing the gate, start depleting the two northwestern rocks. After reaching these rocks, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] to avoid the hit from the Gate's massive attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] to block Begone! ‎later.

​

Ending the fight

⬥ After gathering all shards from the two northwestern rocks, activate Icthlarin's Aid by clicking the Extra Action Button.

⬥ Quickly ascend the pillars and cleanse the Gate again.

⬥ If done correctly, this should kill the boss. Any remaining corruption will be due to unnecessary damage taken.

⬥ If the boss still has remaining corruption at this point, fall back to Icthlarin's shield and gather enough shards from the rock inside of it to deal the remaining damage needed.

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iplLq1wYQLw Advanced fast example]

Note: this guide uses Gargoyle Scrolls to guarantee all swings on rocks are successful.

Additionally, this was prior to the patch fixing the damage radius of the 3x3 autos. However, the strategy does not change.

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7P0Dh0xfXQ Ironman-friendly example]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/j7RO67GrYD.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

Hermod is a lieutenant of Rasial, the First Necromancer. He is a phantom born out of the unending conflicts of the God Wars in the Third Age, and continuously reforms himself when destroyed as long as wars are waged on Gielinor. You can only damage him with the Necromancy combat style and poison.

​

In order to fight Hermod you must complete [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Spirit_of_War The Spirit of War] quest.

​

Notable drops:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139533828629741668.png?v=1 hermodicplate] Hermodic plates, which are used for the Necromancy power armour.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139533737617539235.png?v=1 drumsticks] Animated drumsticks, which are used for [https://runescape.wiki/w/That_Old_Black_Magic That Old Black Magic] quest.

​

Useful Items & Unlocks

These are all highly recommended.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] Undead Slayer Ability

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] Undead Slayer Perk

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] Salve Amulet (e)

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=BsEi4iGWqO8sBAge4j3j T90 Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pDaRDMzjF6EjSCVKFjd7 T95 Necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FpDaRDMzjF6EjSCVKFjd7.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Mechanics

He will only attack with Necromancy and only has 2 mechanics that differ from autos.

⬥ Smash

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When he does this he will draw back his sword and hit your current location. This will disable your protection prayers. When he's about to do it there will be a green aura around the location. Simply move or use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] and tank it to deal extra damage.

⬥ Conjure

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Roughly every 48 seconds he will summon 2 armoured phantoms and become completely immune to damage until they are dead. If you get this mechanic utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] and good abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath].

​

Rotations

There are currently 2 rotations which are used.

Both of which require [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk], however for the level 76+ one you can get away without and just remove [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] from the rotation and just do more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] spam. Equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] to dismiss your conjures.

​

Note: if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] is not owned, add [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] at the end if needed

​

Level 76-99 Rotation

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] → enter instance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]

Level 99+ Rotation

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → enter instance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → (tc) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → build until 100 adren → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

​

AFK Strategy

A full guide on how to AFK Hermod is available here: [[PvME/Hermod/AFK Hermod|AFK Hermod]]

pages.title: PvME/Kalphite Queen/Kalphite Queen
pages.comment: Attributed pinned PvME snapshot 074a9438f79d10fba75735791be0030734db8b5e; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hx0kGtRzCO.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

As a very old boss, Kalphite Queen is relatively unrewarding and relatively simple. Typically only done for the pet or collection log, there is no further reason for a high level account to do this boss. The only notable mechanic is her form change. She will spawn into the instance immune to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]. After the first 40k damage is dealt, she will change forms to her flying form, which is immune to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]. More information available here: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kalphite_Queen https://runescape.wiki/w/Kalphite_Queen]

​

If doing the boss on a low level account for a Reaper task, bring your best [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] equipment, along with some food and poison protection.

​

If farming the boss for log on a high level account, you can do it actively for 88+ KPH or AFK for 40-45 KPH.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=yVhCon0PlnX2U48y3sJe Melee / Ranged Hybrid]

​

Preset Notes

⬥ The [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] damage and accuracy boosts work when on a Kalphites task.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FyVhCon0PlnX2U48y3sJe.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Active Strategy

⬥ You will be instance hopping between the uninstanced encounter and an instanced encounter.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This method will work better if you have a friend in the instance to eliminate the wait for the initial spawn.

​

⬥ Uninstanced encounter rotation:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First form: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879325822986.png?v=1 deci] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use basics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879577612298.png?v=1 sever] in between if entering with low adrenaline.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Waiting for second form spawn: Use basic on minion → Swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846959454617610.png?v=1 sirenicmask] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] minion → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] if 100% adrenaline → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] minion

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Second form: Auto + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] and/or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Immediately climb out once KQ HP hits 0. KC and loot in the uninstanced encounter will register even if you are not in it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] minion + rejoin instanced encounter

​

⬥ Instanced encounter rotation:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Before spawn (if entering on empty instance): [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] for adren if needed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ (tc) just after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] runs out.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first form and second form rotations are the same as above.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon KQ death, do your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] switch and (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] before climbing out if you're the only one in the encounter.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Climbing out immediately and leaving the instance empty before KQ finishes the dying animation will cause the kill to not count and no loot will register. This is avoided if you have a friend in the instance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If missing pet, wait for the loot to appear first before climbing up.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → join uninstanced encounter

​

⬥ Sip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] whenever needed.

​

Example Video

30 minute sample, rotation only shown for first 4 kills - [https://youtu.be/6EtjRyFdOlU https://youtu.be/6EtjRyFdOlU]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/NxT0aYSYLf.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

Legiones are bosses in the Monastery of Ascension. Accessing them requires an [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ascension_Keystone Ascension Keystone]. They each have a unique mechanic which are detailed below. As ascension members, Legiones can only be efficiently harmed with ranged, as they have extremely low affinity against magic and melee attacks.

​

They are very good for learning how to move around and avoid mechanics while still doing damage.

​

Mechanics

General

As ascension members, Legiones can only be efficiently harmed with ranged, as they have extremely low affinity against magic and melee attacks. They take increased damage the closer the player is to them which is why it is recommended to try to stay close to the legio during the fight.

​

Primus

⬥ Legio Primus' unique ability is that the lower life points he has, the more damage he will deal.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For every 25% life points that Primus loses, his lightning orb attacks gain 200 extra damage.

​

Standard lighting orb attack

[https://img.pvme.io/images/q5CULS1.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Using the hit-and-run tactic as normal nullifies this ability, however it is best to eat up as being caught in the middle of a lightning attack can cause massive damage.

​

Secundus

⬥ Legio Secundus' unique ability is using the lightning orb attack more frequently as his life points lower.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 75% health, he will use three orb attacks, then one basic magic attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 50%, he uses a simple magic attack every four orbs, and at 25% he will exclusively attack with lightning.

​

Secundus' rapid lighting orbs

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UZQyxW8.mp4 Source media]

⬥ This is generally not a problem as using the hit-and-run tactic as normal will nullify this ability, however the lightning orbs will be more frequent so having high life points is advantageous when most of his are depleted.

​

Tertius

⬥ Legio Tertius' unique ability is summoning Monastery of Ascension units as his health lowers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 Rorarii, 1 Gladius and 1 Capsarius when he reaches 75%, 50% and 25% of his health respectively.

​

⬥ The ascended spawn under Tertius, so they will can be damaged easily with Corruption Shot and Bombardment.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Gladius can be somewhat problematic, but since Legiones take increased damage the closer the player is to them, the Gladius is unlikely to move out from Corruption Shot and Bombardment will only force him to move away from the pile.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Should the Gladius be able to land a stun, immediately use Freedom and quickly move away before the lightning attack strikes.

​

A gladius rushes towards the player

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vc3fkgi.mp4 Source media]

Note: Any remaining minions after Tertius is killed will die.

​

Quartus

⬥ Legio Quartus' unique ability is teleporting the player next to him when he reaches 75%, 50% and 25% life points and launching an additional lightning attack at/around the spot he teleported the player, on top of his regular attacks.

​

A player is teleported

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6Pd02iU.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Quartus is the only Legio where damage should be dealt carefully, as his ability can punish fast DPS players.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the player damages him too fast, then Quartus will pull the player back to the same spot when he first triggers his ability, resulting in two immediate lightning strikes dead-center which will quickly shred a player's health if Devotion is not used.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quartus' drag is unique compared to other monsters - Freedom and Anticipation do not work, as it isn't classified as a stun attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The pull also grants him a second of invulnerability, and any channeled abilities used when he drags the player are simply put on hold for the same time, after which it is cast as normal again.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a very dangerous mechanic and makes Quartus the most deadly of the Legiones.

​

Quintus

⬥ Legio Quintus' unique ability is summoning "Lines of Ascension" in the laboratory when he reaches 75%, 50% and 25% life points.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first and third lines he summons will run horizontally, while the second line runs vertically.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Accidentally running into lines and getting caught by orb attacks can easily kill a player regardless of experience.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6tdGWIT.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Stepping on one of these lines will deal incredibly heavy damage (more than the lighting strike in terms of individual damage) - however, it only hits once each time the player runs into a line, but due to the lightning orb attacks, you'll be forced to move regardless.

​

⬥ It is worth noting that the player can "force" the lines to spawn as when he reaches 75%, 50% and 25% life points respectively, a line will spawn wherever the player is currently. Doing this near the edges of the laboratory will effectively nullify them if they perform the hit-and-run tactic while keeping away from them completely - however, players should note that he will take less damage the further you are from him, so this is only recommended for inexperienced players.

​

Note: the Lines of Ascension" are extremely similar to the Queen Black Dragon's fire walls - if you stand next to a line, then run over it, you will not take any damage from the line itself. This can allow for easier maneuverability around him to deal maximum damage without having to bring him closer.

​

Sextus

⬥ Legio Sextus' unique ability is his lightning attacks - unlike the other Legiones, his attacks are not modified as his health decreases.

​

⬥ Sextus' lightning attacks last significantly longer than his fellow Legiones, as they only start to dissipate once three strikes are on the field. In addition to the increased duration of these attacks, their AoE is increased from 4x4 to 5x5.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/T23wZTM.mp4 Source media]

⬥ This should be kept in mind while running around; doing so in an erratic way is not advised as the larger radius and prolonged duration can potentially slow down kills, though his laboratory is fairly large to avoid these attacks while dealing as much damage as possible. Sextus is fairly easy to kill, much like Primus and Secundus.

​

Basic Strategy

Simply get into MD of the boss (this is due to you doing more damage the closer you are), double bleed and walk your Fragmentation Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541273755385885.png?v=1 frag]. Then, do your best ranged threshold rotation (i.e. Snap Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] and Rapid Fire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid], avoiding Shadow Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] as Legiones have a hit cap of 7.5k and finally finish the kill with basics.

​

Ideally, kill times should be consistently sub 20 seconds.

​

Familiar Guidance

For your familiars you have 3 main options:

⬥ Ripper Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is for the 0-5% passive damage bonus only - Do not use scrolls as the familiar rarely hits due to boss affinities-

⬥ Steel Titan [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195724738002944.png?v=1 Titan]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It primarily uses a mix of Ranged and Melee attacks, so is only partially effective-

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can take a while to aggro, so is only viable for slower kills (>20s), or when manually targeting it onto the Legiones (e.g. during Snipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258425204770.png?v=1 snipe])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A budget option compared to Ripper Demon.

⬥ Unicorn Stallion (for its special attack, only if struggling for HP)

​

Manipulating Attacks

A more advanced technique worth discussing is the ability to manipulate where legiones will drop their lightning balls. This involves abusing the fact that their mechanics are based on where you click, and the fact that movement can be stopped by using an ability.

​

This is explained here:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x8A8bdTT3ic https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x8A8bdTT3ic]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/x8A8bdTT3ic Embedded guide video]

Advanced Strategy

This method can result in around 240-250 KPH and around 200 KPH at Quartus

​

Requirements

⬥ Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

⬥ Eldritch crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] with Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]

⬥ Fleeting Boots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813993480388640.png?v=1 fleetingboots]

⬥ Nightmare Gauntlets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 NMG]

⬥ Ascension Crossbows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468775936.png?v=1 ascmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159362031631.png?v=1 ascoh] or Blightbound crossbows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879230738434.png?v=1 bbcoh] (For Quartus only)

⬥ Reckless Aura [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1 reckless]

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=T525rjywtBafR4mVL7PS Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

Preset Notes

⬥ Hydrix bolts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 HydrixBakri] are used as a switch in combination with Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] for when you're low on adrenaline.

​

⬥ The generic armour perks in [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] are fine, however if planning to farm for a long time, Enhanced Devoted 4 can be swapped out for the Lucky or Absorbative perks at relatively low cost as you'll be praying Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] anyway - You can easily combo Lucky 6 with Mobile if not already comboed with another perk.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FT525rjywtBafR4mVL7PS.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotations

The rotation remains fairly similar between each boss but is slightly adapted to account for the mechanics of the different Legiones.

Cycle between Kill 1 and Kill 2 of each boss to allow for cooldowns. Expected kill times should be around 9-11 seconds.

​

⬥ Kill 1

⬥ Kill 2

​

Navigating the Lines of Ascension at Quintus

⬥ Quintus can be one of the most dangerous Legiones when first starting out but there's a way to completely avoid the lines of Ascension by placing the lines at certain times and moving on specific ticks.

​

⬥ The diagram below shows where to stand on which phases and the ticks to run can be found within the Advanced Quintus rotation.

​

⬥ This placement of course applies to non advanced methods but you will have to adapt to the phasing hp rather than knowing exactly which tick to move on due to you dealing lower damage.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/AZNWRYK.jpeg Guide illustration]

This is demonstrated here:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FlU2j4qgaq0 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FlU2j4qgaq0]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/GsMXUrqIm6.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

The Magister is a boss residing at the very end of the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon. The fight requires 115 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] (boostable) and a Key to the Crossing for each kill attempt. He is primarily killed for his Phylactery [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643166362361004042.png?v=1 phylactery] drops, used to create the T92 melee Khopeshes of Tumeken and Elidinis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513206794844110858.png?v=1 khopeshmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513206794752098327.png?v=1 khopeshoh] , with vital sparks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426807893032963.png?v=1 vitalspark] and Gloves of Passage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1 Glovesofpassage] being other sought-after drops.

​

It is highly recommended to have at least T90 weapons and to be on a Berserker aura, as his defence is high. Being on a Soul Devourer task will boost Tuska's Wrath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas] damage to the boss, however the Slayer Helm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] perk effects do not work.

​

Mechanics

Mechanics
Attack Rotation
⬥ Special attacks rotate randomly with 3 actions in between. ⬥ Actions include:     • Auto attack, Resonance, Freedom, Siphon, and Dashing.     • The action counter resets to 3 at 150k, 100k, and 50k hitpoints. ⬥ Some actions can occur in rapid succession which makes his special attack timings relatively unpredictable. ​
150k HP
⬥ The Soul Obelisk lowers the player's Constitution level (and therefore their maximum lifepoints) [https://img.pvme.io/images/o8hitZZ.png Example]     • This can cause food to heal less if your level falls below a certain amount.     • Saradomin Brews [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1 Brew] and Guthix Rests [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593901412578.png?v=1 grest] are exempt from this effect.     • 3 Constitution levels are lost each time the effect triggers. ⬥ Can be counteracted by drinking a Super Restore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore] or damaging the obelisk (not recommended). ​
100k HP
⬥ Another soul obelisk spawns to the south, which deals 600 damage and raises the player's corruption level by 4% every 5-7 seconds. [https://img.pvme.io/images/D3nIbDG.png Example]     • Corruption causes the player's damage dealt and taken to increase by the same percentage.     • Caps at 50%, and resets down to 25% after every kill. ​
50k HP
⬥ The Magister goes berserk:     • Increases his damage output while losing some defence. ​
Resonance
⬥ Magister will heal for the damage you would have dealt. [https://img.pvme.io/images/HcUrNlA.mp4 Example]     • It is best to use a bleed or a weak ability to minimise his healing. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/HcUrNlA.mp4 Source video]
Freedom
⬥ Magister cannot freedom while stunned, he will only freedom when he is bound. Should you bind him before or during a bleed, he can clear it. [https://img.pvme.io/images/GkerL8m.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/GkerL8m.mp4 Source video]
Siphon
⬥ When the player is at 70%+ adrenaline, the Magister can drain some of their adrenaline. [https://img.pvme.io/images/8h2rcWI.mp4 Example]     • Aim to stay below 70% adrenaline during ultimates.     • Be wary of adrenaline drain prior to ultimates. [https://img.pvme.io/images/8h2rcWI.mp4 Source video]Note: The three abilities mentioned above replace an auto attack and instead delay Magister's next auto attack by only 0.6s. ​

​

Specials

Specials
Power Blast
⬥ The Magister slams his staff into the ground, sending out a red lightning attack. [https://img.pvme.io/images/S1fJmLr.mp4 Example] ⬥ Deals ~2300 ranged damage (100% accurate) and can be dealt with by:     • Deflect Missiles [https://img.pvme.io/images/S1fJmLr.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 DeflectRange] / Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]     • Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] ​
Barge
⬥ Signalled by the voice line 'You dare fight me?'' ⬥ After a 1.8s delay, the Magister will barge to 1 sq south of player. [https://img.pvme.io/images/ier7amn.mp4 Example]     • Deals ~2300 melee damage in a 5x5 area and disables protection prayers for a small duration.     • Walk one tile north to avoid this.     • Alternatively use [https://img.pvme.io/images/ier7amn.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] , then move a tile away to avoid being md. ​
Stand Still
⬥ Only occurs if the player is md of Magister after his barge. ⬥ The Magister will yell 'Stand still!'' and stun the player for 4.2s, dealing ~2300 melee damage before dashing away in a random direction.     • Use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] + Deflect Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage].     • Use a halberd range weapon if meleeing. Note: This mechanic replaces the Barge mechanic while the player is in melee distance. ​
Dashing
⬥ Occurs during his Stand Still special attack. ⬥ Magister will dash up to 8 tiles away from the starting pillar if he is too close to it     • This usually happens after his Barge special attack on a player stood close to the starting pillar. ⬥ The Magister can chain these previous 3 actions together. ​
Unstable Mixture
⬥ A bomb is thrown in the general vicinity of the player. [https://img.pvme.io/images/EqOep9I.mp4 Example] ⬥ It explodes after the bar above it fills, dealing typeless damage in a 5x5 area to whatever is near it.     • Deals 4000 damage to the player and the Magister and 2000 damage to the player's familiar.     • Can be clicked to kick away. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/EqOep9I.mp4 Source video]
Asphyxiate
⬥ The Magister will asphyxiate the player, dealing ~1500-3000 damage for 3 hits and healing off the base damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/WTSVZKC.mp4 Example]     • This ability does not stun and can be dealt with by moving or by using a melee threshold.     • The Magister will continue auto attacking mid asphyxiate if stunned. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/WTSVZKC.mp4 Source video]
Restore Me
⬥ The Magister will regain several thousand lifepoints. [https://img.pvme.io/images/3siuSRJ.mp4 Example] ⬥ More likely to use this after falling below 50k lifepoints and it is often the first special attack he will use at that point.     • Can be avoided by stun-locking him, dealing damage and killing him before he can spec. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/3siuSRJ.mp4 Source video]
Minions
⬥ Only happens once the Magister has performed a sufficient number of special attacks beforehand. [https://img.pvme.io/images/4rbODea.mp4 Example]     • Two Soul Devourer minions spawn using random combat styles.     • They have 10,000 HP and remain until either they die or the fight ends.     • It is recommended to kill them unless the fight is at least halfway over. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/4rbODea.mp4 Source video]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=63Rg03RoI4WfdDdZ54u9 Melee (Basic)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2g18YuJ2ILHGi5do476M Melee (Advanced)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F2g18YuJ2ILHGi5do476M.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Melee Strategy

⬥ Avoid using high damaging abilities like Tuska's Wrath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas], Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm], Snap Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] etc. while the boss is slightly above 150k, 100k, and 50k hp as he will absorb any extra damage dealt to reach those exact numbers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage is counted towards progressing phases before truncation.

⬥ Magister's phasing is based on him attempting to auto attack or taking a hit of damage within attack range (which is instead mitigated), as such, if you are outside of his attack range, he will not phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This only really applies to ranged weapons at 9 tiles when he is bound.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This also implies that he will sometimes phase a few ticks after reaching his HP threshold instead of instantly, meaning you should be wary about using strong abilities around his HP thresholds, lest they get mitigated.

⬥ For corruption stacks, the speed of the last 50k doesn't matter as much on the first kill, do not burst through it. This will allow you to have higher corruption stacks for the 2nd and 3rd kill, as such you'll be doing more damage overall.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Don't sandbag the speed of the kill. You want to kill him at pace to hit 16-20% corruption by the end of the first kill.

⬥ If you're getting fast kills, don't pick up your drop after the kill, pick it up during your next one or once every 2-3 kills in a set.

​

Low Effort Magic Strategy

A full guide on how to AFK Magister is available in [[PvME/The Magister/Low Effort Magister|Low Effort Magister]].

​

Tip: Protecting Your Familiar

The Unstable Mixture special attack can damage your familiar.

​

⬥ Use one of the following techniques to avoid your familiar being killed:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kick the Unstable Mixture back at the Magister

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray at War's Altar in War's Retreat between trips to restore your familiar's hitpoints.

​

⬥ How many times can my familiar take damage before dying?

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 Mixtures hitting your Blood Reaver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] will kill it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 6 Mixtures hitting your Ripper Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] will kill it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 10 Mixtures hitting your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1 shadownihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1 bloodnihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1 smokenihil] will kill it

​

Formatting Maintained by: @neonx222

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LRKGH3H3yP.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

The [https://runescape.wiki/w/Queen_Black_Dragon Queen Black Dragon] resides in the lowest level of the Grotworm Lair which can be found just west of Port Sarim. 60 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning] is required to be able to enter the arena via the Summoning portal. Before attempting the fight it is highly recommended to have at least level 80 in your preferred combat style (generally [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]) and access to super antifire potions.

​

Note: Completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Song_from_the_Depths Song from the Depths] quest is recommended as well to reduce the amount of damage received.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=5qeONiK3mTiH18UBWxrL Ranged | Basic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8905598c-eb45-4bcd-b9e8-7c733d1a5453 Ranged | Advanced] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8905598c-eb45-4bcd-b9e8-7c733d1a5453.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ The Slayer Helmet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] bonus for being on a Dragon/Black Dragon task does work on the Queen Black Dragon.

​

Mechanics

Phase 1
⬥ QBD uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] auto attacks ⬥ QBD send a fire wall.     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] attacks only occur if the player is standing 2 tiles north from the platform artefact. ⬥ Phase ends when her HP is depleted and the middle artefact is activated.     • QBD will spit out grotworms until you activate the artefact. ​
Fire Wall
⬥ The chatbox will say The Queen Black Dragon takes a huge breath. ⬥ Fire wall deals 750 typeless damage for each tick it hits you.     • You can walk through it to only take 1 tick of damage. ⬥ Each firewall has a gap where you can stand to avoid damage.     • This gap will either be the 5th, 9th (one left of the center artefact) or the 15th square. ​
Phase 2
⬥ All mechanics persist however with each Phase her fire wall gets stronger.     • In Phase 1, the firewall will have 1 wall you have to pass through.     • In Phase 2, it will have 2 walls.     • In Phase 3, there will be 3 walls, and so on. ​
Tortured Souls
⬥ There will be an onscreen message saying The Queen Black Dragon summons one of her Captured Souls. ⬥ A Tortured Soul appears and releases a cloud that deals 900 damage.     • The cloud can be made to hit a Tortured Soul or grotworm first.     • This can be done by walking through the soul at the right time. ⬥ She summons 2 and 4 should in phase 3 and 4 respectively. ​
Phase 3
⬥ Any Souls in the arena can now be used to heal QBD.     • The chatbox will say The Queen Black Dragon starts to siphon the energy of her mages. and will heal her 200 each tick from each Tortured Soul. ​
Crystal Form/Hardened Carapace
⬥ P3 onwards QBD can change her form. ⬥ If QBD takes on the consistency of crystal.     • Takes 25% less [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] damage and 25% more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage. ⬥ If QBD hardens her carapace.     • Takes 25% less [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage but 25% more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] damage. ​
Time Stop
⬥ P4 onwards a Soul can appear in one of the corners of the arena saying 3 of the following:     • Time is short!     • She is pouring her energy into me...hurry!     • The spell is nearly complete!. ⬥ Kill the Tortured Soul or QBD before the Tortured Soul says all three. ⬥ If all dialogues are said, you screen will freeze for a few seconds, unable to move, eat, or do anything until the special is over. ​
Extreme Dragon Breath
⬥ A high hitting attack prompted by the chat box saying, The Queen Black Dragon gathers her strength to breathe extremely hot flames.     • Can be mitigated by moving to the sides of the arena.     • Standing in the middle will cause high damage.     • This also is the special attack needed to brand the Royal Crossbow.

​

Rotation

⬥ This rotation achieves alternating 24s and 25.8s kills.

⬥ Rotation assumes camping [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow]

⬥ Make sure to pre [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] the QBD.

⬥ May use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer] at the start of every 2nd kill, just before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

Phase 1

At 1.2s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → (tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → tag pillar

​

Phase 2

(4t) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to pillar off GCD → tag pillar

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478667086615285770.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] east off GCD → tag pillar

​

Phase 4

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to pillar

​

Example Kill

⬥ [https://youtu.be/AqZcvFVQy9M Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/AqZcvFVQy9M Embedded guide video]

​

Alt1 QBD Helper

Voice guidance throughout the kill

This tool reads your screen, and based on certain lines of dialogue in your chatbox, will trigger and play voice lines during the kill to let you know about upcoming mechanics and what to do for them.

​

Disclaimer: Alt1 is a third party tool, and while generally safe to use, is still recommended to be installed and used at your own risk.

​

Alt 1 QBD Helper
Check out [https://linktr.ee/igorspresets Igor's Presets] and follow the download instructions there for Alt1 presets for this boss and more!

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/D6M7KtAfBS.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

In order to fight Rasial you must complete the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_vs_Omega Alpha vs Omega] quest. Rasial deals Necromancy and typeless damage, and can only be killed using Necromancy.

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/z4ifLrUqck.png Guide illustration] ⬥ The tile shown above serves as a safespot for the ghost wall mechanic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This tile is ideal as it keeps you 5 tiles away for quicker [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For the soul obelisks, you may run 4 tiles west (toward obelisk), and 2-4 east.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Doing this allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] to kill one of the soul obelisks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is only recommended if you have the ruthless perk.

⬥ For an in-game example of the correct tile being used, [https://img.pvme.io/images/N8u6ViKvDL.mp4 click here].[https://img.pvme.io/images/N8u6ViKvDL.mp4 Source video]

​

Mechanics

Dive
⬥ Before the last phase, Rasial uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to avoid the player if the player stands within a 2 square radius (scythe range) of him.     • It is not feasible to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] against him.     • Getting this mechanic may cancel [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] bounces. ​
Conjure familiars
⬥ Rasial can conjure skeletal warriors [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] and putrid zombies [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie] to attack the player.     • Unlike the player, he can conjure multiple of each.     • It's recommended to ignore them throughout the fight. ​
Soul stacks
⬥ Rasial can gain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] like the player, and holds up to 5 stacks, shown by green orbs under his health bar.     • At 5 stacks, he shouts 'This is true power!' and uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]. Flick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1 deflectnecromancy] (+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] if needed) to avoid taking heavy damage.     • The rotations outlined below should skip this mechanic consistently. ​
Soul obelisk
⬥ At 700k HP, Rasial summons 2 soul obelisks with 12,000 HP each.     • They each have a bar which fills repeatedly. Upon filling, Rasial will get a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stack.     • It's recommended to ignore this mechanic and focus on DPSing the boss. ​
Spirit wall
⬥ Rasial summons a wall of 7 ghosts behind the player which moves forward, dealing heavy typeless damage upon contact.     • If using movement abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to avoid this stay within 5 tiles of Rasial for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] ​    • Standing next to the barrier will avoid ghosts entirely. ​
Spectral scythe
⬥ Rasial pulls the player to him and uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe], shouting 'I will reap your soul!' ​
Phase 4
⬥ At 200K HP, Rasial jumps to the upper deck of the citadel and briefly becomes immune, remaining stationary and stopping all mechanics mentioned above.     • Necrotic explosions will occur, following the player. If hit, players take heavy Necromancy damage. Rasial's auto attacks are also always empowered, dealing double damage and disabling protection prayers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787523880281047040.png?v=1 antitheism]

​

Requirements

The rotations may not work as well as intended if any of the following are missing:

⬥ Undead damage boosts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]

⬥ Conservation of Energy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1 conservationofenergy]

⬥ Fury of the Small [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1 furyofthesmall]

⬥ Invigorating 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4]

⬥ Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] (Can downgrade at the cost of damage)

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] to mitigate damage taken or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] without [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll]

⬥ The Lunar spellbook can be used for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng]

⬥ All of the Necromancy talent tree unlocked.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Greater bone shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] active.

​

T90 Equilibrium Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/NhlRG0hm04.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

Yakamaru is the second boss in the Liberation of Mazcab raid, with up to 10 players in a single encounter. While the fight itself does have many mechanics and sections that require coordination between players, with just a little knowledge and practice and communication between your teammates, it can become a relatively smooth and fun boss encounter.

​

This guide aims to cover the basic mechanics of Yakamaru, and cover some of strategies, tips and tricks that will help you get your first kills and beyond. As this is a mechanically intensive group fight with a longer guide, it is broken into a few sections (all linked in the Table of Contents) for easier navigation:

⬥ To see what roles there are and what each one does, see Roles at Yakamaru.

⬥ To learn about Yakamaru's attacks and pool mechanics, see Auto Attacks, Special Attacks and Pool Mechanics.

⬥ See Fight Overview for a brief description of the fight, and Fight Phases for more in-depth information.

​

Drop Rates

[https://www.runescape.com/drop-rates Click here] to see how drop rates for Raids uniques are calculated (scroll down to Liberation of Mazcab).

​

Presets and Relics

Given that Yakamaru is a fairly advanced boss and that its a group boss, it is reasonable (and ideal) to have a sufficient level of gear before attempting the boss. This helps both make the fight easier and make it easier for you to get into teams.

​

A guideline set of recommendations might this include:

⬥ T80+ power armour + T90+ weapons, perked with Starter Perks from [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]]

⬥ 95+ Prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] for curses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

⬥ 99+ Herblore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore] for overloads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1 ovl] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve]

⬥ Berserker auras [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1 berserker] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1 reckless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1 mani]

As always, feel free to adjust the presets according to what you have available.

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=yk1Gpp9iDn0X0xX21oSQ Magic | Basic DPS / Free]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=SZME3sjYOMDBby7M6LGA Melee | Basic DPS / Free]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=i5WO2DTuiWD1z0BNGMK9 Ranged | Basic DPS / Free]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0qcPZuWuWeO2UqVkKHy4 Magic | Tank]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0qcPZuWuWeO2UqVkKHy4.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Standard Preset Notes

⬥ Prefer a DPS familiar like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll], but if required, use a Hellhound [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/922417969731088435.png?v=1 hellhoundscroll] or Reaver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1 reaverscroll] for better survivability.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See !familiar ‎for more info.

​

⬥ Melee is not very learner-friendly, and without sufficient gear will lack DPS compared to other styles - avoid it if you are a learner, or if a low budget.

​

⬥ As Melee, The Zaros Godsword spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] can be used on alternate pools when Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] is on cooldown to increase DPS.

​

Tank Preset Notes

⬥ This preset is built around survivability - the most important thing as a tank is to stay alive - a Reaver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1 reaverscroll] autofiring its scrolls with a short delay can be a significant source of sustain.
