[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EFlnaJbrvr.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an early mechanics guide on 2000% Amascut. Beware of mistakes, and expect an update in the near future. Numbers may vary based on team size! If you have suggestions for our guides, post them [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Source community discussion (external Discord)].

Amascut the Devourer is an endgame group boss encounter, available after completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Eclipse_of_the_Heart Eclipse of the Heart] quest. Normal mode and 100%, 500%, 750%, 1000%, and 2000% enrage modes are available. Amascut drops the T95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] halberd [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tumeken%27s_Light Tumeken's Light], the T95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://runescape.wiki/w/Devourer%27s_Guard Devourer's Guard], the T95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] robes of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tumeken%27s_resplendence_equipment Tumeken's Resplendence], the [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Devourer%27s_Nexus Devourer's Nexus], and the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Genesis_Essence Shard of Genesis Essence].

​

Amascut 2000% stats

⬥ 12M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

⬥ Size: 3x3

⬥ 95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] 2765 armour rating

⬥ 55 affinity all

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] immune

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: Most mobs are not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] immune!

⬥ No slayer creature

​

Mechanics

Auto-attacks:

⬥ Left hand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] attack to all players.

⬥ Right hand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] AoE attack on tank that ricochets as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] attacks on the other players. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] ricochet has a 10-tile range.

⬥ Three rapid [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] swipes on the tank. The style depends on her last auto-attack: For example: if it was [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], the three hits will be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The following autos are based on your protection or deflect prayer on the first swipe hit. If you prayed wrong against it, the following auto-attacks will be the same type as the swipe hit.

⬥ After three autos, Amascut starts a new mechanic at 100% adrenaline.

​

Mobs:

⬥ Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs (150k LP). Need to be killed to use the gateways. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

⬥ Feline Guard Akhs (25k LP). Will target those carrying a fragment of Tumeken. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

⬥ Volatile Scarab Akhs (2k LP).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They need to be stunned [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] to take damage, and will explode if left alone.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Their spawn can be prevented by standing within one tile of their burrowing spots.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Doing this successfully resets mobility cooldowns.

⬥ Modest Crocodile Demons (50k LP).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When its adrenaline bar is full, does [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] attack removing 20% adrenaline and applying a -50% adrenaline gain debuff on the target.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Have Modesty buff.

⬥ Chainwarden Mage Akhs (130k LP). Protects the chains (50k LP each) beyond the gateways.

⬥ Explosive Scarabs (5k LP). Can be killed and then thrown to remove Carapace. Expire over time when killed.

⬥ Lightstealer Salawa Akh (50k LP). Will target Tumeken's light bearers and drain charge or explode. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

⬥ Devoured Mage and Ranger (15k LP). Stand on the platforms, barring you from Tumeken's Light.

⬥ Shadow of Amascut (150k LP). Deal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]. Can reduce [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] timer.

​

Buffs and Debuffs

Lone Soul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1 shadowlink]

⬥ Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 healother], Heal Group [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404462300722626642.png?v=1 healgroup], and Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] are disabled at 2000% and above.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Shadow Link.

Corruption [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption]

⬥ The base gains one stack of Corruption [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption] for every auto-attack received, increasing damage taken. Getting hit by Soulfire waves and Shockwaves also gives [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption] stacks. Max 15 stacks, and stacks expire ~15s after the last one has been given.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In phase 7 every player gets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption] stacks from Amascut's auto-attacks.

Apmeken's Burden [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1 apmekensburden]

⬥ Is applied by Amascut early in phase 2. Deals damage every 1.8s and adds a stack. Can be transferred to teammates. Damage increases every hit, instakilling the player at 8 stacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage can be halved by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] (not by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut will apply this debuff in phase 7 when Apmeken is invoked.

Modesty [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1 modesty]

⬥ Reflects non-basic attacks such as threshold and ultimate abilities, adren-costing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] abilities, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] , plus extra hits from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Does not reflect basic abilities, auto-attacks, conjure damage, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] , and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]

Healing in Strength [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1 healinginstrength]

⬥ Mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where any damage they deal heals Amascut for ~30%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut gains this effect in phase 7 when Het is invoked.

Carapace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1 carapace]

⬥ Multiple mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where they are immune to damage until an explosive scarab is thrown at them.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut gains this effect in phase 7 when Scabaras is invoked. Requires 3 Scarabs to break.

Interceptor [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1 interceptor]

⬥ Gained upon blocking Amascut's Altar strike once in phase 5. Taking another strike will be an instakill [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill].

Enlightened [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1 interceptor]

⬥ Gained after Jumping and taken Tumeken's Light in phase 6. Appears as a 5x5 light area around you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any green bar blasts exploding in the area are nulled.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Interceptor.

Shadow Tear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1 comb]

⬥ Debuff from absorbing Engulfed Shadow Tears in phase 6. Explode after a short period of time, Dealing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage for each tear absorbed. Says it pierces through shielding, but [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] blocks it fully.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as combust.

Shadow Link [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1 shadowlink]

⬥ Shadows of Amascut have a buff when within 15 squares of each other called Shadow Link. This increases their attack speed and damage dealt per stack, and they can hit through [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo].

Inner Darkness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1 shadowlink]

⬥ Amascut will take reduced damage from all sources that do not have the Light Within buff in phase 7.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Shadow Link.

Light Within [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1 interceptor]

⬥ Granted to all players when successfully passing Tumeken's Strike to the called altar in phase 7, ricocheting it back to Amascut. Allows them to deal full damage to Amascut for 30s.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Interceptor.

​

Phase 1 (12000k)

⬥ 3 autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → Summon Scarabs → 1 auto → swipes → 1 auto → Crushing Soul → 2 autos → swipes → Empowered Eruption → 3 autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → phase 2

​

Triple Tap

⬥ Amascut says Grovel, pathetic ‎or weak ‎and will launch three projectiles in the air, with each colour corresponding to a combat style (green: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], blue: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], red: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]) on the tank. These will hit the tank two ticks apart.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Grovel: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pathetic: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weak: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Summon Scarabs

⬥ Amascut says Tear them apart ‎and summons Volatile Scarab Akhs. They need to be stunned [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] to take damage. Will explode if left alone, dealing typeless damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage can be blocked by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and spawn prevented by being near their burrow location.

Crushing Soul

⬥ Amascut says Bend the knee ‎and deals big typeless damage on the tank. Has defensive penetration. Damage can be shared with nearby teammates in a 3x3 around the base..

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 2000% to survive this solo, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teams can have the DPS pile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] to share this damage (with a defensive), then have base [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] back.

Empowered Eruption

⬥ Amascut says I will not suffer this., Your soul is weak ‎, or , All strength withers, or and the arena turns a certain colour, corresponding to a combat style (green: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], blue: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], red: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]). Every player will take three hits from that style. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] is recommended.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Your soul is weak: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All strength withers: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• I will not suffer this: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

Empowered auto

⬥ When Amascut does her three rapid [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto-attacks, Amascut deals another [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] hit to the tank, same tick as the third attack. This auto will always be a different style from the original three.

Tank pull

⬥ Whenever the person with aggro is too far from Amascut, she will say You dare to turn your back on me? ‎and drag them before her. This stuns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] and binds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon] you for 3s. Gives adrenaline to Amascut, likely replaces an auto-attack.

⬥ Amascut's health caps at 9000k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

Phase 2

Devourer's Destruction

Amascut says ENOUGH! Bring forth Crondis and Apmeken ‎and a destruction timer of 100.2s starts. When the timer ends, every player is instakilled.

⬥ Two Gatekeeper gorilla akhs on the sides. They can stun and be stunned/bound. One random player gets marked with Apmeken's Burden [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1 apmekensburden]. This debuff is a ramping bleed and can be passed to others by standing next to them, resetting the damage. Modest Crocodile Demons spawn at both northern entrances, deal heavy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage, and reflect non-basic ability damage. When their adrenaline bar is full, the target's adrenaline gain is reduced by 50%. Feline Guard Akhs and Lightstealer Salawa Akhs spawn as time progresses.

​

⬥ After the Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs are dead, players can go into gateways west and east to free the Echoes of Apmeken and Crondis. Within they will find a Chainwarden Akh and three chains.

⬥ Every killed chain turns the respective statue yellow instead of green. A player in the main arena cleanses the corrupted statue every time, permanently killing the chain. Clicking the statue early deals damage. Chains respawn over time if the statue is not cleansed within ~12s.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chains can be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] from the west/east/north especially in the eastern gateways. This is favourable for necro users.

⬥ After all three chains are broken and cleansed, the player inside the respective room can liberate the god and receive their fragment of Tumeken (30s buff timer).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Crondis' blessing, two more Modest Crocodile Demons spawn.

⬥ Bringing the blessing to the right statue will stun Amascut for 25s. You cannot use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] during this, but [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1 prismofsalvation] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] do work. The stuns of both blessings stack, and after they end phase 3 starts.

⬥ Lightstealer Salawa Akhs spawn from the south in group of three. They can charge a blue bar and barge on players, prioritising those carrying Tumeken's light. This hits 6-7k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage per akh.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These should be prioritised to kill.

​

Empowered Soulfire

⬥ During phase 2 the main arena has waves of Empowered Soulfire passing over it, south to north. Along the Chains, Empowered Soulfire will also appear. These deal magic damage. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] blocks damage, but duration is reduced by 3s for each hit. Each hit taken gives one [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption] stack.

⬥ Amascut's health caps at 7200k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

Phase 3 (Ugh... No!)

⬥ Similar to phase 1, but includes Devourer's Shockwave with every mechanic.

⬥ Rotation:

33% adren no auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → Summon Scarabs → 3x same auto → Crushing Soul → swipes → 2 autos → Empowered Eruption → auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → phase 4.

​

Devourer's Shockwave

Amascut concentric shockwaves spread from under her outward.

⬥ The pattern is always the same:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First only a "middle" ring of 3 tiles wide. MD is safe, far range is safe.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Second are three consecutive shockwaves moving from inner to outer.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Inner (9x9 including under Amascut)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Middle (ring of 3 tiles wide)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Outer (ring of 6 tiles wide).

⬥ Deals typeless damage, resets defensives, and puts them on a 6s cooldown. When hit, adds 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption] stack.

⬥ Amascut's health caps at 4800k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

Phase 4

Devourer's Destruction

Amascut says Scabaras...Het... Bear witness! ‎and the destruction timer starts again similar to phase 2.

⬥ Players can go into gateways west and east to free the Echoes of Het and Scabaras after killing the Gatekeeper gorilla akhs. No modest crocodiles spawn.

​

Scarab bombs

⬥ Explosive Scarab Akhs spawn in the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scarabs will not spawn on players in a 3x3 area (can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to stop spawns).

⬥ Every non-scarab mob NPC has a carapace that makes them immune to damage. Remove the carapace by killing and grabbing Explosive Scarab Akhs, then throwing Scarabs to the NPC and through the gateways. Weaken and kill the Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs. You need 4 Scarabs per gateway for the Chainwarden Akh and the three chains. Scarab throwing has unlimited attack range but does require line-of-sight. Alive Explosive Scarab Akhs heal Amascut over time (100 LP/Scarab/1.2s). Dead Scarabs explode over time and deal minor typeless damage to all players in the arena.

⬥ Amascut's health caps at 3000k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

Phase 5 Tumeken's Reformation

Charging the fragment of Tumeken

⬥ Amascut says Tumeken's heart. Delivered to me by these mortals ‎and four fragments shoot out of each statue, and Tumeken appears in the middle.

⬥ Two Soul Obelisks appear west and east with 30k out of 50k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution], and at full health they will deal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage to all players in their half of the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep their health below 50k. Soul obelisks stop healing when taking damage.

⬥ Channel statue energy to the fragments by having one or multiple players link energy from the statue to the fragment.

Altar Strike

⬥ Amascut will say your light will be snuffed out, once and for all ‎strike the fragments via the altars/statues, draining them of charge.

Interception

⬥ Have a player stand on the green line to intercept Amascut's attack. All lines can be blocked simultaneously by standing in front of Amascut. Taking two hits in a row is an instakill (Interceptor debuff), so switch out with your teammates. Lightstealer Salawa Akhs will continuously spawn from the southern stairs and drain charge from the fragments of Tumeken if reached.

Blinking Strike

⬥ After a fragment is fully charged, Reform Tumeken in the centre and Amascut will become attackable again. She will start dashing and attacking the Reformed Tumeken four times saying GET OUT OF MY WAY!​I AM. ‎THE GOD. ‎OF. ‎DESTRUCTION. If not intercepted by the player called by Tumeken (name) shield us from her shadow… ‎the attack will instakill the party. The intercept damage has 10% [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] penetration and can ricochets to other nearby players, sharing the damage. After the four attacks, more fragments have to be charged if progress has not reached 100.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The called player should stand closest to Amascut's Southwest tile, others should keep their distance.

⬥ For every fragment charged, reform progress increases by 1 every 1.2s. If any Lightstealer Salawa Akh explodes near Tumeken this will instakill the party.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing the Lightstealer Salawa Akhs has high priority in this phase. Can use binds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon] to prevent them from getting too close to Tumeken (within its 5x5 area).

⬥ Amascut transitions to phase 6 at 100% reform progress.

⬥ Amascut's health caps at 1800k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This cap is at 4 charged fragments, each charged fragment allowing you to deal 300k damage.

​

Phase 6

Amascut says Amascut says I will not be denied! ‎and Mwuahahaha ‎and an Engulfing Shadow spawns on Tumeken.

Engulfing Shadow

⬥ This Shadow has 500k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] and is attackable. Amascut will start charging a 500k black health bar. The Engulfing Shadow and Amascut's health bar gain 1% LP based on the Engulfed Shadow's remaining lifepoints. Engulfing Shadow Tears will appear, healing the Engulfed Shadow for 1k rapidly and 15k if not absorbed in time. After absorbing tears, a green bar fills up on the player, exploding for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage (~800 per tear?).

Soul Flare

⬥ Amascut will make it rain, with 8 3x3 projectiles landing across the arena. These deal massive typeless damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These can target players current location. For players standing on symbols to pause Collapse: do not stand on the centre tile of the symbols.

Platform Collapse

⬥ A Collapse countdown of 24s starts, when the timer runs out, the jumper is instakilled.[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill]. Tumeken names one player (referred to as Jumper), and that player can take the path of Tumeken to a platform on the west or east and kill the Devourer minions, moving to the next platform every time.

⬥ The Countdown can get paused temporarily by having another player stand on the same symbol as the jumper is on. This symbol will light up when stood upon. After killing all Devourers, the Jumper takes Tumeken's Light and gets the Enlightened buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1 interceptor], and a 5x5 light area surrounds them. The Jumper reenters the arena, and the Engulfed Shadow will disappear. Amascut says I WILL NOT BE SUBJUGATED BY A MORTAL!.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: If the Jumper with Enlightened dies in phase 6, Amascut will start emptying her black health bar immediately! This can easily wipe the party if unprepared.

​

⬥ Rotation: 20% start → 2 autos → swipes → 1 auto → Player Bomb → 2 autos → swipes → 2 autos → Player Bomb → auto → swipes → 3 same autos → Empowered Eruption → swipes → 3 same autos → swipes → Soul Prison

​

Shadows of Amascut

⬥ Amascut says Fall to the shadow ‎and Shadows of Amascut appear that need to be killed, one for each player not tanking Amascut. The Shadows deal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage when dashing towards you, otherwise attack with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] , and have the Shadow Link buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1 shadowlink]. Can be stunned [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green bars fill on the Shadows after the first one dies, and they respawn when full. These bars reset when another Shadow is killed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A common strategy is to death dot, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] (or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] ) with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage], then swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] after the Shadows dive-bomb you. Can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] or (early) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] into [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] to clear.

Player Bomb

When Amascut says Your companions will betray you, as they always do.​

⬥ A green bar starts on one player and gradually appears on all players with a Shadow of Amascut attacking them.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When the green bar on the player is full, you take a 7x7 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] penetration typeless hit (12k). Standing in the Tumeken's Light 5x5 area of the Jumper greatly reduces this damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: Blasts outside the area still hurt those inside!

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When a second bomb happens (same voiceline), all players will get the green bar at the same time.

​

⬥ Killing all Shadows stuns Amascut for 25s, allowing you to DPS down the black health bar. Only after depleting all the black health can her true health be reduced.

⬥ After the stun all remaining black bar health will be dealt as damage to the team in rapid succession.

⬥ Amascut's true health caps at 600k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

Soul Prison

Note: This mechanic only appears 2min 40s after the Subjugated by a mortal! ‎voiceline, and is rarely seen.

Amascut will say You will take their place, and watch as this vision becomes reality ‎and one player (without Tumeken's light) will get imprisoned on the glyphs.

⬥ This is on the same side as was used prior in phase 6. They will be in a 3x3 of tiles that will explode in 6s. This player has to have their shackles broken by another player, and be pushed towards the one safe tile.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The imprisoned player can get dive-bombed on by their Shadow of Amascut, as will whoever frees them, if those shadows are still alive.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/55scg0L8nD.png Guide illustration] ​

Phase 7

Amascut says YOU ARE NOTHING ‎and teleports everyone to the throne room (27x27 tiles, or 9 "9x9" sections).

⬥ Tumeken is directly north, Apmeken's altar northwest, Scabaras' northeast, Crondis' southeast, and Het's southwest. She gains the Inner Darkness buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1 shadowlink], meaning she will take reduced damage from all sources not blessed by the Light Within buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1 interceptor].

​

*Notes: Amascut stands one tile north of centre.

⬥ Every [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto-attack gives every player 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1 corruption] stack.

⬥ Tumeken has 400k health. When he dies, everyone gets instakilled.

⬥ EZK's Flamebound Rival [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and storm shards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] remain during phase transition to phase 7.

⬥ Taking a typeless Hieroglyph or Shockwave hit deals 4k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage to Tumeken per player hit.

⬥ You can share the Tumeken Strike damage with players in the same quadrant*

​

Rotation:

Starts at 66% adrenaline → 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos → 4.8s charge → Tumeken Strike

​

Tumeken Strike

⬥ Amascut will address one of the lesser gods by name and try to strike at Tumeken.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crondis: Crondis. It should have never come to this.​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scabaras: Scabaras...​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apmeken: I am sorry Apmeken.​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Het: Forgive me, Het.​

⬥ Tumeken will aid the called god's altar to bear the brunt of the strike. Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Amascut so she faces towards the called altar. This will let the attack on you ricochet to the altar and send Tumeken's light back at Amascut, stunning her.

​

When done wrong

Amascut says Heh Heergh ‎or Hmmmwuahaha, Tumeken takes 200k damage, and the party takes massive typeless [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] penetrating damage. 16 Engulfing Shadow Tears appear, healing Amascut 1k each every tick.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fail rotation: Tumeken Strike → 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos → Soul Crush → 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos → repeat

​

When done right

⬥ Tumeken takes a small hit (12.5k), Amascut says This cannot be the end..., all players get the Light Within buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1 interceptor] for 30s and Amascut gets stunned for ~7s. After this, Amascut will use Empowered Eruptions alongside Empowered Shockwaves or Empowered Hieroglyphs. After Light Within has expired, Amascut will repeat Tumeken Strike.

⬥ An effect dependent on the god is applied.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apmeken: A random player gets Apmeken's Burden debuff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1 apmekensburden]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scabaras: Explosive scarabs spawn. kill, grab and throw multiple to break Amascut's Carapace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1 carapace].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Requires 3 scarabs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crondis: Two Modest crocodile Demons (with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1 modesty] ) spawn in; one southwest and one northeast.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Het: Amascut gains Healing in Strength [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1 healinginstrength]. Heals herself for ~30% of damage dealt.

​

Empowered Shockwaves

⬥ Four versions have been observed:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Inner area is safe (9x9)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Middle ring is safe, 3 tiles wide (5 tiles from Amascut)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Far-middle ring is safe, 3 tiles wide (8 tiles from Amascut)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Outer ring is safe, 3 tiles wide

Empowered Hieroglyphs (after Apmeken)

⬥ Similar to the Nakatra fight, various 9x9 sections of the arena will glow blue and blow up. She divides the arena in 9 sections, of which 3-8 sections are about to be blasted. Getting hit resets defensive cooldowns.

​

Example kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/1fntOvpGlc8 Evil Lucario's World's First POV]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/kLQeCEG4WBA Evil Lucario's Amascut 2000% Enrage Commentary]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/0cYZujUSA40 Necro Base POV talkthrough]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/JCdHm_iMWgc Magic DPS POV]

​

​

Phase 2 and 3

(tc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107294084182017.png?v=1 gorillaakh]) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish])

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EFlnaJbrvr.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

This is an early mechanics guide on Normal Mode Amascut. Beware of mistakes and expect an update in the near future.

Parts of this guide were written based on Duo NM footage. Numbers may vary based on team size!

​

Amascut NM stats

⬥ 4000k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

⬥ Size: 3x3

⬥ 95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] 2765 armour rating

⬥ 55 affinity all

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] immune

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: Most mobs are not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] immune!

⬥ No slayer creature

​

Mechanics

Auto-attacks:

⬥ Left hand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] attack to all players.

⬥ Right hand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] AoE attack on tank that ricochets as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] attacks on the other players. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] ricochet has a 10-tile range.

⬥ Three rapid [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] swipes on the tank. The style depends on her last auto-attack: For example: if it was [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], the three hits will be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The following autos are based on your protection or deflect prayer on the first swipe hit. If you prayed wrong against it, the following auto-attacks will be the same type as the swipe hit.

⬥ After three autos, Amascut starts a new mechanic at 100% adrenaline.

​

Mobs:

⬥ Gatekeeper gorilla akhs (45k LP). Need to be killed to use the gateways. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

⬥ Feline akhs (7.5k LP). Will target those carrying a fragment of Tumeken. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

⬥ Volatile scarabs (2k LP).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They need to be stunned [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] to take damage, and will explode if left alone.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Their spawn can be prevented by standing within one tile of their burrowing spots.

⬥ Modest Crocodile (15k LP).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When its adrenaline bar is full, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] attack, removing 20% adrenaline and applying a -50% adrenaline gain debuff on the target.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Have Modesty buff.

⬥ Chainwarden mage akh (30k LP). Protects the chains (15k LP each) beyond the gateways.

⬥ Explosive scarabs (5k LP). Can be killed and then thrown to remove Carapace. Expire over time when killed.

⬥ Lightstealer salawa akh (15k LP). Will target and drain Tumeken's fragment charge and reform progress. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

​

Buffs and Debuffs

Corruption

⬥ The tank gains one stack of Corruption for every hit received, increasing damage taken. Getting hit by Soulfire waves and Shockwaves also gives Corruption stacks. Max 15 stacks, and stacks expire ~15s after the last one has been given.

Apmeken's Burden

⬥ Is applied by Amascut early in phase 2. Deals damage every 1.8s and adds a stack. Can be transferred to teammates. Damage increases every hit, instakilling the player at 8 stacks.

Modesty

⬥ Reflects non-basic attacks such as threshold and ultimate abilities, adren-costing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] abilities, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] , plus extra hits from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Does not reflect basic abilities, auto-attacks, conjure damage, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] , and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]

Healing through Strength

⬥ Mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where any damage they deal heals Amascut for ~30%.

Carapace

⬥ Multiple mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where they are immune to damage until an explosive scarab is thrown at them.

Interceptor

⬥ Gained upon blocking Amascut's Altar strike once in phase 5. Taking another strike will be an instakill [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill].

​

Phase 1 (4000k)

⬥ 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → Summon Scarabs → 1 auto → swipes → 1 auto → Crushing Soul → 2 autos → swipes → Empowered Eruption → 3 autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → phase 2

​

Triple Tap

⬥ Amascut says Grovel, pathetic ‎or weak ‎and will launch three projectiles in the air, with each colour corresponding to a combat style (green: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], blue: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], red: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]) on the tank. These will hit the tank two ticks apart.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Grovel: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pathetic: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weak: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Summon Scarabs

⬥ Amascut says Tear them apart ‎and summons Volatile Scarab Akhs. They need to be stunned [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] to take damage. Will explode if left alone, dealing typeless damage.

Crushing Soul

⬥ Amascut says Bend the knee ‎and deals big typeless damage on the tank. Has defensive penetration. Damage can be shared with nearby teammates in a 3x3 around the base.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teams can have the DPS pile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] to share this damage, then have base [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] back.

Empowered Eruption

⬥ Amascut says I will not suffer this., Your soul is weak ‎, or , All strength withers, or and the arena turns a certain colour, corresponding to a combat style (green: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], blue: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], red: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]). Every player will take three hits from that style.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Your soul is weak: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All strength withers: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• I will not suffer this: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

Empowered auto

⬥ When Amascut does her three rapid [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto-attacks, Amascut deals another [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] hit to the tank, same tick as the third attack. This auto will always be a different style from the original three.

Tank pull

⬥ Whenever the person with aggro is too far from Amascut, she will say You dare to turn your back on me? ‎and drag them before her. This stuns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] and binds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon] you for 3s. Gives adrenaline to Amascut, likely replaces an auto-attack.

​

Phase 2 (2800k) Apmeken and Crondis

⬥ A destruction timer of 200s starts. When the timer ends, every player is instakilled.

⬥ Kill the two gatekeeper gorilla akhs. They can stun and be stunned/bound. One player gets marked with the Burden of Amascut. this debuff is a ramping bleed and can be passed to others by standing next to them, resetting the damage. Modest crocodiles spawn at the northern entrances, deal heavy damage, and reflect non-basic ability damage. When their adrenaline bar is full, it reduces your adrenaline gain by 50%. Feline akhs spawn as time progresses.

​

⬥ After the Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs are dead, players can go into gateways west and east to free the Echoes of Apmeken and Crondis. Within they will find a chainwarden akh (30k LP) and three chains (15k LP each).

Every killed chain turns the respective statue yellow instead of green. A player in the main arena cleanses the corrupted statue every time, permanently killing the chain. clicking the statue early deals damage. Chains respawn over time if the statue is not cleansed within ~12s. After all three chains are broken and cleansed, the player inside the respective room can liberate the god and receive their fragment of Tumeken (30s buff timer).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Crondis' blessing, two more Modest Crocodile Demons spawn.

⬥ Bringing the blessing to the right statue will stun Amascut for 25s. You cannot use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] during this, but [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1 prismofsalvation] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] do work. The stuns of both blessings stack, and after they end phase 3 starts.

​

Phase 3 (2000k)

⬥ Similar to phase 1

⬥ Rotation:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 33% adren no auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → Summon Scarabs → 3 same autos → Crushing Soul → swipes → 2 autos → Empowered Eruption → auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → phase 4.

​

Phase 4 (1200k)

⬥ Players can go into gateways west and east to free the Echoes of Het and Scabaras. No modest crocodiles spawn.

⬥ Similar to phase 2, but every non-scarab NPC has a carapace that makes them immune to damage. Remove the carapace by killing and grabbing explosive scarabs, then throwing scarabs to the NPC and through the gateways. Weaken and kill the gorillas. You need 4 scarabs per gateway for the chainwarden and the three chains. Scarab throwing has unlimited attack range. Alive scarabs heal Amascut over time (100 LP/scarab/1.2s). Exploding scarabs deal minor typeless damage to all players in the arena.

​

Phase 5 (600k)

Charging the fragment

⬥ Amascut says Tumekens heart. Delivered to me by these mortals ‎and four fragments shoot out of each statue, and Tumeken appears in the middle. Two soul obelisks appear west and east, and at full health they will deal damage to all players. Keep their health <100%. Channel statue energy to the fragments by having one or multiple players link energy from the statue to the fragment. Have another player stand on the green line to intercept the Amascut attack. Taking two hits in a row is an instakill, so switch out with your teammates. Lightstealer salawa akhs will spawn from the stairs and drain charge from the fragments of Tumeken if reached.

​

Protecting Tumeken

⬥ After a fragment is fully charged, Reform Tumeken in the centre and Amascut will become attackable again. She will start attacking the Reformed Tumeken four times sayingI AM. THE GOD. OF. ‎DESTRUCTION. If not intercepted by the player called by Tumeken (name) shield us from her shadow…. The attack will hit all for double(?) the damage. After the four attacks, another fragment has to be charged. Every lightstealer salawa akh that explodes on Tumeken will remove 4 reform progress.

Amascut dies at 0 health, regardless of reform progress.

​

Example kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/7l7vz2ie3XM Duo Amascut NM talkthrough]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=g36RHfQihw9RfoCmb7w2 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fg36RHfQihw9RfoCmb7w2.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prefight

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] to indicate start → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto]

​

_Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensive use in builds should include an auto for adren gain via Invigorating [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d6c5595e-226f-4fc8-bd3a-a879f16030fe Magic / Melee preset] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd6c5595e-226f-4fc8-bd3a-a879f16030fe.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Role Information

Mage/Melee should be limited to only free(sc) or hammer roles as well as only 1 per team for optimal performance. It provides strong damage for p1-3 and zaros but woll not attack minions p3 and severely lacks pillar damage.

Rotation

Prefight

At [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005552206302416986.png?v=1 war]: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

​

In Instance on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → : (Release stall asap) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury]

​

Phase 1

s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → tc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] + r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud]

​

Note: TC [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] at 6 seconds on the boss timer

​

Phase 2 and 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063258555650159.png?v=1 sunshine] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] (improv if not phased) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] should be cast 1 tick before amalgamations spawn, can also optionally stall [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] and release with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

​

Pillars

1st Pillar s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils]

2nd Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert]

3rd Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend])

4th Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar]

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → improv if not dead

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=AENJgw5xtKjK1FH4SO5N Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FAENJgw5xtKjK1FH4SO5N.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prefight

This rotation requires you to teleport out after each kill to War's Retreat, where you should altar, bank, and then channel 100% adrenaline at the adrenaline crystals before entering the instance. Once you enter the instance, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] once you see the base use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath].

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574292444791963659.png?v=1 RubyAurora] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → build to 100% using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] and defensives

​

Phase 1

(2.4s) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → tc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] (7t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1 impactflank]

​

Note: TC [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] at 6 seconds on the boss timer

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373972443775056.png?v=1 sonicwave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] (on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] spot) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → drop target + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest]

​

Note: Run behind the amalgamation before you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] so that it hits both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (3t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] (7t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Pillars

Pillar 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153611018261.png?v=1 deepimpactflank] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1 impactflank]

Pillar 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439387474722836.png?v=1 wrackandruin]

Pillar 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1 rubybakri] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas]

Pillar 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1 impactflank] → improvise

​

_Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip 2nd [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] on first pillar if low pillar hp

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Channel [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] longer or shorter depending on pillar hp_

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → improvise

​

Note: Channel [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] for longer or shorter depending on remaining hp, ideally end kill with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

Example Kills
Mage Camp MT Vods

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

DISCLAIMER: This is a very advanced rotation and we do not advise attempting it unless you have an exceptional grasp of basing already

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=itEivqAZtQ741dKvOh1s Magic / Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FitEivqAZtQ741dKvOh1s.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prefight

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] to indicate start → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto]

​

_Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Start fight 1t after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensive use in builds should include an auto for adren gain via Invigorating_ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4]_

​

Phase 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] (7t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] at 2.2m HP

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411826839257138.png?v=1 gsonicwave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739231785222154.png?v=1 iceamalg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain]

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → improvise if not phased

​

_Notes:

⬥ Click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] 2t after tendril

⬥ If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] procs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows], swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] until casting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend]_

​

Lure

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] if needed, otherwise use after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] (Pillar) → (target pillar) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] (7t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → improvise if needed

Example Kills
