pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Y1lOit5n5BrPgLCGTQch Magic / Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FY1lOit5n5BrPgLCGTQch.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prefight

(switch to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574292444791963659.png?v=1 rubyaurora]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → (switch to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming]

​

_Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensive use in builds should include an auto for adren gain via Invigorating [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This rotation starts after base's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build as many [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] stacks as you can before the start of the prebuild_

​

Phase 1

If minion tank/free role:

2.4s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → (switch to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

​

If hammer role:

2.4s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

​

Note: Cancel [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] at 2.2m HP

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411826839257138.png?v=1 gsonicwave] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943601029120.png?v=1 stalkerring]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain]

​

_Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Umbra or Hammer role, do [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] instead of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you are Hammer or Free, use your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232951255091.png?v=1 shadowamalg], then you may help [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232607318086.png?v=1 smokeamalg]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your amalgamation dies before the last ability written above, do the remaining abilities on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge timing to lure minion differs based on role you are doing:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If Umbra, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If Glacies, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] either after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] in Phase 2 or after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] in Phase 3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If Cruor or Fumus, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] in Phase 3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] should be used during the GCD_

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → improvise if not phased

​

_Notes:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] 2t after tendril

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] procs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows], swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] until casting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend]_

​

Pillars

Pillar 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1 impactflank]

Pillar 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574292444791963659.png?v=1 rubyaurora] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → finish with basics

Pillar 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574292444791963659.png?v=1 rubyaurora] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574292444791963659.png?v=1 rubyaurora] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

Pillar 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → finish with basics

​

Note: Pillar rotations are very variable and crit/adren dependent. This rotation should be used as a baseline and you should be prepared to improvise as necessary

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → improvise as needed

Example Kills

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026.

Want to get involved updating our guides? Get started in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)] or join the editing team today!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

Nex Angel of Death has the distinction of being the most damage centric boss in the game. Damage is king at AoD. As such, it is extremely important to have solid knowledge of rotations, as well as understand how to squeeze damage in at every opportunity. An AoD preset will be notably low in solid food, and have a significant amount of Blue Blubber Jellyfishes and Guthix Rests, as you are able to spam them during the kill to heal without losing adrenaline.

At time of writing, it's encouraged to start at Nex, Angel of Death server, and end up in Nex AoD FC.

​

Presets

General Information

Salves are especially useful at AoD, as they save inventory space and also prevent the poison effect during the last 600k of the boss. An essence of finality is used as you reach very high accuracy at AoD. Bladed Dive is critical to use during the last 600k in order to travel quickly between pillars around the arena. Each kill requires using your style-respective damage boosting ultimate prior to actually starting the kill, which is why the following preset suggestions contain an equipped ring of vigour and a defender with planted feet for ranged/mage and energizing for melee.

The various roles at AoD will have their presets, responsibilities and individual dps rotations in their own style-specific guides. This guide will mainly be to discuss the mechanics of the boss and how to handle them.

​

Familiars

A ripper demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] with scrolls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] is used by all roles of all styles at AoD, in order to maximise the team's damage output. The sole exception to this is the base, who may use a mammoth.

​

Mage bases using a Fractured Staff of Armadyl may also use a Kal'gerion Demon familiar with Crit-i-Kal scrolls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] to maximise their damage output during the FSOA spec. It is important to remember that Crit-i-Kall scrolls require manual activation.

​

Prefight

This consists of the team's preparation after entering the arena, before actually starting the boss fight.

​

Melee

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] Meleers should use the natural instinct ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] on a combat dummy and then use the dragon battle-axe special ability before building up to 100% adrenaline again.

​

Ranged

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] Rangers should also use the natural instinct ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat], and then use Death's swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]. They should then build back to 100% adrenaline and then use the incendiary shot ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] on a dummy and continue to build to 100% adrenaline again.

​

Magic

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] Mages should also use the natural instinct ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat], and then use sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine]. They should then build back to 100% adrenaline.

​

Placing Mines

Players should also mine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] the quadrants in preparation for reavers during phase 1, with each minion tank placing 2 dominion mines in their quadrant. Base mines cruor, free melee mines fumus and chinner mines glacies. If team size is 8+, the free dps should mine umbra.

​

Starting the Fight

In the case of a relentless proc on an ultimate during the prefight, incendiary shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] or meteor strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] may be used in order to gain adrenaline from critical hits during p1.

The base should start the fight at around 18-24s timer on their death’s swiftness or sunshine, depending on team speed. The reason for this is that phase 1 generally does not last long enough for the entire ult duration to be useful as well as to ensure that they'll off cooldown for p3.

The entire team except the base should start the fight in flank [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1 flankicon] position.

​

(Starting Positions and Setup)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/BlsqtaX.png Guide illustration]

​

Nex, Angel of Death Attack Pattern

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zo8r83v.png Guide illustration]

​

Phase 1 (3,000,000 - 2,100,000hp)

Start

Phase 1 takes place within the octagon of the arena. Players will stand on the eastern side of the quadrant (towards the Umbra/Glacies quadrants). This is because the base tank will keep Nex facing away from the team, allowing for the remaining 6+ players to utilise Flanking abilities.

​

⬥ After Nex does 5 auto attacks, she will perform her Elements special.

​

Elements

⬥ Nex teleports to the centre, faces a quadrant and divides the arena into quadrants. Icicles will spawn on the midlines and damage you if you're standing on them.

​

⬥ Players in the quadrant Nex is facing will take 3 hits of roughly 4000 damage. This damage can be mitigated by various means. Defensives such as reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] and debilitate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] will halve the incoming damage while resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] or the lunar spell Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] will negate one of the 4k hits entirely.

​

Dealing with Elements

⬥ The optimal means of dealing with this spec is to turn on soulsplit, use disruption shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] to mitigate first hit, tank the second hit, and resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the third. Generally, assuming reaver skip was not obtained, by this point the boss should be phased. If not, switch back to Deflect Mage and finish the phase.

​

⬥ One player must be present in the quadrant Nex is facing, if not, the Nex will build enrage stacks. More stacks = more damage taken. It is important to note that only the minion tank for that respective quadrant should be tanking elements.

​

Reavers

⬥ 3 blood reavers will spawn with 50,000 health points. These will be hit by the mines and can be safely ignored except for the umbra quadrant reaver. Since this reaver only gets two mines, the umbra minion tank as well as the free melee and chinner must deal with this reaver after phasing Nex to 2.1m hp. Reaver does not spawn in the quadrant Nex is facing.

​

Example of the Elements and Reavers Specials

[https://youtu.be/WqKyqvLFwfA https://youtu.be/WqKyqvLFwfA]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/WqKyqvLFwfA Embedded guide video]

Phase 2 (2,100,000 - 1,800,000hp)

At the start of Phase 2, Nex will begin to summon 4 amalgamations. She will take reduced damage until the amalgamations spawn. A brief overview of Phase 2 will be listed below:

​

Amalgamations

⬥ Amalgamations will spawn, dealing around 4000 damage to those nearby.

​

⬥ Minion tanks are tasked with killing the amalgamations, with some assistance from the base tank, quake/free melee and chinner. You can find more details in the style-specific guides.

​

⬥ Minions will spawn with 150,000 health points if the amalgamations are killed before their bar fills up (300,000 if the amalgamations aren't killed). Minions deal magic damage and can stun you.

​

Nex

⬥ The free melee, base and chinner are mostly responsible for reducing Nex to her hp cap (1,800,000) but everyone on the team should also contribute.

​

⬥ Once Nex reaches 1.8m hp, minion tanks should then surge across the octagon, luring all 4 minions directly under Nex for the chinner to kill.

​

⬥ When Nex reaches 1.8m hp, she will say a few voice lines, then Phase 3 will commence.

​

Shadow Orbs and Other Mechanics

⬥ Nex also has another special called shadow orbs where she will raise her hands and red shadow orbs will fall down onto the spot where the player is standing. This will happen a total of 3 times in quick succession. If the player remains standing on these red orbs, they will take rapid typeless damage. The optimal way of dealing with this mechanic is to remain in one spot until the 3rd orb has landed and then move 1 square away from the orb and continue dpsing. However, if you encounter this mechanic, the rotations in our AoD guides will not be timed properly with mechanics if followed exactly.

​

⬥ If you receive a second elements special, the rotations in our AoD guides will not be timed properly with mechanics if followed exactly.

​

Amalgamation Spawn

[https://youtu.be/DspXdhWyRW0 https://youtu.be/DspXdhWyRW0]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DspXdhWyRW0 Embedded guide video]

Phase 3 (1,800,000 - 600,000hp)

Phase 3 is fairly simple. Nex will lose all of her previous mechanics and gain 3 new mechanics.

​

Smoke Line

⬥ Nex targets two players, one will receive a message that a smoke from the East is coming. Another player will receive a message that a smoke from the North is coming.

​

⬥ After two autoattacks the smoke will appear in a line dealing rapid magic damage.

​

⬥ Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + Devotion perks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] will mitigate this damage. (It is highly unrecommended to actually use the devotion ability to nullify damage, as simply walking out of the smoke after placing it is much better way to handle this mechanic).

​

⬥ North smoke can be removed by standing on the wall to the West or East when the smoke is supposed to spawn. i.e. if you stand directly next to the east or west walls of the arena when you have north smoke, it will not spawn.

​

⬥ East smoke can be removed by standing on the wall to the North or South when the smoke is supposed to spawn. i.e. if you stand directly next to the north or south walls of the arena when you have east smoke, it will not spawn.

​

⬥ You should always call out what type of smoke you have in general chat by typing N or E depending on what type of smoke you have.

​

⬥ Be intelligent on where you place these smokes. Try not to pk your teammates. Ideal smoke placement if Nex has not been phased to 600k before smoke spawns will be shown below.

​

North Smoke Example

[https://youtu.be/h7oljWeJ6z8 https://youtu.be/h7oljWeJ6z8]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/h7oljWeJ6z8 Embedded guide video]

East Smoke Example

[https://youtu.be/IzxQyYdqbbs https://youtu.be/IzxQyYdqbbs]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/IzxQyYdqbbs Embedded guide video]

Smoke Pool

⬥ Nex will summon a pool with a crystal in the middle. This is a fairly simple special attack. - The pool will stay there until someone either: activates the crystal or the pool "explodes".

​

⬥ Clicking the crystal will deal 14,000 damage split evenly to everyone in the pool.

​

⬥ Not clicking the crystal will split 37,500 damage to everyone in the arena evenly.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In short, don't click the crystal and eat up. The only time people should take pools is if multiple people on the team have died, in order to prevent team members getting hit for 7k+.

​

Example of the Smoke Pool Special

[https://youtu.be/9R42qQiqMvY https://youtu.be/9R42qQiqMvY]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/9R42qQiqMvY Embedded guide video]

Ice

⬥ Nex will target a player, stun them, then create icicles around them.

​

⬥ Getting "iced" will stun you, make sure to freedom then move away from people. People will take damage if they are in a 5x5 space around the iced player.

​

⬥ Icicles have 20,000 health points. It is mandatory to kill the icicles as the player inside will take rapid damage if they are not freed.

​

⬥ If the team does not free the player (they should!), it is recommended to pray deflect melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee], as this will mitigate the rapid damage they receive.

​

⬥ Most fast teams will skip this mechanic by phasing into pillars before nex stuns a player to ice them.

​

Example of the Ice Special and How to Deal With It

[https://youtu.be/Fa4halk6znI https://youtu.be/Fa4halk6znI]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Fa4halk6znI Embedded guide video]

Phase 4 (600,000 - 0hp) (Crystal Health Points 200,000)

Nex will begin the final phase as soon as she reaches 600,000hp, in addition to all the minions being killed. At this point, Nex will become invulnerable and the team will have to kill the pillars before she becomes damageable again. Nex will only use mage attacks for the remainder of the fight. The base will lure Nex away from the other 6 players shortly before Nex phases, while the rest of the team will surge/bd to the first pillar. Pillar order is determined by the order that minions die during Phase 3. The most optimal order is Umbra, Glacies, Cruor, and lastly Fumus. Pillars will affect players if they are hit by Nex's auto attacks.

​

Bombs

⬥ Nex will cause a bar to gradually fill up on a player's screen. The player must be in the middle when the bar fills up or they will be instantly killed. After the first bar fills up, a second bar will start to fill up. Once this bar fully fills up, a bomb will be dropped at the players location, dealing typeless damage of around 3,000 to nearby players. Bombs deal no damage if the player is far away from Nex. This means that generally for the first 3 pillars, bomb can be placed next to the team, but at the last pillar it should be placed at a safe distance away from the team.

​

Pillar Effects

⬥ Shadow crystal places shadow traps under the player that damages them up to 4,800 typeless damage. To deal with this, keep moving and do not place the shadow traps under another player.

​

⬥ Ice crystal will gradually cause the player's screen to freeze. After a certain time, the player will get stunned and bled. Freedom will clear these effects. Nex's autoattacks will bind if Deflect Magic is not active.

​

⬥ Blood crystal lets Nex heal from her attacks. As she is usually only attacking the base, this pillar’s mechanic is somewhat irrelevant.

​

⬥ Smoke crystal allows Nex to infect players with a virus and can drain stats, overload timers and prayer points.

​

Note: Bladed Dive is incredibly useful for moving efficiently between middle and pillars.

​

Picking up and Placing Bombs

[https://youtu.be/dSxOPlcrd5k https://youtu.be/dSxOPlcrd5k]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dSxOPlcrd5k Embedded guide video]

How to Lure Nex as Base

Lure

Consider each pillar's quadrant. (see picture below)

​

The lure should consist of you moving along 3 of the edges of the last pillar's quadrant. This should be a bladed dive and surge along an edge shared with another quadrant to the arena's wall, followed by a second surge towards the final pillar, round the corner, then stepping 2 squares past the center line (first square of brick flooring).

​

You will have a choice of two starts to the lure. Preferably move along the edge shared with the later pillar. Never move along an edge shared with the 1st pillar.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/yCQLqYr.png Guide illustration]

Worked Example for Normal Case (UGCF)

F is the last pillar.

​

To start your lure, you can either south (shared with U) or west (shared with C).

​

Because C comes after U in this order you should choose to start the lure by bladed diving and surging west, then complete the lure by surging and running south towards the F pillar, after you reach the arena wall, then east to two squares past the line between F and U.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pBsMf5E.png Guide illustration]

Worked Example (UFGC)

C is the last pillar.

​

To start your lure, you can either move north (shared with G) or west (shared with F).

​

Because G comes after F in this order, you should choose to start the lure by bladed diving and surging north, then complete the lure by surging and running west towards the C pillar when you reach the arena wall. Complete you lure by moving south to 2 squares past the line between C and F.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ERwFkQc.png Guide illustration]

Extensive Lure Guide

This document contains a much more extensive guide on how to lure as base as well as all the correct lures for every possible pillar order.

​

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/17kRtNQsRLPcukH-6Y_PTPK9FutPSvK83a7k0ho6TVeU/edit https://docs.google.com/document/d/17kRtNQsRLPcukH-6Y_PTPK9FutPSvK83a7k0ho6TVeU/edit]

How to Re-centre AoD

At AoD, it is incredibly important that Nex stays in the centre until pillars for a variety of reasons. However, sometimes Nex may move from the centre and requires re-centring. In this case follow the steps below:

⬥ You misclick or AoD gets voked (or you die and someone else needs to re-centre)

⬥ Stand in the middle of the arena

⬥ Voke if needed

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or walk directly opposite of where she ends up standing

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or walk back to the base spot

​

In the example image below, the X tiles represent the tiles where AoD will end up standing on after you voke her while standing in the centre. You should then move to the opposite X (so in the image, if AoD ends up standing on the yellow X, you should move to the blue X to re-centre her).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KbXWamU.png Guide illustration]

The reason it is important to move back to the original base spot after re-centring is that if you are standing on the red tiles before minions run into mid, you risk blocking them. The green tiles are "safe" tiles, on which you will not block minions when standing on them.

​

Notes:

⬥ Should AoD move before the Elements special in p1, do not re-centre her as she will re-centre herself when jumping up for the special attack. Instead make sure you have her aggro and that you are in the base spot.

⬥ Do not walk through AoD while re-centring her. This will cause her to move off centre.

​

Example Video

[https://youtu.be/MLBs0sQVKG8 https://youtu.be/MLBs0sQVKG8]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MLBs0sQVKG8 Embedded guide video]

How to vuln pillars

The Umbra minion ent is responsible for applying vuln to all the pillars, below an example can be seen of how to do this quickly. The base of the pillars can be left clicked near the edges to easily throw a vuln bomb without wasting ticks.

​

Example of Vulning pillars

[https://youtu.be/HmYN8WGTbXA https://youtu.be/HmYN8WGTbXA]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Gs2VPyBThwSforFv8Q4y Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FGs2VPyBThwSforFv8Q4y.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

This rotation is viable till ~1:40 kills.

Prefight

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] (when base [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439366708592651.png?v=1 wrack] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439366708592651.png?v=1 wrack] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153680617473.png?v=1 gbargemobile] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 HydrixBakri] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → build

​

Phase 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153680617473.png?v=1 gbargemobile] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1 backhandflank]

​

Phase 2

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

DISCLAIMER: This is a very advanced rotation and we do not advise attempting it unless you have an exceptional grasp of basing already

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4cf6321f-3e5a-4c43-a1e2-41b57333655e Ranged / Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4cf6321f-3e5a-4c43-a1e2-41b57333655e.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prefight

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → base start + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

Phase 1

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → (phased or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] if needed) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → spam [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] + build to 120

Phase 2

If elements skipped

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

​

if elements not skipped

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

Note: spam [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] and channel for 4-6t to extend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk]

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] at 0/1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] at 2/3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → improv until 600k → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to U

Notes:

⬥ UG: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] asap on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

⬥ CF: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid]

Zaros

U: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

G: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

C: farcast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

F: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

Nex: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8d62afdc-71b0-4205-adc3-588a4522015a Melee-Ranged Hybrid] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8d62afdc-71b0-4205-adc3-588a4522015a.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotation

Prefight

Stall [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] at Wars → Enter instance

When everyone is in: (tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] (out of range) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Prefight notes:

⬥ If team banks slow swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] but might cause [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] cooldown issues on pillars, alternatively if base starts slower you can do [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct]

⬥ If your team is struggling with dps you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] at wars before stalling [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] at 2.4s (before you see 2 on timer)

​

Phase 1

(tc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend]

​

P1 notes:

⬥ TC [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] at 6 seconds on the boss timer

⬥ If adren is for some reason not good you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] instead of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

⬥ If "Hammer" Role, swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

⬥ If "Smoke Cloud" Role, swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud]

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

P2 notes:

⬥ Timing the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] is very important on the voiceline 'Show these intruders the true meaning of pain!

⬥ If the boss phases on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] wait 1 tick before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe], if it phased on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] no need to wait, if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213159071547395.png?v=1 nex] phased off tick you will have to resync using smoke visuals or the voiceline

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

(+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] if the boss isn't phased yet)

​

⬥ If the team struggles killing minions due to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] on team or otherwise swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec], then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Notes on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] timing:

⬥ Umbra ASAP, usually on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

⬥ Glacies: 2 ticks after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot]

⬥ Cruor: Same tick as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] (inputs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] same tick)

⬥ Fumus: Needs to run in during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] couple ticks after it starts channeling

​

Pillars

1st Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

2nd Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337470491033600.png?v=1 replenpot]

3rd Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish])

4th Pillar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar]

​

⬥ Assuming normal order (UGCF) you should use the following abilities to move between pillars:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to pillar 1 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to 2 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] to 3 & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to 4

​

⬥ If pillar 3 damage is lacking for the team can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish], then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] pillar 4

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → improvise if not dead

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Wzsd2bwxG0FUNPS36RA2 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FWzsd2bwxG0FUNPS36RA2.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prebuild

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] + start fight → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Note: Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] if Hammer does not use it in the prebuild. You should be using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] at 4.8s on the timer.

​

Phase 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Note: Skip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] if it would put you behind for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate].

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] ( → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] ) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Note: Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] only if it does not put you behind for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate].

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] ( → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] ) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to lure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]

​

Note: Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] only if phase timing allows.

​

Lure

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] ( → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] )

​

Note: Replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] if sufficient [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks.

​

Last Pillar and Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] ( → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] ) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] ( → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] ) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

​

Note: Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] first if your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] is still on cooldown.

​

Example Kills
09-2023 - Miss Kay Z - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k9M8f0cZTzM Base] ​11-2023 - Jedy - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AZyRr16gY8Y Base]
Nex, Angel of Death
This guide is made and upkept in collaboration with the [https://discord.gg/2rd8Vqe Nex, Angel of Death discord (external Discord)]. For those interested in a non-toxic and friendly environment for ‘Small’ team AoD, with team sizes varying from 4 to 7. We accept all experience levels, from Learners to Experts and Teachers. We offer teams running throughout the day.
[https://img.pvme.io/images/52ArNgViKL.png Guide illustration]

Formatting Maintained by: @swimmingfish

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=qeD1svk1xe4ZHSDj2pPz Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FqeD1svk1xe4ZHSDj2pPz.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prebuild

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] ( → (s) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec])

​

Notes:

⬥ This rotation starts on base's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

​

Phase 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Notes:

⬥ Time [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] so that it hits [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] as she becomes damageable again

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

​

Note: Glacies minion tank should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls], and Cruor and Fumus minion tanks should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] one tick before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate]

​

Pillars

Pillar 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] OR [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

Pillar 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

Pillar 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

Pillar 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

​

Note: Use the shorter Pillar 1 rotation if the team is consistently killing the pillar in two gcds. Swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] if Pillar 1 is not consistently dying in 3 gcds.

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic]

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

This is a mechanics guide for 4-man Nex, Angel of Death. It is assumed that you know how to deal with mechanics in 7-man AoD, described in [[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Angel Of Death 7s — Mechanics|Mechanics]].

​

Due to the meta heavily favouring ranged at the time of writing, this guide will assume that the team consists of Ranged Minion Tanks. The base can either Necro or Ranged.

​

The current rotations can consistently reaver skip if executed correctly.

​

Mechanics

Dealing with mechanics in 4-man AoD is slightly different to how they are dealt with in 7-mans. The following summarizes the major mechanics of the fight and how to deal with them.

Phase 1 (3,000,000 - 2,100,000 HP)

⬥ Elements

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quadrant with elements:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Tank it as you would in larger teams.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quadrant with reavers:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Throw sticky bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1 stickybomb] at the reavers until AoD hits her phase hp.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Sticky bombs last 6s / 10t.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Before getting bound by consecutive sticky bombs, the reaver will always walk at least 1 tile.

​

Note: Fast teams should not need to tank elements and do not require sticky bombs as you should consistently reaver skip.

​

Phase 2 (2,100,000 - 1,800,000 HP)

Handle mechanics exactly the same as in Phase 1.

​

Phase 3 (1,800,000 - 600,000 HP)

⬥ Smoke Pool

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All tanked pools taken deal 14k damage spread evenly among the people inside.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base is to tank the first pool making use of a vitality potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]. If the base is using ranged, the Fumus Minion Tank may instead handle the first pool with a vitality potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If there are any other pools, they have to be tanked by at least 2 people both with >7k hp.

⬥ Ice

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Assist the team member who is trapped ice by doing damage on the ice to free them.

⬥ All other mechanics work the same as in 7s.

​

Dummy Placement

⬥ Important Notes

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dummies [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] CANNOT be placed during Nex's elements special attack since squares are blocked for placement

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiars [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] block dummies, they are 2x2

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Conjures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] block dummies, they are 1x1

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prisms [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1016651066684756070.png?v=1 prismofloyalty] block dummies

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure before placing a dummy that nothing blocks it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Call your familiars

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move your conjures (Target the Glacies Amalgamation)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Don't place prisms near where dummies are supposed to be placed

Dummy Placement
A total of 4 dummies can be placed with the following distribution:
[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076241820450968.png?v=1 fumusfrogy] - Fumus MT - Under Dummy
Place on the arena's central tile at any point before p3 (p2/3 is preferable if p1 damage is an issue)
[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076207200669716.png?v=1 cruorfrogy] - Cruor MT - West Dummy
Stand 2 squares out of md on the west midline and place before incend p3
[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076295675183104.png?v=1 umbrafrogy] - Umbra / Glacies MT - South-West Dummy
Place p1 from the tile shown, make sure no pets are blocking, can place after rapid p2 if blocked
[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076486151372925.png?v=1 basefrogy] - Base - South Dummy
Place during p3 after the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton], walk from southeast→south (blue rectangle) and place
[[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Angel Of Death Small Teams — 4s Mechanics|Guide illustration]] ([https://img.pvme.io/images/tsGtkCpi5E.png Guide illustration])

Minion Lure

To lure the minions using 3 minion tanks (UG Tank, C Tank and F Tank) players need to do the movement correctly.

⬥ UG Tank will do the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] at the Fumus detonation spot and move to the center line to avoid elements

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move behind the umbra amalgamation (1) while targeting the amalgamation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre vuln umbra, and surge north after umbra spawns (to 2).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vuln glacies, and surge through nex to lure (to 3).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After luring, you may move to the center line to be closer to first pillar (4).

⬥ C Tank will do the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] at the Umbra detonation spot and move to the center line to avoid elements

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge the minion through nex as you would in a 7-man team at the timing listed in rotations

⬥ F Tank will do the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] at the Umbra detonation spot and move to the center line to avoid elements

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge the minion through nex as you would in a 7-man team at the timing listed in rotations

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move back into after minion is fully lured

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JUSNhrd8hm.png Guide illustration]

Nex, Angel of Death

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=EZblg4fsfM8Fiqy4byvR Necromancy - Base with rangers] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 eofblack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] Death Guard

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] Statius Warhammer

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 hydrixbakri] Ful arrows and Hydrix Bakriminel Bolts [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FEZblg4fsfM8Fiqy4byvR.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prebuild

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

​

Instance: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Note: If rangers are prebuilding, start on the 3rd ability after meteor. Otherwise, signal start with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] and proceed. A ranger will start the fight.

​

Phase 1

tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] (if necessary to phase)

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 hydrixbakri] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] + disassemble [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] if 100) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → fill as needed

​

Pillars

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

Nex, Angel of Death can be done in small Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] teams with relatively low requirements due to the strong multi-target damage and sustain tools available to the combat style. This guide will cover strategies applicable to duo and trio Necromancy teams that will work both for getting your first kill and for consistent farming of the boss.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=rCepvqR0quPCbcRKqfDq Advanced Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=yWAydOcln6bSkHBcYk7b Basic Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FyWAydOcln6bSkHBcYk7b.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Checklist and Unlocks
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku] EoF with Statius Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] and/or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 eofblack] EoF with Death guard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] Passive Ring of Vigour unlocked ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] Darkness active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/659122178704408598.png?v=1 blessedflask] Available ways to restore prayer points ⬥ Bonfire + thermal spa HP boosts are active

​

Rotation and Strategies

Phase 1

⬥ In phase 1 the base will apply the defence level reduction from Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec], which will last until pillars begins

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Invoke Lord of Bones [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] may also be used for a slower-ramping defence reduction

⬥ One player (the base in this rotation) will use Invoke Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] and Threads of Fate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] to clear out the reavers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver], utilising the stun from Death Guard special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to keep them from reaching Nex

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that the reavers must be close enough for threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] to reach them all, this can be timed as the reavers reach the set of green-rune tiles surrounding the center of the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Refer to Example Kills to see this in action

​

Base

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → ​

Minion Tank

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] →
