[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → continue until phased

Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] if adren is available

These rotations serve as a guideline to begin the fight with and don't have to be followed precisely

Note: Replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] if not owned

​

⬥ Stay within 1 tile away from Nex (2 tiles away from the center tile) to ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] hits every reaver.

⬥ If the reavers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver] are 1 tile away from Nex after you stun them due to late threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] timing, then walk 2 tiles away from Nex diagonally and continue the rotation. Relure after reavers die.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To relure you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to the center and walk 2 tiles diagonal away from Nex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]

​

Phase 2

⬥ Phase 2 will begin as Nex hits 2.1 million health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] and will be shortly followed by amalgamation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] spawns, which will be cleared with Invoke Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] and threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate]

⬥ Depending on team size, minion lures will differ but the objective will be to pull them into the center such that scythe combo [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] and threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] will hit them all as well as Nex

⬥ In the meantime, all players should focus on getting Nex down to 1.8 million health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] to avoid getting another elements special attack, which will spawn blocking tiles that will prevent the minions from being lured properly

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your team is having trouble skipping this elements special attack, ideally try to phase Nex during an elements special attack on phase 1 (on the jump but before reavers spawn)

​

All players

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] on Nex to deal as much damage as possible to phase

​

Minion Tank(s) as amalgs spawn

⬥ Duo: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

Note: Replace first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] with 8+ stack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern] is not owned

​

⬥ Trio MT 1: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ Trio MT 2: Focus on doing single-target damage to Nex

​

Minion Lures

Trio Lure
⬥ Base can stand cardinal MD to Nex and stay there for the entire phase ⬥ Minion tanks lure two minions each, starting east and west on the green tiles ⬥ (1): Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] as minions spawn and automatically aggro ⬥ (2): Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as the minion you dove away from reaches the mid-line
[[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Angel Of Death Small Teams — Necro Duo Trio Overview|Guide illustration]] ([https://img.pvme.io/images/yn8KMojB97.png Guide illustration])
Duo Lure
⬥ Base starts diagonal to Nex and will have to move partway through the lure to avoid blocking a minion ⬥ Minion tank starts directly center ⬥ (1): Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] into the base quadrant as minions spawn and Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the minion there ⬥ (2): Base dives [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] as the minion gets provoked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] ⬥ (3): Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as the minion you dove away from reaches the center of the arena
[[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Angel Of Death Small Teams — Necro Duo Trio Overview|Guide illustration]] ([https://img.pvme.io/images/KogPRNBend.png Guide illustration])

Killing minions

The recommended abilities are [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

Duo

⬥ Minion tank: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3]

⬥ Base: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3]

Optional: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] the minion you want to kill first, typically U or G to avoid prolonging their respective mechanics in phase 4

​

Trio

⬥ Base: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ MT 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ MT 1, who used [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg]: focus on doing single-target damage to Nex, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] for single-target damage if it comes up before minions are finished

​

⬥ Minion tanks can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] to reduce damage and prevent their rotations from being disrupted

​

Phase 3

⬥ Phase 3 involves using Necromancy's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] strong multi-target damage to clear out the minions while still keeping up damage on Nex

⬥ If minions are handled properly they should die early in phase 3. If not, continue using AoE abilities until they're finished.

⬥ Utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] flicking on minions to heal up on AoE attacks

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] as they come up to finish phasing Nex to 600k health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

⬥ Mechanic solutions are fairly similar between duo and trio teams and any differences will be covered below

​

Phase 3 Mechanics

Mechanics in phase 3 will happen in a semi-random order, with the primary restriction being that ice cannot happen first and the same mechanic cannot happen back-to-back

​

⬥ Smoke Lines: Simply place these away from the base and walk out

​

⬥ Ice: You go into a 'stasis' mode where [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] will get cancelled if it returns to you and conjures don't attack anymore

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] and place the ice where the team can reach it but be careful not to hit others

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] to quickly destroy the ice

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can still use conjure abilities during ice but as said before conjures won't attack

​

⬥ Pool: There must be >14k combined health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] split amongst all players standing in the pool, heal up as the special attack begins to meet this requirement

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4.7k health each [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] in trio, 7k health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] each in duo

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] to boost life points to take it solo or take it with others if unavailable

​

Phase 4

⬥ All mechanics are straightforward from here on. Make sure to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] on each pillar and keep cycling strong abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] can be optionally reapplied at any time after pillars begins

⬥ Bombs can be placed at max range on a wall next to a pillar or as close to the pillar as possible to leave as much open space as possible

⬥ Conjures will continue attacking when you go middle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] can be used to deal with the constant autoattacks from Nex

⬥ After all pillars have been defeated, the team can all reposition to the middle, only surging out to place bombs

⬥ Continue to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] until Nex is defeated

​

⬥ Invoke Lord of Bones [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks will carry over into phase 4, with the following amounts being required to maximise hit chance:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks if no [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~100 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

Nex, Angel of Death can be done solo using Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] with relatively low requirements due to the strong multi-target damage and sustain tools available to the combat style. This guide will cover strategies applicable to solo players that will work both for getting your first kill and for consistent farming of the boss.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3BH84d4IKg46ErA6Zzh2 Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3BH84d4IKg46ErA6Zzh2.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Checklist and Unlocks
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku] EoF with Statius Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] ⬥ (optional) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] Invoke lord of bones ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 eofblack] EoF with Deathguard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] Passive Ring of Vigour unlocked ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] Animate dead active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] Mobile perk or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/895999229737185280.png?v=1 shadowsgrace] Shadows Grace relic ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/659122178704408598.png?v=1 blessedflask] Available ways to restore prayer points ⬥ Bonfire + thermal spa HP boosts are active ⬥ (Optional) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1206664820682657822.png?v=1 firstnecrorobetop] Power armour swap between mechanics

​

Rotation and Strategies

Phase 1

⬥ Start the fight by using Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] three times to drain AoD's defence level

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will last till pillars start

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Additionally apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] Lord of Bones to keep 100% hit chance when drinking brews

⬥ Use Invoke Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] and Threads of Fate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] to clear out the reavers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver], utilising the stun from Death Guard special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to keep them from reaching Nex

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that the reavers must be close enough for threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] to reach them all, this can be timed as the reavers reach the set of green-rune tiles surrounding the center of the arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Refer to Example Kills to see this in action

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the reavers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver] are 1 tile away from AoD after you stun them, you can walk diagonally 2 tiles to move aod but still have the reavers be in range for threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate]

⬥ When using defensives, keep in mind that Nex's melee autoattacks will reset defensive cooldowns at 5, 10, and 15 enrage stacks, visible on your debuff bar

⬥ During the elements special attack, use defensives such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to absorb the incoming damage from the quadrant Nex is facing

⬥ To prepare to phase Nex into phase 2, hold damage slightly before hitting 2.1 million health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] and wait for her to start her elements special attack, using a high damaging ability such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] to guarantee the phase as she jumps

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to phase before ice walls and reavers can spawn

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is to ensure as much time as possible during phase 2 before she uses another elements special attack, which will spawn additional reavers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver] that will be very difficult to deal with during that phase

​

Phase 2

⬥ Phase 2 will begin as Nex hits 2.1 million health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] and will be shortly followed by amalgamation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] spawns, which will be cleared with Invoke Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] and threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate]

⬥ The objective is to kill all 4 amalgamations simultaneously and lure all minions into the center such that scythe combo [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] and threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] will hit them all as well as Nex

⬥ In the meantime, focus on getting Nex down to 1.8 million health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] to avoid getting another elements special attack, which will spawn blocking tiles that will prevent the minions from being lured properly

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] on Nex to deal as much damage as possible to phase

​

⬥ Nex should be centred during this phase if you phased at the beginning of the elements special attack in phase 1, otherwise make sure to recenter her so that threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] will hit all amalgamations

​

As amalgamations spawn

⬥ Tier 90 off-hand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809239255658587.png?v=1 skulllantern90]: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → (8+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ Tier 95 off-hand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern]: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → 3 stack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

Minion Lure

Solo Lure
⬥ Start anywhere in the center 3x3 area of the arena ⬥ (1): Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] as minions spawn and automatically aggro ⬥ (2): Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as the minion you dove away from reaches the center ⬥ (3): Walk into melee distance of the minions once they are all lured to be able to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] all enemies
[[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Angel Of Death Small Teams — Necro Solo Overview|Guide illustration]] ([https://img.pvme.io/images/YUqj09eLJN.png Guide illustration])

​

Killing minions

The recommended abilities are [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] + 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] as minions spawn, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] on the first set of stuns and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] comes back off cooldown to prevent it from being interrupted and potentially losing a threaded volley [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ Upkeep single target damage on Nex between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] cooldowns

⬥ Blood Siphon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon] may be used for healing between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] cooldowns

⬥ If done correctly, minions should die early in phase 3, leaving only Nex to deal with

​

Phase 3

Phase 3 involves using Necromancy's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] strong multi-target damage to finish off the minions' remaining health, which will then allow you to focus on Nex and staying healthy for upcoming mechanics

⬥ Start with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] and use defensives [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] as necessary to deal with incoming damage

⬥ Once minions are dead, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] can be used as long as Nex's attacks are still flicked properly

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] as they come up to finish phasing Nex to 600k health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

​

Phase 3 Mechanics

Mechanics in phase 3 will happen in a semi-random order, with the primary restrictions being that ice cannot happen first and the same mechanic cannot happen back-to-back

​

⬥ Smoke Lines: Simply place and walk out, can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] to prevent taking extra damage in case of a stun

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Remember to stay within melee distance of minions for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] range

​

⬥ Ice: You go into a 'stasis' mode where [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] will get cancelled if it returns to you and conjures don't attack anymore

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to use a few more damaging abilities before you are imprisoned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Disables defensives such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] but not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] (if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch]) and make sure to keep prayer flicking

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Preparation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] isn't put on cooldown so [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] can be used before ice and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] once you are imprisoned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can still use conjure abilities during ice but as said before conjures won't attack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] can be used as ice is ending to 'save' some global cooldowns

​

⬥ Pool: Must have >14k health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] to take the pool

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tier 90 Deathwarden gear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770718468223027.png?v=1 wardenhood90] and boosts from bonfire + thermal spa [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] will put you >15k maximum health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fortitude [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341748180025365.png?v=1 fortitude] may be flicked on for up to 1000 additional maximum health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 vitality] to boost life points or heal up with food [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1 brew] if unavailable

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be wary of an invisible autoattack as Nex finishes her initial animation of spawning the pool

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] can take care of much of the healing between mechanics once minions are dead

​

Phase 4

⬥ All mechanics are straightforward from here on. Make sure to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] on each pillar and keep cycling strong abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] can be optionally reapplied at any time after pillars begins

⬥ Bombs can be placed at max range on a wall next to a pillar or as close to the pillar as possible to leave as much open space as possible

⬥ Conjures will continue attacking when you go middle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie]

⬥ Remember to upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] on each pillar if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] can be used to deal with the constant autoattacks from Nex

⬥ After all pillars have been defeated, you can reposition middle, only surging out to place bombs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to keep track of which bar is the instakill / bomb if doing this to prevent accidentally bombing mid

⬥ Continue to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] until Nex is defeated

​

⬥ Invoke Lord of Bones [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks will carry over into phase 4, with the following amounts being required to maximise hit chance:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~50 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks if no [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~100 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] stacks if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stacks will last for 10 minutes since the last application so recasting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] during phase 3 may be necessary in longer kills

​

Example Kills

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=NkT9XP8Jz7fbtkaMGbYb Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412865523722.png?v=1 eofpink] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] Eldritch crossbow

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412906680330.png?v=1 eofblue] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] Seren godbow

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] Dark bow

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022282076553268.png?v=1 eofpurpleu] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] Decimation

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412727242773.png?v=1 eofgreen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] Zamorak Bow

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] Ful and Wen arrows

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/923269339136798800.png?v=1 pernixsquiveryellow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] Deathspore arrows

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] Bring Powerburst of Vitality if tanking Pools [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FNkT9XP8Jz7fbtkaMGbYb.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prebuild

auto + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] at Wars Retreat → stall [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

​

Enter instance → wait for the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] signal from base → tc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] [start the fight 1 tick after grico]→ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing]

​

Phase 1

(3.0) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] (8t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232951255091.png?v=1 shadowamalg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → wait 2 ticks + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] are used to prevent from proccing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming]

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if no adren) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Pillars

Pillar 1: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

Pillar 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming]

Note: improvise Pillars 1 and 2 according to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stacks.

Pillar 3: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows]

Pillar 4: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing]

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929540908679208.png?v=1 zammybow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

Example Kill
21/04/2024 - x Neon - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gCZhz0Wlw4o Link]
Nex, Angel of Death
This guide is made and upkept in collaboration with the [https://discord.gg/2rd8Vqe Nex, Angel of Death discord (external Discord)]. For those interested in a non-toxic and friendly environment for ‘Small’ team AoD, with team sizes varying from 4 to 7. We accept all experience levels, from Learners to Experts and Teachers. We offer teams running throughout the day.

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide to hybrid solo AOD [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] It is assumed you are familiar with the mechanics of the boss as well as having a strong sense of timing for prayer flicking. This guide covers strategies to maximize efficiency in this encounter. For a single kill for the CA, [[PvME/Nex: Angel of Death/Angel Of Death Small Teams — Necro Solo Overview|Necro Solo Basic]] is recommended instead due to ease of access and gentler learning curve.

​

Gear & Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2d04a378-b5d9-4bf6-a7e4-7436fad11534 Hybrid Melee-Range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

Phase 1

⬥ Start with a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] rotation and aim to get [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod] to 2500-2600k hp before reavers spawn

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to clear out the reavers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver], utilising [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] to bind the reavers and simultaneously apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow]

⬥ When using defensives, keep in mind that Nex's melee autoattacks will reset defensive cooldowns at 5, 10, and 15 enrage stacks, visible on your debuff bar

Phase 2

⬥ Phase 2 will begin as Nex hits 2.1 million health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] and will be shortly followed by amalgamation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232447938670.png?v=1 bloodamalg] spawns, which will be cleared with Invoke Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] and threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate]

⬥ The objective is to kill all 4 amalgamations simultaneously and lure all minions into the center such that you can efficiently aoe them with decimation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

⬥ Ideally phase into 1.8m with the second [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

⬥ Use a combination of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] to push nex into the 1820-1850k hp range

⬥ Nex should be centred during this phase if you phased at the beginning of the elements special attack in phase 1, otherwise make sure to recenter her so that threads [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] will hit all amalgamations

Phase 3

After the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] spam sequence, optionally tweak [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] and finish the rest of the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] with a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] sequence. ​

Mechanics in phase 3 will happen in a semi-random order, with the primary restrictions being that ice cannot happen first and the same mechanic cannot happen back-to-back:

​

⬥ Ice: You go into a 'stasis' mode where bled channels will get cancelled and you are no longer able to attack the boss

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to use a few more damaging abilities before you are imprisoned, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1508822612049002627.png?v=1 saradominbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] can be very helpful for sustain if you just tanked a pool right before being iced

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Disables defensives such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] but not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] (if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch]) and make sure to keep prayer flicking

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Preparation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] isn't put on cooldown so [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] can be used before ice and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] once you are imprisoned

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The timing for when ice ends is when the cooldown of your mobility abilities reach 4 seconds (they instantly become usable again right after ice ends)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you phase into P4 while iced, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] to avoid being frozen by glacies pillar while prayer flicking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] against ice and boss autos.

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] x 5-6 → adjust [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] as needed and do [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → some combination of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → fillers

​

Phase 4

⬥ All mechanics are straightforward from here on. Cycle between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] to quickly finish the encounter.

⬥ Bombs can be placed at max range on a wall next to a pillar or as close to the pillar as possible to leave as much open space as possible

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] can be used to deal with the constant autoattacks from Nex

⬥ After all pillars have been defeated, you can reposition middle, only surging out to place bombs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to keep track of which bar is the instakill / bomb if doing this to prevent accidentally bombing mid

⬥ BSA [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] stacks will NOT carry over into phase 4, making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] a strong option

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jx7qrEX0DlY 4:54 no ice]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/jaQwI4md-f8 5:40 2 ice]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4ff260d3-32e1-4cf8-b112-85a7c0e27004 Hybrid Base] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ‎ ‎/ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eofor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] Varanus' Mercy

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] Dragon Scimitar

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] Statius Warhammer

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 hydrixbakri] Black Stone Arrows/Hydrix Bolts (e)

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] will need [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] Caroming 4 [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4ff260d3-32e1-4cf8-b112-85a7c0e27004.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

​

Note: All [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] are with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 hydrixbakri] ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] unless specified to be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg]

Prebuild

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

​

Instance: Signal ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones]) → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]) r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879300526080.png?v=1 havoc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864235458464186418.png?v=1 cease] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → Start + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] (press 1 for start and click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] same tick) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Phase 1

([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]) r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] ‎ ‎→ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming]

​

Note: If HP is above 2370k after the second [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] instead of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake]

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1 magmatempesttarget] ‎ ‎ ‎([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232607318086.png?v=1 smokeamalg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] spot) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] → auto + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] → (mid [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]) s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]) r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411826839257138.png?v=1 gsonicwave] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739232607318086.png?v=1 smokeamalg]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Note: If HP is below 1915k for the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath], walk out 2 squares West so [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] does not hit the boss

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]) s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1 aod]) r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411826839257138.png?v=1 gsonicwave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439387474722836.png?v=1 wrackandruin]

​

Pillars

Pillar 1: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming]

Pillar 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration])

Pillar 3: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

Pillar 4: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar]

​

Zaros

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

Example Kills
Rocket Cars - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DynVh3Ie4yM Example Kill] Rocket Cars - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vT-pKORw5m4 Example Kill with Bomb]
Nex, Angel of Death
This guide is made and upkept in collaboration with the [https://discord.gg/2rd8Vqe Nex, Angel of Death discord (external Discord)]. Content provided by @rocket_cars. For those interested in a non-toxic and friendly environment for ‘Small’ team AoD, with team sizes varying from 4 to 7. We accept all experience levels, from Learners to Experts and Teachers. We offer teams running throughout the day.
[https://img.pvme.io/images/52ArNgViKL.png Guide illustration]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=63c7e6fa-3f25-4f1b-95fc-dd85f79e7f03 Hybrid DPS] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ‎ ‎/ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eofor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] Varanus' Mercy

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] Dragon Scimitar

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 hydrixbakri] Black Stone Arrows/Hydrix Bakriminel Bolts (e)

Notes:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] will need [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] Caroming 4

⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/eQFjZEk5If.png Normal prayers] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313901189431296.png?v=1 overcharge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215399597581533264.png?v=1 piety] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1285372688457797672.png?v=1 eclipsedsoul]) will be used with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/926021352626982942.png?v=1 zealots]

⬥ Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1383112489092382810.png?v=1 powderofdefence] is recommended [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F63c7e6fa-3f25-4f1b-95fc-dd85f79e7f03.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/eQFjZEk5If.png Guide illustration]

Rotation

​

Note: All [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] are with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 hydrixbakri] ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] unless specified to be [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ebzDAxLuY1.png Guide illustration] Note: a Table of Contents is available in this page’s contents navigation.

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Araxxor/Overview|Araxxor Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Me4GasJMYFjNy4aK0ScA Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FMe4GasJMYFjNy4aK0ScA.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ It is recommended to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/NopeNopeNope NopeNopeNope] perk from Player Owned Farms active

⬥ Upkeep the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] buff from your familiar

⬥ Araxxor takes a few seconds to clear vulns on phases 1–3, making vuln bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] usable on all phases

​

Top Path

Phase 1

⬥ Burn the web and use:

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → ~20s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → ~35s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Phase 2

⬥ At ~59 seconds, move directly through the path using:

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] (→ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] if not dead)

​

Middle Path

Phase 1

⬥ Walk Araxxor against the web

⬥ At 99% web burn, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] into phase 2

​

Phase 2

⬥ Run across the acid pool and stand 3 tiles up the ramp

⬥ Damage Araxxor until it has absorbed 53% acid

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] up the platform and walk 1 tile west

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] when the acid bar reaches approximately 24–19%

⬥ Build to 100% adrenaline for phase 3

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] as you jump down the ramp → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Bottom Path

Phase 1

⬥ Damage Araxxor to below 5,000 LP

​

Phase 2

⬥ Follow the light and remain at 100% adrenaline

⬥ During the charge, use a defensive ability to remain in combat

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] while moving towards phase 3

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Phase 4 (All Paths)

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → (tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213019543699466.png?v=1 araxxi] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Example Kills

Top Path
⬥ [https://youtu.be/CB7tGY5sDZg 1:37.8 Top Path]
Middle Path
⬥ [https://youtu.be/jpHp21Id-3g 3:00 Middle Path]
Bottom Path
⬥ [https://youtu.be/znZcD9H_JYM 2:42 Bottom Path]

​
