[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/w4CtXQCKIY.png Guide illustration] Note: a Table of Contents is available in this page’s contents navigation.

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Araxxor/Overview|Araxxor Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Ae9Q2oND5zxYU4ILNbI5 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FAe9Q2oND5zxYU4ILNbI5.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ As [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] Araxxor is desired, wearing a ranged weapon until Araxxor has spawned is required

⬥ It is recommended to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/NopeNopeNope NopeNopeNope] perk from Player Owned Farms active

⬥ Upkeep the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] buff from your familiar

⬥ Araxxor takes a few seconds to clear vulns on phase 1-3, making vuln bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] usable on all phases

​

Top Path

Phase 1

⬥ After Araxxor has spawned, equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern]

⬥ Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642262165790911.png?v=1 haunted] and build to 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not attack the boss other than to apply the debuffs and obtain stacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This phase is timegated so it can be used to set yourself up for phase 2 while you deal damage

​

Phase 2

⬥ At 59 seconds use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trigger player movement on every tick along with your mobility abilities

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clicking on an enlarged minimap may be helpful in facilitating movement and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] placements across the path

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] should be executed when web burn reads 99%

​

Phase 3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Middle Path

Phase 1

⬥ No special setup. Just dps araxxor down to <5k hp

​

Phase 2

⬥ Just dps araxxor down to <5k hp

⬥ When you go to the top of the ramp, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → filler → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost]

⬥ End this phase with at least 70% adrenaline

​

Phase 3

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + run to the edge of the arena near Phase 4 → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] at any time in this phase

Bottom Path

Phase 1

⬥ No special setup. Just dps araxxor down to <5k hp

​

Phase 2

⬥ On Phase start [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → filler → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost]

⬥ During the charge you want to do [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + spam click your minimap

⬥ End this phase with at least 70% adrenaline

​

Phase 3

⬥ (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] at any time in this phase

​

Phase 4 (All Paths)

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → Target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213019543699466.png?v=1 araxxi] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Example Kills

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nRwTsLjidK.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

​

This guide is aimed at players looking to kill Arch-Glacor at 3000-4000% Enrage and assumes strong underlying knowledge of all information presented in [[PvME/Arch-Glacor/Overview|Arch Glacor Basic]].

​

The Arch-Glacor is not affected by Slayer tasks in hard mode.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d094d086-73a3-4f45-9bd9-1fbadc4758af Melee / Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd094d086-73a3-4f45-9bd9-1fbadc4758af.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Preset Notes

​

⬥ Powder of Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] or bring a form of prayer restore + Powder of Protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] if using Am-hej [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej]

⬥ Hellhound familiar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] recommended, but Kal'gerion Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] may be used at lower (<3500%) enrages

⬥ Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] at Wars

⬥ Master Magic Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953726341267606.png?v=1 magiccape] stored for longer debuff duration

⬥ Optional [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] usage at Wars

⬥ Optional [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1449363594495135776.png?v=1 nodonspikeharness] for extra melee damage, otherwise wear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1 zemouregalsnexus]

​

Fight Checklist

​

⬥ Keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] applied while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk]

⬥ Have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] equipped as often as possible while meleeing for Flamebound Rival damage reduction

⬥ Keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] applied while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]

⬥ Don't overspend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks before Glacyte Minions during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk], needed for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] cooldown refund

⬥ Regularly use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] to sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch]

​

General Rotations

As a general rule, it is better to keep your hybrid rotation rolling even in the middle of mechanics. If your buffs run out while clearing Glacyte Minions, simply swap styles right then. If Pillars are currently happening, put up your buffs (without dying) anyway. This helps to ensure that you're spending minimal time outside of buffs for mechanics that can happen somewhat unpredictably.

For Arms (Exposed Core) specifically, if your buffs are close to running out while the ice is creeping in, just swap styles early to make sure you're not still building as the mechanic begins.

​

Opener

​

⬥ Arch Glacor spawns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

⬥ First Mechanic:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: finish applying necessary debuffs first, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] (until cleared)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: finish applying necessary debuffs first, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] (until cleared)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cannon: make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] is applied + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Flurry: make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] is applied + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] if needed

​

Magic Phase

The following rotations are laid out as a general checklist that could deviate based on order of mechanics

​

⬥ Make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] is applied → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] if adren is low → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] + use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] as needed for either damage or adrenaline

​

⬥ Mechanics:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] → target bolstered + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1 magmatemptest] middle of minions → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Make sure to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If close to end of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine], swap to melee early and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] to do the melee clear instead

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + improvise

​

Melee Phase

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] / stall [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] (only for adren, don't attack) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] + switch back to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] as quickly as possible → make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] is applied → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] + don't overspend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks

​

⬥ Mechanics:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] → target bolstered + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Watch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks, need 4 for full cooldown reset on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] is used because the Flamebound Rival damage reduction is lost while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] is equipped

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] ends, swap to magic to finish the clear with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: Improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Defensive Usage

⬥ At higher enrage, you will want to prioritise defensives as follows,

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frost Cannon: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] (only one is needed)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] a hit if needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exposed Core (Arms): [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] if it goes too long, rarely needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Flurry: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] does decent damage at higher enrage)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pillars of Ice: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] for adrenaline

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nRwTsLjidK.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

​

This guide is aimed at players looking to kill Arch-Glacor at 3000-4000% Enrage and assumes strong underlying knowledge of all information presented in [[PvME/Arch-Glacor/Overview|Arch Glacor Basic]].

​

The Arch-Glacor is not affected by Slayer tasks in hard mode.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ab514507-02c9-4919-8805-0a0d6e20203a Melee / Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fab514507-02c9-4919-8805-0a0d6e20203a.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Preset Notes

​

⬥ Powder of Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] or bring a form of prayer restore + Powder of Protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] if using Am-hej [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej]

⬥ Hellhound familiar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] recommended, but Ripper Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] may be used at lower (<3500%) enrages

⬥ Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] at Wars

⬥ Master Magic Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953726341267606.png?v=1 magiccape] stored for longer debuff duration

⬥ Optional [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] usage at Wars

​

Fight Checklist

​

⬥ Keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] applied while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk]

⬥ Have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] equipped as often as possible while meleeing for Flamebound Rival damage reduction

⬥ Don't overspend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks before Glacyte Minions during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk], needed for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] cooldown refund

⬥ Regularly use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] to sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] once during each [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] for a faster setup on the next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]

​

General Rotations

As a general rule, it is better to keep your hybrid rotation rolling even in the middle of mechanics. If your buffs run out while clearing Glacyte Minions, simply swap styles right then. If Pillars are currently happening, put up your buffs (without dying) anyway. This helps to ensure that you're spending minimal time outside of buffs for mechanics that can happen somewhat unpredictably.

For Arms (Exposed Core) specifically, if your buffs are close to running out while the ice is creeping in, just swap styles early to make sure you're not still building as the mechanic begins.

​

Opener

​

⬥ Arch Glacor spawns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

⬥ First Mechanic:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: finish applying necessary debuffs first, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] (until cleared)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: finish applying necessary debuffs first, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] (until cleared)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cannon: make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] is applied + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Flurry: make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] is applied + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] if needed

​

Ranged Phase

The following rotations are laid out as a general checklist that could deviate based on order of mechanics

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] to extend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] again (not always possible depending on mechanic order)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Start with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] was not used during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk]

​

⬥ Mechanics:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] → target bolstered + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] if available → spam [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] runs out, swap to melee early and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] to do the melee clear instead

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]

​

Melee Phase

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] / stall [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] (only for adren, don't attack) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] + switch back to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] as quickly as possible → make sure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] is applied → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + don't overspend [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks

​

⬥ Mechanics:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] → target bolstered + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Watch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks, need 4 for full cooldown reset on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] is used because the Flamebound Rival damage reduction is lost while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] is equipped

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] ends, swap to ranged to finish the clear with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: Improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Defensive Usage

⬥ At higher enrage, you will want to prioritise defensives as follows,

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frost Cannon: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] (only one is needed)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] a hit if needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exposed Core (Arms): [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] if it goes too long, rarely needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Flurry: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] does decent damage at higher enrage)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pillars of Ice: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] for adrenaline

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nRwTsLjidK.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

​

This guide is aimed at players looking to kill Arch-Glacor at 2500%-4000%. However, all information is applicable to lower enrages. Swap to ripper demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] below 2500%.

​

This guide assumes strong underlying knowledge of all information presented in [[PvME/Arch-Glacor/Overview|Arch Glacor Basic]].

​

The Arch-Glacor is not affected by Slayer tasks in hard mode.

​

A large portion of the preset below is built on sustaining high enrage kill streaks. Read the notes in the preset link if you wish to substitute some supplies for more food.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] are optionally brought to 0t spec on arms at 3500%+ enrage. Offstyle soulfire speccing arms at high enrage greatly improves consistency, however isn't necessary. This guide isn't structured with their use in consideration. Use !0tick ‎in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)] for more information on 0ticking offstyle special attacks with necromancy.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ecA3h6GIy9XZPdeXBjwt Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FecA3h6GIy9XZPdeXBjwt.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Buffs & checklist;
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] Powder of Penance - Optional, replaces blessed flask at increased cost ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] Weapon poison active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] Darkness active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] Limitless Sigil unlocked ⬥ Bonfire + thermal spa HP boosts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] are active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] Kwuarm incense at 4 stacks

​

General Rotations & tips

⬥ Starting the encounter:

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] (outside) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat]

​

⬥ Rotations for Arch-Glacor are not strict, as per the random nature of the boss's mechanics. Aim to upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] as much as possible.

​

⬥ At 3500%+ enrage, always reserve splitsoul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] for the exposed core.

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] , are all high value abilities with medium-length cooldowns. Put these abilities on cooldown before the pillars of ice mechanic blocks your line of sight.

​

⬥ Living Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] is best used during the flurry mechanic. This mechanic gives you a long, uninterrupted window in which you can deal damage to Arch-Glacor. It can situationally be used to reset [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] cooldown in anticipation of an upcoming exposed core mechanic. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] shouldn't be strategically reserved for arms, as the time it takes to clear the mechanic doesn't largely change with or without the ult active.

​

⬥ Ensure that some Necrosis Stacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] (4+) and Residual Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] (2+) are held for the Exposed Core.

​

⬥ It is best to start the fight with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] , as it is a low adren investment that has no cooldown, and has high use priority during the fight. There is a 2/5 chance you get a mechanic (minions/exposed core) that will nullify your first attacks.

⬥ Both tank gear and TFN should be bound for swapping.

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• TFN gear should be worn in the following conditions;

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Exposed core mechanic is active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pillars of ice mechanic is active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] is active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Equipped before casting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] .

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Arch glacor is not casting any auto attacks, and you are at or below your max HP in DPS gear (~11,100).

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In all other situations, tank gear should always be worn in cases when you are taking damage.

​

⬥ It is important to note that ranged autos during flurry will deal the most damage, as the 3pc cryptbloom buff doesn't reduce ranged damage. On average, the 3pc cryptbloom set provides superior damage reduction over 4pc deathwarden.

Exposed Core (Arms)

⬥ Have your conjures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] active and Ghost commanded [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In some cases, it may be best to equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] excalibur to dismiss conjures, and re-conjure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] to refresh their timer before the next mechanic, if you are anticipating arms coming soon in the spec order. It is essential that conjures have a long enough timer to be active throughout the entire mechanic.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] where required depending on adrenaline in order to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] .

⬥ If you need to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] , use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] and flick to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] for 1 tick to get to 100% adrenaline.

⬥ ~15s into exposed core, you can swap to tank gear to benefit from 3pc cryptbloom's magic damage reduction% passive.

​

Example Arms rotation:

⬥ Closely follow the rotation below in priority of cooldowns and stacks available.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If starting with low [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] soul stacks (1-2), use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] over [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] where appropriate to build adren and stacks before dumping.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] , and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] should always be used first, as their damage is dealt over time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Offstyle soulfire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1 odetodeceit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] may optionally be used after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] .

​

⬥ 0-2500%:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank]

​

⬥ 2500%+:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → (tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] (until 0 stacks) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] (6/8 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] , use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if at 12/12) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109200432959528.png?v=1 commandphantom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Note: Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] when required.

​

Note: If flanking, stand central or on the south wall next to the boss.

​

Clearing Glacyte Minions

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] once at 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks. continue casting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] until at 5/5.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Always cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] , as this starts its 15s cooldown which lets it be available for a second use before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] #3

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Always target the bolstering glacyte. This causes perks and jas book to activate on it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] on the magic minion closest to the bolstering glacyte. This will cause vulnerability to apply to all five glacytes.

​

Rotation;

​

⬥ 0-2500%:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

⬥ 2500%+

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

Note; movement used in example videos on minion clears helps reduce freezing blood stack gain. 10 stacks of freezing blood will apply a 3s bind and stun.

Defensive & utility usage

⬥ At higher enrage, you will want to prioritise defensives as follows,

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frost Cannon: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 reprisal] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] (In TANK GEAR & max HP)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Always wear tank gear for this mechanic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Alternatively; [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] (hit 3, don't need to combo with defensives) / spam food + be overhealed with brew on first hit. Use of any one of these will ensure you survive the mechanic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exposed Core (arms): [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] as needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] on arch-glacor (2500%+) and, rarely, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] to block or clear stun the freezing blood stun.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Flurry: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] (deals ~27k at 4000%) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] if needed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pillars of Ice: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] can deal damage even if the player doesn't have LOS, depending on the skeleton's position.

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/vqcP6IYw1pA?si=CN9Y8AWaBdMlhNm- 6 KPH 4000%]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YrMqspEn6R.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

This guide assumes that you already have an understanding of mechanics of the fight - [[PvME/Beastmaster Durzag/Bm Overview|Bm Basic]]

​

The Strategies

⬥ There are two main strategies to duo BM:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AoE stack strategy - stacking and tanking everything at once, dealing damage with AoEs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Entangle strategy - uses entangle to get the 2nd pet stuck, reducing damage taken

​

General Notes

⬥ It will be significantly easier if the base tank uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289319964763.png?v=1 staffoflight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] , especially if they are tanking pets at the same time for the AoE strategy.

⬥ Cryptbloom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336168363561041.png?v=1 cryptbloomtop] with animate dead [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0VJPdrObhSrzvPodd6zW Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=XpeodVMvtcqHuv5jlqj3 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FXpeodVMvtcqHuv5jlqj3.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

AoE Stack Strategy

⬥ Stand by the north gong where the 2nd pet spawns, and ideally deal damage to both the pets and BM using AoE attacks

​

Stacking Phase

[https://img.pvme.io/images/axiYyam.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Stay in melee distance to the pet to only take melee damage whilst stacking the enemies.

⬥ Walk the pet/BM to stack them for AoEs if necessary.

⬥ Focus on killing one of the pets, particularly if stacking BM on the pet fails

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] Prisms of restoration may not be able to spawn if surrounded by enemies - place the prism before starting, and extend it during the fight

​

⬥ The 3rd pet and chargers will spawn once the 2nd pet's health is lowered sufficiently - continue to deal damage with AoEs.

​

One Pet Dead

⬥ Base tank - run BM to avoid taking too much damage; stacks are only received from melee hits. Using emerald aurora [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/914077639784935424.png?v=1 emeraldaurora] for additional damage reduction is helpful.

⬥ DPS player - finishes off the remaining pet. provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] and tank the pet, using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] again if it jumps onto the base tank.

​

Both Pets Dead

⬥ DPS player helps to kill BM - the DPS player can act as the backup tank, allowing the base tank to do their damage rotation.

⬥ Try not to run BM too far from the non-tank player's damage-boosting ultimate.

​

Entangle Strategy

⬥ Uses entangle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] to manipulate the 2nd pet, preventing it from attacking until you are ready to kill it.

⬥ This strategy aims to use chargers to block the 2nd pet.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Therefore, BM must not be in combat until you are ready to have it summon the chargers and 3rd pet.

​

Pet 2 Lure

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pqwlV4r.png Guide illustration]

Note: Do not aggro BM

1) Stand at the closest charger cage that is south of the west gong as the fight starts.

2) Wait for pet to jump to you → cast entangle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] on pet.

3) Do not attack, move to the southwest corner of the arena and wait for the pet to jump again.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/cxQhHvK.png Guide illustration]

4) Attack the pet; lower its health to around 25k.

​

Pet is Lowered - Getting it Stuck

1) Run towards the middle to aggro BM, cast reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] whilst doing this

2) Run back towards the pet - cast entangle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] on the pet as BM comes close, and use freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] or anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] as you will be stunned by the 3rd pet

3) Wait for chargers to spawn - just as the chargers start to move, surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] east and go to the southeast corner

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6gwUuPF.png Guide illustration]

⬥ If done correctly, the entangle will prevent the pet from moving until the chargers get into position. Once in position, the chargers will block the pet.

​

Southeast Corner

⬥ Lower the 3rd pet/BM as you see fit.

⬥ Base tank - run BM when the 3rd pet dies to avoid taking too much damage; stacks are only received from melee hits. Using emerald aurora [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/914077639784935424.png?v=1 emeraldaurora] for additional damage reduction is helpful.

⬥ DPS player finishes off the pet that is stuck.

​

Killing BM

⬥ DPS player can act as the backup tank, allowing the base tank to do their damage rotation.

⬥ Try not to run BM too far from the non-tank player's damage-boosting ultimate.

​
