pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dInQvgZaB5.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

​

Croesus is the general of the Bik front in the Elder God Wars which is a skilling boss. There is no combat involved in the fight. Instead, the fishing, mining, woodcutting, and hunter skills are used to gather material in order to repair statues that subdue the boss, allowing you to damage its core through skilling. You can fail the encounter, but you will not die, and is safe for Hardcore Ironmen.

​

The boss is massable, however the recommended group size starts at 8, going down to 4 once you are comfortable with the fight.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ZqHNsw0CmOHZiF7lPpFH Woodcutting preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248186782699541.png?v=1 woodcutting]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pysi2plNLpoM0QEUGRbN Hunter preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248190649839667.png?v=1 hunter]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=sWGRXhUPNBCywDkQkobX Mining preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Drw64zexoihAWOmc0gEY Fishing preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109938540564.png?v=1 fishing]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FDrw64zexoihAWOmc0gEY.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Tips and Tricks

Consumables

⬥ Using Crystal Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109829464094.png?v=1 crystalmask]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crystal Mask will fully block one stat drain hit from ANY of Croesus' attacks. This will NOT stop a Fairy Ring from teleporting you, Hard Fungus from stunning you, or Sticky Fungus from rooting you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If players are using extreme hunter potions, they should still avoid Slime Moulds where convenient as Slime Moulds will negate the effects of the potion even with Crystal Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109829464094.png?v=1 crystalmask] active.

​

⬥ Skilling Boosts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342110177624084.png?v=1 gathererscape] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342110030798858.png?v=1 perfectplus]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bringing relevant skilling equipment can greatly improve the speed and overall efficiency of the encounter.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Skilling outfits/elite skilling outfits increase rate of gathering. If Fishing or Hunting, the elite skilling outfits can help by doubling resources.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Relevant tools and will also aid in success rate (High tiered Pickaxe and Hatchet, Rod-o-matic with Honed 6, Magic Butterfly Net).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Perfect Plus or Perfect Juju fishing and woodcutting Potions can be used to increase gathering rates for skills in the encounter for fishing and woodcutting.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stat boosting potions can be used when the core opens up to increase damage dealt to Croesus.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skilling familiars can significantly increase the rate of gathering.

​

Unlocks

⬥ Bladed Dive/Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bladed Dive and Surge help move around the arena faster to deal with mechanics sooner.

​

⬥ Perks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041614888407060.png?v=1 ancienttoolgizmo2]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skilling equipment should be augmented and equipped with the highest tier of the Honed perk available if possible. No other skilling perks are relevant to the encounter.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Perks such as Imp Souled or Furnance will not affect resources in the encounter. Thus, tools with Honed 6 and such perks are viable to use in the encounter with no drawnbacks.

​

⬥ Shadow's Grace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/895999229737185280.png?v=1 shadowsgrace]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lets players avoid needing an off-hand switch for mobile while using skilling off-hands.

​

Mechanics

Contribution Points

Throughout the encounter, players will gain Contribution Points for performing beneficial actions. Having more points will increase the number of rewards given at the end of a kill, up to a maximum of 12 loot rolls at 419. Getting knocked out by having a stat fully drained will drop contribution points to 0, and no loot will be given.

​

Actions that increase contribution points:

⬥ Gathering fungi from dead beasts - 2 per resource from normal nodes, 3 from glowing nodes.

⬥ Placing fungi at statues - 2 per resource.

⬥ Restoring statues - 1 per XP drop.

⬥ Freeing other players from sticky fungi - 10.

⬥ Damaging the core of Croesus - 2 per XP drop.

⬥ Interacting with white and green spores on the core - 1 for white, 2 for green.

⬥ Rotting depleted dead beasts - 20.

​

Actions that decrease contribution points:

⬥ Interacting with red spores on the core - 2.

⬥ Gathering from rotten nodes -2 per resource.

​

Rot Bar

⬥ The rot bar is an orange bar underneath Croesus's health.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anyone getting stats drained by a mechanic will increase the bar by 1% per drain.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Failing to remove the Energy Fungus will increase the bar by 40%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Passively, the bar increases at about 8% per minute.

​

⬥ If Croesus is alive and its core not exposed when the bar hits 100%, players will fail the encounter.

​

⬥ If Croesus still has remaining LP after the four statues have been activated, the bar will immediately reach 100% and players will fail the encounter.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/3SlyrE0.png Guide illustration] ​

Dead Beasts

⬥ Players must gather resources from the monster corpses around the arena to repair statues and prevent fungus from regenerating on them. The following corpses and colours correspond with the following skills:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Araxyte | Red | Woodcutting

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Giant Mole | Yellow | Mining

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crassian Leviathan | Green | Fishing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dagannoth Rex | Blue | Hunter

​

⬥ Gathering a glowing resource node will deplete the corpse faster, while a rotten node will give Rotten Fungus. Guard corpses nearby will provide resources, but award no contribution points.

​

⬥ Upon fully depleting a corpse of resources, a player may acquire 10 Rotten Fungus and attempt to gather from the corpse again. Doing so will rot the corpse, slowing down its regeneration rate as shown below.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Depletion of a corpse is indicated by all nodes being dark and a light blue progress bar filling above it.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rotten Fungus should be obtained by left clicking any gathered fungus in one's inventory. They are also forcefully rotted by getting stats drained.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a corpse is NOT depleted, damage dealt to Croesus's core will be reduced.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

⬥ Croesus sends out mechanics at roughly these times during the first cycle of the fight (mechanic breakdown below):

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 00:14: Red Spore Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 00:23: Fairy Ring

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 00:38: Slime Mould

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 00:51: Yellow Spore Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 01:03: Hard Fungus Fall (Stun)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 01:12: Sticky Fungus

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 01:26: Green Spore Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 01:37: Fairy Ring

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 01:51: Slime Mould

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 02:03: Blue Spore Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 02:14: Hard Fungus Fall (Stun)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 02:23: Sticky Fungus & Energy Fungus

​

⬥ The attacks are then repeated in the same order for subsequent cycles.

​

Spore Bombs

Croesus will fire a Spore Bomb at players, leaving a 3x3 AoE that will drain stats by 15 levels (11 with Pontifex Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring]). The colour of the AoE corresponds to the stat drained:

⬥ Red: Woodcutting

⬥ Yellow: Mining

⬥ Green: Fishing

⬥ Blue: Hunter

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Fairy Rings

Croesus will spawn a 1x1 Fairy Ring under players, indicated by dust particles underneath them. Not moving away will teleport the player to a random location within the arena.

⬥ This does not drain your stats but will forcefully rot the first resource in your inventory.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Slime Mould

Croesus will fire a Slime Mould in a 7x7 radius of players which chases them which explodes upon touching. The Slime Mould gets stuck behind obstacles easily and explodes after awhile.

⬥ The Slime exploding on you will drain stats by 25% (18.75% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring]) and forcefully rots the first resource in your inventory.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Hard Fungus Fall

Croesus will fire a 1x1 Hard Fungus at players, stunning them if hit. This can be dodged or mitigated by using Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom].

⬥ Getting stunned and failing to mitigate it will drain stats by 20% (15% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring]).

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Sticky Fungus

Croesus will spawn Sticky Fungus under some players feet, holding them in place until it is burned away or drains stats four times.

⬥ Players can free themselves and others either by bringing logs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109930143784.png?v=1 proteanlog] in their inventory (Proteans work), or wielding an Orthen Furnace Core [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109892399125.png?v=1 orthenfurnacecore] or Sana's Fyrtorch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109842079766.png?v=1 sanasfyrtorch] in their off-hand slot which is faster and awards no XP.

​

⬥ Stats are drained by 10% (7.5% with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring]) each interval the player is not freed.

​

Energy Fungus

Croesus will spawn an Energy Fungus next to them in each of the four quadrants. Players can click on this fungus to start removing it.

⬥ If the Energy Fungus is not removed, Croesus will gain 40% Rot.

​

⬥ Every Energy Fungus mechanic is accompanied by the Sticky Fungus mechanic.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Mushroom walls

At the northern and southern sides, 4 walls of mushroom on each side separate the quadrants to their West and East.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E6KQ6jw.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Players need to cross the mushrooms 4 times to cross between East and West.

​

⬥ If crossing via a mushroom that is not glowing, the player will have their levels drained and the first resources in their inventory rotted.

​

Mushroom minefield

At the east and western sides, a minefield of mushrooms separate the quadrants to their north and south.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/2YlMtve.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Players need to cross the minefield only stepping on areas free of mines.

​

⬥ If a mine is touched, the first resource in the player's inventory will be rotted and the player will have their levels drained.

​

Statue Restoration

Once 15 materials from nodes diagonally opposite and adjacent clockwise to a statue's quadrant have been deposited at a statue, it can be restored by players. This awards Construction experience.

⬥ Wielding the Artificer's Measure off-hand gives a chance to increase progress and speed up the overall restoration with no loss of points.

​

⬥ The Master Constructor's Outfit provides a similar effect as above.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Statue Prayers

⬥ Once a statue is fully restored, it may be prayed to. When the prayer is complete, it will exposes Croesus's core and halts progress on the rot bar.

​

⬥ If the core is exposed, subsequent statues prayed to will increase the core's exposure time.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Exposed Core

⬥ Croesus's core will be revealed as one of four skilling nodes. Gathering from the core will damage Croesus per XP drop based on the player's level in the relevant stat.

​

⬥ Assuming all monster corpses are depleted, damage dealt to the core will be [Current Level] * 15. If no corpses are depleted, damage dealt will simply be equal to the player's current level in the relevant stat. Stat boosts in the relevant skill will increase damage dealt.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a fungal stew for the corresponding skill is used, damage dealt will be increased by 50%.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

Core Particles

While gathering from Croesus's core, spores will occasionally spawn from its base. Clicking the core again while they are present will have the following effects based on their color:

⬥ White: Deals an extra 500 poison damage.

⬥ Green: Deals an extra 1,000 poison damage.

⬥ Red: Heals the boss for 2,500 LP.

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

​Imgur link to image/gif expired.​

The Fight

Woodcutting Node - Araxyte

[https://img.pvme.io/images/PAZmIy2.png Guide illustration]

Mining Node - Giant Mole

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VAoKlHQ.png Guide illustration]

Fishing Node - Crassian Leviathan

[https://img.pvme.io/images/eVyI5WD.png Guide illustration]

Hunter Node - Dagannoth Rex

[https://img.pvme.io/images/a3iQHXw.png Guide illustration]

Strategy

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LFm0ZMH.png Guide illustration]

The current 4-man method seeks to maximize contribution points (>419, which gives the maximum loot rolls of 12) while maintaining kill times of around 6:30. All 4 statues are restored and the team waits until Energy Fungus spawns in the middle for a second time. After clearing it, all 4 statues are prayed to simultaneously to expose the core for its maximum duration, letting the team kill it in one cycle.

⬥ If a player is lagging behind, the kill can be completed by restoring 3 statues, at the expense of the contribution points of the lagging player.

​

Gathering

The Hunter initiates the encounter. Players will first gather all the resources needed to restore the statues.

​

⬥ At the start of the fight, players can start by using Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] (with Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] if needed) to arrive at their glowing node as fast as possible.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hu7ns3C.mp4 Source media]

⬥ When Croesus fires Spore Bomb attacks, it will check players' positions just before the bomb erupts. Reposition as needed when Croesus bends down. Not placing Spore Bombs at glowing nodes is the most important part of efficient gathering.

​

⬥ Players can utilise Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] or Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or both to place the bomb with little disruption to their gathering.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/79rAGtT.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Use Crystal Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109829464094.png?v=1 crystalmask] and stand still during Slime Mould to not disrupt your gathering.

​

⬥ Try to always have Crystal Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109829464094.png?v=1 crystalmask] active as a safeguard.

​

⬥ Players first gathers 16 resources and deposits them at the base of the statue nearby. Ideally this is done as Croesus drops the first Slime Mould.

​

⬥ Use Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] before the Hard Fungus lands when gathering. This does not disrupt gathering.

​

⬥ Players can save ticks by preparing to Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] between changing glowing nodes. Nodes can change every other attack starting from the first Fairy Ring.

​

⬥ Equip your Orthen Furnace Core [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109892399125.png?v=1 orthenfurnacecore] or Sana's Fyrtorch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109842079766.png?v=1 sanasfyrtorch] before the Sticky Fungus attack and prepare to click under yourself.

​

⬥ Once having depleted the corpse and secured the second batch of 16 resources, players should start running.

​

Running (2-1)

⬥ Players should contribute their first batch of 15 resources to the statue after running anticlockwise twice from their original node.

​

⬥ Before crossing the Northern and Southern mushroom walls, especially if crossing behind another player, ensure you have Crystal Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109829464094.png?v=1 crystalmask] active. Attacks in the mushroom field, particularly Slime Moulds, are hard to avoid.

​

⬥ When crossing the mushroom walls, click on the next glowing mushroom once when you see your character begin to cross the current mushroom as shown below. Excessive clicking on a mushroom cause your character to cross back.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/CtNIoJJ.mp4 Source media]

⬥ When crossing the minefields, use Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] followed by Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as shown below.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clearing the mushroom field correctly is the most important part of running, as you can easily lose more than 1 resource if not careful, resulting in the need to regather from your original node.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Precisely aim your Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] and only click once. Avoid spam clicking to prevent unwanted running.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You may wait for a second before Surging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to ensure your character is facing the correct direction.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crystal Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109829464094.png?v=1 crystalmask] does NOT prevent your stats being drained or your resources from being rotted if you accidentally touch the mushrooms.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is possible to do this in 1 tick once confident enough.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KHaaDjs.mp4 Source media]

⬥ After your first contribution, withdraw the resources beside the statue, cross anticlockwise once more, and contribute them to the statue in your ending quadrant.

​

Mid

⬥ Clearing the Energy Fungus is the most important part of having a good contribution score, ensure you do not miss either if you do not want to lose out on drops.

​

⬥ Pay attention to the timer as you will need to clear the Energy Fungus in the middle at about 2:23.

​

⬥ It is recommended to make your way to mid shortly after the second Hard Fungus fall.

​

⬥ If the timer is 2:10 or more, do not cross mushroom walls, proceed to the mid and wait.

​

⬥ If you have just finished crossing a quadrant and need to rush to the middle, you utilise the Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] and Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] combo shown below.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/a1rL2uB.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Once at mid, equip your Orthen Furnace Core [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109892399125.png?v=1 orthenfurnacecore] or Sana's Fyrtorch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109842079766.png?v=1 sanasfyrtorch] before the Sticky Fungus attack and prepare to click under yourself.

​

Rot and restoration

⬥ After mid, proceed to gather from guard corpses in your current quadrant and rot all resources in your inventory until you have 10.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A quick way to get back to the guard corpses is to utilise the Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] and Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] combo shown below.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/TZd3o1i.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Have hotkeys to rot the fungus as doing so will not interrupt any action.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is not recommended to do this during movement as the rotting animation stalls the running animation, which may make it hard to determine the position of your character.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rot losslessly as your gather so that you do not waste time gathering more than 10 fungus.

​

⬥ After rotting, proceed to equip artificer's measure and start restoring the statue. Dodge attacks by moving around the statue.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All statues can be Surged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] through to avoid attacks as shown below.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The mining and fishing statues can be surged through from both sides

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The hunter and woodcutting statues can only be surged through from one side.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Abwi6EW.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Be wary of Spore Bombs and keep in mind they are 3x3, as their visual display may be obstructed by the staircase.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/XufsvrJ.mp4 Source media]

⬥ You can losslessly equip your Luck Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 LotD] during restoration.

​

⬥ Using defensives will only interrupt restoration for 1 tick, you do not need to click on the statue again after using them.

​

Prayer and DPS

⬥ After restoration, pray until there's 2-3 prayers left and click off the statue.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click off the statue early as your character will pray one more time before leaving the statue.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dodge attacks until about 4:55 seconds and proceed to mid for the second Energy Fungus attacks.

​

⬥ After the second mid, you may Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] back to the statue to quickly finish prayer, then use Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] and click the core to start DPSing.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ffP8zzQ.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Zoom in on the core and click on the white and green spores to increase your contribution score.

​

⬥ Check that your stat used to damage the core is not reduced. Use Restores [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore] if they are.

​

Example Kills

Video Examples
The example kills below consists of a 1mid 4man fishing, and 2mid 4mans (3 kills per video) for all roles. 1mids give slightly more loot and kills per hour if done properly, but are more difficult and thus the consistency of 2mids is generally preferred.
1 Mid
⬥ [https://youtu.be/ljB-8qgnIzI 4:09 4-Man, 1 mid, no rot, Fishing]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dInQvgZaB5.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

​

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the mechanics and the general concept of Croesus. If not, please read [[PvME/Croesus/Croesus|Croesus]].

​

1mid is faster than standard 2 mid 4-mans and duo due to only doing the first energy fungus and not waiting for the second energy fungus. However, it does require alt accounts.

​

⬥ If done properly, all kills should be sub-4.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=lbrLp9wBulBs86QaLjRU Woodcutting preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248186782699541.png?v=1 woodcutting]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=aIInfO23Rq94qbXh6cEJ Hunting preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248190649839667.png?v=1 hunter]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=BuEvFIdVGY5RrzxRNz9P Fishing preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109938540564.png?v=1 fishing]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=snvi0Eh24fk0z9Cpf2LP Mining preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]

​

Preset Notes

​

In Pack Mammoth [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1 mammothpouch]

⬥ 7 of each Fungus Soup (Calcified, Spore, Timber, and Algae)

⬥ 3 Powerbursts of Acceleration [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration]

⬥ 1 Super Restore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fsnvi0Eh24fk0z9Cpf2LP.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Tips

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1162535342163902505.png?v=1 hunterskillcape] needs to be keybound, press the keybind every 2-ticks (1.2s) in order to utilise it.

⬥ Avoid clicking potions and rotting fungus from your inventory as this will stop you from gathering.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keybinding them prevents this.

⬥ Only gather from the sparkling nodes to deplete faster.

⬥ Try to maximise the time you're gathering, the only specs you should move for are smokes and fairy ring.

⬥ Use movement abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153769877514.png?v=1 escapemobile] to traverse between nodes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More details in role specific section below.

⬥ Spam clicking the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109938540564.png?v=1 fishing] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248186782699541.png?v=1 woodcutting] nodes will make you gather one tick faster per resource.

⬥ Using Walk Markers is extremely helpful so you know when you get to the tile you have clicked.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153769877514.png?v=1 escapemobile] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] back to node to dodge bombs.

​

Strategy Information

Using alts can be done to scale the boss fight to get more points through the Energy Fungus (mid) and the Core so you don't have to wait for the second energy fungus.

​

There are 2 strategies, it is recommended for you to use alts to benefit the quality and speed of kills. In both strats you can use the alts to gather 15 resources and deposit them into the resource box which makes you gather 5 less resources.

​

⬥ 4 alts

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each player brings an alt.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These don't need any stats, they can be complete fresh accounts but you can also use alts with stats to benefit the kill.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you're not using them to benefit the kill run them through the mushroom field immediately upon kill start so you don't gain any enrage through them tanking mechanics.

​

⬥ 6 alts

⬥ Two people double alt, the other two single alt.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players ideally want their alt to have 80 in the skill they're doing and at least 50 Construction.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 alts can also help on the core with this method. Base 80+ on the 4 gathering skills is optimal.

​

Your goal is to deplete your node, get to your statue and start repairing before the first mid. On the 6 alt teams you can use your alts to help repair statues (2 to 1 statue, no more). If done correctly you should all have depleted your nodes and fully repaired the statues before the first mid spawns.

​

Strategy Execution

⬥ Gather 10 resources and rot it then gather another 15 resources with depletion then poison your node (25 in total before running).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you're not using an alt to gather 15 resources and deposit into the resource box, don't rot 10, gather 5 more and deposit it (30 in total before running).

​

⬥ Running should be done efficiently utilising both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go 2 quadrants anticlockwise and deposit your resources in the statue.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take the resources from the resource box and go 1 quadrant anticlockwise.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deposit the resources in the statue and start repairing the statue.

​

⬥ Statues repairing should be done using minimal time to dodge attacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] through the statue at 2:23 for the energy fungus.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once it's done pray on your statue, if someone hasn't finished repairing go help them after praying.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drink the relevant soup and attack the core. If it's Hunter drink an Extreme Hunter dose too.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can 2-tick Hunter cores.

​

⬥ Click all the particles that are not red, even on Hunter if 2-ticking you just have to spam click it (the damage may not show up).

​

Role Specific
Take note of the tips and movement patterns listed below to greatly improve your encounters
Tiles not to stand on
⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/TD0Ha6n Do not stand on these tiles]     • These are marked in the pictorial movement guides below as red 'X's. ​
Hunter
⬥ Use the Tracker aura and DO NOT 2-tick while gathering resources as this will result in a contribution loss.     • Start left side for hunter quadrant statue (Woodcutting role). ⬥ You will usually start the encounter (or you can use an alt). ⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/tXRR9eQ Hunter movement guide (pictures)] ⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/m8zrlLU Hunter movement guide (gifs)] ​
Mining
⬥ Use the Quarrymaster or Berserker auras ⬥ Avoid clicking the Mining nodes until you have to, this will cancel your current swing. ⬥ This role is the longest, the Miner should use an alt to gather their 15 resources to deposit in box if possible. ⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/gFkRJx1 Mining movement guide (pictures)] ⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/gurQMzw Mining movement guide (gifs)] ​
Woodcutting
⬥ Use the Lumberjack aura. ⬥ Spam clicking the Woodcutting nodes will improve your gathering by 1 tick per resource. ⬥ Woodcutting movement is the 'hardest' due to the large size and odd shape of rax creating obstacles between nodes.     • You will start on a specific tile northwest of rax detailed below.     • [https://imgur.com/a/GdEo7Mq Woodcutting movement guide (pictures)]     • [https://imgur.com/a/Bgg2Hk5 Woodcutting movement guide (gifs)]​
Fishing
⬥ Use Call of the Sea aura ⬥ Spam clicking the Fishing nodes will improve your gathering by 1 tick per resource ⬥ The Fisher uses the fishing cape and brings a physical hunter cape switch for hunter cores ⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/LZAzPzs Fishing movement guide (pictures)] ⬥ [https://imgur.com/a/IL2qKbh Fishing movement guide (gifs)] ​
Traversing the Statues
Below lists details on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] methods to aid efficiency.
Starting
⬥ Always start right side of the statue on the top step (the tip). [https://img.pvme.io/images/VY32rpU.png Example]     • Start left side for hunter quadrant statue (Woodcutting role). ​
Tip to Mid
⬥ This is done with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] to get to mid for clearing energy fungus and vice versa, which should be done at 2:23 [https://img.pvme.io/images/qH2xm0u.mp4 Example]     • Fishing quadrant (Hunter role) - [https://img.pvme.io/images/qH2xm0u.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] straight to the spot or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and walk 1 tile south [https://img.pvme.io/images/XJNRiC6.mp4 Example]     • Hunter quadrant (Woodcutting role) - [https://img.pvme.io/images/XJNRiC6.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://img.pvme.io/images/x9X9Bk5.mp4 Example]     • Woodcutting quadrant (Mining role) - [https://img.pvme.io/images/x9X9Bk5.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and walk 1 tile west [https://img.pvme.io/images/7hkVY1Y.mp4 Example]     • Mining quadrant (Fishing role) - [https://img.pvme.io/images/7hkVY1Y.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://img.pvme.io/images/ow1Xk41.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/ow1Xk41.mp4 Source video]

Example Kills

Video Examples
The example kills below consist of a Woodcutting & Fishing 1mid 6 alt.
Woodcutting
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3oznZFH6uA 3:58 1mid 6 alt]
Fishing

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dInQvgZaB5.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

​

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the mechanics and the general concept of Croesus. If not, please read [[PvME/Croesus/Croesus|Croesus]].

​

Duoing is faster than standard quad 2 mids due to only doing around 15% of the first energy fungus and not waiting for the second energy fungus. Kills doing this method should be sub-5:20.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=LfwibkU7GkrN79GslHLj Woodcutting / Hunter preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248186782699541.png?v=1 woodcutting] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248190649839667.png?v=1 hunter]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=fmmGaeuFAqCsZNp2wY8w Fishing / Mining preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109938540564.png?v=1 fishing] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1014248188770787390.png?v=1 mining]

​

Preset Notes

​

⬥ When Fishing/Mining, use 1 Gargoyle scroll per resource as it guarantees a resource per swing.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FfmmGaeuFAqCsZNp2wY8w.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Strategy

The Hunter & Woodcutter will always start the fight and starts at Hunt. Miner & Fisher starts at Mining. The Hunter should always have Extreme Hunter potion active whilst gathering.

​

Your optimal goal is to deplete both your nodes before going to the energy fungus; however, this won't always be possible due to luck. This is per player decision making. Go to the energy fungus when you feel like you should. It's not necessary to do the whole energy fungus - around 15% of it is sufficient.

​

⬥ Gather at Mining / Hunter until depleted and you have 15 materials, rot any excess and keep it with you

⬥ Go 1 quadrant anticlockwise and deposit the 15 materials into the statue

⬥ Start on that quadrant (Fishing / Woodcutting)

⬥ Gather until you have 20 rot and 15 materials with the node depleted. Use the dead guards if you must for the rot / materials

⬥ Poison the node

⬥ Go 1 quadrant clockwise back to your starting point and poison the node

⬥ Go 1 quadrant clockwise again and deposit the materials into the statue

⬥ Repair the statue

⬥ Pray on the statue but make sure you are both fully repaired and ready to before praying

⬥ Drink the relevant soup and attack the core. If it's Hunter drink an Extreme Hunter dose too, you can also 2-tick it

⬥ Be sure to click all the particles that are not red, even on Hunter if 2-ticking you just have to spam click it (the damage may not show up but it actually does do damage)

​

Example Kills

Video Examples
The example kills below consist of back to back duo kills.
Hunter & Woodcutting
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Vi6fEaXVFk 4:56 & 4:51 Hunter & Woodcutting]
Mining & Fishing
⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lvGD2XD4DXs 4:40 & 4:25 Mining & Fishing]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LdYq2RP.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Temple of Aminishi/ED1 Overview|ED1 Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6b5a1831-66c2-4082-ad68-5a9370195e00 Melee/Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F6b5a1831-66c2-4082-ad68-5a9370195e00.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ It is assumed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] is equipped for any mob clearing between bosses.

⬥ Camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] for the entire dungeon. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] is only used as a switch at the end on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430543321071626.png?v=1 seiryu] crystals.

⬥ This guide aims to achieve sub 6:00 timers with consistent Masuta water skips.

​

Wars

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight]

(optional: build 3+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] stacks before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] )

→ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] into Sanctum instance

​

Sanctum Guardian

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KCgIv13UAG.png Guide illustration]

Sanctum Guardian

​

Masuta Water Skip Explanation

⬥ Masuta phases to the timelocked Thrashing Waters special at 275k hp, and can no longer phase after 55k hp. The goal of this rotation is therefore to kill Masuta on the 'Persistent Hurricane' spin attack (the long special attack) so it cannot phase into the Thrashing Waters phase, saving one minute on the Masuta kill.

​

⬥ Masuta's attack pattern has a random number of auto attacks between specials, but the number of auto attacks follows a normal distribution, meaning you will generally encounter the following pattern:

​

⬥ 2-4 auto-attacks

⬥ Persistent Hurricane

⬥ 3-5 auto-attacks

⬥ Greater Shadow Tsunami

⬥ 3-5 auto-attacks

⬥ Repeats from Hurricane

​

Introduction

Masuta Water Skip Explanation

⬥ Masuta phases to the timelocked Thrashing Waters special at 275k hp, and can no longer phase after 55k hp. The goal of this rotation is therefore to kill Masuta on the 'Persistent Hurricane' spin attack (the long special attack) so it cannot phase into the Thrashing Waters phase, saving one minute on the Masuta kill.

​

⬥ Masuta's attack pattern has a random number of auto attacks between specials, but the number of auto attacks follows a normal distribution, meaning you will generally encounter the following pattern:

​

⬥ 2-4 auto-attacks

⬥ Persistent Hurricane

⬥ 3-5 auto-attacks

⬥ Greater Shadow Tsunami

⬥ 3-5 auto-attacks

⬥ Repeats from Hurricane

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EA7wP1w.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Dragonkin Laboratory/ED2 Overview|ED2 Basic]].

​

⬥ It's recommended to set your anti-spam delay for your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to 1 via the Lectern at Anachronia

⬥ You can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] a tick before each gate unlocks to save a tick on every entry

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 LotD] will not improve the number of energies dropped, nor the drop rate for any codex

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=T5h73UIw6BNPgSWI3YT2 Necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FT5h73UIw6BNPgSWI3YT2.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ IMPORTANT: Have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] on armour, or use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/895999229737185280.png?v=1 shadowsgrace]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142416978112417812.png?v=1 firstnecrohandwrap] is an optional swap when summoning conjures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] otherwise.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] are optional as a familiar swap if going for flightskip at [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542326759435.png?v=1 bsd]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Summon after killing black hands.

Phase 1 (opening rotation)

​

Phase 3 (flight-skip)

(Optional): [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] + Dismiss [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] + Summon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] + Fill it with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll]

​

Phase 4/5

If the flight skip is not obtained, build Necrosis stacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis], Residual Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and Adrenaline on the boss while it lands and kill it after its final flight.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EA7wP1w.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Dragonkin Laboratory/ED2 Overview|ED2 Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=e8a23587-a7fc-48bc-91ed-603a3f69ba83 Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fe8a23587-a7fc-48bc-91ed-603a3f69ba83.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ This guide assumes you're on a dragon cluster task

⬥ The sections between bosses can be loosely followed, but will still require you to improvise

​

Section 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

Fourth Hand

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

Black Stone Dragon

(TC BSD) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] + (3t) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/W5h47SR.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/The Shadow Reef/ED3 Overview|ED3 Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=30721de3-7b71-463e-995c-b90e22eea38f Melee-Magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F30721de3-7b71-463e-995c-b90e22eea38f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ Rotations below are more of suggestions to give an idea of AoE opportunities and ability prioritisation at different parts of the dungeon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you find yourself needing more abilities to clear mobs due factors such as the lack of adren or unlucky hits it is expected.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target cycling and using basics is a good way to check and finish off leftover mobs as sometimes their bodies take a while to disappear after dying.

⬥ Undead slayer tasks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] work on many of the mobs but is not required or needed for GM timer.

⬥ It's recommended to set your anti-spam delay for your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to 1 via the Lectern at Anachronia.

⬥ You can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] a tick before each gate unlocks to save a tick on every entry.

​

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Pre-Crassian

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] diagonally from entrance to start the dungeon and walk to lure the mobs together.

​

2 Scuttlers 2 Scouts

TC western scuttler [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → eastern scout [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile]

​

2 Scuttlers 3 Scouts

TC [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] while moving towards the edge → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

​

Note: generally have to wait for Scuttlers to move closer.

​

3 Warriors 2 Scouts

Target southwestern crassian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

​

2 Zealots

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

2 Zealots 2 Scouts

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] a zealot and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] to hit all 4 targets → wait 2t for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] procs to clean up and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

​

6 Zombies

Equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → stand in the middle of at least 5 zombies and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

6 Zombies

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] when they clump up

​

4 Zombies 1 Armoured zombie

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] + (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] (must hit 4 zombies) → target armoured zombie [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise]

​

2 Zealots

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti]

​

Crassian Leviathan

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hHWBVqywIK.png Guide illustration]

Wait 2t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1488133579614588948.png?v=1 rendgop] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → finish with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] procs in the previous room can generate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] stacks.

​

Post-Crassian to Pre-Taraket

After Crassian, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] until the next barrier.

​

Notes:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] not needed for timer.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1 bdmobile] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] → target scout + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile]

​

1 Zealot 4 Scuttlers

Target Zealots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

8 Zombies

Stand in the middle of the room and build with basics while waiting for zombies to converge, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

​

1 Necromancer 2 Huge Skeletons

Target Necromancer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 meleebasic] leftovers

​

1 Necromancer

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive]

​

3 Armoured Zombies

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike])

​

2 Necromancers

1st: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to artefact

2nd: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to artefact

Can activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] here

​

1 Necromancer 2 Sea Horrors [Bridge of Death]

Target Necromancer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → Target a Sea Horror [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

3 Sotapannas

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage])

​

2 Necromancers 2 Huge Skeletons

Target a Necromancer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478668630265958471.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → basics to cleanup if any

​

Taraket the Necromancer

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1qztt5mzjF.png Guide illustration]

Notes:

⬥ *Taraket, corpses, and skeletons are classified as undead for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] purposes.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally you ignore the Corpse Carrier and the Bloated Monstrosity.*

⬥ This is a skip rotation, camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku] for part 1, DO NOT USE [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]

​

Setup

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] +1t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti]

​

Note: goal is to have Taraket at 255-270k HP after setting up, and not fall below 200k after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] and first hit of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault]

​

Nuke

Equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → 2t r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1 bloodlust] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to next area

​

Note: entry timing is strict, if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] was tick perfect instead of 1t late, delay an additional 2t somewhere in setup.

​

Post-Taraket to Pre-Ambassador

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] towards Sea Witch after finishing Taraket.

​

1 Sea Witch 2 Armoured Zombies

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/W5h47SR.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

⬥ Rotations are written for each of the three ED3 bosses and the monsters in between. The rotations can be adapted as required.

​

⬥ Boss rotations assume you have the Invigorating 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1 invig4] and Impatient 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] perks on your armour.

​

⬥ It's recommended to set your anti-spam delay for your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to 1 via the Lectern at Anachronia.

​

⬥ You can Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] a tick before each gate unlocks to save a tick on every entry.

​

⬥ It is assumed that Darkness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] is used and reapplied where required to mitigate the damage taken.

​

⬥ It is assumed that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] is used to keep conjures alive as required depending on the speed of your clear (as such, this isn't always specified within the rotations).

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=orZ7YYqxdZsLgFPK9xlY Necromancy]

​

Preset Notes

​

⬥ Hand wrap of the First Necromancer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142416978112417812.png?v=1 firstnecrohandwrap] should only be worn when summoning conjures. Otherwise, Cinderbane Gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] should be used.

​

⬥ For optimal clear speeds and to help at Taraket, the Undead Slayer Perk, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk], Salve Amulet (e) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] and Undead Slayer Ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] should be utilised. Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] can also provide a damage buff while on an undead task, but this isn't recommended.

​

⬥ It's possible to bring Lucky Charms [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588938276874.png?v=1 ed3luckycharm] for some extra profit at the cost of Dungeoneering tokens.

​

⬥ Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] perk is a must have on gear.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, use Shadow's Grace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/895999229737185280.png?v=1 shadowsgrace].

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 LotD] Luck of the Dwarves will not improve the number of scales dropped.

​

⬥ This guide assumes that Kal'gerion Demon Scrolls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] are used, which can be set to autofire and will auto-renew as the buff expires.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2ForZ7YYqxdZsLgFPK9xlY.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Dungeon Walkthrough

​

⬥ Rotations below are more of suggestions to give an idea of AoE opportunities and ability prioritisation at different parts of the dungeon. If you find yourself needing more abilities to clear mobs, improvise accordingly.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target cycling and using basics is a good way to check and finish off leftover mobs as sometimes their bodies take awhile to disappear after dying.

​

⬥ You want to aim to reconjure with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] before the end of this phase.

​

Phase 3 - 650k-400k and Phase 4 (400k-0)

⬥ Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] is useful as you will not have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] available for the next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath]. Aim to use Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] with 10s left on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] cooldown.

​

⬥ If you have time before Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat], you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/oggG9IjOw6.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Ghrazi blood knights/Overview|Ghrazi Blood Knights]].

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fb16bAODe8.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Starting from the tile you spawn on when you enter the instance, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to reach the tile marked above.

⬥ Karmina tank forwards target cycle.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will get moved west or east of Karmina, it doesn't matter which way you get moved.

⬥ Vasily tank backwards target cycle.

⬥ You can use this Tilemarkers [https://runescape.wiki/w/Plugin plugin] preset to display the lure tile ingame.

TM2ARNHaHJhemkgS25pZ2h0cyBEZWNpAbg_wH0B28_h_6-mtIwCFAEETHVyZQ

​

Notes:

⬥ Other lures may work so long as there's two tiles between them.

⬥ The two tiles can be diagonal.

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/a4ac0f53-d82a-4c16-8713-7b7854a872f9/7x4/?v=b7addc6940f0e411a1a8712db1747bd3340981de65e56fde1be827322037857f Ranged-Melee Preset Example]

​

Rotations

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Phase 1-3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1554517443962081474.png?v=1 vampyreslayer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1560137984848691200.png?v=1 malachistooth] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot]

​

Heart

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] (flanking) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1 backhandflank] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1 backhandflank]

​

Phase 4-5

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1 enhreplen] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1554517443962081474.png?v=1 vampyreslayer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1560137984848691200.png?v=1 malachistooth] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

​

Notes:

⬥ Down can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] as soon as they come off cooldown and continue the rotation.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• I would keep an eye on the heart and how much health it has, if it's about 30% remaining it's fine, otherwise wait

⬥ Karmina tank forwards target cycle.

⬥ Vasily tank backwards target cycle.

​

Non-heart

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend]

​

Note: do this without moving Karmina, and hit a tumour.

​

Kill tumours with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → reapply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] on both bosses

​

Note: you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] the second one you kill but not after that as you need to make sure you don't accidentally use any abilities you use for P4-5.

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/BiMMKYNJ7LE 1:15.6]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/BiMMKYNJ7LE Embedded guide video]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/befXbfQX0n.png Guide illustration]

​

Melee Method [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Pre-fight

⬥ With War's Blessing 4: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] → adren crystal → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → adren crystal → enter portal

⬥ Without: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] → 120% adrenaline → enter portal

​

Outside instance

⬥ With War's Blessing 4: pass barrier → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → enter instance

⬥ Without: (tc) any faction npc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → pass barrier → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → enter instance

​

On spawn

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls])

​

HM Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]

​

Outside instance

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → enter

​

Inside instance

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] + enter → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] northeast + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

On spawn

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → improvise

​

After killing wights

(on 6th one) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → improvise

​

Notes:

⬥ Run far enough northeast so that your conjures don't get stuck at the portal.

⬥ Group wights to save time.
