[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fb0VtpIAFc.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kalphite King, which can be found in [[PvME/Kalphite King/Kalphite King — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]]

​

Being on a Kalphite slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is recommended as you gain the benefits of the Slayer Helm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]

​

This guide assumes no Green Shields happen, you may opt to teleport out if one happens early into the fight.

​

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=fhekIZ1Hli0uiCogPGTo Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FfhekIZ1Hli0uiCogPGTo.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Notes

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] Set the Autofire rate to 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] Is only used if running [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1 berserkersfury]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] Is only used if not running [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1 berserkersfury]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] Skips Green/Dig/Charge

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur] Is used to despawn conjures after every kill

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] Is used for better hit chance if not on task

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can skip on task

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] Rotation

Pre-build:

Get ~80% adrenaline → Enter portal

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] East → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to instance + enter

​

In the fight:

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fb0VtpIAFc.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kalphite King, which can be found in [[PvME/Kalphite King/Kalphite King — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]]

​

Being on a Kalphite Slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] for slayer helm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] is completely optional, but will result in slightly faster kills.

​

This guide assumes no green shields happen, but they are very rare and generally won't ruin kills.

​

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c6459333-cf59-48bf-a9c3-e5258185a5f8 Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fc6459333-cf59-48bf-a9c3-e5258185a5f8.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Notes

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] set the autofire rate to 1.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1 sirenicbody] switch has [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087864012840.png?v=1 ch4] to prevent stuns for almost the entire kill.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 spiritsticks] increase damage to help ensure the rotation ends consistently at 13.2-14.4 seconds.

⬥ Toss the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] 1-2 ticks before clicking on Kalphite King, otherwise Melee phase might null your click.

​

Rotation

Pre-build:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → Enter portal

Easier [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] build: Enter instance + drop [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154071998464.png?v=1 anticlearheaded] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] (at 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stacks)

​

Harder [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] build (more consistent): [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → Enter instance + drop [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154071998464.png?v=1 anticlearheaded] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] (at 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stacks)

In the fight:

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] 2t later) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

​

If you don't kill after the last [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot], finish with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] and improvise.

​

If you get Melee phase spawn, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] and using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] over the first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] is an option to help ensure a 13.2 second kill, but not necessary.

​

Post-fight building:

Target kalphite marauder + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot]

​

These [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] ensure you can both skip gaining adrenaline at crystal for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] and avoid the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] during the pre-build, saving both banking time and supplies. The harder [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] build also makes it harder to gain adrenaline from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] if you get a slower kill if you time [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] wrong.

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fb0VtpIAFc.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

The [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kalphite_King Kalphite King] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212971409866765.png?v=1 kalphiteking] is a powerful kalphite found within the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Exiled_Kalphite_Hive Exiled Kalphite Hive] just north of Menaphos. KK can use three combat styles, but he will only use one style at a time with a set attack rotation for each style. At any time throughout the fight, KK can randomly change attack style, starting a new attack rotation.

​

KK is a significant step up in difficulty in comparison to other mid-tier bosses, requiring close tracking of auto attacks and specs, and the use of specific abilites at certain times to dodge one-hit mechanics.

​

Being on a Kalphite slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is recommended as you gain the benefits of the Slayer Helm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]

​

Mechanics

Mechanics
Attack Rotation
⬥ Ranged Phase: 2 Autos → Stun → 2 Autos → Green → 2 Autos → Dig → Repeat ⬥ Melee Phase: 2 Autos → Push → 2 Autos → Charge → 2 Autos → Green → Repeat ⬥ Mage Phase: 4 Autos → Dig → 2 Autos → Charge → Repeat ​
Greens (Beetlejuice)
⬥ Kalphite King stuns and binds the tank for 8 seconds, leaving them unable to do anything. He then deals a melee attack that can hit up to 32k damage. Greens only happen during ranged and melee phase. [https://img.pvme.io/images/XX7mCy9.mp4 Example]     • Ranged phase: the Green can be skipped via stunning KK at the right time.     • Melee phase: you cannot skip the Green, instead you must utilise the Bladed Dive technique discussed later. ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/XX7mCy9.mp4 Source video]
Green Shield (random)
⬥ Kalphite King heals 75% of all damage dealt by players. [https://img.pvme.io/images/HzN16w4.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/HzN16w4.mp4 Source video]
Red Shield (random)
⬥ Kalphite King heals 100% of all damage dealt to players. [https://img.pvme.io/images/9dSKMqO.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/9dSKMqO.mp4 Source video]
Digs
⬥ Kalphite King becomes unattackable and digs under the ground for 10 seconds, it then appears under the player it last targeted, dealing up to 5k damage if not avoided. Digs only happen on ranged and magic phase. [https://img.pvme.io/images/pvgMnLU.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/pvgMnLU.mp4 Source video]
Charges
⬥ Kalphite King becomes unattackable and charges towards a wall, players who fail to avoid the space between the charging boss and wall will be hit up to 4k damage. Charges only happen on melee and magic phase. [https://img.pvme.io/images/VXwsTOU.mp4 Example] ​ [https://img.pvme.io/images/VXwsTOU.mp4 Source video]
Minions
⬥ Kalphite King spawns minions when it reaches 195k (1 wave) and 65k HP (2 waves). All players within a 3 tile radius of KK will be stunned for one second before the minions appear. Minions spawning will also cause KK to skip whatever attack he would have done next, including special attacks. [https://img.pvme.io/images/MU1A7WL.mp4 Example] [https://img.pvme.io/images/MU1A7WL.mp4 Source video]

​

Kalphite King Attack Pattern

[https://img.pvme.io/images/oXYt0ZL.png Guide illustration]

​

Player Stun Timings

Stunning KK at the right time is essential, allowing you skip certain mechanics that either waste time (charge & dig) or result in a death/failed kill (Green).

​

Ranged Phase: Skips Green

2 Autos → Stun → 2 Autos → Your Stun → 2 Autos → Dig → Repeat

​

Melee Phase: Skips Charge

2 Autos → Push → 2 Autos → Your Stun → 2 Autos → Green → Repeat

​

Mage Phase: Skips Dig

4 Autos → Your Stun → 2 Autos → Charge → Repeat

​

Step-by-step Bladed Dive Guide

Don’t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] during ranged phase. Always skip green with a stun. If you use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] remember to cancel after 1 GCD.

⬥ Melee charge happens or is skipped.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If learning, not skipping charge is recommended so you can learn how to get an accurate count on attacks.

⬥ Count 2 KK autos.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equip shield or defender if you are learning. Can be done after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] when more experienced.

⬥ Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom]

⬥ Let the boss green you

⬥ Queue [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] and aim away from walls and minions

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Never [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] through KK

⬥ Look at the stun timer

⬥ As the timer drops from 4 to 3 seconds, click the Bladed Dive spot

⬥ Quickly equip shield or defender if not already equipped

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] (Only [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] if there are no minions)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/61XGHbW.mp4 Source media]

Note: If you get greened solo, you can spam Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] and a teleport to avoid death.

​

Strategies and Tips

General

⬥ Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] before and Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] at the start of every kill.

⬥ Never stun outside of proper stun timings.

⬥ Stay close to the tank during digs but not in the surface radius.

⬥ Run with the boss during charges.

⬥ Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] at the start of Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] phases, use the other defensive when your first runs out.

⬥ Don’t stand directly between KK and a wall during melee or mage phase or you will be hit up to 5k.

​

Melee Form [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack]

⬥ Use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] on melee phase only after you receive both bleeds. If you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] a Dismember [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] before you get Slaughtered [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1 slaughter] be prepared to take hefty damage, especially if you get pushed.

​

Ranged Form [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ The amount of times you get hit by the standard attack while the Incendiary Shot icon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] is on your buff bar is the amount of times you will be hit by the Incendiary Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend].

⬥ If you get a stun with the Incendiary Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1 incend] after green, don’t freedom. Either wait until the stun clears and GBarge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] to KK when he surfaces or GBarge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] to minions to clear and then Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] back to KK.

​

Magic Form [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

⬥ Use Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] during the first 4 autos of this phase so you can continue to attack the boss without moving.

⬥ Anticipate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] during charge.

⬥ Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the blue ball.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Usually happens the attack after charge if you forget how to count.

​

What you must avoid

General

⬥ Never use Smoke Tendrils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 Smoke_Tendrils], Unload [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258664411169.png?v=1 unload], or Frenzy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879279554581.png?v=1 frenzy].

⬥ Attack minions at a time where the Kalphite King is still attackable.

⬥ Never stun outside of proper stun timings. If you do you could cause:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early greens.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early charges.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early digs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skipped attacks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A sped-up attack rotation.

⬥ Never stun during a Green. If you do you could cause:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple greens.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early digs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple digs.

⬥ Never Destroy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] for longer than 1 GCD or stun immediately after a dig or charge. If you do you could cause:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early greens.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple greens.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early digs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Infinite digs.

​

Ranged Form [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Never use Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] during the middle of a ranged phase rotation. Wait for the cycle to reset after dig.

​

Magic Form [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

⬥ Never use Berserk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] during mage phase unless the boss spawns in form.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kerapac which can be seen here [[PvME/Kerapac/Kerapac HM Overview|Kerapac HM Basic]] and own BIS gear in Necromancy.

​

It is recommended to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] as the genocidal boost does work with Necromancy. You may also use the premier Artefact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/918517285176623104.png?v=1 premierartefact] to have a 10% chance to not decrease.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Uc4x8Rydn8KpB1tIYHFk Necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FUc4x8Rydn8KpB1tIYHFk.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Checklist and Unlocks
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] Flanking 4 switch ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 eofblack] EoF with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] Genocidal perk if on-task ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 lantasticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 spiritsticks] Incense sticks running

Additional Notes

One person should do each of these rotations to avoid overlapping [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] & redundant casts of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

​

Prebuild

​

Note: one person [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] the other should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

​

​

Solo Clone (N or S)

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + jump into clone → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] (wait 1t) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

​

Shared Clone (W)

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to west clone to bounce skulls → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Kerapac

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac] (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Note: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] as soon as possible on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac] usually after first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

​

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Kerapac/Kerapac HM Overview|Kerapac HM Basic]].

​

This method aims to consistently hit sub-1:40 kill times.

​

It is not required to have a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Nodon_dragonkin_slayer_assignment Nodon dragonkin] slayer assignment for this method to work, but it will improve your consistency with the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_helmet_stand Slayer helmet stand] boost [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=43ecd334-cee0-436f-af4b-5588ff47381f Magic-Melee Hybrid][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Notes:

⬥ At the bank, activate/apply:

Phase 4

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Kerapac/Kerapac HM Overview|Kerapac HM Basic]].

​

It is highly recommended to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] as the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] helmet boost does work.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=041d38d5-1566-4f4e-9fa1-35db24ba99ac Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F041d38d5-1566-4f4e-9fa1-35db24ba99ac.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ Rotation requires [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4]

⬥ Rotation works off-task and on-task, but requires minor changes

⬥ Expected kills times between 1:40s to 1:50s, 1:40s to 1:43s on-task

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On-task can get high 1:30s with good RNG

​

Note: if on-task, P1-3 is similar but P4 on Kerapac is very RNG, it's easier to just [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] at the end.

​

Pre-fight

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Phase 1

Start fight with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → (tc) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → walk under [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → 2 or 3 hit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] to hit 110k → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

Prephase

Defensive → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] (if 2 hit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] you wait for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry])

​

Note: can swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] around, minimal difference, on-task you want to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] first.

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1488133579614588948.png?v=1 rendgop] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter] → walk under [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1 massacre] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842595639306.png?v=1 jawsoftheabyss] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1488133579614588948.png?v=1 rendgop] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → improvise

​

Note: if on-task, the second [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] isn't needed.

​

Phase 3

Rotation not as set in stone here because [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088204013640.png?v=1 imp4] / adrenaline before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] can all change which abilities you use

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] (1t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] (last tick of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

Note: if off-task leave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189297659940904.png?v=1 vestmentsofhavochood] on ideally until ~115+ adrenaline and take off one ability before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp]

​

Phase 4

Clone 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] click clone → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to 2nd clone

Clone 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] (3t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] click 3rd clone and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] again

Clone 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Kerapac

​

Note: if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] runs out here you might need one extra ability, but it shouldn't run out here.

Kerapac

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] if not dead use one more ability (will happen if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] runs out)

​

Notes:

⬥ To save 1 GCD on clone 2 you need 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] proc or 5+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] and replace the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

⬥ On clone 3 you instead use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] as the 3rd ability.

⬥ This means you need to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] on clone 3 as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] won't be off CD to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Kerapac, or s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] and release with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i6lX00K8IR0 Off-task] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/HwQnUq_U3Oc Off-task (fast clones)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Dt3neHFfkEM On-task] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/fZFK5JJGZ90 On-task (sub 1:40s)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

It is highly recommended to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] as the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] helmet boost does work.

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kerapac which can be seen here [[PvME/Kerapac/Kerapac HM Overview|Kerapac HM Basic]] and own BIS gear in Necromancy.

​

It is required to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] as the genocidal boost does work with Necromancy. You may also use the Premier Artefact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/918517285176623104.png?v=1 premierartefact] to have a 10% chance to not decrease the slayer task count with each kill.

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=QpaFNZ40x5eE0dExdBPR Necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FQpaFNZ40x5eE0dExdBPR.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Additional Info

⬥ 3%+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal], Nodon dragonkin task required, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] switch

⬥ Drinking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1 spiritualprayer] through the kill is required for this method to work, ideally 4-5

⬥ There will be some RNG involved in this strategy due to low [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] proc rates on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] adrenaline gain during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp]

Pre-fight (Wars Retreat)

Get 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] at wars, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] and 4+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]

​

Pre-fight (Boss Arena)

join instance → drop combat → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → wait 1t + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Phase 1

tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 vuln] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → step under + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] → basics if not phased

​

Phase 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] + 1t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + step under → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → basics till phased, ensure 4-5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] by the start of p3

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] if you can skip jumps p1 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] + 1t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] + step under → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] → unequip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern], re-equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern] + ‎ ‎equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142416978112417812.png?v=1 firstnecrohandwrap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → basics if not phased

​

Phase 4

Echo 1: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] + enter echo → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] → ‎ ‎walk 2 tiles SE + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to echo 2

Echo 2: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → basic for 100 adren if needed, otherwise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] + 1t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to echo 3

Echo 3: may need more abilities if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] does not bounce

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to kerapac

Kerapac: use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] to maximise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] damage

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

Notes

Phase 1

⬥ If you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] you can skip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]

⬥ see !0tick on how to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] without losing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]

⬥ If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] is available, use it while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac] immune and get 100 adren for instant [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ On kills with 0 jumps, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] will not be up. if you have adren from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] procs you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac] is immune for extra damage

​

Phase 2

⬥ You can opt to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4]; [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] after step under for some consistent damage, but it is not required.

⬥ If no [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] adren, end [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] ends

​

Phase 3

​

⬥ Try not to skip jump p3 as you cant [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] if Kerapac is not in attack range

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kerapac which can be seen here [[PvME/Kerapac/Kerapac HM Overview|Kerapac HM Basic]] and own BIS gear in Ranged.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a7fe1641-aa2c-46ee-879b-c248b550cc5d Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fa7fe1641-aa2c-46ee-879b-c248b550cc5d.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Requirements

The rotations may not work as well as intended if any of the following are missing:

⬥ Nodon Dragonkin slayer task

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 spiritsticks]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] on anachronia stand.

Overview

⬥ This rotation is capable of getting the grandmaster time of <2:15.0

⬥ Do not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] on the same tick.

⬥ Have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] active for a smoother P4.

Rotation

War's Retreat

s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]

Phase 1

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

Phase 2

r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

Phase 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] + 2t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Phase 4

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] each clone.

⬥ Have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] active for the first 2 clones, then pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage]

​

Clone 1

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

Clone 2

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] + 2t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1 timewarp] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

Clone 3

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

Kerapac

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EHBFVhLaE2.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

When Nex spawns for the first time in an instance she will be praying [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] for the majority of the kill, making Ranged the meta for fast consistent kills. After every kill you will teleport out of the instance and re-enter in order to force Nex to always be praying [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage].

​

Note: It is strongly advised to complete the Ritual of the Mahjarrat quest in order to get access to the Stone of Jas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost] boost, which gives a +5% damage boost in GWD1 (including Nex). This can be done via Fairy ring code D.K.Q.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=271ab9d3-3a6f-4c5f-bc03-e3fadd435b2e Ranged Nex (BoLG)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F271ab9d3-3a6f-4c5f-bc03-e3fadd435b2e.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] should be combo'd with either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1 ultimatums4]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1 as1] is not recommended with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] here as it can proc on the Umbra phase transition and null the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] hit.

Due to this, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800924942396.png?v=1 ruthless1] is recommended instead.

Rotation

Pre-Fight

Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect]

(6.0s) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154071998464.png?v=1 anticlearheaded]

Smoke Phase

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + 7 hit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

Fumus

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

Shadow Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] if not phased

Umbra

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

Blood Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]

Cruor

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot]

Ice Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot]

Glacies

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

Zaros Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

Positioning

⬥ Movement for most of the phases can be seen in the example kill linked below, the only transition where different positioning yields better results is Blood → Ice.
Blood → Ice
⬥ [https://i.gyazo.com/1809d6f0e2cc636442fd9673a25e994d.mp4 Example] [https://i.gyazo.com/1809d6f0e2cc636442fd9673a25e994d.mp4 Source video]
Alternate Blood → Ice
⬥ [https://i.gyazo.com/4b95ab751478b2e5d41385f6a184cf8f.mp4 Example] [https://i.gyazo.com/4b95ab751478b2e5d41385f6a184cf8f.mp4 Source video]
Perfect Blood → Ice
⬥ [https://i.gyazo.com/ec1807b815601c7867562f08fb090110.mp4 Example] [https://i.gyazo.com/ec1807b815601c7867562f08fb090110.mp4 Source video]

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bEpImft0S3M Kill Example] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EHBFVhLaE2.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in ⁠[[PvME/Nex/Overview|Nex Basic]].

​

When Nex spawns for the first time in a custom instance, she will be praying Deflect Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] for the majority of the kill. This is why Ranged-only kills are the meta for fast consistent kills.

​

Note: the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ritual_of_the_Mahjarrat Ritual of the Mahjarrat] quest gives access to the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) Stone of Jas] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost] boost which gives a 5% damage boost in GWD1 (including Nex). It can be reached via fairy ring code D.K.Q. ‎or master quest cape option 5.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=57ad5549-0627-4b0d-98d6-331313a6a09a Melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F57ad5549-0627-4b0d-98d6-331313a6a09a.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ Make sure to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost] boost.

⬥ Keep scripture turned off until Umbra so you don't kill before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar]

​

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

Start + Smoke Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] when Nex calls Cruor → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] after the green projectile from Glacies enters Nex → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + (tc) Fumus

Fumus

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]

​

Shadow Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] click Umbra

Umbra

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar]

​

Blood Phase

s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + (tc) Cruor

Cruor

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1 massacre] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → run a couple tiles towards Glacies then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti]

​

Ice Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Glacies

Glacies

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842595639306.png?v=1 jawsoftheabyss] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]

​

Zaros Phase

If Nex uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee], can swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust], or just wait it out

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1488133579614588948.png?v=1 rendgop] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1 massacre] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] and basics

​

Note: can throw another [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] but not really needed.

​

Phase Notes

Blood Phase Notes

⬥ Make sure you don't have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] or 100% [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] that accidentally phases Nex.

Ice Phase Notes

⬥ If you get caught in an Ice Prison use Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert], optionally also use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

Zaros Phase Notes

⬥ Nex cycles her overhead curses every 3 auto attacks during Zaros Phase, following this rotation: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] → no overhead curse

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] may be used if you are low on food.

⬥ If Nex ends her Ice Phase with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage], there is a chance it will carry over to Zaros Phase. She may also switch to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] during Zaros phase, improvise accordingly.

⬥ When Nex uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee], there is a chance your attacks will be reflected back at you if you hit her.

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/0lmw46TOdCk 1:18.6, 1:15.6, and 1:15 examples]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0lmw46TOdCk Embedded guide video]

​
