[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/EHBFVhLaE2.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

This guide is meant to hit the in-game master Combat Achievement for speed at solo Nex. Boss mechanics can be found in the Nex basic guide.

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=CCLGb0GsoU7oEaTO7VvJ Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] is perked with Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] and is used for Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

⬥ Deathdealer robe bottom is perked with Clear Headed 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087864012840.png?v=1 ch4]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost] from Glacor Cave is required

⬥ Has only been tested with the T100 upgrade from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1 shardofgenesisessence] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] and may be inconsistent without

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fill with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] as needed [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FCCLGb0GsoU7oEaTO7VvJ.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotation

Pre-fight

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] + walk to middle-south → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → (at around 6s) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783488257429504.png?v=1 dealerlegs80] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1206664822654115911.png?v=1 firstnecrorobebottom] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

Smoke Phase

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] + walk 1 tile north-east of Nex → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Fumus

Note: stalling crackling between kills can help make this phase more consistent.

​

Fumus

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → walk towards nex for skull bounce

Note: you are aiming to have skulls bounce onto Fumus and then back to Nex.

Shadow Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] if not 120k + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Umbra

Note: The (tc) timing is when [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] kills Fumus as this will then tag Nex with a hit of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] . This allows the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] to not be nulled.

​

Umbra

​

(tc) Umbra + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap]

Blood Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath]

​

Note: Move towards Cruor during this phase.

​

Cruor

​

(tc) Cruor + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] if not dead

​

Notes:

⬥ If you do not get a darkness skip, ensure you are attacked 3 times to start the Ice phase on Nex's 'Contain this!' special attack.

⬥ Position Nex near Cruor if possible so that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] spreads to her when Cruor dies.

Ice Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Glacies

​

Glacies

​

(tc) Glacies + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626714879218155521.png?v=1 bbc] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] if not dead

Zaros Phase

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → improv

​

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=KC4ZRVh0Ei6hsKxzoZUP Necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FKC4ZRVh0Ei6hsKxzoZUP.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/84XEYnJq1T.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Raksha/Overview|Raksha Basic]].

​

Method 1

Use this method if you have War's Blessing 4 unlocked.

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6f6b6ce6-520d-41fd-a2fd-f83a2d25668f Ranged - Method 1] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F6f6b6ce6-520d-41fd-a2fd-f83a2d25668f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

This rotation averages 1:04 - 1:10 kill times.

⬥ Stalling [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] is optional.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] throughout the fight.

​

War's

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → Adren crystal to 110% → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to portal → enter instance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → wait 2t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows]

Phase 2

Phase 4

Method 2

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mNg7ZjfeBP.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Orikalka has 190,000 LP, across a single fight phase

⬥ Orikalka primarily attacks with Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], with some Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] attacks

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=rex%20matriarchs Rex Matriarchs guides] [[PvME/Rex Matriarchs/AFK Orikalka|AFK Orikalka]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a9149f4d-fbbb-4cb8-87c7-da567c880499 Example Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fa9149f4d-fbbb-4cb8-87c7-da567c880499.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

⬥ Stay aware of nearby Matriarchs when moving, as only 3/4 Matriarchs share the main arena

⬥ You should attack with Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fire spells [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543465116092334083.png?v=1 firesurge] give a +27% hit chance boost

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any other style will only deal insignificant damage

​

Attack Rotation

3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → Frost Storm → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → Pyroclastic Shock →

3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → Pyroclastic Shock → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → 2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → Pyroclastic Shock →

2x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → Pyroclastic Shock → 3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → Pyroclastic Shock → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] →

Repeat

​

Auto Attacks ([https://img.pvme.io/images/n77pITX1Ix.mp4 Melee example] / [https://img.pvme.io/images/n77pITX1Ix.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/ua9uchPcaZ.mp4 Magic example])[https://img.pvme.io/images/ua9uchPcaZ.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Orikalka uses Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto attacks.

​

Solution:

⬥ If lower Defence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] pray against Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1 protectfrommelee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] once you are comfortable surviving the mechanics

​

Frost Storm / Frostbite [https://img.pvme.io/images/icvqcL0erz.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/icvqcL0erz.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Orikalka spins in place, dealing up to 4500 Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage and applying Frostbite.

While Frostbite is active, your global cooldown is doubled for 30 seconds. This makes your abilities feel much slower and lowers your damage.

​

Solution:

⬥ If Frost Storm deals too much damage, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1 protectfrommagic] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

⬥ If you get Frostbite, either:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep fighting with abilities which don't care about the global cooldown (e.g., channels [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] or damage-over-time abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clear it using the fissures from Pyroclastic Shock (see below)

​

Pyroclastic Shock / Fissures [https://img.pvme.io/images/fxCDXAXY4V.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/fxCDXAXY4V.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Orikalka slams its tail, creating 3 fissures on the ground. Standing on a fissure deals rapid Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] damage, with the final hit dealing up to 6000 damage.

​

Solution:

⬥ Avoid the fissures unless you are attempting to clear Frostbite (see above solution under Frost Storm)

​

Helpful videos

⬥ [https://youtu.be/dkEBjqd_zOw Example kills with Revo++]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zOznCIoC2V.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Osseous has 350,000 LP, across a single fight phase.

⬥ Osseous is immune to Ranged, Melee and Magic damage.

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=rex%20matriarchs Rex Matriarchs guides] [[PvME/Rex Matriarchs/AFK Osseous|AFK Osseous]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d50b1a3c-f1f3-4fb0-8f48-43f548f10f64 Example Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd50b1a3c-f1f3-4fb0-8f48-43f548f10f64.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

Avoid using Darkness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] at Osseous as it will often negate your defensive abilities, for example using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] on a big hit to heal you may not work.

​

Attack Rotation

2x auto → 1x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] → 1x auto → Minion Summon →

3x auto → 1x Minion Launch → 2x auto > Osseous’ Roar →

2x auto → Munch > 1x auto →

Repeat

​

Auto Attacks

Mechanic: Osseous attacks primarily with Necromancy damage, with some Ranged attacks.

Solution:

⬥ If camping prayers, use a Necromancy protection prayer ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1 deflectnecromancy] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941136397324448.png?v=1 protectfromnecro])

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] once you are comfortable surviving mechanics

​

Minion Summon [https://img.pvme.io/images/QGYxu2jdtk.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/QGYxu2jdtk.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Osseous slams the ground, dealing heavy melee damage and summoning baby skeletons that can heal her.

Solution:

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to heal from the melee hit

⬥ If Resonance is unavailable, pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1 protectfrommelee] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]

⬥ Alternatively, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] can be used to reduce damage

⬥ Ignore the skeletons initially and prepare for the next mechanic

​

Minion Launch [https://img.pvme.io/images/YJ6LKwQinf.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/YJ6LKwQinf.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Osseous throws minions at you, stunning you and spawning additional skeletons.

Solution:

⬥ Stay targeted on Osseous

⬥ Clear the skeletons using any of these approaches:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] (after the stun)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Three casts of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe]

⬥ Target and kill any remaining skeletons to prevent explosion damage

​

Osseous’ Roar [https://img.pvme.io/images/Hti5nPqCgd.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/Hti5nPqCgd.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: You are pulled into melee distance and bound in place.

Solution:

⬥ Ensure all skeletons are cleared before this mechanic

⬥ Prepare defensives if damage overlaps with other mechanics

​

Munch [https://img.pvme.io/images/txcpikDFS4.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/txcpikDFS4.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Osseous binds you and prepares a high-damage bite attack.

Solution:

⬥ Deal damage to fill the bar above Osseous

⬥ Use any damage-negating defensive, like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] to completely block

​

Helpful videos

⬥ [https://youtu.be/_itR-4abuAo Example kill]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hr19MkjkaT.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Pthentraken has 190,000 LP, across a single fight phase

⬥ Pthentraken primarily attacks with Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], with some Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] attacks

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=rex%20matriarchs Rex Matriarchs guides] [[PvME/Rex Matriarchs/Low Effort Pthentraken|Low Effort Pthentraken]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=f42b63a2-7262-41e3-a740-780f54ee8add Example Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Ff42b63a2-7262-41e3-a740-780f54ee8add.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

⬥Stay on the east-side of Pthentraken to avoid pulling Orikalka's aggression

⬥ You should attack with Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arrows give a +27% hit chance boost

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any other style will only deal insignificant damage

​

Attack Rotation

3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → Converging Lightning → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] → Storm Column →

3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → Converging Lightning → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] →

Repeat

​

Auto Attacks ([https://img.pvme.io/images/ubFr4GP6Je.mp4 Magic example] / [https://img.pvme.io/images/ubFr4GP6Je.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/NVUYvi752x.mp4 Ranged example])[https://img.pvme.io/images/NVUYvi752x.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Pthentraken uses Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] and Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] auto attacks.

​

Solution:

⬥ If lower Defence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] pray against Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1 protectfrommagic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] once you are comfortable surviving the mechanics

​

Converging Lightning [https://img.pvme.io/images/rW2FSiGUoG.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/rW2FSiGUoG.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Pthentraken summons 3-5 lightning beams around the arena. These beams move towards Pthentraken and deal heavy Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage if you stand in them (up to 5000-5500 damage every 2 ticks).

​

Solution:

⬥ Either:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wear Insulated boots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588876279819.png?v=1 insulatedboots] to reduce damage taken

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Avoid standing in the lightning beams as they move towards Pthentraken

​

Storm Column / Overcharged [https://img.pvme.io/images/3EeRovZD36.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/3EeRovZD36.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: An overhead bar appears above the player. When the bar empties, a 3x3 Storm Column appears on the player's tile, dealing rapidly increasing typeless damage, up to 3600 damage every 2 ticks. It also gives the Overcharged buff.

​

While Overcharged is active, your hits on Pthentraken deal an additional Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] hit for 5% of the original damage, and Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] has a 1-tick cooldown.

​

Solution:

⬥ Move away from the Storm Column as soon as it appears, like in the example video

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moving too early may make the Storm Column appear at your new location

​

Helpful videos

⬥ [https://youtu.be/N0Epoh-4oco Example Pthentraken kills]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/14YLWftEeI.png Guide illustration] ​

General Information

⬥ Rathis has 190,000 LP, across a single fight phase

⬥ Rathis attacks with Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]

​

Other guides: [https://pvme.io/guides/?q=rex%20matriarchs Rex Matriarchs guides] [[PvME/Rex Matriarchs/AFK Rathis|AFK Rathis]]

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

⬥ Stab weapons are recommended for a +27% hit chance boost

⬥ Use Elder Overload Salve [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], the Venomblood perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] or Super Antipoison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588884406272.png?v=1 superantipoison] to reduce poison damage

[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3bff65d4-55ad-401d-b23c-70d50230353d Example Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3bff65d4-55ad-401d-b23c-70d50230353d.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Fight Mechanics

⬥ You should attack with Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any other style will only deal insignificant damage

Attack Rotation

3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] → Acid Bombardment → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] →

5x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] → Poison Absorption →

3x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] → 5x [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] →

Repeat

​

Auto Attacks ([https://img.pvme.io/images/VpJQA2o7i9.mp4 Ranged example] / [https://img.pvme.io/images/VpJQA2o7i9.mp4 Source video][https://img.pvme.io/images/JC2ZIPyPYv.mp4 Melee example])[https://img.pvme.io/images/JC2ZIPyPYv.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Rathis uses Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] auto attacks. If you are outside melee distance, the melee attack becomes a charge instead.

​

Solution:

⬥ Stay in melee distance unless moving briefly to dodge poison

⬥ If low Defence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 defence] level, pray against Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551455078367313.png?v=1 protectfrommissiles]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] once you are comfortable surviving the mechanics

​

Charge [https://img.pvme.io/images/RGB4lLK499.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/RGB4lLK499.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: If you move out of melee distance, Rathis can charge at you, stunning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] you and dealing heavy typeless damage.

​

Solution:

⬥ Stand in melee distance of Rathis

⬥ If moving (e.g., to dodge acid pools, move back into melee distance quickly to avoid the charge

​

Acid Bombardment [https://img.pvme.io/images/Kyo7hSa0SR.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/Kyo7hSa0SR.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Rathis launches two acid orbs, with one aimed at the player. Each orb deals up to 3500 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] damage when it lands and leaves behind a Poison Pit.

​

Poison Pits are large green pools that remain in the arena until Rathis uses Poison Absorption. Standing in them deals poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] damage every tick and applies Corrosion, increasing all damage taken by 20% per stack, up to 100%.

​

Poison Pits shrink when stood in, going from 5x5 → 3x3 → 2x2 → 1x1.

​

Solution:

⬥ If avoiding them:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step away from the landing tiles as the orbs arrive

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move only as much as needed, then return to melee distance

​

⬥ If shrinking them:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep Elder Overload Salve [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], Venomblood [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] or Super Antipoison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588884406272.png?v=1 superantipoison] active to reduce poison damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Briefly stand in Poison Pits to shrink them before Poison Absorption

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Avoid building too many Corrosion stacks, as this makes all incoming damage more dangerous

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not risk dying just to shrink every pool

​

Poison Absorption [https://img.pvme.io/images/ihohKA14Pr.mp4 (Example)][https://img.pvme.io/images/ihohKA14Pr.mp4 Source video]

Mechanic: Rathis absorbs any remaining Poison Pits, healing based on their size (you will see Uber Heal ‎appear over Rathis). A full-size Poison Pit can heal Rathis for up to 35,000 LP.

​

Solution:

⬥ This mechanic rewards you for shrinking Poison Pits during Acid Bombardment

⬥ Continue the kill as normal, but expect it to take longer

​

Helpful videos

⬥ [https://youtu.be/BUcpASUPjNk Example kills with Revo++]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/k1pBa3wBhP.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

⬥ The Rex Matriarchs are four dinosaur bosses found on Anachronia

⬥ Each Matriarch has its own attack style, weakness and mechanics

⬥ While the Matriarchs share a boss instance, only 3/4 share an arena

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Osseous' arena is accessed via teleportation device near the entrance, only after completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Osseous_Rex_quest Osseous Rex quest]

​

The 4 Matriarchs

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010873376868.png?v=1 orikalka] Orikalka

⬥ Primarily attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Vulnerable to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (+27% hit chance with fire spells)

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264011049566238.png?v=1 rathis] Rathis

⬥ Primarily attacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/k1pBa3wBhP.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide covers active strategies and rotations for the Rex Matriarchs. There are two main strategies:

​

  1. Hybrid killing multiple Matriarchs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Higher KPH at the cost of significantly higher effort

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only applies to Rathis/Orikalka/Pthentraken (Osseous has a separate arena)

​

  1. Camping a single Matriarch

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Simpler and uses only 1 combat style at the cost of lower KPH

​

Strategy 1: Hybrid killing multiple Matriarchs

Alternate between a pair of Matriarchs to minimise wasted time during respawns. It is suggested to follow the rotations listed for each boss in the below section Strategy 2: Camping a single Matriarch.

​

Top tips:

⬥ If killing Rathis, you can target Rathis from range while moving towards her, and use defensives to build 100% adrenaline for your opening [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://youtu.be/PfhJG00n61s (example)]

⬥ If killing Rathis/Pthentraken, ensure you travel at the edge of the arena to prevent aggression from Orikalka

​

Hybrid Presets

Perked hybrid armour such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513204700980576266.png?v=1 SliskeBody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556592073042821122.png?v=1 AnimalegsSliske] can be used, but will reduce KPH

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=j9LSOzS9FecS0eY1hoCh Orikalka/Pthentraken Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ZkjU34SQqrS98xoJbvDr Orikalka/Rathis Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=GNdGZ7K1XMXRgrpMrBkU Rathis/Pthentraken Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

​

​

Strategy 2: Camping a single Matriarch

​

Single Matriarch Presets

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=qhBiUaM4XYwtCTOgntLZ Orikalka]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=nRMSdlne9qU1egI9Bb1o Rathis]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=O067jI2g4XQ5T8ii10cF Pthentraken]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=HgySggpatAWYi8yf9zB0 Osseous]

​

Orikalka [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010873376868.png?v=1 orikalka]

⬥ Proper use of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1 temporalanomaly] means your rotations will be varied

⬥ Keep Orikalka entangled [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489526534154.png?v=1 sbsstandards] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] to avoid Frostbite

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get Frostbite, be prepared to move away from the fissures and prioritise channeled abilities and stuns like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

​

Example Rotation

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489526534154.png?v=1 SBSStandards] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 tsunamiincite] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → improv

​

Rathis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Stand in melee distance to avoid Rathis charging and stunning you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon]

⬥ Alternate between EZK [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] rotations

​

Rotation A

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] + (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → (bleed) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → dodge Acid Bombs + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → improv → (tc) Orikalka + stall/use 3x abilities for 100% adren → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba]

​

Rotation B

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → (bleed) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → dodge Acid Bombs + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → improv

​

Pthentraken [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ If you are using BIS gear and/or Imbue Shadows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] is not consistently ready at the start of kills, you should follow the guide in Referenced guide unavailable in this snapshot

⬥ If Imbue Shadows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] is consistently ready at the start of kills, you should follow the rotation below

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ensure you re-equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/970657245312467004.png?v=1 necklaceofsalamancy] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Example Rotation

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → improv

​

Osseous [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1521806141250732153.png?v=1 osseoushead]

⬥ Due to banking times, this method only increases KPH marginally over the AFK method listed in [[PvME/Rex Matriarchs/AFK Osseous|AFK Osseous]]

⬥ Teleport to War's Retreat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 warsretreatteleport] after each kill to reset cooldowns

​

Pre-spawn

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

On spawn

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/boe0MAWJIW.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

RotS is generally done in a team size of 2 but can be done with up to 4 while learning. The fight takes place in a split arena where the team is split into pairs. Each side will have 3 brothers, the order of which changes everyday. However you will spend more time running through tunnels than you will actually fighting the brothers, which is why it is important to be proficient at both dps rotations and movement.

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage] is a very crucial part of RotS, as this relic allows you to start every kill at full adrenaline.

⬥ At RotS the meta is to AoE the brothers down as fast as possible. Most of the meta and strategy revolves around stacking and luring the brothers so that they can be killed at the same time.

⬥ With the rotations provided the kills that are lurable should all be either 5.4 seconds or lower.

​

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Rise of the Six/Overview|Rise Of The Six Basic]].

​

Useful Unlocks

⬥ Double [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] unlocked is crucial for high kph. They are important in exiting tunnels efficiently.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipment with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] perk should also be used for this purpose.

⬥ Equipment with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] for a flat 7% and 15% (for 10 seconds) respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm] work against the brothers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead slayer task lowered to make use to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fort Forinthry Guardhouse fully upgraded.

​

The Fight/Strategy

In larger teams both players stand on the same square (DD or death dot) and don’t move unless necessary. Both the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1 Incite] and DPS pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and may opt to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989442220484616242.png?v=1 soullink] to split both the damage taken and health healed between the two players.

​

Positioning

The brothers starting positions change everyday, hence your starting position will also change. On each side, three brothers spawn on three separate squares, spawning alphabetically going from North to South (A North, Z South). They will then aggro onto players, and the melee brothers will run to the players. Because the goal is to stack all brothers in AoE radius, the strategy is generally to stand next to Ahrim or Karil and let the melee brothers run to you and stack on top of, or next to Ahrim or Karil.

​

Because AoE and stacking brothers is the most important part of getting efficient and fast kills, the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1 Incite] should move as little as possible or else you risk messing up the stack. When you need to move is determined by the daily rotation because each brother does different special attacks. Internalize the special attacks below then you can formulate your own plan of when to move based on the daily rotation. For instance, if it’s ADG, you would only move from the starting spot if:

​

⬥ Karil drops a bomb that could damage you or your partner.

⬥ Dharok or Guthan do a melee spin on your side.

⬥ Ahrim specs and becomes unattackable, at which point you should run the brothers to stop taking damage.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=UCJZ9T8Se54mm98Qsd1O Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7b6beea2-829b-4f5c-b0f8-41fc0919c6e6 Melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F7b6beea2-829b-4f5c-b0f8-41fc0919c6e6.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

You are required to have these buffs for this rotation to work:

⬥ Undead Slayer ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] and Undead Slayer perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]

⬥ Undead Slayer task (reduced to 1) alongside Genocidal perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Task will not deplete

⬥ Fort Forinthry Guardhouse Slayer Upgrades

⬥ Ghost Hunter Helm, Backpack, Legs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893829476352.png?v=1 ghosthunterbag] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893854511144.png?v=1 ghosthunterlegs] and Salve Amulet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]

⬥ Equilibrium perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/tG2tDPHFQ5.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Stand on the tiles shown above.

​

Duo

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] in the tunnel

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] + dialogue start → (btc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

Notes:

⬥ Do not stall anything, just let it run you to the most northern brother and naturally use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and on gcd use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

⬥ Btc means backwards target cycle

⬥ You have be on the following brother rotation for this to work with 2 players using melee:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• West: Ahrim, Dharok and Guthan

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• East: Karil, Torag and Verac

​

Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

Duo

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + enter barrier → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → start

​

Karil side

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Ahrim side

s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

For easier/learning kills both sides may opt to do a no stall rotation (slightly slower):

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

4-Man

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Example Videos

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pbo_l9IU2jw Embedded guide video]

Note: the example is pre-Combat Style Modernisation, but it's the exact same except [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] is replaced with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/boe0MAWJIW.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes you understand the basics of combat, equipment, and the RotS fight, including mechanics as explained in [[PvME/Rise of the Six/Overview|Rise Of The Six Basic]].

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage] is a very crucial part of RotS, this relic allows you to start every kill at full adrenaline without [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]

⬥ At RotS the meta is to AoE the brothers down as fast as possible

⬥ Most of the meta and strategy revolve around stacking and luring the brothers so that they can be killed at the same time

​

Useful Unlocks

⬥ Double [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] unlocked is crucial for high kph

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipment with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] should also be used for this purpose

⬥ Equipment with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] for a flat 7% and 15% (for 10 seconds) respectively

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both the perk and sigil work against the brothers

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take note that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm] do now work against the brothers

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7b6beea2-829b-4f5c-b0f8-41fc0919c6e6 Melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=IK4CADWSd1foOoS2yixr Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=eb9f68f1-02bb-47d6-8376-78b1c3a53094 Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F7b6beea2-829b-4f5c-b0f8-41fc0919c6e6.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Note: may use [https://runescape.wiki/w/Delver%27s_anklet delver's anklet] if having issues with run energy

​

Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/rPkClq0aEz.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Solo should be consistently ~30 seconds if done correctly.

⬥ At 24 seconds you will get a message that says "As there is no-one on one side of the shadow portal, it empowers the brothers to destroy everyone!"

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once this happens you can then kill the brothers on the side you start at

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will hop over and be targetable at 27 seconds

⬥ You are required to have these buffs for this rotation to work:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead Slayer ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] and Undead Slayer perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead Slayer task (reduced to 1) alongside Genocidal perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Task will not deplete

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fort Forinthry Guardhouse Slayer Upgrades

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ghost Hunter Helm, Backpack, Legs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893829476352.png?v=1 ghosthunterbag] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893854511144.png?v=1 ghosthunterlegs] and Salve Amulet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equilibrium perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4]

​

Rotation

~12s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → wait for 100% [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → wait for 70% + run to spot + (btc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

Notes:

⬥ Do not stall anything, just let it run you to the northernmost brother and release the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and on global cooldown use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

⬥ Btc means backwards target cycle

⬥ You must be on the following brother rotation:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• West Side: Dharok, Guthan and Verac

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• East Side: Ahrim, Karil and Torag

​

Necromancy

⬥ Solo should be consistently sub 33.6 seconds if done correctly.

⬥ You wear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] before the hop so you don't overkill the brothers with the rotation.

⬥ At 24 seconds you will get a message that says "As there is no-one on one side of the shadow portal, it empowers the brothers to destroy everyone!"

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once this happens you can then kill the brothers on the side you start at

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will hop over and be targetable at 27 seconds

⬥ You should never start on the side in which Karil is on as he will delay the kill significantly

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The ideal brother rotation is: West - Ahrim, Guthan, Verac. East - Karil, Dharok, Torag

⬥ Whilst waiting the 24 seconds you need to get 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks

​

Rotation

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] in room beforehand

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + start + (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] + run north of Ahrim → target Ahrim + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1 spectralscythe2] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + wear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893829476352.png?v=1 ghosthunterbag] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

​

Ranged

[https://img.pvme.io/images/T5CHgOwkrq.png Guide illustration] Note: lure Ahrim to the blue tile by running to one of the two purple tiles, then stand on the red tile around when you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] and target Ahrim just before you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe]

​

⬥ Solo should be consistently ~30 seconds if done correctly

⬥ At 24 seconds you will get a message that says "As there is no-one on one side of the shadow portal, it empowers the brothers to destroy everyone!"

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once this happens you can then kill the brothers on the side you start at

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will hop over and be targetable at 27 seconds

⬥ You are required to have these buffs for this rotation to work:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead Slayer ability [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] and Undead Slayer perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead Slayer task (reduced to 1) alongside Genocidal perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Task will not deplete

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fort Forinthry Guardhouse Slayer Upgrades

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ghost Hunter Helm, Backpack, Legs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893829476352.png?v=1 ghosthunterbag] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893854511144.png?v=1 ghosthunterlegs] and Salve Amulet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equilibrium perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] and Ultimatums perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1 ultimatums4]

​

Rotation

(btc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eofu] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1 rangedbasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → 2t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] + target Ahrim + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]

​

Notes:

⬥ You will need to target cycle twice before you target Ahrim for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe]

⬥ Btc means backwards target cycle

⬥ You must be on the following brother rotation:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• West Side: Ahrim, Guthan, and Verac

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• East Side: Dharok, Karil and Torag

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/_brjjJuKV4U Melee]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Zt_V_5dTKo Necromancy]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/BKnzFMla_tg Ranged]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6SFXGZ90Rz.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

The Sanctum of Rebirth is a boss dungeon set in the Underworld. Formerly owned by Amascut, three soul devourer bosses can be fought after completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Searching Soul Searching] miniquest. This guide focuses on the boss's rotations and mechanics for the Hard Mode version. Only in Hard Mode is the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Genesis_Essence Shard of Genesis Essence] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1 shardofgenesisessence] dropped that upgrades Tier 95 weapons to Tier 100.

​

Vermyx, Brood Mother

[https://img.pvme.io/images/jaS1tXIXjM.png Guide illustration]

​

Auto-attacks

⬥ Vermyx uses both [https://img.pvme.io/images/C31eiH1xcj.mp4 Melee] [https://img.pvme.io/images/C31eiH1xcj.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and [https://img.pvme.io/images/yDjvHTmoY8.mp4 Ranged] [https://img.pvme.io/images/yDjvHTmoY8.mp4 Source video][https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] auto-attacks, while Coilspawns only attack with Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto-attacks cause 2% armour break per successful hit

⬥ Every auto-attack Vermyx's adren bar fills by 50%, starting a new mechanic when full.

⬥ Starts at 4 Brood Mother Bond stacks in HM

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 15% extra damage dealt by Vermyx per coilspawn alive

⬥ You can flank [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] by standing right next to Vermyx's head.

​

Vermyx Rotation

Phase 1 (start: 600k/player)

3 autos →

Moonstone Shards → 2 autos → Wyrmfire + 2 autos → repeat

​

Phase 2 (start: 450k/player)

3 autos →

Moonstone shards → 2 autos → Soul Bomb → 1 auto + bomb hit (in that order) → 1 auto → Wyrmfire → 8 autos + Scarab Healer → Moonstone Shards

​

Phase 3 (start: 300k/player)

3 autos → Scarab Healer (+ autos continue) → 3 autos → Moonstone shards → 2 autos → Soul Bomb → 1 auto + bomb hit (in that order) → 1 auto → Wyrmfire → 7 autos + Scarab Healer → Wyrmfire

​

Vermyx Mechanics

Moonstone shards

Vermyx will shout Snaaaarl! ‎then the following pop-up will appear: Shards of moonstone mark your feet. Prepare to move! ‎sprouting moonstone shards (10.5k LP)

⬥ Three appear per player

⬥ Hits 4k typeless if not evaded

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Binds, stuns, and disables protection prayers for 2 seconds

⬥ Next shard location is aimed 1t after former (1-2 squares away)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blocks movement, line-of-sight, and persists through the remainder of the fight unless killed

⬥ To deal with this mechanic, move out of the way of the light blue sections which will appear underneath you

[https://img.pvme.io/images/L7ucraCzQO.mp4 Source media]

​

Soul Rush

⬥ Vermyx will shout Rarghh! ‎then the following popup will appear: Vermyx channels power from the Sanctum towards the west/east.​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green arrows will appear to indicate where to stand to redirect the soul: it will always be 3 souls per player), and the west side will always be first

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These appear 1.2 seconds faster in HM.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Directly after redirecting the souls, Vermyx reappears and the next phase starts.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shortly after the third set of green arrows appear, that section of the room gets Wyrmfire. An example of this mechanic can be seen [https://img.pvme.io/images/KS7S2YftJk.mp4 here][https://img.pvme.io/images/KS7S2YftJk.mp4 Source video]

⬥ To deal with this mechanic, focus on redirecting souls by standing between the green arrows

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Coilspawns will respawn once per side if you kill them and the phase will keep repeating until [https://img.pvme.io/images/egjbOb6Z5w.png 3 souls are redirected] (3 per player per phase)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing the Coilspawn will speed up the redirecting souls for the next rotation.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Sm2yDvZCdG.mp4 Source media]

​

Wyrmfire

Vermyx stops auto-attacking and any of the heads can start using AoE breath attacks.

⬥ West and East Coilspawn use a breath attack that goes across the middle of the arena.

⬥ Vermyx, NW Coilspawn, and NE Coilspawn use a 19x19 AoE breath attack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Soul Rush, Wyrmfire is guaranteed and only in:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://img.pvme.io/images/KS7S2YftJk.mp4 Northwest] (phase 1-2)[https://img.pvme.io/images/KS7S2YftJk.mp4 Source video]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://img.pvme.io/images/aiq08Q48Mi.mp4 Northeast] (phase 2-3)[https://img.pvme.io/images/aiq08Q48Mi.mp4 Source video]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not after Soul Rush, all alive heads including Vermyx will Wyrmfire in an unknown order

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xkICDlIRJY.mp4 Source media]

​

Corrupted Scarab Healer

Vermyx will say Heaaall… ‎and a corrupted Scarab Healer (15k LP) will spawn on the outer edge of the arena, making its way to Vermyx

⬥ One per player

⬥ Stun to damage it

⬥ The spawn does not delay Vermyx's autos

⬥ Heals Vermyx by double its remaining LP when its overhead bar is full

[https://img.pvme.io/images/9BViB5bz2L.mp4 Source media]

​

Soul Bomb

Vermyx will shout Kreeee! ‎and the following pop-up will appear: Vermyx fires a Soul bomb. Ready yourself!​

⬥ Vermyx will point her head up and fire two 8k soft typeless targeted hits per player, telegraphed on the ground.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These target the ground and will hit anything in a 3x3 area.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To deal with this mechanic: move out of the way of the light blue sections which will appear underneath you

[https://img.pvme.io/images/9cDGUDXTi5.mp4 Source media]

​

Kezalam, the Wanderer

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Td120qtp1z.png Guide illustration]

​

*⬥ Uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] autos

⬥ Can be stunned (delays rotation)*

​

Kezalam Rotation

⬥ Every auto-attack gives it 25% adren, at 100% she uses her next mechanic. Adren carries over between phases.

Phase 1 (start: 900k/player)

Note: Kezalam starts at 100% adren.

SB-Scattered → Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → SB-Targeted → SB-Scattered → Unstable Scarabs → SB-Targeted → repeat

​

Phase 2 (start: 600k/player)

Note: First P2 mechanic is based on last P1 mechanic.

Kill Moonstone Obelisk →

SB-Line → SB-Targeted → Unstable Scarabs → SB-Line → SB-Targeted → Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → repeat

​

Phase 3 (start: 300k/player)

Note: First P3 mechanic is based on last P2 mechanic.

Kill Moonstone Obelisk →

Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → SB-Line → SB-Scattered → Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → SB-Line → SB-Targeted → repeat

​

Kezalam Mechanics

Sanctum Blast - Scattered

Kezalam shouts Dhaaarken ‎and the Sanctum blasts the floor in a wide area.

⬥ Always spawn under whoever holds aggro and is based on their location

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There are safespots for this mechanic

[https://img.pvme.io/images/p57xqyhi2p.mp4 Source media]

​

Sanctum Blast - Targeted

Kezalam shouts and the Sanctum blasts the floor three times in a row.

⬥ sections always appear under whoever holds aggro, based on their location. They appear back-to-back-to-back

⬥ Graaah ‎= sections under her, Kezalam spins

⬥ Kyaaa ‎= sections surround her, Kezalam crouches

⬥ Hrrrr ‎= sections far out, Kezalam crouches

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals soft typeless damage (5-7k)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ba7cwLBSy5.png Guide illustration] Kyaaa (left), Graaah (middle), Hrrrr (right)

​

Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb

Each player is stunned and imprisoned in moonstone shards (10.5k LP), with a Soul Bomb descending on them.

⬥ Soul Bomb hits 9k soft typeless in a 3x3 area if not away

⬥ Blocks movement, line-of-sight, and persists during the remainder of the fight

​

Unstable Scarabs

Kezalam summons scarabs Erggg... ‎into the arena.

⬥ Volatile scarab akhs (3k LP), two per player.

⬥ Stun to damage

⬥ Explode when overhead bar is full, dealing 6-7k soft typeless damage to all players.

​

Sanctum Blast - Line

Kezalam shouts Paiiin ‎and the Sanctum blasts a line on the arena towards the player

⬥ Every player gets one, in order

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1lcLVSvIBf.png Guide illustration] Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb (upper-left), Unstable Scarabs (upper-right), and SB-Line (bottom)

​

Moonstone Obelisk and Wave

When you reach the phase HP, the Moonstone Obelisks at the edges become damageable (90k LP per player)

⬥ Each obelisk up heals Kez 9k LP every 3 seconds

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moonstone obelisks face outward and can be flanked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] easily.

⬥ If failed to destroy after 25s (40t), the obelisks becomes invulnerable again and Kezalam retaliates

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Soulfire Wave goes back and forth over the arena. This wave is not telegraphed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deals 8k soft typeless damage. Can be safespotted behind the obelisk

⬥ In groups you can skip the P2-3 transition by killing both Moonstone Obelisks in the P1-2 transition.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Obelisks need to be killed at roughly the same time (~1 GCD) for this to work

[https://img.pvme.io/images/CNAUnABCQQ.mp4 Source media]

​

Nakatra, Devourer Eternal

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VB3iwFqYtA.png Guide illustration] ​

*⬥ HM starts at 200 corruptive stacks, that increase her typed damage (autos, waves, obliterate)

⬥ Switches between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos after each set

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each auto gives 33% adren

⬥ Nakatra uses a mechanic every time her adren bar is full. In phase 3 and 4 however, mechanics are mostly time-based*

​

Nakatra Rotation

​

Phase 1 (start: 1200k/player)

Nakatra says I am afraid this is where your story ends.​

2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos → Soulfire Wave → 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] autos →

​

Obliterate → 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] autos → Soulfire Wave → 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] autos → Soulfire Wave + Summon Scarabs → 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] auto → Soulfire Wave → 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] autos → repeat

​

Phase 2 (start: 960k/player)

Nakatra says The sanctum is mine to control.​

2 sections →

​

3 autos → Obliterate → Soulfire Wave → 3 autos → 2 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → 3 autos → Soulfire Wave + Summon Scarabs → 3 autos → 2 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → repeat

​

Phase 3 (start: 480k/player)

Nakatra says The Sanctum will protect me while I only grow stronger.​

Summon Nefthys +

Soulfire Crosswave → Soulfire Wave → Soulfire Crosswave → Soulfire Wave → Heal Nefthys → repeat

​

Phase 4 (start: 480k/player)

After the last Nefthys dies, Nakatra shouts Suffer the full power of the Sanctum!​

Shadowsands → 3 autos + Sanctum Shockwave → Obliterate → 3 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → Soulfire Wave → 3 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → repeat

​

Nakatra Mechanics

Obliterate

Nakatra says Prepare for death… ‎& Be obliterated! ‎before blasting you three times with a ramping [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] hit.

⬥ How to deal with it:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage-forward option: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 reprisal] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] the second hit. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] is riskier

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Y7CzDkN4sS.mp4 Source media]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] method example [https://youtu.be/G9Nf8pPd8bQ?t=1565 here]

​

Soulfire Wave

Nakatra says The soulfire erases all. ‎and two soulfire waves will run over the arena in bands (West-East or South-North), dealing magic damage.

⬥ Position yourself between the two wave edges to step out of the way.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, you can [https://youtu.be/Q7BAS0xSvbw run] (or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] ) through them

⬥ This mechanic has 50% defensive penetration (excl. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo])

​

Summon Scarabs

Two scarabs can be summoned during a Soulfire Wave mechanic.

⬥ Stun to damage.

⬥ Volatile scarab akh (3k LP)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stationary

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Explodes when overhead bar is full, dealing 6-7k typeless damage

⬥ Corrupted scarab healer (15k LP)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moves towards Nakatra

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Heals her by double its remaining LP when its overhead bar is full

when overhead bar is full

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WYhCcEMaz6.mp4 Source media]

Soulfire Waves and Summon Scarabs

​

Sanctum Hieroglyphs

Nakatra shouts Feel the power beneath your feet! ‎or Face judgement foul wretch. ‎and she divides the arena in 3x3 sections, of which 3-8 sections are about to be blasted.

⬥ Locations are foretold by one of sixteen hieroglyphs on sides of the arena, up high. Picture them as they fall face down onto the arena. The sections that are safe are highlighted. See [https://img.pvme.io/images/cQUSEsZ3Hr.png here] for an overview of hieroglyphs and how they apply to the arena.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First: west wall hieroglyph

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Second: east wall hieroglyph

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Third: north wall hieroglyph (P4 only)

​

⬥ How to handle: Stand as shown in the picture. Northeast and Southwest are the best corners for Phases 1-2, Southwest corner is the best for phase 4. Stand on purple (other in the image) ready to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]. When the mechanic starts:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One of the adjacent four red sections (42/48 chance) is safe to move onto, or

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The section diagonally across (6/48 chance) is safe: use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] from purple to reach the other side. keep attacking Nakatra so you face her again

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Repeat as necessary.

⬥ If you don't get hit, your mobility ability's ( [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] ) cooldowns is reset

⬥ Hits up to 8k hard typeless damage through defences, putting them on cooldown.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fdcq47Yuzl.png Guide illustration] ​

Summon Nefthys

[https://img.pvme.io/images/C3YD1odWuK.png Guide illustration] At the start of phase 3, Nakatra shouts Nefthys!; summons Nefthys, the Split Soul (90k LP); and becomes immune to all damage.

⬥ Two are summoned per player, at 75% adren.

⬥ Deals melee damage in halberd-distance

⬥ When you move out of halberd-distance Nefthys howls (blue bar fills up) he takes reduced damage, go halberd-distance to stop it and reset the bar.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When the blue bar is full, Nakatra gains +50 stacks (line: RAAR!)

⬥ When their adren bar is full, the next attack disables protection prayers.

​

Heal Nefthys

Nakatra says Be healed! ‎or Nefthys, be retored. ‎and heals all Nefthys at once for 45k LP.

⬥ This occurs roughly every 22 seconds.

​

Soulfire Crosswave

Nakatra blasts the arena with an eight-pointed Soulfire crosswave from the centre while Nefthys are alive.

⬥ Nefthys and star wave [https://youtu.be/DhCuBYnVC4Q?t=660 video example]

​

Shadowsands Devour

When all Nefthys are dead, Nakatra shouts Suffer the full power of the Sanctum! ‎& The Devourer will consume you soul!, and you get dragged to the Shadowsands. Leave within 30 seconds or you get hard instakilled [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill]

⬥ Release the Soul Storm in MD ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] for the gorillas)

⬥ Kill the Shadowsands feline akh (22.5k LP, 2/player in solo)

⬥ Remember the two shown hieroglyphs next to the Devourer

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These are personal

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Four hieroglyphs if it's the fourth time being devoured

⬥ Recover the three soul fragments to go back

​

Back outside, Nakatra says Impossible... ‎or WHAT ARE YOU ‎& Your death is inevitable. ‎Prepare for the incoming barrage.

⬥ Nakatra takes reduced damage for ~10 seconds and gains +50 stacks

⬥ How to handle: Step on the hieroglyph that was not shown in the shadowsands to block the barrage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is personal: Group members might have a different location!

⬥ If failed: The barrage deals heavy typeless and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage every 0.6 seconds for 1.8 seconds. Nakatra gains +10 stacks for each barrage hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• How to handle: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] only reduces damage)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wPvwi9WPG9.png Guide illustration] All possible shadowsands hieroglyphs

⬥ [https://youtu.be/DhCuBYnVC4Q?t=710 Video example of phase 4]

​

Sanctum Shockwave

As Nakatra shouts You cannot stop me!, concentric shockwaves spread from under her to the arena's edge.

⬥ This happens twice back-to-back

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will also get 3 autos during this mechanic.

⬥ Each blast comes in four consecutive hard typeless hits: 4-3-3-3 squares, measured from Nakatra to the edge

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Breaks through defences and puts them on cooldown.

⬥ How to handle, two ways:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/3BkZgA2Lut.mp4 Source media]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] method (more forgiving)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/BKKuoNp0LM.mp4 Source media]

Tilestep method (staying in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] range)

​

Further Notes:

⬥ Nakatra deals a lot of high damage that (partially) ignore defensives. When learning, it might be helpful to use forms of damage mitigation that do work:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Death ward relic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1 deathward]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Aegis aura [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1204128299241177148.png?v=1 aegis]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hellhound familiar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spirit shields [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148977577059430461.png?v=1 spectralspiritshield] as an emergency swap

⬥ P2 Scarab healers can heal Nakatra on P3. This 30k LP can be removed again to reach the cap HP.

⬥ P3 Nakatra is briefly fully damageable (~2 GCDs) after killing the last Nefthys, the moment her adren bar is full again.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One can try to prephase with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] to make P4 faster.

⬥ Shadowsands gorilla akh do not need to be killed, but if killed they do not reappear.

​

Example Kill

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sBn_8_Nduak HM Sanctum Movement Guide]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DhCuBYnVC4Q Hard Mode Talk Through] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DhCuBYnVC4Q Embedded guide video]
