​

Phase 3:

Charge pad #1 + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] (if available) → build to 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] at 4s timer → ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy]

Solak down → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank]

Charge pad #2 (preferably <500k lp Solak) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → build 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] (voiceline: give me the life...) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] (if available) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → Solak down → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] repeats depending on lp → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat]

​

Elf:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → build 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] +100% adren.

​

Notes Phase 3:

⬥ Can fit in 4 abilities as Solak goes down before you go elf.

⬥ after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] ‎ ‎use a rot such as ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] to utilise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave]

⬥ If high lp: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] if 4+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] to finish.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] < 35s upon exit.

​

Phase 4:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] (optional: build 100% adren + 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]).

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] target Solak + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] and adren

​

If 100% adren early:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → (damageable) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

If <100% adren:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → (damageable) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → build for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] if not dead.

​

If ≤3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul]:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → (damageable) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] → repeat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1 soulstrikeflank] till < 60k lp → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Video Example

[https://youtu.be/oCev3AnBwFE Solo Solak GM Necromancy example]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gmrKIcfK2P.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

⬥ This strategy successfully rootskips 75-80% of the time if executed properly.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A successful rootskip is done by getting Solak's HP down to ~1510K or lower at ~45s.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you don't meet this threshold it's advised to ignore the rootskip attempt entirely.

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=25a476eb-10a4-4706-b6d7-93b0b140f77e Melee/Mage]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F25a476eb-10a4-4706-b6d7-93b0b140f77e.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Prefight

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

​

On [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]

r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

​

Phase 1

​

r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → 8t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud]

​

Stand adjacent to arms. Arm 1 is the furthest arm from the player

Arm 1:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063258555650159.png?v=1 sunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath])

Arm 2:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1 magicbasic] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm])

Legs:

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1 magmatemptest] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] → 8t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

Core:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → 8t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath])

​

Phase 2

​

Eruption 1:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → farcast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] on Eruption 2 → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend]

Eruption 3:

4t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise]

Eruption 4:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Solak:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → 3t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → 8t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

On [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063258555650159.png?v=1 sunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

​

Phase 3

​

Solak:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → 8t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1 legatusemberstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

​

Realm:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → 8t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish])

​

Phase 4

​

On [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

​

Solak:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] → s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes a very strong understanding of everything found in [[PvME/Telos/Overview|Telos Basic]], [[PvME/Telos/Telos — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]] and [[PvME/Telos/Telos — P5 Movement And Timing|P5 Movement And Timing]].

​

The rotations listed below are ideally used at 1000%+ enrage. However, they will generally work at lower enrage as well, and it is encouraged to learn these rotations as early as possible to build good habits and muscle memory.

​

Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes (999+)

⬥ 1000% P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, immortality no longer works P5, and Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown

⬥ 2000% "So you think you can guard?" Achievement, aka Silver Warden

⬥ 2700% Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000

⬥ 3300% The first prayer drain on P3 will smite you from full unless Telos touches the beam.

⬥ 4000% Hard enrage cap; "True Warden" achievement, aka Gold Warden

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes a very strong understanding of everything found in [[PvME/Telos/Overview|Telos Basic]], [[PvME/Telos/Telos — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]] and [[PvME/Telos/Telos — P5 Movement And Timing|P5 Movement And Timing]].

​

This guide assumes 250%+ and works best at 1000%+, but these rotations still work below 250% with some tweaks. Adjust accordingly from there - below 250%, these rotations can be loosely followed but after that, you definitely want to make sure you follow them.

​

Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes past 999%

⬥ 1000%: P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, immortality no longer works P5, and Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown

⬥ 2000%: "So you think you can guard?" Achievement, aka Silver Warden

⬥ 2700%: Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000

⬥ 3300%: The first prayer drain on P3 will smite you from full unless Telos touches the beam

⬥ 4000%: Hard enrage cap; "The True Warden" Achievement, aka Gold Warden

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=b99608b2-8131-4629-b155-256445e36415 Melee Telos] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fb99608b2-8131-4629-b155-256445e36415.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This guide assumes very strong understanding of [[PvME/Telos/Overview|Telos Basic]] and [[PvME/Telos/Telos — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]]. The rotations listed below are ideally used at 1000%+ enrage. However, they will generally work at a lower enrage as well, and it is encouraged to learn these rotations as early as possible to build good habits and muscle memory. The [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1 equilibrium] safe push setup is slower but it will allow for a safer experience whilst climbing enrage and streaking, while the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1 equilibrium] fast 2449 farming setup may be used for fast kills while farming this encounter.

​

Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes (999+)

⬥ 1000% P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, immortality no longer works P5, and Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown

⬥ 2000% "So you think you can guard?" Achievement, aka Silver Warden

⬥ 2700% Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000

⬥ 3300% The first prayer drain on P3 will smite you from full unless Telos touches the beam.

⬥ 4000% Hard enrage cap; "True Warden" achievement, aka Gold Warden

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=FNRVoyCSDDRe5kLTrbNz Equilibrium Necromancy Safe Push Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=fnoGMlYMutXfmU4gA5Y8 Equilibrium Necromancy Fast 2449 Farming Preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FfnoGMlYMutXfmU4gA5Y8.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Genesis_Essence Tier 100 weapons] ( [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1 shardofgenesisessence] ) are needed for the listed rotation to consistently work. Minor improvisation in p1 is needed otherwise. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] to compensate on accuracy if owned.
General Notes
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783488257429504.png?v=1 dealerlegs80] switch ( [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102900937460285470.png?v=1 clearheaded] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1 turtling4] )     •Will make most players lose [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] . In this case, swap Death Ward with Shadows Grace. ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1 zemouregalsnexus] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1 malletops] perk for extra [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] duration. ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 spiritsticks], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 lantasticks] incense sticks used at bank.
Safe Preset
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1 underworldgrimoire4] > Underworld Grimoire 3 > any INACTIVE scripture for stat bonus [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1 scriptureofjas] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut] ⬥ Do not swap out [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] , as it can ruin phasing & rotation consistency.

​

Equilibrium Safe Push Rotation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1 equilibrium]

Prefight

⬥ Optional: to reduce P1-2 RNG pushing up from 3000% → 4000%, you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289319964763.png?v=1 staffoflight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] at adrenaline crystal.

​

Dummy at War's Retreat: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] (should end on 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul]) → enter instance.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → (wait 2t) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Phase 1

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This quick reference aims to address two common pain points for aspiring Telosers in P5:

⬥ Understanding the timing for targeting Telos and starting your rotation

⬥ Learning how to efficiently move into, and switch between beams

​

Start Timing

Visual Cue

During the P5 cutscene, fonts will execute a brief "shifting" animation. The tick after this animation is the first tick that Telos can be target-cycled ("tc"). This animation + 1t delay will serve as the starting point for the opening rotation, for example:

​

⬥ (font shift) → (wait 1t) → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

⬥ (font shift) → (wait 1t) → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → (wait 2t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul]

⬥ (font shift) → (wait 1t) → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

⬥ (font shift) → (wait 1t) → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → (wait 2t) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

​

Notes:

⬥ Make sure your target cycle maximum distance is set to 9**

⬥ These example starting rotations may be out of date - check the respective guides

​

Sample Clip with Input Tracking

Note: the icon immediately preceding [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] in this clip represents target cycle.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/RsWkHMC5kF.gif Guide illustration]

​

Movement & Positioning

Overview

There is no "one right way" to move efficiently in P5. The player can experiment with each method and find what works best for them. The primary goals are to:

​

⬥ Move into the initial green beam spawn efficiently so as to maximize adrenaline gain

⬥ Switch beams efficiently, either as part of moving into the green beam, or at a later time in order to acquire a buff or clear a virus [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/853191856350560266.png?v=1 redvirus] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/853191856182657064.png?v=1 greenvirus] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/853191855856287746.png?v=1 blackvirus]

​

Positioning & Movement Inputs

In order to move well throughout P5, it's important to first have a basic understanding of positioning, and how it affects what movement abilities you can use. To keep it simple, always aim to be 1 to 3 tiles away from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos].

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/CQ3FacXvjQ.png Guide illustration]

​

Side Beam Switching

If you are in a side beam, and you are 1 to 3 tiles away, you can:

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] directly into the opposing side beam ([https://youtu.be/z3_azrtzXm0 demo])

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + walk or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] into back beam ([https://youtu.be/mJXEZznIBUw demo])

​

Note: if you are using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] diagonally though [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos] from a side beam as part of your movement strategy, it is important to click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos] first while in the beam. This will force your character to face him and ensure you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] the right way.

​

Back Beam Switching

If you are in back beam, and you are 1 to 2 tiles away, you can:

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] directly into either side beam ([https://youtu.be/MP4z0bUPPK0?si=4BfaWB3AwrEaooKH demo])

​

If you are in back beam, and you are 3 tiles away, you can:

​

⬥ Take 1 step diagonally → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] directly into either side beam ([https://youtu.be/f11Jjp_TYKk demo])

​

​

General Approach to Beam Entry

Entering the initial green beam spawn efficiently is key. The beam's position is random, so the player has to adapt accordingly. As mentioned earlier, there is no "one right way"; however, most players follow one of these two approaches - experiment with what feels best.

​

Option A: Run Towards Left Beam

⬥ On first actionable tick, start running towards the left beam spawn while casting abilities

⬥ As beams spawn, note which one is green, and adapt accordingly:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If left beam, simply continue to run into position

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If back beam, enter left beam position, then use the above strategies to switch beams from left → back ([https://youtu.be/hEDHrJ3sLrU demo])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If right beam, either:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Click above & right of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos], wait until character rounds the corner, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + walk north → click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos] next tick to stop perfectly in beam ([https://youtu.be/nFjiKdA_guQ demo])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Or, enter left beam position, then use the above strategies to switch beams from left → right

​

[https://youtu.be/ec3LEQIVa1s https://youtu.be/ec3LEQIVa1s]

​

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ec3LEQIVa1s Embedded guide video]

Option B: Surge to Centre

⬥ Cast opening ability and wait specified time as per rotation (e.g. 2 ticks), then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] directly towards the centre of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos]

⬥ As beams spawn, note which one is green, and adapt accordingly:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If left or right beam, simply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] into position ([https://youtu.be/ReXIiJVFpNM?si=ZJRmX2cyrCwa_cF2&t=361 demo])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If back beam, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] into side beam position, then use the above strategies to switch beams from side → back

​

​

Introduction

This guide assumes a very strong understanding of everything found in [[PvME/Telos/Overview|Telos Basic]], [[PvME/Telos/Telos — Stuns And Mechanics|Stuns And Mechanics]] and [[PvME/Telos/Telos — P5 Movement And Timing|P5 Movement And Timing]].

​

Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes (999+)

⬥ 1000% P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort] no longer works P5, and Telos will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown

⬥ 2000% "So you think you can guard?" Achievement, aka Silver Warden

⬥ 2700% Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000

⬥ 3300% The first prayer drain on P3 smites you from full unless Telos touches the beam

⬥ 4000% Hard enrage cap; "True Warden" achievement, aka Gold Warden

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] as font hurts you → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1 telos] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrows]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

Stunning Telos takes some getting used to, but with enough practice and knowledge you can greatly enhance your performance from higher survivability to longer window of time to DPS. This guide will assume you primarily use Magic, but Melee can also tap into many of these fundamentals with some changes. Unfortunately, as Ranged does not have an equivalent to either Destroy or Asphyxiate, it cannot stun-lock Telos to the same degree as either Melee or Magic and therefore will not be included much in this guide.

​

Attack Speeds

You vs Telos

⬥ You attack every 3 ticks / 1.8 seconds (GCD), 4 ticks / 2.4 seconds if you follow up with 4TAA

​

⬥ Telos base attack speed is 4 ticks / 2.4 seconds, 3 ticks / 1.8 seconds while in green beam which you generally don't need to worry about

​

Stuns

Basic Stuns

Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] / Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] / Binding Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] stuns for 1.2 seconds, 15 second cooldown.

​

Threshold Stuns

⬥ Deep Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] / Forceful Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand] / Tight Bindings [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541275957657600.png?v=1 tight] stuns for 3.6 seconds, 15 second cooldown.

​

⬥ Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / Destroy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] stuns for 3.6 seconds, 20 second cooldown.

​

Necromancy Stuns

⬥ Soul strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] stuns for 3.0 seconds, has no cooldown, consumes 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] on use.

​

⬥ Deathguard's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] special attack Death Grasp stuns for 4.8 seconds, 30 second cooldown, costs 25% adrenaline. Consumes all [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] on use.

​

Non-stuns that Break Freedom

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1 stickybomb] do not stun but bind, which breaks his Freedom nonetheless. Simple to apply with 4TAA if using Magic, and sticky bombs are also easy enough to throw mid-rotation.

​

Other Stuns

⬥ Dreadnips [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336877900890135.png?v=1 nip] can randomly stun for 4.2 seconds, but can be detrimental at higher level play. Avoid using if following a very specific rotation, but can be decent for learners.

​

⬥ Jade bakriminel bolts (e) can randomly stun for 4.8 seconds, but can be detrimental at higher level play and are outclassed by ruby/hydrix bakriminel bolts regardless. Avoid completely.

​

Telos's Freedom

Enrage Cooldowns

⬥ 150%-249%: 30 second cooldown between Freedom use.

​

⬥ 250%-999%: 20.4 second cooldown between Freedom use. On P5, when Telos uses Freedom he has stun immunity for 6 seconds, then can be stunned in that 14 second window.

​

⬥ 1000%-4000%: 9.6 second cooldown between Freedom use. On P5, when Telos uses Freedom he has stun immunity for 6 seconds, then can be stunned in that 4.2 second window.

​

Mechanics

⬥ Procs whenever off cooldown and if he was bound/stunned between Freedoms.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example: At 150% enrage, if you bound or stun Telos immediately after Freedom, Telos will always use Freedom exactly 30 seconds after the previous one, even if you didn't bind or stun Telos after that.

​

⬥ Right when Telos uses Freedom, his attack cooldown resets and he tries to use his next attack 2 ticks / 1.2 seconds later, even if he just used an attack.

​

⬥ If Telos Freedoms right after he uses an attack, Telos would attack in 2 ticks instead of the usual 4 ticks / 2.4 seconds.

[https://youtu.be/jzrbLGTA1nk https://youtu.be/jzrbLGTA1nk]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/jzrbLGTA1nk Embedded guide video]

Note: This is bad and should be avoided!

​

⬥ If Telos Freedoms 1 tick before his next attack, he must wait 2 additional ticks before using his next attack.

[https://youtu.be/ZigW16NofNw https://youtu.be/ZigW16NofNw]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZigW16NofNw Embedded guide video]

Note: This is good as it acts as a stun!

​

⬥ If you proc his Freedom immediately by using a stun ability like Impact or Deep Impact, he will attack on the same tick you can use your next ability.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do NOT try to stun immediately after a stun if your first stun triggered Telos's Freedom! The clip below shows how to properly circumvent his Freedom.

[https://youtu.be/g_Asfm8TCl0 https://youtu.be/g_Asfm8TCl0]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/g_Asfm8TCl0 Embedded guide video]

General Stun Combos

To maximize stun time, you have to play around both Telos's Freedom and combo your stuns in the best way possible.

​

Stun Combos

⬥ Longest possible stun uptime below 1000%:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (3 hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]

[https://youtu.be/JDoVptf9yIU https://youtu.be/JDoVptf9yIU]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JDoVptf9yIU Embedded guide video]

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee #1:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] (3 hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand]

[https://youtu.be/pHRv3QO_BTA https://youtu.be/pHRv3QO_BTA]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pHRv3QO_BTA Embedded guide video]

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee #2:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] → (DW) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand] → (5taa) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy]

[https://youtu.be/LZuxkRYm71g https://youtu.be/LZuxkRYm71g]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/LZuxkRYm71g Embedded guide video]

Note: "5TAA", or "5T" for short, is doing an autoattack with 2H after using an ability with DW. More info can be found in [[PvME/Damage rotations/Melee damage guide|DPM Advice Melee]], but this 5TAA wastes just enough time between Destroy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] and Forceful Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand] yet still gains damage to allow for the longest stun duration. You can even replace Forceful Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand] with a bleed Destroy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy], 5TAA, then use Forceful Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand]!

​

⬥ A slightly more damaging, yet shorter stun by one tick stun combo:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

[https://youtu.be/fxkfSegn7yU https://youtu.be/fxkfSegn7yU]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/fxkfSegn7yU Embedded guide video]

⬥ If Telos has Freedom up:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] + any ability, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257439366708592651.png?v=1 wrack] most recommended → any ability → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (3 hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 1000%+, Telos will even Freedom after Deep Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep], allowing you to follow up with Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] for even more stun time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Below 1000%, you can add Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] before Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx].

[https://youtu.be/ZigW16NofNw https://youtu.be/ZigW16NofNw]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZigW16NofNw Embedded guide video]

⬥ Melee has it differently due to sticky bombs. They're a bit more tricky to use, but they don't rely on stopping your abilities to apply them. To pop Freedom perfectly, you need to throw the sticky bomb right as Telos attacks. Doing this will achieve the same result Ice Barrage can. You may need to delay your actual ability rotation for the best stun time possible, but at least throwing the bomb itself shouldn't be too bad.

[https://youtu.be/IJP8_d3dG-c https://youtu.be/IJP8_d3dG-c]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/IJP8_d3dG-c Embedded guide video]

⬥ A beginner friendly way without 4TAA or sticky bombs:

​

Pop Freedom with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand] → use any ability as long as it's not a stun → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (3 hit) / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] (3 hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand].

[https://youtu.be/g_Asfm8TCl0 https://youtu.be/g_Asfm8TCl0]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/g_Asfm8TCl0 Embedded guide video]

Note: While this combo is not as efficient as using 4TAA or sticky bombs, it's relatively easy to do and doesn't require anything extra beyond abilities.

​

Common Mistakes

Actions to Avoid

⬥ Stunning as soon as Telos attacks makes Telos attack quicker and wastes the stun. Instead, you always want to make sure you stun right before he does any attack.

[https://youtu.be/jzrbLGTA1nk https://youtu.be/jzrbLGTA1nk]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/jzrbLGTA1nk Embedded guide video]

⬥ Following up a Telos Freedom immediately with a stun. If you use a stun right after popping Freedom, you will waste either the entirety of (Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] / Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1 backhand]) or waste most of Asphyxiate ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / Destroy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1 destroy] and Deep Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] / Forceful Backhand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1 fbackhand]).

[https://youtu.be/B7eumx0U998 https://youtu.be/B7eumx0U998]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/B7eumx0U998 Embedded guide video]

⬥ Using stuns immediately after another without waiting properly or just mistiming it. This can range from canceling Asphyxiate too early to following up Deep Impact with Impact too quickly to simply mistiming the follow-up stun. Be sure to follow these timings perfectly if you want the maximum stun uptime!

​

Stun Applications

Tricks

⬥ All of the above stun combos can work from P1-P4 to maximize stun time. Sometimes it's more efficient to go maximum DPS as stated in the other guides, but in general these stun rotations do lead to the most damage possible before any special attacks/etc.

​

⬥ At the start of P2, P3, and P4 with Magic, there exists a special stun combo you can do. As Telos takes longer to start attacking you and you can pop Telos's Freedom losslessly with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535613865912696883.png?v=1 iceblitz] + any slow ability like Wild Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] or Corruption Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast], all with dual wield. Then you do [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (3 hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact]. This normally lasts as long as the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] combo, but as both you and Telos take one tick longer to start attacking, the overall stun uptime is still as long as possible with a perfect Freedom at the end.

[https://youtu.be/MAYl7tvN1ck https://youtu.be/MAYl7tvN1ck]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MAYl7tvN1ck Embedded guide video]

⬥ When using Detonate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] inside fonts on P4, you want to release with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1 impact] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] (3 hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]. This guarantees you will do the 37.5k damage needed to quickly phase him into the next font while preventing Telos from doing anything.

[https://youtu.be/hMmRE9UuFW0 https://youtu.be/hMmRE9UuFW0]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hMmRE9UuFW0 Embedded guide video]

⬥ As a backup, you can force out an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] to pop Freedom, then one tick later use your normal stun combos. This isn't as efficient as a carefully laid out stun rotation, but if you need to improvise, this can easily save you before any potentially bad situation.

[https://youtu.be/_jG-TEINbHk https://youtu.be/_jG-TEINbHk]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/_jG-TEINbHk Embedded guide video]

Stunning P5

Starting at 250% and above, when Telos Freedoms he gets a 6 second stun immunity on P5. This further punishes bad stunning, but you can still work around this and stun Telos as long as possible.

​

When the phase starts, Telos will always Freedom immediately, which turns out to be a waste for him as you can immediately follow up with stuns after getting inside the green beam and setting up your Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine]. Telos will Freedom again afterwards, but by this point your stuns will be on cooldown so once they come back, you are free to stun again.

​

At 1000%+, you can no longer stun him as easily. As you only have a 4.2 second window to stun, you only have room for one long stun like Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] or Deep Impact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1 deep]. Fortunately with enough raw DPS you can circumvent that fine enough, but should you be lacking in DPS in some way, knowing how to stun properly can still make the difference between a death or a kill. In general, you want to stun Telos after he does three autoattacks after his Freedom. This works no matter if you're in the green beam or not.

[https://youtu.be/MbfruBRsOFU https://youtu.be/MbfruBRsOFU]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MbfruBRsOFU Embedded guide video]

Pay attention to when the Freedom happens and when he gets stunned, which is three attacks after Freedom.

​

Target Cycling at Telos

Target cycling can be used to tag earlier on phase 1 and phase 5.

​

For phase 1, you need to trigger GCD (using Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo]) wait 2 ticks then Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] in (mid-gcd) and sun on the next tick. Wait 3 ticks then use Target Cycle and an ability. Be aware that if your first ability splashes, it can cause Telos' first auto to hit 2 ticks earlier.

​

In phase 5, you can Target Cycle the tick after the font moves as in the animation below. Alternatively, just Target Cycle as soon as you see Telos' head pop up, or as soon as you see the yellow dot on the minimap. Your target range must be set to max for this to work.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/OwGhR2U.gif Guide illustration]

​

Telos Target Cycle Comparison

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wveIsE9Y0C8 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wveIsE9Y0C8]

​

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/wveIsE9Y0C8 Embedded guide video]

P1 Walk

If using deto/wm strategy for P1, it's important to make sure you are either south or west of Telos to ensure your deto wm hits are all on the same tick. You do this by checking walk direction with your combust at start, running to the edge of your sun in the opposite direction. Next, run out of your sun immediately after an ability and escape back 2 ticks later. More specifically:

⬥ If West walk, run to the east to drag Telos and escape back into your sun. When walking your second combust, click one square under Telos to walk it, then click on Telos again 1t later to stay on his west side.

⬥ If South walk, run to the north west of your Sun and run north before escaping/running back south.

​

Video Examples of West and South Walk P1

⬥ West Walk - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L_hNGDNHdiM https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L_hNGDNHdiM]

⬥ South Walk - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nDxlekndiaA https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nDxlekndiaA]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zURz0KcXrt.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction and preface

​

This guide is targeted towards players with a strong understanding of the encounter, players attempting hardmode Zuk for the first time should read [[PvME/TzKal-Zuk/Tzkal Zuk Overview|Tzkal Zuk Basic]]

​

Time save breakdown:

⬥ Players should focus on wave clear and try to follow this guide as best as possible.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that movements are specific for certain waves, and stepping on the wrong tiles may lead to failed lures

​

As such, it is strongly recommended to follow the guide alongside the video examples. The rotations are constructed to allow for continuous usage. If followed correctly, players should not lose ticks between abilities unless otherwise stated.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=b6bbf927-136b-4b7d-8045-2c785fa55f01 Melee/Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fb6bbf927-136b-4b7d-8045-2c785fa55f01.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ Preset Notes

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Powder at bank [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] w/ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1 equilibrium])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] w/ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439139400224849.png?v=1 graspingpouch] w/ runes for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud]

​

The Fight

⬥ Waves are generally broken down into alternating between melee and ranged unless otherwise specified, using melee for all igneous + challenge waves and ranged for all jad waves

⬥ Wars: (optional [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]) → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Wave 1

General pointers

⬥ Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1 tzkalzuk], use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] as TzekHaar-Hurs are clumping up, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] to finish

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Aim to clear through wave 2 with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk]

Specific rotations

⬥ (1) Zuk: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

⬥ West Hur: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]

⬥ (2) All Hurs: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + wait 2 ticks → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1 tzkalzuk] + far-cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → target Hur + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

⬥ (3) South Kihs: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/RtUs5sm00f.png Guide illustration] Note: Provided diagrams only cover the most important abilities and movements, some amount of improvisation may be required in general

Wave 2

General pointers

⬥ Clear all spawns of northern enemies, then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] to clear the southern enemies, ideally all before [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] runs out

Specific rotations

⬥ (1) West Xil + Hur: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1 tzkalzuk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1 pulverise]

⬥ (2) East Xil + Hurs: wait for second spawn of Hurs → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592040507744257.png?v=1 dragon2hsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → target far Hur + far-cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault]

⬥ (3) Yt-Mejkot: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → position yourself in the middle of the enemies + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/quySn0GqIh.png Guide illustration] ​

Wave 3

General pointers

⬥ Set up [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows], clear all Yt-Mejkot with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot], then pick off remaining enemies with single-target abilities

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Entering the next wave is somewhat timelocked to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] cooldown, so there is some amount of leeway on this wave

Specific rotations

⬥ (1) Zuk: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Wall of Flame will occur around this time, make sure that all Yt-Mejkot have walked around any obstacles before moving away

⬥ (2) Center-Most Yt-Mejkot: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot]

⬥ Remaining Enemies: Pick off using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → end on 100 adren

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HytPNxCaD4.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Har-Aken: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Wave 18 (Tz-Kal Zuk)

Zuk

⬥ Start near the middle and build to 100% adren

⬥ Equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring] + Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] + build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] + be on 3-7 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium]

​

⬥ Zuk: 3 ticks after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1 tzkalzuk] starts moving [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → dump adren to finish

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] as necessary to deal with mechanics

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zuk should be lowered to ~220k or less by this point

​

Pizza

⬥ Igneous Hur: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1 bindingshot] + build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] while killing → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] when rain is about to disappear

⬥ Igneous Xil: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] + build adren while killing

⬥ Igneous Mej: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] and finish with basics

⬥ Zuk: s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] (depending on his remaining hp) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] if needed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Time it such that the extra action button to interrupt Zuk is usable after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk]

​

Conduits

⬥ Some improvisation may be needed, but generally just keep pressing strong abilities while following the listed defensive order

​

⬥ Deal with Zuk's charged attacks using the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• C1 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• C2 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• C3 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• C4 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] (make sure sign is not available, unequip cape if needed)

​

⬥ Conduits: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → wait 2 ticks + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] + improvise to finish, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] if it comes up while [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] is still running

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take advantage of the lack of bombs during Zuk's charging attack to use more channelled abilities ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry])

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zURz0KcXrt.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction and preface

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/TzKal-Zuk/Tzkal Zuk Overview|Tzkal Zuk Basic]].

​

The rotations used are examples and can be adapted depending on Adrenaline, Residual Soul stacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and Necrosis Stacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]. The lures generally require moving depending on which monsters are blocked prior to using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate].

​

Notes:

⬥ Players should try to follow this guide as best as possible. If you find that you are slower at moving between luring positions then you should try to always be hitting an enemy while running

⬥ You should upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] at all times for a reduction in damage taken, healing and increased damage dealt

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1 zemouregalsnexus] should be used as defensives will be vital during the encounter, such as to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] on challenge wave 15 and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] in the conduit phase

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1 mahj] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505652865695767.png?v=1 invigaura] are viable alternatives, however, they are less consistent. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1 equilibriumaura] offers consistency, cheap upkeep cost, longer duration, more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] damage, and more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] healing

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=DBJShaNHiFWgvpriGLPM Necromancy]

​

Preset Notes

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] used at the bank [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FDBJShaNHiFWgvpriGLPM.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142416978112417812.png?v=1 firstnecrohandwrap] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1 zorgothsring] should only be worn when summoning conjures and when fighting Zuk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1 tzkalzuk] as he isn't poisonable nor does the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160759550042.png?v=1 tokkulzo] buff work on him

⬥ Mobile [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] perk is a must have on gear

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, use Shadow's Grace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/895999229737185280.png?v=1 shadowsgrace]

⬥ Mage, Ranged or Melee Obsidian Helm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1100353893063462912.png?v=1 obsidianmagehelm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1100353910130102312.png?v=1 obsidianrangerhelm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1100353943277686924.png?v=1 obsidianwarriorhelm] can be used for damage reduction. Although it is offstyle, it can be useful for the damage reduction (especially if charged in the Fight Cauldron beforehand). This guide assumes that a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] familiar is used, reducing the need for an offstyle obsidian helm

⬥ A [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] familiar may be used, however, the usefulness of it is limited throughout the majority of the encounter and requires micro-management with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] use and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933299003121078332.png?v=1 callfollower] as it is prone to getting stuck behind obstacles

Waves 1-16

⬥ A visual guide to the lures used throughout the fight can be found [https://raidplan.io/plan/tdrat5qccgh87rbs here]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use the panel icons (1,2,3,4,5,6...) to navigate between each wave. Challenge waves are not included.

Wave 1

(Go East) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → (East Meleer) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → (Go North) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → (Any North Meleer) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] (South) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] (Kill both bats with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Wave 2

Start North-East

(NE Ranger) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] (West and tc NW Ranger) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] (East and tc NE Meleer) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → (Move South) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → (West Meleer) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] → (Yt-MejKot) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → finish with basics → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Wave 3

Start South-East

(SE Yt-MejKot) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → (Bat) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → (Move West) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] (East) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] (East Ranger) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton]

​

Wave 4 (Igneous wave)

General pointers

To minimise time spent on Igneous waves you should aim to do 2-3 basics and have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] finish off the igneous mobs. Move towards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1 tzkalzuk] while attacking the Igneous Hur (Meleer).

​

Specific rotations

Ideally conjures are summoned or extended prior to the igneous mobs spawning, however, if necessary then either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] as needed.
