[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

Rotations provided by the [https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH Rago Hub discord community (external Discord)]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xwkK1u3.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

This guide focuses on Duo Hard Mode Vorago only. The most important and most difficult part about duo hard mode is that Vorago always fires 2 blue bombs at once, if two persons are in reach. The second blue bomb can be prevented by learning to step under. Up to P10 and P11, this is mostly handled with devo / cade cepting.

​

Requirements

⬥ Knowledge how to Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] / Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]

⬥ Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh]

⬥ Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb]

​

Note: To effectively use SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] in Duo HM as mage, you will need to learn to unequip armour.

​

Recommendations

⬥ Important: Knowledge how to Target Cycle (tc)

⬥ Knowledge about stalling Vorago in phases 10 / 11

⬥ Knowledge about stepping under to avoid Blue Bombs

⬥ Limitless [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless]

⬥ Malletops for extended Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

⬥ 2 dummies each player [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] for phases 2, 4, 9 and 11

⬥ Nihil (do not use ice nihil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil])

​

Nihil vs Pack Yak/Mammoth

Generally speaking, if you are only trying to go for a kill and do not want to bother with doing phases 1 - 9 in an optimal way, using a Pack Yak [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195712201228289.png?v=1 Yak] or Mammoth [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1 mammothpouch] is going to lead you to a successful duo hardmode kill faster. Yet, using a Nihil will significantly decrease the supply upkeep cost throughout your attempts. Therefore it is recommended to learn the mechanics and strategies properly.

​

Ability Rotations

Rago Hub maintains a spreadsheet with over 150+ unique ability rotations. Whilst the provided Duo Hard Mode ability rotations are aimed towards advanced and experienced Ragoers, it is still recommended to check them out. You can easily adjust the rotations to your personal preferences.

​

Rago Hub spreadsheet:

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing]

​

Strategy Overview

Bomb Tank Strategy Summary

[https://img.pvme.io/images/liY9ZqF.png Guide illustration]

Base Tank Strategy Summary

[https://img.pvme.io/images/7AvxrfI.png Guide illustration]

Phase 1

In phase 1, Blue Bombs have a drastic chance of dragging the Bomb Tank from his climb. To prevent this from happening, the Base Tank has to keep Vorago far enough on the eastern wall, so that no blues are launched at the climber. Only once they reached the final platform from which they can voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke], the Base Tank lures Vorago closer to the west.

​

Base Tank

Stall Vorago and delay the first Red Bomb until shortly before the Bomb Tank can voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke]. The goal with stalling the Red Bomb launch that long is to avoid one being launched early during jump. If done correctly, the second Red Bomb will be fired after the Bomb Tank has jumped.

​

Phase 1 Diagram:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/9p2cIAW.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Disrupt [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] and Excalibur [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] as you drop into Phase 1.

​

⬥ Starting point is the white rectangle, MD east of Vorago.

​

⬥ Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use thresholds until your bomb tank jumps.

​

⬥ Bladed dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to the south east corner.

​

⬥ At your 3rd - 4th ability after Target Cycle, as Vorago does his first auto attack, start walking to the north east corner, along the eastern wall.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If done correctly, Vorago is not going to auto you at all while walking north, so you have long soul split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] uptime.

​

⬥ At the north eastern corner, pray flick until the Red Bomb is launched (utilise Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] if necessary).

​

⬥ Bladed dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to the west before the non-homing Blue Bomb hits you, so that the Bomb Tank can voke Vorago.

​

⬥ South-voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago ASAP.

​

⬥ As the Bomb Tank jumps, escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] and bladed dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] to the southern wall, then walk back to the north and keep building to 100% with defensives.

​

⬥ Ideally Vorago switches aggro to the Bomb Tank, if not, keep pray flicking.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does a slight turn-around of ~ 45° clock-wise if he switches aggro.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can see Blue Bombs being fired by watching Vorago's animation during the jump.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago switches to the Bomb Tank during jump, voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] after, to allow your Bomb Tank to step under.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago stays on the Base Tank, step under and Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] / Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ After jump, use Metamorphosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta].

​

Phase 1 Base Tank Example

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTs6laViJfE https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTs6laViJfE]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/GTs6laViJfE Embedded guide video]

Bomb Tank

⬥ Do a normal climb.

​

⬥ Once you have reached the final platform, voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago.

​

⬥ Use SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], thresholds and a couple of basics.

​

⬥ Jump 1 - 2 ticks before the first Blue Bomb hits.

​

⬥ Ideally Vorago switches aggro to you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago switches to you during your jump, Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the Base Tank afterwards (alternatively: step under and Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther]).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago stays on the Base Tank during your jump, voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] afterwards and step away, to allow the Base Tank for stepping under.

​

Phase 2

Both players should utilise Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] and Storm Shards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 StormShards] throughout the phase. Your goal should be to always apply 10 shards by Bring Him Down.

​

Base Tank

⬥ Bladed dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] back under Vorago after escaping [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] the second bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], to avoid the launched Blue Bomb.

​

⬥ Red bombs 1 and 3 cade cept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] before second and last reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] to prevent eating during Bring Him Down.

​

Bomb Tank

⬥ Cade cept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the second Red Bomb.

​

⬥ Tag all gravity fields.

​

Bring Him Down

⬥ Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258425204770.png?v=1 snipe] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

⬥ Mage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

​

Note: If both players use magic, Shatter [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 Shatter] should be utilised for consistently passing the damage check.

​

Phase 3 Ceilings

It is highly recommended to drop a combat dummy in the end of Phase 2 and use Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] for Ceilings Phase 3.

​

Phase Strategy

⬥ Base Tank voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] entire phase.

​

⬥ Both Base and Bomb Tank ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and Apot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal].

​

⬥ Base Tank apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

​

⬥ At Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], the Bomb Tank devo cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ After Vorago jumped for the second time, the Base Tank should move closer.

​

⬥ At the Red Bomb, the Base Tank devo cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Phase 4 Scopulus

The goal is to camp magic protection prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] for the Blue Bombs and run away from all Scopuli in order to avoid melee slaps.

​

Pathing Scopulus

⬥ Whoever has 2 Scopuli on them, voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the third.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept], both players DD (to avoid Scopuli decoupling).

​

⬥ Walk around the arena clock-wise in a circle.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not walk out the corners.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not walk too close to the center, or Scopuli will not be in line of sight any longer if they get stuck behind Vorago.

​

Strategy

Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] does not register while moving. Make sure you stand still when cepting!

​

Phase 4 Diagram:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/F4NFSTD.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Base Tank start at the green circle in the north-west and tag the northern Scopulus.

​

⬥ Bomb Tank start at the red circle in the south-west and tag both of the southern Scopuli.

​

⬥ Meet your partner at the white cross in the middle of the western wall.

​

⬥ At the second Blue Bomb, the Bomb Tank cade cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ Bomb Tank vokes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the northern Scopulus in order to stack all 3.

​

⬥ After Barricade runs out, the Bomb Tank devo cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ As Intercept runs out, the Base Tank follows devo cept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the phase is expected to take longer than 5-10 seconds after the Base's devo cept runs out, the Base Tank should Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Note: Most of the times, as you kill the last Scopulus, you are going to drop target and will not be able to build adrenaline with defensive abilities any longer. Due to this, it is highly recommended to place a combat dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] as the last Scopulus dies.

​

Phase 4 Scopulus Example (Base Tank POV)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=neAeSDWC4OU https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=neAeSDWC4OU]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/neAeSDWC4OU Embedded guide video]

Phase 5 Vitalis

The goal is to camp melee protection prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and pray flick every single Blue Bomb you receive on-tick. Make sure to always eat up to 6,000 or higher life points, due to a Blue Bomb easily knocking you out otherwise.

​

Strategy

⬥ Base Tank pre-ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and Apot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal].

​

⬥ Bomb Tank apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

​

⬥ At Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], the Bomb Tank devo cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ Handling Bleeds.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank must voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] before Vorago applies the first Bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bomb Tank cade cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] bleeds 1 - 4.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] the fourth Bleed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bomb Tank voke and Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] the last Bleed.

​

⬥ If the phase takes a lot longer after Bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember] are over, the Base Tank can utilise Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Note: If the Bomb Tank has Malletops Perk unlocked, they can alternatively skip their voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] for the last Bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember]. Refresh Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] as Barricade's timer reaches 11 seconds. The Base Tank has to Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] the last Bleed instead of the fourth.

​

Tips & Tricks

⬥ Excalibur [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] should be activated in the start of Phase 5.

​

⬥ Base and Bomb tank position next to each other to ensure no spawned Vitali blocking their line of sight to each other.

​

⬥ Ideally, position west of Vorago at the L-Rock, where one player can utilise Flanking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4] (blue circled tile).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/F6oslzi.png Guide illustration]

Phase 5 Vitalis Example (Base Tank POV)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KZCW_qE8kP0 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KZCW_qE8kP0]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/KZCW_qE8kP0 Embedded guide video]

Phase 6 Green Bomb

If comfortable, Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] can be used in the end of Phase 5 on the Vitali surrounding you (make sure you are not killing your last targeted Vitalis, or you will drop target and can not use defensive abilities for adrenaline gain once dropping into Phase 6). This is going to increase the consistency of skipping the second Green Bomb, thus saving you a lot of food.

​

Strategy

⬥ Bomb Tank voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the entire phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Base should step under throughout this phase.

​

⬥ Both Base and Bomb Tank pre-ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and utilise their Apot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal].

​

⬥ Base Tank apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

​

⬥ Bomb Tank activates Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] for the first Blue Bomb.

​

⬥ Handling Green Bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the first Green Bomb targets the Bomb Tank, sip a dose of your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the first Green Bomb targets the Base Tank, either sip a dose of your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] or, if successfully stepped under for all auto attacks, simply tank the 10,000 and eat once or twice after the detonation.

​

⬥ Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the second Blue Bomb in Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect].

​

⬥ Whoever does not receive the second Green Bomb should Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the other player.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to have high enough life points for the Red Bomb following the second Green Bomb.

​

Phase 6 Green Bomb Example (Base Tank POV)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mii85UTiTdQ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mii85UTiTdQ]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Mii85UTiTdQ Embedded guide video]

Phase 7 Team Split

Use Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal] situationally, depending on your life points, adrenaline and Vorago's remaining life points.

​

Strategy

⬥ Bomb Tank vokes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the entire phase.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Base Tank should step under throughout this phase.

​

⬥ Bomb Tank apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

​

⬥ At the start of Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], both players ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift].

​

⬥ Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the first Blue Bomb in Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect].

​

⬥ Base Tank devo cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the Red Bomb after the second Team Split.

​

Phase 8 The End

Strategy

⬥ Base Tank apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is ideal to use your SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] in the first quadrant, as it is guaranteed to connect all 5 arrows.

​

⬥ At the quadrant with Blue Bombs, the Bomb Tank devo cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] and the Base Tank tags all bombs.

​

⬥ At the quadrant with Red Bombs, each player tags 2 bombs.

​

⬥ Between the third and last quadrant, both players ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] with Apot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal].

​

⬥ At stand-up, the Base Tank vokes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bomb Tank should step under after stand-up.

​

Note: If a second stand-up is possibly happening, switch around Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] and tagging Blue Bombs. Again, both players tag 2 Red Bombs each.

​

Alternative Strategy

⬥ Ignore the quadrant with Blue Bombs.

​

⬥ Tag 2 Red Bombs each.

​

⬥ At stand-up, one player uses Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Phase 9 - Team Split

Both players should utilise Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] and Storm Shards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 StormShards] throughout the phase. Your goal should be to always apply 10 shards by the third Waterfall.

​

Base Tank

⬥ After each Waterfall, surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] under Vorago and step under.

​

⬥ If not skipping the Stone Clone, use Anticipation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] or Freedom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] before the clone's spawn.

​

⬥ After each Team Split, Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ Voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] for bleeds 3, 4 and 5 ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]).

​

⬥ Use Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] for yourself during Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] (do no Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]).

​

Bomb Tank

⬥ After each Waterfall, keep Vorago voked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] until Bleeds.

​

⬥ Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] for yourself (do not Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]) the fourth Blue Bomb (first Blue Bomb after the Stone Clone's spawn).

​

⬥ Take bleeds 1 and 2 ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape]).

​

Phase End

Just like in the end of Phase 2, it is highly recommended to place a combat dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] in the end of Phase 9. Use Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] to have more adrenaline available in the start of Phase 10.

​

Phase 10 - Team Split

Strategy

⬥ Every odd number of Team Splits (after first, third, fifth, etc), your team rotates applying SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The person not barricading [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] is the one hammering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] should be applied at start of Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], to not lose DPS uptime.

​

⬥ Important Line up vertically, so that both players have the same distance to Vorago - You will force both Blue Bombs to hit in the same tick, avoiding one square push back each auto attack Vorago fires.

​

⬥ Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] should only be used after the first Team Split of the phase, or after messing up Lining Up.

​

⬥ Generally speaking, throughout a longer Phase 10, utilising a stable order of thresholds is going to generate more stall than using ultimates.

​

⬥ Check [[PvME/Vorago/Vorago — Tips And Tricks|Tips And Tricks]] for more information about how stall works.

​

Note: To avoid high food consumption, Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal] should be used for Team Splits that one person follows with cade cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]

​

Starting Phase 10

⬥ As you drop into Phase 10, the Base Tank should pre-ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on tick.

​

⬥ Both players Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] the first Blue Bomb after the first Team Split.

​

⬥ The Bomb Tank starts with cade cepting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] for the second Blue Bomb (tank the first with disrupt [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]).

​

⬥ During Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], both players move melee distance for the third auto attack.

​

⬥ After the second Team Split, both players use thresholds.

​

⬥ The Base Tank should keep in mind they will have to Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] after the third Team Split.

​

⬥ If the Bomb Tank has excess adrenaline, they can eventually ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift].

​

⬥ After the third Team Split, the Base Tank cade cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the first Blue Bomb.

​

Mauling

⬥ You should always wait with mauling until the start of a Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] in order to optimise your Phase 11 start.

​

⬥ Using Shield Dome right before mauling is going to cancel the maul animation, providing you more time during the phase transition.

​

⬥ Shield Dome cannot be used off GCD (you have to wait for your GCD to be over, then Shield Dome → Maul).

​

⬥ The player not mauling should reapply the SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and place a combat dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] in the very east.

​

⬥ During the phase transition, both players build up to 100% on the dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] (use defensive abilities + auto attacks).

​

Phase 10 Example (Base Tank POV)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vaawIOmKJcw https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vaawIOmKJcw]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/vaawIOmKJcw Embedded guide video]

Phase 11 - Team Split

Strategy

⬥ After every Team Split, your team rotates ultimating [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ At the start of each Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect], the player not barricading should reapply the SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec].

​

⬥ Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] should optimally be used when scuffing lining up or after a Purple Bomb detonation.

​

⬥ Important Line up vertically, like you did in Phase 10.

​

Starting Phase 11

⬥ Both players ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] start of the phase.

​

⬥ The person who did not Barricade last in Phase 10 should cade cept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the first Blue Bomb after the first Team Split.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The other player reapplies the SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The person who barricades [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] builds to 100% quickly in order to ultimate.

​

⬥ Rotationally switch Barricade Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] and ultimates [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] for every Team Split.

​

Mauling

Finish him! Congrats on your kill! Make sure to find the official Vorago Duo Hard Mode Achievement spreadsheet in Source channel no longer available and follow the instructions to submit your personal kill!

​

Acknowledgements

Check out Rago Hub for a wide variety of strategy guides for everything-Vorago, featuring a Hammer Climbing guide and more.

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

Hard Mode Vorago (HM) is a variant of Vorago where the fight is extended from 5 to 11 phases, of which only phases 9 to 11 depend on the weekly rotation. Knowledge of all the Normal Mode (NM) rotations as well as Reflect timings are essential when learning this mode. Strategies do not vary from 4 - 7 man, thence the recommended team size is 5.

​

⬥ This guide will be separated into roles, combat styles and skill levels - It will not cover DPS rotations by any means

​

⬥ This guide focuses on transferring and adapting gained knowledge from NM to HM, rather than explaining mechanics and role responsibilities from scratch

​

⬥ Most warnings and specific comments can be found in the DPS section and will not be repeated for other roles

​

⬥ After each phase finishes, you are supposed to build to 100% adrenaline for the next phase (usually the team coordinates dummies [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] for each phase)

​

The first section of this guide explains every phase and how to deal with it using general strategies. Every phase will have the respective attack order and relevant mechanics. This section will also treat TL5 as a DPS: the DPS strategies and responsibilities will be explained only. This section covers phases 1 - 8.

​

The second section is dedicated to tank roles. The Base Tank section is applicable to all styles, but the recommended combat style is melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]. The Bomb Tank section is applicable to ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and mage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], with the only differences being the use of ultimates [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]. This section covers phases 1 - 8.

​

The last section explains phases 9 - 11 depending on the weekly special mechanic and is split into all 6 rotations with roles and their respective responsibilities.

​

Requirements

Note: Mauling all NM rotations is not a requirement. That is only needed to create an instance or start the challenge, but you can still join someone else.

​

⬥ Proper gear (T90+ weapons, T80+ power armour, Invention perks)

​

⬥ Knowledge of all weekly special mechanics / rotations in Normal Mode

​

⬥ Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] is required for all roles and there should always be at least one person capable of replacing a Bomb Tank in case they die

​

⬥ Anyone meleeing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] is responsible for applying the Statius's Warhammer special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] in DPS phases (split by phases if there are multiple meleers on the team)

​

⬥ Vorago should be debuffed for the majority of all phases, including SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh], Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] and potentially Blackstone Arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] for phases 10 / 11

​

⬥ A Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] (Entry hit, Green Bomb and Team Split team split) as well as having 14,000 ‎life points to avoid failing the entry hit

​

⬥ Nihils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1 bloodnihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1 shadownihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1 smokenihil] are mandatory for all team sizes and roles.

​

Note: Do not use Ice Nihils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil]

​

Recommendations

⬥ Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther]

⬥ Zaros Godsword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] for meleers

⬥ Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] for rangers

⬥ Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb]

⬥ Basic knowledge of Target Cycle

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JdkIDmzO3yRvDY8losgL Magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ltTxKZTkowjIhwdm0ULU Melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=YSPh9XkAiF2t73Oyvrzk Ranged]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FYSPh9XkAiF2t73Oyvrzk.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Entry Hit

The entry hit is the first difference with Normal Mode: It is 90% ‎of health per player, instead of 70%.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This damage also cancels defensive abilities, and the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 EnhancedExcalibur] healing effect.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 EnhancedExcalibur] after taking the entry damage

​

⬥ There are 12s between challenge and entry damage. Advanced players can use this time to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There are 36 ticks from challenging Vorago to Target Cycle, and 35 ticks from the Accept Challenge message to Target Cycle.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drop down damage is 20 ticks after challenging Vorago.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sample [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] rotation:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JycYCl7.mp4 Source media]

⬥ To time [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality], use it 20 ticks after challenging Vorago/accepting challenge.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done by counting each tick from when you challenge by looking at prayer point drain

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can also be done by looking at the bar above Vorago and clicking on it when it is about to fill, as in the following clip:

​

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA]

​

Tips

Things that help getting the HP needed: Fortitude prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341748180025365.png?v=1 fortitude] and a solid food [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336701933060106.png?v=1 sailfishsoup]. You may also use your Vitality potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] 15 seconds after challenging. The best way to time this is using Preparation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1 prep] as soon as the challenge prompt appears. Sip your Powerburst of Vitality when the cooldown is at 5 seconds left on Preparation. Using Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] and having the HP needed is recommended, because if you fail the entry hit due to timing your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] poorly, the team will most likely wait until its CD wears off, resulting in a waste of aura time.

​

Other helpful things to get entry hp:

⬥ Font of Life (Archaeology Relic) is helpful to get extra HP

⬥ Using the Thermal effect from Oo'glog is also helpful

​

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MG00fhlSnKA Embedded guide video]

Phases and Mechanic Breakdown

Phase Breakdown

There are 11 phases in Hard Mode.

​

⬥ Phases 1 - 8 stay always the same.

​

⬥ Phase 9 HM is the same as Phase 4 NM (Waterfall-phase) with some additional changes as described following.

​

⬥ Phase 10 and 11 are maul phases with the same pushback mechanic as Phase 5 NM. The order is always:

​

Phase 1: Top Lure (Piece)
Phase 2: Bring Him Down (Piece)
Phase 3: Ceiling Collapse
Phase 4: Scopulus
Phase 5: Vitalis
Phase 6: Green Bomb
Phase 7: Team Split
Phase 8: The End
Phase 9: Waterfall (Piece)
Phase 10: Maul
Phase 11: Maul

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pB3bo1z.png https://img.pvme.io/images/pB3bo1z.png] [https://img.pvme.io/images/pB3bo1z.png Guide illustration]

Rewards

⬥ Mauling in Phase 11 will grant you the in-game title the Defeater ‎as well as an outfit piece depending on the weekly rotation.

​

⬥ Having obtained all outfit pieces (6/6 rotations) is a requirement to be eligible to receive the Ancient Artefact (Bombi pet) drop.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/F61kKIC.png https://img.pvme.io/images/F61kKIC.png] [https://img.pvme.io/images/F61kKIC.png Guide illustration]

Differences from Normal Mode

⬥ Warnings: This is the most important change in Hard Mode. Warning messages do not appear in Hard Mode, which means that Reflect will not be announced, and thus it is easy to PK on accident if you do not know when the respective mechanic happens. Make sure you memorize all the Reflect timings for all the weekly special mechanics to avoid these issues. The only "warning" that appears is on The End (Phase 8) with the Purple Bomb timer (this is also true for The End p9/10/11).

​

⬥ Entry Hit: Total damage is increased from 50,000 ‎to 70,000 ‎and the per player damage cap from 12,500 ‎to 14,000​

​

⬥ Reflects: Players who attack during a Reflect will deal damage to both themselves and the linked players

​

⬥ Blue Bombs: Up to 2 bombs are fired at the same time instead of only one (independent of team size)

​

⬥ Red Bombs: Damage increased by 50%

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Minimum damage is increased from 2,000 ‎to 3,000​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Maximum damage dealt by standing close to other players is increased from 7,000 ‎to 10,500​

​

⬥ Phase 1 Climb: Vorago has a chance of dragging the climber back into the arena every time the player is hit by a Blue Bomb

​

⬥ Smashes: Bleed damage is increased from 1,200 ‎to 3,000 ‎and stacked bleeds increase from 6,000 ‎to 10,000​

​

Additionally, there are also phase-specific changes:

DPS/TL5 - Introduction

The DPS and TL5 are essentially the same role with a few exceptions. On Phase 1, the TL5 must do the usual climb just like in Normal Mode and Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke]. The DPS acts like a Normal Mode DPS: standing close to Vorago and helping lower the HP.

​

Notes

⬥ On phases 2 and 9 the TL5 takes bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], which leaves all other phases unchanged for all DPS and the TL5

​

⬥ For this section of the guide, the TL5 is only mentioned when specific responsibilities are required on top of being a DPS.

​

⬥ The DPS should stand at a maximum of 2 - 3 tiles away from Vorago throughout phases 1 - 9, and up to 2 tiles for phases 10 - 11.

​

Positioning for DPS and TL5 throughout Phases 3 - 8

DPS/TL5 - Phases 1 & 2

DPS/TL5 - Phase 1

In the start, every player will receive a Red Bomb that deals 2,000 ‎damage, except the person who stood on the TL spot at face. However, if someone is nearby, that hit can increase, scaling like in Normal Mode. After the first wave of reds, all following bombs will scale with the HM base damage of 3,000.

​

⬥ Spread out and stay in distance to other players in order to avoid increased damage

​

⬥ Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] is not recommended, as you might get too close to another player, resulting in PKs with the Reds

​

⬥ By the time the Red Bomb explodes, the Tl5 should be at the entry obstacle in the west

​

⬥ Due to all Blue Bomb's potential of dragging the climber, the TL5 must jump as soon as possible

​

There is always a chance of a random Red Bomb happening. If you get one, pray Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] and move away from all players until it explodes. Do not go farther out than the Bomb Tanks.

​

The following gif shows what's been explained above: the TL5 must get to the spot, Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] and Jump as soon as possible, regardless of Vorago's HP.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/lQr0FfS.mp4 Source media]

DPS/TL5 - Phase 2

⬥ The TL5 takes the 5th Bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], approaching the phase similar to NM

​

⬥ Bring Him Down: The time available to retrieve the Maul Piece (b) is reduced to 7.8 seconds

​

⬥ Use 1 - 2 thresholds, then continue building with basics

​

⬥ Build on the placed Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] once Vorago dies

​

Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] can be utilised at the start of BHD. It will be off CD early in Phase 3, easily allowing for more damage mitigation.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/yHSpGcd.png Guide illustration]

DPS/TL5 - Phases 3 - 8

DPS/TL5 - Phase 3 Ceilings

⬥ You must have shadows enabled to at least medium to be able to see rocks falling

​

⬥ All DPS should spread out centrally in the southern half of the arena

​

⬥ After Vorago jumps, pay attention on the rock's location and pray Deflect Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] in case you get hit by a Blue Bomb during the jump

​

⬥ If you are far away post-jump, utilise Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] or Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] as soon as Vorago lands to avoid dragging additional bombs

​

DPS/TL5 - Phase 4 Scopulus

Pray Deflect Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] as soon as the phase starts and do not try to pray flick. You will receive heavy damage from nearby scopuli.

​

⬥ Even though you are not required to Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] any Scopulus, you should do so in case they start chasing one a Bomb Tank

​

⬥ Initially, position in the south-western quadrant and stand near the crack on the floor (refer to the image below)

​

⬥ Ultimate before the scopuli spawn and start attacking the eastern Scopulus

​

⬥ Keep them stacked and prioritise AoE damage

​

⬥ You may use Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] after you are out of strong thresholds and special attacks (SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh], Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow], Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff])

​

⬥ Once all have died, you can move to the nearest Bomb Tank to Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the last Blue Bomb

​

⬥ 1 DPS should drop a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] as soon as 2 scopuli have died or at latest when the last one dies

[https://img.pvme.io/images/G5hKzZw.png Guide illustration]

DPS/TL5 - Phase 5 Vitalis

Every person in the team that is not a Bomb Tank must stand north-east of Vorago and in melee distance (MD). Vitali can block you from moving, so if you are not in melee distance (MD) there is a chance of losing your Line of Sight, preventing you from using any offensive abilities.

​

⬥ Use your SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] after Reflect if needed (or before if you are ranging)

​

⬥ Ignore all Vitalis Orbs as well as all spawned vitali

​

⬥ If Vorago happens to inflict bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], the Base, Bomb Tanks and TL5 will deal with them as usual

​

⬥ For 4 man teams it is recommended to deal with Bleeds like this: Base (1 2), TL5 (3 4), BT (5) due to the TL5 being in melee distance (MD)

​

Once the phase is finished, build to 100% on a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] or an alive Vitalis.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/SFzYxmS.png Guide illustration]

DPS/TL5 - Phase 6 Green Bomb

⬥ Drop a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] immediately as you drop into the phase

​

⬥ DPS usually position centrally in the western half of the arena.

​

⬥ For Mages [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] - it is recommended to Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] (or Metamorphosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta]) and apply Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff], followed by thresholds

​

⬥ Rangers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] - should pre-ECB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] or only dump thresholds

​

⬥ If both are available, utilise your Ingenuity of the Humans [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] in combination with the Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] special attack in order to optimise your damage output pre-Reflect.

​

If you receive a Green Bomb, simply stay close to another player and let it bounce off you. For 4 man you can let it bounce and then use your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] when it targets you a second time. Since the Bomb Tank provokes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago in this phase, you should not receive any additional damage, assuming proper positioning.

​

DPS/TL5 - Phase 7 Team Split

Team Split cancels all defensive abilities, including Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]. Make sure to eat well above 9,000 ‎to avoid dying.

​

⬥ Drop a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] in the start of the phase, close to the edge of the arena

​

⬥ Due to TS cancelling all defensive abilities, the optimal timing for Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] is shortly after Reflect started (aiming to resonance the third or fourth Blue Bomb)

​

⬥ Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal] can be used if tanking the TS damage

​

DPS/TL5 - Phase 8 The End

⬥ Due to the Stand Up being skipped in most scenarios, avoid tagging any bombs

​

⬥ Pre-ultimate before using Target Cycle, and use your strongest abilities

​

⬥ Try to glitch out of arms if possible so you can Ultimate without having to move (due to Quadrants moving)

​

⬥ In case a Stand Up happens, eat to full HP and use Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] and your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] (if either is available)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6j6v67i.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Glitching out of arms

Base Tank - Introduction

Basing Hard Mode does not change much from Normal Mode. It is all about not moving the boss when it is not needed, and tanking hits without wasting food. Prayer flicking is also very useful to maintain HP without eating or using Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]. Basing is usually performed by a meleer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], who is also in charge of applying the Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] special attack throughout the fight. Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] or Mage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] can be used just as well, but most strategies of this guide will focus on melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]. If the Base Tank is not meleeing, a DPS should be in charge of applying SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh].

​

Strategy Summary

[https://img.pvme.io/images/DwkesCR.png Guide illustration]

Base Tank - Phases 1 & 2

Base Tank - Phase 1

If not executing the described Solo Lure, perform the following steps.

​

⬥ Move east of Vorago's spawn location as shown in the following clip

[https://img.pvme.io/images/uJP5zV5.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Once Vorago spawns, use an ability and Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] shortly after (within the ability's GCD)

​

Note: It is important to not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] right away as if base vokes before the TL5 goes past the rock, they will lose aggro.

​

⬥ Take Vorago close to the North-East corner

​

⬥ Keep Vorago there until the climber reaches the final platform

​

⬥ At roughly 30 seconds, or before the TL5 jumps the to the last ledge, head west quickly (take 1 or 2 steps followed by Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge])

​

⬥ Once the Top Lure voked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago into spot, position south in MD and Provoke (utilise Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge])

​

Base Tank - Phase 2

The Base Tank's responsibilities throughout Phase 2 are not any different to basing Normal Mode. During Phase 2 Bomb Tanks will deal with Red Bombs. Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] is usually not needed for the base tank in P2. A Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] will be placed South once Bring Him Down is finished.

​

Base Tank - Phases 3 - 8

Base Tank - Phase 3 Ceilings

⬥ Optionally: Use Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] in Phase 2 after Bring Him Down

​

⬥ Pre-ultimate and drink your adrenaline potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] as you drop into Phase 3

​

⬥ Place a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] towards an edge but far from both the middle and the wall

​

⬥ Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] soon as possible

​

⬥ Since a Bomb Tank is supposed to voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] this phase, the Base Tank should not do so in order to avoid melee auto attacks

​

Base Tank - Phase 4 Scopulus

The Base Tank's job in this Phase is to lure and stack all scopuli. Make sure the rest of the team is focusing them as well in case they go to the Bomb Tanks. A frequent usage of Vulnerability Bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] increases the probability of keeping all scopuli stacked.

​

⬥ Stand directly west of the western Scopulus and throw a Vulnerability bomb 3 seconds before Target Cycle

​

⬥ Once the scopuli are spawned, use one ability on the closest Scopulus, then target the eastern Scopulus and apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh]

​

⬥ Walk a few steps north and attack the northern Scopulus quickly

​

⬥ Walk south-east to lure all scopuli and throw vuln bombs to keep them stacked

​

⬥ Utilise Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] once you start consuming too much food rapidly

​

⬥ Avoid moving the scopuli more than required as it can lead them changing aggro.

​

⬥ Once all scopuli are defeated, build adrenaline on the placed Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy]

​

Note: You should NOT be voking any scopuli unless they go for the Bomb tank.

​

Hammering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] the western Scopulus is not recommended because it usually takes the heaviest damage, thence dying the fastest with or without SWH.

​

Base Tank - Phase 5 Vitalis

Base tank should position themselves in northeast md.

​

⬥ If meleeing 4attack, pre-ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk], otherwise use thresholds and special attacks

​

⬥ Place a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] at the start

​

⬥ Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] as soon as possible

​

⬥ Utilise SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] right after Reflect if Vorago's life points are high (80k+)

​

⬥ Ignore and avoid all Vitalis Orbs as well as any spawned vitali

​

⬥ Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago shortly before the first Vitalis Orb explodes and avoid moving Vorago (do not leave MD)

​

⬥ If Vorago happens to inflict bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], the Base, Bomb Tanks and TL5 will deal with them as usual

​

Base Tank - Phase 6 Green Bomb

Base tank should remind Bomb tanks to voke if needed after dropdown. Do not revoke Vorago once his aggression is switched to avoid melee auto attacks.

​

⬥ No ultimate is required, simply apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] and use thresholds

​

⬥ A Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] will be placed on dropdown for the team to build adrenaline

​

⬥ If Ingenuity of the Humans [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] is ready, you may use SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] to optimise your damage pre-Reflect

​

If you receive a Green Bomb, simply stay close to another DPS and let it bounce off you. For 4 man you can let it bounce and then use your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] when it targets you a second time.

​

If the Green Bomb targets a Bomb Tank, heal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] them before it explodes.

​

Base Tank - Phase 7 Team Split

⬥ Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] on Target Cycle

​

⬥ Use thresholds for the rest of the phase. Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal] the first Team Split if you managed to Target Cycle

​

⬥ Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago shortly before Reflect and stay MD (this saves the entire team quite some food)

​

⬥ Exit the phase with enough adrenaline to activate Natural Instinct in the end of Phase 7

​

Base Tank - Phase 8 The End

⬥ Use Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] in the end of Phase 7

​

⬥ Pre-ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] and drink your adrenaline potion as you drop into Phase 8

​

⬥ Place a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] in the start

​

⬥ Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] on tick and then build adrenaline with defensive abilities

​

⬥ Use all your strong thresholds in the first quadrant and try to kill Vorago before Stand Up

​

⬥ Utilise SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] and avoid being close to other players in case a Stand Up happens (also use your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] to boost survivability)

​

Base Tank - Tips

⬥ SWH EoF [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku] and Dragon Claws EoF [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412839833601.png?v=1 eofred] are useful for optimal ability rotations

⬥ Use Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] every time you can (Phase 2 during BHD, end of Phase 4 Scopulus, during Phase 7 Team Split, end of Phase 9 / start of Phase 10)

​

⬥ Pre-ultimating and using Natural Instinct [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 nat] is not needed but significantly increases your contribution to progressing DPS phases quickly

⬥ Performing a Solo Lure in Phase 1 is a massive QoL improvement for the entire team
