Bomb Tank - Introduction

In Hard Mode Vorago throws 2 Blue Bombs at once, requiring a second Bomb Tank throughout the kill. Bomb Tanks will be referred to as BT1 and BT2. To perform this role, Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] is required. BTs with knowledge of cept timings should split cepts before the hour begins. In case of using Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther], the Bomb Tanks always heal each other. Both BTs position south for most phases.

​

Strategy Summary

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mHVPVse.png Guide illustration]

Bomb Tank - Phases 1 & 2

Bomb Tank - Phase 1

After the initial Red Bomb hits, build on Vorago and ultimate. Even if the team deals enough damage in time, utilising an ultimate is yet recommended, in order to prevent excessive food usage.

​

​

⬥ Activate Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] after the initial wave of reds dealt its 2,000 ‎damage

​

⬥ Afterwards, the person who devo cepted steps farther away to force the next Red Bomb on themselves

​

⬥ If the phase takes long, Barricade Intercept can be useful

​

⬥ Perform crack heals after every phase

​

In case of a random Red Bomb, one of the Bomb Tanks should either devo or cade cept the targeted player. Additionally you should cast Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] whilst under the effect of Barricade.

​

Bomb Tank - Phase 2

Phase 2 is mostly similar to Normal Mode.

​

⬥ The Bomb Tanks should stand south of the boss at all times (also escape bleeds from the south)

​

⬥ Only one BT will be responsible for taking the third and fourth Bleed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember]

​

⬥ BT1 cade cepts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the first and third Red Bomb, BT2 cade cepts the second always intercept the Base Tank too

​

⬥ Cast Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] during Barricade, situationally on the player with the lowest HP

​

⬥ Place a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] close to the south-western corner during Bring Him Down

​

⬥ Activate Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] at the start of BHD

​

Bomb Tank - Phases 3 - 8

Bomb Tank - Phase 3 Ceilings

Both BTs stay north in this phase due to all others standing on the south side of the arena.

​

⬥ Start the phase with thresholds and Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago as soon as possible

​

⬥ Watch out for the rock's landing location

​

⬥ The team will spread out post-jump, be careful and avoid sharing bombs

​

⬥ Use Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] carefully to get closer to Vorago post-jump, you always have to stay out the farthest in order to receive all bombs

​

⬥ Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] is not required but can be used if a Reflect occurs

​

Bomb Tank - Phase 4 Scopulus

In the beginning, go to the south-west corner and ultimate as shown in the image. Utilise your apot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] in this phase.

​

⬥ Positioning in Phase 4 Scopulus

[https://img.pvme.io/images/G5hKzZw.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Wait a few seconds before attacking the scopuli to avoid dragging aggression from the base tank

​

⬥ You can use Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] to null a Blue Bomb, followed by Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] if you need the HP

​

⬥ BT1 should Devotion Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] first, with the BT2 following up another 10 seconds of devo cept

​

⬥ The intercepted person should use Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] until the effect wears off

​

⬥ Rangers should bring Mechanised Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] and mages should apply Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff] (pair GStaff with a prior Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain])

​

⬥ One of the Bomb Tanks should drop a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] once the last Scopulus has died

​

If a Scopulus switches aggression and starts running towards you, immediately run away until it is provoked off you (make use of Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]).

​

Bomb Tank - Phase 5 Vitalis

Even though the meta used to require both BTs position in melee distance to Vorago throughout the entire phase, the most commonly used strategy is changed nowadays.

​

⬥ Both Bomb Tanks stand out of melee distance for the whole phase to prevent Blue Bombs targeting other players and to avoid the need for prayer flicking

​

⬥ Use thresholds and special attacks

​

⬥ Do not use Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] during Reflect if there are vitali nearby as they may snipe its effect

​

⬥ If needed, use your SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] after Reflect

​

⬥ If Vorago happens to inflict bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], the Base, Bomb Tanks and TL5 will deal with them as usual

​

Bomb Tank - Phase 6 Green Bomb

⬥ The BTs should position in the South

​

⬥ One Bomb Tank provokes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] 2 - 3 GCDs after Target Cycle

​

⬥ If Vorago switches his aggression, revoke in order to avoid melee auto attacks

​

⬥ Rangers should activate ECB spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], mages should utilise Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] or Metamorphosis [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1 meta]

​

⬥ Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] and use thresholds

​

⬥ A Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] will be placed on dropdown for the team to build adrenaline

​

⬥ If Ingenuity of the Humans [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] is ready, you may use SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] to optimise your damage pre-Reflect

​

If you receive a Green Bomb, eat up and use your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality].

​

Bomb Tank - Phase 7 Team Split

You may use your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] if it is available in order to improve health management when using Reprisal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1 Reprisal] during a Team Split.

​

⬥ Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago as soon as the first Team Split ends

​

⬥ The Base Tank will provoke during Reflect - do not revoke after this

​

⬥ A Bomb Tank should use Devotion Intercept right after the second Team Split

​

⬥ Drop a Combat Dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] during Reflect or during the second TS

​

Bomb Tank - Phase 8 The End

The goal is to skip the Stand Up and avoid tagging any bombs.

​

⬥ Pre-ultimate before using Target Cycle, and dump the strongest abilities you have available

​

⬥ If a Stand Up happens, eat to full life points and utilise your Powerburst of Vitality (if it is not on CD)

​

Weekly Special Mechanics - Phases 9, 10 & 11

Overview

[https://img.pvme.io/images/S2PZvtj.png Guide illustration]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ASTyHHs.png Guide illustration]

Phase 9

This section will be split into a regular Phase 9 and a Phase 9 with Clone Skip. The strategies only change for Green Bomb.

Bomb Tanks will take turns to Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the team for each cycle. Make sure to designate who is going to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] first.

​

If Clone Skip fails, everyone must get closer to Vorago as soon as possible: DPS goes 2-3 steps away from Vorago and BTs at their usual distance.

​

Ceilings

BTs must [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] everyone when Vorago makes the animation to launch the rock. Also, if you are not responsible for bleeds [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1 dismember], you should help the team to clear the rocks asap after you are [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Scopulus

It is dealt with in the same way as Phase 2. One BT will step further from rago and the other will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Vitalis

⬥ Right before Vorago launches the Vitalis orb, one Bomb Tank will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] everyone while going to the orb too. For the clone skip one, the BTs will alternate with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

⬥ The DPS should help the team to clear the that spawned. In order to do that, you can deploy dominion mines [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] before they spawn and use AoE abilities on them.

​

⬥ For the regular Phase 9, the whole team should be at the NE quadrant and the BTs on the E or N quadrant; but for the Clone Skip, the orb will be thrown in a random direction.

​

Green Bomb

⬥ Regular Phase 9: BTs must build to 100% before the Green Bomb is launched. After the green targets one person, one BT should [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] them.

​

⬥ Clone Skip Phase 9: Both BTs should build to 100% for the first green and deal with it as normal. For the second green, the Base must also build to 100% to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the BT. If the green is on one of the DPS, the BT with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] off cooldown will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept].

​

Team Split

The BTs will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] everyone after the team split.

​

The End

⬥ BT 1 will be responsible for tagging reds and BT 2 will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] them. It is important that everyone either glitches out of arms or stays MD while this is done, to avoid receiving damage from red. The BT that tags must also go to the wall as soon as possible to avoid sharing Red Bombs.

​

⬥ After that, BT 1 will build to 100% asap and will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] everyone right before the stand up of Vorago. Following that, the BT, who is [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]'d (BT 2), should move away so the red goes to him.

​

⬥ If there are Ranger [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] + Mage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] BTs, it is preferable that the Ranged BT uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the Mage BT that will tag the reds.

​

⬥ Before the last Waterfall, whoever is mauling must have Piece (a) and Piece (b) in their inventory. Make sure to grab the Piece (c) and make the maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] before Phase 10 starts.

​

⬥ One of the BT must drop a dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] at the end of this phase, preferably during the last waterfall and close to the middle.

​

Phase 10 and 11 Overview

The strategies for the 6 rotations can be summarised into two methods: the safe method and the fast or advanced method.

​

For the Phase 10 and 11 sections, all the DPS must place their ultimates in melee distance. Whenever an ultimate is mentioned, it is already implied that it should be place in md.

​

⬥ Bomb Tanks will always split sides: one BT North (usually the one that ultimates) and the other BT South (DPS side)

​

⬥ Both BTs must use Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] in Phase 9 when Vorago dies for Scopulus, Vitalis, Green Bomb and The End. This is done to block the first blue in Phase 10 and then Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] (if needed) the second one. For Phase 11, BTs and DPS should use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] when it is available

​

⬥ If BTs do not have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] active at the same time, the pushback from the blue will not be nullified

​

⬥ For 4 man teams the Base and TL5 will take a side too. Base usually goes South and TL5 North. This is only helpful on rotations with Green Bomb and Purple Bomb, as it is easier to tank the specials without having to move from the team

​

Safe Method

It requires everyone to Ultimate on dropdown except for one of the Bomb Tanks. The other BT will use a threshold or two (depending on adrenaline management), and then build to 100% to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]. The first blue should be blocked by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt], giving more time to build to Barricade. In the next phase, the BT that used [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] will now build to ultimate and vice versa.

​

Advanced Method

Requires everyone to Ultimate except for one BT (South) that will use all the strong thresholds and special attacks available. This is done to help with the push, usually referred to as 0-Link (zero link), to avoid having to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]. This method is not recommended on a team with multiple learners.

The reason why only one of the BT will Ultimate is because the damage needed to push should be enough from the rest of the team's Ultimates and the BT thresholds. This way the BT that didn't Ultimate can do so in Phase 11

​

The safe method is not considered a common strategy anymore (as it aims for less damage and a longer phase), but it is still recommended when there are multiple learners in the team.

​

The fast (advanced) method relies on the team pushing Vorago non-stop, but on a team with low damage it is hard to do so without a set rotation.

​

Phase 10

In addition to the two methods, there are also some things to point out for some rotations. Make sure to also read about Broken Team Splits below, because it is a bug that happens on every rotation that has as the second special.

​

Ceilings & Team Split

Avoid using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] before the phase starts because team split cancels defensives and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]. Save it for after the team split regardless of what method the team is using. If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] is used for the team split special, make sure to use it after the team split and not before the special. This also applies to Scopulus and Green Bomb.

​

Ceilings, Scopulus, Vitalis, & The End

The DPS must step back to block the Vitalis orb in Phase 10 and 11. Make sure to not go further than Bomb Tanks, to avoid sharing Blue Bombs with each other. For the safe method, one of the BT will [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] the whole team before the Vitalis orb is launched. BTs will rotate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] for each cycle if needed.

​

Green Bomb

Deal with the Green Bomb as usual. If it is on a Bomb Tank, they should use their Vitality potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]. Optional: If the Bomb Tank's HP is too low, the Base Tank can heal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] them before the green hits. If it is on the DPS, eat up and let it bounce amongst the pile. Tank it (with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]) on your side of the arena if it is a 4 man team.

​

The right [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] timing must be used to ensure a consistent Phase 11. Read below for the timings.

At the end of the arena in Phase 10, and before it is mauled, the BT should drop a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] to build at the start of the next phase. This is even more helpful with a Shield Dome maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 sd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul], explained below.

​

Broken Team Split

[https://img.pvme.io/images/fvNg9AV.png Guide illustration]

Specials marked with a red font represent a broken Team Split. You will notice that it is always going to happen when Team Split is the second special in Phase 10 or 11.

A broken Team Split is one where Vorago is able to throw autos (Melee or Blue Bombs) while charging the team split.

The best way to reduce the damage from these is to not attack Vorago at all after the Reflect ends.

If you get autos during a broken team split, simply Pray Deflect Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage], go to your colour box and eat up. Make sure to go closer to Vorago as soon as the Team Split explodes, otherwise you will drag more Blue Bombs into the DPS pile.

​

Mauling Phase 10

Mauling phase 10 is typically the TL5's job, unless the base is meleeing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] - this is because a melee base would always be in MD and will be able to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] at the right time. The timing for the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] is important because it determines what happens at the start of Phase 11.

You must always wait for the special to be released before mauling, otherwise Vorago will start the next phase with it instead of Auto Attacks.

​

If we take the example of Scopulus week, Vorago's rotation for phases 10 and 11 are as follows:

⬥ Phase 10: Purple Bomb release → 5 Attacks → Reflect (for 3 Attacks) → 3 Attacks → Team Split → 3 Attacks

​

⬥ Phase 11: Purple Bomb release → 5 Attacks → Reflect (for 3 Attacks) → 3 Attacks → Vitalis orb → 3 Attacks

​

If you maul in Phase 10 after 2 Attacks have been released, Vorago has 3 remaining Attacks in his rotation (because in Phase 10, there are a total of 5 autos before the Reflect). At the start of Phase 11, he would perform these 3 autos before continuing with his rotation, and going into reflect.

If you mauled 4 Attacks autos after purple release at the start of Phase 10, there would be 1 remaining Attack. This means that Phase 11 would begin with 1 auto before going into Reflect. This leads to a high chance of killing other people as people attempt to DPS at the start of the phase.

If you are unsure of how many Attacks have been fired, it is better to keep Vorago in the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] spot and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] when reflect starts.

​

In summary, there are 3 times to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] that are optimal for the kill, as they maximise the number of Attacks in Phase 11 before the next special:

⬥ #1: When the first special begins

​

⬥ #2 When Reflect starts

​

⬥ #3: When the second special begins

​

Mauling as soon as Reflect starts is good for all rotations, but it is not the best option.

While this can seem complicated at first, mauling at the right time makes the kill easier because you do not have to calculate how many autos remain from the Phase 10 rotation before the next special will occur in Phase 11.

​

The following chart shows all the possible [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] timings for each rotation, and they assume the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] occurred as soon as the special started, with no autos in between the special release and the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul].

[https://img.pvme.io/images/9tJk0aI.png Guide illustration]

If you get more than 2 autos after a Special, go to the next [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] timing as it is best to skip the first timing to optimise the amount of Attacks on the next phase.

​

Shield Dome Mauling

This is a strategy that allows you to skip the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] animation in Phase 10. It does not save time but allows everyone to build on the dummy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1 dummy] while Vorago is still talking.

It is done by using Shield Dome [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 sd] before clicking the maul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] while Vorago is in the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul] spot. do not spam clicking your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 sd] or the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736524968174682132.png?v=1 maul], otherwise it will not work.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/3X7xQ5k.mp4 Source media]

Phase 11

This phase is dealt with in the same way as Phase 10, and following the same descriptions in the Overview above,

The Bomb Tank that used Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] in Phase 10 should now build to Ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] and the other BT should build to Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade].

Depending on the push, it might be better for BTs to Ultimate and threshold respectively. Only use Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] for one of the specials in Phase 11.

​

Acknowledgements

This guide originally came from the [https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH Rago Hub Discord community (external Discord)]

​

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

⬥ Solo Hardmode Vorago is one of the hardest PvM challenges in the game and will require good improvisation skills. Therefore, a strong understanding of the combat system is required.

⬥ A basic understanding of the boss and P10/11 pushback is assumed and strong knowledge of solo normal mode P5 will translate well to hardmode and save time learning

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended to read [[PvME/Vorago/Introductory Necro Solo Vorago Guide|Introductory Necro Solo Vorago Guide]] first to make sure you have a base knowledge of solo Vorago

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is assumed you have 6/6 solo NM Vorago before attempting this

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A good goal before starting is to solo all normal mode weeks before 2nd spec

​

Preset and Relics

P10/11 Overview

Stalling Vorago

⬥ One of the most important thing for this phase is extending the amount of time you have to do damage

⬥ Keep Vorago moving (Push/Pushback) because this stalls out his next attack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• String together lots of damage at the same time

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] used during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] to keep the push going

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not waste [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt], instead use it only when about to maul or if the blue would not extend your DPS window

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For example, the blue right before you bomb stack usually lands after reflect starts. This is the optimal bomb to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

⬥ When you [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] since there is minimal push and no push-back Vorago will quickly throw out autos

​

Applying Debuffs

⬥ Aim to apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] when in a TeamSplit or when running out to bomb stack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] can also be used at the end of these to maximise the damage window from them

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is VERY important on P10 TeamSplit week due to the minimal damage windows

​

Defence Scaling

⬥ Upkeeping [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] is of utmost importance to raise your hitchance from ~87% to 100%

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stacks applied P10 carry over into P11

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ On Ceilings / Scopulus / Purple Bomb it is important to end P10 at 100% hitchance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ts2SAbqoMs.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Vorago will increase its defence based on how close it is from maul spot, starting at 90 defence and scaling up to 97.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get pushed back from the starting point it won't decrease below 90.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For P11 he has maintains the max Defence of 97 from P10

​

Stacking Bombs

⬥ Anytime you are melee distance to Vorago, you run a chance of either getting a blue or a melee hit + blue, so stacks are not perfectly consistent

​

⬥ 3 auto stack:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Consists of a 9-11 tile blue → 2-3 tile blue → md auto to potentially negate 2 autos worth of pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• So, stand 9-11 tiles away, wait for the first blue to release, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] into 2-3 tile range, wait for the second blue to release, then walk md

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This requires the player to not attack the boss in order to prepare for a 9-11 square auto. Also, pushing the boss during a triple stack will ruin it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For solo hm in particular, this is useful for P10/P11 reflects that are not barricaded [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VFBW3xK.mp4 Source media]

​

⬥ 2 auto stack:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Consists of a 2-3 tile blue → md auto to potentially negate 1 auto worth of pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If done outside of a reflect, take this time to use weaker abilities to build adrenaline. Pushing the boss while trying to stack will stagger the auto timings

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For solo hm in particular, this is useful for P10/P11 to stack 1st and 2nd autos of reflect if close to instakill ledge

[https://img.pvme.io/images/PNOiPlW.mp4 Source media]

​

⬥ PB stack:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Consists of a PB landing + blue to potentially negate 1 auto worth of pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can go a step further and combine this with other stack methods to negate even more pushback

​

Broken TeamSplit

⬥ A broken TS [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160675647538.png?v=1 brokents] will occur for every teamsplit immediately after a reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• TeamSplit Week: Even-numbered TeamSplits during P10

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scopulus Week: TeamSplits during P10

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green Bomb Week: TeamSplits during P11

​

⬥ Vorago will be able to attack much sooner than normal during a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160675647538.png?v=1 brokents]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago pushes you due to receiving damage after the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160675647538.png?v=1 brokents] spawns the teamsplit will be more broken than usual

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It will throw 2 blue bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/923249600276615200.png?v=1 bluebomb] one a tick next to each other during or before the explosion

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Vorago doesn't push you back it will result in a usual broken teamsplit, throwing the first blue bomb during or shortly after its explosion

​

⬥ Use one of the following to un-break TS: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1 commandzombie] during the TS can help immensely as well

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example of an extremely broken teamsplit, where you get pushed back after the teamsplit spawns:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/P70FQse.mp4 Source media]

​

‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Example of a usual broken teamsplit, where you don’t get pushed back after the teamsplit spawns:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/SOJZVNC.mp4 Source media]

​

Vitalis Orbs and Red Bombs

⬥ 3-5 Vitalis spawn every orb in hardmode

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you stand on the orb, one less than normal will spawn (2-4)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Often you will not have line of sight of all of them

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple can spawn on the same tile

⬥ The goal should be to instantly deal with vits, and often you will want to be under [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

⬥ Necromancy alleviates most of the issues of vits once you get used to the timing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1 deathguard90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] should deal with them

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Make sure to have 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] or at least 8 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you don't [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] should be used prior to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] (or if in general you aren't killing them with your first ability)

​

⬥ Target cycle before you can see them physically spawn (usually on vit orb explosion)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is worth it to lose ticks while vit orb is coming out to get the target cycle timing correct

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In this example, watch for when the EoF keybind (on the bottom action bar) lights up for the target cycle timing

[https://img.pvme.io/images/62f4JyxcH3.mp4 Source media]

​

⬥ Stay roughly in the center of where vits spawn to have the highest likelihood of no LoS issues

⬥ If you miss the target cycle or do not have LoS of some of the vits, focus on maintaining LoS with Vorago above all

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Otherwise he will free walk forwards and you will lose a lot of squares of push

⬥ This clip misses target cycle but manages to keep LoS of Vorago and then maneuver to a position to get LoS to kill the vit which ran away

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dRmPHHeLmN.mp4 Source media]

​

⬥ Vitalis will still block LoS even during death animation. Make sure to get back into LoS of Vorago by running MD

[https://img.pvme.io/images/QDZAkc4xQ2.mp4 Source media]

​

⬥ After 24 Vitalis have spawned, no more can spawn

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The vit orb explosion will still deal 1 square of pushback, but just don't get hit by it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If only 1 Vitalis spawned on a Vit orb, the cap has been reached (since at minimum 2 will spawn in other scenarios)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This does NOT happen on Vitalis week

⬥ If Vorago is within 3 tiles of pushing you off P10 or 6 tiles P11, he will throw out a red bomb instead of a vit orb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This comes with the standard non-homing blue

[https://img.pvme.io/images/tquHWoDjTP.mp4 Source media]

​

⬥ This can be utilised to slowly work towards vit cap by greatly staggering when vits come out

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] will always be up when dealing with vits this way

⬥ This can lead to "Red Bomb Hell"

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Since you are close to the edge, you are no longer able to do a 3-stack during reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It takes a lot of push to get away from the edge and get back to spawning vit orbs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Having [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] ready for the push immediately after the red bomb spawns can help alleviate this

​

Mauling

⬥ It is very important to maul at a specific time rather than whenever Vorago is in maul spot

[https://img.pvme.io/images/9tJk0aI.png Guide illustration] ​

⬥ The goal for maul-timing is to avoid Vitalis for the longest period of time. There are two options for this:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First option is to maul whenever it would take the longest for the Vit orb spec to happen

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Second option is to maul whenever Vit orb is next, but you force the red bomb special instead

​

⬥ There are a few main exceptions to this rule

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teamsplit does not have Vitalis either phase

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Maul on Reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green bomb does not have Vitalis on P11

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you do not vit-cap, maul whenever as long as you believe you can consistently do the P11

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you do vit-cap, maul on Reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vitalis has Vitalis on P10 and P11

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Maul on reflect to be able to deal with bleeds effectively P11

​

Ceilings P10/11 Overview

⬥ P10 is TeamSplit/Green Bomb:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stall out this phase to be able to reach 100% hitchance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] before going into P11 to be able to deal with vits

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] after TeamSplit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] the end of reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770709530161192.png?v=1 wardentop90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770705688174652.png?v=1 wardenlegs90] to tank the Green Bombs

⬥ Maul either on GB release or on Reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If mauling on reflect you will want to bait out the red bomb start of P10

​

⬥ P11 is TeamSplit/Vitalis:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When learning, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] may not be off cooldown every vit orb for target cycle

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Just [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] when possible and potentially you will have to kill vits during TeamSplit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] either after TeamSplit or before Vit orb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] during reflects

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298313980182541.png?v=1 adrenrenewalflask] is needed to maximise [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] due to tight damage windows this week

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Do not rely on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] without [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298313980182541.png?v=1 adrenrenewalflask]

​

Scopulus P10/11 Overview

⬥ P10 is PB/Broken TS:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stall out this phase to be able to reach 100% hitchance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] before going into P11 to be able to deal with vits

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Very large damage window after broken teamsplit to do a full [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] rotation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] during PB such that it lasts through reflect

⬥ Mauling on reflect and baiting out the red bomb the start of P11 is the easiest

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is hard to maul on TS

​

⬥ P11 is PB/Vitalis:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] end of reflect to be able to deal with vitalis

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] end of reflects when you don't have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] isn't cleared by either mechanic and will always run the full duration, making it very strong

​

Vitalis P10/11 Overview

⬥ P10 is Vit/PB:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] solely for dealing with Vitalis

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] at the end of reflect or during purple bomb

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] isn't cleared by either mechanic and will always run the full duration, making it very strong

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Resummon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] once you are at 100% hitchance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones]

⬥ Maul on reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To do so, get Vorago into maul position before vit orb spawns

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 cadeturtling] and run melee distance

​

⬥ P11 is Vit/Bleeds:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The beginning of this phase is where you are most likely to fail

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Save [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] for start of P11

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Vorago will throw 3 blue bombs before bleeds start

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to clear bleeds, you need to stand melee distance + have not lost any tiles

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] rotation works well to get the 2 tiles you need

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] is for dealing with vitalis

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] end of reflects

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] isn't cleared by either mechanic and will always run the full duration, making it very strong

​

Green Bomb P10/11 Overview

⬥ P10 is GB/Vit:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is the hardest phase to aim to vit cap

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770709530161192.png?v=1 wardentop90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770705688174652.png?v=1 wardenlegs90] to tank the Green Bombs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Red Bomb Hell is even harder to deal with since to trigger a red bomb you must be even closer to the edge on P10 than in P11

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] to deal with vits

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] end of reflects

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] isn't cleared by either mechanic and will always run the full duration, making it very strong

⬥ Maul on reflect if you have vit-capped

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not, maul at any point if you believe you can salvage the P11

​

⬥ P11 is GB / Broken TS:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] in broken TS

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Aim to always have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298313980182541.png?v=1 adrenrenewalflask], do not rely on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] once you un-break the TS

​

TeamSplit P10/11 Overview

⬥ P10 is TS/Broken TS:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] during the broken TS

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] after the normal TS

⬥ Maul on Reflect

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] the 3rd bomb after TS while Vorago is in maul spot to do so

​

⬥ P11 is TS/PB:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] after TeamSplit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] end of reflects

​

Purple Bomb P10/11 Overview

⬥ P10 is PB/Bleeds:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same as normal mode P5 but the PB causes one square of pushback

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stall out this phase to be able to reach 100% hitchance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968330582700174.png?v=1 invokelordofbones] before going into P11 to be able to deal with vits

⬥ Maul after the third bleed or on Reflect if you aim to get a red bomb start of P11

​

⬥ P11 is PB/Vitalis:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] end of reflect to be able to deal with vitalis

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] end of reflects when you don't have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] isn't cleared by either mechanic and will always run the full duration, making it very strong

​

Example Kills

Example Kills
⬥ [https://youtu.be/FcyUXV0KJxM Ceilings] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/XHJUhqJi2HY Scopulus] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/-SjamYR9r7g Vitalis] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/4qkqf_Z3NlA Green Bomb] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/eorHN04EwvU TeamSplit] ⬥ [https://youtu.be/-L2zxU173zU Purple Bomb]

​

Once you have gotten a Solo Hardmode kill, feel free to submit your kill to the sheet!

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

For more information visit the [https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH Rago Hub Discord community (external Discord)]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pnLUzwq.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

Trio Hard Mode is one of the most challenging fights at Vorago. Weekly changing special mechanics, several combat style compositions, and an individually varying player skill level - All of this results in the fight being very dynamic and at times extremely difficult.

​

This Trio Hard Mode Strategy Guide will be separated into roles, combat styles, and skill levels. Generally speaking, the strategies described can be applied to most, if not all combat style compositions.

​

General Requirements

⬥ Proper gear (T90+ weapons, T80+ power armour, Invention perks)

⬥ The team's Base Tank (melee) is responsible for applying the Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] special attack in all phases

⬥ A base knowledge for approaching Vorago in Hard Mode, all its weekly special attacks and appropriate intuition for occurrences such as random Red Bombs

⬥ Intercept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept]

⬥ Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther]

⬥ Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] (14k entry hit, Green Bomb damage, Team Split damage)

​

Recommendations

⬥ Seren Godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb]

⬥ Zaros Godsword [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] for the Base Tank

⬥ Eldritch Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] for ranging Bomb Tanks

⬥ Target Cycle

⬥ Nihil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil]

​

Base Tank - Introduction [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Uz1pzBM.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

Basing Trio Hard Mode is typically performed by a Melee. The Base Tank has several responsibilities, the most important being to apply the Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] special attack in every phase. Additionally you are expected to properly lure Vorago in phase 1 on the eastern wall so that the Climber (referred to as Bomb Tank #2) does not receive any Blue Bombs.

​

Required

⬥ Statius's Warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] (stored in an Essence of Finality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1 eofblacku], you will be using at least 10 SWH specs per kill, this can be very costly otherwise)

​

Recommended

⬥ Heightened Senses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773573771344.png?v=1 heightenedsenses] (this relic is essential for approaching fast kills with advanced strategies)

⬥ Stalling Abilities

⬥ Refer to the official Rago Hub spreadsheet for advanced ability damage rotations: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing]

​

Strategy Summary

[https://img.pvme.io/images/DZCJcev.png Guide illustration]

Base Tank - Phases 1 & 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack]

Base Tank - Phase 1

⬥ In phase 1 the Base Tank is responsible for luring Vorago in such a way that the top lure cannot receive Blue Bombs. This also causes the Base Tank to receive Blue Bombs on top of melee Swipes, therefore pray flicking between melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 DeflectMage] is required. Additionally, when the kill timer reaches ~ 30 seconds, you must bring the boss close enough to the final platform of the climb, from where the Climber will voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago into jump spot.

​

⬥ The easiest way to position correctly in the start is by standing east of Vorago's spawn location, tagging the boss, moving two tiles to the east, and finally two tiles to the south. By moving two tiles east, Vorago is far enough away from the Climber. Moving two tiles south and then attacking the boss causes you to face north-west, enabling the capability of simply surging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] north-west when it is time to take the boss closer to the Top Lure.

​

⬥ You should surge as the top lure is jumping the last ledge. Continue running to stall Vorago until the Top Lure vokes, then bladed dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] south. Provoke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago, and wait for the Top Lure to jump.

​

⬥ One of the most important aspects of Phase 1 is to pay attention to Vorago's lifepoints - You do not want to deplete it too quickly, as you may accidentally reset the HP. Due to the ease of getting Vorago's HP low enough in time, you will generally have to slow your damage down intentionally before surging.

​

Base Tank - Phase 4 Scopulus

The Base Tank has to lure all Scopuli, in addition to hammering the eastern and northern Scopulus. A frequent usage of Vulnerability bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] is very useful for keeping up all Scopuli's stacked and aggressive towards you, due to vuln bombs dragging Scopulus' aggro.

​

⬥ Strategy

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand directly west of the western Scopulus

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Throw a Vulnerability Bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] 3 - 4 seconds before Target Cycle to the eastern Scopulus's spawn location

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Throw another bomb as soon as possible (after 3 ticks) directly under you in order to drag the western Scopulus's aggression

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attack both southern Scopuli with a few abilities [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] first Scop > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] second Scop

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As the northern Scopulus comes close enough, target, attack and voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Run directly south by a few tiles and back north, straight through the Scopuli (this should stack the Scopuli next to / on top of each other)

​

⬥ For slower phases you should utilise Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] and eventually Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect].

​

​

​

⬥ If a Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] occurs in this phase, it is best to utilise your Seren Godbow special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1 ingen] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] shortly after.

Base Tank - Phase 6 Green Bomb

At the beginning of the phase, it is recommended to voke [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] Vorago and walk the boss far enough so that you will not be harmed by a mid mist, and can attack vorago from at least two different of the 9 grid arena sections of the arena.

​

⬥ Strategy

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apply SWH [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] as soon as possible

​

⬥ On this phase, you will simply be dumping thresholds. On Target Cycle, release your hammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh] with a bled assault [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] and continue to thresh.

​

⬥ SGB [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] can be perfectly implemented in your pre-Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] ability damage rotation.

​

⬥ If you receive a Green Bomb, simply drink a sip of your Powerburst of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] in order to easily survive it. If the Green Bomb is not on you, it is an optimal strategy to heal the respective Bomb Tank, shortly after they tanked the 10,000 detonation damage.

​

Introduction

Bomb Tanking at Trio Hard Mode can be performed in several setups. This section focuses Ranged, covering both Bomb Tank's responsibilities: Bomb Tank #1 and Bomb Tank #2 (the Climber). If you are Ranged bomb tanking with a Hybrid on your team, read up on both this and the Hybrid section. This guide section also covers strategies for approaching Double Ranged bomb tanking in Trio Hard Mode.

Ranged Bomb Tank - Phase 1

⬥ It is always recommended to have one Bomb Tank ranging in Trio Hard Mode, who will pre-Ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] start of Phase 1 and deal damage to Vorago, referred to as Bomb Tank #1. The other Bomb Tank is responsible for Climbing and Top Luring, also referred to as Bomb Tank #2.

​

⬥ A simple Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] standard rotation should be enough to bring Vorago's lifepoints low enough before the Climber jumps. Your Ultimate should be placed right in melee distance, west of Vorago's spawn location. This position should provide you 100% uptime of your Ultimate for most locations that Vorago is lured to. Slow down dealing damage as Vorago reaches 50,000 HP and off early enough to avoid a reset.

​

⬥ If the Base Tank receives the second Red Bomb (random), you should cast Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] to support the Base Tank's food management.

​

⬥ Phase 1 initial positioning

​

Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 1

⬥ It is always recommended to have one Bomb Tank ranging in Trio Hard Mode, who will pre-Ultimate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] start of Phase 1 and deal damage to Vorago. The other Bomb Tank is responsible for Climbing and Top Luring, also referred to as Bomb Tank #2.

​

⬥ As Magic Bomb Tank you will most likely be the one climbing in Phase 1.

​

⬥ Yet, if you happen to be the one DPSing, a simple Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] standard rotation should be enough to bring Vorago's lifepoints low enough before the Climber jumps. Your Ultimate should be placed right in melee distance, west of Vorago's spawn location. This position should provide you 100% uptime of your Ultimate for most locations that Vorago is lured to. Slow down dealing damage as Vorago reaches 50,000 HP and off early enough to avoid a reset.

​

⬥ If the Base Tank receives the second Red Bomb (random), you should cast Heal Other [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 HealOther] to support the Base Tank's food management.

Your Base Tank is responsible for stacking all 3 Scopuli. At times though, a Scopulus might reaggro to one of the Bomb Tanks. In this case: run! Make sure to stay at the outside of the arena in order to avoid passing any Blue Bombs to your Base Tank.

Introduction

A general Hybrid setup for Trio HM consists of Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack] as primary and either Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] or Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] as secondary combat style. Magic is recommended due to the naturally increased hitchance on Scopuli. At the current unbalanced state of combat styles, there exists only one method of making Hybrid effective over a double Ranged Bomb Tank setup. Hybridding is only recommended if your goal is improved kill speed, as your team is a lot more likely to lose a kill.

​

⬥ It is highly discouraged to take a BoB familiar (Mammoth scrolls with Soups [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336701933060106.png?v=1 sailfishsoup]), due to the lost accuracy from a Nihil familiar already making Ranged a better choice over Hybrid. Therefore a Hybrid setup ends up having a very small amount of food (1 - 3 inventory slots). The selected aura should be Berserker [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1 berserker].

​

⬥ In phases 1, 2, 4 (Scopulus) and 9 the Hybrid Bomb Tank uses the secondary combat style, Ranged or Magic.

​

⬥ Throughout phases 3 - 8 (excluding Scopulus P4) Melee is to be used. A primary portion of these phases will require you (the Hybridder) and the Base Tank to step under Vorago, with the BT#1 voking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] the boss.

​

⬥ Depending on the outcome of your Phase 10, you will either camp Melee for the start of P11 or switch to your secondary combat style immediately during phase transition.

​

⬥ As Hybrid Bomb Tank you will be the one climbing in Phase 1.

​

Weekly Special Mechanics - Phases 9, 10, & 11

Introduction

Trio Hard Mode approaches Phase 9 similar to Duo / Trio Normal Mode Phase 4. The person barricading [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] last on P9 should be the person that does not barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] start of P10.

​

Phases 10 and 11 vary the most, relying on the same factors as described in the intro to this Trio Hard Mode guide: Weekly changing special mechanics, several combat style compositions and an individually varying player skill level. This section of the guide will cover 2 basic guidelines of strategies for differently approaching phases 10 and 11: Safe vs Advanced.

​

Safe Strategies

A stable order of Ultimates [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] and Barricades [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] for consistently finishing a Trio Hard Mode kill fast with safe strategies.

Powercreep goes brrrrrr. Essentially simply follow the Rago Hub spreadsheet ability damage rotations:

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#2 ultimate and thresh, build to cade cept [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] for the second Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

​

Advanced Phases 10 & 11

Approaching phases 10 and 11 in advanced teams is independent of weekly mechanics.

​

Overview

⬥ In Phase 10 you always aim for 0-speccing (get to maul before the spec release, e.g. Purple Bomb or Vitalis orb ). This is achieved by pushing consecutively every 3 ticks for 8 tiles from Target Cycle on. Once you reached maul spot, you wait for the spec to release and maul right after.

​

⬥ If Phase 10 was executed correctly, Phase 11 should always start with 3 auto attacks (5 if first P10 spec is Green Bomb or Purple Bomb) into the second spec of P11.

​

Rotations

For optimal execution of phases 10 and 11 simply refer to the Rago Hub spreadsheet:

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing]

​

Acknowledgements

It's imperative to treat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] as a switch, not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej] as a switch.

⬥ If you end up using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] when Zemouregal has around 70k HP left, move [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] up and use it with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] to instantly KO Zemouregal. Alternatively, if you get an early [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] proc and 3+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1 primordialice] stacks for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec], you can replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] and two [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1 gmaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec].

​

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/FysXlFOwOW.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics, and will go over how to quickly kill Zemouregal & Vorkath with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] only.

​

This is a strong option that can achieve 30+ kph without hybridding, and can comfortably achieve the Grandmaster timer while style camping.

​

Preset and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3d8cabf4-4985-47c2-93ce-27465be6aca5 Method 1] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=5ad255b1-85e1-4f24-849b-9b626401d820 Method 2] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F5ad255b1-85e1-4f24-849b-9b626401d820.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Method 1

⬥ Apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] at bank for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej]

⬥ Utilize [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] for reduced damage from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1 vorkath] and minions, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] is a viable alternative familiar if struggling.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] can be taken.

​

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → enter portal

Fort Forinthry

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] while Fort textures loading → claim loot and rejoin instance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + click door → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] again when 0:00 visible on boss timer

Vorkath

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Zemouregal → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → target [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1 vorkath] + s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1 lengoh]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] + 1t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] away from spikes → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike]

Zemouregal

Two rotation options are provided using either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof]

​

Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] on Zemouregal → stall w/basics until less than 10 sec left on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] cooldown → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1 vorkath] to phase below 765k + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] once available → target Zemouregal + s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → s[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → r[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1 ballista] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

​

Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] on Zemouregal → stall w/basics until less than 10 sec left on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] cooldown → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1 vorkath] to phase below 765k

​

target Zemouregal + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1 annihilation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + 2t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1 varanussmercy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

​

Notes:

⬥ Loading into Fort Forinthry is very intensive. Reducing draw distance and turning off textures can reduce load times.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] is required since this rotation does not skip Zemouregal's [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike]

⬥ Hit chance on Zemouregal is very tight under [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba]. If brewed down at all or without maximum accuracy, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] is necessary to maintain 100% hitchance.

⬥ It is extremely important to control damage to not overphase Vorkath below 765k into flight phase while there is significant >13 sec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] cooldown remaining. If this happens, the chance of a successful kill is low.

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1 ballista] 2-3 ticks into the first [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault]. Do not activate a 2nd [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1 ballista] until after Vorkath departs for flight.

​

Method 2

⬥ This rotation uses Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4]

⬥ Being on task is not required.

⬥ You need to flick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] to maintain LP with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• May use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] instead.

​

War's Retreat

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh]) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur]

Fort Forinthry

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] + claim + instance → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] + enter door + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge]

Vorkath

(tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] + 1t [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → click Zemouregal + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → click [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1 vorkath] + (equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] 3t → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478166426190741584.png?v=1 rend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1 ballista] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1 gflurry] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062904732418159.png?v=1 slaughter] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062911619469495.png?v=1 massacre] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842595639306.png?v=1 jawsoftheabyss] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → basics until 764k phased

Zemouregal

(equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1 amhej]) build to 120 adren → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb]

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → any defensive → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1 gbarge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1 ballista] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1 lengmh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → improv

​

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/FysXlFOwOW.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

Zemouregal & Vorkath is a boss encounter consisting of two bosses; Zemouregal and Vorkath. To access this encounter, the players must progress through the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Battle_of_Forinthry Battle of Forinthry]. Completion of the quest unlocks the normal mode and hardmode encounters.

​

Applicable Damage boosts for Vorkath
