Mechanics (Hardmode)

Mechanics
Power meter
⬥ Displays the connection between Zemouregal and Vorkath, affecting damage absorption and damage dealt by Vorkath.     • Each next phase increases it by net 25%.     • Empowered zombies can increase it by 50%.     • Power meter disappears when vorkath leaves at zero lifepoints. ​
Dragonfire Breath
⬥ Vorkath charges up and deals a big magic hit.     • Damage is reduced by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1 superantifire] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] ​
Zonal Ice Breath
⬥ Vorkath takes to the air and spews ice on his location that spreads outward, after which he comes back down.     • Can deal three [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] hits and one MD [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] slam.         • Can be avoided by moving away from Vorkath, also protecting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 summoning] familiars.     • The [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] hits damage Zemouregal and all minions caught within it. ​
Poison pools
⬥ Vorkath will stand on his hind legs and spew into the air, causing pools that hit hard typeless damage to appear.     • Phase 2: Green poison pools, hitting up to 3k.     • Phase 3: Purple poison pools, hitting up to 5k.         • Every hit taken increases Zemouregal's Empowerment debuff by 5%, increasing damage taken.     • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: Spew your venom, my malformed pet! ​
Fly
⬥ Vorkath flies up high to freeze the whole arena by air strike. If not stopped, all in the arena will be hit ~15k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage, killing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 summoning] familiars.     • Using the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1 balista] (extra action button) while Vorkath is up will shoot Vorkath down, preventing the attack and dealing a 10k hit to Vorkath.         • Can fail if done right before Vorkath returns!     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] can be used alternatively.     • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: Cast my glorious vengeance down upon them! or Cut them down without mercy! ​
Power Meter and Damage Reduction
⬥ The power meter increases Vorkath's damage dealt by auto attacks as well as mechanics. ⬥ While Vorkath is around, Zemouregal takes no or reduced damage.     • Every phase transition Zemouregal gets hit 10k by Vorkath, reducing his damage reduction by 10% (100%→90%→80%). ⬥ If Zemouregal gets hit while shielded, a green orb is sent to Vorkath, giving him damage absorption based on the damage dealt on Zemouregal.     • Vorkath's damage absorption is multiplied by the power meter % and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 vuln]. ​
Minions
⬥ Zemouregal summons two minions, one of each type.     • This is a time-based mechanic which resets on phasing.     • Combat minions (36k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] per player)         • Skeleton ranger         • Zombie warrior         • Skeleton knight         • Phantom Spellcaster     • Support minions (6k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] per player)         • Ghost Healer, heals Vorkath 1000 lifepoints.         • Zombie Shielder, gives Vorkath a shield, reducing incoming damage.         • Empowering Zombie, adds +50% to the power meter temporarily. ​
Bone Spikes
⬥ Zemouregal makes a dust cloud appear on every player's location, where 4.2s later spikes shoot out of the ground.     • This is a time-based mechanic which resets on phasing.     • Can deal up to 8k soft typeless damage to every player in the 7x7 area.     • Can be avoided by moving away from your location. ​
Soul sap
⬥ Zemouregal uses soul sap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap], gaining one [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul]. ​
Soul Strike
⬥ Zemouregal uses soul strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike], using up one [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and stunning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] his target for 3 seconds. ​
Finger of Death
⬥ Zemouregal uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath], hitting up to 10k through [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941136397324448.png?v=1 protectfromnecro].     • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: Die! ​
Death Skulls
⬥ Zemouregal uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls], hitting up to 7k through [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941136397324448.png?v=1 protectfromnecro]     • Can bounce between players, and also be cancelled by moving more than 6 tiles away. ​
Blood Siphon
⬥ Zemouregal uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon]     • Any of his combat minions will run to his side, healing him and increasing the damage dealt on Zemouregal's target.     • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: I'll make a feast of your blood, and be strengthened ​
Volley of Souls
⬥ Zemouregal uses Volley of souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] hitting up to 3k three times.     • Is only used in Phase 3.     • Can only be used when Zemouregal is at 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] stacks.     • Can be accompanied by the voiceline: Your life is payment for this folley! ​

​

Introduction

⬥ This rotation is consistent for farming and yields multiple GM timers per hour, without flight skips

⬥ Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716885265252382.png?v=1 dracolichcoif] flight skips are very inconsistent and risky

⬥ Expect times from 1:43 to 1:53 when done correctly

⬥ For safer but slower farming, you can swap in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Downgrades will require some improv on P4 Zemouregal

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E9HmNuzAe2.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

Zamorak, Lord of Chaos is the fifth and final instalment in the Elder God Wars dungeon. This guide will primarily focus on the final boss encounter. For help clearing the dungeon, refer to [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak Dungeon|Zamorak Dungeon]]. If you would like a more simple version of the guide for your first few kills, refer to [[PvME/Zamorak/Overview|Zamorak Basic]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=dc2b2947-f705-4bdd-a557-27783697454e Hybrid]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3da02410-dd19-42de-87b7-ea3ead262b81 Melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6958cd6e-91eb-4a07-ad9b-789e7bdcc42d Necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=b0545387-32d0-4d6f-815b-04416fe0c04b Ranged]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9c8ce868-3e1f-4b76-8b4a-da0b8fb174ac Magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9c8ce868-3e1f-4b76-8b4a-da0b8fb174ac.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Checklist and Unlocks
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] Zuk cape for your chosen style ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] Disruption Shield unlocked ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] Toolbelt Infernal Puzzle Box unlocked. ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] Passive Ring of Vigour unlocked ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1 temporalanomaly] Darkness/Temporal Anomaly active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] Thermal spa HP boost active

​

Recommended Upgrades

These items should be part of your preset if available and will aid in being able to follow the rotations and strategies in our Zamorak guides

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] Melee

Fight Overview

Zamorak has 6 phases that are progressed by depleting his health bar and charging the 6 edicts, or pads, located around the arena. During each phase he will cycle through 3 health bar colours, each with their own effects that dictate the progression of the fight:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/XvTHsFcxSC.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Grey HP: The health bar Zamorak starts with and regains between each phase

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will have accelerated 4-tick attack speed and deal 50% more damage, but won't use special attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cannot be fully depleted through damage and will constantly regenerate itself at an increasing rate

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Starts at a soft cap that can regenerate itself up to a hard cap of double the starting value

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The soft cap will increase with uninterrupted healing at the current cap

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A healing tick can only restore up to the cap if current grey HP is lower than it

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Damage is calculated before healing on the same tick, even a tiny amount of damage can prevent the cap from increasing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ DoT effects like [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] are very effective at preventing the soft cap from increasing

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 900% enrage, the regeneration increase will carry over between grey HP phases

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon activating a pad, all remaining grey HP will be converted into red HP

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An increased grey HP soft cap, or hard cap, never carries over between grey HP phases and always resets to the initial soft cap

[https://img.pvme.io/images/TZEQHE85wb.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Red HP: The health bar Zamorak gains upon the player activating a pad

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will have accelerated 4-tick attack speed and deal 50% more damage, and will do his next special attack every 11 auto attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The first mechanic in red HP will carry over attacks from the previous green HP phase, see the Special Attack Order section for more information

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Must be depleted by dealing damage and will be followed by green HP

[https://img.pvme.io/images/GRgpCe9WAg.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Green HP: Zamorak's main health bar, and is split into 6 sections representing each phase

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will have 5-tick attack rate and deal normal damage, and will do his next special attack every 5 auto attacks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The first mechanic in green HP on each phase will happen after 1 auto attack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon depletion of each section, Zamorak will regain Grey HP and start the Channelers mechanic

​

Overall, the progression of the first 6 phases can be summarised as:

​

Grey HP > charge pad > deplete red HP > deplete green HP section > Channelers + grey HP > repeat

​

⬥ Zamorak's green HP scales between 300,000 and 1,600,000 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] per player, capping at 1740% enrage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Phases 1-5 each take up 16% of the total green HP bar, while phase 6 takes up 20%

⬥ At 100%+ enrage, Zamorak will gain an additional 7th phase that will be explained in its own section

​

Hexes and Edicts

⬥ Charge Pads

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The arena has 6 pads that you can stand on to charge.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When it is fully charged, Zamorak will stop attacking for a while and your adrenaline bar will be refilled. After this, you will gain an Edict while Zamorak gains a Hex depending on the pad charged.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will become unable to charge pads during the Channelers mechanic. To continue charging the next pad, you must enter Infernus [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] and kill the witch present.

​

⬥ Hexes and Edicts

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every time a pad is charged, all players and Zamorak will gain a stack of currently active stacking edicts and hexes, respectively

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes it such that earlier pad effects become stronger as the fight progresses

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Note that pads 3 and 5 don't have stacking effects

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ E.g. if you activate pads 2 → 4 → 1 → 3 → 6 → 5, once 5 is activated rune 2 will have 6 stacks, rune 4 will have 5 stacks, rune 1 will have 4 stacks, and rune 6 will have 2 stacks

[https://img.pvme.io/images/pAOYodBn8H.png Guide illustration] ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During phase 7, all stacking edicts and hexes have their stack amounts reversed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ E.g. Using the pad order in the above example, phase 7 will act as if the pad order were 5 → 6 → 3 → 1 → 4 → 2

[https://img.pvme.io/images/tOouJ4IzhG.png Guide illustration] ⬥ A calculator has been made to gauge the effects of each activated Edict & Hex: [https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Rune_pads https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Rune_pads]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UOtlSkO.png Guide illustration]

Hex: Twinshot, Edict: Anima Flow (Stacking) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1 twinshotrune]
⬥ Zamorak's attacks deal a second hit at 10% of the original hit, per stack. ⬥ Player's basic abilities have their adrenaline gain increased by 20% of the original value, per stack. ​

⬥ If Zamorak's targets are hit below 5% (per stack) of their Constitution level (times 100), they'll be executed instantly. ⬥ Your ability cooldowns are reduced by 8% of the original cooldown per stack. ​

⬥ Zamorak calls forth some of his coven to support him. Lifeweaver will continually heal Zamorak for 1,000 health every few ticks, while Protector applies a buff that reduces the damage he takes by 25%. These enemies will spawn to the far west and east (by the second and fifth runes) respectively, but will not move towards Zamorak until a player is in mini-map range of them. ⬥ When standing near a hexed rune, you deal and take 5% more damage. ​

⬥ Zamorak's attacks push 7% of damage through any shielding effects, per stack. ⬥ After casting an ultimate ability, your next basic ability consumes Guardian's Triumph, increasing the damage it deals by 20% damage and heals you for 8% of your missing LP per stack. Has a 30s cooldown. ​
Hex: Chaos Traps, Edict: Sword of Edicts (Non-Stacking) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206002658431016.png?v=1 chaostrapsrune]

Also protects against the damage, stun and bind when setting off Chaos Traps. Lasts 30 seconds and has a 60 second cooldown. ​
Hex: Affliction, Edict: Balance of Power (Stacking) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994205987663794206.png?v=1 afflictionrune]
⬥ When Zamorak's targets heal, the amount will be reduced by 10% per stack. ⬥ While below 60% lifepoints, outgoing damage is increased by 6% per stack. ​

Twinshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1 twinshotrune] from pad 1 and Disintegrate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206018680668171.png?v=1 disintegraterune] from pad 4 will result in the largest increases in incoming damage, especially when they are ramped up in later phases

​

⬥ Twinshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1 twinshotrune] deals a second hit 1 tick after all of Zamorak's autoattacks, equal to 10% of the possible max hit per stack, which allows for less [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] uptime and creates special hit timings to be wary of once it's active

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During grey HP and red HP, Zamorak will have an accelerated 4-tick attack rate, meaning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1 deflectrange] will have to be active 1/2 of the time with twinshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1 twinshotrune] active

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During the Flames of Zamorak mechanic, if the black smoke is picked up immediately, the timed damage will occur on the same tick as a twinshot hit during grey HP and red HP

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This will make it impossible to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] the timed damage unless [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] is also used

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Note that entering Infernus [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] or phasing Zamorak between red HP/grey HP and green HP, causing his attack speed to change, while the timer is running can cause the damage to line up with an attack regardless of twinshot being active or not

​

Hex: Disintegrate

⬥ Disintegrate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206018680668171.png?v=1 disintegraterune] from pad 4 grants Zamorak 7% defence piercing per stack on his attacks, stacking with existing defence piercing values such as Chaos Blast: 40% and Flames of Zamorak Smoke damage: 1% per stack

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This only affects the following defensives:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Disruption shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Barricade [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Divert [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Debilitate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Shield dome [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The % damage taken through a defensive affected by disintegrate is calculated as follows

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ = floor(Defensive_value * (Disintegrate_stacks * 0.07 + Base_piercing) + (100 - Defensive_value))/100​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Given the way some defensives are calculated through this effect, this results in a buff and debuff on certain aspects of them:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Reflect [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] damage increases as more damage taken results in more damage reflected

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Resonance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] healing decreases since disintegrate results in less damage blocked

​

Hex: Chaos Traps

Once the Chaos Traps rune [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206002658431016.png?v=1 chaostrapsrune] is active from pad 5, traps will spawn in set locations. The locations on the map below are possible locations where the traps may spawn

⬥ Note that traps respawn on every pad each time a new pad is charged

⬥ To avoid being stunned and taking heavy damage, you can:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step off each pad right as it finishes charging (new traps spawn with a slight delay)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pick up the buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006128082266107954.png?v=1 swordofedictsedict] near the sword before charging a new pad

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] to step on a new pad without the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006128082266107954.png?v=1 swordofedictsedict] buff

[https://img.pvme.io/images/6dVF9SM48q.png Guide illustration] ​

Phase 7

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WavFFAD1rN.png Guide illustration] At 100% enrage, phase 7 is introduced. Zamorak will enter Infernus and force the player in along with them.

⬥ When the phase starts:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The pad order from phases 1-6 is reversed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak starts immune to damage

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Chaos Demon will spawn which should be killed

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak sends 2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] hits to all players

Rune Calls

⬥ An amount of runes (2 in solo, otherwise equal to team size in group) will appear before Zamorak and stay there temporarily, the order in which they appear is the order they must be defeated in

⬥ At the same time Zamorak will begin charging a new red HP bar, referred to as the chaos bar, that determines the damage of upcoming mechanics

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206048334393385.png?v=1 smiterune] may be shown twice

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing a rune will delay Zamorak from charging for 9 ticks (4 ticks at 1600%+ enrage)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing a rune out of order will deal heavy damage to all players

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Runes uber heal after they are defeated, be careful not to kill it twice.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The rate of charge increases with enrage and caps at 8850%

​

⬥ After the last rune is defeated Zamorak stops charging, becomes damageable, and uses in this order:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [1] A single moderate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [2] A large chaos damage hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Soft typeless damage that is equivalent to the chaos bar that charges while killing runes

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Make sure your team is spread out as it does damage in a small area around each player

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Has a base defence piercing of 50%

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [3] 4 additional small chaos damage hits

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deals damage based on a portion of the chaos bar and the amount of time it was allowed to charge for

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Does not have base defence piercing but is affected by Twinshot

​

⬥ If Zamorak is not defeated before becoming immune on the 4th small chaos hit:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [4] Another Chaos Demon spawns

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [5] Another moderate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [6] Another large chaos damage hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [7] Runes are called

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Resets to [1] once last rune is defeated

​

⬥ Zamorak will have 100,000 to 250,000 health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution] per player during phase 7, capping at 1000% enrage

⬥ The Chaos Demon is the same as during the Infernal Tomb mechanic and will have 18,750 to 70,000 health [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution], capping at 1470% enrage

⬥ At 1000% enrage the chaos bar charge no longer resets between cycles, meaning the chaos damage will likely become unmanageable in a second cycle

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It's generally expected for Zamorak to be low enough at this point to defeat before the large chaos hit reaches the player, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] can also be used to buy more time

​

⬥ Each small chaos damage hit is calculated as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• = floor(Iteration * Chaos_bar/100) ‎where Iteration ‎refers to how many times the Charge value has increased (this gets delayed when killing a rune)

​

Final phase (Solo [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] 440%)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gQrldqS.mp4 Source media]

​

Phase 7 General Strategy

​

After entering Infernus:

⬥ Team kills the Chaos Demon

⬥ Before Zamorak calls runes, team gets ready to ult [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath]**

⬥ Team kills runes as soon as they appear, being careful not to kill them twice unintentionally

⬥ Team gets on Zamorak immediately after killing last rune

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will want to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] the melee hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] on the large bomb, less defensives will be required with lower (<10k) charge

⬥ Repeat cycle if necessary

⬥ When 0 cycling a riskier approach is taken to deal out as much damage as possible

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will want to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] the melee hit

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] on the large bomb and finish Zamorak

​

Notes:

⬥ 0 cycling means killing Zamorak before small bombs hit, risking death if not

⬥ See enrage and style-specific Zamorak guides for full working rotations

​

Phase 7 Troubleshooting

Taking too much damage? Note: refer to !p7skulls in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/534563158304620564 Bot commands (external Discord)] if struggling with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] bouncing to runes
⬥ Edict Order (see !edicts for recommendations)     • A late edict 4 leads to less effective defensives.     • An early edict 6 leads to lesser healing food. ⬥ Rune Killing Speed     • Killing the first rune immediately is imperative as Zamorak's red bar stops charging for 10 ticks (5 ticks at 1600+ enrage) following each rune death. The red bar directly correlates to the damage you receive. ⬥ Defensive Usage     • Pre-[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] the initial [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] hit?     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] the Large Smoke?             • Full hp when using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality]?
Not dealing enough damage to one-cycle?
⬥ Damage Checklist     • Delaying [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] until after the Large Smoke?             • This is to benefit from edict 6 effect (low HP damage bonus)     • Stacking 7+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 StormShards] during p1-6 and using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 Shatter]?     • Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to reach Zamorak after final Rune death? ⬥ Preparing for a Second Cycle     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the 2nd melee hit, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 sd]       OR     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1 debil] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] the 2nd melee hit, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort]

​

Enrage-Based Mechanics

Zamorak's damage and HP scales with enrage, and additional mechanics are introduced at specific enrage thresholds:

​

⬥ 100% Phase 7 is introduced

⬥ 500% During Infernal Tomb, all players must be on their rune at the same time to exit Infernus

⬥ 500% During Channelers, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 50% adrenaline and the first ability is Asphyxiate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx]

⬥ 750% During Infernal Tomb, demons will move faster towards the portal

⬥ 900% During Channelers, grey HP healing ramp-up no longer resets between phases

⬥ 1000% During Channelers, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 100% adrenaline and their first ability is Omnipower [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni]

⬥ 1000% On phase 7, red bar charge is no longer reset between cycle(s)

⬥ 1000% On phase 7, Zamorak's life points cap at 250,000 per player

⬥ 1470% The life points of chaos demons cap at 70,000 while on Infernus

⬥ 1500% During the Adrenaline Cage attack, the targeted player will have their Devotion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] deactivated

⬥ 1600% Zamorak's stagger after killing a rune on Phase 7 reduced from 10 to 5 ticks

⬥ 1740% For phases 1-6, Zamorak's starting life points cap at 1,600,000 per player

⬥ 3500% On phase 7, the life points the runes revive with are capped at 60,000

​

Helpful Tips

⬥ The grey HP soft cap can't increase on the ticks Zamorak takes damage, meaning DoT abilities such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] can be used before entering Infernus [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] to prevent meaningful amounts of healing

⬥ As Infernal Tomb starts, you can on tick stun Zamorak by using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] as he assigns runes and using a stun as your character is lifted. [https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 Example clip here.][https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 Source video]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will greatly reduce the damage dealt to players

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can double stun by stalling one and releasing it with another, this counts as two stuns and lets you cover one missed stun

⬥ You can stack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] to use with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 Shatter] during phase 7

⬥ At high enrages the base can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1 enfeeble] to reduce the damage dealt by autos

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] also reduces a lot of damage since Zamorak uses a lot of autos

⬥ Ring of Death [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] effect clears upon entering phase 7

⬥ Many debuffs such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404885709034229922.png?v=1 flameboundrival] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] carry over into phase 7

⬥ You may [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 Cept] other players and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort] if multiple players will take a fatal attack at the same time

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 Source media]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E9HmNuzAe2.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Zamorak/Overview|Zamorak Basic]] and [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak|Zamorak]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=64f8364c-2a27-4dfd-b907-1230f1b7d80d Ranged-Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F64f8364c-2a27-4dfd-b907-1230f1b7d80d.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ This rotation can achieve sub 3:30 kills.

⬥ Pad order used: 2 → 1 → 4 → 6 → 5 → 3

​

Witches

Last Witch

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

​

Phase 1

Base

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → (charge pad) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1 adaptivestrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E9HmNuzAe2.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in [[PvME/Zamorak/Overview|Zamorak Basic]] and [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak|Zamorak]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=92ce878a-d5e5-427f-8fdf-9fddc3665e9e Ranged-Melee(base)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=44e4118d-85e2-46e3-b518-1e80b079f64e Ranged-Melee(dps)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F92ce878a-d5e5-427f-8fdf-9fddc3665e9e.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Rotations

⬥ This rotation aims to achieve sub 3:20 minute kills.

⬥ Pad order used: 6 → 2 → 1 → 3 → 4 → 5

⬥ This rotation requires strict adherence to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stacks and any variation should be adjusted to accordingly.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E9HmNuzAe2.png Guide illustration] ​

Intro

This guide contains information for players doing Zamorak at 4000% enrage solo with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] hybrid.

​

⬥ The rotations in this guide will help you achieve ~8 kph. This guide expects strong knowledge from [[PvME/Zamorak/Overview|Zamorak Basic]] and [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak|Zamorak]]. BiS gear is highly recommended.

​

⬥ This guide uses edict order 2-3-1-6-4-5.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6f073a09-a4ee-49b8-b5a1-fd33ad8ceb32 Magic / Melee Hybrid]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F6f073a09-a4ee-49b8-b5a1-fd33ad8ceb32.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Other Unlocks
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] EoF with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1 legatusemberstaff] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer] Demon Slayer Sigil unlocked ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] Penance Powder active ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953726341267606.png?v=1 magiccape] 120 Magic perk in your Max cape ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] Bow of the Last Guardian to proc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] earlier ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] A Demon slayer combo perk is used ⬥ Thermal spa HP boost is active

Special attack order

⬥ The following special attack order assumes decent DPS pacing to skip all mechanics in red HP. If struggling to meet this, refer to alternative orders in [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak|Zamorak]].

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ilNPOrOYlr.png Guide illustration]

Handling Grey HP

⬥ Tips to reduce grey HP regeneration:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Grey HP healing is based on the total amount of time spent in grey HP over the course of the entire fight. As such, you should always focus on charging the next pad as soon as possible.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] in combination with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] should keep grey HP below 150k at all times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ DoT abilities ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember]) will partially prevent healing if grey HP is above 150k

​

The Fight

Rotations

⬥ You may opt to replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] while charging pads to reduce damage taken.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For charging pads, you can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] to get [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] off earlier.

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] can be used freely, but is assumed to cover the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] from the witch.

Phase 1

Phase overview:

⬥ In order to do this phase correctly, aim for the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak uses Flames of Zamorak in green HP.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You phase Zamorak immediately before being teleported by Infernal Tomb at 1344k HP

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Allows you to deal with the demon + witch at the same time, removing the need to re-enter Infernus again

⬥ The P1 ability rotation requires some adaptation to not phase Zamorak too quickly. In general, aim to be at around 1400k HP before the Flames of Zamorak bomb goes off.

⬥ Build 10 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] before the last witch, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] on the last witch to proc them, then use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1 naturalinstinct] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert]

⬥ Witch: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] (without target)

​

Phase 6

Phase overview:

⬥ The phase should proceed as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip mechanic in red HP and get Rune of Destruction in green HP

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Phase Zamorak as soon as possible

​

P6 rotation:

⬥ target Zamorak + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1 combust] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to pad 5 → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] (refund) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1 roarofawakening] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] south of sun as Rune of Destruction starts → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] (optional) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] → improvise with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step off the pad as it finishes charging to avoid getting hit by Chaos Traps [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206002658431016.png?v=1 chaostrapsrune]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Should aim to finish above 30% adrenaline to have enough for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Zamorak was not lured far enough north at the end of phase 5 you may lose your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] as Rune of Destruction starts

​

Phase 7

⬥ For this phase its important to note your defensives will be very weak because of Disintegrate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206018680668171.png?v=1 disintegraterune], this includes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt].

⬥ Demon: s [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] during cutscene → r [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1 icebarrage] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] → filler if not dead → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1 meteorstrike] Zamorak → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 berserk] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng]

⬥ Runes: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] first rune → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] while waiting for barge cooldown → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1 barge] second rune → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] to Zamorak

⬥ Zamorak: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1 assault] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You need to be above ~50% HP to live the Melee Slam with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] before the large bomb hits

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk] has a sign, unequip it after using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1 overpower]

Troubleshooting

⬥ Struggling to get the desired spec order while following the listed rotations is usually an indication that too much time is spent inbetween phases

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Aim to get the next pad charged as quickly as possible from the moment Zamorak enters grey HP, allowing time for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] to finish and using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1 ezk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Efficient movement between pads is important, on some phases it's possible to already be on the next pad by the time you phase Zamorak and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement]

⬥ You may want to flick [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690976219612708954.png?v=1 arcanespiritshield] as you set up on each pad. Once the pad is charged you should be able to burst down Zamorak's red HP within 1-2 autos, keeping the incoming damage within manageable ranges.

⬥ If you fail to skip red HP mechs on phase 5 or 6, focus on following the alternative spec order from [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak|Zamorak]]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1 cade] Flames of Zamorak on phase 5, and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1 res] the smoke with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] active

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get Chaos Blast on phase 6 red HP, you should be able to kill Zamorak before he releases the bomb, otherwise simply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1 immort]

⬥ Once entering phase 7, the kill is basically guaranteed, take it slow and safe if necessary

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can take as long as you want setting up on phase 7 as the red HP bar is completely irrelevant

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Avoid getting close to the Chaos Demon, you could get hit by his melee swipe as you get hit by Zamorak's mage autos

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is almost no benefit from staying below 60% HP as you will already overkill Zamorak with the listed rotation

Example Kill

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wxxJh3f.jpg Guide illustration]

Introduction

​

Zamorak, Lord of Chaos is the fifth and final instalment in the Elder God Wars. This guide will primarily focus on clearing the dungeon segment, for help defeating the boss visit [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak|Zamorak]].

​

General Notes for Senntisten Undercity + Zamorak

⬥ Lucky charms for the dungeon can be bought from Thoksdottir at Daemonheim

⬥ A LOT of mobs can be ignored throughout the dungeon, but note that Menders and Dark Wizards will heal mobs/drain your adrenaline

⬥ The only required minibosses are the Jailer on the second floor (who teleports to different floors after 50k damage dealt x Team Size) and Eterna being the second boss before Zamorak.

⬥ A Demon / Greater Demon slayer task will affect a great number of mobs present in the dungeon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kuradal offers the best chance for this task.

​

Presets and Relics

DISCLAIMER: Presets below have been made for both the dungeon and boss based on preliminary knowledge. This will change as more information becomes available. Upgrade as you see fit, the gear posted below is merely the minimum we suggest.

​

It is assumed that Zuk capes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket] for your chosen style, Disruption Shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] and passive Ring of Vigour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] are unlocked.

⬥ All gear used is based on Stage 1 of [https://pvme.io/gear/ Upgrade guides], with the addition of the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged skillcape on Anachronia cape stand/Max Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] + Igneous Kal-Xil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Strength skillcape on Anachronia cape stand/Max Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] (For effect while wearing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket])

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• City of Senntisten spells [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=jihSy8LySUQfmUMB5Kwq Magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JhS4g9ARMslHRoDn4HKt Melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=lGc5Op2pA5RIc1cCppuB Ranged]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FlGc5Op2pA5RIc1cCppuB.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Recommended Upgrades

These items should be part of your preset if you have them or can afford them, listed in order of cost-effectiveness.

​

⬥ Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917456789554.png?v=1 mwspear] Masterwork Spear of Annihilation or off-hand Lunging 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736522494315593759.png?v=1 lunge4] switch

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] Zaros Godsword

​

⬥ Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] with Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] with Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] switch

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ascendrii bolts (e) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643170748495691796.png?v=1 ascendribolt]

​

⬥ Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] with Caroming 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] switch

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 soa] Fractured Staff of Armadyl and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] Erethdor's grimoire

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1 eofpurple] with Guthix Staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1 gstaff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022281229434951.png?v=1 eofredu] with Armadyl Battlestaff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1 armadylbattlestaff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336168363561041.png?v=1 cryptbloomtop] ‎ ‎Cryptbloom Equipment

​

Dungeon Floor Overview

[https://img.pvme.io/images/JC5C0F9.png Guide illustration]

​

Mefis the Jailer

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sZ3U9n3.png Guide illustration]

Mefis the Jailer is the first boss of the dungeon, this boss is a typical "mini-boss" styled encounter, dealing magic auto-attacks and low upfront damage to the player.

Mefis will teleport to different floors after (50k damage dealt X Team Size), (ex: see [[PvME/Zamorak/Zamorak Dungeon#dungeon-floor-overview|this link]] for locations)
Damage Scaling
• 1 Person: 50k Damage before the jailer teleports • 2 People: 100k Damage before the jailer teleports • 3 People: 150k Damage before the jailer teleports • 4 People: 200k Damage before the jailer teleports • 5 People: 250k Damage before the jailer teleports

​

Unlocking Eterna's Door

To unlock Eterna's doorway you must find two crystal pylon locations see Dungeon Floor Overview Section for the respective locations

​

Eterna

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wgsSSmr.png Guide illustration]

Eterna is the last boss of the dungeon, this boss has multiple high hitting mechanics and does alternating magic / ranged auto-attacks throughout the fight.

Phase 1
⬥ Deal damage until Eterna phases     • Eterna will spawn a single Chaos Demon Savage after phasing, kill them to move into phase 2.
Phase 2
⬥ Eterna re-appears with full HP along with spawning spiked-circles on the ground, deal damage until phase HP again to move on.     • Circles can be dealt with by using defensives or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] ⬥ Magic bombs will also spawn from the red portal in the center dealing low magic damage. ⬥ Two Chaos Demon Savages will spawn kill them to proceed to phase 3.
Phase 3
⬥ Eterna re-appears with all mechanics listed previously, deal damage until she is dead to move on to the next room. ⬥ The red portal in the center fires a spout into the player, dealing no damage and placing a bar over their head.     • When this bar depletes, a 5x5 area around the player will become engulfed in smoke, dealing more damage the longer you stand inside.

​

Example Runs

Note: All of these runs are done on release and are to be taken as a quick reference for the time being. As time progresses, proper example kills with much better handling of mechanics will be posted. If you have an example kill you'd like to submit for posting feel free to submit it and label it as such through the PvME community (the source did not specify a submission destination).

​

Run Videos
Simple kills where mechanics may or may not be handled properly.

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat beta changes in March 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E9HmNuzAe2.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

​

This [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] guide was made as an approachable guide to reach do 500% enrage. Rotations focus on skipping mechanics and should achieve ~5min kills comfortably. Results at enrages over 500% may vary.

​

This guide assumes knowledge of Zamorak mechanics. Visit [[PvME/Zamorak/Overview|Zamorak Basic]] to learn more.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ZmjzW3mXYxIeR9KSPnyp Necromancy]

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll]

⬥ Thermal pool [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] and bonfire boost [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] recommended.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] active

⬥ Runes for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt]

⬥ Note: using T70-90 power armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783476169441401.png?v=1 dealertop80] instead can apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] on runes, leading to an unpredictable p7.

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FZmjzW3mXYxIeR9KSPnyp.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

General information

⬥ The pad order for the fight is: 2 → 1 → 4 → 6 → 5 → 3

⬥ Keep conjures up

⬥ Aim to keep your HP below 60% for phasing p6 and after p7 red bomb to benefit from 6th edict.

​

Rotation Phase 1-6

The general rotation for charging a pad and phasing will look similar for certain phases. For most phases you want good stacks build up and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] to phase it. For phases 2 and 4 you use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] instead.

​

Prefight:

Kill mages and build 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] and 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul]. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1 lifetransfer] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] before killing last mage.

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] → attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak]

​

Phases 1, 3, 5, and 6:

([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] +) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] (run to pad ) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] (at 50% pad charge) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement]

​

Phases 2 and 4:

get 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] and 4+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks.

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] (move to next pad) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] + step on pad → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] (as pad is almost charged) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] (move towards next pad) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] if not close to phasing) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1 bloat] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement]

​

Witches:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath], then build [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] & [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] and set-up [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] as needed. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] as witch dies (bleeds do not tick!).

​

Phase 6 notes:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] to pop bomb from pad 3.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get a mechanic it will be:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Flames of Zamorak ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee]), or

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Infernal Tomb (get out ASAP and phase [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak]. Don't [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] is low LP), or

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ‎ ‎Rune of Destruction (stand in the not-red circle and phase).

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] will not carry over to phase 7. Try to be high adren when going into p7.

⬥ Save [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] for phase 7.

​

Phase 7

Notes:

⬥ Before first rune is shown you should target and kill demon. Once it's dead throw [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] on zamorak and apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath].

⬥ Try to build to 12 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1 necrosis] stacks and 5 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1 residualsoul] as you kill demon + runes.

⬥ If you stacked [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards], at 6+ shards it hits harder than a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] if runes are far apart, or far from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak]

⬥ If you do not have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt], use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1 reflect] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo].

⬥ Optionally: pre-equip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 RoD] to tank red bombs.

⬥ If dps is low:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul] as second rune dies.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to keep your hp low (<60% of your max) after first red bomb hit. Having low hp will not only increase the damage from 6th edict but also make it safer to survive since bleed from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 RoD] will be lower.

​

Phase 7 Rotation:

Spam [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] (if needing adrenaline) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] during cutscene ( optional: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer]) → target demon + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] → kill demon.

Target zammy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1 stormshards] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] until first rune is shown.

Kill first rune with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 necrobasic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1 livingdeath] at 100% adren. use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1 splitsoul]

Second rune: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1 touchofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1 commandskeleton] + move to zam

​

Zamorak [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak]

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] ‎ ‎→ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] (+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] after melee hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter] (+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] for red bomb) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave] if not dead

​

Phase 7 Rotation - B-rune:

⬥ There is an alternative p7 rotation that requires killing the B-rune. If the B-rune has died once you can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] without it targeting the B-rune.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This rotation assumes the B-rune is called, not that you kill it just to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls].

⬥ If B-rune isn't killed, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] will bounce to and kill B-rune, which deals heavy damage!

⬥ Up to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] it is the same rotation as described above.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dRGS0SAUZN.webp Guide illustration] Phase 7 positioning for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls]. Positioning on the green tiles is recommended to prevent [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] from the player bouncing to any runes.

​

Zamorak [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1 zamorak] B-rune:

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] → (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] (+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] after melee hit) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1 shatter] (+ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1 powerburstofvitality] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] for red bomb) → ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1 fingerofdeath] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642264850141205.png?v=1 deathsparkorsoulreave]

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8TfyN8EsVXs Full 500% kill (p7 no B-rune 4:54)]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pgTfot8h0YE Phase 7 B-rune example]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/E9HmNuzAe2.png Guide illustration] ​

Intro

​

This guide contains information for players doing Zamorak at 500% enrage solo with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

⬥ The rotations in this guide will help you achieve <4 min kills comfortably

⬥ This guide uses edict order 2 - 1 - 4 - 6 - 5 - 3

​

Gear, Relics and Familiars

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2f37e9db-203f-4430-95c9-37fdf177b784 Ranged]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F2f37e9db-203f-4430-95c9-37fdf177b784.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

The Fight

All rotations listed may need improvisation due to ful book procs and crits.

​

Phase 1

⬥ Build 10 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] before the 2nd last witch and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1 deathsswiftness] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows], kill last witch when imbue shadows has ~20s on it's timer

1t after timer appears → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] + step on pad → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

​

Note: Keep your hp low to maximise berserker's fury damage, can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] if needed

​

Witch: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] → tc + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1 realmmovement] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1 piercingshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot]

​

Phase 2:
