[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_beast Abyssal beasts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107328964014100.png?v=1 abyssalbeast] are a higher level alternative for Abyssal Slayer creature assignments. They are mainly killed for Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] tasks, the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Senntisten Senntisten collection log], combat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] item experience, profit, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586941057769552.png?v=1 eliteclue]

​

⬥ Abyssal beasts can be assigned as a Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] assignment by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, Duradel, Sumona, and The Raptor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal beasts specific tasks may be assigned by Mandrith.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Demon cluster tasks also work, they may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Laniakea assigns almost twice as many.

⬥ The level 35 Wilderness location yields the highest kph.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 105

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1448.4

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~809 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~790 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], ~742 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~809 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (All AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~1.17m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~1.15m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], ~1.07m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~1.17m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (All AFK)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Jaws_of_the_Abyss Jaws of the Abyss] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842595639306.png?v=1 jawsoftheabyss]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 times rarer off-task.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_flesh Abyssal flesh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842520170576.png?v=1 abyssalflesh]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required to craft [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107347259555981.png?v=1 abyssalarmourspike]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_drop_enhancer Revenant drop enhancer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only dropped if killed in the Wilderness.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_obelisk Portable obelisk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1 portableobelisk] / [https://runescape.wiki/w/Obelisk_shard Obelisk shard]     • Allows for an easy teleport to the lvl 35 wilderness obelisk. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator attuned ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]     • Helps sustain your prayer. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dwarven_siege_engine Dwarven siege engine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kinetic_cyclone Kinetic cyclone] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone]     • Make sure to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards Restocking Cannon] ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ Armour perked with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) Demon Slayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk]     • +7% damage against demons. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) Stone of Jas buff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]     • 3% damage bonus for 4 hours after visiting the cave. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.         ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.     • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.

​

Location and How to Get there

Abyssal beasts can be fought in the Senntisten Asylum, the Wilderness, or the Sunken Pyramid.

​

Senntisten Asylum

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ZRpoxozL1P.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If killing Abyssal beasts at the Senntisten Asylum, use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go to the second room of the Senntisten Asylum and position yourself 5 tiles east of the west drain.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] 4 tiles east of you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If using an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] place it 3 tiles north of you.

​

Level 35 Wilderness

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5LslOc41ka.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If killing Abyssal beasts at the level 35 Wilderness location, use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1 portableobelisk]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go just north of the level 35 Wilderness obelisk and position yourself 2 tiles north of the skeleton.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] 1 tile north, and 9 tiles east of the skeleton.

​

Sunken Pyramid

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mGGioEKQkA.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If killing Abyssal beasts in the Sunken Pyramid, use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 Abyssal beasts in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.

​

Method: AFK (All Styles)

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and starting the session, check the following:

​

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] are active at all times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] only needed in the Sunken Pyramid.

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Use Stone of Jas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost] boost at the level 35 Wilderness location.

⬥ Senntisten asylum offers more kph than Wilderness, but requires cannon to maintain kph.

​

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] > Biting 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate]

⬥ Ensure that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut] is active.

​

Range [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] > Biting 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697055334491.png?v=1 jasdemonbanearrow] arrows are crucial, ideally in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Abyssal demons offer high experience rates while being completely afk. Being that they don't deal much damage, they're a great option for lower level players.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 85

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 277.2

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~2400 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~3075 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~2310 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], ‎ ‎~ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~665k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~852k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~640k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], ~ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Abyssal Demons drop the Abyssal whip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891494805536769.png?v=1 abyssalwhip], wand [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588590805043.png?v=1 abyssalwand] and orb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891495041073152.png?v=1 abyssalorb] which are required for the Slayer Log. They also drop alchables and hard clues at a decent rate.

⬥ If killed in the Wilderness, they can also drop [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer] which can be helpful for Ultimate Slayer hunters.

​

Useful Items

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_obelisk Portable obelisk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1 portableobelisk] / [https://runescape.wiki/w/Obelisk_shard Obelisk shard]     • Allows for an easy teleport to the lvl 18 wilderness obelisk. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] + [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator Attuned Ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]     • Helps sustain your prayer.
Other
⬥ Armour perked with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) Demon Slayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk]     • +7% damage against demons. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.         ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.     • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop Restocking Cannon Ability] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • Allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] restocking without user input.

​

Location and How to Get there

The best spot for abyssal demons is located at the level 18 Wilderness obelisk (Graveyard of Shadows). The fastest way to reach the location is using the portable obelisk or an obelisk shard.

​

Level 18 Wilderness

[https://img.pvme.io/images/MtWr7YkgwP.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] on yellow tile as shown below (2E of stump NE of obelisk) and stand on red tile (2N and 2W of stump SE of obelisk).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your character gets walked off the marked tile, step back on it, and click the nearest demon.

​

Method - AFK (All styles)

⬥ Upkeep Elder Overload [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and Weapon Poison +++ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]

⬥ If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/926021352626982942.png?v=1 zealots] pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1285372688457797672.png?v=1 eclipsedsoul] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313898068738151.png?v=1 ultimatestrength] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313902808174712.png?v=1 overpoweringforce] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313901189431296.png?v=1 overcharge] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941007795757117.png?v=1 accelerateddecay]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489526534154.png?v=1 sbsstandards] if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] and Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439136875253810.png?v=1 graspingpouchblack] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1 bloodrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658961481769.png?v=1 astralrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659301089280.png?v=1 bodyrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660333019136.png?v=1 soulrune]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439129275306164.png?v=1 graspingpouchblue] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659422855188.png?v=1 chaosrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 airrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1 waterrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1 firerune]

​

Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1146866649505468597.png?v=1 blightbolt]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3d7dcda0-91e8-4076-be93-d7801a17e768 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=575cd94f-e734-4043-bbbd-8037fe7cd01b Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=875ece5a-7771-4510-ab8d-62290712e9b3 Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4baf42c0-98aa-4354-b1c4-8454727d5d84 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4baf42c0-98aa-4354-b1c4-8454727d5d84.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bars

⬥ Magic

[https://img.pvme.io/images/sZSncLeGnX.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/rIlovwBwzu.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Ranged

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Uq7rtEBLlo.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_lord Abyssal lords] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord] are the best abyssal creatures task for both experience and gold. They are mainly killed for Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] tasks, the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Senntisten Senntisten collection log], combat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] item experience, profit, and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586941057769552.png?v=1 eliteclue] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643215216934518815.png?v=1 trisk]

​

⬥ Abyssal lords tasks may be assigned by Mandrith.

⬥ Abyssal demons tasks may be assigned by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, Duradel, Sumona, and The Raptor.

⬥ Demon cluster tasks may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Laniakea assigns almost twice as many.

⬥ For both abyssal demons and demon cluster tasks, each [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord] counts as 5 kills.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 115 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 8,235 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord]

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~450 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~398 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~240 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~884 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Wilderness abyssal lords and beasts)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ ~45% [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord] / ~55% [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107328964014100.png?v=1 abyssalbeast]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~3.71M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~3.28M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~1.98M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ~3.98m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Wilderness abyssal lords and beasts)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_scourge Abyssal scourge] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842469834832.png?v=1 abyssalscourge]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_flesh Abyssal flesh] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842520170576.png?v=1 abyssalflesh]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_drop_enhancer Revenant drop enhancer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only dropped if killed in the Wilderness.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Wilderness_sword_4 Wilderness sword 4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1 wildernesssword]     • Allows for an easy teleport. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator attuned ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]     • May be used to help sustain your prayer. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dwarven_siege_engine Dwarven siege engine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • Make sure to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards Restocking Cannon] ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ Armour perked with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) Demon Slayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk]     • +7% damage against demons. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.         ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.     • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.

​

Location and How to Get there

Abyssal lords can be fought in the Wilderness, the Senntisten Asylum, or the Sunken Pyramid.

​

Level 47 Wilderness

[https://img.pvme.io/images/AL2LhIQoXZ.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1 wildernesssword] and teleport to the Wilderness herb patch.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Position yourself on the westernmost corner of the rock and walk 2 tiles north and 1 tile west.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] 1 tile west of the bottom skeleton.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using an alt, position yourself as shown [https://img.pvme.io/images/nmGp4fMne5.png here].

⬥ Abyssal lords and beasts can be fought simultaneously at this location.

⬥ Do not use Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] at this location.

​

Senntisten Asylum

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wogijlVST4.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring] and teleport to Senntisten, then run north-east towards the asylum elevator.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once inside run to the final room, a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Gate_key gate key] unlocks a shortcut.

​

Sunken Pyramid

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mGGioEKQkA.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex] and teleport to the Sunken Pyramid.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 abyssal lords in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.

​

Method: AFK (all styles)

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and starting the session, check the following:

​

General notes

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] are active at all times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] only needed in the Sunken Pyramid.

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Acheron mammoths are one of the 4 raptor mobs and have the highest HP of the bunch. Although they give decent slayer XP, they don't drop any rare uniques and thus are the least popular of the raptor creatures. They attack with melee and ranged, with their ranged attack having the animation of throwing a ice ball. This attack is dodge-able always hits if it lands, dealing moderately heavy ranged damage.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 4215.6

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~375 (High Effort), 290 (Low Effort)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour : ~1.58M (High effort), 1.22M (Low effort)

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ Guaranteed unique drop every kill of a Mammoth Tusk, which is an ingredient in making Pack Mammoth [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1 mammothpouch] pouches.

⬥ In addition to this, they have a rich drop table, making the tasks decent for GP alongside XP. Mammoths also provide a large amount of crimson and blue charms, dropping 4 at a time.

​

Location and How to Get There

⬥ Mammoths can be found in 2 locations:

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Mammoth Iceberg - Accessible via a boat to the north of the Fremennik Lodestone.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This location is used if AoE slaying actively due to having more spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Methods to get there (fastest to slowest): Fairy Ring D K S > Fremennik lode > Fremennik boots teleport

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frozen Waste Plateau

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This location is used if slaying Mammoths low effort due to it benefiting from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Teleport there using the Ice Plateau teleport (Lunar spellbook).

​

Mechanics

Freedom
⬥ When stunned for bound, mammoths will shout 'Freedom!' and remove any stuns and binds. This does not clear bleeds. ​
Dishonourable conduct
⬥ When damaged out of melee distance of the player, the mammoth may fling 3 ice balls at the player, each dealing heavy ranged damage. Getting hit will disable all prayers, drain all run energy, and bind the player.     • This is the mechanic with by far the highest kill potential. Try to keep in melee distance when attacking mammoths at all costs.     • It is suicidal to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to aggro mammoths due to this mechanic. ​
Charge
⬥ The mammoth shakes and a blue bar above its head starts filling up. When the bar fills, the mammoth does 1-3 charges, pushing the player and dealing heavy melee damage each charge.     • To avoid this, simply pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and allow it to hit you, or move out of the way.     • If being attacked by more than 1 mammoth, the displacement from this attack may trigger Dishonourable conduct from another mammoth, which can easily kill the player.

Useful Items and Unlocks

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dominion_mine Dominion Mines] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine]     • Useful for doing Mammoths actively. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Magic_notepaper Magic notepaper] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1 notepaper]     • Useful for noting mammoth tusks for extra GP. ​
Passives/Unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) Stone of Jas buff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]     • Damage boost to mammoths in the wilderness. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle box] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • Damage boost to mammoths in the wilderness. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Aggression Aggression] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/909338509234569216.png?v=1 aggression]     • Useful for pulling spawns to AoE.

Method: Active Melee

Melee is the best method for mammoths, as you need to be in melee distance as much as possible due to Dishonourable conduct. Additionally, melee has abundant AoE which hits around the player, making it perfect for killing multiple mammoths as you want to position in the middle of mammoths as much as possible.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=429f11b1-df4e-4f1a-aa34-f6c37dc7a151 Melee - Active] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F429f11b1-df4e-4f1a-aa34-f6c37dc7a151.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Strategy

⬥ Set up your coil as shown below between the 2 rocks and exposed rib skeleton. Stay in this general vicinity to kill the 4 spawns boxed in yellow.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/L47xyt0ZBA.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Use lossless healing food such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690140078407680059.png?v=1 supergrest] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593742291033.png?v=1 blueblubber] to keep HP up, along with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal]

​

⬥ The general rotation is [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] ends → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] ASAP

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lay [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] every time [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] is used.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] under [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1279516151423963166.png?v=1 critbuff] for more adren.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use excess adrenaline on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] when using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk]

​

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/qItk3CbK_mE Active melee task]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This video uses an suboptimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] positioning.

​

Method: Low effort Melee

There's no completely safe method to AFK killing mammoths due to their charge attack. However, players can utilise the Wilderness which is less densely populated with spawns, of which there are several spots that guarantees getting attacked by at most 2 mammoths at once.

​

⬥ This method uses the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear], a cheap weapon which exploits mammoths' stab weakness, allowing you to not splash through their high defences even with no aura.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BIS perks are not needed, and using one the player may own for killing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813907706478603.png?v=1 raksha] will suffice.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9e6db227-52fa-4fd3-8f18-db16d54f37f1 Melee - Low Effort] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9e6db227-52fa-4fd3-8f18-db16d54f37f1.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Strategy

⬥ Set up your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] as shown below between the trees.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/eo4XgVJkSZ.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Click mammoths to start kills as sometimes mammoths will take a while to start their first attack despite being hit by the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] multiple times, which increases the time your character stands idle.

​

⬥ Manually casting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] when not in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] on mammoths with more than 20k HP left improves this method significantly.

​

Revo bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/cTHCb9toyb.png Guide illustration] ​

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/vEtE83yS6Vw Low effort melee task]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Armoured phantoms are the highest tiered Zemouregal's undead, requiring 113 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] to kill. Even though their drops are worth less than that of other similar high-levelled slayer monsters such as abyssal lords [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord] and moss golems [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107335343542404.png?v=1 mossgolem], they offer competitive XP rates and make for a fairly speedy task.

​

They can be killed for following tasks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Armoured phantoms, assigned by The Raptor and Laniakea

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zemouregal's undead, assigned by The Raptor

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead cluster, assigned by The Raptor and Laniakea

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] XP per kill : 2625 + 866.2 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 2500

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~900 (~800 AFK [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~630 AFK [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy])

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~2.2M (~2M AFK)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These rates do not include other factors such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex], ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1 sacrificescrim] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1114819109650169896.png?v=1 bonefragments] or other XP boosts.

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sonic_Wave_ability_codex Greater Sonic Wave ability codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411830207299654.png?v=1 gsoniccodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 3 times rarer off-task.

⬥ Often killed for very high XP rates.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Item unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scrimshaw_of_sacrifice Scrimshaw of Sacrifice] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1 sacrificescrim]     • Can be used for 50% increased [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] exp     • Feasible for AFKing at the cost of all drops. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scrimshaw_of_vampyrism Scrimshaw of Vampyrism] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim]     • Good source of sustain if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet (e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]     • Crucial for good KPH (and accuracy if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]). ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Essence_of_Finality_amulet Essence of Finality] with a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_halberd Dragon Halberd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd]     • Good AoE spec to use if killing them actively with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ​
Passive unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kinetic_cyclone Upgraded kinetic cyclone] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271733481493.png?v=1 kineticcycloneupgradekit]     • Triggers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim] healing if using melee actively. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dwarf_multicannon Dwarf multicannon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1114767361975779379.png?v=1 dwarfmulticannon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • For aggression in AFK methods. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Undead_Slayer Undead slayer (perk)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]     • Increases damage and KPH. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Undead_Slayer_(ability) Undead slayer (sigil)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer]     • Increases damage and KPH if slaying actively.

​

AFK Methods

⬥ AFK relies on only allowing one phantom to attack you at once by either:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Standing in a corner, causing phantoms to pile up to be hit with AoE damage such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1 spectralscythe3] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Platypus platypus] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tooth_creature tooth creature] pet to block phantoms. A cannon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] with the Restocking Cannon upgrade is not necessary for this, but increases kph. An aggression potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] can be used instead, but yields less kph.

​

Positioning

⬥ Place the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] (or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] for west spot) and:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee: Position yourself in the west as shown below, with the blocking pet to your south (player position in red):

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Else: Position yourself in the north-eastern corner (shown as Other in purple):

​

^^Watching the lure example is recommended!

^^

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Mc4A2cAsS4.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c3759de6-9d9e-4e7a-a854-d48bccfce253 AFK Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2d8f9b32-350d-4bef-acc2-3212dab2630c AFK Melee Medium Level] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=314c257b-6bfa-47db-99c8-dd28ce32de94 AFK Melee High Level] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0e9e2f43-a362-464d-84b4-e6aaba65930e AFK Necromancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0e9e2f43-a362-464d-84b4-e6aaba65930e.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Notes:

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] can be used, but for medium level Melee, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] can be the safer option. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] can be used for prayer sustain.

⬥ Rune pouches included are for ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vampyrism [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is safer, though Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] can be used for pray sustain instead of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Sticky bombs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1 stickybomb] can be thrown at healing phantom spirits to despawn them when setting up

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] (recommended for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]) and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring] are both good with 100% hit chance.

⬥ Every 25 minutes, the cannon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] needs to be refreshed.

⬥ Platypus and tooth creature do not need to be fed. They will not run away, even as babies.

​

​

Ability Bars

Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/S6Ka3yQnYH.png Guide illustration] Necro [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/qZ39h548ja.png Guide illustration] Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (outdated)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HwPgJ9wsim.png Guide illustration] ​

Video Examples

⬥ [https://youtu.be/t-cY8M9tU-k Lure example with blocking pet]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/eobheFklRTg AFK Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Active Method [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Ensure the following things are active when using this method:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deflect melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and Turmoil/Malevolence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Elder overload [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and aggression potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hellhound familiar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Revo++ and auto-retaliate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] enabled.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kinetic cyclone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone] and Scrimshaw of Vampyrism [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim] switched on.

​

⬥ Armoured phantoms can be AoE'd efficiently using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]. Stand in the middle of your cannon as shown below so that the cannon can hit any phantom which approaches you.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You are positioned nearer to the back of the room to avoid risen ghost aggression.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/m6pc0AxrzQ.png Guide illustration] ⬥ This method requires a consistently high damage output to minimise specs. The general ability outline is as follows:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] after using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise AoE [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave] during [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk], squeeze in some [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] if there's sufficient adrenaline.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] after [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] ends.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1 zgs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec]. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] depending on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1279516151423963166.png?v=1 critbuff] procs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to get as many [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] resets as possible when building adrenaline.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] when HP falls below ~20%, sip [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690140078407680059.png?v=1 supergrest] if needed.

​

⬥ Try to have [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] key bound somewhere in that order so you can spec and switch back to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet] easily by pressing 3 side-by-side keys.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1 stickybomb] to negate any healing orbs.

⬥ Remember to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] to restore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] HP.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=998ad5f5-01f5-45a5-b1c3-e99af715a75f Melee - Active] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F998ad5f5-01f5-45a5-b1c3-e99af715a75f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/S7OY3iNLiN.png Guide illustration] ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This bar does not let you AFK. You can mostly let the bar fire off abilities automatically, only occasionally interjecting with manual inputs such as targeted [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd] as required.

​

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/9Q9TMQt7tU0 active melee example]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

The quest [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_World_Wakes The World Wakes] is required to kill Automatons or get them as a Slayer task [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer].

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 67

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 624

⬥ Optimal kills per hour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generators - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] 530+ / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] 570+ / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] 470+

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tracers - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] 550+ / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] 610+ / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] 480+

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guardians - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] 600+ / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] 650+

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~390k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Static [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694757179403.png?v=1 staticglove], Tracking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694765699101.png?v=1 trackingglove] and Pneumatic gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694711304193.png?v=1 pneumaticglove] ‎ ‎- 1/1000

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped by Guardians (melee), Generators (mage), and Tracers (ranged) respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for Slayer log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Also required for crafting the Enchantments of metaphysics, shadows and heroism respectively.

⬥ Cresbot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107269820133477.png?v=1 automaton] (pet) - 1/1600

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pet required for slayer log

​

Strategy

⬥ For Tracers and Generators the core strategy is the same: back yourself into the corner to minimize the chance of getting spec'd by 2 automatons at the same time and taking rapid, heavy damage.

⬥ For Guardians, who roam the middle of the room, it is best to stand near the doorway.

⬥ The special timer starts counting from the time when the automatons are damaged.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be careful when using "chaining" abilities ( [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] ) as they will aggro a large number of enemies at once.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

⬥ Most Wanted Card (Automaton) (obtained from Rush of Blood) can be used if you own any, as they will improves the droprate of both the pet and gloves.

⬥ Recommended relics:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1 conservationofenergy] Conservation of Energy

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1 deathward] Death Ward

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is the most important to further diminish KO potential.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1 furyofthesmall] Fury of the Small

​

Location and Where to Stand

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Greater demon variants found southwest of Elite Dungeon 2 and within the Zamorakian undercity elite dungeon are significantly stronger than standard greater demons.

​

⬥ The two wilderness variants of enhanced greater demons attack using melee (berserker) and magic (ash lord). The wilderness population is weaker than those found in the Zamorakian undercity and are poisonable [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon]. Along with access to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] buffs, this makes them ideal for slayer training.

​

⬥ Since they don't have any unique drops, a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1 sacrificescrim] can be used for additional slayer XP. This makes greater demon berserkers and ash lords some of the best AFK slayer exp in the game.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This also means there's no reason to do them off-task.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 7150

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~185 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] (All AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~1.3m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] (All AFK)

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scrimshaw_of_sacrifice Scrimshaw of sacrifice] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1 sacrificescrim]     • Increases slayer XP gained by 1.5X and removes all drops obtained.     • Losses are negligible as demons do not have any uniques or otherwise valuable drops. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks]     • A large portion of your damage comes from poison. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Jas_demonbane_arrow Jas demonbane arrows] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697055334491.png?v=1 jasdemonbanearrow]     • Best in slot demon slaying ammo if using ranged. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_slayer_equipment Demon slayer equipment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325697503907910.png?v=1 demonslayercirclet]     • Best in slot demon slaying armour if using ranged.     • Bring 3 pieces and 1 piece of augmented power armour with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] ​
Passive unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Guardhouse Tier 3 guardhouse]     • Due to the high amount of HP of the demons, the chance for ultimates to instakill [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 instakill] is highly beneficial for this task. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop Restocking Cannon Ability]     • Allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] restocking without user input, essential for AFKing.

Location and How to Get There

Use the dragonkin laboratory teleport or a portal attuned to the Elite dungeon via War's Retreat. Exit via the southwest to enter the wilderness.

​

General strategy

Enhanced greater demon variants possess high damage and cannot be recklessly AoE'd unlike many other slayer mobs. Hence, it would be best to safespot them or at most tank 2 of them at once.

​

⬥ Players who do not possess end game equipment may utilise a safespot west of the dungeon as shown below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/QNQKfw6CFG.png Guide illustration] ⬥ More information on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] placement and demonstration may be found [https://youtu.be/mSMcfhR4OKM?t=270 here]

⬥ Players who are well-geared and can afford to tank their attacks may run south and position themselves on a small peninsula as shown below, using a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to aggro the demons.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This spot allows you to lure 5 demons in total (3 ash lords + 2 berserkers), and limits the number of demons attacking you to at most 2 at once (1 Ash lord + 1 Berserker) as other demons will be stuck behind.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nC2nSMEQNe.png Guide illustration]

Method: AFK Magic/Ranged

With high end gear, both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] can be used to AFK the demons, at around the same rates.

​

⬥ When you need to repair the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon], quickly [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] out, click, and then [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1 dive] back to the suggested spot.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Check that the demons did not walk in a way which gets them stuck.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] with Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] with Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

**Note: ** During the initial lure, the demons may get stuck in a conformation that makes them unable to approach you, to resolve this, kill the initial wave and then walk back to the suggested spot.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UiLHx0Iiew.mp4 Source media]

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=xOESeIBUXTomu0czCDdw Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a9c1ce6b-f046-430e-a601-5ac813f5a3cc Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fa9c1ce6b-f046-430e-a601-5ac813f5a3cc.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Revo bars

⬥ Magic

[https://img.pvme.io/images/IgDOtxOzBV.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Ranged

[https://img.pvme.io/images/3kySUDBDK3.png Guide illustration]

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/GkZeab52L24 AFK Magic]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/hFzJCVmSOXg AFK Ranged]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Example Block/Prefer Lists

Note: The following block/prefer lists are just examples, it’s always more efficient to make your own.

​

⬥ It's assumed the player will slay Moss Golems for Creatures of the Lost Grove tasks and Ripper Demons for Demon cluster tasks, as well as bringing Binding Contracts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073883118521557052.png?v=1 bindingcontract] for GP.

⬥ These lists are made for use with Laniakea [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1 laniakea]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Before level 90, when you can't use her as your Slayer Master, its generally not worth thinking too hard about your block/prefer list, and you can just block tasks you don't like or find unrewarding.

​

Block/Prefer List for XP:

Block
⬥ Aviansies ⬥ Black Demons ⬥ Kalphites ⬥ Dagannoths ⬥ Dark Beasts ⬥ Mutated Jadinkos ⬥ Order of Ascension members ⬥ Steel Dragons
Prefer
⬥ Abyssal Demons ⬥ Creatures of the Lost Grove ⬥ Demons ⬥ Living Wyverns ⬥ Gemstone Dragons ⬥ Nightmare Creatures ⬥ Ripper Demons ⬥ Acheron Mammoths

​

Block/Prefer List for GP:

Block
⬥ Kalphites ⬥ Black Demons ⬥ Greater Demons ⬥ Aviansies ⬥ Dagannoths ⬥ Vile Blooms ⬥ Order of Ascension members ⬥ Shadow Creatures
Prefer
⬥ Profane Scabarites ⬥ Creatures of the Lost Grove ⬥ Demons ⬥ Living Wyverns ⬥ Kal'gerion Demons ⬥ Nightmare Creatures ⬥ Ripper Demons ⬥ Abyssal Demons

​

Personalised Spreadsheet

⬥ Configuring the spreadsheet below is an easy way to find the best Block/Prefer list for your personal use.

⬥ Be aware of the Slayer collection log while blocking monsters, and whether it's something you have interest in filling out or not.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Slayer collection log is something you're interested in doing, check out our [[PvME/Slayer/Ultimate Slayer|Ultimate Slayer]] on obtaining Ultimate Slayer, which has an alternative block/prefer list included.

​

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-HSin-Tqwbc1ZJHNcz9jg2xs6XMPu56dKyMFgYV-sYc/edit?gid=829497037#gid=829497037 Customisable Block/Prefer Spreadsheet] ⬥ Click File > Make a copy top left for a personal copy. ⬥ Toggle the Home page settings to match what you use.     • The Misc section is for unlisted XP modifiers, e.g. enter 10 if you have an unlisted 10% XP buff. ⬥ Enter your KPH in the column on the right of the Experience page.     • You can select tasks to lock, force prefer/block, and that you use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1 sacrificescrim] for here as well. ⬥ Select the focus of your Slaying in the next page's dropdown menu and copy the displayed Block and Prefer list.

​

Additional Information

⬥ Players start with a only a few slots to block/prefer monsters, gaining 1 of each every 50 Quest Points achieved, up to a maximum of 8 slots to block and prefer monsters at 400 Quest Points.

⬥ Don't be afraid to skip undesired or bad assignments, as you can skip around half of the tasks given by Laniakea [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1 laniakea] without losing many Slayer points overall, and they can be farmed with relative ease, making it unnecessary to force yourself to do any tasks you dislike.

⬥ The assignment given by your Slayer Master is not completely random, a system unique to each Slayer Master known as weighting is used to make some assignments more common than others, and may be a factor in what the player chooses to block/prefer.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The higher the weighting, the more common the assignment compared to others, the weighting for each task a Slayer Master has can be viewed on their page of the RuneScape Wiki.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As we can see from the image below, Jacquelyn [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345369665577.png?v=1 jacquelyn] has a slightly higher chance to assign us Cows, Goblins, or Zombies.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/K4vpwtYbmi.png Guide illustration] ​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Camel_Warrior Camel Warriors] are one of the 4 Raptor Mobs, generally killed for the collection log. As such, they should only be killed on task where they are 5x more likely to drop the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/917025698479210528.png?v=1 camelstaff]

​

⬥ Camel warriors have one main mechanic - After taking some damage, they split into 3 mirages - Blood, Smoke and Shadow. Each has their own unique abilities. All attack with magic.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shadow mirages - Drains [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] points after charging their overhead bar.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood mirages - Heal other mirages for ~900 HP per attack.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Smoke mirages - Cast the Confuse, Weaken and Snare spells on the player, reducing hitchance and damage by 5%, and freezing you in place for 10s respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ After the mirages have been killed, the camel warrior re-appears with the HP it had before phasing, and can now be finished off.

​

⬥ Mirages can be bypassed by dealing a singular hit of more than 20,125 damage, before hitcaps apply.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example, if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] is used on task in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] with 120 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer], it will be capped at 15K, but in theory it would've dealt 30K damage, so the camel will not be phased. This will then allow the player to finish off the camel by dealing the remaining 5125 damage in 1 hit.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the player fails to deal 5125 damage in the next hit, the camel will phase into mirages. This is why perks such as crackling [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1 crack4] and aftershock [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] should be avoided when relying on methods that skip the mirage mechanic.

​

⬥ All methods suggested below use tricks that bypass the mechanic entirely, as it is very time consuming and detrimental to kph to kill Camel warriors "normally".

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 4768.8

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 300 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], 200 AFK

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~1.43M (~1m AFK)

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Camel_staff Camel staff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/917025698479210528.png?v=1 camelstaff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 times rarer off-task.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Raptor_key_part_3 Raptor key part 3]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Must be on task.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Ugthanatos The Ugthanatos]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cursed_amascut_sand Cursed amascut sand] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152063208763433.png?v=1 cursedamascutsand]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped by any of the 4 Raptor specialty monsters.

​

Location and How to Get There

⬥ They can be found on the island east of Sophanem, which is accessed via stepping stones (no [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864819760758844.png?v=1 agility] level needed) near a group of crocodiles. The area is affected by desert heat.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via travelling south from Pharaoh's sceptre/Sceptre of the Gods option 2 followed by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, one can go via a gate in the eastern wall of Sophanem that allows access from the city.

​

Method: Active Melee [PoSD]

The fastest way to kill camels relies on doing trips to a player owned dungeon with 3-4 camel warriors, using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] and trying to kill as many camels as possible within the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] duration while skipping the mirage mechanic. It also requires essentially best in slot melee gear to be as consistent as possible.

​

⬥ 2023-AUG-29 - IMPORTANT NOTE

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] changes which made the enhanced variant not reset-able with the War's Retreat crystal, this method is significantly worse and will not be able to achieve the advertised kph. However, it is likely still better than methods which involves dealing with camel spawns.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=IaEAq8JYt0E4KufUW910 Melee - Active] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FIaEAq8JYt0E4KufUW910.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Strategy

⬥ Ensure your familiar combat setting is on Passive.

​

⬥ Occasionally, the camel will not phase despite [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] hitting for significantly less than 20,000. When this happens, use a 188 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879577612298.png?v=1 sever] to guarantee the kill on the camel. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994929821727604808.png?v=1 smashgop] may not deal sufficient raw damage to finish the camel off.

​

  1. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] at War's Retreat with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1 asr] equipped + Kalg spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll]

  2. Swap to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602561894829522954.png?v=1 terramaul] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1 reaverring] and get back 90% or more adrenaline before teleporting to the Menaphos house portal.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Use a Menaphos tablet or the House teleport spell if your house is attuned to Menaphos.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. You can activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] from action bar without interrupting adren gaining if not on full HP.

  1. Travel to the sunken pyramid with Kags (option 1).

  2. Enter the dungeon using right click. You should fall out of combat and Persistent Rage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1 persistentrage] should start topping your adrenaline off until 120% around this time.

  3. Do a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] → walk diagonal → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1 surgemobile] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378665802235968.png?v=1 divemobile] to get to whichever large dungeon hosts your camels (diagram below).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/314C4Su9Hi.png Guide illustration]

  1. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] as you enter the dungeon and turn on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim]

​

Step 1 - [https://youtu.be/ZOVInSkksNI 6 demonstration]

​

Camel 1: Target closest Camel → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1 punish] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] spot where it spawns. If enhanced [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] is on cooldown, use defensive basics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] for adrenaline until you can [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous]

Camel 2: Walk next to spawn + (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] + basic

Camel 3 onwards: (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → basic

​

⬥ Sometimes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1 overpowerigneous] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] will crit and kill the camel on its own, and you will not need to use a basic after.

​

⬥ Cycle basics in the order [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994929821727604808.png?v=1 smashgop] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] after a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] guarantees a kill.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] after a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1 gfury] crit guarantees kill.

​

⬥ In an ideal run, you should be able to get 7-8 camel KC.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1 relentless5] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] and lucky crits, a 9 kill run is possible.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HuDHDp3du2.mp4 Source media]

⬥ When you fail a skip, use (tc) + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] to avoid getting rooted and try to spend as much of your adrenaline as possible on other spawns before teleporting out.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KuRqzaZMl5.mp4 Source media]

⬥ If you run out of adrenaline and still have time on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk], use (tc) + defensive basics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1 voke] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1 anti] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1 freedom] until you have enough adrenaline for another [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592042399383713.png?v=1 dragonlongsword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] (22.5%)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/3oKetozjs6.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Turn off [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] when finishing up a trip to preserve charges.

​

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/WxDyOaSMxrM Narrated task and example kills]

​

Method: AFK Cannon

This method involves not engaging in combat with the Camel Warriors at all, relying on cannon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and poison damage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] which passively kill the Camel Warriors without triggering their mirage mechanic.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9b25a62c-dd22-4055-bfc3-bb0541bdefb3 Melee - AFK] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9b25a62c-dd22-4055-bfc3-bb0541bdefb3.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093437906374696.png?v=1 bookofdeath] can be used here to increase kph by 10%

​

Strategy

⬥ Place the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] in the Camel Warrior island, while staying in the tiny island before the stepping stone, as shown below:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vVgYAkeEST.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Players can do other activities in the meantime (e.g. Fletching [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864817881722960.png?v=1 fletching]).

⬥ To avoid being attacked by camels, players should bring runes for Telekinetic Grab [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/866551637970255872.png?v=1 telekeneticgrab] to collect the drops along with using a legendary pet with the "Scavenge" perk active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do NOT call your pet as it will end up being on the same small island as you, and will not able to access the drops.

​

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Lau76BJzi6c Short sample of AFK Camels]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the change from Legacy Combat Mode to Classic Combat Mode

Know of a newer method? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Capsarius Capsarius] are the healers of the Order of Ascension. They are mainly killed for Ascension members Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] tasks, the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Feldip_Hills Feldip Hills collection log], and Ascension Keystones in the Sunken Pyramid.

​

⬥ This guide will focus on killing Capsarius in the Sunken Pyramid, as this location yields the highest kills per hour.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Capsarius have weak attacks, don't heal each other, and have low health which makes them very easy to farm.

⬥ Ascension members can be assigned as a Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] assignment by Duradel, Kuradal, Morvran, and Laniakea.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 81

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 99 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is required to access the Sunken Pyramid.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 146.6

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~1000 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] (Legacy AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~146k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] (Legacy AFK)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Ascension Keystone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1161265528057380904.png?v=1 ascensionkeystone]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

⬥ Ascension Grips [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643166338461859850.png?v=1 ascgrips]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Must be on task.

⬥ Ascension Shard

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be used to get [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429563465730.png?v=1 silentcomp]

⬥ Order journal pages

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape]

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Magic_notepaper Magic notepaper] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1 notepaper]     • Extends your trips by allowing you to note [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1161265528057380904.png?v=1 ascensionkeystone] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Excalibur Enhanced Excalibur] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1 enhancedexcalibur]     • Can be used to help sustain life points.

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ If killing Capsarius in the Monastery of Ascension use the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552303024152578.png?v=1 oogloglode] and run northwest.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only use this location while collecting souls.

⬥ If killing Capsarius in the Sunken Pyramid use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.

​

Method: Legacy Ranged

⬥ Toggle on [https://runescape.wiki/w/Legacy_Mode#Combat Legacy Combat Mode].

⬥ Place 5 Capsarius in the small room of the Sunken Pyramid.

⬥ Toggle the scavenge settings on your legendary to only pick up desired drops.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not doing this results in an increased chance at missing keystone drops.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/t6Us9dgqjv.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Position yourself in the center of the small room.

​

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689551388576972805.png?v=1 aggrovl] is active at all times.

⬥ Activate your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159546712074.png?v=1 cruelty]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9023abcc-de44-469f-afd6-49f9ca0be436 Legacy Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9023abcc-de44-469f-afd6-49f9ca0be436.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/BX5N4tSNrew Legacy Ranged AFK]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/BX5N4tSNrew Embedded guide video]

​
