[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Celestial Dragons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212539441975296.png?v=1 celestialdragon] are generally only killed for the Ultimate Slayer title. Otherwise, the XP and GP/hr are mediocre at best.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 976.6

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~650 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] (AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~635k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] (AFK)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Celestial_handwraps Celestial handwraps] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158716239885.png?v=1 Celestialhandwraps] (only dropped on-task)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Rider_armour Dragon rider armour] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1029416866537554021.png?v=1 dragonriderbody] 1/1,280 for any piece (1/5,120 for a specific piece)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Bonecrusher Bonecrusher] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher]     • 100% prayer sustain with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dwarven_Seige_Engine Dwarven Siege Engine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] ⬥ Poison-boosting items     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison%2B%2B%2B#(4) Weapon poison+++] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane_gloves Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes]     • [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks Kwuarm incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks]
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_(perk) Dragon slayer perk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenging Scavenging perk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1 scavenging4] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enchantment_of_shadows Upgraded] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943601029120.png?v=1 stalkerring] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enchantment_of_dispelling Upgraded] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow] ⬥ If using a familiar to maximise KPH, you do not need scrolls:     • Blood Reaver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] + Vampyrism [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] for additional [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] procs     • Ripper Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] for its passive     • Kalg Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] for its crit boost     • Legendary Pet to pick up drops

​

Location and How to Get There

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212539441975296.png?v=1 celestialdragon] can be found in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragontooth_Island_resource_dungeon Dragontooth Island resource dungeon] after the question [https://runescape.wiki/w/One_of_a_Kind One of a Kind] is complete.

You can get there by:

⬥ Option 0 → 3 on the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dungeoneering_cape Dungeoneering cape] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1 dgcape] (option 0 → 3).

⬥ Using a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Max_guild_portal Max guild portal] tuned to the Radiant Wisp colony.

⬥ Teleport to Dragontooth Island using the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Big_Book_o%27_Piracy Big Book o' Piracy].

⬥ You can also go to Port Phasmatys (Ectophial teleport or charter a boat) and speak with the Ghost captain while wearing a ghostspeak amulet.

​

Method: AFK Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

Place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] in the middle of the room and ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] is active.

With this [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] method trips are only limited by your supplies (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and cannonballs).

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1 superantifire] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/YSnu4Zec7z.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=gmY7VtwCu66FgPJ7HcPx Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FgmY7VtwCu66FgPJ7HcPx.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4cLhV09cEF.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ijd4qDmtaX8 Example AFK Ranged Kills] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_Shapeshifter Crystal Shapeshifters] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107281153150986.png?v=1 crystalshapeshifter] are a slayer monster found on [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tarddiad Tarddiad] and are accessible via the World Gate (looks like the number 1), they can be assigned by Morvran or Laniakea after the completion of [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Light_Within The Light Within] quest. Crystal Shapeshifters will change their attacking style to what your armour is weakest against (if this is equal, attack styles will be random).

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 80

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 99 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is required to access the Sunken Pyramid

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1,269.8

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~490 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~780 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~570 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~622k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~990k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~724k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_elven_wedding_ring Ancient elven wedding ring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tarddian_crystal Tarddian crystal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used to exchange for Attuned crystal armour at [https://runescape.wiki/w/Angof%27s_Crystal_Armour_Shop Angof's Crystal Armour Shop]

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sixth-Age_circuit Sixth-Age circuit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit]     • Used to teleport to the World Gate if doing the Tarddiad method ⬥ Each piece of crystal armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515663490285648.png?v=1 attunedcrystalhelm] worn increases the drop rate of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_elven_wedding_ring Ancient elven wedding ring]     • Attuned crystal armour boosts this drop rate massively

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ If killing Crystal Shapeshifters in Tarddiad use option 2 on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit] to select the World Gate.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to attune the World Gate to Tarddiad.

⬥ If killing Crystal Shapeshifters in the Sunken Pyramid use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.

​

Method: Tarddiad

⬥ Make sure you toggle on aggression by speaking to Angof on Tarddiad (north, near the camp fire).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes the Crystal Shapeshifters permanently aggressive and eliminates the need for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ESHtyB6.png Guide illustration]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vNye6IiODf.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] then go east and stand just to the east of the bridge.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you find yourself getting dragged around then simply return back to the position shown above when convenient.

⬥ If using Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] then go northwest and kill them [https://img.pvme.io/images/TVYM0GfqAn.png here].

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7a9b1030-6118-40db-9041-8a70ee8bc87b Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c69fc0df-eddd-43e1-94b3-b5588d036cc5 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F7a9b1030-6118-40db-9041-8a70ee8bc87b.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bar

⬥ Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/0YHOCwd95Q.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Necromancy

[https://img.pvme.io/images/nstEjYU6Wt.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OUlMak8y9FQ Melee]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n8BYDqEn1kI Necromancy]

​

Method: Sunken Pyramid

⬥ Make sure you toggle on aggression by speaking to Angof on Tarddiad (north, near the camp fire).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes the Crystal Shapeshifters permanently aggressive and eliminates the need for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion]

⬥ Place 5 Crystal Shapeshifters in the small room of the Sunken Pyramid.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/67qNuIGcUI.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Position yourself in the southeast corner of the small room.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9b19be1f-cd14-4376-808f-7a2b564e210b Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=05dde51b-53d9-4ce9-a313-f6c11d936b7b Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9b19be1f-cd14-4376-808f-7a2b564e210b.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bar

⬥ Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/0YHOCwd95Q.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Necromancy

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1yxYPRIk40.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026.

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

Introduction

⬥ There are 4 types of dinosaurs (slayer monster), all of which are found on Anachronia:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Feral dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1 feraldinosaur] - 90 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Venomous dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1 venomousdinosaur] - 105 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Brutish dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1 brutishdinosaur] - 99 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ripper dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1 ripperdinosaur] - 114 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

​

⬥ Dinosaurs are only assigned by Laniakea [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1 laniakea] and CANNOT be placed in the player owned dungeon.

​

⬥ All of them attack with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes the best style to use against them [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], followed by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] should not be used for any dinosaur tasks.

​

Desirable Drops

All dinosaurs have the same drop rates for uniques and Totem pieces. It is thus recommended to kill Venomous Dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1 venomousdinosaur] if your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level is high enough as they have the highest KPH.

​

⬥ Dinosaur tooth - 1/800

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Needed for T3 Slayer Lodge for Slayer Helmet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] stand

⬥ Blowpipe pieces [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794591830056961.png?v=1 upgradedboneblowpipe] - 1/6,000 on-task, 1/20,000 off-task

⬥ Totem of auras middle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem] - 1/300

⬥ Totem of Summoning middle [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811539499.png?v=1 summtotem] - 1/300

⬥ Totem of intimidation base [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594794631198.png?v=1 intimidationtotem] - 1/300

⬥ Dinosaur rib bone - 1/1,000

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Needed for T3 Player Lodge for Skillcape stand

​

During the Roar of Osseous, blowpipe and totem pieces have a 10% increase in drop rate.

​

Useful Items

Useful Items and Unlocks
Improves KPH/Exp rates/QoL.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_armour_spikes_(alloy) Abyssal Armour Spikes (alloy)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842541129768.png?v=1 abyssalarmourspikesalloy]     • Increases [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] hits and healing via the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 VampScrim]     • Other tiers of armour spikes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004090524669587517.png?v=1 armourspike] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756235792053174332.png?v=1 armourspikealloy] work as well. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Essence_of_Finality_amulet Essence of Finality] with a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_halberd Dragon Halberd] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1 dragonhalberd]     • Good AoE spec to use if killing them actively with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Necklace_of_Salamancy Necklace of Salamancy] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/970657245312467004.png?v=1 necklaceofsalamancy]     • Provides a 10% accuracy and damage buff wild fighting dinosaurs. ​
Passive unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop Restocking Cannon Ability]     • Allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] restocking without user input. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Anachronia_base_camp#Slayer_Lodge Anachronia slayer lodge]     • Tiers 1, 2 and 3 increases damage dealt on Anachronia monsters by 1%. 3%, and 6% respectively.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Cq64oeS.png Guide illustration]

Venomous Dinosaurs

Venomous dinosaurs are the go-to for dinosaur tasks as they have the highest kills per hour of any dinosaur.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] XP per kill : 1378 + 454.7 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 Constitution]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 1332

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 480

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour : ~640k

​

Location and How to Get There

⬥ Venomous Dinosaurs are located on the northwestern part of Anachronia, easily accessed by using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1354420110772928512.png?v=1 nwanachronia] and heading east.

​

⬥ Place the cannon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] on the yellow square and stand on the green square shown in the image below. This effectively aggros 5 dinosaurs. This works for all three methods.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a dinosaur is getting stuck on the bone to the south while using Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], stand 1 tile east.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WOzKMPVw24.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: Active and AFK Melee

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] may be used to prevent excess damage.

⬥ The Corbicula Rex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117273821280.png?v=1 corbicula] perk from Ranch out of Time can increase KPH.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=51882ae9-509d-4e67-be76-59f676e6a71c Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F51882ae9-509d-4e67-be76-59f676e6a71c.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/bLMRGXzCII.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: AFK Magic

Thanks to the Venomous Dinosaurs' higher affinity to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] (and susceptibility to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff]) and damage reduction provided by [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] and Cryptbloom Armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336168363561041.png?v=1 cryptbloomtop], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] can achieve a similar or slightly higher KPH than melee at ~480 KPH, while being both very safe and AFK.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=MopjYBuvJUpsaspbD93p Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FMopjYBuvJUpsaspbD93p.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Note: Prism of Restoration [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] should be cast at least every 5min to keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] alive.

Note: This preset assumes the player has their [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] in the Anachronia Stand.

​

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1sj0CK2.png Guide illustration] ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] and/or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] are not owned, simply ignore them and move the remaining abilities closer to the left. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] is by no means a requirement, but can slightly improve KPH.

​

Method: AFK Necromancy

Thanks to Necromancies sustain with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon], as well as its strong aoe damage potential with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe], it can effectively AFK Venomous Dinosaurs. Around 450-470kph can be achieved on task with this method while being safe and AFK with low input costs.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] at all times.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to help aggroing the dinosaurs.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=758cb45a-c742-4df1-92fb-ac1698546b93 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F758cb45a-c742-4df1-92fb-ac1698546b93.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/aVsKFtymtR.png Guide illustration] ​

Video Example

[https://youtu.be/wSqeBdw2cVE Melee active]

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Z3n6q4v0ps Necromancy AFK]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/lqGkdJ79ji.png Guide illustration]

Other dinosaurs

It is only recommended to kill other dinosaurs if you do not have the level for Venomous dinosaurs or if collecting their souls in [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1 ushabti]. Bars for all these dinosaurs might be sub-optimal, if you find a better bar please make a post in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)].

​

Rates

⬥ Feral Dinosaur [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1 feraldinosaur] ~300kph

⬥ Brutish Dinosaur [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1 brutishdinosaur] ~200kph

⬥ Ripper Dinosaur [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1 ripperdinosaur] ~200kph

​

Location and How to Get There

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1 brutishdinosaur] are located east of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1 venomousdinosaur], following the northern path at the fork in the road.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1 feraldinosaur] are in the same area, but found by following the south path.

⬥ For [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1 ripperdinosaur], teleport to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1 laniakea] using the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape] and walk north.

​

Method: Melee AFK - Feral and Brutish

This method is viable for both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1 feraldinosaur] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1 brutishdinosaur], but not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1 ripperdinosaur]

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 Malevolence]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] at all times.

⬥ Bring some emergency food or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1 reaverscroll] for healing if having issues with HP.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim] is active.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] is active.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] for aggro.

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=N1yeCIBMIEm8BgJvhRZN Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FN1yeCIBMIEm8BgJvhRZN.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Where to Stand

Player position (yellow) and cannon position (red) for Feral and Brutish dinosaurs respectively.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/xdwdy8F.png Guide illustration]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/NsU5cgR.png Guide illustration]

Action bar

⬥ Feral dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1 feraldinosaur] - Remove [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1 zerk] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas] if off-task.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gQpI1Gv.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Brutish dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1 brutishdinosaur] - Remove [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas] if off-task.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/BUlsZhU.png Guide illustration]

Method: AFK Magic - Ripper

Ripper dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1 ripperdinosaur] are highly damaging and generally not worth doing unless getting a soul [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1 ushabti]. They can only be reliably AFK'd with multiple pieces of Cryptbloom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1 cryptbloomhelm] and with Vampyrism aura [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1 vampaura]. The method below may not work if cutting corners such as not having [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 omnipowerigneous]

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 Affliction]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] is active at all times.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] is active.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1 autoretaliate] is active before stocking the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=fu9akCKqeq84DP1a5xGi Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Ffu9akCKqeq84DP1a5xGi.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/cpC7pDh.png Guide illustration]

Where to Stand

Place the cannon on the tile as shown below and stand close to it (specific tile not important).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/GJYFEsW.png Guide illustration]

Video Examples

[https://youtu.be/46Ce1ZpU4BY?si=SQfm-dEwAUapCW8g Melee AFK (Feral dinosaurs)]

[https://youtu.be/lzzZCmpRJRg Melee AFK (Brutish dinosaurs)]

[https://youtu.be/pox00C4NLJI Magic AFK (Ripper dinosaurs)]

​

Method: AFK Necromancy - Ripper

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] at all times.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to help aggroing the dinosaurs.

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9mYyxkdP3FCGVGtk3hbS Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Edimmu [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1 Edimmu] are undead slayer monster requiring 90 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] and 115 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering] to kill. They are a task-only monster so players going for the Daemonheim log are strongly advised to prioritise picking this monster whenever [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape] procs. The player can only access the Edimmu area if on a slayer task or holding slayer wildcards.

​

⬥ Besides the default Edimmu tasks, you can also kill Edimmu for the following tasks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Creatures of Daemonheim

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ghosts

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zombies

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] XP per kill : 1600 + 528 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 880.2

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~585 (530 AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~515K (466K AFK)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Edimmu pet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1 Edimmu] - 1/512 only from Elites

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer log.

⬥ Blood Necklace shards [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1015699014764728492.png?v=1 bloodnecklaceshard]

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Item unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_luck_potion Enhanced luck potion] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717295935500.png?v=1 luckpotion]     • Spawns more Elites and increases pet droprate to 1/496. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment Ghost hunter equipment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm]     • Each piece provides a 3% damage boost. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet (e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]     • Best in slot for killing Edimmu. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Wildcard Slayer wildcards] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130171148349485186.png?v=1 wildcards]     • Helpful for killing an Elite if one spawns right as the task ends. ​
Passive unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Undead_Slayer Undead slayer (perk)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Genocidal Genocidal] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]     • Increases damage and KPH.     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal] should be on the armour used to kill Edimmus as you are always on task. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Undead_Slayer_(ability) Undead slayer (sigil)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1 undeadslayer]     • Increases damage and kph if slaying actively. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop Restocking Cannon Ability]     • Allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] restocking without user input.

Location and How to Get There

Edimmu are slayer monsters found within the Edimmu dungeon, which is located in the Meilyr district of Prifddinas and requires 115 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering] to be assessed. The best way to get there would be the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1 dgcape] teleport straight to the dungeon, or by teleporting to the Meilyr district via a teleport seed.

​

General strategy

Despite looking large, Edimmus are 1x1, with Elites being 2x2. This makes it viable to use strategies which involve stacking them up and then AoEing them down.

​

⬥ For both active and AFK methods, position your cannon as shown below.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If AFKing, stand in the position as shown below.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/diLpe7Xnjz.png Guide illustration]

Method: Jacquelyn tasks

If going for pet, as each slayer task forces an Elite spawn, a good way to farm Elites is via the slayer master Jacquelyn. This is done by killing Edimmu during a Zombie or Ghost task which forces an Elite spawn every 15 kills with slayer introspection.

​

Method: Active Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

⚠️ Disclaimer

This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

The active strategy for Edimmu involves aggroing as many as possible, luring them to a barrier and then chinning them down. This method also works with melee if using a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159341322240.png?v=1 noxscythe], but ranged has a much easier experience. Additionally, less damage is taken using ranged as Edimmus primarily attack with magic.

​

⬥ Generally this method is only recommended for relatively ungeared players, as players with good magic equipment can AFK the task obtaining a slightly lower kph.

​

⬥ The kph of killing Edimmu actively is highly limited by their slow spawn timers.

​

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1QskhDlXvb7BMjnvTpfW Ranged - Active] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F1QskhDlXvb7BMjnvTpfW.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Strategy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ When a bunch of Edimmu are aggro'd onto you, step behind the barrier and wait for the Edimmu to fill in the space immediately before the barrier.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Edimmus are in position, immediately enter to avoid losing Edimmu aggression and target the center Edimmu.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rough ability priority with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin]: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1 deadshotigneous] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is easier to target the normal Edimmu around the Elite and chin them down together.

​

⬥ A [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195712201228289.png?v=1 Yak] can be a viable familiar for this task.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Store some food it in case you mess up Elite Edimmu spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use it to store rare drop table drops, sharks, or unstackable drops (e.g. crystal seeds).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Winter Storage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540068163895347.png?v=1 yakscroll] can be used to bank untradeable drops like attuned crystal weapon/armour seeds or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1015699014764728492.png?v=1 bloodnecklaceshard]

​

⬥ While waiting for Edimmu to respawn, you can run around to aggro and kill stray Edimmu not tagged by the cannon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153635004447.png?v=1 ricocaroming] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/909338509234569216.png?v=1 aggression] are good options for mass-aggroing.

​

⬥ If done right, you will be able to kill at least 585 per hour.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will vary a little depending on the number of Elite spawns.

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] is not needed for the method to work well.

​

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

Video Example [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/5XFZDdfoRjA Ranged - Active]

Method: AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

⚠️ Disclaimer

This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

Edimmu are best AFK'd using a staff with caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159294922753.png?v=1 noxstaff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4] along with gchain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain]. The gear required strongly depends on the player's effort in dealing with Elite Edimmu. Even though Edimmu themselves do not deal much damage and can be out healed with mage's AoE easily, Elites pose a huge problem if trying to AFK with subpar gear and will require the player to click back and take measures to kill the Elite (e.g. laying [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine], eating food).

​

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=VOyUgsYbqFqGu37RvZRq Magic - AFK] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FVOyUgsYbqFqGu37RvZRq.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Strategy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

​

⬥ You can move in a way similar to this clip to repair your cannon when needed:

[https://img.pvme.io/images/iJqur840Ku.mp4 Source media]

⬥ Although this method should work semi-consistently completely AFK, it is highly recommended to set an Alt1 alert for Elite slayer monster spawns so that Elite Edimmus won't cause problems even in the event of bad RNG.

​

⬥ This setup achieves around 530 kph.

​

Revo bar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/djjJ8Pc13v.png Guide illustration]

Video Example [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Z1FIad1hFJ0 Magic - AFK]

Method: AFK Necro [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Strategy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Although this method can consistently work completely AFK, the only KO potential is with Elite Edimmu so it is recommended to set up an alt1 alert to ensure safety.

​

⬥ This setup achieves around 500-550kph.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] if necessary

⬥ Alternatively, sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1 penanceaura] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] if necessary (will result in fewer kills)

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] , [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] , and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison]

⬥ Have your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] turned on

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1 kalgscroll] and set auto fire rate to 1

​

Presets and Relics [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Elite_Profane_Scabarite Elite Profane Scabarites] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1333926854666621019.png?v=1 profanescabarite] are slayer monsters requiring 87 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] to kill. They can be killed off-task, or with either a "Scabarites" or "Profane Scabarites" task for on-task bonuses.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level required: 87

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1,890

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~460 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~618 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~869k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~1.17m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ The Spectral Lens [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334309383831818342.png?v=1 spectrallens] which is the Necromancy slayer helm component.

⬥ Killing 200 Elite Profane Scabarites while wielding the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Primed_keris Primed keris] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334318822269780028.png?v=1 primedkeris] upgrades it to a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Consecrated_keris Consecrated keris] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334318846202478615.png?v=1 consecratedkeris]

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Elite Profane Scabarites can be fought in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Temple_of_Isolation Temple of Isolation] or the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid Sunken Pyramid].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The [https://runescape.wiki/w/Temple_of_Isolation Temple of Isolation] can be reached by taking the boat in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scabarite_Cavern Scabarite Cavern].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once inside the cavern, cross the bridge and take the boat to the temple area.

​

Temple of Isolation

⬥ If using Melee:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Run up the hill and across the bridge.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place your cannon south-east of the bridge, just south of the fallen pillar.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand underneath your cannon.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/lpLpqZGa6v.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If using Magic:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Run up the hill and across the bridge.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place your cannon at the top of the stairs, in the middle of the platform outside the door.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand underneath your cannon.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/k8SWWEzgSJ.png Guide illustration] ​

Sunken Pyramid

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mGGioEKQkA.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If killing Elite Profane Scabarites in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid Sunken Pyramid], use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Relocating your house to Menaphos and using a teleport to house tablet also works.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 Elite Profane Scabarites in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.

​

Method: Sunken Pyramid AFK

Before starting the session, check the following:

​

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1 holyaggroverload] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is active at all times.

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If accuracy issues, use earth spells.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265371144202.png?v=1 iritsticks] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] as antipoison effects are drained.

​

Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] > Biting 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] (if not using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness])

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Check [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim] is active, and ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] and / or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] are active at all times.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265371144202.png?v=1 iritsticks] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] as antipoison effects are drained.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=72c94344-5d06-4fd9-8b69-c187a32610cd Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d575871a-bd6f-4fc1-842e-4c50b6fcdd3f Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd575871a-bd6f-4fc1-842e-4c50b6fcdd3f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bars

⬥ Magic

[https://img.pvme.io/images/b57yUjEgRL.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/8C8OjLz5OP.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/5N2kGe1fRYM Sunken Pyramid AFK Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/f8Jdy3gjVdU Sunken Pyramid AFK Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Method: Temple of Isolation AFK Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

⚠️ Disclaimer

It may be difficult to survive with this method after the Aura changes made on 13/4/2026.

​

This method is primarily used to upgrade the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Primed_keris Primed keris] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334318822269780028.png?v=1 primedkeris] to a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Consecrated_keris Consecrated keris] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334318846202478615.png?v=1 consecratedkeris]

​

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and starting the session, check the following:

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265371144202.png?v=1 iritsticks] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] as antipoison effects are drained.

⬥ Set an Alt1 alarm for 50% HP in case of bad RNG.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Active [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] when it does.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=KvlhiUI1Ha94ZwCTcd3q Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FKvlhiUI1Ha94ZwCTcd3q.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/soKppb1G6B.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: Temple of Isolation AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

This method is primarily used to gather souls or for tasks if you don't have souls already, the highest kph can only achieved in the Sunken Pyramid so it is recommended to kill them there instead.

​

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and starting the session, check the following:

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is active at all times.

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If accuracy issues, use earth spells.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265371144202.png?v=1 iritsticks] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1 venomblood] as antipoison effects are drained.

⬥ If the south-east Scabarite is stuck on rocks, manually kill it to fix method - will only happen when starting trip.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=54f148fb-f6c4-4329-b825-5429ac84affb Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F54f148fb-f6c4-4329-b825-5429ac84affb.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/b57yUjEgRL.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/PZCZR-lNh2s Temple of Isolation AFK Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026.

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

Introduction

There are three species of gemstone dragons - Dragonstone dragons, Onyx dragons, and Hydrix dragons.

​

⬥ To kill them off-task in gemstone mines, you need to buy KC through these following uncut gems:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507025602543638.png?v=1 dstone] - Allows 2 kills each

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643411078763511828.png?v=1 uncutonyx] - Allows 400 kills each

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485542456135730.png?v=1 uncuthydrix] - Allows 4000 kills each

​

⬥ If killing them in the wilderness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1 mandrith] or Dragonkin Laboratory [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542326759435.png?v=1 bsd], payment is not needed.

​

⬥ Due to their low profitability but relatively high [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] EXP rates, they should be only be killed on-task for slayer EXP and heavily improved rare drop rates.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All presets hence assume [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] buffs are active on the Anachronia helmet stand.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For active methods, ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] is preferred with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For AFK methods [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] is better, although [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] methods are still available.

​

⬥ Besides autos and standard dragonbreath attacks, each species of gemstone dragon has a special attack which fires out a set of gemstone spikes, creating a 3x3 area centred around the player after a delay, dealing high [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] damage. Additionally, gemstone spikes have the following effects:

⬥ Dragonstone Dragon: Halves the duration of antifires and super antifires.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This does NOT work only on extended super antifires.

⬥ Onyx Dragon: Heals the dragon by up to 5000 LP.

⬥ Hydrix Dragon: Drains adrenaline to 0 and halves adrenaline gain for 15 seconds.

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ Besides the Draconic Visage (1/10000) which most dragons drop, different dragons drop the different pieces of Gemstone Armour (T80 hybrid, unaugmentable) required for the Karamja slayer log:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragonstone Dragon: Gemstone Gloves and Boots

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Onyx Dragon: Gemstone Helmet and Greaves

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hydrix Dragon: Gemstone Hauberk

​

⬥ All Gemstone dragons have a static droprate for Armour pieces at a rate of 1/2500 off-task and 1/1000 on-task.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Dragonstone and Onyx Dragons this is then 50% chance to be either of the pieces they can drop.

​

Location and How to Get There

⬥ Gemstone dragons are located below the Shilo Village Mines. A ladder leads to the cavern beside Kelhar, which requires Karamja Gloves 3 or above to access.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The teleport option on Karamja Gloves 3 or higher is the fastest way to access the cavern.

​

⬥ They are also found in the Wilderness Dungeon just south of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1 mandrith]. The quickest way to get there is by teleporting to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1 mandrith] using the Slayer Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape], walk south and down the ladder.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Glacors are profitable monsters that can be fought on or off task effectively, usually for their Slayer collection log items, or due to consistent profit from making [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1 armadylbattlestaff] and opening [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271452479488.png?v=1 eldertrovewent3] if fought at the Elder God Wars Dungeon.

The ability to be assigned Glacors can be unlocked at any Slayer master after completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat, which also unlocks access to the Glacor Cave.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

⬥ XP per kill: 4,810

⬥ Optimal kills/hr: ~100

⬥ Optimal XP/hr: ~481,000

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Steadfast Boots

⬥ Ragefire Boots

⬥ Glaiven Boots

​

Location and where to stand

Glacors can be found at the Elder God Wars Dungeon, Glacor Cave, and Frozen Plateau (Wilderness), but are best killed at the Elder God Wars Dungeon due to dropping [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271452479488.png?v=1 eldertrovewent3] and being generally easier to AFK.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Glacor Front of the EGWD can be accessed quickly using a boss portal leading to Arch-Glacor.

There are two viable spots to kill Glacors, which each having pros and cons:

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/55ufEq0vvx.png Guide illustration] ⬥ This spot allows for the consistent killing of 2 Glacor spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The long spawn time of Glacors can cause a lot of downtime which may cause issues with maintaining [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/KrGtsWEcVF.png Guide illustration] ⬥ This spot allows for the consistent killing of 3 Glacor spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This location is more gear/luck dependant as maintaining max KPH requires fast killing of the Glacors and good Enduring Glacyte luck.

⬥ Glacytes further North will be killed by some AoE abilities, which may cause them to drop hard to reach [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271452479488.png?v=1 eldertrovewent3] as well as being less efficient XP per Glacor kill while on task.

​

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] AFK Magic

Magic is the only viable style to AFK Glacors due to Dragon Breath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] and Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] being able to hit the spawned Glacytes while targetting the Glacor.

​

Note: When starting your hour or killing too slow, you may take the aggro of 2 Glacors at once, be sure to click on the one your character can actually attack, as one will be unable to be damaged

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] is active.

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7230797f-23bc-4ea6-b91f-0298a5fb7feb AFK Magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F7230797f-23bc-4ea6-b91f-0298a5fb7feb.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/lKvUUdplfY.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] is required for the 3 Glacor spot.

​

Example Kills

AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] 2 Glacors spot - [https://youtu.be/eJC2tiX20N4 Youtube Link]

AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] 3 Glacors spot - [https://youtu.be/HELoda2mCE8 Youtube Link]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Kal'gerion Demons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1155600607504257024.png?v=1 kalgerion_demon] can be killed at two locations outside Daemonheim:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Demonic Ruins in the Wilderness at level 47.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Kal'gerion Demons resource dungeon in Daemonheim.

​

Kal'gerion Demons are primarily killed for the Kal'gerion battle commendation drops which are a requirement for the Trimmed Completionist Cape. They also drop Demon Slayer equipment (T60 Ranged power armour) and an Adrenaline Urn which are requirements for the Daemonheim slayer log and Ultimate Slayer title.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1 dungeoneering] level: 90

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] level: 99+

⬥ Kills per hour:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Low Effort: ~340 at 120 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] using T90 weapons and an upgraded cannon

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AFK: ~325 kills at 120 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] using T95 weapons

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1858.8

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~604k (AFK) & 632k (Low Effort)

​

⬥ Due to the way Necromancy has been designed, kills per hour will increase as your Necromancy level (and hence accuracy and damage) increases.

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Kal'gerion battle commendation

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Trimmed Completionist Cape

⬥ Demon slayer equipment [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325697503907910.png?v=1 demonslayercirclet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325695520002068.png?v=1 demonslayerbody] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325693519302706.png?v=1 demonslayerlegs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325689836716103.png?v=1 demonslayergloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325691510231041.png?v=1 demonslayerboots]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Daemonheim Slayer collection log

⬥ Adrenaline Urn [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717413507074.png?v=1 adrenurn]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Daemonheim Slayer collection log

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lantadyme_incense_sticks Lantadyme Incense Sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 lantasticks]     • Increases potion timers by 30 seconds, up to a maximum 2 minute increase. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator Attuned Ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]     • Brought to restore 150 prayer points every kill in combination with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace]     • Brought to restore 150 prayer points every kill in combination with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]
Other
⬥ [Demon slayer perk](https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk]

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Player-owned Slayer Dungeon (3 spawns)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right click teleport on the Slayer Codex

⬥ Kal'gerion Demons resource dungeon (13 spawns)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Option 0→9 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1 dgcape] will take you directly outside the resource dungeon entrance.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teleport to Daemonheim using a Ring of Kinship and run South-West to the entrance.

​

Methods: Necromancy

AFK

The AFK method uses [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1 holyaggroverload] but this method could also use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] in combination with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion]. Some notes for this method are:

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]

⬥ Have your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] turned on

⬥ Use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil]

Low Effort

The resource dungeon is not AFK for this method as there are more spawns. It is safer than the Wilderness as there are less surrounding mobs such as Abyssal Lords and Abyssal Beasts which can overwhelm the player.

​

⬥ The "Drag" mechanic will bind the player without leaving a status icon indicating such and cannot be blocked. On rare occasions this will take you out of range of your target and cause you to stop attacking - simply re-click your target.

⬥ Rarely, this same mechanic will take you out of auto-refill range of you cannon. Simply click a Kal'gerion Demon on the opposite side of your cannon.

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1 reaverscroll] set to autofire every 10s

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]

⬥ Alternatively, sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562486588821555.png?v=1 aggressionscrim] are active at all times.

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=TBtqoqHcvRYHFG3y4iYT Necromancy - Low Effort] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FTBtqoqHcvRYHFG3y4iYT.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bars

AFK: The bar below is for off-task. Swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1 conjureskeleton] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] when on--task. Undead Army uses Skeleton, Ghost and Zombie

[https://img.pvme.io/images/njc2yrKgX6.png Guide illustration] Low Effort: Undead Army uses Skeleton, Ghost and Zombie

[https://img.pvme.io/images/ChPNNEesTd.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/EE6LoGvNReE Necro AFK] - Sunken Pyramid (POSD)

⬥ [https://youtu.be/2ht2HVEd3og Necro Low Effort] - Resource Dungeon

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

​

Introduction

After the Wilderness Update, killing Lava Strykewyrms has become substantially safer. Despite that, their drops are still highly valued mainly due to Searing Ashes being the main ingredient for Aggression Potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion]

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 1872

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~520 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], 450 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour : ~973K [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], 842K [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ Lava Strykewyrms have a valuable loot table containing: Searing Ashes, Onyx Bolts (e), Rune salvage, coins and potions.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes them one of the better tasks to do for gp.

⬥ Lava Strykewyrms also drop the Wyrm Spike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150743982723143.png?v=1 wyrmspike], Wyrm Heart [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150746721603625.png?v=1 wyrmheart], and Wyrm Scalp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150749091381248.png?v=1 wyrmscalp] at a rate of 1/6168 on task (1/12,288 off task), which are required for the Wilderness Slayer collection log.

​

Location and how to get there

⬥ They are located South of the Lava Maze (level 34-41 wilderness).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via the obelisk teleport to the level 35 obelisk.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Wilderness_sword_4 Wilderness sword 4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1 wildernesssword]     • Automatically notes ashes when carried in the inventory. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Headhunter's_thrill Headhunter's thrill] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134960074608095252.png?v=1 headhuntersthrill]     • Since lava strykes cannot be poisoned, there is no glove slot that significantly increases kph. Thus, these can be used for longer tasks. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Quest_Cape Portable fairy ring/Quest cape] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape]     • Provides a fast teleport to the Glacor cavern for the Stone of Jas buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_obelisk Portable obelisk/Obelisk shard]     • Used to teleport to the level 35 Obelisk, the fastest way to get to lava strykewyrms. ​
Passive unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Premier_artefact Premier Artefact] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/918517285176623104.png?v=1 premierartefact]     • Can be used for longer tasks. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) Stone of Jas buff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]     • Provides a 4% damage increase against lava strykewyrms. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle box] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • Provides a 9% damage increase and 14% damage reduction in the wilderness at max rank. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Mobile Mobile] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1 mob] perk on armour     • Lava strykes are spaced out and spawn moderately slowly. You will need to use movement abilities frequently while waiting for spawns.

General strategy

Place your cannon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] between the 2 small lava pits as shown below. You will alternate between killing the strykes northwest and southeast of this spot, most of which can be hit by the cannon.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LTV5mCPKc0.png Guide illustration]

Method: Active Magic

This method is can be done with low effort, only requiring the player to click on each spawn and letting Revo++ kill them (~250 KPH), or with high effort, using both dual-wield and 2H weapons and full manual (~450 KPH).

​

⬥ If 4TAA, stamp on mounds with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff] equipped and input the auto when you see your character do the stomp animation.

​

Preset

[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=hkE9wpk2HmcXTeGsfxPD Active Magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FhkE9wpk2HmcXTeGsfxPD.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bar

Use this bar if doing the task low effort, shift [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] to last slot if not on task.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/T8NBimA.png Guide illustration]

Video example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Ammu3M_H1U0 Active Mage] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Method: Active Ranged

If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] is owned, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] is the best style for killing lava strykewyrms due to its high damage, range and mobility.

​

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] at all times.

​

⬥ Proc priority for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] if 3 stacks: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] > [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258425204770.png?v=1 snipe]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Don't let autos snipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] proc when using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stacked damage buffs of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1 reckless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] allow you to easily hit hitcap with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] even outside of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] are your main basics, use them to balance stacks and keep an eye on your threshold cooldowns.

​

⬥ Common ability sequences for kills include (adjust order based on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1 perfectequilibrium] stack count):

  1. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds] if needed

  2. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1 piercing] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico]

  3. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1 mds]

  4. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] (helpful for building adren)

​

Preset

[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=f9O1xbSTbl11Gzy2VTlR Active Ranged]
