[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Wyverns are one of the 4 raptor mobs, and are known for their unique environmental effects and highly damaging attacks. They offer decent [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP, and are a consistent source of GP due to their wyvern bone drops.

​

⬥ The Dragon slayer perk and sigil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer], along with any other dragon-slaying related items such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow], do NOT work on wyverns.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 1878.8

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~700 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (ALL AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour : ~1.3M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (ALL AFK)

​

Use this tile for all styles.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/MJ1aIsrsJN.png Guide illustration]

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ Wyverns have a rich drop table with a guaranteed drop of Wyvern bones, a valuable item and an ingredient for super prayer potions.

⬥ For the Slayer collection log, Wyverns are also killed for their unique drop, the Wyvern Crossbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522587729940.png?v=1 wyverncrossbow], a T85 crossbow dropped at a rate of 1/2000 on task (1/10,000 off-task).

​

Location and How to Get There

Living Wyverns are found in 2 locations:

  1. The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, accessed via a rope in the south of the Skeletal Wyvern room.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. The easiest way to get there would be via dungeoneering cape teleport [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1 dgcape] to the Frost dragon dungeon (0,8)

  1. Northwest of Ghorrock, accessed via the Ghorrock teleport (ancient spellbook)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. This is the best location as it benefits from the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Wyverns are also attackable from areas without the chill mechanic, making it viable to be stationary and AFK in this location.

​

Mechanics

Wyrm breath
⬥ Wyverns have a breath attack different from that of dragons, and requires wyrmfire protection.     • Use wyrmfire potions or elder overload salves to block all damage from this attack. ​
Cavern chill
⬥ Wyverns reside in a habitat which slowly increases the player's cold percentage.     • The higher the chill percentage, the lower the poison damage taken by the player. No poison damage will be taken by players with ~70% chill.     • At ≥25% chill, wyvern attack damage increases to 2500 from around 1300.     • At ≥90% chill, players will be periodically stunned at 8-10s per stun, Never let your chill reach this stage.     • Fires throughout the wyvern habitats and be lit, standing within 2 tiles of them periodically lowers the player's chill percentage.     • This mechanic is avoided completely by standing outside of area affected by cavern chill in the wilderness. ​
Wyrm poison
⬥ Wyverns can inflict poison damage based on the percentage of Cavern chill every 4-5 ticks.     • Antipoison++ halves the damage, but every tick of poison decreases potion duration.     • This mechanic is avoided completely by standing outside of area affected by cavern chill in the wilderness. ​
Varied attacking
⬥ Wyverns can attack with all 3 styles, alongside their breath attack.     • They will attack with primarily [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] if the player stands in melee range.     • Hence, either stand in melee distance and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] or camp [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and out heal their damage through high DPS.

Useful Items

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Elder_overload_salve#(6) Elder overload salve] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve]     • By far the best potion to use here due to its wyrmfire protection. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Bonecrusher#Bonecrusher_upgrade Upgraded bonecrusher] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher]     • Useful for gathering wyvern bones, in combination with Death Note [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150755093426216.png?v=1 deathnote] ⬥[https://runescape.wiki/w/Underworld_Grimoire_2 Underworld Grimoire 2/3/4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1 underworldgrimoire4]     • Very useful for sending wyvern bones to storage as soon as they're dropped.
Passive unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) Stone of Jas buff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]     • Provides a 5% damage increase against living wyverns in the wilderness. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle box] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • Provides a 9% damage increase and 14% damage reduction in the wilderness at max rank.

Method: AFK Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] at all times.

⬥ Use Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem] and Boon of Het HP boosts.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1 underworldgrimoire4] and Legendary pet.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to help aggro the Living Wyverns.

​

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=49b35267-1149-4cbc-aab8-ff36440b64ad AFK Ranged] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F49b35267-1149-4cbc-aab8-ff36440b64ad.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Revo bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zFncRYemVQ.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NPtJ6nLKJIM AFK Ranged]

​

Method: Active/AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] at all times.

⬥ Use Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem] and Boon of Het HP boosts.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1 underworldgrimoire4] and Legendary pet.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to help aggro the Living Wyverns.

​

Preset

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=f22c8357-3337-4550-a00d-7af8d9ceeee3 Active/AFK Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Ff22c8357-3337-4550-a00d-7af8d9ceeee3.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Active Strategy

⬥ If doing them actively with best-in-slot gear, stand close to the most north-western fire in the wilderness spot (refer to example vod), and use target cycle to target wyverns within range. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1 dommine] whenever [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] is used along with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal] if available.

​

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] combos opportunistically on any wyverns that wander close to each other.

​

⬥ When eating solid food, such as sharks dropped by wyverns, try to eat them in the tick between the end of a kill and the start of the next kill when you have no target, as this does not reduce adrenaline.

​

⬥ If doing wyverns with lesser gear, an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] may be used to aggro a limited amount (2-3) of wyverns which makes it more manageable to [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit], as shown [https://youtu.be/2jCihwc-Bd0 here]

​

Revo bar

This bar should be used only for AFKing.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/486Vn8Cvym.png Guide illustration] ​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

For a creatures of the lost grove task you can choose between three different monsters: Moss Golems, Vinecrawlers and Bulbous crawlers. Moss Golems are the fastest, best xp/hr and best gp/hr, therefore the other ones are only worth doing if you are looking to get a soul.

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ Cinderbane Gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 Cinderbanes] - Drop Rate of 1/1500 on task and 1/5000 off task

⬥ Ancient Elven Ritual Shard [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] - Drop Rate of 1/1500 on task and 1/5000 off task

⬥ Torn Grimoire Pages [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643168594493964298.png?v=1 grimpage] - Drop Rate of 1/512 on task and 1/1536 off task.

​

Location and How to Get There

Creatures of the Lost Grove can be accessed through the monolith west of the incandescent wisp colony, west of Yanille.

​

⬥ The easiest way to get there would be through the fairy ring (code B J S) after repairing it with 5 Bittercap mushrooms.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An alternative method is to run west from the Incandescent wisp colony, accessible via the portal in the Max guild garden, the elder divination outfit, or via the fairy ring south of Castle Wars (code B K P).

​

⬥ Alternatively, players can also utilise the Solak [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371310891029.png?v=1 solak] boss portal through Max Guild, War's Retreat or the teleport through the grouping system. The exact location for each monster can be found on the map in game.

​

Moss Golems

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zqSNLFE.png Guide illustration]

Moss Golems have hard hitting melee auto-attacks, and can hit from halberd range. When they lose HP, their heads pop off and spawn a Mossy Rock that also deals damage. To prevent taking too much damage, the Enhanced Devoted [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] or cryptbloom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1 cryptbloomhelm] are extremely important for survivability, as you will be praying [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] regardless of which method you are using.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 104

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 2408.8

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 1570 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], 965 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy], 990 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour : 3.78m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], 2.32m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy], 2.38m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Positioning

[https://img.pvme.io/images/X5nGfR5x95.png Guide illustration] ⬥Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] / Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (Red square)

⬥Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Purple square)

⬥Dwarven Siege Engine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] (Yellow square)

​

Method - AFK Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] at all times.

⬥ Use Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem], Ogre flask (thermal) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask], and Boon of Het HP boosts.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] required.

⬥ Tier 2 Corbicula Rex Perk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117273821280.png?v=1 corbicula]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to help aggro the Moss Golems.

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9415c01f-cf22-46f1-89e2-75ad68110bb7 Moss Golems - AFK Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9415c01f-cf22-46f1-89e2-75ad68110bb7.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bars

⬥ High Level - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1 tumekenslight] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159341322240.png?v=1 noxscythe] (Nox Scythe requires Superior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence])

[https://img.pvme.io/images/XFZ2cvb7eM.png Guide illustration]

⬥ Low Level - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159341322240.png?v=1 noxscythe] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643161541931171872.png?v=1 dragonriderlance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UwN3LlwSh0.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wKPrLiS8ocE High Level AFK Melee]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=itPCUpvEPY4 Low Level AFK Melee]

​

Method - AFK Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 DeflectMelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341748180025365.png?v=1 fortitude]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 kwuarmsticks] at all times.

⬥ Use Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem], Ogre flask (thermal) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask], and Boon of Het HP boosts.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] required.

⬥ T100 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern] required off-task.

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] to help aggro the Moss Golems.

​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6f69cdbc-db00-46e1-baaf-8ebe80e07438 Moss Golems - AFK Necro] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F6f69cdbc-db00-46e1-baaf-8ebe80e07438.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/IOTz1qwx36.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IPtsyG_P30c AFK Necro]

Method - AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Useful Items and unlocks

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Kethsi_ring Kethsi Ring] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093437881192498.png?v=1 kethsiring]     • Provides a 4% damage boost towards metal dragons, making it the BIS ring to use if owned.
Passives / Unlocks
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_(perk) Dragon slayer (perk)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk]     • Increases damage and KPH. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_(ability) Dragon slayer (sigil)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer]     • Increases damage and KPH if slaying actively. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Note Death Note (relic)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150755093426216.png?v=1 deathnote]     • Useful for AFK looting valuable metal dragon bone.

Desirable Drops

⬥ Dragon Full Helm

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1080862292016644176.png?v=1 mithrildragon] Mithril dragons - 1/8,192 (includes Chewed Bones chance)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1080862288006873138.png?v=1 adamantdragon] Adamant dragons - 1/16,384

​

⬥ Forcae's Journal pages

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1080862288006873138.png?v=1 adamantdragon] Adamant and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107341374963852.png?v=1 runedragon] Rune dragons - 1/20

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 20 are required for MQC [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape]

​

⬥ Kethsi Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093437881192498.png?v=1 kethsiring]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107341374963852.png?v=1 runedragon] Rune dragons - 1/1024 or 1/512 from elites

​

⬥ Kethsi outfit scroll

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107341374963852.png?v=1 runedragon] Rune dragons - 1/200 from elites only or guaranteed from 'Barry the Destroyer'

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only 1 is required for the Slayer log

​

⬥ Boot upgrades for Steadfast, Glaiven and Ragefire Boots

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107341374963852.png?v=1 runedragon] Rune dragons - 1/768 on-task only

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can also be found in Elite Dungeons with Lucky Charms [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588561707009.png?v=1 ed1luckycharm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588694876222.png?v=1 ed2luckycharm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588938276874.png?v=1 ed3luckycharm]

​

Mithril Dragons

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5clGyMHybb.png Guide illustration] Mithril Dragons are often killed for their drops of Ancient Pages and Chewed bones/Dragon Full helm. You can obtain both all of these items in your PSD, making it a desirable AFK method and location for players hunting the Dragon Full Helm or the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Barbarian_Scavenger Barbarian Scavenger] achievement.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 564.4

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~700-730 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~412k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Location and Where to Stand

Due to bad respawn timers in habitat locations, it is highly recommended to kill Mithril Dragons in a large room in your PSD.

There is no precise positioning required as you may need to move for chewed bones to be in area loot range. Due to this, setting up an alt1 loot beam notifier is recommended if hunting for the Dragon Full Helm.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/kbHDJj9td7.png Guide illustration] ​

Method - AFK Necromancy

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] are active

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a5MVeBuXRpQmSnwDYSS0 AFK Necromancy]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fa5MVeBuXRpQmSnwDYSS0.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/BKS5KD9HLn.png Guide illustration] ​

Video Example

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YhpV_1vEeeg Necro AFK]

​

Adamant Dragons

[https://img.pvme.io/images/QndSJaR.png Guide illustration] ​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 655.6

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~420 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~275k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Location and Where to Stand

Place the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] on the yellow tile and stand under it as in the below image. If you're taking too much damage using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon], you can use an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] instead on the purple tile marked on the same map for a slower but safer experience.

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1 dgcape] 0,6 teleport or metal dragon trinkets are a fast way to get to the location.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/NEsoqPNzDz.png Guide illustration] ​

Method - AFK Magic

​

⚠️ Disclaimer

This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 Affliction]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] are active, with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] being on autocast

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively you can use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] but this will reduce profits

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9YAjVWTEtCakVmPgqplj AFK Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9YAjVWTEtCakVmPgqplj.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bar (Outdated)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/z0KB6YR.png Guide illustration]

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/P2UvKbKyVIg Magic AFK]

​

Rune Dragon

[https://img.pvme.io/images/TI73Be4.png Guide illustration] ​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 76

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 2051

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~270 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~550k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

Location and Where to Stand

⬥ Travel to Kethsi via the World Gate

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teleport to the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552307595948052.png?v=1 eaglespeaklode] Eagle's Peak Lodestone and run south, or

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teleport directly to the World Gate with the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit]

⬥ Place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] on the yellow tile and stand on the red tile marked in the below image.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/wZpSBqnHsh.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: Ranged (AFK)

​

You should kill all rune dragons around the statues when you initially arrive the spot to reset their spawn points. For the most part, 2-3 dragons should be the be targeting you at any time.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 desolation] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can alternatively use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab] to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness] instead if sustain is a concern

⬥ The pillar often blocks area loot, so you may wish to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/866551637970255872.png?v=1 telekeneticgrab] to loot without moving

⬥ Can replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] with a Legendary Pet to pick up some drops

⬥ Set an Alt1 alert for Elite spawns if fully AFK as Elites often require manual intervention to prevent KO

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2f53ca65-bac5-40ba-b75b-eb6214e4d854 AFK Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F2f53ca65-bac5-40ba-b75b-eb6214e4d854.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Action Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/vVKZJSO6Nc.png Guide illustration] ​

Video Examples

⬥ [https://youtu.be/AhmstH9B2w0 Legendary Pet]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/1JLp0pjNq9w Ripper Demon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Nightmare Nightmare creatures] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107308516782111.png?v=1 nightmare] can be assigned as a Slayer assignment after purchasing the toggle for 50 Slayer points, this requires completion of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Children_of_Mah Children of Mah] quest. They are mainly killed for Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] tasks, the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Other_Worlds Other Worlds collection log], combat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1 invention] item experience, and profit.

​

⬥ Nightmare creatures can be assigned as a Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] assignment by Laniakea, Morvran, and Kuradal.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 80

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1540

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~870 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~803 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~800 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (All AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~1.34m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~1.24m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~1.23m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (All AFK)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Nightmare_gauntlets Nightmare gauntlets] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 nightmaregauntlets]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1/2,000 on-task and 1/10,000 off-task.

​

Note: if you change the monetary value for custom loot to 5k this will allow you to loot everything relevant (No sharks or Muspah spines). This is achieved by going to Settings > Gameplay > Item Drops > Loot System > Monetary Value 5,000.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sixth-Age_circuit Sixth-Age circuit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit]     • Allows for an easy teleport to the World Gate. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace]     • Helps sustain your prayer. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Grace_of_the_elves Grace of the Elves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900765150678749204.png?v=1 gote]     • Can be used as a swap when looting to automatically bank Muspah spines. ⬥ Weapon perked with Eruptive 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1 eruptive4] Ruthless 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3]     • Mainly useful if camping Nightmares.
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dwarven_siege_engine Dwarven siege engine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • Make sure to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards Restocking Cannon] ability unlocked.

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Nightmare Creatures are located at the Ritual site on Freneskae, accessible through the [https://runescape.wiki/w/World_Gate World Gate] after completion of the Children of Mah quest.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring a Sixth-Age circuit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit] for a quick teleport.

​

Method: AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

Killing Nightmare creatures with Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] will yield the highest kph but require expensive abilities and gear for optimal results. If wanting to camp Nightmares, this is the preferred setup.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/PuyjMXH9uG.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Positioning can greatly impact kph.

​

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and starting the session, check the following:

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Ensure that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut] is active.

Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] has good sustain with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1 conjurearmy] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1 conjureghost] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon], as well as strong aoe damage potential with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1 conjurezombie] (poison), [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe]. 4-piece T90 Deathdealer Robes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783479810117702.png?v=1 dealerhood80] for chance to proc [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

​

Introduction

The quest Fate of the Gods is a requirement to fight Nihils or get them as a slayer task. Despite being a Nihil, Nex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213159071547395.png?v=1 Nex] is not affected by being on a task.

​

⬥ As Nihils are not technically demons, the various demon slayer buffs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer] do not work on them.

​

⬥ They are permanently aggressive unless the player is wielding a Shard of Zaros and run at the same speed as the player.

​

⬥ Each nihil variant has their own unique special they will use after a few autos.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Smoke nihil: Reduces combat stats.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This effect is easily nullified by overloads.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shadow nihil: Deals 500 typeless damage 3 times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood nihil: Stops attacking, becomes invulnerable to styled damage and absorbs incoming damage.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Blood Nihils will not heal from damage in a player-owned dungeon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Poison [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 poisonicon] will still damage them normally.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ice nihil: Drains 50 prayer points per attack. Also stuns and binds the player [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 stunicon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1 bindicon]

​

Stats

⬥ These rates are calculated with blood Nihils.

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] XP per kill : 2,532.6 + 835.7 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 constitution]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill : 705.4

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~790 (AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour : ~557K (AFK)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Summoning ingredient drops (Aviansie talons, Demon horn, Vampyre fangs, Icyene feather)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped from the Smoke, Shadow, Blood and Ice Nihils respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used to craft Nihil familiar pouches [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1 smokenihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1 shadownihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1 bloodnihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil]

​

⬥ They also have a very small chance to drop the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791280228377952276.png?v=1 zarytebow], though one has a much better chance of obtaining this drop by killing Nex.

​

Useful Items

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Zaros Shard of Zaros]     • Removes nihil aggression.     • This is absolutely essential if gathering souls or killing them individually. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sixth-Age_circuit Sixth-Age Circuit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit]     • Allows for an easy teleport to the World Gate. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Grace_of_the_elves Grace of the Elves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900765150678749204.png?v=1 gote]     • Highly useful as a swap to automatically bank nihil materials. ​

Location and How to Get There

Teleport to the World Gate with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit], set it to Freneskae and select the option "The Pit" to teleport to where Nihils are. Walking on the center tile will provide the option to spawn Nihils for slayer.

​

⬥ Alternatively, teleport to Eagles' Peak lodestone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552307595948052.png?v=1 eaglespeaklode] and run south to the World Gate.

​

Method: Low effort Magic

Magic can utilise the terrain and Nihils' natural aggression to group them up, followed by barraging them down with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage]. The use of tank armour and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] also helps it withstand the attacks of multiple Nihils.

​

Preset

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0BUcOGXcnqpjDNocpL0Z Low effort Magic]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0BUcOGXcnqpjDNocpL0Z.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Strategy

⬥ Spawn the Nihils and run around the pillars to group them up. Make sure to have less than 9 on you else [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] will not hit all of them.

​

⬥ If done properly, this achieves ~500kph, getting around 70-100 Nihil pouch ingredients + ~5m in other commons (mostly from onyx bolts and herbs). Being on task helps but the short length of Nihil slayer tasks makes this method mostly impractical for XP.

​

Method: AFK Magic [PoSD]

As players can place specific nihil variants in a dungeon, the best method of killing Nihils is AoEing blood Nihils in the player owned dungeon. This can be done with both revo++ or legacy.

​

⬥ Revo++ vs Legacy:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Legacy benefits: Tank armour not required.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Revo++ benefits: Significantly lower rune cost and higher kph (~120 more with a BIS setup).

​

⬥ If using legacy with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff], use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714098246.png?v=1 bloodburst], otherwise, use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage]. Cast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate] if using revo++

​

Presets

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=caAj2jaWsxNWFUEWn8md Active Magic (Soul Gathering)]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=q7fGOb0BeX1VgOsu5JPB AFK Magic (PoSD)]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fq7fGOb0BeX1VgOsu5JPB.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Strategy - Gathering souls

⬥ As blood Nihils cannot be isolated from the other nihil variants, they must be fought in an active manner. Magic is suggested for this although it may also be viable to use ranged with sufficient accuracy boosts.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do NOT have multi-hitting abilities on your bar to avoid aggroing other Nihils. This includes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1 deto]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast] can be used as it does not aggro other Nihils.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee is not as viable as you will spend a lot of time chasing Nihils around due to their high mobility.

​

⬥ Stand in the western area of The Pit where the blood Nihils spawn.

​

⬥ Do not spend excessive amounts of time chasing the nihil. Target close-by Nihils as fast as possible after they spawn to prevent them from running away.

​

Strategy - PoSD slaying

⬥ Place the Nihils in the small room. Stand in the middle of the room if using revo++.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand in the northeast corner (yellow box) if using legacy.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/dONoLgJiU7.png Guide illustration]

Revo bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/HwPgJ9wsim.png Guide illustration]

Video Example

⬥ [https://youtu.be/t8Mi0XjLwoo Gathering souls]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kVTAmGkarzw AFK]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

There are 4 Nodon dragonkin variants that can be killed for slayer: Nodon engineers, artificers, hunters, and guards. The Nodon dragonkin task can be assigned by Morvran or Laniakea and requires level 92 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]. Additionally, players can kill Kerapac [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac] in Normal Mode or Hard Mode, since the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] buffs (but not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas]) apply to the boss.

​

⬥ Currently there are only methods detailed for Nodon guards and artificers. If you have a different method for Nodon hunters or engineers, please make a post in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)].

​

​

Note: Dragon cluster tasks from Laniakea apply [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas] buffs to Slayer monsters at Nodon front but not [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac]. This also applies for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1 dragonslayer], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk] and Dragonbane weaponry.

Desirable Drops

⬥ Nodon dragonkin cannon upgrade kits [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271674785842.png?v=1 coilupgradekit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271733481493.png?v=1 kineticcycloneupgradekit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271788023838.png?v=1 cannonupgradekit] - Drop rates of 1/2000 each from guards, artificers and hunters.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rate are 3/2560 each from Nodon engineers and 5/64 each from Elite versions (Nodon enforcers).

​

Location and How to Get There

⬥ Option 1: Teleport to the Senntisten cathedral using the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1 pontifexshadowring] and run to your destination (Fastest for Nodon Guards).

⬥ Option 2: Enter a War's Retreat/Max Guild [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1 kerapac] portal and run to the location from there (Fastest for Nodon Artificers).

[https://img.pvme.io/images/V3U9dAn.png Guide illustration]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/gUzgqdg.png Guide illustration]

Nodon Guards

Stats

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Slayer is a combat-based skill, where XP is awarded for killing the monsters assigned to you by a Slayer Master, with harder monsters generally giving more XP. Slayer is a great way for the player to earn GP and combat XP while progressing their account, and can be trained using both low-effort and high-effort methods.

​

The Basics of Slaying

Overview

⬥ Early Slayer Assignments offer low XP rates, which can be avoided with other methods, such as squashing Scarabs in Menaphos [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552289589796904.png?v=1 menaphoslode] and completing Reaper tasks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641341976960172043.png?v=1 death]

⬥ Generally, using the highest levelled Slayer Master is recommended, with the exception of Mandrith [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1 mandrith] who only offers Wilderness tasks.

⬥ Cluster assignments are highly valued as they allow you to fight monsters above your level for high XP rates, e.g. fighting Greater Demon Berserkers for a "Demons" task.

⬥ AFKing assignments sacrifices XP rates for convenience, actively Slaying will always grant the player higher XP rates.

⬥ Most Slayer Masters have a chance of offering the player a unique assignment which they may accept or decline, these often give good reward for the effort needed to complete them.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Notable special assignments are Laniakea's, which is well worth the effort, Morvran's, which should be completed only once for the Completionist Cape, and the Raptor's, which is also involved in a Completionist Cape requirement.

​

Utilizing Slayer Points

Slayer Points are obtained by successfully completing Slayer Assignments with the amount given depending on the Slayer Master used. If you ever find yourself wanting to quickly obtain Slayer Points, you can find our guide on farming them in [[PvME/Slayer/Slayer Point Farming|Slayer Point Farming]].

​

⬥ As for how to spend Slayer Points, our order of priority is:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Building a block/prefer list and upgrading your Slayer Helmet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocking any desired Slayer Assignments, such as Nightmare Creatures.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quality of life unlocks such as quicker killing blows and attaching items to your Toolbelt.

​

Managing Your Block/Prefer List

The Block & Prefer list is a very powerful tool which can be used to focus your Slaying on monsters that grant great reward, while ignoring those which the player deems a waste of time or not fun to slay. You can find our guide on finding the best block/prefer list for you in [[PvME/Slayer/Block Prefer List|Block Prefer List]].

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=G8a7S4ZjIWspR9f9ozZY Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=uv6fuVGjCwKfxrYxrvlY Melee preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=b0acc1f2-7fe0-42e7-9844-a7851b28eb24 Ranged preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3e5e5dc0-a3ab-473a-9d78-b59d73c92177 Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F3e5e5dc0-a3ab-473a-9d78-b59d73c92177.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ These presets and relics are examples of what the player may bring on their assignment.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Specific relic setups and aura usage are included in our monster guides, you can view our general recommendations with the !relics ‎and !aura ‎commands.

​

Ability Usage

We have several guides on specific Slayer Assignments with their own methods and action bar layouts, you can find them in [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Slayer Slayer guides].

​

⬥ Generally, AoE abilities will be prioritized when training Slayer, below are examples of AoE abilities for each combat style.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]: Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1 chain] or Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain], Corruption Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast], Dragon Breath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath], Tsunami [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami], and Magma Tempest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]: Cleave [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave], Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd], Quake [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake], Hurricane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane], and Meteor Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]: Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259566186521.png?v=1 ricochet] or Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico], Corruption Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot], and Bombardment [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1 bombard]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Mechanised Chinchompa [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin] can be used to make many single target abilities hit in a 3x3 AoE.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]: Soul Strike [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1 soulstrike], Blood Siphon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1 bloodsiphon], Spectral Scythe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1 spectralscythe], Death Skulls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1 deathskulls] and Threads of Fate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] + any single target ability.

⬥ Tuska's Wrath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] deals extra damage against your current Slayer Assignment at an increased cooldown.

​

Useful Items

⬥ Slayer Helmet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm]     • BiS helm against current assignment.     • At 90 Slayer, prioritize building the Slayer Helmet stand on Anachronia so you don't have to wear it. ⬥ Slayer VIP Tickets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344597934120.png?v=1 slayervip]     • Lets you choose between 2 assignments. ⬥ Wilder Pie     • Boosts your Slayer level by 6 for 6 minutes. ⬥ Cannons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1114767361975779379.png?v=1 dwarfmulticannon] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1 kineticcyclone]     • Deals AoE damage and draws aggro, Artisans' Workshop upgrade allows for automatic reloading. ⬥ Demon Horn Necklace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace]     • Restores prayer if paired with Bonecrusher [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1 bonecrusher] (for bones) or Attuned Ectoplasmator [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator] (for ashes). ⬥ Scrimshaw of Sacrifice [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1 sacrificescrim]      • Destroys loot for increased XP. Uniques destroyed count towards logs. ⬥ Ushabti [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1 ushabti]     • Captures monster souls used in the Sunken Pyramid and the Slayer Codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex] ⬥ Slayer's Introspection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345365471232.png?v=1 slayerintrospection]     • Lets you choose minimum or maximum possible size task. ⬥ Drop Cleaners     • Several items can help collect or consume drops automatically, such as Spring Cleaner [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170723130937427.png?v=1 springcleaner], Magic Notepaper [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1 notepaper], and Artificer's Measure.     • Your toolbelt can hold several other drop cleaning items. ⬥ Teleports     • There are many useful teleports, such as the Slayer Cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape] and the Slayer Codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

​

Perks

⬥ Genocidal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1 genocidal]     • Grants a damage boost against the current Slayer target, increasing as the task progresses. ⬥ X-Slayer Perks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1 dragonslayerperk] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]     • Grants a damage bonus to the perk's respective monster type. ⬥ Scavenging [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1109429520995463288.png?v=1 scavenging]     • Grants Invention components when killing monsters. These stack up quickly. ⬥ Caroming [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1 caroming4]     • Allows Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1 chain], Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259566186521.png?v=1 ricochet], and their greater variants to hit more targets.

​

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

​

Introduction

Profane Scabarites [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1333926854666621019.png?v=1 profanescabarite] are slayer monsters requiring 87 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] to kill. They can be killed off-task, or with either a "Scabarites" or "Profane Scabarites" task for on-task bonuses.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level required: 87

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 900

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~850 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~765k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ The Spectral Lens [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334309383831818342.png?v=1 spectrallens] which is the Necromancy slayer helm component.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance Powder of penance] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]     • Helps sustain your prayer. ⬥ Elder overload [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] ⬥ Weapon poison+++ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cinderbane_gloves Cinderbane gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scripture_of_Amascut Scripture of Amascut] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1 scriptureofamascut]     • Can be substituted for any of the GWD3 books
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop Restocking Cannon Ability] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • Allows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] restocking without user input. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Animate_Dead Animate Dead] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead]     • Only needed if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1 cryptbloomhelm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947807754960896.png?v=1 ganohelm] instead of the recommended gear

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Profane Scabarites are only found in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scabarite_Cavern Scabarite Cavern] outside of Pollnivneach.

​

Getting to: Profane Scabarites

⬥ Once inside the cavern, cross the bridge to south-western area.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Follow the image below to place and load your cannon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand 2 tiles south-west of your cannon.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/VaR3USyqMW.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

⬥ Set an Alt1 alarm for 50% HP in case of bad RNG, and active [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1 excal] when it does.

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289461260329.png?v=1 shadowburst] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727956567261184.png?v=1 shadowbarrage]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Bh7moSg88JTHsUCEwD8g Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FBh7moSg88JTHsUCEwD8g.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zlZ1dM13fE.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NV5699E9Ycw AFK Magic Profane Scabarites] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ravenous_strigoi Ravenous Strigoi] are large beasts located in [https://runescape.wiki/w/Shuruk-Ba Shuruk-Ba]. They are slayer monsters that require the completetion of [https://runescape.wiki/w/Heralds_of_Crimson Heralds of Crimson] to kill.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 104

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 4,549

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~250 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] (All AFK) / ~470 Hybrid Active [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~1.14m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] (All AFK) / ~2100k Hybrid Active [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Nightblood_ring Nightblood ring]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forgotten_painting Forgotten painting piece (1-5)]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crimson_ichor Crimson ichor]

​

Disclaimer

⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if you cannot get it to work

​

Location and How to Get there

Either:

⬥ From the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Canoe_station_(Havenhythe) Canoe station] in Heathervein

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stonevein_amulet Stonevein Amulet] provides close teleports to Divine Fall and Unicorn Mural

[https://img.pvme.io/images/GTnj5YepV8.png Guide illustration] ​

Positioning - AFK

[https://img.pvme.io/images/OqcOFI9FrG.png Guide illustration] ​

Method - AFK Necro [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Preset Suggestions

[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/8d473469-a681-445f-8aeb-24ad7d1462d9/7x4/?v=483eeb55cc5085fe6cd116f3ca19ef02ad0bdd85e2bfa6527c6b5fecf380cede Necro] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/A5cOBLRdkw.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ujoJcDBr_bk AFK Necro]

​

Method - AFK Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

​

Preset Suggestions

[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/1b2c54b8-78aa-475d-9805-445197cf9d87/7x4/?v=6a833b7aa8272e4ee6f02ec6248143ba45daf59f36e68f902ed4f2be3f72fcda Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

​

Action Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/WozpwSKaOS.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mOrs-oTEwKY High Level AFK Ranged]

⬥ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ElI0enTx02g Low Level AFK Ranged]

​

Method 2: Hybrid Magic + Ranged

​

Positioning - Active

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5hxeyRBSRL.png Guide illustration] ​

Preset Suggestions

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0a772bb4-8ab7-48c4-83ee-dd0786342fa6 Magic / Ranged] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged]

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0a772bb4-8ab7-48c4-83ee-dd0786342fa6.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Rotation

Once the cannon is placed, stay near the large wall and use it to avoid attacks from the west Strigois while simultaneously walking them into AoE range of each other. The cannon should be able to tag all 4 Strigois in the area if placed correctly. From there, alternate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] ultimates while keeping an eye on your adrenaline buff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1279516151423963166.png?v=1 critbuff] duration to end on full adrenaline for the next style. Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] to capitalise on any Strigoi you manage to lure close to each other.

​

Ranged rotation: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1 imbueshadows] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1 galeshot] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1 deadshot] for AoE + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1 snapshot] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1 snipe] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] for single-target → end on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1 rapid] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] to top up adrenaline

​

Magic rotation: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1 runic_charge] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1 gsonic] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1 tsunami] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1 fsoa] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1 spec] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1 gchain] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1 omni] for AoE + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1 wm] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1 asphyx] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils] for single-target → end on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1 gconc] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1 dbreath] to top up adrenaline

​

Example Kills

[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 ranged] [https://youtu.be/xtz-gx4HyoE Method 2: Hybrid Magic + Ranged]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenants Revenants] are a popular type of Wilderness monster which may be found in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forinthry_Dungeon Forinthry Dungeon]. They're mainly killed for the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Boss_collection_log#Chaos_Elemental Chaos Elemental collection log], [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Wilderness Wilderness collection log], and the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_Spirit Revenant Spirit] which is used to unlock the Revenant pet as well as its skins; this drop gets increasingly rarer the more skins you have.

​

⬥ After the Wilderness update killing revenants became substantially safer, as players can now opt-out of PvP.

⬥ Using a [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forinthry_bracelet#Effects Forinthry bracelet] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152061350678549.png?v=1 forinthrybracelet] will make revenants NOT be aggressive.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This effect will persist for an hour and only count down while in the Forinthry Dungeon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Even if it was used years ago, the effect may still be active.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: Varies

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~730 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Active), ~400 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Low Effort)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: Varies

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Warriors%27_equipment Ancient Warriors' equipment]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Notable drops:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Statius's warhammer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1 swh]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zuriel's staff [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891361594966067.png?v=1 superiorzurielstaff]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zuriel's robe top [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556586037216804864.png?v=1 SuperiorZurielstop]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zuriel's robe bottom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556591275604836395.png?v=1 SuperiorZurielsrobebottom]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_Spirit Revenant Spirit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150742481158154.png?v=1 revenantspirit]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocks the next unowned Revenant pet, gets rarer the more skins you have unlocked.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_drop_enhancer Revenant drop enhancer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer]     • 10% increase to the revenant drop table, except [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150742481158154.png?v=1 revenantspirit] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet (e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]     • Damage increase helps one-shot potential, and accuracy increase is useful for high level revenants. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment Ghost hunter equipment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm]     • Wear 3 pieces for a 10% damage increase. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Dwarven_siege_engine Dwarven siege engine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • Extremely strong in combination with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 cinderbanes] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison], allowing it to kill revenants on its own.     • Make sure to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards Restocking Cannon] ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Elite_Wilderness_achievements#Rewards Elite Wilderness achievements] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1 wildernesssword]     • 5% increased chance to get Ancient Warriors' equipment, stacks with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) Stone of Jas buff] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1 jasboost]     • 3% damage increase for 4 hours after visiting the cave. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Undead_Slayer Undead Slayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1 undeadslayerperk]     • Wear a piece of augmented power armour with this perk.

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Revenants are located in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forinthry_Dungeon Forinthry Dungeon].

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1 wildernesssword] Forinthry Dungeon teleport.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively you may use the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552297231822878.png?v=1 wildernesslode] and run west to the level 17 Wilderness entrance.

​

Method: Active Magic

The active Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] method consists of killing revenants using [https://runescape.wiki/w/Legacy_Mode#Combat Legacy Combat Mode] one at a time following specific routes, this can be replicated using Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] with an augmented [https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_bane_2h_sword Revenant bane 2h sword] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/859483155210567741.png?v=1 bane2h]

​

⬥ The knight and dragon are the fastest spawning revenants; use routes that prioritise killing them as soon as they respawn, as they have the highest drop rates for uniques.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hAJb1MB50g.png Guide illustration] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] is positioned to kill the southern revenant goblins and imp, occasionally being able to kill the pyrefiend, and lowering the dark beast and demon such that they can be consistently one-shot.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mjtXJs8Zua.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Red and green: Main routes to take when killing revenants between knight and dragon spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When going from knight to dragon, kill 3-5 revenants. When going from dragon to knight, kill 2-3 revenants.

⬥ Blue and yellow: Potential detour routes for red and green routes respectively depending on revenant movement.

​

⬥ Ensure Legacy Combat Mode is active.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535616247807868938.png?v=1 bloodblitz]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The healing from the spell alone should negate the need for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead] Crumble Undead with Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit], Holy Scarab [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab] and any overload with prayer restore to restore prayer

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=bd9925ea-3f24-4e2f-bad8-0f77ab241a65 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fbd9925ea-3f24-4e2f-bad8-0f77ab241a65.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/xROxupx3T6I Active Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Method: Low Effort Magic

The low effort Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] method consists of killing revenants using [https://runescape.wiki/w/Legacy_Mode#Combat Legacy Combat Mode] to AFK until they are no longer aggressive. When this happens you will follow a specific route killing revenants along the way in order to reset their aggro.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LlbDHRTBgQ.png Guide illustration] ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] will solo kill the dragon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You AFK kill the dark beast, ork, demon, cyclops, pyrefiend, and 2 goblins.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5K8rvWazPb.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Blue → Green → Yellow → Blue (back to start)

⬥ Every ~10 minutes follow the route shown above: take the outer loop to the dragon → knight → dragon → start.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to reach the marked northwesternmost tile in order to properly reset aggro.

​

⬥ Ensure Legacy Combat Mode is active.

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

⬥ Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535616247807868938.png?v=1 bloodblitz]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The healing from the spell alone should negate the need for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead] Crumble Undead with Soul Split [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit], Holy Scarab [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1 holyscarab] and any overload with prayer restore to restore prayer

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=bd9925ea-3f24-4e2f-bad8-0f77ab241a65 Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fbd9925ea-3f24-4e2f-bad8-0f77ab241a65.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Zo0MXAvQjII Low Effort Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]
