[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon Ripper Demons] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1 ripperdemon] are one of the 4 Raptor specialty monsters, as such they boast mechanics that make engaging them more dangerous than normal mobs. They are mainly killed for Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] tasks, the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Kharidian_Desert Kharidian Desert collection log], the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Parasitic_orb parasitic orb] which is used to unlock the Nipper demon pet, and for profit via creating [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch]

​

⬥ Ripper Demons can be assigned as a Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] assignment by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, and The Raptor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Demon cluster tasks also work, they may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Laniakea assigns almost twice as many.

⬥ This guide will focus on killing Ripper Demons via AOE methods as they yield the highest KPH; however, at lower levels it is suggested to kill them one at time in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_cave Ripper Demon cave] southeast of the Al Kharid lodestone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552328005419038.png?v=1 alkharidlode]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring your best Melee gear with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170689119326350.png?v=1 darklight] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Midday [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skyboxes_and_filters skybox] helps brighten the area.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 96

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 2,721.6

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~930 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Low Effort), ~1700 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (Low Effort)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~2.53M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] (Low Effort), ~3.79M [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (Low Effort)

​

Mechanics

Slaughter
⬥ When engaged from a distance, Ripper Demons will immediately teleport to the player and cast Slaughter [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1 slaughter], which deals triple damage if you move.     • This makes them extremely easy to stack up for AoE damage.     • This also incentivises staying at the same spot when AoEing.
Death from above
⬥ Ripper Demons gain adrenaline whenever they autoattack.     • When the bar fills up, they will jump and land where the player was standing shortly after, dealing up to 32,000 hard typeless damage resulting in an instant kill.     • This can be avoided by moving away from your original location immediately upon seeing them jump.     • When AoEing, good DPM is crucial to avoid this mechanic.
Aggression
⬥ If the player is below 35% HP, all nearby Ripper Demons will immediately aggro to the player.     • Usually, using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] when low HP is desirable to prevent being stacked out.
Death spin
⬥ When killed, Ripper Demons will spin and hit any nearby players with weak rapid melee hits per tick in a 3x3 area, which can deal large damage if stood in.     • This mechanic is the main reason [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4] are essential for killing rippers.

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_claw Ripper claw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797895640054759444.png?v=1 ripperclaw] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Off-hand_ripper_claw Off-hand ripper claw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232154252890122.png?v=1 ripperclawoh]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5 times rarer off-task.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Parasitic_orb Parasitic orb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150740384006234.png?v=1 parasiticorb]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Significantly more common from Slasher Demons (elite variant).

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Raptor_key_part_2 Raptor key part 2]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Must be on task.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Don%27t_Fear_the_Ripper Miner's journal 1-5] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Diary_of_Jebediah_Omnis The Diary of Jebediah Omnis]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cursed_amascut_sand Cursed amascut sand] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152063208763433.png?v=1 cursedamascutsand]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped by any of the 4 Raptor specialty monsters.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Binding_contract Binding contracts] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073883118521557052.png?v=1 bindingcontract] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Magic_notepaper Magic notepaper] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1 notepaper]     • Increases profit via creating [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] ⬥ Armour perked with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(perk) Demon Slayer] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1 demonslayerperk]     • +7% damage against demons. ⬥ Armour perked with [https://runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_Devoted Enhanced Devoted] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4]     • Reduces incoming damage when active. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Oldak_coil Oldak coil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil]     • Make sure to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards Restocking Cannon] ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_Slayer_(ability) Demon Slayer (ability)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer]     • Increases damage against demons by 15% for 10 seconds.     • 1-minute cooldown. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box Infernal Puzzle Box (tier 6)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox]     • 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.         ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.     • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.

​

Location and How to Get there

The Wilderness

If killing Ripper Demons in the Wilderness; they are located west of the Demonic Ruins / northeast of Red Dragon Isle, they are aggressive in this location. Ensure you disable PVP by speaking to [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vala#Edgeville Vala] in Edgeville.

​

1) How to get there in order of speed:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a) [https://runescape.wiki/w/Annakarl_Teleport Annakarl Teleport (Ancient Magicks)] and run west, has a high chance of aggro'ing Kal'gerion demons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1155600607504257024.png?v=1 kalgerion_demon]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b) Games necklace teleport to Corporeal Beast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212996726685749.png?v=1 corporealbeast] and run northeast.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c) Wilderness sword teleport to herb patch and run north, then east along the lava.

​

Notes:

⬥ [https://img.pvme.io/images/fKZLfiGXqH.png Click here] to open a map of optimal routes for the above.

⬥ If hunting elite spawns in the Wilderness, stay a few kills after the end of your task in case the "forced spawn" is delayed.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/zVTy9k8mLg.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Unless otherwise specified, stand in-between the lava pools to funnel the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1 ripperdemon] onto one tile.

​

Ripper Demon Cave

If killing Ripper Demons in the Ripper Demon cave; teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552328005419038.png?v=1 alkharidlode] and run southeast towards the cave entrance. They are not aggressive in this location.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Hs3NllZKrA.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: Low Effort Magic

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] is very effective at damage reduction and as such is a strong choice for killing Ripper Demons. Stacking Animate Dead [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead], Cryptbloom armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1 cryptbloomhelm], Infernal Puzzle Box [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox], Deflect Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] with Amulet of souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos] and Enhanced Devoted 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4], should allow players to sustain themselves purely with Blood Barrage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] healing alone.

​

Walk up and attack demons between steps. This is the most dangerous part of the method as the first few demons are the slowest to kill since [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] is not active yet and you have no [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3] stacks. Keep track of the demons on you and look out for jumps (refer to example video below).

​

⬥ Ensure Legacy Combat Mode is active.

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] and upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen]

⬥ Drink [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] once you are comfortably set up with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] active.

​

Notes:

⬥ You must target the Slasher Demon (elite) when it spawns to kill it before the jump as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1 bloodbarrage] deals only 60% to non-main targets.

*⬥ In legacy, after almost every action the player should click on a ripper to prevent attacks from being delayed.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eating / drinking potions

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Looting

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Noting [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch]*

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=15e7b07c-4b4f-40ab-9fdc-04a9a1baab8f Magic preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F15e7b07c-4b4f-40ab-9fdc-04a9a1baab8f.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/KiP5Li1JfxM Low Effort Magic]

​

Method: Low Effort Necromancy

Stacking Animate dead [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead], Cryptbloom armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1 cryptbloomhelm], Deathwarden armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770718468223027.png?v=1 wardenhood90], Infernal Puzzle Box [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1 infernalpuzzlebox], Hellhound [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch], Deflect Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] with Amulet of souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos] / Powder of protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection], and Enhanced Devoted 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4], should allow players to only require inputs when Alt1 warnings go off.

​

While setting up use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1 devo] to help mitigate damage taken. This is the most dangerous part of the method as the first few demons are the slowest to kill. Keep track of the demons on you and look out for jumps (in case of a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] proc refer to the third example video below).

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] if not using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead]

⬥ Use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] to keep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] alive

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen]

⬥ When a Slasher Demon (elite) spawns, you must do the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right-click attack elite spawn.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1 invokedeath] (optionally use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1 demonslayer]) → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1 threadsoffate] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1 soulsap] → [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1 volleyofsouls]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Continue as normal.

​

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=29a3659c-fee8-45e0-a3f7-5aecdee2f2ae Necromancy preset] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F29a3659c-fee8-45e0-a3f7-5aecdee2f2ae.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/u2Xr8TKPVQ.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/wt9MOvmFBj8 Necro - Camping]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/sHFZpO6g-xw Necro/Cryptbloom - Camping]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/zxjP8zVb1kc Necro - Elite spawn farming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Featuring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1 rod] proc + reset.

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/5NovBO72bO.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

Risen Ghosts are generally only killed for the Ultimate Slayer title. Otherwise, the XP and GP/hr are mediocre at best.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 85

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1000

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 800 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] 720 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: 800k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] 720k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sonic_Wave_ability_codex Greater Sonic Wave ability codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411830207299654.png?v=1 gsoniccodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment Ghost Hunter equipment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm] 1/2000 for any piece

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

​

Location and Positioning

Risen Ghosts can be found in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crypt_(Wilderness) Crypt] North of Fort Forinthry after the question [https://runescape.wiki/w/Unwelcome_Guests Unwelcome Guests] is complete.

​

For both methods, place an [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] in the tile shown and stand underneath it.

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/MIlLxZRIhW.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: AFK Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sanguine_crawler Sanguine crawlers] are a low level Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] mob found on top of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Blighted_Cave Blighted Cave], located in Havenhythe. They are mainly killed for the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Havenhythe Havenhythe collection log].

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 28

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 54.2

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~1500 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~81.3k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vampyrism_gloves Vampyrism gloves] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1 vampyrismgloves]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Tainted_seed Tainted seed]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_fairy_ring Portable fairy ring] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799722780360704.png?v=1 portablefairyring]     • Teleport to BKS and run northeast. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Antisanguine Antisanguine]     • Mitigates the damage of the schluurp mechanic if needed. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Havensilver_weapons Havensilver weapons]     • Anything else deals reduced damage, may be used if downgrading gear. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Oldak_coil Oldak coil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil]     • Make sure to have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards Restocking Cannon] ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ Access to boss portals     • Teleporting to Silverquill, the Dreadhog is the quickest way to reach the Blighted Cave.

​

Location and How to Get there

Sanguine crawlers can be fought on top of the Blighted Cave, located in Havenhythe.

​

Blighted Cave

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hZs8OVaOEw.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Teleport to Silverquill, the Dreadhog via a boss portal, exit the cave and head north.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• May alternatively use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799722780360704.png?v=1 portablefairyring] and teleport to BKS ‎then run northeast.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] as shown above, your character will constantly be moving.

​

Method: AFK Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1 oldakcoil] and starting the session, check the following:

​

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence] you will need extra prayer sustain, use prayer potion drops as needed.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8cbe8dae-8899-4640-9f22-92e163937b07 Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8cbe8dae-8899-4640-9f22-92e163937b07.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

​

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/kAKzyjns13.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/76QWDLVSrUA Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/76QWDLVSrUA Embedded guide video]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sanguine_werewolf Sanguine werewolves] are a low level Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] mob found in [https://runescape.wiki/w/Berylbrook Berylbrook], located in Havenhythe. They are mainly killed for the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Havenhythe Havenhythe collection log].

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 1

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 99 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is required to access the Sunken Pyramid

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1,877.5

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~850 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~575 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (Sunken Pyramid)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~1.52m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~1.08m [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (Sunken Pyramid)

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Crimson_ichor Crimson ichor]

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Forgotten_painting Forgotten painting piece (1-5)]

​

Location and How to Get there

Sanguine werewolves can be fought in [https://runescape.wiki/w/Berylbrook Berylbrook] or the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid Sunken Pyramid].

​

Berylbrook

[https://img.pvme.io/images/mx0A7JlRmi.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If killing sanguine werewolves in [https://runescape.wiki/w/Berylbrook Berylbrook], use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] as shown above.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While standing on the path, line yourself up with the blue fish on the clothesline then place the cannon 2 tiles north and then move back.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You may have to get them unstuck from the clothesline for the first kill, thus allowing them to get pulled from the side by the cannon.

​

Sunken Pyramid

[https://img.pvme.io/images/lh39WYpTE1.png Guide illustration] ⬥ If killing sanguine werewolves in the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid Sunken Pyramid], use a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• May instead use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1534426786048249907.png?v=1 houseteleportfree] and select Menaphos as your exit destination.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 Sanguine Werewolves in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.

​

Method: Berylbrook AFK

Before loading your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] and starting the session, check the following:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] and use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence] will require extra sustain.

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upkeeping either [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555704881321353257.png?v=1 superantisanguine] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555705025194623026.png?v=1 extremeantisanguine] is required if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555692252213547139.png?v=1 havensilverhalberd2]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Also requires [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1 vampyrismgloves]

⬥ Upkeep [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect]

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim]

⬥ Use armour perked with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1 dev4] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1 enhdev4]

⬥ Set [https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenge Scavenge] (legendary pet) to "miscellaneous" only.

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/7e7e4454-406d-4530-8f30-4e9b9e89399e/7x4/?v=4dc4f75bb35eb060b6a368bbe5213e767ac4ac664642216fbca31bf256df00b5 Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Ability Bars

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4N6N2iZDW1.png Guide illustration] ​

Method: Sunken Pyramid AFK

Before starting the session, check the following:

​

Magic

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1 affliction]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times.

​

Melee

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1 deflectmelee] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is required if using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555692252213547139.png?v=1 havensilverhalberd2]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Also requires a different form of prayer restoration [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1 vampscrim]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/1WjHa6I.png Guide illustration]

Introduction

Shattered Worlds is a combat-based minigame where it's reward currency, Shattered Anima, is awarded for killing mobs and achieving objectives in the minigame. This currency can be used to purchase a variety of abilities, titles, pets, slayer masks and notably, Huge Slayer XP Lamps. At level 120 this gives 103,132 Slayer experience, at the cost of 6 million Anima. This guide will go over the most efficient method of farming Anima to purchase these lamps, to achieve high Slayer XP rates.

​

Note: This method also gives high [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1 combat] XP, but is not recommended as the main way to train slayer once the player is at a higher level, due to offering nothing but slayer XP.

​

Stats

⬥ World Set: 101-105

⬥ Optimal Anima Rate: 170m/h

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP Rate: ~1.9m/h

​

Location and How to Get There

The Shattered Worlds minigame is located in the south of the Lumbridge Swamp, easily accessible via the Lumbridge lodestone and running south west. Direct teleports can be bought from the reward shop, but are not recommended to be used.

​

Useful Items

⬥ Acceleration Powerburst [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] - Reduces the cooldown of mobility abilities such as Bladed Dive [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd], Surge [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1 surge] and Escape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1 escape] to 0.6s, allowing for extremely quick travel over large distances.

​

⬥ Essence of Finality Amulet with Dark Bow spec [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] - Required for optimal rates, allows for huge AoE damage to be dealt in conjunction with Mechanised Chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin].

​

Method

⬥ The best worlds to farm are 101-105, due to them starting with the Feeling Pumped modifier, and having low HP mobs.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Feeling Pumped gives the player unlimited adrenaline for 10s upon activation, which allows the player to deal massive damage in a short time, and is required for this style of farming.

​

⬥ Shattered worlds has 3 main objectives, kill X amount of enemies, deal X amount of damage, or repair the portal. Completing an objective quickly rewards the player with skipping worlds in that bracket, up to 3 worlds skipped if the first world is completed in under 1 minute.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To farm anima efficiently, skipping worlds is the priority. However, due to RNG in the objectives, skipping 2 worlds is often more achievable.

​

⬥ Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] offers the most efficient way to farm these worlds, via the usage of the Dark bow special attack [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec], stored in an Essence of Finality necklace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1 eof] to allow it to be used with Mechanical chinchompas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1 mechchin], allowing the player to often one-hit large groups of enemies. If Feeling Pumped has not activated yet, simply use basic abilities or thresholds like Snapshot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1 snap]. An example video is shown below featuring various world skips.

​

Note: Melee can also be viable, having strong AoE potential with abilities such as ([https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1 cleave], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1 cane], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1 quake], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1 meteorstrike], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1 bd]), however will be significantly slower than ranged.

​

⬥ As speed is the most important factor here, Acceleration potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1 powerburstofacceleration] can be particularly helpful for clearing large distances, to get to more enemies or to rush to the portal after finishing an objective. If getting to the portal quicker will help with world skips, use it, otherwise save it for the next world where it may come in more useful, this is up to the player's discretion.

​

⬥ The usage of Target Cycling is heavily recommended. This is due to auto-attacks stalling repeated Essence of Finality special attacks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1 eofspec], preventing you from continuously speccing whilst Feeling Pumped is active. Targets can still be clicked if the player is careful not to auto-attack.

​

⬥ Soulsplit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] is used for all healing, as the massive damage dealt generates a lot of healing. Solid food is also recommended, as adrenaline is effectively infinite, alongside healing a large amount in one bite and therefore has no downside.

​

⬥ The best modifiers to take after Feeling pumped are variable, but generally consistent. Electric, Explosive (if not using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]) and Charged. However, with an objective like kill X mobs, a negative modifier like Hydra can be positive.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the case of no positive modifiers, options like Zombie Apocalypse, Zone of Suffering or Hungry are the least negative options and can be ignored.

​

Ranged Preset

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1 eofyellowu] Essence of Finality Dark Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] spec stored

[https://img.pvme.io/images/UCXF0Mo.jpg Guide illustration]

Video Guide

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

⬥ Slayer Points are a currency obtained by completing Slayer Assignments which have several uses, such as skipping Slayer Assignments, purchasing consumables such as [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1 ushabti], and purchasing permanent unlocks at Slayer Masters.

⬥ This mini-guide will outline a method of effectively farming these points without having to complete lengthy, high levelled Slayer Assignments.

​

Requirements

⬥ Completion of The Blood Pact quest for access to the Lumbridge Catacombs.

⬥ Optional: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345365471232.png?v=1 slayerintrospection] Slayer Introspection to guarantee the shortest assignments possible

⬥ Optional: lunar spellbook Spellbook swap (Lunar) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1 SBSLunars] + NPC Contact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284195280695326.png?v=1 npccontact]

​

​

Blocklist

⬥ Copy the blocklist below to ensure that all Slayer Assignments given by Jacquelyn will be to slay monsters present in the Lumbridge Catacombs.

Jacquelyn Blocklist
⬥ Cave Bugs ⬥ Cows ⬥ Cave Slimes ⬥ Frogs ⬥ Birds ⬥ Ghosts ⬥ Rats ⬥ Spiders

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d6whBtns6jFiz3bUW4Ct Low-level Magic camp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=cLt3Q6IWW5L8jSziWDUB High-level Hybrid] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FcLt3Q6IWW5L8jSziWDUB.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

The Method

⬥ This method consists of doing 9 Slayer Assignments with Jacquelyn [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345369665577.png?v=1 jacquelyn], then doing the 10th with Laniakea [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1 laniakea] or your current highest level Slayer Master (not including Mandrith [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1 mandrith]).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This takes advantage of the Slayer Point bonus awarded to the player after every 10th and 50th assignment completion while also letting us speed past assignments 1-9 with Jacquelyn's short and easy tasks.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Raptor may also be used as they reward a good amount of Slayer Points while also having generally quicker assignments.

⬥ Before starting, ensure you are not currently on a Slayer streak that ends with a 9 by clicking on the Slayer icon located on the Slayer counter.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be enabled in Settings > Gameplay > Interfaces > Information Windows > Slayer counter.

​

1) Enter the bottom floor of the Lumbridge Catacombs and stand in the Skeleton room.

​

2) Use Spellbook swap (Lunar) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1 SBSLunars] and then NPC Contact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284195280695326.png?v=1 npccontact] to receive a Slayer Assignment from Jacquelyn [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345369665577.png?v=1 jacquelyn] (located at the bottom right of the interface).

​

3) Slay the required monsters within the catacombs, all possible assignments can be completed in the southern half of the dungeon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a) With the high-level preset alternate between [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1 gricocaroming] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1 gchaincaroming]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b) If Magic camping prioritise AoE Magic spells such as Corruption Blast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1 corruptblast], Greater Chain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain], and Magma Tempest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c) The Goblin used for this method, Skoblin, also count toward Skeleton assignments.

​

4) Repeat steps 2 & 3 until your streak ends in 9, which can be confirmed by either having the slayer counter expanded or double checking the message in chat that's received by the player after completing an assignment.

​

5) Spellbook swap (Lunar) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1 SBSLunars] + NPC Contact [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284195280695326.png?v=1 npccontact] again, this time receiving an assignment from your highest levelled Slayer Master (or the Raptor for faster tasks). Upon completion you'll be rewarded the bulk of the Slayer Points from this method and can repeat from step 1.

​

Video Example

[https://youtu.be/AIO4Knqmebw Efficient Slaying in Lumbridge Catacombs]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

There are 6 types of soul devourers, ranging from 105 to 117 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]. The Magister may also be killed for this task, requiring 115 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]. The mobs each require a different level of attention, and the profits differ.

​

⬥ The Magister will give 8000 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] experience per kill and benefit from the use of Tuska's Wrath [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 Tuskas], but the slayer helmet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1 slayerhelm] effect does not work on him.

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Key to the Crossing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1 keytothecrossing]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped at a rate of 1/75 on task, which can be increased to 1/60 with the use of Sophanem slayer dungeon drop enhancers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

⬥ Vital Spark [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426807893032963.png?v=1 vitalspark]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be doubled via the use of vital spark drop enhancers.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.

⬥ Soul devourers each have their own drop tables, containing good alchables and other resources, making them a consistent moneymaker.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Sophanem Slayer Dungeon contains chests which will [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_Slayer_Dungeon#Chest automatically gather drops].

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Sophanem Slayer Dungeon

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablets.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, you can teleport to the Menaphos lodestone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552289589796904.png?v=1 menaphoslode], take the bridge to Sophanem, and then run south to the dungeon entrance.

⬥ Sunken Pyramid (south-eastern room, 5 spawns)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the small room, position yourself anywhere near the center of all the spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For Imperial warrior akh's stand in the northern part of the room and target southern spawns.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_Slayer_Dungeon_teleport Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport]     • Allows quick access to the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Feather_of_Ma'at Feather of Ma'at]     • Required for killing mobs inside the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vital_spark_drop_enhancer Vital spark drop enhancer]     • Gives an additional vital spark [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426807893032963.png?v=1 vitalspark] if gotten as a drop.     • Can be purchased for 1000 Dungeoneering tokens [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_slayer_dungeon_drop_enhancer Sophanem slayer dungeon drop enhancers]     • Increases chance to get Key to the Crossing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1 keytothecrossing] drops.     • Can be purchased for 10,000 Dungeoneering tokens [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken]

​

Salawa Akh

[https://img.pvme.io/images/midZL8f.png Guide illustration] The lowest level soul devourer, they do weak melee attacks and have no special mechanics, making them easy to AFK.

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Soulgazers [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107315521257572.png?v=1 soulgazer] can be killed in the Wilderness, the stalker dungeon in Zamorak's hideout, and the Sunken Pyramid. The Sunken Pyramid is easier to loot in and has no cannonball cost, but the Wilderness spawns can drop [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer]

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 99

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1950.4

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~420 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] ~490kph [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~819k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] ~956k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Hexhunter bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

⬥ Soulgazer pet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107315521257572.png?v=1 soulgazer]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fellstalk_incense_sticks Fellstalk Incense Sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265421213746.png?v=1 fellstalksticks]     • Increases chance of spawning elite monsters ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Seeker%27s_charm Seeker's charm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212537411932160.png?v=1 seekerscharm]     • Offered to the portal in the stalker dungeon     • Increases chances of elite soulgazers spawning ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Deathtouched_dart Deathtouched dart] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1106421990044213269.png?v=1 deathtoucheddart]     • Optionally brought to kill [https://runescape.wiki/w/Veil-ripper_Ozharakha Veil-Ripper Ozharakha] if it spawns
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop Restocking Cannon Ability] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon]     • Restocks cannon without user input when using Wilderness location

⬥ Both items are considerably rare and have a much higher chance of being dropped by Elite Soulgazers, including Veil-Ripper Ozharakha which has a guaranteed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/581180369911414794.png?v=1 hexhunterbow] drop. Using Seeker's Charms [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212537411932160.png?v=1 seekerscharm] is highly recommended to increase the rate of elites from 1/50 to 1/10

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Wilderness (level 27 Wilderness)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place and load the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1 cannon] in the open area a few tiles east of the lava pool

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Northeast of the level 18 obelisk, accessible via [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1 portableobelisk]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/qGhOmREHX2.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Sunken Pyramid (south-eastern room, 5 spawns)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the small room, position yourself six tiles south of the northern statue (northeastern corner of the brazier's shadow)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

​

Method: Necromancy

Soulgazers can be effectively AFK'd in the Sunken Pyramid and the Wilderness using Necromancy due to its high damage output and sustain from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1 commandghost] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect]

Sunken Pyramid

⬥ Elite soulgazers should be focused when they spawn as they have KO potential when ignored

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] are active at all times, drinking a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] dose whenever you drink a weapon poison

⬥ Ensure that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is active at all times.

⬥ Set the autofire rate of your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver] to 15

Wilderness

⬥ Elite soulgazers should be focused when they spawn as they have KO potential when ignored

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1 deflectmage] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1 ancientshard] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times, drinking a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] dose whenever you drink a weapon poison

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soulgazer's in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, so [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] is not required

⬥ Ensure that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is active at all times.

⬥ Set the autofire rate of your [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1 bloodreaver] based on how much damage you're taking and calibrate accordingly

Presets and Relics

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a0f06969-1567-4ec6-9ae2-ce348b2bbeda Necromancy - Sunken Pyramid] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=fb246308-6181-43ab-851e-c31caec61f3d Necromancy - Wilderness] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Ffb246308-6181-43ab-851e-c31caec61f3d.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

Sunken Pyramid

[https://img.pvme.io/images/qtOOxDY248.png Guide illustration] Wilderness

[https://img.pvme.io/images/hY51Y8Rlyq.png Guide illustration]

Method: Magic

​

⚠️ Disclaimer

This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

Sunken Pyramid

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with ‎ ‎[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1 animatedead] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] are active at all times

Presets and Relics

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FpODx8KbWN6mGZu9eWCiW.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

⚠️ Disclaimer

Some methods in this guide may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026

Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 Suggestions (external Discord)]!

​

Introduction

Spiritual warriors have four different variants, each resembling their respective god within the God Wars Dungeon. They're mostly similar, except that Armadylean spiritual warriors can't be attacked with melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

⬥ This guide will focus on killing spiritual warriors in the Sunken Pyramid, as this location yields the highest kills per hour

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other methods of killing spiritual warriors, such as in the God Wars Dungeon will not be discussed

⬥ They can be assigned as a slayer assignment [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] by Jacquelyn, The Raptor, Vannaka, Sumona, and Laniakea

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They count as spiritual warriors, ghosts, and undead slayer tasks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Armadylean spiritual warriors also count as aviansie slayer tasks

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: 68

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• level 99 Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] is required to access the Sunken Pyramid

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 231

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~1170 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~1000 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] (All AFK)

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~270k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~231k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] (All AFK)

​

Desirable Drops

⬥ Spiritual warriors have a valuable loot table containing: coins [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134866724043358218.png?v=1 goldacc], salvage [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170723130937427.png?v=1 springcleaner], super sets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1 notepaper], and a variety of herb drops [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134863720128974940.png?v=1 herbbag]

⬥ Sealed clue scroll (hard) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586945273049109.png?v=1 hardclue]

⬥ Warpriest armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158477033474.png?v=1 armadylcomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429861261322.png?v=1 bandoscomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429785632769.png?v=1 saradomincomp] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026334232576.png?v=1 zamorakcomp]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will drop warpriest armour for their respective faction, so they are a good source of god components

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) Salve amulet (e)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1 salveamulet]     • Increases damage and accuracy by 20% when fighting undead monsters ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment Ghost hunter equipment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1 ghosthunterhelm]     • Increases damage done against ghosts related creatures by 10% when three or more pieces are worn ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Herbicide Herbicide] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134923280625709106.png?v=1 herbicide] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Herb_bag Herb bag] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134863720128974940.png?v=1 herbbag]     • With the herbicide collector upgrade you will automatically loot herbs
Abilities
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Magma_Tempest Magma Tempest] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1 magmatempest] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Chain Greater Chain] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1 gchain] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sunshine Greater Sunshine] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1 gsunshine]
Other
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Luck_of_the_Dwarves_(relic_power) Luck of the Dwarves (relic power)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/987267727980912701.png?v=1 lotdrelic]     • Allows you to increase your kph by wearing a better ring

​

Location and How to Get there

The best place to kill spiritual warriors is in the Sunken Pyramid due to how spread out they are in other locations. You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spiritual warriors will only spawn as the version you captured

​

Method: Magic and Melee

⬥ Spiritual warriors can be AFK'd for extended periods with minimal inputs required

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is possible to AFK them with only one input every 10 minutes

⬥ Sacrifice [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065907322880.png?v=1 sacrifice] is used to help sustain your life points

⬥ They're aggressive to you if you're not wearing any armour for their respective faction; however, using aggression potions [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] will net you a higher kph and requires less inputs

⬥ If you're using melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] you can't have Armadylean spiritual warriors

​

Where to stand

⬥ With your camera facing north, center yourself between the northern statue and the two green pots to the east

[https://img.pvme.io/images/t6Us9dgqjv.png Guide illustration] ​

Presets

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=l8ENoGbUVvKoUYXGKP1X Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a9a3a18d-fe08-486d-8f09-628cf1cb3ad6 Magic (Alternative)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=94de33d3-7969-4808-ac20-6f6f7fc819df Magic (Best in Slot)] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic] [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F94de33d3-7969-4808-ac20-6f6f7fc819df.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

⬥ The alternative Magic preset can be used for accounts with minimal unlocks

⬥ If using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1 inquisitorstaff], Air Wave will do the same damage as Air Surge, but use less runes

⬥ Precise 6 Caroming 1 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953962207957162.png?v=1 caroming1] + Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1 er4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1 ruthless3] are the best weapon perks if only doing this method

​

Action Bars

Note: You can place [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1 tuskas] further up if on task.

⬥ Magic (Best in Slot)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/O8zD1FFqoa.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Magic (Alternative)

[https://img.pvme.io/images/4ZVzO6qmU2.png Guide illustration] ⬥ Melee

[https://img.pvme.io/images/o2prKTfAlU.png Guide illustration] ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Chaos Roar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1 chaosroar] isn't unlocked, shift the rest of the abilities forward

​

Video Examples

⬥ [https://youtu.be/Z3TG2pi0sgY AFK Melee ~1000 kph]

⬥ [https://youtu.be/5y7HoAZpKek AFK Magic ~1170 kph]

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/5y7HoAZpKek Embedded guide video]

​

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

Tormented demons are classified as demons, and can be slain with no Slayer level [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] requirement. They can be assigned as a task after completing [https://runescape.wiki/w/While_Guthix_Sleeps While Guthix Sleeps] and purchasing the ability to have them assigned, for 50 Slayer points [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer]

​

⬥ Besides the default Tormented demon task, you can also kill them for Demons cluster tasks

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 1136

⬥ Optimal kills per hour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (AFK)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sunken Pyramid: 200+

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guthixian Temple: 180+

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] (AFK)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sunken Pyramid: 227k+

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guthixian Temple: 204k+

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Dragon Claws [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1 dragonclaw] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048040865726485.png?v=1 dragonclawoh]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

⬥ Dragon limbs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1154851356264374292.png?v=1 dragonlimbs]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

⬥ Ruined dragon armour pieces (slice, lump and shard) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1154851369837142107.png?v=1 ruinedarmourslice] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1154851358294421584.png?v=1 ruinedarmourlump] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1154851359514972230.png?v=1 ruinedarmourshard]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log

​

Useful Items and Unlocks

Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
Items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex Slayer Codex] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]     • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace Demon horn necklace] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator Attuned ectoplasmator] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]     • Helps sustain your prayer

​

Method 1: Sunken Pyramid

Four Tormented Demon souls should be placed into a large room in the Sunken Pyramid, use Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] with a blood reaver familiar and weapon poison.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is active at all times

⬥ You do not need [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] as the demons are naturally aggressive

⬥ Do not use Darkness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness]

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Sunken Pyramid (either northern room, 4 spawns)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In either large room, position yourself anywhere near the center of all the spawns

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

​

Presets

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1f0d8087-b39e-4569-9db2-97919222cc1c Preset breakdown]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F1f0d8087-b39e-4569-9db2-97919222cc1c.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/LAMOCiafiu.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/XwpfYx1gFmo Sunken Pyramid]

​

Method 2: Guthixian Temple

Tormented Demon can also be killed in their natural habitat - the Guthixian Temple. You may wish to use this method first to capture the 4 Ushabti souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1 ushabti] required for Method 1.

​

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1 sorrow] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination]

⬥ Sustain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1 demonhornnecklace] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1 ectoplasmator]

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active at all times

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] is active at all times

⬥ You do not need [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] as the demons are naturally aggressive

⬥ Do not use Darkness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1 darkness]

​

Location and How to Get there

⬥ Guthixian Temple

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teleport using the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1 sixthagecircuit] (option 4 "Tormented Demons")

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand in the south-east room, anywhere on the steps which captures the aggression of a Tormented Demon.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will be pulled around due to spawns and limited ranged of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] weapons.

​

Presets

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d6cfc438-3742-46fa-8f12-3ac57371ab2c Preset breakdown]

​

​ [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd6cfc438-3742-46fa-8f12-3ac57371ab2c.png?alt=media Guide illustration]

Ability Bar

[https://img.pvme.io/images/co4xMGoXdB.png Guide illustration] ​

Example Kills

⬥ [https://youtu.be/aahuHIMDtec Guthixian Temple]

​

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

[https://img.pvme.io/images/MKHhHLw.png Guide illustration] ​

Introduction

TzHaar creatures are killed for the Ring of Stone drop, which is their rarest item for the Karamja slayer log. This method utilises legacy combat mode. The method is basically just running around the TzHaar City and killing every TzHaar monster you see. If you happen to get the Ring of Stone early, the Fight Cauldron minigame is your best way of obtaining the rest of the items you're missing.

​

Notable drops

⬥ Ring of stone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1029416868534046761.png?v=1 ringofstone] 1/5000 or 1/4850 with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/987267727980912701.png?v=1 lotdrelic] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/566453486913323042.png?v=1 LotD]

⬥ Various Tzhaar weapons/armour

​

Recommended items

⬥ Replace [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689551388463595590.png?v=1 holyovl] with [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1 ovl]

⬥ Weapon preference: Decimation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] > Upgraded bone blowpipe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794591830056961.png?v=1 upgradedboneblowpipe] > Seren godbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] > Noxious longbow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159425208342.png?v=1 noxbow] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656863806080811038.png?v=1 quiver] with Araxyte arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507040248922130.png?v=1 raxarrow]

⬥ Any decent DPS armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1 sirenicbody] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641672159051120651.png?v=1 pernixbody] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556585903489810454.png?v=1 EliteRobinHoodTop]

​

Presets and Relics

⬥ Legacy mode is ON.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/tDRVUVc.png Guide illustration] ​

Path cycle

[https://img.pvme.io/images/jVi9Duy.png Guide illustration]

Note: If struggling with run energy, start at the plaza.

​

Example

[https://youtu.be/tL_QWghiXsY https://youtu.be/tL_QWghiXsY]

​

Basic Fight Cauldron guide

​

Overview of the Fight Cauldron

Fight Cauldron is a safe minigame unlocked after the Grandmaster quest The Brink of Extinction. Within the Fight Cauldron minigame, players battle with unlimited waves of TokHaar monsters who wish to test their might, and that of their opponent.

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will need a total of 228 obsidian shards to make every piece of obsidian equipment. On average, this will take 66 kills in the Cauldron.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Full Obsidian armour is required for the TokHaar-Mok achievement.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fight Cauldron is also the fastest way to obtain weapon/armour drops for the Karamja slayer log.

​

Minimal requirements

⬥ 80 + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 Strength] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 Constitution] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer]

⬥ Any T85 Weapon or better

⬥ A hybrid armour set (lower levels only)

​

Magic preset

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439129275306164.png?v=1 graspingpouchblue] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1 Waterrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660333019136.png?v=1 Soulrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659422855188.png?v=1 Chaosrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1 Airrune]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439136875253810.png?v=1 graspingpouchblack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659301089280.png?v=1 Bodyrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1 Firerune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658961481769.png?v=1 Astralrune] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1 Bloodrune]

⬥ (Runes for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1 exsanguinate])

[https://img.pvme.io/images/OpdQ18s.png Guide illustration]

Ranged preset

​

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656863806080811038.png?v=1 quiver] with Araxyte arrows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507040248922130.png?v=1 raxarrow]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Nrz1Eji.png Guide illustration]

***NOTE: If [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] are owned, use those instead of kiln capes. ***

​

Mechanics to watch for

⬥ Hot floor sections

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep an eye on the floor. Standing on a hot section of the floor will deal damage equal to 20% of your life points every game tick, which can kill you quickly.

​

IMPORTANT: If you are about to die, simply leave the fight. If you die, the shard amount that you would get normally rewarded with is halved.

​

Video Guide made by Trinijunie

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=21x5kr6_2Xc https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=21x5kr6_2Xc]
