pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

[https://img.pvme.io/images/2DsYuqm.png Guide illustration]

​

Introduction

⬥ the Ultimate Slayer is a title obtained by completing every slayer collection log item. After the wilderness update, it became a popular goal for many players as PvP can now be turned off. This guide contains all the tips and tricks to make the grind as smooth as possible.

This made tasks like Lava Strykewyrms, Revenants and Ripper demons a very safe and hassle-free task.

⬥ An overview of generally helpful slayer items/consumables/relics can be found in [[PvME/Slayer/Overview Of Slayer|Overview Of Slayer]]

⬥ Task specific guides can be found in [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Slayer Slayer guides]

​

Useful Items

Useful Items
Items that will greatly assist the player's Ultimate Slayer journey.
Consumables - Time savers
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Fellstalk_incense_sticks Fellstalk incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265421213746.png?v=1 fellstalksticks]     • Each potency level provides a x1.01 multiplier to elite NPCs spawn chance, up to ~4% (tiers stack multiplicatively).     • Important item for tasks such as: Ripper Demons, Edimmu and Rune Dragons. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_VIP_ticket Slayer VIP ticket] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344597934120.png?v=1 slayervip]     • Usually obtained via the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Travelling_merchant Travelling Merchant] or [https://runescape.wiki/w/Cabbage_Facepunch_Bonanza Cabbage Facepunch Bonanza].     • You can also kill the beginner version of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Giant_Mimic Giant Mimic] for ~30+ slayer VIP tickets per hour depending on luck. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Seeker's_charm Seeker's Charm] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212537411932160.png?v=1 seekerscharm]     • Offering them to the northern portal in the stalker dungeon increases the chance of elite soulgazers appearing from 1/50 to 1/10. ​
Consumables - QoL
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Lantadyme_incense_sticks Lantadyme incense sticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 lantasticks]     • Extends potion timers up to +2 minutes at max potency - reduces the doses of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1 aggressionpotion] used. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Potion_reservoir Potion reservoir] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/878739200407654431.png?v=1 potionreservoir]     • Allows for potions with a timer to be automatically consumed - Helps the grind become more AFK. ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_penance Penance powder] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance]     • Good for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] upkeep. ​
Other Untradeable items
⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Most_Wanted_card Most wanted cards] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877256884867152.png?v=1 mostwantedcardabbydemon] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877287327125594.png?v=1 mostwantedcardautomaton] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877303722659840.png?v=1 mostwantedcardglacor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877321212907561.png?v=1 mostwantedcardtormenteddemon]     • Obtained weekly from the platinum mode of Rush of Blood.     • Increases unique droprates for their respective monsters.     • Each card contains 100 charges, each kill of the monsters depletes 1 charge.     • Multiple copies cannot be obtained.     • Very good for Glacors [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107344935923743.png?v=1 glacor] and Automatons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107269820133477.png?v=1 automaton] ⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_mask Slayer Masks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325563068071936.png?v=1 maskoftheabyss]     • Allow players to force a task for the monster once a day. Read more in the following section.

​

Daily Slayer mask tasks

⬥ There are 2 main reasons to force 1 task per day with their respective slayer masks:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Easy points that adds up over time.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Removes the need to use lower tier slayer masters.

​

⬥ Most important: Use slayer masks for monsters whose uniques are only obtainable on-task/have rates significantly boosted on task:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ice strykewyrm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107267915907166.png?v=1 icestrykewyrm] - Staff of light

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Desert strykewyrm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107266313703566.png?v=1 desertstrykewyrm] - Focus sight

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jungle strykewyrm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107264459821066.png?v=1 junglestrykewyrm] - Hexcrest

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Airut [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107275562139648.png?v=1 airut] - Razorback gauntlets (Only on task)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107332478840873.png?v=1 abyssaldemon] - Abyssal wand and orb (Only on task)

​

Note: Other slayer masks such as Mask of Kurask/Basilisks/Stone provide a boost in drop chance for their respective head items.

​

Task prioritisation

**Disclaimer! This section assumes the following:

⬥ You own the Slayer master cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape]

⬥ Laniakea [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1 laniakea] is your main slayer master

⬥ You are starting with mostly empty logs

⬥ Block/Prefer lists are based on task weighing and general level of annoyance of the task**

​

The Slayer master cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1 slayercape] has a perk that gives a 20% chance to choose what a new task will be from a Slayer master. There are a couple of tasks that should have priority over others. The last thing you want is having little to no points with your last item being an Edimmu pet which can be very hard to obtain.

​

Block and Prefer Tasks
Ask questions if you get stumped
Prefer List
• Ripper demons • Demons cluster • Strykewyrms cluster • Lava Strykewyrms • Dragons cluster • Gemstone dragons • Dinosaurs • Edimmu (see below)
Block List
• Black demons • Elves • Greater Demons • Dark beasts (after dark bow is obtained) • Aviansies • Gargoyles (after granite maul is obtained) • Vyrewatch • Crystal Shapeshifters (after elven ring is obtained)

​

Note: Undead cluster and Creatures of Daemonheim are also good prefer tasks to replace any monsters you finish before obtaining the [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1 edimmu] pet.

​

Priority (P) list if your cape procs:

​

⬥ P1: Edimmu [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1 edimmu]

⬥ P2: Ripper demons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1 ripperdemon] , Demons cluster task

⬥ P3: Camel Warrior [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107305173913721.png?v=1 camelwarrior] , Living Wyverns [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107283015421962.png?v=1 livingwyvern] , Lava Strykewyrms [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107339126808627.png?v=1 lavastrykewyrm] , Strykewyrms cluster, Dinosaurs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1 venomousdinosaur]

⬥ P4: Nightmare creatures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107308516782111.png?v=1 nightmare] , Creatures of the Lost Grove [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107335343542404.png?v=1 mossgolem] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107312115490877.png?v=1 vinecrawler] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947789895606312.png?v=1 luminoussnaggler]

⬥ P5: Ascension creatures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107271523020831.png?v=1 rorarius] , Celestial Dragons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212539441975296.png?v=1 celestialdragon]

⬥ P6: Dragon cluster, Gemstone dragons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107337415544854.png?v=1 hydrixdragon]

⬥ P7: Anything that can be killed without a task and does not provide a drop boost on task (Stalker creatures, Kal'gerion demons, Tormented demons, Aquanites, Nihils, Glacors, Nodon Dragonkin...)

​

Note: Tasks that can be toggled with slayer points should be turned off after obtaining their relevant drops.

​

Wilderness tasks

By doing tasks in the wilderness whenever feasible, you can obtain more [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1 revenantdropenhancer] for future revenant tasks.

​

Tasks that should be done in the wilderness during Ultimate Slayer:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ripper demons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1 ripperdemon]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lava Strykewyrms [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107339126808627.png?v=1 lavastrykewyrm]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abyssal Creatures [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107327126904842.png?v=1 abyssallord] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107328964014100.png?v=1 abyssalbeast] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107332478840873.png?v=1 abyssaldemon]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hydrix Dragons (optional) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107337415544854.png?v=1 hydrixdragon]

​

Useful Spreadsheets

Useful Spreadsheets
Ultimate Slayer Drop Tracker
A nicely designed spreadsheet to keep track of your Ultimate Slayer progress! [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1csNk0EmEnhW10JkrNg10Z4zN6346S60XxEplcPQ-w7U/edit#gid=725595188 Gooch Era's tracker]
Slayer Task Sheet
A spreadsheet containing info regarding task methods and task priority. [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lDe13I1nH9E930SCMiE5pp1CbteYn9_dQVzxKM-Axrg/edit#gid=80902186 Spreadsheet made by Neb | RSN: A Neb]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vile_blooms Vile blooms] are a combination task of all plant monsters on Anachronia. The main reason to do them is for the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Lost_Lands_and_Dungeons Lost Lands and Dungeons] collection log, [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skeka%27s_hypnowand Skeka's hypnowand] pieces, or to obtain their soul for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1 slayercodex]

​

⬥ Vile blooms can be assigned as a Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] assignment by Laniakea.

​

Desirable drops

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Blast_diffusion_boots Blast diffusion boots] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602581956072439828.png?v=1 blastdiffusion]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 times rarer off-task.

⬥ [https://runescape.wiki/w/Skeka%27s_hypnowand Skeka's hypnowand] pieces

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All 4 pieces, but Skeka's hypnowand handle is twice as common.

​

Introduction

[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vyrelord Vyrelords] / [https://runescape.wiki/w/Vyrelady Vyreladies] are popular Slayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] monsters due to being AFK while having a profitable drop table, as well as providing cheap, passive Prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] and Firemaking [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] XP when killed with a [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891494977765446.png?v=1 sunspear]

​

⬥ Darkmeyer is unlocked after partial completion of [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Branches_of_Darkmeyer The Branches of Darkmeyer] quest; however, the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunspear_(melee) reforged Sunspear] is acquired during the [https://runescape.wiki/w/River_of_Blood River of Blood] quest.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Completing the Morytania elite achievements is recommended due to the worn effect of the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Morytania_legs_4 Morytania legs 4].

⬥ Cremating 250 vyre corpses is recommended as this will restore 5% prayer points per vyre killed.

​

Stats

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] level: Unknown

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per kill: 343.6

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] XP per kill: 280 (420 with Morytania legs 4)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] XP per kill: 200 (300 with Morytania legs 4)

⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~940 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~1000 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] (using flagpole lure), ~940 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

⬥ Optimal [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] XP per hour: ~323k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic], ~344k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee], ~323k [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

Desirable drops

⬥ Vyres have a very rewarding loot table, filled with Herblore supplies, seeds, and alchables; particularly useful in Ironman mode [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1 iron]

⬥ Cremating 200 and 500 vyre corpses is required for the Shade-Shattering Ka-Bloom [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641342351532621824.png?v=1 achiev] and Ivan is Flailing [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641342351532621824.png?v=1 achiev] achievements respectively.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every 50 vyre corpses cremated gives you +10 damage with all Sunspear variants [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891494977765446.png?v=1 sunspear], capping out at 500 vyre corpses cremated (+100 damage).

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every vyre killed will restore 1% prayer points, increasing to 5% at 250 vyre corpses cremated.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cremating 500 vyre corpses is a requirement for the master quest cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1 masterquestcape] and the trimmed completionist cape [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235223932958.png?v=1 comptrim]

​

Location & How to Get there

⬥ Darkmeyer can be accessed via [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855869058225274931.png?v=1 drakansmedallion], option 4.

⬥ Position yourself on the tile shown below.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand north of the tree, and walk two tiles east.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/RLuLGkIcfs.png Guide illustration] ​

Pre-AFK Setup

Before starting your AFK session, refer to the map below to ensure the area is prepared properly.

⬥ Red areas are places vyres can occasionally get stuck, check these spots and kill any vyres that are roaming the area.

⬥ The green house holds the 2 vyres which are used for the flagpole lure to increase KPH with Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ The blue house's door can be opened for more KPH, but as the door shuts every 5 minutes, keeping it open is only viable with an alt.

⬥ If there are more vyres in a house than is shown on the map, kill all the vyres in that house to reset their spawns.

[https://img.pvme.io/images/Jc8BPhNV9K.png Guide illustration] Note: on server reset Vanescula Drakan will block the path for vyres trying to walk to you. This is fixed by talking to Vanescula and then walking under her.

​

Flagpole Lure

You can optionally set up the flagpole lure which allows you to have one extra spawn to kill, this can be done solo and is only recommended with Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Once you're done fixing the spawns, go in the house highlighted green above.

⬥ Lure the vyres which spawn in that house out, then try to get them stuck on the flagpole.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done by tagging both vyres then running north.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When they're almost out of the house, run to the player position highlighted in the previous section.

⬥ If done correctly, the vyre which spawns between the house highlighted green and the bank won't get stuck on the flagpole, and will instead make its way to you.

​

Note: setting up a flagpole lure solo may be seen [https://youtu.be/pQ_ZQLOPyKE?si=ekESrGxDbN_0LOP_&t=39 here].

​

Method: AFK (All Styles)

Before starting your AFK session, check the following:

​

⬥ Ensure [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderoverload] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] are active.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderoverload] doesn't increase Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] KPH.

⬥ Ensure that [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1 scriptureofwen] is active

⬥ Activate [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] if having issues with Prayer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer]

⬥ Sunspear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/860891494977765446.png?v=1 sunspear] is in the correct combat style.

​

Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1 malevolence]

⬥ Optionally set up the flagpole lure for increased KPH as shown by the Melee [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee] example video at the bottom of this page.

​

Magic [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 magic]

⬥ Pray [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1392980672980975717.png?v=1 leechmagicstrength]

⬥ Autocast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1 incitefear]

​

Ranged [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range]

​

⬥ [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4d3fd553-8bbf-4cbf-9d7f-aec9cfc9860b Melee] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1 melee]

​

Armour

General Armour Introduction

⬥ There are three categories of armour:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Power: any armour with a style bonus

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hybrid: anything stated as "hybrid"

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank: any other item (also has more armour than power / hybrid)

⬥ Armour tiers are based on the level required to equip them

⬥ Equipping armour provides style and armour bonuses

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These bonuses are based on armour category and tier

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally armours in the same category and tier will have equal bonuses

⬥ Wearing off-style armour slots (excluding cape slot) provides an accuracy penalty based on armour bonus

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• "Off-style" is any style that does not match your equipped main hand / 2H weapon

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hybrid gear incurs no penalty

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This penalty is near-doubled (0.8 → 1.5) when using the Necromancy combat style.

⬥ Some armour sets have set effects which may be useful

Index of Armour
⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoury Wiki] ⬥ Armour in bold is worth being aware of, they will be elaborated on after or are recommended in the respective upgrade order ⬥ Use !armour to see DPS difference between the armour ⬥ Generally speaking, use power armour

Gloves

Gloves
⬥ Use !gloves to see where to use which gloves ⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/884739993543782420.png?v=1 lengartefact] upgrades [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 nightmaregauntlets] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1 Glovesofpassage] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869286640722513940.png?v=1 kerapacswristwraps] to T90 and allows enchantments to work     • The T90 gloves can also be bought directly from the G.E. ⬥ Gloves covered: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869286640722513940.png?v=1 kerapacswristwraps] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 NMG] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717613769728100.png?v=1 edracogloves] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694862037012.png?v=1 glovesofpassage] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 Cinderbanes] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159429271562.png?v=1 DTB] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643214402169864213.png?v=1 spellcaster] | [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1 vampyrismgloves]

Weapons

General Weapons Introduction

⬥ The tier of a weapon is the listed equip requirement. Generally the damage and accuracy tier match that

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exceptions include: [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1 lanispear] (T90 damage, T75 accuracy), GWD2 weapons (T80 damage, T90 accuracy), and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232154160594974.png?v=1 darkiceshard] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/915232153787334677.png?v=1 darkicesliver] (T88 damage, T85 accuracy)

⬥ For dual-wield weapons:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall damage tier is equal to 66% of the main hand's tier and 33% of the off-hand's tier

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall accuracy tier you have is equal to your main hand's tier fully.

⬥ For ammo'd [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] weapons and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic] weapons:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage tier is equal to the minimum between the weapon tier and the ammo / spell tier

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ E.g. a T90 weapon with a T1 ammo / spell has T1 damage

⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoury Wiki] ⬥ Use !defender for info on obtaining defenders ⬥ Defender weapon and shield tier is half its tier (e.g. T90 defender is T45) ⬥ Defenders provide 3% accuracy and 1/15 chance to reduce hit by 50-100% ⬥ T90 shields' right-click voke option drops target when using queueing ⬥ Spirit shields reduce damage by 30%, 20% of it is removed from prayer ⬥ Shieldbows count as a MH + shield of its tier (e.g. [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1 dbow] is a T70 MH + shield) ⬥ Bone shield [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809125590450276.png?v=1 lesserboneshield] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] is unlocked via [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] and allows the use of defensive shield abilities without a physical shield, costing necrotic runes.     • With lvl120 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1 zemouregalsnexus] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1 greaterboneshield] you can reach up to bone shield tier 75.

⬥ Utility [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543875425055670275.png?v=1 sbs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 vuln] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 healother] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009570755836641331.png?v=1 venggroup] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1 prismofsalvation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050892142325780.png?v=1 spiritualhealing]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1 crumbleundead] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] bring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439138401980446.png?v=1 graspingpouchgreen]

​

Situation 3 - Non-magic Combat [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439136875253810.png?v=1 graspingpouchblack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439126519644271.png?v=1 graspingpouchpink]

⬥ Utility [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543875425055670275.png?v=1 sbs] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1 smokecloud] (via [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/657248051190300682.png?v=1 borrowedpower]) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1 disrupt] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1 healother] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1 veng] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009570755836641331.png?v=1 venggroup] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 prismofrestoration] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1 prismofsalvation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050892142325780.png?v=1 spiritualhealing]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1 penanceaspect] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1 vampyrismaspect] bring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439129275306164.png?v=1 graspingpouchblue]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1 cept] or [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1 ent] bring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439138401980446.png?v=1 graspingpouchgreen]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1 shielddome] bring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439129275306164.png?v=1 graspingpouchblue] or swap [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1 earthrune] for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660286881832.png?v=1 mudrune]

​

​

Banking Preset

Banking Preset
For an exhaustive list of everything you might want in a banking preset, see Quick Banking Preset in [[PvME/Getting started/Interface Guide|Interface Guide]].
Preset Contents
⬥ Summoning familiars & scrolls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1 ripperscroll] ⬥ Potions to use pre-fight [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1 weppoison] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475161809190913.png?v=1 summoningrenewal] ⬥ Incense sticks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 SpiritSticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 LantaSticks] ⬥ Preferred book and pages [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643168594493964298.png?v=1 grimpage] ⬥ Penance powder [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] ⬥ Divine Charges [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1 divinecharge] ⬥ Rune pouches [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1390439138401980446.png?v=1 graspingpouchgreen] to cast aspects [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1 temporalanomaly] ⬥ HP-boosting euipment for bonfire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770709530161192.png?v=1 wardentop90] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102553021457645579.png?v=1 merciless] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839906296290476033.png?v=1 reefcape]     • Only necessary if you do not have the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Totem_of_Vitality Totem of Vitality] unlocked     • Reach 13400 HP for the maximum boost
Example Banking Presets
Some players' banking presets for reference. [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7a3eaf08-a1ce-4a89-b3ec-ee94efcffa29 Dyanne], [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=2a258b96-3929-47f3-adc6-92a8d6f8a95a hikaru nara], [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ad56e52f-0cd0-4173-9caf-a4cf1e04170e basic preset]

pages.text:
[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Healing

Solid Food

Solid Food
⬥ All solid food drain 3% adrenaline when eaten while attacking ⬥ Use !food to see why solid foods are not great, and the alternatives
List of Notable Solids
⬥ Sailfish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489363087360.png?v=1 Sailfish] - Heals 2.4K LP, can overheal up to 10% of max LP ⬥ Sailfish Soup [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336701933060106.png?v=1 sailfishsoup] - Heals 2.6K LP, can overheal up to 15% of max LP ⬥ Giant kebbit meat - Heals 2.8K LP, can overheal up to 15% of max LP     • Too scarce for general use, but current best single-bite food ⬥ Great Gunkan [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689528927928188963.png?v=1 greatgunkan] - Heals 2.85K LP over 10.8s     • Cannot eat another [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689528927928188963.png?v=1 greatgunkan] during this time ⬥ Primal Feast [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281849532416.png?v=1 primalfeast] - Requires 115 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705729192820747.png?v=1 cooking], unpacks 4 items each healing 2.5K LP     • Requires 3 open inventory slots to unpack     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281849532416.png?v=1 primalfeast] is untradeable, but ingredients are tradeable ⬥ Calorie Bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656790558177755169.png?v=1 caloriebomb] - Heals equivalent of the 5 stored fish, user heals +20%     • Heals up to 4 other players within 2 squares of user

​

Other Foods

Other Foods
⬥ These do not drain adrenaline, and are commonly used
List of Notable Solids
⬥ Blue Blubber Jellyfish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593742291033.png?v=1 blueblubber] - Heals 750 LP per bite, up to 3 bites ⬥ Green Blubber Jellyfish [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/977320004200579082.png?v=1 greenblubber] - Heals 500 LP per bite, up to 3 bites

​

Potions

Potions
⬥ Can be combo'd with other food doing potion → food same tick ⬥ Use !food to see issues of [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1 Brew] and food you should use
List of Notable Potions
⬥ Saradomin Brew [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1 Brew] - Heals 1K LP per dose, up to 6 doses; overheals 1K     • Decreases [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 Strength], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] by 4% + 1 even if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] used ⬥ Super Sara. Brew [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708771344482314.png?v=1 supersara] - Heals 1.3K LP per dose, up to 6 doses; 1.3K overheal     • Decreases [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 Strength], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range] by 4% + 1 even if [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] used ⬥ Guthix Rest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593901412578.png?v=1 grest] - Heals 500 LP per dose, up to 6 doses     • Cures poison and gives 30s of poison immunity ⬥ Super Guthix Rest [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690140078407680059.png?v=1 supergrest] - Heals 650 LP per dose, up to 6 doses     • Cures poison and gives 30s of poison immunity

​

LP-related Items

List of Notable LP-related Items
⬥ Ogre Flask (Thermal) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593796423724.png?v=1 thermalflask] - Boosts LP by 3 per [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1 Constitution] level, up to 297     • Stacks with bonfires, Totem of Vitality, [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341748180025365.png?v=1 fortitude], and LP-boosting equipment     • Last 60 min per dose (90 min with level 3 Anachronia Spa)     • Cures poison and protects from poison

​

Prayer Restoration

List of Notable Potions
⬥ Super Restore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642708657825644554.png?v=1 restore] - Restores 327 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] per dose, up to 6 doses     • Restores lowered stats by 25% + 8 levels per dose ⬥ Super Prayer Renewal ** [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1 superprayerrenewal] - Restores 317 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] per dose, up to 6 doses     • Restores 600 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] over 6 minutes per dose ⬥ Spiritual Prayer** [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1 spiritualprayer] - Restores 317 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] per dose, up to 6 doses     • Restores 15 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning] spec points per dose

​

Overloads

Overloads
⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450653390360626.png?v=1 pulsecore] boosts 8 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore] levels (wait at w84 Lumbridge market) ⬥ Overloads reapply / refresh their stat buff every 15 seconds
List of Notable Overloads
⬥ Elder [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl], 106 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore] - Buffs [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1 Attack], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1 Strength], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1 Magic], [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1 range], and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1 Defence] by 17% + 5 (120 at 99) ⬥ Elder Salve [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve], 107 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore]     • [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1 elderovl] stat buff     • Restores 70 + 35% of their max [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] points (416 at 99) instantly     • Restores 600 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] over 6 minutes     • Protects from dragonfire, wyrmfire, and poison

​

Adrenaline Potions

Adrenaline Potions
⬥ Cannot boost to make adrenaline potions ⬥ All have a 2min cooldown on adren generation effect
List of Notable Adrenaline Potions
⬥ Adrenaline Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705731118006544.png?v=1 adrenalinepotion], 84 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore] - Generates 25% adrenaline ⬥ Adrenaline Renewal Potion [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal], 115 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore] (cheaper at 119 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1 Herblore])     • Can request assistance to make     • Generates 4% adrenaline per tick for 10 ticks (40% total)          - Excluding sip tick, you cannot use the 4% gained until the next tick     • Made using [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705731118006544.png?v=1 adrenalinepotion]

Bombs

Bombs
⬥ Bombs apply their effects 3t (1.8s) after being thrown ⬥ Bombs have a cast range of 9 tiles and spread over a 3x3 area
Ways to Throw Bombs
1) Option 1: Default Action Bar Mode - Throws at target     • Does not show quantity on action bar 2) Option 2: Targeted Action Bar Mode - Throws at selected tile     • This allows for pre-bombing     • Shows quantity on action bar 3) Click from inventory - Throws at target
List of Notable Bombs
⬥ Vulnerability Bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1 vulnbomb] - applies [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] (10% damage increase)     • Casts [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1 Vuln] 3 times, once every 0.6s     • Hitchance is equal to current accuracy against target ⬥ Sticky Bomb [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1 stickybomb] - binds monsters standing in it (lasts 6s)

​

Incense Sticks

Incense Sticks
⬥ Refer to specific boss guides to see stick usage ⬥ Each stick increases buff duration by 10 min, capping at 60 minutes ⬥ Potency has 4 ranks, increasing by 1 every 10 min (maxes out after 30 min)     • Use 6 sticks to 'overload' and start at rank 4 potency (starts at 10 min) ⬥ At 95 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1011705727041163396.png?v=1 firemaking] you can have 3 incense effects active at once
Notable Incense Sticks
⬥ Spirit Weed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1 SpiritSticks] - (10 * potency)% increased [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning] spec attack recovery rate ⬥ Kwuarm [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1 KwuarmSticks] - Deal +(2.5 * potency)% poison damage ⬥ Irit [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265371144202.png?v=1 IritSticks] - (25 * potency)% poison damage reduction ⬥ Lantadyme [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1 LantaSticks] - Increases timed potion durations by (0.5 * Potency)min ⬥ Fellstalk [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690987265421213746.png?v=1 FellstalkSticks] - Potency% increased chance for spawning elite [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1 slayer] mobs

​

Prayer Powders

Powders
⬥ Each powder increases buff duration by 30 min, capping at 60 minutes
Notable Powders
⬥ Penance [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1 powderofpenance] - Restores [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1 prayer] points equal to 2.5% of damage received ⬥ Item Protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953716908269598.png?v=1 powderofitemprotection] - 1 more item protected with Protect Item [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010486261682810891.png?v=1 protectitem]     • You can still only protect 5 items max ⬥ Protection [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1 powderofprotection] - boosts protection prayers/curses from 50% to 60%     • Does not stack with similar effects from [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] / [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos]

​

Familiars

Familiars
⬥ This will just categorise familiars, for more info refer to the [https://runescape.wiki/ Wiki] ⬥ Use !familiar for a rough idea of where to use each familiar ⬥ Refer to specific boss guides to see explicit familiar usage
Notable Familiars
⬥ Nihil [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1 bloodnihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1 shadownihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1 smokenihil] - Accuracy Buff ⬥ Ripper Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch] - DPS ⬥ Kal'gerion Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch] - Crit Buff ⬥ Hellhound [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch] - Tank ⬥ Pack Mammoth [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1 mammothpouch] - Beast of Burden / Tank

​

Ammo

Notable Ammo
⬥ For more info on ammo effects, refer on the [https://runescape.wiki/ Wiki] ⬥ Use !ammo to see what ammo to use where ⬥ Use !quiver to see Pernix Quiver setups ⬥ Both the Elite Seer's Diary and Ranged Skillcape increase bolt proc chance
Bakriminel Bolts (e)
⬥ Ruby [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1 RubyBakri] - use !ruby for details ⬥ Hydrix [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/550834403136503822.png?v=1 HydrixBakri] ⬥ Dragonstone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489144852511.png?v=1 DragonstoneBakri] ⬥ Onyx [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489362956308.png?v=1 OnyxBakri] ⬥ Emerald [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/866551637714665484.png?v=1 emeraldbakri]
Special Arrows
⬥ Black Stone [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1 blackstonearrow] ⬥ Deathspore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1 deathsporearrows] ⬥ Splintering [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234246299649.png?v=1 splinteringarrows] ⬥ Bik [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697235689513.png?v=1 bikarrow] ⬥ Ful [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1 fularrow] ⬥ Jas Demonbane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697055334491.png?v=1 jasdemonbanearrow] ⬥ Jas Dragonbane [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1 jasdragonbanearrow] ⬥ Wen [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1 wenarrow]

​

Pocket slot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439482638346.png?v=1 SaraBook]

Notable Pocket Slots
⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the [https://runescape.wiki/ Wiki] ⬥ Use !pocketslot to see what pocket slots to use
Upkeep Costs of Various Notable Pocket Slots

Banking Preset

⬥ Use !banking ‎or check [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]]

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide lists the general list of free and skilling upgrades.

​

Disclaimer

These are worth looking at before looking at style specific upgrade orders.

​

As prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands, other unlocks may be added to this list at any time.

​

Free & Cheap Upgrades

Feel free to ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] if unsure where upgrades are relevant for content that you do!

​

For a checklist version, visit the RS Wiki page at [https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order].

​

Tier 1

Worth obtaining ASAP - Severe Hindrance to PvM without these

⬥ At least level 90 in your relevant combat style

⬥ Ring of Vigour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1 rov] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1 dungtoken] 50,000

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can convert into a passive after [https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction Extinction] with a [https://runescape.wiki/w/warped_gem warped gem]

⬥ [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005552207824953456.png?v=1 defencemastercape] Defence 99 cape - provides a sign of life once per hour

⬥ Level 95 Prayer and [https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Temple_at_Senntisten The Temple at Senntisten] quest for [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1 soulsplit] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1 torment] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1 anguish] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1 turmoil]

⬥ Level 99 Herblore [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1 elderovlsalve] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can boost from 99 to make Elder Overloads with the aid of pulse cores, and can request assistance to make [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1 adrenrenewal]

​

Style Specific:

⬥ Sunshine [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1 sunshine] , Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1 deathsswift]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These both come from the world wakes

⬥ Style-specific Skillcapes - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 99,000

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Strength (99) - extend Dismember [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1 dismember] duration

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attack (120) - +2% increased hit chance

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged (99) - +20% ammo special effect procs

⬥ Melee "utility" specs

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon battleaxe [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1 dba] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 115,000

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon scimitar [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1 dragonscimitar] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 125,000

​

Tier 2

Work towards these after finishing tier 1 unlocks

⬥ Entry Level Perks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1 ancientweapongizmo] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Refer to [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] for setups as well as cost

⬥ Berserker's Fury [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1 berserkersfury] (56 Archaeology [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology])

⬥ 112 Archaeology [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1 archaeology] (refer to !relic ‎for setups)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Will need to use [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450653390360626.png?v=1 pulsecore] boosts to unlock 650 energy and certain relics.

⬥ Claim the [https://runescape.wiki/w/Codex_Ultimatus Codex Ultimatus] to unlock [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1 shadowtend] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1 smoketendrils]

⬥ Totem of Vitality [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1 vitalitytotem] (85 Agility, 90 Slayer)

⬥ 120 combat stats (refer to [https://pvme.io/guides/?category=Slayer Slayer guides] for methods)

​

Tier 3

Get these when you can

⬥ Summoning [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1 Summoning], notable milestones are:

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 45 for Hellhound [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1 hellhoundpouch]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 73 for Blood Reaver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1 reaverpouch]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 87 for Nihils [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1 shadownihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1 smokenihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1 icenihil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1 bloodnihil]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 90 for Kal'gerion Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1 kalgpouch]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 96 for Ripper Demon [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1 ripperpouch]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use !familiar ‎to see where to use what familiar

⬥ Asylum Surgeon's Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1 asr]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a good all round ring for all styles.

⬥ Zorgoth's Soul Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1 zorgothsring] (Necromancy [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1 necromancy] only)

​

Other

As soon as you are able to get these, get them.

⬥ Zuk Capes [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1 igneouskalxil] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1 igneouskalmej] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1 igneouskalmor] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1 igneouskalzuk] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1 igneouskalket]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can kill Zuk 4 times in one style to get all the capes

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is usually recommended around t85 gear

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The hardmode cape is not needed, and is mainly a quality of life upgrade

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction & Disclaimer

This guide lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.

​

Last Revised: 26th October 2026

The order is subject to change at any time as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands

​

Please note the following assumptions:

⬥ The order assume a starting point of T70 gear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643151011199975434.png?v=1 subjgarb]

⬥ Priorities may be different if you are doing niche content

⬥ "ROI" (meaning return-on-investment) typically means quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase

⬥ We do not recommend selling an item to buy another, unless it is a direct upgrade

⬥ Unlisted items are not worth buying

​

Feel free to ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] for a tailored list to the content that you do!

​

Magic Upgrade Order

For further information on each upgrade, check [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]], [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] and [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]], [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Permanent Unlocks|Permanent Unlocks]], or [[PvME/Combat reference/Eof Specs|Eof Specs]]

⬥ Tumeken's resplendence boots + gloves + helm - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 173,973,721 + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 157,234,218 + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 172,328,089

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

​

Introduction & Disclaimer

This guide lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.

​

Last Revised: 23rd October 2026

The order is subject to change at any time as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands

​

Please note the following assumptions:

⬥ The order assume a starting point of T70 gear [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442182029382.png?v=1 dharokaxe] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643151021748518917.png?v=1 bandoschest]

⬥ Priorities may be different if you are doing niche content

⬥ "ROI" (meaning return-on-investment) typically means quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase

⬥ We do not recommend selling an item to buy another, unless it is a direct upgrade

⬥ Unlisted items are not worth buying

​

Feel free to ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] for a tailored list to the content that you do!

​

Melee Upgrade Order

For further information on each upgrade, check [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]], [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] and [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]], [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Permanent Unlocks|Permanent Unlocks]], or [[PvME/Combat reference/Eof Specs|Eof Specs]]

Kili's Tasks

Upon reaching level 70 you have the option to choose your path between power and tank armour. Completing either branch allows you to also create the same tier weaponry.

​

⬥ Deathdealer [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783479810117702.png?v=1 dealerhood80] - experienced players

⬥ Deathwarden [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142782592878387321.png?v=1 wardenhood80] - less experienced players

​

⬥ Scripture of Ful [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 117,685,383

⬥ Essence of Finality (with T70 Death Guard) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1 eofblack] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1 deathguard70] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 163,544,923

⬥ Divert [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 22,178,750

⬥ T90 Flanking switch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809239255658587.png?v=1 skulllantern90] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 5,476,693

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Perked with Flanking 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1 flank4]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Primarily for group based content, with some niche solo uses, skip if these do not pertain to you.

⬥ Equilibrium 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1 eq4] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 134,937,162

⬥ Shard of Genesis Essence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1 shardofgenesisessence] (1 covers both [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1 omniguard] and [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern]) - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 631,546,595

⬥ Ruination [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1 ruination] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 647,519,856

⬥ Vital Drain [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1554518117550395422.png?v=1 vitaldrain] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 158,609,796

⬥ Devourer's Nexus [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511690281320498.png?v=1 devourersnexus] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 19,832,576

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a higher priority if primarily doing group content

⬥ Misalionar's Death Mask [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178019159838720.png?v=1 visageofthefirstnecromancer] and Cinderbane Gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 Cinderbanes] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 362,093,491 + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 41,219,331

⬥ Deathtouch Bracelet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159429271562.png?v=1 dtb] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 34,498,346

⬥ Upgrade to T100 Flanking switch [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1 soulboundlantern]- [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 473,487,016

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Optionally dyed [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1365390498369372230.png?v=1 barrowssoulbound] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 532,294,405

⬥ Invoke Arisen Flesh [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1563943555683197019.png?v=1 invokearisenflesh] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 56,558,249

[[PvME|PvME guide index]]

Introduction

This guide lists the general natural combat style progression template for players to follow.

Last Revised: 15 April 2026

​

Disclaimer

Before looking here, check [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Free Upgrades|Free Upgrades]].

​

Priorities can of course change depending on the content being done by the player. You should note that when you upgrade weapons, you can sell the weapon being upgraded to deduct cost from the new weapon.

​

If an item is not in the order it was deemed not worth buying.

​

As prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands, the order is subject to change at any time.

​

Feel free to ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)] for a tailored list for the content that you do!

​

Early Money Making

To make money to fund your first style early on, it is recommended to do either Croesus or easy clue scrolls.

​

Ranged Upgrade Order

This is a generalised order which assumes a starting point of T70 weapons and armour.

​

For further information on each upgrade check the relevant section in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Armour And Weapons|Armour And Weapons]], [[PvME/Invention perks/Perks|Perks]] and [[PvME/Invention perks/Perk Information|Perk Information]], [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Permanent Unlocks|Permanent Unlocks]], or [[PvME/Combat reference/Eof Specs|Eof Specs]].

​

For a checklist version, visit the RS Wiki page at [https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order].

​

If you would like specialised advice, ask in [https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/656898197561802760 PvM help (external Discord)].

​

Stage 1: No Real Variance Based on Content

⬥ Decimation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 29,979,206

⬥ Planted Feet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1 pf] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 6,139,820

⬥ T90 Sirenic Armour [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1 sirenicbody] + Nightmare Gauntlets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 nightmaregauntlets] + Fleeting Boots [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813993480388640.png?v=1 fleetingboots] with Entry Level Perks [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1 ancientarmourgizmo] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 14,469,946

⬥ Cinderbane Gloves [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1 Cinderbanes] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 41,219,331

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip if mostly doing poison-immune content.

⬥ Scripture of Jas [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1 scriptureofjas] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 2,468,912

⬥ Amulet of Souls [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1 aos] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 38,647,279

⬥ Pernix's Quiver [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1 pernixsquiver] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 59,998,701

​

At this point try to finish the majority of unlocks in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Free Upgrades|Free Upgrades]].

​

Stage 2: Some Variance Based on Content/Wealth

All other upgrades in [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Free Upgrades|Free Upgrades]].

⬥ Divert [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1 divert] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 22,178,750

⬥ Greater Ricochet [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1 grico] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 284,686,093

⬥ Gloomfire Bow [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 191,671,259

⬥ Bow of the Last Guardian [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 1,443,353,956

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Add [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1 gloomfirebow] into [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412727242773.png?v=1 eofgreen] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 163,544,923

⬥ Eldritch Crossbow (Essence of Finality) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1 ecb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412865523722.png?v=1 eofpink] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 1,080,899,164

⬥ Seren Godbow (Essence of Finality) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1 sgb] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412906680330.png?v=1 eofblue] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 780,955,877

⬥ Best-in-slot weapon perks

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• P6C1 AS4E2 for 2H weapons [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1 p6] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953962207957162.png?v=1 caroming1] + [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1 as4] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1 er2] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 77,004,695

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AS4 is a very strong perk in its own right. If you fail going for AS4E2, feel free to use AS4 in its place for the time being.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon getting Aftershock you'll now need it on all of your weapons for that style

⬥ Decimation (Essence of Finality) [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1 decimation] [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1 eof] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 163,544,923

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip if not doing AoE content

⬥ T90 Dracolich [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717045412180019.png?v=1 dracolichbody] Armour - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 218,339,820

⬥ Stalker's Ring [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943601029120.png?v=1 stalkerring] + Enchantment of Shadows [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481313190129694.png?v=1 enchantmentofshadows] + Biting 4 [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1 biting4] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 234,064,167

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To make use of this ring, it is important to replace the Equilibrium perk with the Biting perk.

⬥ T92 Elite Dracolich [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717430436704306.png?v=1 edracobody] Armour - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 939,900,269

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only upgrade to the full set all at once.

⬥ Scripture of Ful [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1 scriptureofful] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 117,685,383

​

Stage 3: Pretty Low ROI

⬥ Greater Death's Swiftness [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1 gdeathsswift]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If purchasing from GE - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 84,752,097

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If crafting - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 34,594,991

⬥ Enhanced Nightmare Gauntlets [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159441723392.png?v=1 nightmaregauntlets] + Enchantment of Dread [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481315199209524.png?v=1 enchantmentofdread] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 82,981,413

⬥ Shard of Genesis Essence [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1 shardofgenesisessence] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 631,546,595

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use on [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1 bolg]

⬥ Desolation [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1 Desolation] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 647,519,856

⬥ Erethdor's Grimoire [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1 grim] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 120,654,238

⬥ Corruption Shot [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1 corruptshot] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 32,498,144

⬥ Limitless [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1 limitless] - [https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1 coins] 129,670,000

​

Reminder - [[PvME/Gear upgrades/Ranged upgrade order#disclaimer|Disclaimer]]

​

Common Mistakes to Avoid
